hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah forbade facing the Qiblah when urinating. But I saw him, one year before he died, facing the Qiblah (while urinating)."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وَهْبُ بْنُ جَرِيرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي قَالَ، سَمِعْتُ مُحَمَّدَ بْنَ إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ أَبَانَ بْنِ صَالِحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَنْ نَسْتَقْبِلَ الْقِبْلَةَ بِبَوْلٍ فَرَأَيْتُهُ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُقْبَضَ بِعَامٍ يَسْتَقْبِلُهَا .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 325

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 326

chapter.englishTitle: Making sure of being free (of urine) after urinating

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from 'Eisa bin Yazdad Al-Yamani that his father said:
                      "The Messenger of Allah said: 'When anyone of you urinates, let him squeeze his penis three times (to remove the remaining urine drops)." (Da'if)
Another chain with similar wording.
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from 'Eisa bin Yazdad Al-Yamani that his father said:
hadiths.body:
"The Messenger of Allah said: 'When anyone of you urinates, let him squeeze his penis three times (to remove the remaining urine drops)." (Da'if)
Another chain with similar wording.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا زَمْعَةُ بْنُ صَالِحٍ، عَنْ عِيسَى بْنِ يَزْدَادَ الْيَمَانِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " إِذَا بَالَ أَحَدُكُمْ فَلْيَنْتُرْ ذَكَرَهُ ثَلاَثَ مَرَّاتٍ " .    قَالَ أَبُو الْحَسَنِ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا زَمْعَةُ، فَذَكَرَ نَحْوَهُ .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 326

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 327

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَنْ بَالَ وَلَمْ يَمَسَّ مَاءً
chapter.englishTitle: One who urinated and did not touch water

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that 'Aishah said:
                      "The Prophet went out to urinate, and 'Umar followed him with water. He said: 'What is this, O 'Umar?' He said: 'Water.' He said: 'I have not been commanded to perform ablution every time I urinate. If I did that it would have become a Sunnah.'"
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that 'Aishah said:
hadiths.body: "The Prophet went out to urinate, and 'Umar followed him with water. He said: 'What is this, O 'Umar?' He said: 'Water.' He said: 'I have not been commanded to perform ablution every time I urinate. If I did that it would have become a Sunnah.'"
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ يَحْيَى التَّوْأَمِ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي مُلَيْكَةَ، عَنْ أُمِّهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتِ انْطَلَقَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ يَبُولُ فَاتَّبَعَهُ عُمَرُ بِمَاءٍ فَقَالَ " مَا هَذَا يَا عُمَرُ " . قَالَ مَاءٌ . قَالَ " مَا أُمِرْتُ كُلَّمَا بُلْتُ أَنْ أَتَوَضَّأَ وَلَوْ فَعَلْتُ لَكَانَتْ سُنَّةً " .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 327

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 328

chapter.arabicTitle: باب النَّهْىِ عَنِ الْخَلاَءِ عَلَى قَارِعَةِ الطَّرِيقِ
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of relieving oneself in the middle of the road

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Sa'eed Al-Himyari narrated that :
                      Mu'adh bin Jabal used to narrate something that the Companions of the Messenger of Allah had not heard, and he used to keep quiet about what they had heard. News of this report reached 'Abdullah bin 'Amr, and he said: "By Allah, I never heard the Messenger of Allah say this, and Mu'adh will put you into difficulty with regard to relieving yourself." News of that reached Mu'adh, so he met with him ('Abdullah). Mu'adh said: "O 'Abdullah! Denying a Hadith from the Messenger of Allah is hypocrisy, and its sn is upon the one who said it (if it is not true). I did indeed hear the Messenger of Allah say: 'Beware of the three things which provoke curses: Relieving oneself in watering places, in places of shade and in the middle of the street.'"
hadiths.narrator: Abu Sa'eed Al-Himyari narrated that :
hadiths.body: Mu'adh bin Jabal used to narrate something that the Companions of the Messenger of Allah had not heard, and he used to keep quiet about what they had heard. News of this report reached 'Abdullah bin 'Amr, and he said: "By Allah, I never heard the Messenger of Allah say this, and Mu'adh will put you into difficulty with regard to relieving yourself." News of that reached Mu'adh, so he met with him ('Abdullah). Mu'adh said: "O 'Abdullah! Denying a Hadith from the Messenger of Allah is hypocrisy, and its sn is upon the one who said it (if it is not true). I did indeed hear the Messenger of Allah say: 'Beware of the three things which provoke curses: Relieving oneself in watering places, in places of shade and in the middle of the street.'"
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي نَافِعُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ، عَنْ حَيْوَةَ بْنِ شُرَيْحٍ، أَنَّ أَبَا سَعِيدٍ الْحِمْيَرِيَّ، حَدَّثَهُ قَالَ كَانَ مُعَاذُ بْنُ جَبَلٍ يَتَحَدَّثُ بِمَا لَمْ يَسْمَعْ أَصْحَابُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَيَسْكُتُ عَمَّا سَمِعُوا فَبَلَغَ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عَمْرٍو مَا يَتَحَدَّثُ بِهِ فَقَالَ وَاللَّهِ مَا سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ هَذَا وَأَوْشَكَ مُعَاذٌ أَنْ يَفْتِنَكُمْ فِي الْخَلاَءِ . فَبَلَغَ ذَلِكَ مُعَاذًا فَلَقِيَهُ فَقَالَ مُعَاذٌ يَا عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عَمْرٍو إِنَّ التَّكْذِيبَ بِحَدِيثٍ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ نِفَاقٌ وَإِنَّمَا إِثْمُهُ عَلَى مَنْ قَالَهُ لَقَدْ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ  " اتَّقُوا الْمَلاَعِنَ الثَّلاَثَ الْبَرَازَ فِي الْمَوَارِدِ وَالظِّلِّ وَقَارِعَةِ الطَّرِيقِ " .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 328

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 329

chapter.arabicTitle: باب النَّهْىِ عَنِ الْخَلاَءِ عَلَى قَارِعَةِ الطَّرِيقِ
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of relieving oneself in the middle of the road

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Jabir bin 'Abdullah said:
                      "The Messenger of Allah said: 'Beware of stopping to rest and praying in the middle of the road, for it is the refuge of snakes and carnivorous animals, and beware of relieving yourselves in the middle of the road, for this is an act that provokes curses.'"
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Jabir bin 'Abdullah said:
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah said: 'Beware of stopping to rest and praying in the middle of the road, for it is the refuge of snakes and carnivorous animals, and beware of relieving yourselves in the middle of the road, for this is an act that provokes curses.'"
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ زُهَيْرٍ، قَالَ قَالَ سَالِمٌ سَمِعْتُ الْحَسَنَ، يَقُولُ حَدَّثَنَا جَابِرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " إِيَّاكُمْ وَالتَّعْرِيسَ عَلَى جَوَادِّ الطَّرِيقِ وَالصَّلاَةَ عَلَيْهَا فَإِنَّهَا مَأْوَى الْحَيَّاتِ وَالسِّبَاعِ وَقَضَاءَ الْحَاجَةِ عَلَيْهَا فَإِنَّهَا مِنَ الْمَلاَعِنِ " .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 329

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 330

chapter.arabicTitle: باب النَّهْىِ عَنِ الْخَلاَءِ عَلَى قَارِعَةِ الطَّرِيقِ
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of relieving oneself in the middle of the road

hadiths.englishRaw:
Salim narrated from his father that:
                      The Prophet forbade praying in the middle of the road, or defecating there, or urinating.
hadiths.narrator: Salim narrated from his father that:
hadiths.body: The Prophet forbade praying in the middle of the road, or defecating there, or urinating.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ خَالِدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ لَهِيعَةَ، عَنْ قُرَّةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ نَهَى أَنْ يُصَلَّى عَلَى قَارِعَةِ الطَّرِيقِ أَوْ يُضْرَبَ الْخَلاَءُ عَلَيْهَا أَوْ يُبَالَ فِيهَا .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 330

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 331

chapter.englishTitle: Distancing oneself for defecating outside

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Mugirah bin Shu'bah said:
                      "Whenever the Prophet went to relieve himself, he would go far away."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Mugirah bin Shu'bah said:
hadiths.body: "Whenever the Prophet went to relieve himself, he would go far away."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ بْنِ شُعْبَةَ، قَالَ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ إِذَا ذَهَبَ الْمَذْهَبَ أَبْعَدَ .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 331

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 332

chapter.englishTitle: Distancing oneself for defecating outside

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Anas said:
                      "I was with the Prophet on a journey. He went away to relieve himself, then he came and called for water and performed ablution."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Anas said:
hadiths.body: "I was with the Prophet on a journey. He went away to relieve himself, then he came and called for water and performed ablution."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ عُبَيْدٍ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْمُثَنَّى، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ الْخُرَاسَانِيِّ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ كُنْتُ مَعَ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ فِي سَفَرٍ فَتَنَحَّى لِحَاجَتِهِ ثُمَّ جَاءَ فَدَعَا بِوَضُوءٍ فَتَوَضَّأَ .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 332

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 333

chapter.englishTitle: Distancing oneself for defecating outside

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Ya'la bin Murrah that:
                      When the Prophet went to relieve himself, he would go far away.
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Ya'la bin Murrah that:
hadiths.body: When the Prophet went to relieve himself, he would go far away.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ كَاسِبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سُلَيْمٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ خُثَيْمٍ، عَنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ خَبَّابٍ، عَنْ يَعْلَى بْنِ مُرَّةَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ كَانَ إِذَا ذَهَبَ إِلَى الْغَائِطِ أَبْعَدَ .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 333

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 334

chapter.englishTitle: Distancing oneself for defecating outside

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that 'Abdur-Rahman bin Abu Qurad said:
                      "I went for Hajj with the Prophet and he went far away to relieve himself."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that 'Abdur-Rahman bin Abu Qurad said:
hadiths.body: "I went for Hajj with the Prophet and he went far away to relieve himself."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الْقَطَّانُ، عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ الْخَطْمِيِّ، - قَالَ أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ وَاسْمُهُ عُمَيْرُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ - عَنْ عُمَارَةَ بْنِ خُزَيْمَةَ، وَالْحَارِثِ بْنِ فُضَيْلٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي قُرَادٍ، قَالَ حَجَجْتُ مَعَ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ فَذَهَبَ لِحَاجَتِهِ فَأَبْعَدَ .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 334

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 335

chapter.englishTitle: Distancing oneself for defecating outside

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Jabir said:
                      "We went out on a journey with the Messenger of Allah, and the Messenger of Allah would not relieve himself until he had disappeared and could not be seen by anyone."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Jabir said:
hadiths.body: "We went out on a journey with the Messenger of Allah, and the Messenger of Allah would not relieve himself until he had disappeared and could not be seen by anyone."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى، أَنْبَأَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ خَرَجْنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فِي سَفَرٍ وَكَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ لاَ يَأْتِي الْبَرَازَ حَتَّى يَتَغَيَّبَ فَلاَ يُرَى .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 335

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 336

chapter.englishTitle: Distancing oneself for defecating outside

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Bilal bin Al-Harith Al-Muzani that:
                      When the Messenger of Allah wanted to relieve himself, he would go far away.
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Bilal bin Al-Harith Al-Muzani that:
hadiths.body: When the Messenger of Allah wanted to relieve himself, he would go far away.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا الْعَبَّاسُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْعَظِيمِ الْعَنْبَرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ كَثِيرِ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا كَثِيرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْمُزَنِيُّ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ، عَنْ بِلاَلِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ الْمُزَنِيِّ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ كَانَ إِذَا أَرَادَ الْحَاجَةَ أَبْعَدَ .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 336

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 337

chapter.englishTitle: Looking for a place to defecate or urinate

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that:
                      The Prophet ﷺ said: "Whoever uses stones to clean himself, let him use an odd number of stones. Whoever does that has done well, and whoever does not, there is no harm in it. Whoever uses a tooth stick should spit out (whatever he removes) and whoever removes (the particle of food) by dislodging it with his tongue should swallow it. Whoever does that has done well, and whoever does not, tere is no harm in it. Whoever goes to the toilet should conceal himself, and if he cannot find anything except a pile of sand (behind which to conceal himself), then he should use that, for the Shaitan plays with the backside of the son of Adam. Whoever does that has done well, and whoever does not, there is no harm in it."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that:
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ said: "Whoever uses stones to clean himself, let him use an odd number of stones. Whoever does that has done well, and whoever does not, there is no harm in it. Whoever uses a tooth stick should spit out (whatever he removes) and whoever removes (the particle of food) by dislodging it with his tongue should swallow it. Whoever does that has done well, and whoever does not, tere is no harm in it. Whoever goes to the toilet should conceal himself, and if he cannot find anything except a pile of sand (behind which to conceal himself), then he should use that, for the Shaitan plays with the backside of the son of Adam. Whoever does that has done well, and whoever does not, there is no harm in it."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ بْنُ الصَّبَّاحِ، حَدَّثَنَا ثَوْرُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ، عَنْ حُصَيْنٍ الْحِمْيَرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدِ الْخَيْرِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ  " مَنِ اسْتَجْمَرَ فَلْيُوتِرْ مَنْ فَعَلَ ذَلِكَ فَقَدْ أَحْسَنَ وَمَنْ لاَ فَلاَ حَرَجَ وَمَنْ تَخَلَّلَ فَلْيَلْفِظْ وَمَنْ لاَكَ فَلْيَبْتَلِعْ مَنْ فَعَلَ ذَلِكَ فَقَدْ أَحْسَنَ وَمَنْ لاَ فَلاَ حَرَجَ وَمَنْ أَتَى الْخَلاَءَ فَلْيَسْتَتِرْ فَإِنْ لَمْ يَجِدْ إِلاَّ كَثِيبًا مِنْ رَمْلٍ فَلْيَمْدُدْهُ عَلَيْهِ فَإِنَّ الشَّيْطَانَ يَلْعَبُ بِمَقَاعِدِ ابْنِ آدَمَ مَنْ فَعَلَ فَقَدْ أَحْسَنَ وَمَنْ لاَ فَلاَ حَرَجَ " .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 337

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 338

chapter.englishTitle: Looking for a place to defecate or urinate

hadiths.englishRaw:
A similar report was narrated by 'Abdul-Malik bin As-Sabbah with a similar chain, with the additional words:
                      "Whoever applies kohl to his eyes, let him add it an odd number of times. Whoever does that has done well, and whoever does not, there is no harm in it. And whoever dislodges (a particle of food from between the teeth) by dislodging it with his tongue, let him swallow it."
hadiths.narrator: A similar report was narrated by 'Abdul-Malik bin As-Sabbah with a similar chain, with the additional words:
hadiths.body: "Whoever applies kohl to his eyes, let him add it an odd number of times. Whoever does that has done well, and whoever does not, there is no harm in it. And whoever dislodges (a particle of food from between the teeth) by dislodging it with his tongue, let him swallow it."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ بْنُ الصَّبَّاحِ، بِإِسْنَادِهِ نَحْوَهُ وَزَادَ فِيهِ  " وَمَنِ اكْتَحَلَ فَلْيُوتِرْ مَنْ فَعَلَ فَقَدْ أَحْسَنَ وَمَنْ لاَ فَلاَ حَرَجَ وَمَنْ لاَكَ فَلْيَبْتَلِعْ " .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 338

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 339

chapter.englishTitle: Looking for a place to defecate or urinate

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Ya'la bin Murrah that his father said:
                      "I was with the Prophet on a journey, and he wanted to relieve himself. He said to me: 'Go to those two small date-palm trees and tell them: "The Messenger of Allah orders you to come together.'" So they came together and he concealed himself behind them, and relieved himself. Then he said to me: 'Go to them and tell them: "Go back, each one of you, to your places.'" So I said that to them and they went back."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Ya'la bin Murrah that his father said:
hadiths.body: "I was with the Prophet on a journey, and he wanted to relieve himself. He said to me: 'Go to those two small date-palm trees and tell them: "The Messenger of Allah orders you to come together.'" So they came together and he concealed himself behind them, and relieved himself. Then he said to me: 'Go to them and tell them: "Go back, each one of you, to your places.'" So I said that to them and they went back."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنِ الْمِنْهَالِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو، عَنْ يَعْلَى بْنِ مُرَّةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ كُنْتُ مَعَ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ فِي سَفَرٍ فَأَرَادَ أَنْ يَقْضِيَ حَاجَتَهُ فَقَالَ لِي " ائْتِ تِلْكَ الأَشَاءَتَيْنِ " . - قَالَ وَكِيعٌ يَعْنِي النَّخْلَ الصِّغَارَ . قَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ الْقِصَارَ - " فَقُلْ لَهُمَا إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَأْمُرُكُمَا أَنْ تَجْتَمِعَا " . فَاجْتَمَعَتَا فَاسْتَتَرَ بِهِمَا فَقَضَى حَاجَتَهُ ثُمَّ قَالَ لِي " ائْتِهِمَا فَقُلْ لَهُمَا لِتَرْجِعْ كُلُّ وَاحِدَةٍ مِنْكُمَا إِلَى مَكَانِهَا " . فَقُلْتُ لَهُمَا فَرَجَعَتَا .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 339

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 340

chapter.englishTitle: Looking for a place to defecate or urinate

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that 'Abdullah bin Ja'far said:
                      "The thing that the Prophet most liked to conceal himself behind when relieving himself was a hillock or a stand of date-palm trees."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that 'Abdullah bin Ja'far said:
hadiths.body: "The thing that the Prophet most liked to conceal himself behind when relieving himself was a hillock or a stand of date-palm trees."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا مَهْدِيُّ بْنُ مَيْمُونٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَبِي يَعْقُوبَ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ، قَالَ كَانَ أَحَبَّ مَا اسْتَتَرَ بِهِ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ لِحَاجَتِهِ هَدَفٌ أَوْ حَائِشُ نَخْلٍ .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 340

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 341

chapter.englishTitle: Looking for a place to defecate or urinate

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Ibn 'Abbas said:
                      "The Messenger of Allah turned towards a mountain pass and urinated, until I took pity on him because of the way he parted his legs when he urinated."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Ibn 'Abbas said:
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah turned towards a mountain pass and urinated, until I took pity on him because of the way he parted his legs when he urinated."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَقِيلِ بْنِ خُوَيْلِدٍ، حَدَّثَنِي حَفْصُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنِي إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ طَهْمَانَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ ذَكْوَانَ، عَنْ يَعْلَى بْنِ حَكِيمٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ عَدَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ إِلَى الشِّعْبِ فَبَالَ حَتَّى أَنِّي آوِي لَهُ مِنْ فَكِّ وَرِكَيْهِ حِينَ بَالَ .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 341

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 342

chapter.arabicTitle: باب النَّهْىِ عَنْ الاِجْتِمَاعِ، عَلَى الْخَلاَءِ وَالْحَدِيثِ عِنْدَهُ
chapter.englishTitle: The prohibition of gathering or talking at the toilet

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Sa`eed al-Khudri that:
                      The Messenger of Allah said: "No two people should converse while relieving themselves, each of them looking at the private parts of the other, for Allah, the Mighty and Sublime, hates that." (Da'if)
Other chains with similar wording.
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Sa`eed al-Khudri that:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah said: "No two people should converse while relieving themselves, each of them looking at the private parts of the other, for Allah, the Mighty and Sublime, hates that." (Da'if)
Other chains with similar wording.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ رَجَاءٍ، أَنْبَأَنَا عِكْرِمَةُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، عَنْ هِلاَلِ بْنِ عِيَاضٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ  " لاَ يَتَنَاجَى اثْنَانِ عَلَى غَائِطِهِمَا يَنْظُرُ كُلُّ وَاحِدٍ مِنْهُمَا إِلَى عَوْرَةِ صَاحِبِهِ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ يَمْقُتُ عَلَى ذَلِكَ " .  حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا سَلْمُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الْوَرَّاقُ، حَدَّثَنَا عِكْرِمَةُ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، عَنْ عِيَاضِ بْنِ هِلاَلٍ، . قَالَ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى هُوَ الصَّوَابُ .    حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ أَبِي بَكْرٍ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ الثَّوْرِيِّ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، عَنْ عِيَاضِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، نَحْوَهُ .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 342

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 343

chapter.arabicTitle: باب النَّهْىِ عَنِ الْبَوْلِ فِي الْمَاءِ الرَّاكِدِ
chapter.englishTitle: The prohibition of urinating into standing water

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Jabir that:
                      The Messenger of Allah forbade urinating into standing water.
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Jabir that:
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah forbade urinating into standing water.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رُمْحٍ، أَنْبَأَنَا اللَّيْثُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَنَّهُ نَهَى عَنْ أَنْ يُبَالَ فِي الْمَاءِ الرَّاكِدِ .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 343

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 344

chapter.arabicTitle: باب النَّهْىِ عَنِ الْبَوْلِ فِي الْمَاءِ الرَّاكِدِ
chapter.englishTitle: The prohibition of urinating into standing water

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Abu Hurairah said:
                      "The Messenger of Allah said: 'No one among you should urinate into standing water.'"
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Abu Hurairah said:
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah said: 'No one among you should urinate into standing water.'"
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو خَالِدٍ الأَحْمَرُ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَجْلاَنَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " لاَ يَبُولَنَّ أَحَدُكُمْ فِي الْمَاءِ الرَّاكِدِ " .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 344

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 345

chapter.arabicTitle: باب النَّهْىِ عَنِ الْبَوْلِ فِي الْمَاءِ الرَّاكِدِ
chapter.englishTitle: The prohibition of urinating into standing water

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Ibn 'Umar said:
                      "The Messenger of Allah said: 'No one among you should urinate into standing water.'"
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Ibn 'Umar said:
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah said: 'No one among you should urinate into standing water.'"
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَمْزَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي فَرْوَةَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " لاَ يَبُولَنَّ أَحَدُكُمْ فِي الْمَاءِ النَّاقِعِ " .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 345

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 346

chapter.englishTitle: Strictness concerning urination

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that `Abdur-Rahman bin Hasanah said:
                      "The Messenger of Allah came out to us holding a small shield in his hand. He put it down, then he sat down and urinated towards it. Some of the people said: 'Look at him, he urinates like a woman!' The Prophet heard that and said: 'Woe to you! Do you not know what happened to one of the children of Israel? If any urine touched any part of their clothes, they would cut that out with scissors. He told them not to do that, so he was tormented in his grave.'" (Da'if)
Another chain with similar wording.
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that `Abdur-Rahman bin Hasanah said:
hadiths.body:
"The Messenger of Allah came out to us holding a small shield in his hand. He put it down, then he sat down and urinated towards it. Some of the people said: 'Look at him, he urinates like a woman!' The Prophet heard that and said: 'Woe to you! Do you not know what happened to one of the children of Israel? If any urine touched any part of their clothes, they would cut that out with scissors. He told them not to do that, so he was tormented in his grave.'" (Da'if)
Another chain with similar wording.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ وَهْبٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ ابْنِ حَسَنَةَ، قَالَ خَرَجَ عَلَيْنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَفِي يَدِهِ الدَّرَقَةُ فَوَضَعَهَا ثُمَّ جَلَسَ فَبَالَ إِلَيْهَا فَقَالَ بَعْضُهُمُ انْظُرُوا إِلَيْهِ يَبُولُ كَمَا تَبُولُ الْمَرْأَةُ . فَسَمِعَهُ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ فَقَالَ  " وَيْحَكَ أَمَا عَلِمْتَ مَا أَصَابَ صَاحِبَ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ كَانُوا إِذَا أَصَابَهُمُ الْبَوْلُ قَرَضُوهُ بِالْمَقَارِيضِ فَنَهَاهُمْ عَنْ ذَلِكَ فَعُذِّبَ فِي قَبْرِهِ " .   قَالَ أَبُو الْحَسَنِ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى، أَنْبَأَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، فَذَكَرَ نَحْوَهُ .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 346

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 347

chapter.englishTitle: Strictness concerning urination

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Ibn 'Abbas said:
                      "The Messenger of Allah passed by two new graves, and he said: 'They are being punished, but they are not being punished for anything major. One of them was heedless about preventing urine from getting on his clothes, and the other used to walk about spreading malicious gossip.'"
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Ibn 'Abbas said:
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah passed by two new graves, and he said: 'They are being punished, but they are not being punished for anything major. One of them was heedless about preventing urine from getting on his clothes, and the other used to walk about spreading malicious gossip.'"
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، وَوَكِيعٌ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، عَنْ طَاوُسٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ مَرَّ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ بِقَبْرَيْنِ جَدِيدَيْنِ فَقَالَ  " إِنَّهُمَا لَيُعَذَّبَانِ وَمَا يُعَذَّبَانِ فِي كَبِيرٍ أَمَّا أَحَدُهُمَا فَكَانَ لاَ يَسْتَنْزِهُ مِنْ بَوْلِهِ وَأَمَّا الآخَرُ فَكَانَ يَمْشِي بِالنَّمِيمَةِ " .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 347

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 348

chapter.englishTitle: Strictness concerning urination

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Abu Hurairah said:
                      "The Messenger of Allah said: 'Most of the torment of the grave is because of urine.'"
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Abu Hurairah said:
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah said: 'Most of the torment of the grave is because of urine.'"
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَفَّانُ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " أَكْثَرُ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ مِنَ الْبَوْلِ " .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 348

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 349

chapter.englishTitle: Strictness concerning urination

hadiths.englishRaw:
Bahr bin Marrar narrated that his grandfather Abu Bakrah said:
                      "The Messenger of Allah passed by two graves, and he said: 'They are being punished but they are not being punished for anything major. One of them is being punished because of urine, and the other is being punished because of backbiting.'"
hadiths.narrator: Bahr bin Marrar narrated that his grandfather Abu Bakrah said:
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah passed by two graves, and he said: 'They are being punished but they are not being punished for anything major. One of them is being punished because of urine, and the other is being punished because of backbiting.'"
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَسْوَدُ بْنُ شَيْبَانَ، حَدَّثَنِي بَحْرُ بْنُ مَرَّارٍ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ أَبِي بَكْرَةَ، قَالَ مَرَّ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ بِقَبْرَيْنِ فَقَالَ  " إِنَّهُمَا لَيُعَذَّبَانِ وَمَا يُعَذَّبَانِ فِي كَبِيرٍ أَمَّا أَحَدُهُمَا فَيُعَذَّبُ فِي الْبَوْلِ وَأَمَّا الآخَرُ فَيُعَذَّبُ فِي الْغِيبَةِ " .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 349

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 350

chapter.arabicTitle: باب الرَّجُلِ يُسَلَّمُ عَلَيْهِ وَهُوَ يَبُولُ
chapter.englishTitle: A man who is greeted while he is urinating

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Muhajir bin Qunfudh bin (Umair) bin Jud'an said:
                      "I came to the Prophet when he was performing ablution and greeted him with the Salam, but he did not return (the greeting). When he had finished his ablution he said: 'Nothing prevented me from returning your greeting but the fact that I need to have ablution.'" (Da'if)
Another chain with similar wording.
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Muhajir bin Qunfudh bin (Umair) bin Jud'an said:
hadiths.body:
"I came to the Prophet when he was performing ablution and greeted him with the Salam, but he did not return (the greeting). When he had finished his ablution he said: 'Nothing prevented me from returning your greeting but the fact that I need to have ablution.'" (Da'if)
Another chain with similar wording.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ الطَّلْحِيُّ، وَأَحْمَدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الدَّارِمِيُّ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا رَوْحُ بْنُ عُبَادَةَ، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، عَنْ حُضَيْنِ بْنِ الْمُنْذِرِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ بْنِ وَعْلَةَ أَبِي سَاسَانَ الرَّقَاشِيِّ، عَنِ الْمُهَاجِرِ بْنِ قُنْفُذِ بْنِ عُمَيْرِ بْنِ جُدْعَانَ، قَالَ أَتَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ وَهُوَ يَتَوَضَّأُ فَسَلَّمْتُ عَلَيْهِ فَلَمْ يَرُدَّ عَلَىَّ السَّلاَمَ فَلَمَّا فَرَغَ مِنْ وُضُوئِهِ قَالَ  " إِنَّهُ لَمْ يَمْنَعْنِي مِنْ أَنْ أَرُدَّ عَلَيْكَ إِلاَّ أَنِّي كُنْتُ عَلَى غَيْرِ وُضُوءٍ " .   قَالَ أَبُو الْحَسَنِ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَنْصَارِيُّ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي عَرُوبَةَ، فَذَكَرَ نَحْوَهُ .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 350

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 351

chapter.arabicTitle: باب الرَّجُلِ يُسَلَّمُ عَلَيْهِ وَهُوَ يَبُولُ
chapter.englishTitle: A man who is greeted while he is urinating

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Abu Hurairah said:
                      "A man passed by the Prophet while he was urinating, and greeted him with the Salam, but he did not return the greeting. While he finished, he struck the ground with his palms and did dry ablution (Tayammum), then he returned the greeting."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Abu Hurairah said:
hadiths.body: "A man passed by the Prophet while he was urinating, and greeted him with the Salam, but he did not return the greeting. While he finished, he struck the ground with his palms and did dry ablution (Tayammum), then he returned the greeting."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مَسْلَمَةُ بْنُ عُلَىٍّ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَوْزَاعِيُّ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ مَرَّ رَجُلٌ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ ﷺ وَهُوَ يَبُولُ فَسَلَّمَ عَلَيْهِ فَلَمْ يَرُدَّ عَلَيْهِ فَلَمَّا فَرَغَ ضَرَبَ بِكَفَّيْهِ الأَرْضَ فَتَيَمَّمَ ثُمَّ رَدَّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمَ .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 351

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 352

chapter.arabicTitle: باب الرَّجُلِ يُسَلَّمُ عَلَيْهِ وَهُوَ يَبُولُ
chapter.englishTitle: A man who is greeted while he is urinating

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Jabir bin `Abdullah that:
                      "A man passed by the Prophet while he was urinating, and greeted him by the Salam. The Messenger of Allah said to him: "If you see me in this situation, do not greet me with the Salam, for if you do that I will not respond to you.'"
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Jabir bin `Abdullah that:
hadiths.body: "A man passed by the Prophet while he was urinating, and greeted him by the Salam. The Messenger of Allah said to him: "If you see me in this situation, do not greet me with the Salam, for if you do that I will not respond to you.'"
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا سُوَيْدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عِيسَى بْنُ يُونُسَ، عَنْ هَاشِمِ بْنِ الْبَرِيدِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَقِيلٍ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَنَّ رَجُلاً، مَرَّ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ ﷺ وَهُوَ يَبُولُ فَسَلَّمَ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " إِذَا رَأَيْتَنِي عَلَى مِثْلِ هَذِهِ الْحَالَةِ فَلاَ تُسَلِّمْ عَلَىَّ فَإِنَّكَ إِنْ فَعَلْتَ ذَلِكَ لَمْ أَرُدَّ عَلَيْكَ " .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 352

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 353

chapter.arabicTitle: باب الرَّجُلِ يُسَلَّمُ عَلَيْهِ وَهُوَ يَبُولُ
chapter.englishTitle: A man who is greeted while he is urinating

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Ibn 'Umar said:
                      "A man passed by the Prophet while he was urinating and greeted him with the Salam, and he did not return the greeting."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Ibn 'Umar said:
hadiths.body: "A man passed by the Prophet while he was urinating and greeted him with the Salam, and he did not return the greeting."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَالْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ أَبِي السَّرِيِّ الْعَسْقَلاَنِيُّ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنِ الضَّحَّاكِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ مَرَّ رَجُلٌ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ ﷺ وَهُوَ يَبُولُ فَسَلَّمَ عَلَيْهِ فَلَمْ يَرُدَّ عَلَيْهِ .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 353

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 354

chapter.englishTitle: Cleaning oneself with water (Istinja')

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that 'Aishah said:
                      "I never saw the Messenger of Allah come out of the toilet without first (cleansing himself) with water."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that 'Aishah said:
hadiths.body: "I never saw the Messenger of Allah come out of the toilet without first (cleansing himself) with water."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا هَنَّادُ بْنُ السَّرِيِّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الأَحْوَصِ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنِ الأَسْوَدِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ مَا رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ خَرَجَ مِنْ غَائِطٍ قَطُّ إِلاَّ مَسَّ مَاءً .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 354

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 355

chapter.englishTitle: Cleaning oneself with water (Istinja')

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Sufyan said:
                      "Abu Ayyub Al-Ansari, Jabir bin 'Abdullah, and Anas bin Malik told me that when this Verse: "In it (the mosque) are men who love to clean and to purify themselves. And Allah loves those who make themselves clean and pure." was revealed, the Messenger of Allah said: 'O Ansar! Allah has praised you for your cleanliness. What is the nature of your cleanliness?' They said: 'We  perform ablution for prayer and we take bath to cleanse ourselves of impurity due to sexual activity, and we clean ourselves with water (after urinating). He said: 'This is what it is. So adhere to it.'"
hadiths.narrator: Abu Sufyan said:
hadiths.body: "Abu Ayyub Al-Ansari, Jabir bin 'Abdullah, and Anas bin Malik told me that when this Verse: "In it (the mosque) are men who love to clean and to purify themselves. And Allah loves those who make themselves clean and pure." was revealed, the Messenger of Allah said: 'O Ansar! Allah has praised you for your cleanliness. What is the nature of your cleanliness?' They said: 'We  perform ablution for prayer and we take bath to cleanse ourselves of impurity due to sexual activity, and we clean ourselves with water (after urinating). He said: 'This is what it is. So adhere to it.'"
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا صَدَقَةُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عُتْبَةُ بْنُ أَبِي حَكِيمٍ، حَدَّثَنِي طَلْحَةُ بْنُ نَافِعٍ أَبُو سُفْيَانَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو أَيُّوبَ الأَنْصَارِيُّ، وَجَابِرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، وَأَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّ هَذِهِ الآيَةَ، نَزَلَتْ {فِيهِ رِجَالٌ يُحِبُّونَ أَنْ يَتَطَهَّرُوا وَاللَّهُ يُحِبُّ الْمُطَّهِّرِينَ} قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ " يَا مَعْشَرَ الأَنْصَارِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ قَدْ أَثْنَى عَلَيْكُمْ فِي الطُّهُورِ فَمَا طُهُورُكُمْ " . قَالُوا نَتَوَضَّأُ لِلصَّلاَةِ وَنَغْتَسِلُ مِنَ الْجَنَابَةِ وَنَسْتَنْجِي بِالْمَاءِ . قَالَ " هُوَ ذَلِكَ فَعَلَيْكُمُوهُ " .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 355

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 356

chapter.englishTitle: Cleaning oneself with water (Istinja')

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from 'Aishah that:
                      The Prophet used to wash his private parts three times. Ibn 'Umar said: "We did that and we found it to be healing and a means of purification."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from 'Aishah that:
hadiths.body: The Prophet used to wash his private parts three times. Ibn 'Umar said: "We did that and we found it to be healing and a means of purification."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ شَرِيكٍ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، عَنْ زَيْدٍ الْعَمِّيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي الصِّدِّيقِ النَّاجِيِّ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ كَانَ يَغْسِلُ مَقْعَدَتَهُ ثَلاَثًا . قَالَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ فَعَلْنَاهُ فَوَجَدْنَاهُ دَوَاءً وَطُهُورًا .   قَالَ أَبُو الْحَسَنِ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ، وَإِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ الْوَاسِطِيُّ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ، نَحْوَهُ .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 356

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 357

chapter.englishTitle: Cleaning oneself with water (Istinja')

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Abu Hurairah said:
                      "The Messenger of Allah said: 'The (following) was revealed about the people of Quba': 'In it (the mosque) are men who love to clean and purify themselves. And Allah loves those who make themselves clean and pure.'" He said: 'They used to clean themselves with water (after urinating), and this Verse was revealed concerning them.'"
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Abu Hurairah said:
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah said: 'The (following) was revealed about the people of Quba': 'In it (the mosque) are men who love to clean and purify themselves. And Allah loves those who make themselves clean and pure.'" He said: 'They used to clean themselves with water (after urinating), and this Verse was revealed concerning them.'"
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاوِيَةُ بْنُ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ أَبِي مَيْمُونَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ " نَزَلَتْ فِي أَهْلِ قُبَاءٍ {فِيهِ رِجَالٌ يُحِبُّونَ أَنْ يَتَطَهَّرُوا وَاللَّهُ يُحِبُّ الْمُطَّهِّرِينَ} قَالَ كَانُوا يَسْتَنْجُونَ بِالْمَاءِ فَنَزَلَتْ فِيهِمْ هَذِهِ الآيَةُ " .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 357

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 358

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَنْ دَلَكَ يَدَهُ بِالأَرْضِ بَعْدَ الاِسْتِنْجَاءِ
chapter.englishTitle: One who rubs his hand on the ground after cleaning himself

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that:
                      The Prophet relieved himself, then he cleaned himself (with water) from a pot made of brass, then he wiped his hand on the ground.
Another chain with similar wording.
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that:
hadiths.body:
The Prophet relieved himself, then he cleaned himself (with water) from a pot made of brass, then he wiped his hand on the ground.
Another chain with similar wording.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَعَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ شَرِيكٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ جَرِيرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي زُرْعَةَ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ جَرِيرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ قَضَى حَاجَتَهُ ثُمَّ اسْتَنْجَى مِنْ تَوْرٍ ثُمَّ دَلَكَ يَدَهُ بِالأَرْضِ .   قَالَ أَبُو الْحَسَنِ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ الْوَاسِطِيُّ، عَنْ شَرِيكٍ، نَحْوَهُ .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 358

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 359

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَنْ دَلَكَ يَدَهُ بِالأَرْضِ بَعْدَ الاِسْتِنْجَاءِ
chapter.englishTitle: One who rubs his hand on the ground after cleaning himself

hadiths.englishRaw:
Ibrahim bin Jarir narrated from his father that :
                      The Prophet of Allah entered a thicket and relieved himself, then Jarir brought him a small water skin from which he cleansed himself, then he wiped his hand in the dirt.
hadiths.narrator: Ibrahim bin Jarir narrated from his father that :
hadiths.body: The Prophet of Allah entered a thicket and relieved himself, then Jarir brought him a small water skin from which he cleansed himself, then he wiped his hand in the dirt.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبَانُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنِي إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ جَرِيرٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ ﷺ دَخَلَ الْغَيْضَةَ فَقَضَى حَاجَتَهُ فَأَتَاهُ جَرِيرٌ بِإِدَاوَةٍ مِنْ مَاءٍ فَاسْتَنْجَى مِنْهَا وَمَسَحَ يَدَهُ بِالتُّرَابِ .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 359

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 360

chapter.englishTitle: Covering vessels

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Jabir said:
                      "The Prophet commanded (us) to tie up our water skins and cover our vessels."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Jabir said:
hadiths.body: "The Prophet commanded (us) to tie up our water skins and cover our vessels."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْلَى بْنُ عُبَيْدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ بْنُ أَبِي سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ أَمَرَنَا النَّبِيُّ ﷺ أَنْ نُوكِيَ أَسْقِيَتَنَا وَنُغَطِّيَ آنِيَتَنَا .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 360

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 361

chapter.englishTitle: Covering vessels

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that 'Aishah said:
                      "I used to cover three vessels for the Messenger of Allah at night: A vessel (of water) for his ablution, a vessel for his tooth stick and a vessel for his drink."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that 'Aishah said:
hadiths.body: "I used to cover three vessels for the Messenger of Allah at night: A vessel (of water) for his ablution, a vessel for his tooth stick and a vessel for his drink."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عِصْمَةُ بْنُ الْفَضْلِ، وَيَحْيَى بْنُ حَكِيمٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا حَرَمِيُّ بْنُ عُمَارَةَ بْنِ أَبِي حَفْصَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا حَرِيشُ بْنُ الْخِرِّيتِ، أَنْبَأَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي مُلَيْكَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ كُنْتُ أَضَعُ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ ثَلاَثَةَ آنِيَةٍ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ مُخَمَّرَةً إِنَاءً لِطَهُورِهِ وَإِنَاءً لِسِوَاكِهِ وَإِنَاءً لِشَرَابِهِ .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 361

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 362

chapter.englishTitle: Covering vessels

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Ibn 'Abbas said:
                      "The Messenger of Allah never entrusted his purification to anyone nor his charity that he had given to anyone; he would be the one to take care of these matters himself."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Ibn 'Abbas said:
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah never entrusted his purification to anyone nor his charity that he had given to anyone; he would be the one to take care of these matters himself."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَدْرٍ، عَبَّادُ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ حَدَّثَنَا مُطَهَّرُ بْنُ الْهَيْثَمِ، حَدَّثَنَا عَلْقَمَةُ بْنُ أَبِي جَمْرَةَ الضُّبَعِيُّ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ أَبِي جَمْرَةَ الضُّبَعِيِّ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ لاَ يَكِلُ طُهُورَهُ إِلَى أَحَدٍ وَلاَ صَدَقَتَهُ الَّتِي يَتَصَدَّقُ بِهَا يَكُونُ هُوَ الَّذِي يَتَوَلاَّهَا بِنَفْسِهِ .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 362

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 363

chapter.arabicTitle: باب غَسْلِ الإِنَاءِ مِنْ وُلُوغِ الْكَلْبِ
chapter.englishTitle: Washing a vessel that has been licked by a dog

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Abu Razin said:
                      'I saw Abu Hurairah hitting his forehead with his hand and saying: "O people of Iraq! Do you claim that I would tell a lie against the Messenger of Allah so that it may be more convenient for you and a sin upon me?' I bear witness that I heard the Messenger of Allah say: 'If a dog licks the vessel of anyone of you, let him wash it seven times.'"
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Abu Razin said:
hadiths.body: 'I saw Abu Hurairah hitting his forehead with his hand and saying: "O people of Iraq! Do you claim that I would tell a lie against the Messenger of Allah so that it may be more convenient for you and a sin upon me?' I bear witness that I heard the Messenger of Allah say: 'If a dog licks the vessel of anyone of you, let him wash it seven times.'"
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي رَزِينٍ، قَالَ رَأَيْتُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ يَضْرِبُ جَبْهَتَهُ بِيَدِهِ وَيَقُولُ يَا أَهْلَ الْعِرَاقِ أَنْتُمْ تَزْعُمُونَ أَنِّي أَكْذِبُ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ لِيَكُونَ لَكُمُ الْمَهْنَأُ وَعَلَىَّ الإِثْمُ أَشْهَدُ لَسَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ  " إِذَا وَلَغَ الْكَلْبُ فِي إِنَاءِ أَحَدِكُمْ فَلْيَغْسِلْهُ سَبْعَ مَرَّاتٍ " .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 363

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 364

chapter.arabicTitle: باب غَسْلِ الإِنَاءِ مِنْ وُلُوغِ الْكَلْبِ
chapter.englishTitle: Washing a vessel that has been licked by a dog

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that:
                      The Messenger of Allah said: "If a dog licks the vessel of anyome of you, let him wash it seven times."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that:
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah said: "If a dog licks the vessel of anyome of you, let him wash it seven times."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا رَوْحُ بْنُ عُبَادَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ  " إِذَا شَرِبَ الْكَلْبُ فِي إِنَاءِ أَحَدِكُمْ فَلْيَغْسِلْهُ سَبْعَ مَرَّاتٍ " .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 364

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 365

chapter.arabicTitle: باب غَسْلِ الإِنَاءِ مِنْ وُلُوغِ الْكَلْبِ
chapter.englishTitle: Washing a vessel that has been licked by a dog

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from 'Abdullah bin Mughaffal that:
                      The Messenger of Allah said: 'If a dog licks a vessel, wash it seven times and rub it with dust the eight times."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from 'Abdullah bin Mughaffal that:
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah said: 'If a dog licks a vessel, wash it seven times and rub it with dust the eight times."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا شَبَابَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ أَبِي التَّيَّاحِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ مُطَرِّفًا، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْمُغَفَّلِ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ  " إِذَا وَلَغَ الْكَلْبُ فِي الإِنَاءِ فَاغْسِلُوهُ سَبْعَ مَرَّاتٍ وَعَفِّرُوهُ الثَّامِنَةَ بِالتُّرَابِ " .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 365

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 366

chapter.arabicTitle: باب غَسْلِ الإِنَاءِ مِنْ وُلُوغِ الْكَلْبِ
chapter.englishTitle: Washing a vessel that has been licked by a dog

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Ibn 'Umar said:
                      "The Messenger of Allah said: 'If a dog licks the vessel of anyone of you, let him wash it seven times.'"
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Ibn 'Umar said:
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah said: 'If a dog licks the vessel of anyone of you, let him wash it seven times.'"
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي مَرْيَمَ، أَنْبَأَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " إِذَا وَلَغَ الْكَلْبُ فِي إِنَاءِ أَحَدِكُمْ فَلْيَغْسِلْهُ سَبْعَ مَرَّاتٍ " .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 366

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 367

chapter.arabicTitle: باب الْوُضُوءِ بِسُؤْرِ الْهِرَّةِ وَالرُّخْصَةِ فِي ذَلِكَ
chapter.englishTitle: Ablution with water left over by a cat and the concession in that

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Kabshah bint Ka'b, who was married to one of the sons of Ab Qatadah, that:
                      She poured water for Abu Qatadah to perform ablution. A cat came and drank the water, and he tilted the vessel for it. She started looking at it (in surprise) and he said: "O daughter of my brother, do you find it strange? The Messenger of Allah said: 'They (cats) are not impure, they are of those who go around among you.'"
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Kabshah bint Ka'b, who was married to one of the sons of Ab Qatadah, that:
hadiths.body: She poured water for Abu Qatadah to perform ablution. A cat came and drank the water, and he tilted the vessel for it. She started looking at it (in surprise) and he said: "O daughter of my brother, do you find it strange? The Messenger of Allah said: 'They (cats) are not impure, they are of those who go around among you.'"
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا زَيْدُ بْنُ الْحُبَابِ، أَنْبَأَنَا مَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ الأَنْصَارِيُّ، عَنْ حُمَيْدَةَ بِنْتِ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ رِفَاعَةَ، عَنْ كَبْشَةَ بِنْتِ كَعْبٍ، وَكَانَتْ، تَحْتَ بَعْضِ وَلَدِ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ أَنَّهَا صَبَّتْ لأَبِي قَتَادَةَ مَاءً يَتَوَضَّأُ بِهِ فَجَاءَتْ هِرَّةٌ تَشْرَبُ فَأَصْغَى لَهَا الإِنَاءَ فَجَعَلْتُ أَنْظُرُ إِلَيْهِ فَقَالَ يَا ابْنَةَ أَخِي أَتَعْجَبِينَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " إِنَّهَا لَيْسَتْ بِنَجَسٍ هِيَ مِنَ الطَّوَّافِينَ أَوِ الطَّوَّافَاتِ " .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 367

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 368

chapter.arabicTitle: باب الْوُضُوءِ بِسُؤْرِ الْهِرَّةِ وَالرُّخْصَةِ فِي ذَلِكَ
chapter.englishTitle: Ablution with water left over by a cat and the concession in that

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that 'Aishah said:
                      "The Messenger of Allah and I used to perform ablution from a single vessel, when the cat had drunk from it beforehand."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that 'Aishah said:
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah and I used to perform ablution from a single vessel, when the cat had drunk from it beforehand."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ رَافِعٍ، وَإِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ تَوْبَةَ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ زَكَرِيَّا بْنِ أَبِي زَائِدَةَ، عَنْ حَارِثَةَ، عَنْ عَمْرَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ كُنْتُ أَتَوَضَّأُ أَنَا وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ، ﷺ مِنْ إِنَاءٍ وَاحِدٍ قَدْ أَصَابَتْ مِنْهُ الْهِرَّةُ قَبْلَ ذَلِكَ .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 368

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 369

chapter.arabicTitle: باب الْوُضُوءِ بِسُؤْرِ الْهِرَّةِ وَالرُّخْصَةِ فِي ذَلِكَ
chapter.englishTitle: Ablution with water left over by a cat and the concession in that

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that:
                      The Messenger of Allah said: "Cats do not invalidate the prayer, because they are one of the things that are useful in the house."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that:
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah said: "Cats do not invalidate the prayer, because they are one of the things that are useful in the house."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمَجِيدِ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " الْهِرَّةُ لاَ تَقْطَعُ الصَّلاَةَ لأَنَّهَا مِنْ مَتَاعِ الْبَيْتِ " .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 369

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 370

chapter.englishTitle: Concession regarding water left over from a woman's ablution

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Ibn 'Abbas said:
                      "One of the wives of the Prophet took a bath from a large vessel, then the Prophet came and had a bath or ablution, and she said: 'O Messenger of Allah, I was sexually impure.' He said: 'Water does not become impure.'"
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Ibn 'Abbas said:
hadiths.body: "One of the wives of the Prophet took a bath from a large vessel, then the Prophet came and had a bath or ablution, and she said: 'O Messenger of Allah, I was sexually impure.' He said: 'Water does not become impure.'"
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الأَحْوَصِ، عَنْ سِمَاكِ بْنِ حَرْبٍ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ اغْتَسَلَ بَعْضُ أَزْوَاجِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ فِي جَفْنَةٍ فَجَاءَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ لِيَغْتَسِلَ أَوْ يَتَوَضَّأَ فَقَالَتْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي كُنْتُ جُنُبًا . فَقَالَ  " الْمَاءُ لاَ يُجْنِبُ " .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 370

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 371

chapter.englishTitle: Concession regarding water left over from a woman's ablution

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Ibn 'Abbas that:
                      One of the wives of the Prophet took a bath to cleanse herself from sexual impurity, then the Prophet performed ablution and had a bath with the water left over from her ablution."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Ibn 'Abbas that:
hadiths.body: One of the wives of the Prophet took a bath to cleanse herself from sexual impurity, then the Prophet performed ablution and had a bath with the water left over from her ablution."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ سِمَاكِ بْنِ حَرْبٍ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّ امْرَأَةً، مِنْ أَزْوَاجِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ اغْتَسَلَتْ مِنْ جَنَابَةٍ فَتَوَضَّأَ أَوِ اغْتَسَلَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ مِنْ فَضْلِ وَضُوئِهَا .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 371

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 372

chapter.englishTitle: Concession regarding water left over from a woman's ablution

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Ibn 'Abbas, from Maimunah the wife of the Prophet, that :
                      the Prophet performed ablution with the water left over after she had taken a bath to cleanse herself from sexual impurity.
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Ibn 'Abbas, from Maimunah the wife of the Prophet, that :
hadiths.body: the Prophet performed ablution with the water left over after she had taken a bath to cleanse herself from sexual impurity.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ، حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ، عَنْ سِمَاكٍ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، عَنْ مَيْمُونَةَ، زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ تَوَضَّأَ بِفَضْلِ غُسْلِهَا مِنَ الْجَنَابَةِ .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 372

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 373

chapter.englishTitle: The prohibition of that (i.e., performing ablution with the leftover water)

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Hakam bin 'Amr that:
                      The Messenger of Allah forbade men to perform ablution with the left over water by a woman.
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Hakam bin 'Amr that:
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah forbade men to perform ablution with the left over water by a woman.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَاصِمٍ الأَحْوَلِ، عَنْ أَبِي حَاجِبٍ، عَنِ الْحَكَمِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ نَهَى أَنْ يَتَوَضَّأَ الرَّجُلُ بِفَضْلِ وَضُوءِ الْمَرْأَةِ .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 373

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 374

chapter.englishTitle: The prohibition of that (i.e., performing ablution with the leftover water)

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that `Abdullah bin Sarjis said:
                      "The Messenger of Allah forbade men to perform ablution with the water left over by a woman, and women to perform ablution with water left over by a man, however both (spouses) may start to perform their ablutions at the same time."
Abu `Abdullah Ibn Majah said: "The first (narration) is correct, and the second (narration) is Wahm (an error)."
Another chain with similar wording.
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that `Abdullah bin Sarjis said:
hadiths.body:
"The Messenger of Allah forbade men to perform ablution with the water left over by a woman, and women to perform ablution with water left over by a man, however both (spouses) may start to perform their ablutions at the same time."
Abu `Abdullah Ibn Majah said: "The first (narration) is correct, and the second (narration) is Wahm (an error)."
Another chain with similar wording.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا الْمُعَلَّى بْنُ أَسَدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ الْمُخْتَارِ، حَدَّثَنَا عَاصِمٌ الأَحْوَلُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ سَرْجِسَ، قَالَ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَنْ يَغْتَسِلَ الرَّجُلُ بِفَضْلِ وَضُوءِ الْمَرْأَةِ وَالْمَرْأَةُ بِفَضْلِ الرَّجُلِ وَلَكِنْ يَشْرَعَانِ جَمِيعًا .  قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَاجَهْ الصَّحِيحُ هُوَ الأَوَّلُ وَالثَّانِي وَهَمٌ .  قَالَ أَبُو الْحَسَنِ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ، وَأَبُو عُثْمَانَ الْبُخَارِيُّ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا الْمُعَلَّى بْنُ أَسَدٍ، نَحْوَهُ .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 374

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 375

chapter.englishTitle: The prohibition of that (i.e., performing ablution with the leftover water)

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that 'Ali said:
                      "The Prophet and his wife would take a bath from one vessel, but neither of them would have a bath with the leftover water of the other."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that 'Ali said:
hadiths.body: "The Prophet and his wife would take a bath from one vessel, but neither of them would have a bath with the leftover water of the other."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، عَنْ إِسْرَائِيلَ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنِ الْحَارِثِ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ، قَالَ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ وَأَهْلُهُ يَغْتَسِلُونَ مِنْ إِنَاءٍ وَاحِدٍ وَلاَ يَغْتَسِلُ أَحَدُهُمَا بِفَضْلِ صَاحِبِهِ .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 375

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 376

chapter.arabicTitle: باب الرَّجُلِ وَالْمَرْأَةِ يَغْتَسِلاَنِ مِنْ إِنَاءٍ وَاحِدٍ
chapter.englishTitle: A man and woman taking bath from a single vessel

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that 'Aishah said:
                      "The Messenger of Allah and I would take a bath from a single vessel."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that 'Aishah said:
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah and I would take a bath from a single vessel."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رُمْحٍ، أَنْبَأَنَا اللَّيْثُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ كُنْتُ أَغْتَسِلُ أَنَا وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ، ﷺ مِنْ إِنَاءٍ وَاحِدٍ .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 376

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 377

chapter.arabicTitle: باب الرَّجُلِ وَالْمَرْأَةِ يَغْتَسِلاَنِ مِنْ إِنَاءٍ وَاحِدٍ
chapter.englishTitle: A man and woman taking bath from a single vessel

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Ibn 'Abbas that his maternal aunt Maimunah said:
                      "The Messager of Allah and I used to take bath from a single vessel."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Ibn 'Abbas that his maternal aunt Maimunah said:
hadiths.body: "The Messager of Allah and I used to take bath from a single vessel."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، عَنْ خَالَتِهِ، مَيْمُونَةَ قَالَتْ كُنْتُ أَغْتَسِلُ أَنَا وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ، ﷺ مِنْ إِنَاءٍ وَاحِدٍ .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 377

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 378

chapter.arabicTitle: باب الرَّجُلِ وَالْمَرْأَةِ يَغْتَسِلاَنِ مِنْ إِنَاءٍ وَاحِدٍ
chapter.englishTitle: A man and woman taking bath from a single vessel

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Umm Hani that :
                      The Prophet and Maimunah took a bath from a single vessel, a large bowl in which they were some traces of dough.
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Umm Hani that :
hadiths.body: The Prophet and Maimunah took a bath from a single vessel, a large bowl in which they were some traces of dough.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَامِرٍ الأَشْعَرِيُّ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَامِرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَبِي بُكَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، عَنْ أُمِّ هَانِئٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ اغْتَسَلَ وَمَيْمُونَةُ مِنْ إِنَاءٍ وَاحِدٍ فِي قَصْعَةٍ فِيهَا أَثَرُ الْعَجِينِ .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 378

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 379

chapter.arabicTitle: باب الرَّجُلِ وَالْمَرْأَةِ يَغْتَسِلاَنِ مِنْ إِنَاءٍ وَاحِدٍ
chapter.englishTitle: A man and woman taking bath from a single vessel

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Jabir bin 'Abdullah said:
                      "The Messenger of Allah and his wives used to take a bath from a single vessel."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Jabir bin 'Abdullah said:
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah and his wives used to take a bath from a single vessel."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْحَسَنِ الأَسَدِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَقِيلٍ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَأَزْوَاجُهُ يَغْتَسِلُونَ مِنْ إِنَاءٍ وَاحِدٍ .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 379

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 380

chapter.arabicTitle: باب الرَّجُلِ وَالْمَرْأَةِ يَغْتَسِلاَنِ مِنْ إِنَاءٍ وَاحِدٍ
chapter.englishTitle: A man and woman taking bath from a single vessel

hadiths.englishRaw:
Zainab the daughter of Umm Salamah narrated from Umm Salamah that:
                      She and the Messenger of Allah used to take a bath from a single vessel.
hadiths.narrator: Zainab the daughter of Umm Salamah narrated from Umm Salamah that:
hadiths.body: She and the Messenger of Allah used to take a bath from a single vessel.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ الدَّسْتَوَائِيِّ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ زَيْنَبَ بِنْتِ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ، أَنَّهَا كَانَتْ وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَغْتَسِلاَنِ مِنْ إِنَاءٍ وَاحِدٍ .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 380

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 381

chapter.arabicTitle: باب الرَّجُلِ وَالْمَرْأَةِ يَتَوَضَّآنِ مِنْ إِنَاءٍ وَاحِدٍ
chapter.englishTitle: A man and woman performing ablution from a single vessel

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Ibn 'Umar said:
                      "Men and women used to perform ablution from a single vessel during the time of the Messenger of Allah."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Ibn 'Umar said:
hadiths.body: "Men and women used to perform ablution from a single vessel during the time of the Messenger of Allah."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ، حَدَّثَنِي نَافِعٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ كَانَ الرِّجَالُ وَالنِّسَاءُ يَتَوَضَّئُونَ عَلَى عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ مِنْ إِنَاءٍ وَاحِدٍ .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 381

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 382

chapter.arabicTitle: باب الرَّجُلِ وَالْمَرْأَةِ يَتَوَضَّآنِ مِنْ إِنَاءٍ وَاحِدٍ
chapter.englishTitle: A man and woman performing ablution from a single vessel

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Umm Subyah Al-Juhaniyyah said:
                      "Often my hand would touch the hand of the Messenger of Allah while performing ablution from a single vessel." 
Abu `Abdullah bin Majah said: "I heard Muhammad say: 'Umm Subyah was Khawlah bint Qais. I mentioned that to Abu Zur`ah and he said: "It is true."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Umm Subyah Al-Juhaniyyah said:
hadiths.body:
"Often my hand would touch the hand of the Messenger of Allah while performing ablution from a single vessel." 
Abu `Abdullah bin Majah said: "I heard Muhammad say: 'Umm Subyah was Khawlah bint Qais. I mentioned that to Abu Zur`ah and he said: "It is true."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الدِّمَشْقِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَنَسُ بْنُ عِيَاضٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أُسَامَةُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ أَبِي النُّعْمَانِ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ سَرْجٍ - عَنْ أُمِّ صُبَيَّةَ الْجُهَنِيَّةِ، قَالَتْ رُبَّمَا اخْتَلَفَتْ يَدِي وَيَدُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فِي الْوُضُوءِ مِنْ إِنَاءٍ وَاحِدٍ .  قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ابْنُ مَاجَهْ سَمِعْتُ مُحَمَّدًا يَقُولُ أُمُّ صُبَيَّةَ هِيَ خَوْلَةُ بِنْتُ قَيْسٍ . فَذَكَرْتُ لأَبِي زُرْعَةَ فَقَالَ صَدَقَ .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 382

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 383

chapter.arabicTitle: باب الرَّجُلِ وَالْمَرْأَةِ يَتَوَضَّآنِ مِنْ إِنَاءٍ وَاحِدٍ
chapter.englishTitle: A man and woman performing ablution from a single vessel

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from 'Aishah that:
                      The Prophet and she used to perform ablution together for prayer.
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from 'Aishah that:
hadiths.body: The Prophet and she used to perform ablution together for prayer.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا دَاوُدُ بْنُ شَبِيبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَبِيبُ بْنُ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ هَرَمٍ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ أَنَّهُمَا كَانَا يَتَوَضَّآنِ جَمِيعًا لِلصَّلاَةِ .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 383

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 384

chapter.englishTitle: Performing ablution with Nabidh

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from 'Abdullah bin Mas'ud that :
                      On the night of the jinn, the Messenger of Allah said to him: "Do you have water for ablution?" He said: "No, I have nothing, but some Nabidh in a vessel." He said: "Good dates and pure water (i.e. there is no harm from the mixing of the two)." So he performed ablution with it. This is the narration of Waki'.
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from 'Abdullah bin Mas'ud that :
hadiths.body: On the night of the jinn, the Messenger of Allah said to him: "Do you have water for ablution?" He said: "No, I have nothing, but some Nabidh in a vessel." He said: "Good dates and pure water (i.e. there is no harm from the mixing of the two)." So he performed ablution with it. This is the narration of Waki'.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَعَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ أَبِي فَزَارَةَ الْعَبْسِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي زَيْدٍ، مَوْلَى عَمْرِو بْنِ حُرَيْثٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ لَهُ لَيْلَةَ الْجِنِّ " عِنْدَكَ طَهُورٌ " . قَالَ لاَ إِلاَّ شَىْءٌ مِنْ نَبِيذٍ فِي إِدَاوَةٍ . قَالَ " تَمْرَةٌ طَيِّبَةٌ وَمَاءٌ طَهُورٌ " . فَتَوَضَّأَ . هَذَا حَدِيثُ وَكِيعٍ .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 384

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 385

chapter.englishTitle: Performing ablution with Nabidh

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from 'Abdullah bin 'Abbas that :
                      On the night of the Jinn the Messenger of Allah said to Ibn Mas'ud: "Do you have water?" He said: "No, only some Nabidh in a large water skin." The Messenger of Allah said: "Good dates and pure water." (i.e. there is no harm from the mixing of the two.) Pour it for me." He said: "So I performed ablution with it."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from 'Abdullah bin 'Abbas that :
hadiths.body: On the night of the Jinn the Messenger of Allah said to Ibn Mas'ud: "Do you have water?" He said: "No, only some Nabidh in a large water skin." The Messenger of Allah said: "Good dates and pure water." (i.e. there is no harm from the mixing of the two.) Pour it for me." He said: "So I performed ablution with it."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا الْعَبَّاسُ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ الدِّمَشْقِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا مَرْوَانُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ لَهِيعَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا قَيْسُ بْنُ الْحَجَّاجِ، عَنْ حَنَشٍ الصَّنْعَانِيِّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ لاِبْنِ مَسْعُودٍ لَيْلَةَ الْجِنِّ " مَعَكَ مَاءٌ " . قَالَ لاَ إِلاَّ نَبِيذًا فِي سَطِيحَةٍ . فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ " تَمْرَةٌ طَيِّبَةٌ وَمَاءٌ طَهُورٌ صُبَّ عَلَىَّ " . قَالَ فَصَبَبْتُ عَلَيْهِ فَتَوَضَّأَ بِهِ .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 385

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 386

chapter.englishTitle: Ablution with seawater

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Mughirah bin Abu Burdah, who was from the tribe of Banu 'Abdud-Dar, said that:
                      He heard Abu Hurairah say: "A man came to the Messenger of Allah and said: "O Messenger of Allah, we travel by sea and carry a small amount of water with us. If we use it for ablution, we will become thirsty. Can we perform ablution with seawater?' The Messenger of Allah said: 'Its water is a means of purification, ad its dead meat is permissible. (i.e. the fish found dead in the sea).'"
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Mughirah bin Abu Burdah, who was from the tribe of Banu 'Abdud-Dar, said that:
hadiths.body: He heard Abu Hurairah say: "A man came to the Messenger of Allah and said: "O Messenger of Allah, we travel by sea and carry a small amount of water with us. If we use it for ablution, we will become thirsty. Can we perform ablution with seawater?' The Messenger of Allah said: 'Its water is a means of purification, ad its dead meat is permissible. (i.e. the fish found dead in the sea).'"
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ، حَدَّثَنِي صَفْوَانُ بْنُ سُلَيْمٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ سَلَمَةَ، - هُوَ مِنْ آلِ ابْنِ الأَزْرَقِ - أَنَّ الْمُغِيرَةَ بْنَ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ، - وَهُوَ مِنْ بَنِي عَبْدِ الدَّارِ - حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّهُ، سَمِعَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، يَقُولُ جَاءَ رَجُلٌ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّا نَرْكَبُ الْبَحْرَ وَنَحْمِلُ مَعَنَا الْقَلِيلَ مِنَ الْمَاءِ فَإِنْ تَوَضَّأْنَا بِهِ عَطِشْنَا أَفَنَتَوَضَّأُ مِنْ مَاءِ الْبَحْرِ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " هُوَ الطَّهُورُ مَاؤُهُ الْحِلُّ مَيْتَتُهُ " .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 386

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 387

chapter.englishTitle: Ablution with seawater

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Ibn Firasi said:
                      "I was fishing and I had a vessel with me in which I kept water, and I used seawater for ablution. I mentioned that to the Messenger of Allah and he said: 'Its water is a means of purification, and its dead meat is permissible.'"
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Ibn Firasi said:
hadiths.body: "I was fishing and I had a vessel with me in which I kept water, and I used seawater for ablution. I mentioned that to the Messenger of Allah and he said: 'Its water is a means of purification, and its dead meat is permissible.'"
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا سَهْلُ بْنُ أَبِي سَهْلٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ بُكَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنِي اللَّيْثُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ رَبِيعَةَ، عَنْ بَكْرِ بْنِ سَوَادَةَ، عَنْ مُسْلِمِ بْنِ مَخْشِيٍّ، عَنِ ابْنِ الْفِرَاسِيِّ، قَالَ كُنْتُ أَصِيدُ وَكَانَتْ لِي قِرْبَةٌ أَجْعَلُ فِيهَا مَاءً وَإِنِّي تَوَضَّأْتُ بِمَاءِ الْبَحْرِ فَذَكَرْتُ ذَلِكَ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَقَالَ  " هُوَ الطَّهُورُ مَاؤُهُ الْحِلُّ مَيْتَتُهُ " .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 387

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 388

chapter.englishTitle: Ablution with seawater

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Jabir that:
                      The Prophet was asked about seawater, and he said: "Its water is a means of purification, and its dead meat is permissible." 
Another chain with similar wording.
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Jabir that:
hadiths.body:
The Prophet was asked about seawater, and he said: "Its water is a means of purification, and its dead meat is permissible." 
Another chain with similar wording.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ حَنْبَلٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْقَاسِمِ بْنُ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ حَازِمٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، - هُوَ ابْنُ مِقْسَمٍ - عَنْ جَابِرٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ سُئِلَ عَنْ مَاءِ الْبَحْرِ فَقَالَ  " هُوَ الطَّهُورُ مَاؤُهُ الْحِلُّ مَيْتَتُهُ " .   قَالَ أَبُو الْحَسَنِ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ الْحَسَنِ الْهِسِنْجَانِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ حَنْبَلٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْقَاسِمِ بْنُ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، حَدَّثَنِي إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ حَازِمٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، - هُوَ ابْنُ مِقْسَمٍ - عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ فَذَكَرَ نَحْوَهُ .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 388

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 389

chapter.arabicTitle: باب الرَّجُلِ يَسْتَعِينُ عَلَى وُضُوئِهِ فَيُصَبُّ عَلَيْهِ
chapter.englishTitle: A man who asks for help with his ablution and water is poured on him

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Mughirah bin Shu'bah said:
                      "The Prophet went out to relieve himself and when he came back, I met him with a water skin and poured water for him. He washed his hands and his face, then he went to wash his forearms but his garment was too tight, so he brought his arms out from underneath his garment and washed them, then he wiped over his leather socks, then he led us in prayer."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Mughirah bin Shu'bah said:
hadiths.body: "The Prophet went out to relieve himself and when he came back, I met him with a water skin and poured water for him. He washed his hands and his face, then he went to wash his forearms but his garment was too tight, so he brought his arms out from underneath his garment and washed them, then he wiped over his leather socks, then he led us in prayer."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عِيسَى بْنُ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، عَنْ مُسْلِمِ بْنِ صُبَيْحٍ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، عَنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ بْنِ شُعْبَةَ، قَالَ خَرَجَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ لِبَعْضِ حَاجَتِهِ فَلَمَّا رَجَعَ تَلَقَّيْتُهُ بِالإِدَاوَةِ فَصَبَبْتُ عَلَيْهِ فَغَسَلَ يَدَيْهِ ثُمَّ غَسَلَ وَجْهَهُ ثُمَّ ذَهَبَ يَغْسِلُ ذِرَاعَيْهِ فَضَاقَتِ الْجُبَّةُ فَأَخْرَجَهُمَا مِنْ تَحْتِ الْجُبَّةِ فَغَسَلَهُمَا وَمَسَحَ عَلَى خُفَّيْهِ ثُمَّ صَلَّى بِنَا .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 389

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 390

chapter.arabicTitle: باب الرَّجُلِ يَسْتَعِينُ عَلَى وُضُوئِهِ فَيُصَبُّ عَلَيْهِ
chapter.englishTitle: A man who asks for help with his ablution and water is poured on him

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Rubai' bint Mu'awwidh said:
                      "I brought a basin of water to the Prophet and he said: 'Pour it,' so I poured it and he washed his face and forearms, then he took fresh water and wiped his head, front and back, and then he washed his feet. He washed each part three times."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Rubai' bint Mu'awwidh said:
hadiths.body: "I brought a basin of water to the Prophet and he said: 'Pour it,' so I poured it and he washed his face and forearms, then he took fresh water and wiped his head, front and back, and then he washed his feet. He washed each part three times."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا الْهَيْثَمُ بْنُ جَمِيلٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَقِيلٍ، عَنِ الرُّبَيِّعِ بِنْتِ مُعَوِّذٍ، قَالَتْ أَتَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ بِمِيضَأَةٍ فَقَالَ  " اسْكُبِي " . فَسَكَبْتُ فَغَسَلَ وَجْهَهُ وَذِرَاعَيْهِ وَأَخَذَ مَاءً جَدِيدًا فَمَسَحَ بِهِ رَأْسَهُ مُقَدَّمَهُ وَمُؤَخَّرَهُ وَغَسَلَ قَدَمَيْهِ ثَلاَثًا ثَلاَثًا .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 390

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 391

chapter.arabicTitle: باب الرَّجُلِ يَسْتَعِينُ عَلَى وُضُوئِهِ فَيُصَبُّ عَلَيْهِ
chapter.englishTitle: A man who asks for help with his ablution and water is poured on him

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Safwan bin 'Assal said:
                      "I poured water for the Prophet on journeys and as a resident, when he performed ablution."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Safwan bin 'Assal said:
hadiths.body: "I poured water for the Prophet on journeys and as a resident, when he performed ablution."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ آدَمَ، حَدَّثَنَا زَيْدُ بْنُ الْحُبَابِ، حَدَّثَنِي الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ عُقْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنِي حُذَيْفَةُ بْنُ أَبِي حُذَيْفَةَ الأَزْدِيُّ، عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ عَسَّالٍ، قَالَ صَبَبْتُ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ ﷺ الْمَاءَ فِي السَّفَرِ وَالْحَضَرِ فِي الْوُضُوءِ .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 391

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 392

chapter.arabicTitle: باب الرَّجُلِ يَسْتَعِينُ عَلَى وُضُوئِهِ فَيُصَبُّ عَلَيْهِ
chapter.englishTitle: A man who asks for help with his ablution and water is poured on him

hadiths.englishRaw:
Umm 'Ayyash, the slave woman of Ruqayyah, the daughter of the Messenger of Allah, said:
                      "I used to help the Messenger of Allah perform ablution, when I was standing and he was sitting."
hadiths.narrator: Umm 'Ayyash, the slave woman of Ruqayyah, the daughter of the Messenger of Allah, said:
hadiths.body: "I used to help the Messenger of Allah perform ablution, when I was standing and he was sitting."
