hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا كُرْدُوسُ بْنُ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْوَاسِطِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْكَرِيمِ بْنُ رَوْحٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي رَوْحُ بْنُ عَنْبَسَةَ بْنِ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي عَيَّاشٍ، مَوْلَى عُثْمَانَ بْنِ عَفَّانَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْبَسَةَ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ جَدَّتِهِ أُمِّ أَبِيهِ أُمِّ عَيَّاشٍ، وَكَانَتْ، أَمَةً لِرُقَيَّةَ بِنْتِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَتْ كُنْتُ أُوَضِّئُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَنَا قَائِمَةٌ وَهُوَ قَاعِدٌ .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 392

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 393

chapter.arabicTitle: باب الرَّجُلِ يَسْتَيْقِظُ مِنْ مَنَامِهِ هَلْ يُدْخِلُ يَدَهُ فِي الإِنَاءِ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَغْسِلَهَا
chapter.englishTitle: When a man wakes up from sleep: should he put his hand in the vessel before washing it?

hadiths.englishRaw:
Sa'eed bin Musayyab and Abu Salamah bin 'Abdur-Rahman narrated that :
                      Abu Hurairah used to say: "The Messenger of Allah said: 'When anyone of you wakes up from sleep, he should not put his hand into the vessel until he has poured water on it two or three times, for none of you knows where his hand spent the night,'"
hadiths.narrator: Sa'eed bin Musayyab and Abu Salamah bin 'Abdur-Rahman narrated that :
hadiths.body: Abu Hurairah used to say: "The Messenger of Allah said: 'When anyone of you wakes up from sleep, he should not put his hand into the vessel until he has poured water on it two or three times, for none of you knows where his hand spent the night,'"
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الدِّمَشْقِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَوْزَاعِيُّ، حَدَّثَنِي الزُّهْرِيُّ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، وَأَبِي، سَلَمَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ أَنَّهُمَا حَدَّثَاهُ أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ كَانَ يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " إِذَا اسْتَيْقَظَ أَحَدُكُمْ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ فَلاَ يُدْخِلْ يَدَهُ فِي الإِنَاءِ حَتَّى يُفْرِغَ عَلَيْهَا مَرَّتَيْنِ أَوْ ثَلاَثًا فَإِنَّ أَحَدَكُمْ لاَ يَدْرِي فِيمَ بَاتَتْ يَدُهُ " .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 393

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 394

chapter.arabicTitle: باب الرَّجُلِ يَسْتَيْقِظُ مِنْ مَنَامِهِ هَلْ يُدْخِلُ يَدَهُ فِي الإِنَاءِ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَغْسِلَهَا
chapter.englishTitle: When a man wakes up from sleep: should he put his hand in the vessel before washing it?

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Salim from his father that:
                      The Messenger of Allah said: "When anyone of you wakes up from sleep, he should not put his hand into the vessel until he has washed it."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Salim from his father that:
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah said: "When anyone of you wakes up from sleep, he should not put his hand into the vessel until he has washed it."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ لَهِيعَةَ، وَجَابِرُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، عَنْ عُقَيْلٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " إِذَا اسْتَيْقَظَ أَحَدُكُمْ مِنْ نَوْمِهِ فَلاَ يُدْخِلْ يَدَهُ فِي الإِنَاءِ حَتَّى يَغْسِلَهَا " .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 394

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 395

chapter.arabicTitle: باب الرَّجُلِ يَسْتَيْقِظُ مِنْ مَنَامِهِ هَلْ يُدْخِلُ يَدَهُ فِي الإِنَاءِ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَغْسِلَهَا
chapter.englishTitle: When a man wakes up from sleep: should he put his hand in the vessel before washing it?

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Jabir said:
                      "The Messenger of Allah said: 'When anyone of oyu gets up from sleep and wants to perform ablution, he should not put his hand into the vessel he used for ablution until he has washed it, because he does not know where his hand spent the night or where he put it.'" [(One of the narrators) Abu Ishaq said: "What is correct is that it is narrated from Jabir, from Abu Hurairah."]
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Jabir said:
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah said: 'When anyone of oyu gets up from sleep and wants to perform ablution, he should not put his hand into the vessel he used for ablution until he has washed it, because he does not know where his hand spent the night or where he put it.'" [(One of the narrators) Abu Ishaq said: "What is correct is that it is narrated from Jabir, from Abu Hurairah."]
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ تَوْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا زِيَادُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْبَكَّائِيُّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ أَبِي سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " إِذَا قَامَ أَحَدُكُمْ مِنَ النَّوْمِ فَأَرَادَ أَنْ يَتَوَضَّأَ فَلاَ يُدْخِلْ يَدَهُ فِي وَضُوئِهِ حَتَّى يَغْسِلَهَا فَإِنَّهُ لاَ يَدْرِي أَيْنَ بَاتَتْ يَدُهُ وَلاَ عَلَى مَا وَضَعَهَا " .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 395

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 396

chapter.arabicTitle: باب الرَّجُلِ يَسْتَيْقِظُ مِنْ مَنَامِهِ هَلْ يُدْخِلُ يَدَهُ فِي الإِنَاءِ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَغْسِلَهَا
chapter.englishTitle: When a man wakes up from sleep: should he put his hand in the vessel before washing it?

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Harith said:
                      "'Ali called for water, and he washed his hands before putting them in the vessel, then he said: 'This is what I saw the Messenger of Allah doing.'"
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Harith said:
hadiths.body: "'Ali called for water, and he washed his hands before putting them in the vessel, then he said: 'This is what I saw the Messenger of Allah doing.'"
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ عَيَّاشٍ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنِ الْحَارِثِ، قَالَ دَعَا عَلِيٌّ بِمَاءٍ فَغَسَلَ يَدَيْهِ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُدْخِلَهُمَا الإِنَاءَ ثُمَّ قَالَ هَكَذَا رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ صَنَعَ .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 396

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 397

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي التَّسْمِيَةِ فِي الْوُضُوءِ
chapter.englishTitle: Concerning saying "Bismilllah" when performing ablution

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Sa'eed that:
                      The Messenger of Allah said: "There is no ablution for one who does not mention the Name of Allah (before doing it)."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Sa'eed that:
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah said: "There is no ablution for one who does not mention the Name of Allah (before doing it)."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلاَءِ حَدَّثَنَا زَيْدُ بْنُ الْحُبَابِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَامِرٍ الْعَقَدِيُّ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مَنِيعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أَحْمَدَ الزُّبَيْرِيُّ، قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا كَثِيرُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ رُبَيْحِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ قَالَ  " لاَ وُضُوءَ لِمَنْ لَمْ يَذْكُرِ اسْمَ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ " .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 397

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 398

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي التَّسْمِيَةِ فِي الْوُضُوءِ
chapter.englishTitle: Concerning saying "Bismilllah" when performing ablution

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Abu Sa'eed bin Zaid said:
                      "The Messenger of Allah said: 'There is no prayer for one who does not have ablution, and there is no ablution for one who does not mention the Name of Allah (before it).'"
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Abu Sa'eed bin Zaid said:
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah said: 'There is no prayer for one who does not have ablution, and there is no ablution for one who does not mention the Name of Allah (before it).'"
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ الْخَلاَّلُ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ، أَنْبَأَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ عِيَاضٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو ثِفَالٍ، عَنْ رَبَاحِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ جَدَّتَهُ بِنْتَ سَعِيدِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ، تَذْكُرُ أَنَّهَا سَمِعَتْ أَبَاهَا، سَعِيدَ بْنَ زَيْدٍ يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " لاَ صَلاَةَ لِمَنْ لاَ وُضُوءَ لَهُ وَلاَ وُضُوءَ لِمَنْ لَمْ يَذْكُرِ اسْمَ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ " .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 398

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 399

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي التَّسْمِيَةِ فِي الْوُضُوءِ
chapter.englishTitle: Concerning saying "Bismilllah" when performing ablution

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Abu Hurairah said:
                      "The Messenger of Allah said: 'There is no prayer for one who does not have ablution, and there is no ablution for one who does not mention the Name of Allah (before it).'"
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Abu Hurairah said:
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah said: 'There is no prayer for one who does not have ablution, and there is no ablution for one who does not mention the Name of Allah (before it).'"
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، وَعَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي فُدَيْكٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مُوسَى بْنِ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ سَلَمَةَ اللَّيْثِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " لاَ صَلاَةَ لِمَنْ لاَ وُضُوءَ لَهُ وَلاَ وُضُوءَ لِمَنْ لَمْ يَذْكُرِ اسْمَ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ " .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 399

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 400

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي التَّسْمِيَةِ فِي الْوُضُوءِ
chapter.englishTitle: Concerning saying "Bismilllah" when performing ablution

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated by 'Abdul-Muhaimin bin 'Abbas bin Sahl bin Sa'd As-Sa'idi, from his father, from his grandfather, that:
                      The Prophet ﷺ said: "There is no prayer for one who does not have ablution, and there is no ablution for one who does not mention the Name of Allah (before it). There is no prayer for one who does not send blessing, (Salat) upon the Prophet, and there is no prayer for one who does not love the Ansar." (Da'if)
Another chain with similar wording.
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated by 'Abdul-Muhaimin bin 'Abbas bin Sahl bin Sa'd As-Sa'idi, from his father, from his grandfather, that:
hadiths.body:
The Prophet ﷺ said: "There is no prayer for one who does not have ablution, and there is no ablution for one who does not mention the Name of Allah (before it). There is no prayer for one who does not send blessing, (Salat) upon the Prophet, and there is no prayer for one who does not love the Ansar." (Da'if)
Another chain with similar wording.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي فُدَيْكٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمُهَيْمِنِ بْنِ عَبَّاسِ بْنِ سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ السَّاعِدِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ  " لاَ صَلاَةَ لِمَنْ لاَ وُضُوءَ لَهُ وَلاَ وُضُوءَ لِمَنْ لَمْ يَذْكُرِ اسْمَ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ وَلاَ صَلاَةَ لِمَنْ لاَ يُصَلِّي عَلَى النَّبِيِّ ﷺ وَلاَ صَلاَةَ لِمَنْ لاَ يُحِبُّ الأَنْصَارَ " .   قَالَ أَبُو الْحَسَنِ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْسُ بْنُ مَرْحُومٍ الْعَطَّارُ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْمُهَيْمِنِ بْنُ عَبَّاسٍ، فَذَكَرَ نَحْوَهُ .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 400

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 401

chapter.englishTitle: Starting on the right in ablution

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from 'Aishah that:
                      The Messenger of Allah liked to start on the right when purifying himself, when combing his hair and when putting on his footwear.
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from 'Aishah that:
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah liked to start on the right when purifying himself, when combing his hair and when putting on his footwear.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا هَنَّادُ بْنُ السَّرِيِّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الأَحْوَصِ، عَنْ أَشْعَثَ بْنِ أَبِي الشَّعْثَاءِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ وَكِيعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ عُبَيْدٍ الطَّنَافِسِيُّ، عَنْ أَشْعَثَ بْنِ أَبِي الشَّعْثَاءِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ كَانَ يُحِبُّ التَّيَمُّنَ فِي الطُّهُورِ إِذَا تَطَهَّرَ وَفِي تَرَجُّلِهِ إِذَا تَرَجَّلَ وَفِي انْتِعَالِهِ إِذَا انْتَعَلَ .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 401

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 402

chapter.englishTitle: Starting on the right in ablution

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Abu Hurairah said:
                      "The Messenger of Allah said: 'When you perform ablution, start on the right.'" (Da'if)
Another chain with similar wording.
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Abu Hurairah said:
hadiths.body:
"The Messenger of Allah said: 'When you perform ablution, start on the right.'" (Da'if)
Another chain with similar wording.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ النُّفَيْلِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " إِذَا تَوَضَّأْتُمْ فَابْدَءُوا بِمَيَامِنِكُمْ " .   قَالَ أَبُو الْحَسَنِ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ صَالِحٍ، وَابْنُ، نُفَيْلٍ وَغَيْرُهُمَا قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ، فَذَكَرَ نَحْوَهُ .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 402

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 403

chapter.arabicTitle: باب الْمَضْمَضَةِ وَالاِسْتِنْشَاقِ مِنْ كَفٍّ وَاحِدٍ
chapter.englishTitle: Rinsing the mouth and sniffing up water into the nostrils with one handful of water

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Ibn 'Abbas that:
                      The Messenger of Allah rinsed his mouth and sniffed water up into his nostrils from one scoop of water.
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Ibn 'Abbas that:
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah rinsed his mouth and sniffed water up into his nostrils from one scoop of water.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الْجَرَّاحِ، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ خَلاَّدٍ الْبَاهِلِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ مَضْمَضَ وَاسْتَنْشَقَ مِنْ غَرْفَةٍ وَاحِدَةٍ .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 403

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 404

chapter.arabicTitle: باب الْمَضْمَضَةِ وَالاِسْتِنْشَاقِ مِنْ كَفٍّ وَاحِدٍ
chapter.englishTitle: Rinsing the mouth and sniffing up water into the nostrils with one handful of water

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from 'Ali that:
                      The Messenger of Allah performed ablution and he rinsed his mouth three times, and sniffed water up into his nose three times from one handful.
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from 'Ali that:
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah performed ablution and he rinsed his mouth three times, and sniffed water up into his nose three times from one handful.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ، عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ عَلْقَمَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ خَيْرٍ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ تَوَضَّأَ فَمَضْمَضَ ثَلاَثًا وَاسْتَنْشَقَ ثَلاَثًا مِنْ كَفٍّ وَاحِدٍ .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 404

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 405

chapter.arabicTitle: باب الْمَضْمَضَةِ وَالاِسْتِنْشَاقِ مِنْ كَفٍّ وَاحِدٍ
chapter.englishTitle: Rinsing the mouth and sniffing up water into the nostrils with one handful of water

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that 'Abdullah bin Zaid Al-Ansari said:
                      "The Messenger of Allah came to us and asked us for water for ablution. I brought water to him and he rinsed his mouth and sniffed water up into his nostrils from one handful."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that 'Abdullah bin Zaid Al-Ansari said:
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah came to us and asked us for water for ablution. I brought water to him and he rinsed his mouth and sniffed water up into his nostrils from one handful."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْحُسَيْنِ الْعُكْلِيُّ، عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ يَحْيَى، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ الأَنْصَارِيِّ، قَالَ أَتَانَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَسَأَلَنَا وَضُوءًا فَأَتَيْتُهُ بِمَاءٍ فَمَضْمَضَ وَاسْتَنْشَقَ مِنْ كَفٍّ وَاحِدٍ .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 405

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 406

chapter.englishTitle: Going to extremes in sniffing water up into the nostrils and blowing it out

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Salamah bin Qais said to me:
                      The Messenger of Allah said to me: 'When you perform ablution, clean your nose, and when you use pebbles to clean yourself after defecating, use an odd number.'"
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Salamah bin Qais said to me:
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah said to me: 'When you perform ablution, clean your nose, and when you use pebbles to clean yourself after defecating, use an odd number.'"
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الأَحْوَصِ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ هِلاَلِ بْنِ يِسَافٍ، عَنْ سَلَمَةَ بْنِ قَيْسٍ، قَالَ قَالَ لِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " إِذَا تَوَضَّأْتَ فَانْثُرْ وَإِذَا اسْتَجْمَرْتَ فَأَوْتِرْ " .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 406

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 407

chapter.englishTitle: Going to extremes in sniffing water up into the nostrils and blowing it out

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from 'Asim bin Laqit bin Sabrah that his father said:
                      "I said: 'O Messenger of Allah! Tell me about ablution.' He said: 'Perform ablution properly and sniff water up into your nostrils, thoroughly, unless you are fasting.'"
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from 'Asim bin Laqit bin Sabrah that his father said:
hadiths.body: "I said: 'O Messenger of Allah! Tell me about ablution.' He said: 'Perform ablution properly and sniff water up into your nostrils, thoroughly, unless you are fasting.'"
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سُلَيْمٍ الطَّائِفِيُّ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ كَثِيرٍ، عَنْ عَاصِمِ بْنِ لَقِيطِ بْنِ صَبِرَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَخْبِرْنِي عَنِ الْوُضُوءِ، . قَالَ  " أَسْبِغِ الْوُضُوءَ وَبَالِغْ فِي الاِسْتِنْشَاقِ إِلاَّ أَنْ تَكُونَ صَائِمًا " .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 407

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 408

chapter.englishTitle: Going to extremes in sniffing water up into the nostrils and blowing it out

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Ibn 'Abbas said:
                      'Sniff up water into the nostrils thoroughly, two or three times.'"
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Ibn 'Abbas said:
hadiths.body: 'Sniff up water into the nostrils thoroughly, two or three times.'"
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ، عَنْ قَارِظِ بْنِ شَيْبَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي غَطَفَانَ الْمُرِّيِّ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " اسْتَنْثِرُوا مَرَّتَيْنِ بَالِغَتَيْنِ أَوْ ثَلاَثًا " .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 408

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 409

chapter.englishTitle: Going to extremes in sniffing water up into the nostrils and blowing it out

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Abu Hurairah said:
                      "The Messenger of Allah said: 'Whoever performs ablution, let him clean his nose, and whoever uses pebbles to clean himself after defecating, let him use an odd number.'"
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Abu Hurairah said:
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah said: 'Whoever performs ablution, let him clean his nose, and whoever uses pebbles to clean himself after defecating, let him use an odd number.'"
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا زَيْدُ بْنُ الْحُبَابِ، وَدَاوُدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ أَبِي إِدْرِيسَ الْخَوْلاَنِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " مَنْ تَوَضَّأَ فَلْيَسْتَنْثِرْ وَمَنِ اسْتَجْمَرَ فَلْيُوتِرْ " .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 409

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 410

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي الْوُضُوءِ مَرَّةً مَرَّةً
chapter.englishTitle: Concerning ablution washing (each limb) once

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Thabit bin Abi Safiyyah Ath-Thumali said:
                      "I asked Abu Ja'far: Was it narrated to you from Jabir bin 'Abdullah that the Prophet performed ablution washing each part once?' He said: 'Yes.' I said: 'And each part twice, and each part thrice?' He said: 'Yes.'"
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Thabit bin Abi Safiyyah Ath-Thumali said:
hadiths.body: "I asked Abu Ja'far: Was it narrated to you from Jabir bin 'Abdullah that the Prophet performed ablution washing each part once?' He said: 'Yes.' I said: 'And each part twice, and each part thrice?' He said: 'Yes.'"
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَامِرِ بْنِ زُرَارَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ النَّخَعِيُّ، عَنْ ثَابِتِ بْنِ أَبِي صَفِيَّةَ الثُّمَالِيِّ، قَالَ سَأَلْتُ أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ قُلْتُ لَهُ حُدِّثْتَ عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ تَوَضَّأَ مَرَّةً مَرَّةً قَالَ نَعَمْ . قُلْتُ وَمَرَّتَيْنِ مَرَّتَيْنِ وَثَلاَثًا ثَلاَثًا قَالَ نَعَمْ .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 410

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 411

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي الْوُضُوءِ مَرَّةً مَرَّةً
chapter.englishTitle: Concerning ablution washing (each limb) once

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Ibn 'Abbas said:
                      "I saw the Messenger of Allah performing ablution, taking one handful (of water) at a time.'"
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Ibn 'Abbas said:
hadiths.body: "I saw the Messenger of Allah performing ablution, taking one handful (of water) at a time.'"
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ خَلاَّدٍ الْبَاهِلِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الْقَطَّانُ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ تَوَضَّأَ غُرْفَةً غُرْفَةً .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 411

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 412

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي الْوُضُوءِ مَرَّةً مَرَّةً
chapter.englishTitle: Concerning ablution washing (each limb) once

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that 'Umar said:
                      "I saw the Messenger of Allah during the campaign of Tabuk performing ablution, washing each part once."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that 'Umar said:
hadiths.body: "I saw the Messenger of Allah during the campaign of Tabuk performing ablution, washing each part once."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا رِشْدِينُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، أَنْبَأَنَا الضَّحَّاكُ بْنُ شُرَحْبِيلَ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عُمَرَ، قَالَ رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ فِي غَزْوَةِ تَبُوكَ تَوَضَّأَ وَاحِدَةً وَاحِدَةً .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 412

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 413

chapter.englishTitle: Performing ablution by washing three times

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Shaqiq bin Salamah said:
                      "I saw `Uthman and `Ali performing ablution, washing each part three times, and they said: 'This is how the Messenger of Allah used to perform ablution.'" 
Another chain with similar wording.
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Shaqiq bin Salamah said:
hadiths.body:
"I saw `Uthman and `Ali performing ablution, washing each part three times, and they said: 'This is how the Messenger of Allah used to perform ablution.'" 
Another chain with similar wording.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مَحْمُودُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ الدِّمَشْقِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ الدِّمَشْقِيُّ، عَنِ ابْنِ ثَوْبَانَ، عَنْ عَبْدَةَ بْنِ أَبِي لُبَابَةَ، عَنْ شَقِيقِ بْنِ سَلَمَةَ، قَالَ رَأَيْتُ عُثْمَانَ وَعَلِيًّا يَتَوَضَّآنِ ثَلاَثًا ثَلاَثًا وَيَقُولاَنِ هَكَذَا كَانَ وُضُوءُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ .   قَالَ أَبُو الْحَسَنِ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ حَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ ثَابِتِ بْنِ ثَوْبَانَ، فَذَكَرَ نَحْوَهُ .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 413

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 414

chapter.englishTitle: Performing ablution by washing three times

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Ibn 'Umar:
                      Performed ablution washing each part three times, and he attributed that to the Prophet.
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Ibn 'Umar:
hadiths.body: Performed ablution washing each part three times, and he attributed that to the Prophet.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الدِّمَشْقِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَوْزَاعِيُّ، عَنِ الْمُطَّلِبِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ حَنْطَبٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّهُ تَوَضَّأَ ثَلاَثًا ثَلاَثًا وَرَفَعَ ذَلِكَ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ ﷺ .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 414

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 415

chapter.englishTitle: Performing ablution by washing three times

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from 'Aishah and Abu Hurairah that:
                      The Prophet did ablution washing each part three times.
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from 'Aishah and Abu Hurairah that:
hadiths.body: The Prophet did ablution washing each part three times.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ حَيَّانَ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ أَبِي الْمُهَاجِرِ، عَنْ مَيْمُونِ بْنِ مِهْرَانَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، وَأَبِي، هُرَيْرَةَ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ تَوَضَّأَ ثَلاَثًا ثَلاَثًا .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 415

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 416

chapter.englishTitle: Performing ablution by washing three times

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that 'Abdullah bin Awfa said:
                      "I saw the Messenger of Allah performing ablution, washing each part three times, and wiping his head once."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that 'Abdullah bin Awfa said:
hadiths.body: "I saw the Messenger of Allah performing ablution, washing each part three times, and wiping his head once."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ وَكِيعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عِيسَى بْنُ يُونُسَ، عَنْ فَائِدٍ أَبِي الْوَرْقَاءِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي أَوْفَى، قَالَ رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ تَوَضَّأَ ثَلاَثًا ثَلاَثًا وَمَسَحَ رَأْسَهُ مَرَّةً .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 416

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 417

chapter.englishTitle: Performing ablution by washing three times

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Abu Malik Ash'ari said:
                      "The Messenger of Allah used to perform ablution washing each part three times."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Abu Malik Ash'ari said:
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah used to perform ablution washing each part three times."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ لَيْثٍ، عَنْ شَهْرِ بْنِ حَوْشَبٍ، عَنْ أَبِي مَالِكٍ الأَشْعَرِيِّ، قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَتَوَضَّأُ ثَلاَثًا ثَلاَثًا .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 417

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 418

chapter.englishTitle: Performing ablution by washing three times

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Rabi' bint Mu'awwidh bin 'Afra' that:
                      The Messenger of Allah performed ablution washing each part three times.
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Rabi' bint Mu'awwidh bin 'Afra' that:
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah performed ablution washing each part three times.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَعَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَقِيلٍ، عَنِ الرُّبَيِّعِ بِنْتِ مُعَوِّذِ بْنِ عَفْرَاءَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ تَوَضَّأَ ثَلاَثًا ثَلاَثًا .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 418

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 419

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي الْوُضُوءِ مَرَّةً وَمَرَّتَيْنِ وَثَلاَثًا
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning ablution by washing once, twice or thrice

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Ibn 'Umar said:
                      "The Messenger of Allah performed ablution washing each part once. He said: 'This is the ablution of the person from whom Allah will not accept his prayer without it.' Then he performed ablution washing each part twice, and he said: 'This is the ablution that Allah appreciates.' Then he performed ablution washing each part three times, and said: 'This is how ablution is performed properly, and this is my ablution and the ablution of the Close Friend of Allah, Ibrahim. Whoever performs ablution like this, then on completing it says: 'Ashhadu an la ilaha illallah, wa ashhadu anna Muhammadan 'abduhu wa rasuluhu' (I bear witness that none has the right to be worshipped but Allah, and I bear witness that Muhammed is His servant and His Messenger), eight gates of Paradise will be opened to him and he may enter through whichever one he wants.'"
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Ibn 'Umar said:
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah performed ablution washing each part once. He said: 'This is the ablution of the person from whom Allah will not accept his prayer without it.' Then he performed ablution washing each part twice, and he said: 'This is the ablution that Allah appreciates.' Then he performed ablution washing each part three times, and said: 'This is how ablution is performed properly, and this is my ablution and the ablution of the Close Friend of Allah, Ibrahim. Whoever performs ablution like this, then on completing it says: 'Ashhadu an la ilaha illallah, wa ashhadu anna Muhammadan 'abduhu wa rasuluhu' (I bear witness that none has the right to be worshipped but Allah, and I bear witness that Muhammed is His servant and His Messenger), eight gates of Paradise will be opened to him and he may enter through whichever one he wants.'"
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ خَلاَّدٍ الْبَاهِلِيُّ، حَدَّثَنِي مَرْحُومُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ الْعَطَّارُ، حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الرَّحِيمِ بْنُ زَيْدٍ الْعَمِّيُّ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ قُرَّةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ تَوَضَّأَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَاحِدَةً وَاحِدَةً فَقَالَ " هَذَا وُضُوءُ مَنْ لاَ يَقْبَلُ اللَّهُ مِنْهُ صَلاَةً إِلاَّ بِهِ " . ثُمَّ تَوَضَّأَ ثِنْتَيْنِ ثِنْتَيْنِ فَقَالَ " هَذَا وُضُوءُ الْقَدْرِ مِنَ الْوُضُوءِ " . وَتَوَضَّأَ ثَلاَثًا ثَلاَثًا وَقَالَ " هَذَا أَسْبَغُ الْوُضُوءِ وَهُوَ وُضُوئِي وَوُضُوءُ خَلِيلِ اللَّهِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَمَنْ تَوَضَّأَ هَكَذَا ثُمَّ قَالَ عِنْدَ فَرَاغِهِ أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ فُتِحَ لَهُ ثَمَانِيَةُ أَبْوَابِ الْجَنَّةِ يَدْخُلُ مِنْ أَيِّهَا شَاءَ " .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 419

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 420

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي الْوُضُوءِ مَرَّةً وَمَرَّتَيْنِ وَثَلاَثًا
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning ablution by washing once, twice or thrice

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Ubayy bin Ka'b that:
                      The Messenger of Allah called for water and performed ablution once. He said: "This is the minimum requirement of ablution' or he said: 'The ablution of one who, if he does not perform this ablution, Allah will not accept his prayer." Then he performed ablution washing each part twice, and he said: 'This is the ablution of one who, if he performs it, Allah will give him two shares of reward." Then he performed ablution washing each part three times, and said: 'This is my ablution and the ablution of the Messengers who were sent before me."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Ubayy bin Ka'b that:
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah called for water and performed ablution once. He said: "This is the minimum requirement of ablution' or he said: 'The ablution of one who, if he does not perform this ablution, Allah will not accept his prayer." Then he performed ablution washing each part twice, and he said: 'This is the ablution of one who, if he performs it, Allah will give him two shares of reward." Then he performed ablution washing each part three times, and said: 'This is my ablution and the ablution of the Messengers who were sent before me."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ مُسَافِرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ قَعْنَبٍ أَبُو بِشْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَرَادَةَ الشَّيْبَانِيُّ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ الْحَوَارِيِّ، عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ قُرَّةَ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ، عَنْ أُبَىِّ بْنِ كَعْبٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ دَعَا بِمَاءٍ فَتَوَضَّأَ مَرَّةً مَرَّةً فَقَالَ " هَذَا وَظِيفَةُ الْوُضُوءِ " . أَوْ قَالَ " وُضُوءٌ مَنْ لَمْ يَتَوَضَّأْهُ لَمْ يَقْبَلِ اللَّهُ لَهُ صَلاَةً " . ثُمَّ تَوَضَّأَ مَرَّتَيْنِ مَرَّتَيْنِ ثُمَّ قَالَ " هَذَا وُضُوءٌ مَنْ تَوَضَّأَهُ أَعْطَاهُ اللَّهُ كِفْلَيْنِ مِنَ الأَجْرِ " . ثُمَّ تَوَضَّأَ ثَلاَثًا ثَلاَثًا فَقَالَ " هَذَا وُضُوئِي وَوُضُوءُ الْمُرْسَلِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِي " .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 420

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 421

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي الْقَصْدِ فِي الْوَضُوءِ وَكَرَاهِيَةِ التَّعَدِّي فِيهِ
chapter.englishTitle: Concerning moderation in ablution and avoiding extravagance

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Ubayy bin Ka'b said:
                      "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'There is a devil for ablution who is called Walahan, so be on guard against the insinuating thoughts (Waswas) about water.'"
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Ubayy bin Ka'b said:
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'There is a devil for ablution who is called Walahan, so be on guard against the insinuating thoughts (Waswas) about water.'"
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ، حَدَّثَنَا خَارِجَةُ بْنُ مُصْعَبٍ، عَنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ عُبَيْدٍ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، عَنْ عُتَىِّ بْنِ ضَمْرَةَ السَّعْدِيِّ، عَنْ أُبَىِّ بْنِ كَعْبٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " إِنَّ لِلْوُضُوءِ شَيْطَانًا يُقَالُ لَهُ وَلَهَانُ فَاتَّقُوا وَسْوَاسَ الْمَاءِ " .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 421

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 422

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي الْقَصْدِ فِي الْوَضُوءِ وَكَرَاهِيَةِ التَّعَدِّي فِيهِ
chapter.englishTitle: Concerning moderation in ablution and avoiding extravagance

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from 'Amr bin Shu'aib from his father, from his grandfather, that:
                      A Bedouin came to the Prophet and asked him about ablution. He showed him how to perform it washing each part of the body three times. Then he said: 'This is the ablution, and whoever does more than this, has done evil, transgressed the limits and wronged himself.'"
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from 'Amr bin Shu'aib from his father, from his grandfather, that:
hadiths.body: A Bedouin came to the Prophet and asked him about ablution. He showed him how to perform it washing each part of the body three times. Then he said: 'This is the ablution, and whoever does more than this, has done evil, transgressed the limits and wronged himself.'"
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِي، يَعْلَى عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ أَبِي عَائِشَةَ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ شُعَيْبٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ، قَالَ جَاءَ أَعْرَابِيٌّ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ ﷺ فَسَأَلَهُ عَنِ الْوُضُوءِ فَأَرَاهُ ثَلاَثًا ثَلاَثًا ثُمَّ قَالَ  " هَذَا الْوُضُوءُ فَمَنْ زَادَ عَلَى هَذَا فَقَدْ أَسَاءَ وَتَعَدَّى أَوْ ظَلَمَ " .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 422

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 423

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي الْقَصْدِ فِي الْوَضُوءِ وَكَرَاهِيَةِ التَّعَدِّي فِيهِ
chapter.englishTitle: Concerning moderation in ablution and avoiding extravagance

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that 'Amr heard Kuraib saying:
                      "I heard Ibn 'Abbas say: 'I stayed overnight with my maternal aunt Maimunah, and the Prophet got up and performed ablution from an old water skin, and he did a brief ablution. Then I got up and did the same as he had done."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that 'Amr heard Kuraib saying:
hadiths.body: "I heard Ibn 'Abbas say: 'I stayed overnight with my maternal aunt Maimunah, and the Prophet got up and performed ablution from an old water skin, and he did a brief ablution. Then I got up and did the same as he had done."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو إِسْحَاقَ الشَّافِعِيُّ، إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْعَبَّاسِ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو، سَمِعَ كُرَيْبًا، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ، يَقُولُ بِتُّ عِنْدَ خَالَتِي مَيْمُونَةَ فَقَامَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ فَتَوَضَّأَ مِنْ شَنَّةٍ وُضُوءًا يُقَلِّلُهُ فَقُمْتُ فَصَنَعْتُ كَمَا صَنَعَ .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 423

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 424

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي الْقَصْدِ فِي الْوَضُوءِ وَكَرَاهِيَةِ التَّعَدِّي فِيهِ
chapter.englishTitle: Concerning moderation in ablution and avoiding extravagance

hadiths.englishRaw:
It is narrated that Ibn 'Umar said:
                      "The Messenger of Allah saw a man performing ablution, and he said: 'Do not be extravagant, do not be extravagant (in using water).'" (Maudu')
hadiths.narrator: It is narrated that Ibn 'Umar said:
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah saw a man performing ablution, and he said: 'Do not be extravagant, do not be extravagant (in using water).'" (Maudu')
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُصَفَّى الْحِمْصِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا بَقِيَّةُ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْفَضْلِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ رَأَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ رَجُلاً يَتَوَضَّأُ فَقَالَ  " لاَ تُسْرِفْ لاَ تُسْرِفْ " .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 424

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 425

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي الْقَصْدِ فِي الْوَضُوءِ وَكَرَاهِيَةِ التَّعَدِّي فِيهِ
chapter.englishTitle: Concerning moderation in ablution and avoiding extravagance

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from 'Abdullah bin 'Amr that:
                      The Messenger of Allah passed by Sa'd when he was performing ablution, and he said: 'What is this extravagance?' He said: 'Can there be any extravagance in ablution?' He said: 'Yes, even if you are on the bank of a flowing river.'"
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from 'Abdullah bin 'Amr that:
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah passed by Sa'd when he was performing ablution, and he said: 'What is this extravagance?' He said: 'Can there be any extravagance in ablution?' He said: 'Yes, even if you are on the bank of a flowing river.'"
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ لَهِيعَةَ، عَنْ حُيَىِّ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْمَعَافِرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْحُبُلِيِّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ مَرَّ بِسَعْدٍ وَهُوَ يَتَوَضَّأُ فَقَالَ " مَا هَذَا السَّرَفُ " . فَقَالَ أَفِي الْوُضُوءِ إِسْرَافٌ قَالَ " نَعَمْ وَإِنْ كُنْتَ عَلَى نَهَرٍ جَارٍ " .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 425

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 426

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي إِسْبَاغِ الْوُضُوءِ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning performing ablution properly

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Ibn 'Abbas said:
                      "The Messenger of Allah commanded us to perform ablution properly."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Ibn 'Abbas said:
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah commanded us to perform ablution properly."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ سَالِمٍ أَبُو جَهْضَمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ أَمَرَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ بِإِسْبَاغِ الْوُضُوءِ .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 426

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 427

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي إِسْبَاغِ الْوُضُوءِ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning performing ablution properly

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Sa'eed Khudri that he heard :
                      The Messenger of Allah say: "Shall I not tell you of something by means of which Allah expiates for sins and increases good deeds?" They said: "Yes, O Messenger of Allah." He said: "Perform ablution properly despite difficulties, increasing the number of steps one takes towards the mosque and waiting for the next prayer after prayer.'"
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Sa'eed Khudri that he heard :
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah say: "Shall I not tell you of something by means of which Allah expiates for sins and increases good deeds?" They said: "Yes, O Messenger of Allah." He said: "Perform ablution properly despite difficulties, increasing the number of steps one takes towards the mosque and waiting for the next prayer after prayer.'"
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَبِي بُكَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَقِيلٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ " أَلاَ أَدُلُّكُمْ عَلَى مَا يُكَفِّرُ اللَّهُ بِهِ الْخَطَايَا وَيَزِيدُ بِهِ فِي الْحَسَنَاتِ " . قَالُوا بَلَى يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ . قَالَ " إِسْبَاغُ الْوُضُوءِ عَلَى الْمَكَارِهِ وَكَثْرَةُ الْخُطَا إِلَى الْمَسَاجِدِ وَانْتِظَارُ الصَّلاَةِ بَعْدَ الصَّلاَةِ " .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 427

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 428

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي إِسْبَاغِ الْوُضُوءِ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning performing ablution properly

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that:
                      The Prophet ﷺ said: "Sins are expiated by well-performed ablution despite difficulties, increasing the number of steps one takes towards the mosque, (and waiting for the next prayer after prayer)."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that:
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ said: "Sins are expiated by well-performed ablution despite difficulties, increasing the number of steps one takes towards the mosque, (and waiting for the next prayer after prayer)."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ كَاسِبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ حَمْزَةَ، عَنْ كَثِيرِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ، عَنِ الْوَلِيدِ بْنِ رَبَاحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ قَالَ  " كَفَّارَاتُ الْخَطَايَا إِسْبَاغُ الْوُضُوءِ عَلَى الْمَكَارِهِ وَإِعْمَالُ الأَقْدَامِ إِلَى الْمَسَاجِدِ وَانْتِظَارُ الصَّلاَةِ بَعْدَ الصَّلاَةِ " .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 428

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 429

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي تَخْلِيلِ اللِّحْيَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: Concerning running the fingers through the beard (when performing ablution)

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that 'Ammar bin Yasir said:
                      "I saw the Messenger of Allah running his fingers through his beard."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that 'Ammar bin Yasir said:
hadiths.body: "I saw the Messenger of Allah running his fingers through his beard."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ الْعَدَنِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْكَرِيمِ أَبِي أُمَيَّةَ، عَنْ حَسَّانِ بْنِ بِلاَلٍ، عَنْ عَمَّارِ بْنِ يَاسِرٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي عَرُوبَةَ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ حَسَّانِ بْنِ بِلاَلٍ، عَنْ عَمَّارِ بْنِ يَاسِرٍ، قَالَ رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يُخَلِّلُ لِحْيَتَهُ .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 429

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 430

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي تَخْلِيلِ اللِّحْيَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: Concerning running the fingers through the beard (when performing ablution)

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from 'Uthman that:
                      The Messenger of Allah performed ablution and ran his fingers through his beard.
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from 'Uthman that:
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah performed ablution and ran his fingers through his beard.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَبِي خَالِدٍ الْقَزْوِينِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ إِسْرَائِيلَ، عَنْ عَامِرِ بْنِ شَقِيقٍ الأَسَدِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ، عَنْ عُثْمَانَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ تَوَضَّأَ فَخَلَّلَ لِحْيَتَهُ .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 430

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 431

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي تَخْلِيلِ اللِّحْيَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: Concerning running the fingers through the beard (when performing ablution)

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Anas bin Malik said:
                      "When the Messenger of Allah performed ablution, he ran his fingers through his beard and separated his fingers (to let water run through them) twice."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Anas bin Malik said:
hadiths.body: "When the Messenger of Allah performed ablution, he ran his fingers through his beard and separated his fingers (to let water run through them) twice."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ حَفْصِ بْنِ هِشَامِ بْنِ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ كَثِيرٍ أَبُو النَّضْرِ، صَاحِبُ الْبَصْرِيِّ عَنْ يَزِيدَ الرَّقَاشِيِّ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ إِذَا تَوَضَّأَ خَلَّلَ لِحْيَتَهُ وَفَرَّجَ أَصَابِعَهُ مَرَّتَيْنِ .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 431

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 432

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي تَخْلِيلِ اللِّحْيَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: Concerning running the fingers through the beard (when performing ablution)

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Ibn 'Umar said:
                      "Whenever the Messenger of Allah performed ablution, he rubbed the sides of his face then run his fingers through his beard from beneath."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Ibn 'Umar said:
hadiths.body: "Whenever the Messenger of Allah performed ablution, he rubbed the sides of his face then run his fingers through his beard from beneath."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْحَمِيدِ بْنُ حَبِيبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَوْزَاعِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ بْنُ قَيْسٍ، حَدَّثَنِي نَافِعٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ إِذَا تَوَضَّأَ عَرَكَ عَارِضَيْهِ بَعْضَ الْعَرْكِ ثُمَّ شَبَكَ لِحْيَتَهُ بِأَصَابِعِهِ مِنْ تَحْتِهَا .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 432

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 433

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي تَخْلِيلِ اللِّحْيَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: Concerning running the fingers through the beard (when performing ablution)

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Abu Ayyub Al-Ansari said:
                      "I saw the Messenger of Allah performing ablution and he ran his fingers through his beard."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Abu Ayyub Al-Ansari said:
hadiths.body: "I saw the Messenger of Allah performing ablution and he ran his fingers through his beard."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الرَّقِّيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَبِيعَةَ الْكِلاَبِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا وَاصِلُ بْنُ السَّائِبِ الرَّقَاشِيُّ، عَنْ أَبِي سَوْرَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ الأَنْصَارِيِّ، قَالَ رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ تَوَضَّأَ فَخَلَّلَ لِحْيَتَهُ .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 433

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 434

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي مَسْحِ الرَّأْسِ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning wiping the head

hadiths.englishRaw:
'Amr bin Yahya narrated that his father said to 'Abdullah bin Zaid who was the grandfather of 'Amr bin Yahya:
                      "Can you show me how the Messenger of Allah used to perform ablution?" 'Abdullah bin Zaid said: "Yes," So he called for water, poured it over his hands and washed his hands twice. Then he raised his mouth and sniffed water up into his nostrils three times. Then he washed his face three times and his arms up to his elbows twice. Then he wiped his head with his hands, from front to back. He started at the front of his head, then went with them to the nape of his neck, then he brought them back, returning them to the place he started, then he washed his feet."
hadiths.narrator: 'Amr bin Yahya narrated that his father said to 'Abdullah bin Zaid who was the grandfather of 'Amr bin Yahya:
hadiths.body: "Can you show me how the Messenger of Allah used to perform ablution?" 'Abdullah bin Zaid said: "Yes," So he called for water, poured it over his hands and washed his hands twice. Then he raised his mouth and sniffed water up into his nostrils three times. Then he washed his face three times and his arms up to his elbows twice. Then he wiped his head with his hands, from front to back. He started at the front of his head, then went with them to the nape of his neck, then he brought them back, returning them to the place he started, then he washed his feet."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا الرَّبِيعُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، وَحَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِدْرِيسَ الشَّافِعِيُّ، قَالَ أَنْبَأَنَا مَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ يَحْيَى، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ لِعَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ - وَهُوَ جَدُّ عَمْرِو بْنِ يَحْيَى - هَلْ تَسْتَطِيعُ أَنْ تُرِيَنِي، كَيْفَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَتَوَضَّأُ فَقَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ زَيْدٍ نَعَمْ . فَدَعَا بِوَضُوءٍ فَأَفْرَغَ عَلَى يَدَيْهِ فَغَسَلَ يَدَيْهِ مَرَّتَيْنِ ثُمَّ تَمَضْمَضَ وَاسْتَنْثَرَ ثَلاَثًا ثُمَّ غَسَلَ وَجْهَهُ ثَلاَثًا ثُمَّ غَسَلَ يَدَيْهِ مَرَّتَيْنِ مَرَّتَيْنِ إِلَى الْمِرْفَقَيْنِ ثُمَّ مَسَحَ رَأْسَهُ بِيَدَيْهِ فَأَقْبَلَ بِهِمَا وَأَدْبَرَ بَدَأَ بِمُقَدَّمِ رَأْسِهِ ثُمَّ ذَهَبَ بِهِمَا إِلَى قَفَاهُ ثُمَّ رَدَّهُمَا حَتَّى رَجَعَ إِلَى الْمَكَانِ الَّذِي بَدَأَ مِنْهُ ثُمَّ غَسَلَ رِجْلَيْهِ .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 434

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 435

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي مَسْحِ الرَّأْسِ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning wiping the head

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that 'Uthman bin 'Affan said:
                      "I saw the Messenger of Allah performing ablution and he wiped his head once."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that 'Uthman bin 'Affan said:
hadiths.body: "I saw the Messenger of Allah performing ablution and he wiped his head once."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبَّادُ بْنُ الْعَوَّامِ، عَنْ حَجَّاجٍ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ عَفَّانَ، قَالَ رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ تَوَضَّأَ فَمَسَحَ رَأْسَهُ مَرَّةً .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 435

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 436

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي مَسْحِ الرَّأْسِ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning wiping the head

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from 'Ali that:
                      The Messenger of Allah wiped his head once.
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from 'Ali that:
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah wiped his head once.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا هَنَّادُ بْنُ السَّرِيِّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الأَحْوَصِ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ أَبِي حَيَّةَ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ مَسَحَ رَأْسَهُ مَرَّةً .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 436

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 437

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي مَسْحِ الرَّأْسِ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning wiping the head

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Salamah bin Akwa' said:
                      "I saw the Messenger of Allah performing ablution, and he wiped his head once."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Salamah bin Akwa' said:
hadiths.body: "I saw the Messenger of Allah performing ablution, and he wiped his head once."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْحَارِثِ الْمِصْرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ رَاشِدٍ الْبَصْرِيُّ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ، مَوْلَى سَلَمَةَ عَنْ سَلَمَةَ بْنِ الأَكْوَعِ، قَالَ رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ تَوَضَّأَ فَمَسَحَ رَأْسَهُ مَرَّةً .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 437

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 438

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي مَسْحِ الرَّأْسِ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning wiping the head

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Ar-Rubai' bint Mu'awwidh bin 'Afra' said:
                      "The Messenger of Allah performed ablution and wiped his head twice."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Ar-Rubai' bint Mu'awwidh bin 'Afra' said:
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah performed ablution and wiped his head twice."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَعَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَقِيلٍ، عَنِ الرُّبَيِّعِ بِنْتِ مُعَوِّذِ ابْنِ عَفْرَاءَ، قَالَتْ تَوَضَّأَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَمَسَحَ رَأْسَهُ مَرَّتَيْنِ .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 438

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 439

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي مَسْحِ الأُذُنَيْنِ
chapter.englishTitle: Concerning wiping the ears

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Ibn 'Abbas that:
                      The Messenger of Allah wiped his ears, putting his forefingers in his ears and wiping the back of them with his thumbs, so he wiped them inside and out.
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Ibn 'Abbas that:
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah wiped his ears, putting his forefingers in his ears and wiping the back of them with his thumbs, so he wiped them inside and out.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ إِدْرِيسَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَجْلاَنَ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ مَسَحَ أُذُنَيْهِ دَاخِلَهُمَا بِالسَّبَّابَتَيْنِ وَخَالَفَ إِبْهَامَيْهِ إِلَى ظَاهِرِ أُذُنَيْهِ فَمَسَحَ ظَاهِرَهُمَا وَبَاطِنَهُمَا .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 439

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 440

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي مَسْحِ الأُذُنَيْنِ
chapter.englishTitle: Concerning wiping the ears

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Rubai' that:
                      The prophet performed ablution and wiped his ears inside and out.
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Rubai' that:
hadiths.body: The prophet performed ablution and wiped his ears inside and out.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَقِيلٍ، عَنِ الرُّبَيِّعِ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ تَوَضَّأَ فَمَسَحَ ظَاهِرَ أُذُنَيْهِ وَبَاطِنَهُمَا .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 440

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 441

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي مَسْحِ الأُذُنَيْنِ
chapter.englishTitle: Concerning wiping the ears

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Rubai' bint Mu'awwidh bin 'Afra' said:
                      "The Prophet performed ablution, and he put his fingers in the (holes) inside of his ears."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Rubai' bint Mu'awwidh bin 'Afra' said:
hadiths.body: "The Prophet performed ablution, and he put his fingers in the (holes) inside of his ears."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَعَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ صَالِحٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَقِيلٍ، عَنِ الرُّبَيِّعِ بِنْتِ مُعَوِّذِ ابْنِ عَفْرَاءَ، قَالَتْ تَوَضَّأَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ فَأَدْخَلَ إِصْبَعَيْهِ فِي جُحْرَىْ أُذُنَيْهِ .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 441

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 442

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي مَسْحِ الأُذُنَيْنِ
chapter.englishTitle: Concerning wiping the ears

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Miqdam bin Ma'dikarib that:
                      The Messenger of Allah performed ablution and he wiped his head and his ears, inside and out.
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Miqdam bin Ma'dikarib that:
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah performed ablution and he wiped his head and his ears, inside and out.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ، حَدَّثَنَا حَرِيزُ بْنُ عُثْمَانَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ مَيْسَرَةَ، عَنِ الْمِقْدَامِ بْنِ مَعْدِيكَرِبَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ تَوَضَّأَ فَمَسَحَ بِرَأْسِهِ وَأُذُنَيْهِ ظَاهِرَهُمَا وَبَاطِنَهُمَا .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 442

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 443

chapter.englishTitle: The ears are part of the head

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that 'Abdullah bin Zaid said:
                      "The Messenger of Allah said: 'The ears are part of the head.'"
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that 'Abdullah bin Zaid said:
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah said: 'The ears are part of the head.'"
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا سُوَيْدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ زَكَرِيَّا بْنِ أَبِي زَائِدَةَ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ حَبِيبِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ عَبَّادِ بْنِ تَمِيمٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " الأُذُنَانِ مِنَ الرَّأْسِ " .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 443

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 444

chapter.englishTitle: The ears are part of the head

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Umamah that:
                      The Messenger of Allah said: "The ears are part of the head." He used to wipe his head once, and he used to wipe over the inner corners of the eyes (that are close to the nose).
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Umamah that:
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah said: "The ears are part of the head." He used to wipe his head once, and he used to wipe over the inner corners of the eyes (that are close to the nose).
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ زِيَادٍ، أَنْبَأَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ سِنَانِ بْنِ رَبِيعَةَ، عَنْ شَهْرِ بْنِ حَوْشَبٍ، عَنْ أَبِي أُمَامَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ  " الأُذُنَانِ مِنَ الرَّأْسِ " . وَكَانَ يَمْسَحُ رَأْسَهُ مَرَّةً وَكَانَ يَمْسَحُ الْمَأْقَيْنِ .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 444

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 445

chapter.englishTitle: The ears are part of the head

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Abu Hurairah said:
                      "The Messenger of Allah said: 'The ears are part of the head.'"
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Abu Hurairah said:
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah said: 'The ears are part of the head.'"
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ الْحُصَيْنِ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُلاَثَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْكَرِيمِ الْجَزَرِيِّ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " الأُذُنَانِ مِنَ الرَّأْسِ " .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 445

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 446

chapter.englishTitle: Running the fingers of one hand between the finger of the other (and the toes)

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Mustawarid bin Shaddad said:
                      "I saw the Messenger of Allah performing ablution, and he ran his little finger between his toes." 
Another chain with similar wording.
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Mustawarid bin Shaddad said:
hadiths.body:
"I saw the Messenger of Allah performing ablution, and he ran his little finger between his toes." 
Another chain with similar wording.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُصَفَّى الْحِمْصِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حِمْيَرَ، عَنِ ابْنِ لَهِيعَةَ، حَدَّثَنِي يَزِيدُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو الْمَعَافِرِيُّ، عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْحُبُلِيِّ، عَنِ الْمُسْتَوْرِدِ بْنِ شَدَّادٍ، قَالَ رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ تَوَضَّأَ فَخَلَّلَ أَصَابِعَ رِجْلَيْهِ بِخِنْصِرِهِ .   قَالَ أَبُو الْحَسَنِ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ حَدَّثَنَا خَازِمُ بْنُ يَحْيَى الْحُلْوَانِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ لَهِيعَةَ، فَذَكَرَ نَحْوَهُ .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 446

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 447

chapter.englishTitle: Running the fingers of one hand between the finger of the other (and the toes)

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Ibn 'Abbas said:
                      'The Messenger of Allah said: 'When you get up for prayer, perform ablution properly and make the water run between your toes and your fingers.'"
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Ibn 'Abbas said:
hadiths.body: 'The Messenger of Allah said: 'When you get up for prayer, perform ablution properly and make the water run between your toes and your fingers.'"
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الْجَوْهَرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْحَمِيدِ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ عُقْبَةَ، عَنْ صَالِحٍ، مَوْلَى التَّوْأَمَةِ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " إِذَا قُمْتَ إِلَى الصَّلاَةِ فَأَسْبِغِ الْوُضُوءَ وَاجْعَلِ الْمَاءَ بَيْنَ أَصَابِعِ يَدَيْكَ وَرِجْلَيْكَ " .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 447

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 448

chapter.englishTitle: Running the fingers of one hand between the finger of the other (and the toes)

hadiths.englishRaw:
'Asim bin Laqit bin Saabirah narrated that his father said:
                      "The Messenger of Allah said: perform ablution properly and let the water run between your fingers."
hadiths.narrator: 'Asim bin Laqit bin Saabirah narrated that his father said:
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah said: perform ablution properly and let the water run between your fingers."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سُلَيْمٍ الطَّائِفِيُّ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ كَثِيرٍ، عَنْ عَاصِمِ بْنِ لَقِيطِ بْنِ صَبِرَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " أَسْبِغِ الْوُضُوءَ وَخَلِّلْ بَيْنَ الأَصَابِعِ " .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 448

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 449

chapter.englishTitle: Running the fingers of one hand between the finger of the other (and the toes)

hadiths.englishRaw:
'Ubaidullah bin Abu Rafi' narrated from his father that:
                      Whenever the Messenger of Allah performed ablution, he moved his ring.
hadiths.narrator: 'Ubaidullah bin Abu Rafi' narrated from his father that:
hadiths.body: Whenever the Messenger of Allah performed ablution, he moved his ring.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ الرَّقَاشِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا مَعْمَرُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي رَافِعٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ كَانَ إِذَا تَوَضَّأَ حَرَّكَ خَاتَمَهُ .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 449

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 450

chapter.englishTitle: Washing the (heels and) Achilles tendon

hadiths.englishRaw:
'Abdullah bin 'Amr said:
                      "The Messenger of Allah saw some people performing ablution, and their heels were dry. He said: 'Woe to the heels because of Hell-fire, perform ablution properly!'"
hadiths.narrator: 'Abdullah bin 'Amr said:
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah saw some people performing ablution, and their heels were dry. He said: 'Woe to the heels because of Hell-fire, perform ablution properly!'"
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَعَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ هِلاَلِ بْنِ يِسَافٍ، عَنْ أَبِي يَحْيَى، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ رَأَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَوْمًا يَتَوَضَّئُونَ وَأَعْقَابُهُمْ تَلُوحُ فَقَالَ  " وَيْلٌ لِلأَعْقَابِ مِنَ النَّارِ أَسْبِغُوا الْوُضُوءَ " .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 450

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 451

chapter.englishTitle: Washing the (heels and) Achilles tendon

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that 'Aishah said:
                      The Messenger of Allah said: 'Woe to the heels because of Hell-fire.'"
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that 'Aishah said:
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah said: 'Woe to the heels because of Hell-fire.'"
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ الْقَطَّانُ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْمُؤْمِنِ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ السَّلاَمِ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " وَيْلٌ لِلأَعْقَابِ مِنَ النَّارِ " .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 451

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 452

chapter.englishTitle: Washing the (heels and) Achilles tendon

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Abu Salamah said:
                      "Aishah saw 'Abdur-Rahman performing abluti0on, and she said: Perform ablution properly, for I heard the Messenger of Allah say: 'Woe to the Achilles' tendon because of Hell-fire.'"
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Abu Salamah said:
hadiths.body: "Aishah saw 'Abdur-Rahman performing abluti0on, and she said: Perform ablution properly, for I heard the Messenger of Allah say: 'Woe to the Achilles' tendon because of Hell-fire.'"
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الصَّبَّاحِ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ رَجَاءٍ الْمَكِّيُّ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَجْلاَنَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَأَبُو خَالِدٍ الأَحْمَرُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَجْلاَنَ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، قَالَ رَأَتْ عَائِشَةُ عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ وَهُوَ يَتَوَضَّأُ فَقَالَتْ أَسْبِغِ الْوُضُوءَ فَإِنِّي سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ  " وَيْلٌ لِلْعَرَاقِيبِ مِنَ النَّارِ " .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 452

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 453

chapter.englishTitle: Washing the (heels and) Achilles tendon

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that :
                      The Prophet ﷺ said: "Woe to the heels because of Hell-fire."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that :
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ said: "Woe to the heels because of Hell-fire."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ أَبِي الشَّوَارِبِ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ الْمُخْتَارِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُهَيْلٌ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ  " وَيْلٌ لِلأَعْقَابِ مِنَ النَّارِ " .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 453

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 454

chapter.englishTitle: Washing the (heels and) Achilles tendon

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Jabir bin 'Abdullah said:
                      "I heard the Messenger of Allah say: 'Woe to the Achilles' tendon because of Hell-fire."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Jabir bin 'Abdullah said:
hadiths.body: "I heard the Messenger of Allah say: 'Woe to the Achilles' tendon because of Hell-fire."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الأَحْوَصِ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي كَرِبٍ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ  " وَيْلٌ لِلْعَرَاقِيبِ مِنَ النَّارِ " .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 454

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 455

chapter.englishTitle: Washing the (heels and) Achilles tendon

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Khalid bin Walid, Yazid bin Abu Sufyan, Shurahbil bin Hasanah and 'Amr bin 'As that:
                      They all heard the Messenger of Allah say: 'Complete the ablution. Woe to the heels because of Hell-fire."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Khalid bin Walid, Yazid bin Abu Sufyan, Shurahbil bin Hasanah and 'Amr bin 'As that:
hadiths.body: They all heard the Messenger of Allah say: 'Complete the ablution. Woe to the heels because of Hell-fire."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا الْعَبَّاسُ بْنُ عُثْمَانَ، وَعُثْمَانُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ الدِّمَشْقِيَّانِ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَةُ بْنُ الأَحْنَفِ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلاَّمٍ الأَسْوَدِ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ الأَشْعَرِيِّ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الأَشْعَرِيُّ، عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ الْوَلِيدِ، وَيَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ، وَشُرَحْبِيلَ ابْنِ حَسَنَةَ، وَعَمْرِو بْنِ الْعَاصِ، كُلُّ هَؤُلاَءِ سَمِعُوا مِنْ، رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ  " أَتِمُّوا الْوُضُوءَ وَيْلٌ لِلأَعْقَابِ مِنَ النَّارِ " .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 455

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 456

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي غَسْلِ الْقَدَمَيْنِ
chapter.englishTitle: Washing the feet

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Abu Haiyah said:
                      "I saw 'Ali performing ablution and he washed his feet up to the ankles, then he said: 'I wanted to show you how your Prophet purified himself.'"
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Abu Haiyah said:
hadiths.body: "I saw 'Ali performing ablution and he washed his feet up to the ankles, then he said: 'I wanted to show you how your Prophet purified himself.'"
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الأَحْوَصِ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ أَبِي حَيَّةَ، قَالَ رَأَيْتُ عَلِيًّا تَوَضَّأَ فَغَسَلَ قَدَمَيْهِ إِلَى الْكَعْبَيْنِ ثُمَّ قَالَ أَرَدْتُ أَنْ أُرِيَكُمْ طُهُورَ نَبِيِّكُمْ ﷺ .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 456

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 457

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي غَسْلِ الْقَدَمَيْنِ
chapter.englishTitle: Washing the feet

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Miqdam bin Ma'dikarib that:
                      The Messenger of Allah performed ablution; so he washed his feet three times.
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Miqdam bin Ma'dikarib that:
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah performed ablution; so he washed his feet three times.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَرِيزُ بْنُ عُثْمَانَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ مَيْسَرَةَ، عَنِ الْمِقْدَامِ بْنِ مَعْدِيكَرِبَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ تَوَضَّأَ فَغَسَلَ رِجْلَيْهِ ثَلاَثًا ثَلاَثًا .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 457

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 458

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي غَسْلِ الْقَدَمَيْنِ
chapter.englishTitle: Washing the feet

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Rubai' said:
                      "Ibn 'Abbas came to me and asked me about this Hadith" meaning the Hadith, that she had narrated, saying that the Messenger of Allah performed ablution and washed his feet. "Ibn 'Abbas said: 'The people are insisting on washing their feet, but I do not find anything in the Qur'an except (the injunction to) wipe them.'"
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Rubai' said:
hadiths.body: "Ibn 'Abbas came to me and asked me about this Hadith" meaning the Hadith, that she had narrated, saying that the Messenger of Allah performed ablution and washed his feet. "Ibn 'Abbas said: 'The people are insisting on washing their feet, but I do not find anything in the Qur'an except (the injunction to) wipe them.'"
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ، عَنْ رَوْحِ بْنِ الْقَاسِمِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَقِيلٍ، عَنِ الرُّبَيِّعِ، قَالَتْ أَتَانِي ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ فَسَأَلَنِي عَنْ هَذَا الْحَدِيثِ، - تَعْنِي حَدِيثَهَا الَّذِي ذَكَرَتْ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ تَوَضَّأَ وَغَسَلَ رِجْلَيْهِ - فَقَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ إِنَّ النَّاسَ أَبَوْا إِلاَّ الْغَسْلَ وَلاَ أَجِدُ فِي كِتَابِ اللَّهِ إِلاَّ الْمَسْحَ .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 458

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 459

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي الْوُضُوءِ عَلَى مَا أَمَرَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى
chapter.englishTitle: Ablution in accordance with the commands of Allah the Exalted

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Jami' bin Shaddad - AbuSakhrah - said:
                      "I heard Humran telling Abu Burdah in the mosque that he had heard 'Uthman bin 'Affan narrating that the Prophet had said" 'Whoever performs ablution perfectly as Allah has enjoined, then his prescribed prayer will serve as expiation for what is between them."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Jami' bin Shaddad - AbuSakhrah - said:
hadiths.body: "I heard Humran telling Abu Burdah in the mosque that he had heard 'Uthman bin 'Affan narrating that the Prophet had said" 'Whoever performs ablution perfectly as Allah has enjoined, then his prescribed prayer will serve as expiation for what is between them."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ جَامِعِ بْنِ شَدَّادٍ أَبِي صَخْرَةَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ حُمْرَانَ، يُحَدِّثُ أَبَا بُرْدَةَ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ عُثْمَانَ بْنَ عَفَّانَ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ  " مَنْ أَتَمَّ الْوُضُوءَ كَمَا أَمَرَهُ اللَّهُ فَالصَّلَوَاتُ الْمَكْتُوبَاتُ كَفَّارَاتٌ لِمَا بَيْنَهُنَّ " .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 459

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 460

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي الْوُضُوءِ عَلَى مَا أَمَرَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى
chapter.englishTitle: Ablution in accordance with the commands of Allah the Exalted

hadiths.englishRaw:
'Ali bin Yahya bin Khallad narrated, from his father, from his paternal uncle Rifa'ah bin Rafi' that:
                      He was sitting with the Prophet who said: 'No person's prayer is complete until he performs ablution properly as Allah has commanded him, washing his face, his arms up to the elbows, wiping his head and his feet up to the ankles.'"
hadiths.narrator: 'Ali bin Yahya bin Khallad narrated, from his father, from his paternal uncle Rifa'ah bin Rafi' that:
hadiths.body: He was sitting with the Prophet who said: 'No person's prayer is complete until he performs ablution properly as Allah has commanded him, washing his face, his arms up to the elbows, wiping his head and his feet up to the ankles.'"
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجٌ، حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ، حَدَّثَنِي عَلِيُّ بْنُ يَحْيَى بْنِ خَلاَّدٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَمِّهِ، رِفَاعَةَ بْنِ رَافِعٍ أَنَّهُ كَانَ جَالِسًا عِنْدَ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ فَقَالَ  " إِنَّهَا لاَ تَتِمُّ صَلاَةٌ لأَحَدٍ حَتَّى يُسْبِغَ الْوُضُوءَ كَمَا أَمَرَهُ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى يَغْسِلُ وَجْهَهُ وَيَدَيْهِ إِلَى الْمِرْفَقَيْنِ وَيَمْسَحُ بِرَأْسِهِ وَرِجْلَيْهِ إِلَى الْكَعْبَيْنِ " .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 460

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 461

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي النَّضْحِ بَعْدَ الْوُضُوءِ
chapter.englishTitle: Sprinkling water after ablution

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Hakam bin Sufyan Ath-Thawri that:
                      He saw the Messenger of Allah perform ablution then take a handful of water and sprinkle it over his private area to remove any doubts about urine drippings.
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Hakam bin Sufyan Ath-Thawri that:
hadiths.body: He saw the Messenger of Allah perform ablution then take a handful of water and sprinkle it over his private area to remove any doubts about urine drippings.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بِشْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا زَكَرِيَّا بْنُ أَبِي زَائِدَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ مَنْصُورٌ حَدَّثَنَا مُجَاهِدٌ، عَنِ الْحَكَمِ بْنِ سُفْيَانَ الثَّقَفِيِّ، أَنَّهُ رَأَى رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ تَوَضَّأَ ثُمَّ أَخَذَ كَفًّا مِنْ مَاءٍ فَنَضَحَ بِهِ فَرْجَهُ .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 461

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 462

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي النَّضْحِ بَعْدَ الْوُضُوءِ
chapter.englishTitle: Sprinkling water after ablution

hadiths.englishRaw:
Usamah bin Zaid narrated that his father Zaid bin Harithah said:
                      "The Messenger of Allah said: 'Jibril taught me (how to perform) the ablution, and he ordered me to sprinkle water underneath my garment, lest a drop of urine leak out after the ablution.'" (Da'if)
Other chains with similar wording.
hadiths.narrator: Usamah bin Zaid narrated that his father Zaid bin Harithah said:
hadiths.body:
"The Messenger of Allah said: 'Jibril taught me (how to perform) the ablution, and he ordered me to sprinkle water underneath my garment, lest a drop of urine leak out after the ablution.'" (Da'if)
Other chains with similar wording.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ الْفِرْيَابِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا حَسَّانُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ لَهِيعَةَ، عَنْ عُقَيْلٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أُسَامَةُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، زَيْدِ بْنِ حَارِثَةَ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " عَلَّمَنِي جِبْرَائِيلُ الْوُضُوءَ وَأَمَرَنِي أَنْ أَنْضَحَ تَحْتَ ثَوْبِي لِمَا يَخْرُجُ مِنَ الْبَوْلِ بَعْدَ الْوُضُوءِ " .   قَالَ أَبُو الْحَسَنِ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ التَّنِّيسِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ لَهِيعَةَ، فَذَكَرَ نَحْوَهُ .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 462

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 463

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي النَّضْحِ بَعْدَ الْوُضُوءِ
chapter.englishTitle: Sprinkling water after ablution

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Abu Hurairah said:
                      "The Messenger of Allah said: 'When you perform ablution, sprinkle water.'"
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Abu Hurairah said:
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah said: 'When you perform ablution, sprinkle water.'"
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ الْيَحْمَدِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا سَلْمُ بْنُ قُتَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ الْهَاشِمِيُّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " إِذَا تَوَضَّأْتَ فَانْتَضِحْ " .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 463

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 464

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي النَّضْحِ بَعْدَ الْوُضُوءِ
chapter.englishTitle: Sprinkling water after ablution

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Jabir said:
                      "The Messenger of Allah performed ablution and sprinkled his private part."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Jabir said:
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah performed ablution and sprinkled his private part."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا عَاصِمُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ، حَدَّثَنَا قَيْسٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ تَوَضَّأَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَنَضَحَ فَرْجَهُ .
references: Vol. 1, Book of The Purification and its Sunnah, Hadith 464

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 465

chapter.arabicTitle: باب الْمِنْدِيلِ بَعْدَ الْوُضُوءِ وَبَعْدَ الْغُسْلِ
chapter.englishTitle: (Drying oneself with) a cloth after ablution or bathing

hadiths.englishRaw:
Umm Hani' bint Abu Talib narrated that :
