hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1080

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِيمَنْ تَرَكَ الصَّلاَةَ
chapter.englishTitle: Concerning one who does not perform Prayer

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Anas bin Malik that the Prophet ﷺ said:
            “There is nothing standing between a person and Shirk (polytheism) except leaving the prayer, so if he leaves it he has committed Shirk.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Anas bin Malik that the Prophet ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “There is nothing standing between a person and Shirk (polytheism) except leaving the prayer, so if he leaves it he has committed Shirk.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الدِّمَشْقِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَوْزَاعِيُّ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ الرَّقَاشِيِّ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ  " لَيْسَ بَيْنَ الْعَبْدِ وَالشِّرْكِ إِلاَّ تَرْكُ الصَّلاَةِ فَإِذَا تَرَكَهَا فَقَدْ أَشْرَكَ " .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Establishing the Prayer and the Sunnah Regarding Them, Hadith 1080

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1081

chapter.englishTitle: The obligation of Friday

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Jabir bin ‘Abdullah said:
           “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ delivered a sermon to us and said: ‘O people! Repent to Allah before you die. Hasten to do good deeds before you become preoccupied (because of sickness and old age). Uphold the relationship that exists between you and your Lord by remembering Him a great deal and by giving a great deal of charity in secret and openly. (Then) you will be granted provision and Divine support, and your condition will improve. Know that Allah has enjoined Friday upon you in this place of mine, on this day, in this month, in this year, until the Day of Resurrection. Whoever abandons it, whether during my lifetime or after I am gone, whether he has a just or an unjust ruler, whether he takes it lightly or denies (that it is obligatory), may Allah cause him to lose all sense of tranquility and contentment, and may He not bless him in his affairs. Indeed, his prayer will not be valid, his Zakat will not be valid, his Hajj will not be valid, his fasting will not be valid, and his righteous deeds will not be accepted, until he repents. Whoever repents, Allah will accept his repentance. No woman should be appointed as Imam over a man, no Bedouin should be appointed as Imam over a Muhajir, no immoral person should be appointed as Imam over a (true) believer, unless that is forced upon him and he fears his sword or whip.’”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Jabir bin ‘Abdullah said:
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ delivered a sermon to us and said: ‘O people! Repent to Allah before you die. Hasten to do good deeds before you become preoccupied (because of sickness and old age). Uphold the relationship that exists between you and your Lord by remembering Him a great deal and by giving a great deal of charity in secret and openly. (Then) you will be granted provision and Divine support, and your condition will improve. Know that Allah has enjoined Friday upon you in this place of mine, on this day, in this month, in this year, until the Day of Resurrection. Whoever abandons it, whether during my lifetime or after I am gone, whether he has a just or an unjust ruler, whether he takes it lightly or denies (that it is obligatory), may Allah cause him to lose all sense of tranquility and contentment, and may He not bless him in his affairs. Indeed, his prayer will not be valid, his Zakat will not be valid, his Hajj will not be valid, his fasting will not be valid, and his righteous deeds will not be accepted, until he repents. Whoever repents, Allah will accept his repentance. No woman should be appointed as Imam over a man, no Bedouin should be appointed as Imam over a Muhajir, no immoral person should be appointed as Imam over a (true) believer, unless that is forced upon him and he fears his sword or whip.’”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ بُكَيْرٍ أَبُو خَبَّابٍ، حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ الْعَدَوِيُّ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ خَطَبَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَقَالَ  " يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ تُوبُوا إِلَى اللَّهِ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَمُوتُوا وَبَادِرُوا بِالأَعْمَالِ الصَّالِحَةِ قَبْلَ أَنْ تُشْغَلُوا وَصِلُوا الَّذِي بَيْنَكُمْ وَبَيْنَ رَبِّكُمْ بِكَثْرَةِ ذِكْرِكُمْ لَهُ وَكَثْرَةِ الصَّدَقَةِ فِي السِّرِّ وَالْعَلاَنِيَةِ تُرْزَقُوا وَتُنْصَرُوا وَتُجْبَرُوا وَاعْلَمُوا أَنَّ اللَّهَ قَدِ افْتَرَضَ عَلَيْكُمُ الْجُمُعَةَ فِي مَقَامِي هَذَا فِي يَوْمِي هَذَا فِي شَهْرِي هَذَا مِنْ عَامِي هَذَا إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ فَمَنْ تَرَكَهَا فِي حَيَاتِي أَوْ بَعْدِي وَلَهُ إِمَامٌ عَادِلٌ أَوْ جَائِرٌ اسْتِخْفَافًا بِهَا أَوْ جُحُودًا بِهَا فَلاَ جَمَعَ اللَّهُ لَهُ شَمْلَهُ وَلاَ بَارَكَ لَهُ فِي أَمْرِهِ أَلاَ وَلاَ صَلاَةَ لَهُ وَلاَ زَكَاةَ لَهُ وَلاَ حَجَّ لَهُ وَلاَ صَوْمَ لَهُ وَلاَ بِرَّ لَهُ حَتَّى يَتُوبَ فَمَنْ تَابَ تَابَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ أَلاَ لاَ تَؤُمَّنَّ امْرَأَةٌ رَجُلاً وَلاَ يَؤُمَّنَّ أَعْرَابِيٌّ مُهَاجِرًا وَلاَ يَؤُمَّ فَاجِرٌ مُؤْمِنًا إِلاَّ أَنْ يَقْهَرَهُ بِسُلْطَانٍ يَخَافُ سَيْفَهُ وَسَوْطَهُ " .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Establishing the Prayer and the Sunnah Regarding Them, Hadith 1081

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1082

chapter.englishTitle: The obligation of Friday

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that ‘Abdur-Rahman bin Ka’b bin Malik said:
           “I used to guide my father after he lost his sight, and when I took him out for the Friday (prayer), when he heard the Adhan he would pray for forgiveness for Abu Umamah As’ad bin Zurarah, and supplicate for him. I heard that from him for a while, then I said to myself: ‘By Allah! What is this weakness? Every time he heard the Adhan for Friday (prayer) I hear him praying for forgiveness for Abu Umamah and supplicate for him, and I do not ask him about why he does that.’ Then I took him out for Friday (prayer), as I used to take him out, and when he heard the Adhan he prayed for forgiveness as he used to do. I said to him: ‘O my father! I see you supplicating for As’ad bin Zurarah every time you hear the call for Friday; why is that?’ He said: ‘O my son, he was the first one who led us for the Friday prayer before the Messenger of Allah ﷺ came from Makkah, in Naqi’ Al- Khadamat (a place near Al-Madinah), in the plain of Harrah Banu Bayadah.’ I asked: ‘How many of you were there at that time?’ He said: ‘Forty men.’”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that ‘Abdur-Rahman bin Ka’b bin Malik said:
hadiths.body: “I used to guide my father after he lost his sight, and when I took him out for the Friday (prayer), when he heard the Adhan he would pray for forgiveness for Abu Umamah As’ad bin Zurarah, and supplicate for him. I heard that from him for a while, then I said to myself: ‘By Allah! What is this weakness? Every time he heard the Adhan for Friday (prayer) I hear him praying for forgiveness for Abu Umamah and supplicate for him, and I do not ask him about why he does that.’ Then I took him out for Friday (prayer), as I used to take him out, and when he heard the Adhan he prayed for forgiveness as he used to do. I said to him: ‘O my father! I see you supplicating for As’ad bin Zurarah every time you hear the call for Friday; why is that?’ He said: ‘O my son, he was the first one who led us for the Friday prayer before the Messenger of Allah ﷺ came from Makkah, in Naqi’ Al- Khadamat (a place near Al-Madinah), in the plain of Harrah Banu Bayadah.’ I asked: ‘How many of you were there at that time?’ He said: ‘Forty men.’”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ خَلَفٍ أَبُو سَلَمَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الأَعْلَى، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي أُمَامَةَ بْنِ سَهْلِ بْنِ حُنَيْفٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ أَبِي أُمَامَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ كَعْبِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ كُنْتُ قَائِدَ أَبِي حِينَ ذَهَبَ بَصَرُهُ وَكُنْتُ إِذَا خَرَجْتُ بِهِ إِلَى الْجُمُعَةِ فَسَمِعَ الأَذَانَ اسْتَغْفَرَ لأَبِي أُمَامَةَ أَسْعَدَ بْنِ زُرَارَةَ وَدَعَا لَهُ فَمَكَثْتُ حِينًا أَسْمَعُ ذَلِكَ مِنْهُ ثُمَّ قُلْتُ فِي نَفْسِي وَاللَّهِ إِنَّ ذَا لَعَجْزٌ إِنِّي أَسْمَعُهُ كُلَّمَا سَمِعَ أَذَانَ الْجُمُعَةِ يَسْتَغْفِرُ لأَبِي أُمَامَةَ وَيُصَلِّي عَلَيْهِ وَلاَ أَسْأَلُهُ عَنْ ذَلِكَ لِمَ هُوَ فَخَرَجْتُ بِهِ كَمَا كُنْتُ أَخْرُجُ بِهِ إِلَى الْجُمُعَةِ فَلَمَّا سَمِعَ الأَذَانَ اسْتَغْفَرَ كَمَا كَانَ يَفْعَلُ فَقُلْتُ لَهُ يَا أَبَتَاهُ أَرَأَيْتَكَ صَلاَتَكَ عَلَى أَسْعَدَ بْنِ زُرَارَةَ كُلَّمَا سَمِعْتَ النِّدَاءَ بِالْجُمُعَةِ لِمَ هُوَ قَالَ أَىْ بُنَىَّ كَانَ أَوَّلَ مَنْ صَلَّى بِنَا صَلاَةَ الْجُمُعَةِ قَبْلَ مَقْدَمِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ مِنْ مَكَّةَ فِي نَقِيعِ الْخَضِمَاتِ فِي هَزْمٍ مِنْ حَرَّةِ بَنِي بَيَاضَةَ . قُلْتُ كَمْ كُنْتُمُ يَوْمَئِذٍ قَالَ أَرْبَعِينَ رَجُلاً .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Establishing the Prayer and the Sunnah Regarding Them, Hadith 1082

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1083

chapter.englishTitle: The obligation of Friday

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Abu Hurairah said:
           “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: ‘Allah led those who came before us astray from Friday. Saturday was for the Jews and Sunday was for the Christians. And they will lag behind us until the Day of Resurrection. We are the last of the people of this world but we will be the first to be judged among all of creation.’”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Abu Hurairah said:
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: ‘Allah led those who came before us astray from Friday. Saturday was for the Jews and Sunday was for the Christians. And they will lag behind us until the Day of Resurrection. We are the last of the people of this world but we will be the first to be judged among all of creation.’”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ الْمُنْذِرِ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ فُضَيْلٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مَالِكٍ الأَشْجَعِيُّ، عَنْ رِبْعِيِّ بْنِ حِرَاشٍ، عَنْ حُذَيْفَةَ، وَعَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " أَضَلَّ اللَّهُ عَنِ الْجُمُعَةِ مَنْ كَانَ قَبْلَنَا كَانَ لِلْيَهُودِ يَوْمُ السَّبْتِ وَالأَحَدُ لِلنَّصَارَى فَهُمْ لَنَا تَبَعٌ إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ نَحْنُ الآخِرُونَ مِنْ أَهْلِ الدُّنْيَا وَالأَوَّلُونَ الْمَقْضِيُّ لَهُمْ قَبْلَ الْخَلاَئِقِ " .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Establishing the Prayer and the Sunnah Regarding Them, Hadith 1083

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1084

chapter.englishTitle: The virtues of Friday

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Abu Lubabah bin ‘Abdul-Mundhir said:
           “The Prophet ﷺ said: ‘Friday is the chief of days, the greatest day before Allah. It is greater before Allah then the Day of Adha and the Day of Fitr. It has five characteristics: On it Allah created Adam; on it Allah sent down Adam to this earth; on it there is a time during which a person does not ask Allah for anything but He will give it to him, so long as he does not ask for anything that is forbidden; on it the Hour will begin. There is no angel who is close to Allah, no heaven, no earth, no wind, no mountain, and no sea that does not fear Friday.’”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Abu Lubabah bin ‘Abdul-Mundhir said:
hadiths.body: “The Prophet ﷺ said: ‘Friday is the chief of days, the greatest day before Allah. It is greater before Allah then the Day of Adha and the Day of Fitr. It has five characteristics: On it Allah created Adam; on it Allah sent down Adam to this earth; on it there is a time during which a person does not ask Allah for anything but He will give it to him, so long as he does not ask for anything that is forbidden; on it the Hour will begin. There is no angel who is close to Allah, no heaven, no earth, no wind, no mountain, and no sea that does not fear Friday.’”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَبِي بُكَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَقِيلٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ الأَنْصَارِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي لُبَابَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْمُنْذِرِ، قَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ  " إِنَّ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ سَيِّدُ الأَيَّامِ وَأَعْظَمُهَا عِنْدَ اللَّهِ وَهُوَ أَعْظَمُ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ مِنْ يَوْمِ الأَضْحَى وَيَوْمِ الْفِطْرِ فِيهِ خَمْسُ خِلاَلٍ خَلَقَ اللَّهُ فِيهِ آدَمَ وَأَهْبَطَ اللَّهُ فِيهِ آدَمَ إِلَى الأَرْضِ وَفِيهِ تَوَفَّى اللَّهُ آدَمَ وَفِيهِ سَاعَةٌ لاَ يَسْأَلُ اللَّهَ فِيهَا الْعَبْدُ شَيْئًا إِلاَّ أَعْطَاهُ مَا لَمْ يَسْأَلْ حَرَامًا وَفِيهِ تَقُومُ السَّاعَةُ مَا مِنْ مَلَكٍ مُقَرَّبٍ وَلاَ سَمَاءٍ وَلاَ أَرْضٍ وَلاَ رِيَاحٍ وَلاَ جِبَالٍ وَلاَ بَحْرٍ إِلاَّ وَهُنَّ يُشْفِقْنَ مِنْ يَوْمِ الْجُمُعَةِ " .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Establishing the Prayer and the Sunnah Regarding Them, Hadith 1084

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1085

chapter.englishTitle: The virtues of Friday

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Shaddad bin Aws said:
           “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: ‘The best of your days is Friday. On it Adam was created, on it the Trumpet will be blown, on it all creatures will swoon. So send a great deal of peace and blessings upon me on that day, for your peace and blessings will be presented to me.’ A man said: ‘O Messenger of Allah, how will our peace and blessings be shown to you when you will have disintegrated?’ He said: ‘Allah has forbidden the earth to consume the bodies of the Prophets.’”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Shaddad bin Aws said:
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: ‘The best of your days is Friday. On it Adam was created, on it the Trumpet will be blown, on it all creatures will swoon. So send a great deal of peace and blessings upon me on that day, for your peace and blessings will be presented to me.’ A man said: ‘O Messenger of Allah, how will our peace and blessings be shown to you when you will have disintegrated?’ He said: ‘Allah has forbidden the earth to consume the bodies of the Prophets.’”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ بْنِ جَابِرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الأَشْعَثِ الصَّنْعَانِيِّ، عَنْ شَدَّادِ بْنِ أَوْسٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ " إِنَّ مِنْ أَفْضَلِ أَيَّامِكُمْ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ فِيهِ خُلِقَ آدَمُ وَفِيهِ النَّفْخَةُ وَفِيهِ الصَّعْقَةُ فَأَكْثِرُوا عَلَىَّ مِنَ الصَّلاَةِ فِيهِ فَإِنَّ صَلاَتَكُمْ مَعْرُوضَةٌ عَلَىَّ " . فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ كَيْفَ تُعْرَضُ صَلاَتُنَا عَلَيْكَ وَقَدْ أَرَمْتَ - يَعْنِي بَلِيتَ - . فَقَالَ " إِنَّ اللَّهَ قَدْ حَرَّمَ عَلَى الأَرْضِ أَنْ تَأْكُلَ أَجْسَادَ الأَنْبِيَاءِ " .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Establishing the Prayer and the Sunnah Regarding Them, Hadith 1085

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1086

chapter.englishTitle: The virtues of Friday

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            “From one Friday to the next is an expiation for whatever was committed in between, so long as one does not commit any major sin.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “From one Friday to the next is an expiation for whatever was committed in between, so long as one does not commit any major sin.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحْرِزُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ الْعَدَنِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنِ الْعَلاَءِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ  " الْجُمُعَةُ إِلَى الْجُمُعَةِ كَفَّارَةُ مَا بَيْنَهُمَا مَا لَمْ تُغْشَ الْكَبَائِرُ " .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Establishing the Prayer and the Sunnah Regarding Them, Hadith 1086

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1087

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي الْغُسْلِ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning bath on Friday

hadiths.englishRaw:
Aws bin Aws Ath-Thaqafi said:
           “I heard the Prophet ﷺ say: ‘Whoever takes a bath on Friday, and bathes completely, and goes early, arriving early,* and walks and does not ride (to the mosque), and sits close to the Imam and listens to him, and does not engage in idle talk; for every step he takes he will have the reward of one year, the reward of a year’s fasting and praying (at night).”
hadiths.narrator: Aws bin Aws Ath-Thaqafi said:
hadiths.body: “I heard the Prophet ﷺ say: ‘Whoever takes a bath on Friday, and bathes completely, and goes early, arriving early,* and walks and does not ride (to the mosque), and sits close to the Imam and listens to him, and does not engage in idle talk; for every step he takes he will have the reward of one year, the reward of a year’s fasting and praying (at night).”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ، عَنِ الأَوْزَاعِيِّ، حَدَّثَنَا حَسَّانُ بْنُ عَطِيَّةَ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الأَشْعَثِ، حَدَّثَنِي أَوْسُ بْنُ أَوْسٍ الثَّقَفِيُّ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ يَقُولُ  " مَنْ غَسَّلَ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ وَاغْتَسَلَ وَبَكَّرَ وَابْتَكَرَ وَمَشَى وَلَمْ يَرْكَبْ وَدَنَا مِنَ الإِمَامِ فَاسْتَمَعَ وَلَمْ يَلْغُ - كَانَ لَهُ بِكُلِّ خَطْوَةٍ عَمَلُ سَنَةٍ أَجْرُ صِيَامِهَا وَقِيَامِهَا " .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Establishing the Prayer and the Sunnah Regarding Them, Hadith 1087

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1088

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي الْغُسْلِ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning bath on Friday

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Ibn ‘Umar said:
           “I heard the Prophet ﷺ say from the pulpit: ‘Whoever comes to Friday, let him take a bath.’”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Ibn ‘Umar said:
hadiths.body: “I heard the Prophet ﷺ say from the pulpit: ‘Whoever comes to Friday, let him take a bath.’”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ عُبَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ يَقُولُ عَلَى الْمِنْبَرِ  " مَنْ أَتَى الْجُمُعَةَ فَلْيَغْتَسِلْ " .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Establishing the Prayer and the Sunnah Regarding Them, Hadith 1088

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1089

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي الْغُسْلِ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning bath on Friday

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Sa’eed Al-Khudri that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
           “Bath on Fridays is obligatory for every male who has reached the age of puberty.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Sa’eed Al-Khudri that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “Bath on Fridays is obligatory for every male who has reached the age of puberty.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا سَهْلُ بْنُ أَبِي سَهْلٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ سُلَيْمٍ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ  " غُسْلُ يَوْمِ الْجُمُعَةِ وَاجِبٌ عَلَى كُلِّ مُحْتَلِمٍ " .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Establishing the Prayer and the Sunnah Regarding Them, Hadith 1089

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1090

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي الرُّخْصَةِ فِي ذَلِكَ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning the concession for that

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Abu Hurairah said:
           “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: ‘Whoever performs ablution and performs ablution well, then comes to Friday (prayer) and sits near (the Imam), and keeps quiet and listens, he will be forgiven for what was between that and the previous Friday (of sins), and three days more. And whoever touches the pebbles then he has engaged in Laghw (idle talk or behaviour).”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Abu Hurairah said:
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: ‘Whoever performs ablution and performs ablution well, then comes to Friday (prayer) and sits near (the Imam), and keeps quiet and listens, he will be forgiven for what was between that and the previous Friday (of sins), and three days more. And whoever touches the pebbles then he has engaged in Laghw (idle talk or behaviour).”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " مَنْ تَوَضَّأَ فَأَحْسَنَ الْوُضُوءَ ثُمَّ أَتَى الْجُمُعَةَ فَدَنَا وَأَنْصَتَ وَاسْتَمَعَ غُفِرَ لَهُ مَا بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَ الْجُمُعَةِ الأُخْرَى وَزِيَادَةُ ثَلاَثَةِ أَيَّامٍ وَمَنْ مَسَّ الْحَصَى فَقَدْ لَغَا " .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Establishing the Prayer and the Sunnah Regarding Them, Hadith 1090

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1091

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي الرُّخْصَةِ فِي ذَلِكَ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning the concession for that

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Anas bin Malik that the Prophet ﷺ said:
            “Whoever performs ablution on Friday, it is well and good for him, and he has done what is obligatory for him. But whoever takes a bath, bath is better.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Anas bin Malik that the Prophet ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “Whoever performs ablution on Friday, it is well and good for him, and he has done what is obligatory for him. But whoever takes a bath, bath is better.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا نَصْرُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ الْجَهْضَمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ، أَنْبَأَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ الْمَكِّيُّ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ الرَّقَاشِيِّ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ  " مَنْ تَوَضَّأَ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ فَبِهَا وَنِعْمَتْ يُجْزِئُ عَنْهُ الْفَرِيضَةُ وَمَنِ اغْتَسَلَ فَالْغُسْلُ أَفْضَلُ " .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Establishing the Prayer and the Sunnah Regarding Them, Hadith 1091

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1092

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي التَّهْجِيرِ إِلَى الْجُمُعَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated about setting out early for Friday

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            “When Friday comes, angels stand at every door of the mosque and record the names of the people who come, in order of arrival. When the Imam comes out, they close their records and listen to the sermon. The first one who comes to the prayer is like one who sacrifices a camel; the one who comes after him is like one who sacrifices a cow; the one who comes after him is like one who sacrifices a ram,” (and so on) until he made mention of a hen and an egg. Sahl added in his Hadith: “And whoever comes after that comes only to do his duty with regard to the prayer.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “When Friday comes, angels stand at every door of the mosque and record the names of the people who come, in order of arrival. When the Imam comes out, they close their records and listen to the sermon. The first one who comes to the prayer is like one who sacrifices a camel; the one who comes after him is like one who sacrifices a cow; the one who comes after him is like one who sacrifices a ram,” (and so on) until he made mention of a hen and an egg. Sahl added in his Hadith: “And whoever comes after that comes only to do his duty with regard to the prayer.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، وَسَهْلُ بْنُ أَبِي سَهْلٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ " إِذَا كَانَ يَوْمُ الْجُمُعَةِ كَانَ عَلَى كُلِّ بَابٍ مِنْ أَبْوَابِ الْمَسْجِدِ مَلاَئِكَةٌ يَكْتُبُونَ النَّاسَ عَلَى قَدْرِ مَنَازِلِهِمُ الأَوَّلَ فَالأَوَّلَ فَإِذَا خَرَجَ الإِمَامُ طَوَوُا الصُّحُفَ وَاسْتَمَعُوا الْخُطْبَةَ فَالْمُهَجِّرُ إِلَى الصَّلاَةِ كَالْمُهْدِي بَدَنَةً ثُمَّ الَّذِي يَلِيهِ كَمُهْدِي بَقَرَةٍ ثُمَّ الَّذِي يَلِيهِ كَمُهْدِي كَبْشٍ " . حَتَّى ذَكَرَ الدَّجَاجَةَ وَالْبَيْضَةَ زَادَ سَهْلٌ فِي حَدِيثِهِ " فَمَنْ جَاءَ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ فَإِنَّمَا يَجِيءُ بِحَقٍّ إِلَى الصَّلاَةِ " .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Establishing the Prayer and the Sunnah Regarding Them, Hadith 1092

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1093

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي التَّهْجِيرِ إِلَى الْجُمُعَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated about setting out early for Friday

hadiths.englishRaw: It was narrated from Samurah bin Jundab that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ described the likeness of Friday, saying that those who come earliest are like the one who sacrifices a camel, then like one who sacrifices a cow, then like one who sacrifices a sheep, until he made mention of a chicken.
hadiths.body: It was narrated from Samurah bin Jundab that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ described the likeness of Friday, saying that those who come earliest are like the one who sacrifices a camel, then like one who sacrifices a cow, then like one who sacrifices a sheep, until he made mention of a chicken.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ بَشِيرٍ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، عَنْ سَمُرَةَ بْنِ جُنْدُبٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ ضَرَبَ مَثَلَ الْجُمُعَةِ ثُمَّ التَّبْكِيرِ كَنَاحِرِ الْبَدَنَةِ كَنَاحِرِ الْبَقَرَةِ كَنَاحِرِ الشَّاةِ حَتَّى ذَكَرَ الدَّجَاجَةَ .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Establishing the Prayer and the Sunnah Regarding Them, Hadith 1093

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1094

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي التَّهْجِيرِ إِلَى الْجُمُعَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated about setting out early for Friday

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that ‘Alqamah said:
           “I went out with ‘Abdullah to Friday (prayer), and he found three men who arrived before him. He said: ‘The fourth of four, and the fourth of four is not far away. I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: “On the Day of Resurrection people will gather near Allah according to how early they came to Friday (prayer), the first, second, and third.’” Then he said: ‘The fourth of four, and the fourth of four is not far away.’”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that ‘Alqamah said:
hadiths.body: “I went out with ‘Abdullah to Friday (prayer), and he found three men who arrived before him. He said: ‘The fourth of four, and the fourth of four is not far away. I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: “On the Day of Resurrection people will gather near Allah according to how early they came to Friday (prayer), the first, second, and third.’” Then he said: ‘The fourth of four, and the fourth of four is not far away.’”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا كَثِيرُ بْنُ عُبَيْدٍ الْحِمْصِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْمَجِيدِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ، قَالَ خَرَجْتُ مَعَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ إِلَى الْجُمُعَةِ فَوَجَدَ ثَلاَثَةً قَدْ سَبَقُوهُ فَقَالَ رَابِعُ أَرْبَعَةٍ وَمَا رَابِعُ أَرْبَعَةٍ بِبَعِيدٍ إِنِّي سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ  " إِنَّ النَّاسَ يَجْلِسُونَ مِنَ اللَّهِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ عَلَى قَدْرِ رَوَاحِهِمْ إِلَى الْجُمُعَاتِ الأَوَّلَ وَالثَّانِيَ وَالثَّالِثَ " . ثُمَّ قَالَ رَابِعُ أَرْبَعَةٍ وَمَا رَابِعُ أَرْبَعَةٍ بِبَعِيدٍ .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Establishing the Prayer and the Sunnah Regarding Them, Hadith 1094

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1095

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي الزِّينَةِ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated about adornment on Fridays

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from ‘Abdullah bin Salam that he heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying on the pulpit one Friday:
           “There is nothing wrong with anyone of you buying two garments for Friday (prayer), other than his daily work clothes.”
(Another chain) from Yusuf bin Abdullah bin Salam that his father said: "The Prophet delivered a sermon to us" and he mentioned that.
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from ‘Abdullah bin Salam that he heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying on the pulpit one Friday:
hadiths.body:
“There is nothing wrong with anyone of you buying two garments for Friday (prayer), other than his daily work clothes.”
(Another chain) from Yusuf bin Abdullah bin Salam that his father said: "The Prophet delivered a sermon to us" and he mentioned that.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ الْحَارِثِ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ، عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى بْنِ حَبَّانَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ سَلاَمٍ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ عَلَى الْمِنْبَرِ فِي يَوْمِ الْجُمُعَةِ  " مَا عَلَى أَحَدِكُمْ لَوِ اشْتَرَى ثَوْبَيْنِ لِيَوْمِ الْجُمُعَةِ سِوَى ثَوْبِ مِهْنَتِهِ " .   حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا شَيْخٌ، لَنَا عَنْ عَبْدِ الْحَمِيدِ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى بْنِ حَبَّانَ، عَنْ يُوسُفَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ سَلاَمٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ خَطَبَنَا النَّبِيُّ ﷺ . فَذَكَرَ ذَلِكَ .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Establishing the Prayer and the Sunnah Regarding Them, Hadith 1095

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1096

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي الزِّينَةِ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated about adornment on Fridays

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from ‘Aishah that the Prophet ﷺ delivered a sermon to the people one Friday, and he saw them wearing woollen clothes. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
           “There is nothing wrong with any one of you, if he can afford it, buying two garments for Friday, other than his daily work clothes.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from ‘Aishah that the Prophet ﷺ delivered a sermon to the people one Friday, and he saw them wearing woollen clothes. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “There is nothing wrong with any one of you, if he can afford it, buying two garments for Friday, other than his daily work clothes.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ زُهَيْرٍ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ خَطَبَ النَّاسَ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ فَرَأَى عَلَيْهِمْ ثِيَابَ النِّمَارِ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " مَا عَلَى أَحَدِكُمْ إِنْ وَجَدَ سَعَةً أَنْ يَتَّخِذَ ثَوْبَيْنِ لِجُمُعَتِهِ سِوَى ثَوْبَىْ مِهْنَتِهِ " .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Establishing the Prayer and the Sunnah Regarding Them, Hadith 1096

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1097

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي الزِّينَةِ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated about adornment on Fridays

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Dharr that the Prophet ﷺ said:
           “Whoever takes a bath on a Friday and does it well, and purifies himself and does it well, and puts on his best clothes, and puts on whatever Allah decrees for him of the perfume of his family, then comes to the mosque and does not engage in idle talk or separate (pushing between) two people; he will be forgiven for (his sins) between that day and the previous Friday.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Dharr that the Prophet ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “Whoever takes a bath on a Friday and does it well, and purifies himself and does it well, and puts on his best clothes, and puts on whatever Allah decrees for him of the perfume of his family, then comes to the mosque and does not engage in idle talk or separate (pushing between) two people; he will be forgiven for (his sins) between that day and the previous Friday.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا سَهْلُ بْنُ أَبِي سَهْلٍ، وَحَوْثَرَةُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الْقَطَّانُ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَجْلاَنَ، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ الْمَقْبُرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ وَدِيعَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي ذَرٍّ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ  " مَنِ اغْتَسَلَ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ فَأَحْسَنَ غُسْلَهُ وَتَطَهَّرَ فَأَحْسَنَ طُهُورَهُ وَلَبِسَ مِنْ أَحْسَنِ ثِيَابِهِ وَمَسَّ مَا كَتَبَ اللَّهُ لَهُ مِنْ طِيبِ أَهْلِهِ ثُمَّ أَتَى الْجُمُعَةَ وَلَمْ يَلْغُ وَلَمْ يُفَرِّقْ بَيْنَ اثْنَيْنِ غُفِرَ لَهُ مَا بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَ الْجُمُعَةِ الأُخْرَى " .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Establishing the Prayer and the Sunnah Regarding Them, Hadith 1097

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1098

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي الزِّينَةِ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated about adornment on Fridays

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Ibn ‘Abbas said:
           “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: ‘This day is an ‘Eid (festival) which Allah has ordained for the Muslims. Whoever comes to Friday (prayer), let him take a bath and if he has perfume then let him put some on. And upon you (I urge to use) is the tooth stick.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Ibn ‘Abbas said:
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: ‘This day is an ‘Eid (festival) which Allah has ordained for the Muslims. Whoever comes to Friday (prayer), let him take a bath and if he has perfume then let him put some on. And upon you (I urge to use) is the tooth stick.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَمَّارُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ الْوَاسِطِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ غُرَابٍ، عَنْ صَالِحِ بْنِ أَبِي الأَخْضَرِ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ السَّبَّاقِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " إِنَّ هَذَا يَوْمُ عِيدٍ جَعَلَهُ اللَّهُ لِلْمُسْلِمِينَ فَمَنْ جَاءَ إِلَى الْجُمُعَةِ فَلْيَغْتَسِلْ وَإِنْ كَانَ طِيبٌ فَلْيَمَسَّ مِنْهُ وَعَلَيْكُمْ بِالسِّوَاكِ " .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Establishing the Prayer and the Sunnah Regarding Them, Hadith 1098

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1099

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي وَقْتِ الْجُمُعَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning the time of Friday (Prayer)

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Sahl bin Sa’d said:
           “We did not take a Qailulah nor eat Ghada’ until after Friday (prayer).”*
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Sahl bin Sa’d said:
hadiths.body: “We did not take a Qailulah nor eat Ghada’ until after Friday (prayer).”*
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الصَّبَّاحِ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، قَالَ مَا كُنَّا نَقِيلُ وَلاَ نَتَغَدَّى إِلاَّ بَعْدَ الْجُمُعَةِ .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Establishing the Prayer and the Sunnah Regarding Them, Hadith 1099

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1100

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي وَقْتِ الْجُمُعَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning the time of Friday (Prayer)

hadiths.englishRaw:
Iyas bin Salamah bin Akwa’ narrated that his father said:
           “We used to perform Friday (prayer) with the Prophet ﷺ, then we would return, and we would not see any shadow from the walls in which we could seek shade.”
hadiths.narrator: Iyas bin Salamah bin Akwa’ narrated that his father said:
hadiths.body: “We used to perform Friday (prayer) with the Prophet ﷺ, then we would return, and we would not see any shadow from the walls in which we could seek shade.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْلَى بْنُ الْحَارِثِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ إِيَاسَ بْنَ سَلَمَةَ بْنِ الأَكْوَعِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ كُنَّا نُصَلِّي مَعَ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ الْجُمُعَةَ ثُمَّ نَرْجِعُ فَلاَ نَرَى لِلْحِيطَانِ فَيْئًا نَسْتَظِلُّ بِهِ .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Establishing the Prayer and the Sunnah Regarding Them, Hadith 1100

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1101

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي وَقْتِ الْجُمُعَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning the time of Friday (Prayer)

hadiths.englishRaw:
‘Abdur-Rahman bin Sa’d bin ‘Ammar bin Sad, the Mu’adh-dhin of the Prophet ﷺ, said:
           “My father told me, narrating from his father, from his grandfather, that during the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, he used to call the Adhan on Fridays when the shadow was like a sandal strap.”
hadiths.narrator: ‘Abdur-Rahman bin Sa’d bin ‘Ammar bin Sad, the Mu’adh-dhin of the Prophet ﷺ, said:
hadiths.body: “My father told me, narrating from his father, from his grandfather, that during the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, he used to call the Adhan on Fridays when the shadow was like a sandal strap.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ سَعْدِ بْنِ عَمَّارِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، مُؤَذِّنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ جَدِّهِ أَنَّهُ كَانَ يُؤَذِّنُ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ عَلَى عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ إِذَا كَانَ الْفَىْءُ مِثْلَ الشِّرَاكِ .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Establishing the Prayer and the Sunnah Regarding Them, Hadith 1101

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1102

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي وَقْتِ الْجُمُعَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning the time of Friday (Prayer)

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Anas said:
           “We used to perform the Friday (prayer), then we would return for a nap (Qailulah).”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Anas said:
hadiths.body: “We used to perform the Friday (prayer), then we would return for a nap (Qailulah).”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا الْمُعْتَمِرُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، حَدَّثَنَا حُمَيْدٌ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ كُنَّا نُجَمِّعُ ثُمَّ نَرْجِعُ فَنَقِيلُ .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Establishing the Prayer and the Sunnah Regarding Them, Hadith 1102

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1103

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي الْخُطْبَةِ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning the sermon on Friday

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Ibn ‘Umar that the Prophet ﷺ used to deliver two sermons, and he would sit briefly between the two. (One of the narrators) Bishr added:
           “While he was standing.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Ibn ‘Umar that the Prophet ﷺ used to deliver two sermons, and he would sit briefly between the two. (One of the narrators) Bishr added:
hadiths.body: “While he was standing.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مَحْمُودُ بْنُ غَيْلاَنَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَنْبَأَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ خَلَفٍ أَبُو سَلَمَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ الْمُفَضَّلِ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ كَانَ يَخْطُبُ خُطْبَتَيْنِ يَجْلِسُ بَيْنَهُمَا جَلْسَةً . زَادَ بِشْرٌ وَهُوَ قَائِمٌ .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Establishing the Prayer and the Sunnah Regarding Them, Hadith 1103

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1104

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي الْخُطْبَةِ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning the sermon on Friday

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Ja’far bin ‘Amr bin Huraith that his father said:
            “I saw the Prophet ﷺ delivering the sermon on the pulpit, wearing a black turban.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Ja’far bin ‘Amr bin Huraith that his father said:
hadiths.body: “I saw the Prophet ﷺ delivering the sermon on the pulpit, wearing a black turban.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ مُسَاوِرٍ الْوَرَّاقِ، عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ حُرَيْثٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ رَأَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ يَخْطُبُ عَلَى الْمِنْبَرِ وَعَلَيْهِ عِمَامَةٌ سَوْدَاءُ .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Establishing the Prayer and the Sunnah Regarding Them, Hadith 1104

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1105

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي الْخُطْبَةِ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning the sermon on Friday

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Simak bin Harb said:
           “I heard Jabir bin Samurah say: ‘The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to deliver the sermon standing, but he used to sit down briefly, then stand up.’”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Simak bin Harb said:
hadiths.body: “I heard Jabir bin Samurah say: ‘The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to deliver the sermon standing, but he used to sit down briefly, then stand up.’”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ سِمَاكِ بْنِ حَرْبٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ جَابِرَ بْنَ سَمُرَةَ، يَقُولُ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَخْطُبُ قَائِمًا غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَقْعُدُ قَعْدَةً ثُمَّ يَقُومُ .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Establishing the Prayer and the Sunnah Regarding Them, Hadith 1105

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1106

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي الْخُطْبَةِ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning the sermon on Friday

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Jabir bin Samurah said:
           “The Prophet ﷺ used to deliver the sermon standing, then he would sit down, then he would stand up and recite some Verses and remember Allah. His sermon was moderate, and his prayer was moderate (i.e., neither too long nor too short).”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Jabir bin Samurah said:
hadiths.body: “The Prophet ﷺ used to deliver the sermon standing, then he would sit down, then he would stand up and recite some Verses and remember Allah. His sermon was moderate, and his prayer was moderate (i.e., neither too long nor too short).”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ سِمَاكٍ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ سَمُرَةَ، قَالَ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ يَخْطُبُ قَائِمًا ثُمَّ يَجْلِسُ ثُمَّ يَقُومُ فَيَقْرَأُ آيَاتٍ وَيَذْكُرُ اللَّهَ وَكَانَتْ خُطْبَتُهُ قَصْدًا وَصَلاَتُهُ قَصْدًا .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Establishing the Prayer and the Sunnah Regarding Them, Hadith 1106

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1107

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي الْخُطْبَةِ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning the sermon on Friday

hadiths.englishRaw: ‘Abdur-Rahman bin Sa’d bin ‘Ammar bin Sa’d narrated that his father told him, from his father, from his grandfather, that when the Messenger of Allah ﷺ delivered a speech on the battlefield he would do so leaning on a bow, and when he delivered a sermon on Friday, he would do so leaning on his staff.
hadiths.body: ‘Abdur-Rahman bin Sa’d bin ‘Ammar bin Sa’d narrated that his father told him, from his father, from his grandfather, that when the Messenger of Allah ﷺ delivered a speech on the battlefield he would do so leaning on a bow, and when he delivered a sermon on Friday, he would do so leaning on his staff.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ سَعْدِ بْنِ عَمَّارِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ كَانَ إِذَا خَطَبَ فِي الْحَرْبِ خَطَبَ عَلَى قَوْسٍ وَإِذَا خَطَبَ فِي الْجُمُعَةِ خَطَبَ عَلَى عَصًا .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Establishing the Prayer and the Sunnah Regarding Them, Hadith 1107

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1108

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي الْخُطْبَةِ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning the sermon on Friday

hadiths.englishRaw:
‘Alqamah narrated that ‘Abdullah was asked whether the Prophet ﷺ used to deliver the sermon standing or sitting. He said:
           “Have you not read the Verse: ‘...and leave you (Muhammad) standing (while delivering the Friday sermon?” [62:11]
hadiths.narrator: ‘Alqamah narrated that ‘Abdullah was asked whether the Prophet ﷺ used to deliver the sermon standing or sitting. He said:
hadiths.body: “Have you not read the Verse: ‘...and leave you (Muhammad) standing (while delivering the Friday sermon?” [62:11]
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي غَنِيَّةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَنَّهُ سُئِلَ أَكَانَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ يَخْطُبُ قَائِمًا أَوْ قَاعِدًا قَالَ أَوَمَا تَقْرَأُ {وَتَرَكُوكَ قَائِمًا} قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ غَرِيبٌ لاَ يُحَدِّثُ بِهِ إِلاَّ ابْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ وَحْدَهُ .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Establishing the Prayer and the Sunnah Regarding Them, Hadith 1108

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1109

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي الْخُطْبَةِ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning the sermon on Friday

hadiths.englishRaw: It was narrated from Jabir that whenever the Prophet ﷺ ascended the pulpit he would greet (the people with Salam).
hadiths.body: It was narrated from Jabir that whenever the Prophet ﷺ ascended the pulpit he would greet (the people with Salam).
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ خَالِدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ لَهِيعَةَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ زَيْدِ بْنِ مُهَاجِرٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْمُنْكَدِرِ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ كَانَ إِذَا صَعِدَ الْمِنْبَرَ سَلَّمَ .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Establishing the Prayer and the Sunnah Regarding Them, Hadith 1109

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1110

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي الاِسْتِمَاعِ لِلْخُطْبَةِ وَالإِنْصَاتِ لَهَا
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning listening to the sermon and remaining silent

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Prophet ﷺ said:
           “If you say to your companions: ‘Be quiet’ on a Friday while the Imam is delivering the sermon, you have engaged in Laghw (idle talk or behaviour).”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Prophet ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “If you say to your companions: ‘Be quiet’ on a Friday while the Imam is delivering the sermon, you have engaged in Laghw (idle talk or behaviour).”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا شَبَابَةُ بْنُ سَوَّارٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ قَالَ  " إِذَا قُلْتَ لِصَاحِبِكَ أَنْصِتْ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ وَالإِمَامُ يَخْطُبُ فَقَدْ لَغَوْتَ " .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Establishing the Prayer and the Sunnah Regarding Them, Hadith 1110

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1111

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي الاِسْتِمَاعِ لِلْخُطْبَةِ وَالإِنْصَاتِ لَهَا
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning listening to the sermon and remaining silent

hadiths.englishRaw:
‘Ata’ bin Yasar narrated from Ubayy bin Ka’b:
           “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ recited Tabarak [Al-Mulk (67)] one Friday, while he was standing and reminding us of the Days of Allah (i.e., preaching to us). Abu Darda’ or Abu Dharr raised an eyebrow at me and said: ‘When was this Surah revealed? For I have not heard it before now.’ He (Ubayy) gestured to him that he should remain silent. When they finished, he said: ‘I asked you when this Surah was revealed and you did not answer me.” Ubayy said: ‘You have gained nothing from your prayer today except the idle talk that you engaged in.’ He went to the Prophet ﷺ and told him about that, and what Ubayy had said to him. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: ‘Ubayy spoke the truth.’”
hadiths.narrator: ‘Ata’ bin Yasar narrated from Ubayy bin Ka’b:
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ recited Tabarak [Al-Mulk (67)] one Friday, while he was standing and reminding us of the Days of Allah (i.e., preaching to us). Abu Darda’ or Abu Dharr raised an eyebrow at me and said: ‘When was this Surah revealed? For I have not heard it before now.’ He (Ubayy) gestured to him that he should remain silent. When they finished, he said: ‘I asked you when this Surah was revealed and you did not answer me.” Ubayy said: ‘You have gained nothing from your prayer today except the idle talk that you engaged in.’ He went to the Prophet ﷺ and told him about that, and what Ubayy had said to him. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: ‘Ubayy spoke the truth.’”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحْرِزُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ الْعَدَنِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ الدَّرَاوَرْدِيُّ، عَنْ شَرِيكِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي نَمِرٍ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ، عَنْ أُبَىِّ بْنِ كَعْبٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَرَأَ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ تَبَارَكَ وَهُوَ قَائِمٌ فَذَكَّرَنَا بِأَيَّامِ اللَّهِ وَأَبُو الدَّرْدَاءِ أَوْ أَبُو ذَرٍّ يَغْمِزُنِي فَقَالَ مَتَى أُنْزِلَتْ هَذِهِ السُّورَةُ إِنِّي لَمْ أَسْمَعْهَا إِلاَّ الآنَ . فَأَشَارَ إِلَيْهِ أَنِ اسْكُتْ فَلَمَّا انْصَرَفُوا قَالَ سَأَلْتُكَ مَتَى أُنْزِلَتْ هَذِهِ السُّورَةُ فَلَمْ تُخْبِرْنِي فَقَالَ أُبَىٌّ لَيْسَ لَكَ مِنْ صَلاَتِكَ الْيَوْمَ إِلاَّ مَا لَغَوْتَ . فَذَهَبَ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَذَكَرَ ذَلِكَ لَهُ وَأَخْبَرَهُ بِالَّذِي قَالَ أُبَىٌّ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " صَدَقَ أُبَىٌّ " .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Establishing the Prayer and the Sunnah Regarding Them, Hadith 1111

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1112

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِيمَنْ دَخَلَ الْمَسْجِدَ وَالإِمَامُ يَخْطُبُ
chapter.englishTitle: Concerning one who enters the mosque while the Imam is delivering the sermon

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Jabir bin ‘Abdullah said:
           “Sulaik Ghatafani entered the mosque when the Prophet ﷺ was delivering the sermon. He said: ‘Have you prayed?’ He said: ‘No.’ He said: ‘Then perform two Rak’ah.’”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Jabir bin ‘Abdullah said:
hadiths.body: “Sulaik Ghatafani entered the mosque when the Prophet ﷺ was delivering the sermon. He said: ‘Have you prayed?’ He said: ‘No.’ He said: ‘Then perform two Rak’ah.’”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ، سَمِعَ جَابِرًا، وَأَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ، سَمِعَ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ دَخَلَ سُلَيْكٌ الْغَطَفَانِيُّ الْمَسْجِدَ وَالنَّبِيُّ ﷺ يَخْطُبُ . فَقَالَ " أَصَلَّيْتَ " . قَالَ لاَ . قَالَ " فَصَلِّ رَكْعَتَيْنِ " . وَأَمَّا عَمْرٌو فَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ سُلَيْكًا .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Establishing the Prayer and the Sunnah Regarding Them, Hadith 1112

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1113

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِيمَنْ دَخَلَ الْمَسْجِدَ وَالإِمَامُ يَخْطُبُ
chapter.englishTitle: Concerning one who enters the mosque while the Imam is delivering the sermon

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Abu Sa’eed said:
           “A man entered the mosque when the Prophet ﷺ was delivering the sermon. He said: ‘Have you prayed?’ He said: ‘No.’ He said: ‘Then pray two Rak’ah.’”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Abu Sa’eed said:
hadiths.body: “A man entered the mosque when the Prophet ﷺ was delivering the sermon. He said: ‘Have you prayed?’ He said: ‘No.’ He said: ‘Then pray two Rak’ah.’”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الصَّبَّاحِ، أَنْبَأَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَجْلاَنَ، عَنْ عِيَاضِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، قَالَ جَاءَ رَجُلٌ وَالنَّبِيُّ ﷺ يَخْطُبُ فَقَالَ " أَصَلَّيْتَ " . قَالَ لاَ . قَالَ " فَصَلِّ رَكْعَتَيْنِ " .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Establishing the Prayer and the Sunnah Regarding Them, Hadith 1113

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1114

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِيمَنْ دَخَلَ الْمَسْجِدَ وَالإِمَامُ يَخْطُبُ
chapter.englishTitle: Concerning one who enters the mosque while the Imam is delivering the sermon

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Jabir said:
           “Sulaik Al-Ghatafani came while the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was delivering the sermon. The Prophet ﷺ said to him: ‘Did you perform two Rak’ah before you came?’ He said: ‘No.’ He said: ‘Then perform two Rak’ah, but make them brief.’”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Jabir said:
hadiths.body: “Sulaik Al-Ghatafani came while the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was delivering the sermon. The Prophet ﷺ said to him: ‘Did you perform two Rak’ah before you came?’ He said: ‘No.’ He said: ‘Then perform two Rak’ah, but make them brief.’”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا دَاوُدُ بْنُ رُشَيْدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصُ بْنُ غِيَاثٍ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، وَعَنْ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالاَ جَاءَ سُلَيْكٌ الْغَطَفَانِيُّ وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَخْطُبُ فَقَالَ لَهُ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ " أَصَلَّيْتَ رَكْعَتَيْنِ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَجِيءَ " قَالَ لاَ . قَالَ " فَصَلِّ رَكْعَتَيْنِ وَتَجَوَّزْ فِيهِمَا " .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Establishing the Prayer and the Sunnah Regarding Them, Hadith 1114

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1115

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي النَّهْىِ عَنْ تَخَطِّي النَّاسَ، يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: Concerning the prohibition of stepping over the people’s shoulders on Friday

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Jabir bin ‘Abdullah that a man entered the mosque one Friday when the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was delivering the sermon. He started stepping over the people’s shoulders, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
           ‘Sit down, for you have annoyed (people) and you are late.’”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Jabir bin ‘Abdullah that a man entered the mosque one Friday when the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was delivering the sermon. He started stepping over the people’s shoulders, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: ‘Sit down, for you have annoyed (people) and you are late.’”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ الْمُحَارِبِيُّ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَنَّ رَجُلاً، دَخَلَ الْمَسْجِدَ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَخْطُبُ فَجَعَلَ يَتَخَطَّى النَّاسَ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " اجْلِسْ فَقَدْ آذَيْتَ وَآنَيْتَ " .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Establishing the Prayer and the Sunnah Regarding Them, Hadith 1115

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1116

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي النَّهْىِ عَنْ تَخَطِّي النَّاسَ، يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: Concerning the prohibition of stepping over the people’s shoulders on Friday

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Sahl bin Mu’adh bin Anas that his father said:
            “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: ‘Whoever steps over the people’s necks on Friday has built a bridge to Hell.’”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Sahl bin Mu’adh bin Anas that his father said:
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: ‘Whoever steps over the people’s necks on Friday has built a bridge to Hell.’”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا رِشْدِينُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ زَبَّانَ بْنِ فَائِدٍ، عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ مُعَاذِ بْنِ أَنَسٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " مَنْ تَخَطَّى رِقَابَ النَّاسِ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ اتُّخِذَ جِسْرًا إِلَى جَهَنَّمَ " .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Establishing the Prayer and the Sunnah Regarding Them, Hadith 1116

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1117

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي الْكَلاَمِ بَعْدَ نُزُولِ الإِمَامِ عَنِ الْمِنْبَرِ
chapter.englishTitle: Concerning speaking after the Imam comes down from the pulpit

hadiths.englishRaw: It was narrated from Anas bin Malik that the people used to speak to the Prophet ﷺ about their needs when he came down from the pulpit on Friday.
hadiths.body: It was narrated from Anas bin Malik that the people used to speak to the Prophet ﷺ about their needs when he came down from the pulpit on Friday.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرُ بْنُ حَازِمٍ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ كَانَ يُكَلَّمُ فِي الْحَاجَةِ إِذَا نَزَلَ عَنِ الْمِنْبَرِ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Establishing the Prayer and the Sunnah Regarding Them, Hadith 1117

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1118

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي الْقِرَاءَةِ فِي الصَّلاَةِ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning the recitation in the Prayer on Friday

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that ‘Ubaidullah bin Abu Rafi’ said:
           “Marwan appointed Abu Hurairah in charge of Al-Madinah, and set out for Makkah. Abu Hurairah led us in prayer on Friday, and he recited Surat Al-Jumu’ah in the first Rak’ah, and in the second, ‘When the hypocrites come to you,” [Al-Munafiqun (63)] ‘Ubaidullah said: “I caught up with Abu Hurairah when he finished and said to him: ‘You recited two Surah that ‘Ali used to recite in Kufah.’ Abu Hurairah said: ‘I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ reciting them.’”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that ‘Ubaidullah bin Abu Rafi’ said:
hadiths.body: “Marwan appointed Abu Hurairah in charge of Al-Madinah, and set out for Makkah. Abu Hurairah led us in prayer on Friday, and he recited Surat Al-Jumu’ah in the first Rak’ah, and in the second, ‘When the hypocrites come to you,” [Al-Munafiqun (63)] ‘Ubaidullah said: “I caught up with Abu Hurairah when he finished and said to him: ‘You recited two Surah that ‘Ali used to recite in Kufah.’ Abu Hurairah said: ‘I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ reciting them.’”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا حَاتِمُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ الْمَدَنِيُّ، عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي رَافِعٍ، قَالَ اسْتَخْلَفَ مَرْوَانُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ عَلَى الْمَدِينَةِ فَخَرَجَ إِلَى مَكَّةَ فَصَلَّى بِنَا أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ فَقَرَأَ بِسُورَةِ الْجُمُعَةِ فِي السَّجْدَةِ الأُولَى وَفِي الآخِرَةِ {إِذَا جَاءَكَ الْمُنَافِقُونَ} . قَالَ عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ فَأَدْرَكْتُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ حِينَ انْصَرَفَ فَقُلْتُ لَهُ إِنَّكَ قَرَأْتَ بِسُورَتَيْنِ كَانَ عَلِيٌّ يَقْرَأُ بِهِمَا بِالْكُوفَةِ . فَقَالَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ إِنِّي سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقْرَأُ بِهِمَا .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Establishing the Prayer and the Sunnah Regarding Them, Hadith 1118

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1119

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي الْقِرَاءَةِ فِي الصَّلاَةِ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning the recitation in the Prayer on Friday

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that ‘Ubaidullah bin ‘Abdullah said:
           “Dahhak bin Qais wrote to Nu’man bin Bashir, saying: ‘Tell us what the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to recite on Friday along with Surah Al-Jumu’ah.’ He said: ‘He used to recite: “Has there come to you the narration of the overwhelming (i.e., the Day of Resurrection)?’” [Al-Ghashiyah (88)]
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that ‘Ubaidullah bin ‘Abdullah said:
hadiths.body: “Dahhak bin Qais wrote to Nu’man bin Bashir, saying: ‘Tell us what the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to recite on Friday along with Surah Al-Jumu’ah.’ He said: ‘He used to recite: “Has there come to you the narration of the overwhelming (i.e., the Day of Resurrection)?’” [Al-Ghashiyah (88)]
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الصَّبَّاحِ، أَنْبَأَنَا سُفْيَانُ، أَنْبَأَنَا ضَمْرَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ كَتَبَ الضَّحَّاكُ بْنُ قَيْسٍ إِلَى النُّعْمَانِ بْنِ بَشِيرٍ أَخْبِرْنَا بِأَىِّ، شَىْءٍ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ يَقْرَأُ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ مَعَ سُورَةِ الْجُمُعَةِ قَالَ كَانَ يَقْرَأُ فِيهَا {هَلْ أَتَاكَ حَدِيثُ الْغَاشِيَةِ} .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Establishing the Prayer and the Sunnah Regarding Them, Hadith 1119

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1120

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي الْقِرَاءَةِ فِي الصَّلاَةِ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning the recitation in the Prayer on Friday

hadiths.englishRaw: It was narrated from Abu ‘Inabah Al-Khawlani that the Prophet ﷺ used to recite “Glorify the Name of your Lord the Most High” and “Has there come to you the narration of the overwhelming (i.e., the Day of Resurrection)? [Al-A’la (87) and Al-Ghashiyah (88)] on Friday.
hadiths.body: It was narrated from Abu ‘Inabah Al-Khawlani that the Prophet ﷺ used to recite “Glorify the Name of your Lord the Most High” and “Has there come to you the narration of the overwhelming (i.e., the Day of Resurrection)? [Al-A’la (87) and Al-Ghashiyah (88)] on Friday.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الزَّاهِرِيَّةِ، عَنْ أَبِي عِنَبَةَ الْخَوْلاَنِيِّ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ كَانَ يَقْرَأُ فِي الْجُمُعَةِ بِـ {سَبِّحِ اسْمَ رَبِّكَ الأَعْلَى} وَ {هَلْ أَتَاكَ حَدِيثُ الْغَاشِيَةِ} .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Establishing the Prayer and the Sunnah Regarding Them, Hadith 1120

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1121

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِيمَنْ أَدْرَكَ مِنَ الْجُمُعَةِ رَكْعَةً
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning one who catches one Rak’ah of Friday Prayer

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Prophet ﷺ said:
            “Whoever catches one Rak’ah of Friday, let him add another Rak’ah to it.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Prophet ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “Whoever catches one Rak’ah of Friday, let him add another Rak’ah to it.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الصَّبَّاحِ، أَنْبَأَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ حَبِيبٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، وَسَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ قَالَ  " مَنْ أَدْرَكَ مِنَ الْجُمُعَةِ رَكْعَةً فَلْيُصَلِّ إِلَيْهَا أُخْرَى " .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Establishing the Prayer and the Sunnah Regarding Them, Hadith 1121

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1122

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِيمَنْ أَدْرَكَ مِنَ الْجُمُعَةِ رَكْعَةً
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning one who catches one Rak’ah of Friday Prayer

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Abu Hurairah said:
           “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: ‘Whoever catches one Rak’ah of prayer, he has caught it.’”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Abu Hurairah said:
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: ‘Whoever catches one Rak’ah of prayer, he has caught it.’”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَهِشَامُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " مَنْ أَدْرَكَ مِنَ الصَّلاَةِ رَكْعَةً فَقَدْ أَدْرَكَ " .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Establishing the Prayer and the Sunnah Regarding Them, Hadith 1122

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1123

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِيمَنْ أَدْرَكَ مِنَ الْجُمُعَةِ رَكْعَةً
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning one who catches one Rak’ah of Friday Prayer

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Ibn ‘Umar said:
           “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: ‘Whoever catches one Rak’ah of Friday prayer or other than it, then he has caught the prayer.’”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Ibn ‘Umar said:
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: ‘Whoever catches one Rak’ah of Friday prayer or other than it, then he has caught the prayer.’”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ سَعِيدِ بْنِ كَثِيرِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ الْحِمْصِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا بَقِيَّةُ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ، حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ الأَيْلِيُّ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " مَنْ أَدْرَكَ رَكْعَةً مِنْ صَلاَةِ الْجُمُعَةِ أَوْ غَيْرِهَا فَقَدْ أَدْرَكَ الصَّلاَةَ " .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Establishing the Prayer and the Sunnah Regarding Them, Hadith 1123

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1124

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ مِنْ أَيْنَ تُؤْتَى الْجُمُعَةُ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning from where you should come to Friday (Prayer)

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Ibn ‘Umar said:
           “The people of Quba’ used to pray with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ on Fridays.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Ibn ‘Umar said:
hadiths.body: “The people of Quba’ used to pray with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ on Fridays.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي مَرْيَمَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ إِنَّ أَهْلَ قُبَاءَ كَانُوا يُجَمِّعُونَ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Establishing the Prayer and the Sunnah Regarding Them, Hadith 1124

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1125

chapter.arabicTitle: باب فِيمَنْ تَرَكَ الْجُمُعَةَ مِنْ غَيْرِ عُذْرٍ
chapter.englishTitle: Those who do not attend Friday prayer without an excuse

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Abu Ja’d Ad-Damri who was a Companion said that the Prophet ﷺ said:
           “Whoever abandons Friday (prayer) three times, neglecting it, a seal will be placed over his heart.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Abu Ja’d Ad-Damri who was a Companion said that the Prophet ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “Whoever abandons Friday (prayer) three times, neglecting it, a seal will be placed over his heart.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ إِدْرِيسَ، وَيَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بِشْرٍ، قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو، حَدَّثَنِي عَبِيدَةُ بْنُ سُفْيَانَ الْحَضْرَمِيُّ، عَنْ أَبِي الْجَعْدِ الضَّمْرِيِّ، - وَكَانَ لَهُ صُحْبَةٌ - قَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ  " مَنْ تَرَكَ الْجُمُعَةَ ثَلاَثَ مَرَّاتٍ تَهَاوُنًا بِهَا طُبِعَ عَلَى قَلْبِهِ " .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Establishing the Prayer and the Sunnah Regarding Them, Hadith 1125

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1126

chapter.arabicTitle: باب فِيمَنْ تَرَكَ الْجُمُعَةَ مِنْ غَيْرِ عُذْرٍ
chapter.englishTitle: Those who do not attend Friday prayer without an excuse

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Jabir bin ‘Abdullah said:
           “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: ‘Whoever abandons Friday (prayer) three times, for no necessary reason, Allah will place a seal over his heart.’”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Jabir bin ‘Abdullah said:
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: ‘Whoever abandons Friday (prayer) three times, for no necessary reason, Allah will place a seal over his heart.’”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَامِرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ، عَنْ أَسِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي أَسِيدٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عِيسَى الْمِصْرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ، عَنْ أَسِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي أَسِيدٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " مَنْ تَرَكَ الْجُمُعَةَ ثَلاَثًا مِنْ غَيْرِ ضَرُورَةٍ طَبَعَ اللَّهُ عَلَى قَلْبِهِ " .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Establishing the Prayer and the Sunnah Regarding Them, Hadith 1126

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1127

chapter.arabicTitle: باب فِيمَنْ تَرَكَ الْجُمُعَةَ مِنْ غَيْرِ عُذْرٍ
chapter.englishTitle: Those who do not attend Friday prayer without an excuse

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Abu Hurairah said:
           The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “What if one of you were to take a flock of sheep and look for grass for them one or two miles away, but he cannot find any at that distance, so he goes further away? Then (the time for) Friday comes but he does not attend it, then (another) Friday comes but he does not attend it, and (another) Friday comes but he does not attend it, until Allah places a seal on his heart.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Abu Hurairah said:
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “What if one of you were to take a flock of sheep and look for grass for them one or two miles away, but he cannot find any at that distance, so he goes further away? Then (the time for) Friday comes but he does not attend it, then (another) Friday comes but he does not attend it, and (another) Friday comes but he does not attend it, until Allah places a seal on his heart.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مَعْدِيُّ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عَجْلاَنَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " أَلاَ هَلْ عَسَى أَحَدُكُمْ أَنْ يَتَّخِذَ الصُّبَّةَ مِنَ الْغَنَمِ عَلَى رَأْسِ مِيلٍ أَوْ مِيلَيْنِ فَيَتَعَذَّرَ عَلَيْهِ الْكَلأُ فَيَرْتَفِعَ ثُمَّ تَجِيءُ الْجُمُعَةُ فَلاَ يَجِيءُ وَلاَ يَشْهَدُهَا وَتَجِيءُ الْجُمُعَةُ فَلاَ يَشْهَدُهَا وَتَجِيءُ الْجُمُعَةُ فَلاَ يَشْهَدُهَا حَتَّى يُطْبَعَ عَلَى قَلْبِهِ " .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Establishing the Prayer and the Sunnah Regarding Them, Hadith 1127

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1128

chapter.arabicTitle: باب فِيمَنْ تَرَكَ الْجُمُعَةَ مِنْ غَيْرِ عُذْرٍ
chapter.englishTitle: Those who do not attend Friday prayer without an excuse

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Samurah bin Jundab that the Prophet ﷺ said:
            “Whoever abandons Friday deliberately, let him give a Dinar in charity, and if he cannot afford that, then (let him give) half a Dinar.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Samurah bin Jundab that the Prophet ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “Whoever abandons Friday deliberately, let him give a Dinar in charity, and if he cannot afford that, then (let him give) half a Dinar.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا نَصْرُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ الْجَهْضَمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا نُوحُ بْنُ قَيْسٍ، عَنْ أَخِيهِ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، عَنْ سَمُرَةَ بْنِ جُنْدُبٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ  " مَنْ تَرَكَ الْجُمُعَةَ مُتَعَمِّدًا فَلْيَتَصَدَّقْ بِدِينَارٍ فَإِنْ لَمْ يَجِدْ فَبِنِصْفِ دِينَارٍ " .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Establishing the Prayer and the Sunnah Regarding Them, Hadith 1128

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1129

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي الصَّلاَةِ قَبْلَ الْجُمُعَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning Prayer before Friday (Prayer)

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Ibn ‘Abbas said:
           “The Prophet ﷺ used to perform four Rak’ah before Friday (prayer), and he did not separate any of them.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Ibn ‘Abbas said:
hadiths.body: “The Prophet ﷺ used to perform four Rak’ah before Friday (prayer), and he did not separate any of them.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ رَبِّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا بَقِيَّةُ، عَنْ مُبَشِّرِ بْنِ عُبَيْدٍ، عَنْ حَجَّاجِ بْنِ أَرْطَاةَ، عَنْ عَطِيَّةَ الْعَوْفِيِّ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ يَرْكَعُ مِنْ قَبْلِ الْجُمُعَةِ أَرْبَعًا لاَ يَفْصِلُ فِي شَىْءٍ مِنْهُنَّ .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Establishing the Prayer and the Sunnah Regarding Them, Hadith 1129

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1130

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي الصَّلاَةِ بَعْدَ الْجُمُعَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning Prayer after Friday

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that when ‘Abdullah bin ‘Umar had prayed Friday, he went and prayed two Rak’ah in his house. Then he said:
           “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to do that.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that when ‘Abdullah bin ‘Umar had prayed Friday, he went and prayed two Rak’ah in his house. Then he said:
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to do that.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنَ رُمْحٍ، أَنْبَأَنَا اللَّيْثُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّهُ كَانَ إِذَا صَلَّى الْجُمُعَةَ انْصَرَفَ فَصَلَّى سَجْدَتَيْنِ فِي بَيْتِهِ ثُمَّ قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَصْنَعُ ذَلِكَ .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Establishing the Prayer and the Sunnah Regarding Them, Hadith 1130

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1131

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي الصَّلاَةِ بَعْدَ الْجُمُعَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning Prayer after Friday

hadiths.englishRaw: It was narrated from Salim, from his father, that the Prophet ﷺ used to pray two Rak’ah after Jumu’ah.
hadiths.body: It was narrated from Salim, from his father, that the Prophet ﷺ used to pray two Rak’ah after Jumu’ah.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الصَّبَّاحِ، أَنْبَأَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ كَانَ يُصَلِّي بَعْدَ الْجُمُعَةِ رَكْعَتَيْنِ .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Establishing the Prayer and the Sunnah Regarding Them, Hadith 1131

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1132

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي الصَّلاَةِ بَعْدَ الْجُمُعَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning Prayer after Friday

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Abu Hurairah said:
           “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: ‘If you pray after Friday, then pray four (Rak’ah).’”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Abu Hurairah said:
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: ‘If you pray after Friday, then pray four (Rak’ah).’”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو السَّائِبِ، سَلْمُ بْنُ جُنَادَةَ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ إِدْرِيسَ، عَنْ سُهَيْلِ بْنِ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " إِذَا صَلَّيْتُمْ بَعْدَ الْجُمُعَةِ فَصَلُّوا أَرْبَعًا " .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Establishing the Prayer and the Sunnah Regarding Them, Hadith 1132

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1133

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي الْحِلَقِ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ قَبْلَ الصَّلاَةِ وَالاِحْتِبَاءِ وَالإِمَامُ يَخْطُبُ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning sitting in circles on Fridays before the Prayer, and Ihtiba’ when the Imam is delivering the sermon

hadiths.englishRaw: It was narrated from ‘Amr bin Shu’aib, from his father, from his grandfather, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade sitting in circles in the mosque on Fridays before the prayer.
hadiths.body: It was narrated from ‘Amr bin Shu’aib, from his father, from his grandfather, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade sitting in circles in the mosque on Fridays before the prayer.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَاتِمُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رُمْحٍ، أَنْبَأَنَا ابْنُ لَهِيعَةَ، جَمِيعًا عَنِ ابْنِ عَجْلاَنَ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ شُعَيْبٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ نَهَى أَنْ يُحَلَّقَ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ قَبْلَ الصَّلاَةِ .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Establishing the Prayer and the Sunnah Regarding Them, Hadith 1133

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1134

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي الْحِلَقِ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ قَبْلَ الصَّلاَةِ وَالاِحْتِبَاءِ وَالإِمَامُ يَخْطُبُ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning sitting in circles on Fridays before the Prayer, and Ihtiba’ when the Imam is delivering the sermon

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from ‘Amr bin Shu’aib, from his father, that his grandfather said:
           “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade Ihtiba’ (sitting with one's thighs gathered up against the stomach while wrapping one's arm or garment around them) on Fridays, meaning, when the Imam is delivering the sermon.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from ‘Amr bin Shu’aib, from his father, that his grandfather said:
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade Ihtiba’ (sitting with one's thighs gathered up against the stomach while wrapping one's arm or garment around them) on Fridays, meaning, when the Imam is delivering the sermon.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُصَفَّى الْحِمْصِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا بَقِيَّةُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ وَاقِدٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَجْلاَنَ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ شُعَيْبٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ، قَالَ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَنْ الاِحْتِبَاءِ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ - يَعْنِي - وَالإِمَامُ يَخْطُبُ .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Establishing the Prayer and the Sunnah Regarding Them, Hadith 1134

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1135

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي الأَذَانِ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning the Adhan on Fridays

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Sa’ib bin Yazid said:
           “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ had only one Mu’adh-dhin. When he came out he would give the Adhan and when he came down (from the pulpit) he would give the Iqamah. Abu Bakr and ‘Umar did likewise, but when ‘Uthman (became caliph) the numbers of people had increased, he added the third call from atop a house in the marketplace that was called Zawra’. When he came out (the Mu’adh-dhin) would call the Adhan, and when he came down from the pulpit, he would call the Iqamah.
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Sa’ib bin Yazid said:
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ had only one Mu’adh-dhin. When he came out he would give the Adhan and when he came down (from the pulpit) he would give the Iqamah. Abu Bakr and ‘Umar did likewise, but when ‘Uthman (became caliph) the numbers of people had increased, he added the third call from atop a house in the marketplace that was called Zawra’. When he came out (the Mu’adh-dhin) would call the Adhan, and when he came down from the pulpit, he would call the Iqamah.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ بْنُ مُوسَى الْقَطَّانُ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو خَالِدٍ الأَحْمَرُ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْحَاقَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنِ السَّائِبِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ، قَالَ مَا كَانَ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ إِلاَّ مُؤَذِّنٌ وَاحِدٌ فَإِذَا خَرَجَ أَذَّنَ وَإِذَا نَزَلَ أَقَامَ وَأَبُو بَكْرٍ وَعُمَرُ كَذَلِكَ فَلَمَّا كَانَ عُثْمَانُ وَكَثُرَ النَّاسُ زَادَ النِّدَاءَ الثَّالِثَ عَلَى دَارٍ فِي السُّوقِ يُقَالُ لَهَا الزَّوْرَاءُ فَإِذَا خَرَجَ أَذَّنَ وَإِذَا نَزَلَ أَقَامَ .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Establishing the Prayer and the Sunnah Regarding Them, Hadith 1135

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1136

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي اسْتِقْبَالِ الإِمَامِ وَهُوَ يَخْطُبُ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning facing the Imam when he is delivering the sermon

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from ‘Adi bin Thabit that his father said:
           “When the Prophet ﷺ stood on the pulpit, his Companions would turn to face him.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from ‘Adi bin Thabit that his father said:
hadiths.body: “When the Prophet ﷺ stood on the pulpit, his Companions would turn to face him.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا الْهَيْثَمُ بْنُ جَمِيلٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ، عَنْ أَبَانَ بْنِ تَغْلِبَ، عَنْ عَدِيِّ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ إِذَا قَامَ عَلَى الْمِنْبَرِ اسْتَقْبَلَهُ أَصْحَابُهُ بِوُجُوهِهِمْ .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Establishing the Prayer and the Sunnah Regarding Them, Hadith 1136

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1137

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي السَّاعَةِ الَّتِي تُرْجَى فِي الْجُمُعَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning the hour that is hoped for on Friday

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Abu Hurairah said:
           “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: ‘On Friday there is a time when no Muslim man happens to stand in prayer at that time, asking Allah for good things, but He will give that to him.” And he gestured with his hand to indicate how short that time is.
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Abu Hurairah said:
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: ‘On Friday there is a time when no Muslim man happens to stand in prayer at that time, asking Allah for good things, but He will give that to him.” And he gestured with his hand to indicate how short that time is.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الصَّبَّاحِ، أَنْبَأَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِيرِينَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " إِنَّ فِي الْجُمُعَةِ سَاعَةً لاَ يُوَافِقُهَا رَجُلٌ مُسْلِمٌ قَائِمٌ يُصَلِّي يَسْأَلُ اللَّهَ فِيهَا خَيْرًا إِلاَّ أَعْطَاهُ " . وَقَلَّلَهَا بِيَدِهِ .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Establishing the Prayer and the Sunnah Regarding Them, Hadith 1137

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1138

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي السَّاعَةِ الَّتِي تُرْجَى فِي الْجُمُعَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning the hour that is hoped for on Friday

hadiths.englishRaw:
Kathir bin ‘Abdullah bin ‘Amr bin ‘Awf Al-Muzani narrated from his father, that his grandfather said:
           “I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: ‘On Friday there is a time of the day during which no person asks Allah for something but He will give him what he asks for.’” It was said: ‘When is that time?’ He said: ‘When the Iqamah for prayer (is called), until the prayer ends.’”
hadiths.narrator: Kathir bin ‘Abdullah bin ‘Amr bin ‘Awf Al-Muzani narrated from his father, that his grandfather said:
