hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا الْمُحَارِبِيُّ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْحَاقَ، عَنِ الْحَارِثِ بْنِ فُضَيْلٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ كَعْبِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ لَمَّا حَضَرَتْ كَعْبًا الْوَفَاةُ أَتَتْهُ أُمُّ بِشْرٍ بِنْتُ الْبَرَاءِ بْنِ مَعْرُورٍ فَقَالَتْ يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ إِنْ لَقِيتَ فُلاَنًا فَاقْرَأْ عَلَيْهِ مِنِّي السَّلاَمَ . قَالَ غَفَرَ اللَّهُ لَكِ يَا أُمَّ بِشْرٍ نَحْنُ أَشْغَلُ مِنْ ذَلِكِ . قَالَتْ يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ أَمَا سَمِعْتَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ  " إِنَّ أَرْوَاحَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ فِي طَيْرٍ خُضْرٍ تَعْلُقُ فِي شَجَرِ الْجَنَّةِ " . قَالَ بَلَى . قَالَتْ فَهُوَ ذَاكَ .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1449

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1450

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِيمَا يُقَالُ عِنْدَ الْمَرِيضِ إِذَا حُضِرَ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning what is to be said to the sick person when death approaches

hadiths.englishRaw:
Muhammad bin Munkadir said:
           “I entered upon Jabir bin ‘Abdullah when he was dying, and I said: ‘Convey my Salam to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ.’”
hadiths.narrator: Muhammad bin Munkadir said:
hadiths.body: “I entered upon Jabir bin ‘Abdullah when he was dying, and I said: ‘Convey my Salam to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ.’”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ الأَزْهَرِ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى، حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ بْنُ الْمَاجِشُونِ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُنْكَدِرِ، قَالَ دَخَلْتُ عَلَى جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ وَهُوَ يَمُوتُ فَقُلْتُ اقْرَأْ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ السَّلاَمَ .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1450

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1451

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي الْمُؤْمِنِ يُؤْجَرُ فِي النَّزْعِ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning the believer being rewarded for the agony of death

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from ‘Aishah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ entered upon her and there was a close relative of hers who was in the throes of death. When the Prophet ﷺ saw how upset she was, he said:
           “Do not grieve for your relative, for that is part of his Hasanat (merits).”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from ‘Aishah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ entered upon her and there was a close relative of hers who was in the throes of death. When the Prophet ﷺ saw how upset she was, he said:
hadiths.body: “Do not grieve for your relative, for that is part of his Hasanat (merits).”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَوْزَاعِيُّ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ دَخَلَ عَلَيْهَا وَعِنْدَهَا حَمِيمٌ لَهَا يَخْنُقُهُ الْمَوْتُ فَلَمَّا رَأَى النَّبِيُّ ﷺ مَا بِهَا قَالَ لَهَا  " لاَ تَبْتَئِسِي عَلَى حَمِيمِكِ فَإِنَّ ذَلِكَ مِنْ حَسَنَاتِهِ " .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1451

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1452

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي الْمُؤْمِنِ يُؤْجَرُ فِي النَّزْعِ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning the believer being rewarded for the agony of death

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Buraidah from his father that the Prophet ﷺ said:
           “The believer dies with sweat on his brow.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Buraidah from his father that the Prophet ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “The believer dies with sweat on his brow.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا بَكْرُ بْنُ خَلَفٍ أَبُو بِشْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنِ الْمُثَنَّى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ بُرَيْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ قَالَ  " الْمُؤْمِنُ يَمُوتُ بِعَرَقِ الْجَبِينِ " .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1452

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1453

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي الْمُؤْمِنِ يُؤْجَرُ فِي النَّزْعِ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning the believer being rewarded for the agony of death

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Abu Musa said:
           “I asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ: ‘When does a person stop recognizing people?’ he said: ‘When he sees.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Abu Musa said:
hadiths.body: “I asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ: ‘When does a person stop recognizing people?’ he said: ‘When he sees.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا رَوْحُ بْنُ الْفَرَجِ، حَدَّثَنَا نَصْرُ بْنُ حَمَّادٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ كَرْدَمٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ، عَنْ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى، قَالَ سَأَلْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ مَتَى تَنْقَطِعُ مَعْرِفَةُ الْعَبْدِ مِنَ النَّاسِ قَالَ  " إِذَا عَايَنَ " .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1453

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1454

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي تَغْمِيضِ الْمَيِّتِ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning closing the eyes of the deceased

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Umm Salamah said:
           “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ entered upon Abu Salamah (after he had died), and his eyes were wide open. He closed his eyes, then he said: ‘When the soul is taken, the sight follows it.’”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Umm Salamah said:
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ entered upon Abu Salamah (after he had died), and his eyes were wide open. He closed his eyes, then he said: ‘When the soul is taken, the sight follows it.’”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ أَسَدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاوِيَةُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو إِسْحَاقَ الْفَزَارِيُّ، عَنْ خَالِدٍ الْحَذَّاءِ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلاَبَةَ، عَنْ قَبِيصَةَ بْنِ ذُؤَيْبٍ، عَنْ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ، قَالَتْ دَخَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَلَى أَبِي سَلَمَةَ وَقَدْ شَقَّ بَصَرُهُ فَأَغْمَضَهُ ثُمَّ قَالَ  " إِنَّ الرُّوحَ إِذَا قُبِضَ تَبِعَهُ الْبَصَرُ " .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1454

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1455

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي تَغْمِيضِ الْمَيِّتِ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning closing the eyes of the deceased

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Shaddad bin Aws that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            “When you come to your dead ones, close their eyes, for the sight follows the soul. And say good things, for the Angels say Amin to what the members of the household say.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Shaddad bin Aws that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “When you come to your dead ones, close their eyes, for the sight follows the soul. And say good things, for the Angels say Amin to what the members of the household say.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ، سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ تَوْبَةَ حَدَّثَنَا عَاصِمُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ، حَدَّثَنَا قَزَعَةُ بْنُ سُوَيْدٍ، عَنْ حُمَيْدٍ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ مَحْمُودِ بْنِ لَبِيدٍ، عَنْ شَدَّادِ بْنِ أَوْسٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " إِذَا حَضَرْتُمْ مَوْتَاكُمْ فَأَغْمِضُوا الْبَصَرَ فَإِنَّ الْبَصَرَ يَتْبَعُ الرُّوحَ وَقُولُوا خَيْرًا فَإِنَّ الْمَلاَئِكَةَ تُؤَمِّنُ عَلَى مَا قَالَ أَهْلُ الْبَيْتِ " .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1455

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1456

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي تَقْبِيلِ الْمَيِّتِ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning kissing the deceased

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that ‘Aishah said:
           “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ kissed ‘Uthman bin Maz’un when he had died, and it is as if I can see him with his tears flowing down his cheeks.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that ‘Aishah said:
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ kissed ‘Uthman bin Maz’un when he had died, and it is as if I can see him with his tears flowing down his cheeks.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَعَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ عَاصِمِ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ قَبَّلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ عُثْمَانَ بْنَ مَظْعُونٍ وَهُوَ مَيِّتٌ فَكَأَنِّي أَنْظُرُ إِلَى دُمُوعِهِ تَسِيلُ عَلَى خَدَّيْهِ .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1456

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1457

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي تَقْبِيلِ الْمَيِّتِ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning kissing the deceased

hadiths.englishRaw: It was narrated from Ibn ‘Abbas and ‘Aishah that Abu Bakr kissed the Prophet ﷺ when he died.
hadiths.body: It was narrated from Ibn ‘Abbas and ‘Aishah that Abu Bakr kissed the Prophet ﷺ when he died.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ سِنَانٍ، وَالْعَبَّاسُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْعَظِيمِ، وَسَهْلُ بْنُ أَبِي سَهْلٍ، قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ أَبِي عَائِشَةَ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، وَعَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ أَبَا بَكْرٍ، قَبَّلَ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ وَهُوَ مَيِّتٌ .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1457

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1458

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي غُسْلِ الْمَيِّتِ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning washing the deceased

hadiths.englishRaw:
Muhammad bin Sirin narrated that Umm ‘Atiyyah said:
           “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ entered upon us when we were washing his daughter Umm Kulthum. He said: ‘Wash her three or five times, or more than that if you think you need to, with water and lote leaves, and put camphor or a little camphor in (the water) for the last washing. When you have finished, call for me.’ When we finished, we called him, and he gave his waist-wrapper to us and said: ‘Shroud her with it.’”
hadiths.narrator: Muhammad bin Sirin narrated that Umm ‘Atiyyah said:
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ entered upon us when we were washing his daughter Umm Kulthum. He said: ‘Wash her three or five times, or more than that if you think you need to, with water and lote leaves, and put camphor or a little camphor in (the water) for the last washing. When you have finished, call for me.’ When we finished, we called him, and he gave his waist-wrapper to us and said: ‘Shroud her with it.’”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ الثَّقَفِيُّ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِيرِينَ، عَنْ أُمِّ عَطِيَّةَ، قَالَتْ دَخَلَ عَلَيْنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَنَحْنُ نُغَسِّلُ ابْنَتَهُ أُمَّ كُلْثُومٍ فَقَالَ " اغْسِلْنَهَا ثَلاَثًا أَوْ خَمْسًا أَوْ أَكْثَرَ مِنْ ذَلِكِ إِنْ رَأَيْتُنَّ ذَلِكِ بِمَاءٍ وَسِدْرٍ وَاجْعَلْنَ فِي الآخِرَةِ كَافُورًا أَوْ شَيْئًا مِنْ كَافُورٍ فَإِذَا فَرَغْتُنَّ فَآذِنَّنِي " . فَلَمَّا فَرَغْنَا آذَنَّاهُ فَأَلْقَى إِلَيْنَا حَقْوَهُ . وَقَالَ " أَشْعِرْنَهَا إِيَّاهُ " .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1458

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1459

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي غُسْلِ الْمَيِّتِ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning washing the deceased

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Ayyub who said:
           “Hafsah narrated to me, from Umm ‘Atiyyah” and it is similar to the Hadith of Muhammad. And in the narration of Hafsah it says: “Wash her an odd number of times.” And: “Wash her face three or five times.” And “Start on her right, with the places washed in ablution.” And it says that Umm ‘Atiyyah said: “And we combed her hair into three braids.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Ayyub who said:
hadiths.body: “Hafsah narrated to me, from Umm ‘Atiyyah” and it is similar to the Hadith of Muhammad. And in the narration of Hafsah it says: “Wash her an odd number of times.” And: “Wash her face three or five times.” And “Start on her right, with the places washed in ablution.” And it says that Umm ‘Atiyyah said: “And we combed her hair into three braids.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ الثَّقَفِيُّ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، حَدَّثَتْنِي حَفْصَةُ، عَنْ أُمِّ عَطِيَّةَ، بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَكَانَ فِي حَدِيثِ حَفْصَةَ " اغْسِلْنَهَا وِتْرًا " . وَكَانَ فِيهِ " اغْسِلْنَهَا ثَلاَثًا أَوْ خَمْسًا " . وَكَانَ فِيهِ " ابْدَءُوا بِمَيَامِنِهَا وَمَوَاضِعِ الْوُضُوءِ مِنْهَا " . وَكَانَ فِيهِ أَنَّ أُمَّ عَطِيَّةَ قَالَتْ وَامْشِطْنَهَا ثَلاَثَةَ قُرُونٍ .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1459

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1460

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي غُسْلِ الْمَيِّتِ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning washing the deceased

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that ‘Ali said:
           “The Prophet ﷺ said to me: ‘Do not show your thigh, and do not look at the thigh of anyone, living or dead.’”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that ‘Ali said:
hadiths.body: “The Prophet ﷺ said to me: ‘Do not show your thigh, and do not look at the thigh of anyone, living or dead.’”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ آدَمَ، حَدَّثَنَا رَوْحُ بْنُ عُبَادَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، عَنْ حَبِيبِ بْنِ أَبِي ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ عَاصِمِ بْنِ ضَمْرَةَ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ، قَالَ قَالَ لِي النَّبِيُّ ﷺ  " لاَ تُبْرِزْ فَخِذَكَ وَلاَ تَنْظُرْ إِلَى فَخِذِ حَىٍّ وَلاَ مَيِّتٍ " .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1460

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1461

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي غُسْلِ الْمَيِّتِ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning washing the deceased

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from ‘Abdullah bin ‘Umar that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
           ‘Let the honest wash your dead.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from ‘Abdullah bin ‘Umar that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: ‘Let the honest wash your dead.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُصَفَّى الْحِمْصِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا بَقِيَّةُ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ، عَنْ مُبَشِّرِ بْنِ عُبَيْدٍ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " لِيُغَسِّلْ مَوْتَاكُمُ الْمَأْمُونُونَ " .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1461

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1462

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي غُسْلِ الْمَيِّتِ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning washing the deceased

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from ‘Ali that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            “Whoever washes a deceased person, shrouds him, embalms him, carries him and offers the funeral prayer for him, and does not disclose what he has seen, he will emerge from his sins as on the day his mother bore him.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from ‘Ali that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “Whoever washes a deceased person, shrouds him, embalms him, carries him and offers the funeral prayer for him, and does not disclose what he has seen, he will emerge from his sins as on the day his mother bore him.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ الْمُحَارِبِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبَّادُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ خَالِدٍ، عَنْ حَبِيبِ بْنِ أَبِي ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ عَاصِمِ بْنِ ضَمْرَةَ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " مَنْ غَسَّلَ مَيِّتًا وَكَفَّنَهُ وَحَنَّطَهُ وَحَمَلَهُ وَصَلَّى عَلَيْهِ وَلَمْ يُفْشِ عَلَيْهِ مَا رَأَى خَرَجَ مِنْ خَطِيئَتِهِ مِثْلَ يَوْمِ وَلَدَتْهُ أُمُّهُ " .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1462

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1463

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي غُسْلِ الْمَيِّتِ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning washing the deceased

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            “Whoever washes a dead person, let him take a bath.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “Whoever washes a dead person, let him take a bath.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ أَبِي الشَّوَارِبِ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ الْمُخْتَارِ، عَنْ سُهَيْلِ بْنِ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " مَنْ غَسَّلَ مَيِّتًا فَلْيَغْتَسِلْ " .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1463

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1464

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي غُسْلِ الرَّجُلِ امْرَأَتَهُ وَغُسْلِ الْمَرْأَةِ زَوْجَهَا
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning a man washing his wife and a woman washing her husband

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that ‘Aishah said:
           “If I had known then what I know now, no one would have washed the Prophet ﷺ but his wives.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that ‘Aishah said:
hadiths.body: “If I had known then what I know now, no one would have washed the Prophet ﷺ but his wives.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ الْوَهْبِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ عَبَّادِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ لَوْ كُنْتُ اسْتَقْبَلْتُ مِنَ الأَمْرِ مَا اسْتَدْبَرْتُ مَا غَسَّلَ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ غَيْرُ نِسَائِهِ .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1464

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1465

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي غُسْلِ الرَّجُلِ امْرَأَتَهُ وَغُسْلِ الْمَرْأَةِ زَوْجَهَا
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning a man washing his wife and a woman washing her husband

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that ‘Aishah said:
           “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ came back from Al-Baqi’ and I had a headache and was saying: ‘O my head!’ He said: ‘Rather, I should say, O my head, O ‘Aishah!’ Then he said: ‘It will not matter if you were to die before me, for I will take care of you, wash you, shroud you, offer the funeral prayer for you and bury you.’”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that ‘Aishah said:
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ came back from Al-Baqi’ and I had a headache and was saying: ‘O my head!’ He said: ‘Rather, I should say, O my head, O ‘Aishah!’ Then he said: ‘It will not matter if you were to die before me, for I will take care of you, wash you, shroud you, offer the funeral prayer for you and bury you.’”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ حَنْبَلٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ رَجَعَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ مِنَ الْبَقِيعِ فَوَجَدَنِي وَأَنَا أَجِدُ صُدَاعًا فِي رَأْسِي وَأَنَا أَقُولُ وَارَأْسَاهُ فَقَالَ " بَلْ أَنَا يَا عَائِشَةُ وَارَأْسَاهُ " . ثُمَّ قَالَ " مَا ضَرَّكِ لَوْ مِتِّ قَبْلِي فَقُمْتُ عَلَيْكِ فَغَسَّلْتُكِ وَكَفَّنْتُكِ وَصَلَّيْتُ عَلَيْكِ وَدَفَنْتُكِ " .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1465

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1466

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي غُسْلِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning the washing of the Prophet (SAW)

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Buraidah that his father said:
           “When they started to wash the Prophet ﷺ, a voice called out from inside (the house) saying: ‘Do not remove the shirt of the Messenger of Allah.’”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Buraidah that his father said:
hadiths.body: “When they started to wash the Prophet ﷺ, a voice called out from inside (the house) saying: ‘Do not remove the shirt of the Messenger of Allah.’”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى بْنِ الأَزْهَرِ الْوَاسِطِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بُرْدَةَ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ بْنِ مَرْثَدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ بُرَيْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ لَمَّا أَخَذُوا فِي غُسْلِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ نَادَاهُمْ مُنَادٍ مِنَ الدَّاخِلِ لاَ تَنْزِعُوا عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَمِيصَهُ .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1466

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1467

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي غُسْلِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning the washing of the Prophet (SAW)

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that ‘Ali bin Abu Talib said that when he washed the Messenger of Allah ﷺ he looked for what which is usually looked for on the deceased (i.e., dirt), and he found none. He said:
           “May my father be sacrificed for you, you are pure; you were pure in life and you are pure in death.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that ‘Ali bin Abu Talib said that when he washed the Messenger of Allah ﷺ he looked for what which is usually looked for on the deceased (i.e., dirt), and he found none. He said:
hadiths.body: “May my father be sacrificed for you, you are pure; you were pure in life and you are pure in death.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ خِذَامٍ، حَدَّثَنَا صَفْوَانُ بْنُ عِيسَى، أَنْبَأَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ، قَالَ لَمَّا غَسَّلَ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ ذَهَبَ يَلْتَمِسُ مِنْهُ مَا يَلْتَمِسُ مِنَ الْمَيِّتِ فَلَمْ يَجِدْهُ . فَقَالَ بِأَبِي الطَّيِّبُ طِبْتَ حَيًّا وَطِبْتَ مَيِّتًا .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1467

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1468

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي غُسْلِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning the washing of the Prophet (SAW)

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from ‘Ali that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            “When I die, then wash me with seven buckets from me well, the well of Ghars.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from ‘Ali that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “When I die, then wash me with seven buckets from me well, the well of Ghars.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبَّادُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ، حَدَّثَنَا الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ زَيْدِ بْنِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " إِذَا أَنَا مُتُّ فَاغْسِلْنِي بِسَبْعِ قِرَبٍ مِنْ بِئْرِي بِئْرِ غَرْسٍ " .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1468

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1469

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي كَفَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning the shrouding of the Prophet ﷺ

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from ‘Aishah that the Prophet ﷺ was shrouded in three white Yemeni cloths, among which there was no shirt and no turban. It was said to ‘Aishah:
           “They used to claim that he was shrouded in Hibarah.” ‘Aishah said: “They brought a Hibarah Burd, but they did not shroud him in it.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from ‘Aishah that the Prophet ﷺ was shrouded in three white Yemeni cloths, among which there was no shirt and no turban. It was said to ‘Aishah:
hadiths.body: “They used to claim that he was shrouded in Hibarah.” ‘Aishah said: “They brought a Hibarah Burd, but they did not shroud him in it.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصُ بْنُ غِيَاثٍ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ كُفِّنَ فِي ثَلاَثَةِ أَثْوَابٍ بِيضٍ يَمَانِيَةٍ لَيْسَ فِيهَا قَمِيصٌ وَلاَ عِمَامَةٌ فَقِيلَ لِعَائِشَةَ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا يَزْعُمُونَ أَنَّهُ قَدْ كَانَ كُفِّنَ فِي حِبَرَةٍ . فَقَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ قَدْ جَاءُوا بِبُرْدِ حِبَرَةٍ فَلَمْ يُكَفِّنُوهُ .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1469

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1470

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي كَفَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning the shrouding of the Prophet ﷺ

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that ‘Abdullah bin ‘Umar said:
           “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ was shrouded in three thin white Suhuli cloths.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that ‘Abdullah bin ‘Umar said:
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ was shrouded in three thin white Suhuli cloths.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ خَلَفٍ الْعَسْقَلاَنِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، قَالَ هَذَا مَا سَمِعْتُ مِنْ أَبِي مُعَيْدٍ، حَفْصِ بْنِ غَيْلاَنَ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ مُوسَى، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ كُفِّنَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ فِي ثَلاَثِ رِيَاطٍ بِيضٍ سَحُولِيَّةٍ .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1470

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1471

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي كَفَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning the shrouding of the Prophet ﷺ

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Ibn ‘Abbas said:
           “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ was shrouded in three garments: The shirt in which he died, and a Najrani Hullah.
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Ibn ‘Abbas said:
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ was shrouded in three garments: The shirt in which he died, and a Najrani Hullah.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ إِدْرِيسَ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي زِيَادٍ، عَنِ الْحَكَمِ، عَنْ مِقْسَمٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ كُفِّنَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ فِي ثَلاَثَةِ أَثْوَابٍ قَمِيصُهُ الَّذِي قُبِضَ فِيهِ وَحُلَّةٌ نَجْرَانِيَّةٌ .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1471

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1472

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِيمَا يُسْتَحَبُّ مِنَ الْكَفَنِ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning what is recommended in shrouding

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Ibn ‘Abbas that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            “The best of your garments are those which are white, so shroud your dead in them, and wear them.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Ibn ‘Abbas that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “The best of your garments are those which are white, so shroud your dead in them, and wear them.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الصَّبَّاحِ، أَنْبَأَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ رَجَاءٍ الْمَكِّيُّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ خُثَيْمٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " خَيْرُ ثِيَابِكُمُ الْبَيَاضُ فَكَفِّنُوا فِيهَا مَوْتَاكُمْ وَالْبَسُوهَا " .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1472

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1473

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِيمَا يُسْتَحَبُّ مِنَ الْكَفَنِ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning what is recommended in shrouding

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from ‘Ubadah bin Samit that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
           “The best of shrouds is the Hullah (two-piecer).”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from ‘Ubadah bin Samit that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “The best of shrouds is the Hullah (two-piecer).”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الأَعْلَى، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَنْبَأَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ حَاتِمِ بْنِ أَبِي نَصْرٍ، عَنْ عُبَادَةَ بْنِ نُسَىٍّ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عُبَادَةَ بْنِ الصَّامِتِ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ  " خَيْرُ الْكَفَنِ الْحُلَّةُ " .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1473

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1474

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِيمَا يُسْتَحَبُّ مِنَ الْكَفَنِ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning what is recommended in shrouding

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Qatadah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
           “If anyone of you is charged with taking care of his brother (after death), let him shroud him well.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Qatadah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “If anyone of you is charged with taking care of his brother (after death), let him shroud him well.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا عِكْرِمَةُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ حَسَّانٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِيرِينَ، عَنْ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " إِذَا وَلِيَ أَحَدُكُمْ أَخَاهُ فَلْيُحْسِنْ كَفَنَهُ " .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1474

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1475

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي النَّظَرِ إِلَى الْمَيِّتِ إِذَا أُدْرِجَ فِي أَكْفَانِهِ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning looking at the deceased when he has been wrapped in his shroud

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Anas bin Malik said:
           “When Ibrahim the son of the Prophet ﷺ died, the Prophet ﷺ said to them: ‘Do not wrap him in his shroud until I look at him.’ He came to him, bent over and wept.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Anas bin Malik said:
hadiths.body: “When Ibrahim the son of the Prophet ﷺ died, the Prophet ﷺ said to them: ‘Do not wrap him in his shroud until I look at him.’ He came to him, bent over and wept.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ سَمُرَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْحَسَنِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو شَيْبَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ لَمَّا قُبِضَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ ابْنُ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ لَهُمُ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ  " لاَ تُدْرِجُوهُ فِي أَكْفَانِهِ حَتَّى أَنْظُرَ إِلَيْهِ " . فَأَتَاهُ فَانْكَبَّ عَلَيْهِ وَبَكَى .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1475

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1476

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي النَّهْىِ عَنِ النَّعْىِ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning the prohibition of making public death announcements

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Bilal bin Yahya said:
           “If one of the members of his family died, Hudhaifah would say: ‘Do not inform anyone of it, for I am afraid that that would be a public death announcement. I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ with these two ears of mine forbidding making public death announcements.’”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Bilal bin Yahya said:
hadiths.body: “If one of the members of his family died, Hudhaifah would say: ‘Do not inform anyone of it, for I am afraid that that would be a public death announcement. I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ with these two ears of mine forbidding making public death announcements.’”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ، عَنْ حَبِيبِ بْنِ سُلَيْمٍ، عَنْ بِلاَلِ بْنِ يَحْيَى، قَالَ كَانَ حُذَيْفَةُ إِذَا مَاتَ لَهُ الْمَيِّتُ قَالَ لاَ تُؤْذِنُوا بِهِ أَحَدًا إِنِّي أَخَافُ أَنْ يَكُونَ نَعْيًا إِنِّي سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ بِأُذُنَىَّ هَاتَيْنِ يَنْهَى عَنِ النَّعْىِ .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1476

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1477

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي شُهُودِ الْجَنَائِزِ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning attending funerals

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            ‘Hasten with the funeral (procession), for if the person was righteous then you are advancing him towards good, and if he was otherwise then it is evil which you are taking off of your necks.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: ‘Hasten with the funeral (procession), for if the person was righteous then you are advancing him towards good, and if he was otherwise then it is evil which you are taking off of your necks.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَهِشَامُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " أَسْرِعُوا بِالْجِنَازَةِ فَإِنْ تَكُنْ صَالِحَةً فَخَيْرٌ تُقَدِّمُونَهَا إِلَيْهِ وَإِنْ تَكُنْ غَيْرَ ذَلِكَ فَشَرٌّ تَضَعُونَهُ عَنْ رِقَابِكُمْ " .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1477

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1478

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي شُهُودِ الْجَنَائِزِ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning attending funerals

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Abu ‘Ubaidah said:
           “ ‘Abdullah bin Mas’ud said: ‘Whoever follows a funeral (procession), let him carry all (four) corners of it (in turn), for that is Sunnah. Then if he wishes let him voluntarily carry it, and if he wishes let him not do so.’”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Abu ‘Ubaidah said:
hadiths.body: “ ‘Abdullah bin Mas’ud said: ‘Whoever follows a funeral (procession), let him carry all (four) corners of it (in turn), for that is Sunnah. Then if he wishes let him voluntarily carry it, and if he wishes let him not do so.’”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا حُمَيْدُ بْنُ مَسْعَدَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ نِسْطَاسٍ، عَنْ أَبِي عُبَيْدَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْعُودٍ مَنِ اتَّبَعَ جِنَازَةً فَلْيَحْمِلْ بِجِوَانِبِ السَّرِيرِ كُلِّهَا فَإِنَّهُ مِنَ السُّنَّةِ ثُمَّ إِنْ شَاءَ فَلْيَتَطَوَّعْ وَإِنْ شَاءَ فَلْيَدَعْ .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1478

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1479

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي شُهُودِ الْجَنَائِزِ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning attending funerals

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Musa that the Prophet ﷺ saw a funeral (procession) with which the people were rushing. He said:
           “You should move with tranquility.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Musa that the Prophet ﷺ saw a funeral (procession) with which the people were rushing. He said:
hadiths.body: “You should move with tranquility.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ عَقِيلٍ، حَدَّثَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ ثَابِتٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ لَيْثٍ، عَنْ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ أَنَّهُ رَأَى جِنَازَةً يُسْرِعُونَ بِهَا قَالَ  " لِتَكُنْ عَلَيْكُمُ السَّكِينَةُ " .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1479

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1480

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي شُهُودِ الْجَنَائِزِ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning attending funerals

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Thawban, the freed slave of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, said:
           “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ saw some people riding on their animals in a funeral (procession). He said: ‘Do you not feel ashamed that the angels of Allah are walking on foot and you are riding?’”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Thawban, the freed slave of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, said:
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ saw some people riding on their animals in a funeral (procession). He said: ‘Do you not feel ashamed that the angels of Allah are walking on foot and you are riding?’”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا كَثِيرُ بْنُ عُبَيْدٍ الْحِمْصِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا بَقِيَّةُ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ، عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ أَبِي مَرْيَمَ، عَنْ رَاشِدِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ ثَوْبَانَ، مَوْلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ رَأَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ نَاسًا رُكْبَانًا عَلَى دَوَابِّهِمْ فِي جِنَازَةٍ فَقَالَ  " أَلاَ تَسْتَحْيُونَ أَنَّ مَلاَئِكَةَ اللَّهِ يَمْشُونَ عَلَى أَقْدَامِهِمْ وَأَنْتُمْ رُكْبَانٌ " .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1480

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1481

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي شُهُودِ الْجَنَائِزِ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning attending funerals

hadiths.englishRaw:
Al-Mughirah bin Shu’bah said:
           “I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: ‘The rider should travel behind the funeral (procession) but the one who is walking may walk wherever he wants.”
hadiths.narrator: Al-Mughirah bin Shu’bah said:
hadiths.body: “I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: ‘The rider should travel behind the funeral (procession) but the one who is walking may walk wherever he wants.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا رَوْحُ بْنُ عُبَادَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ جُبَيْرِ بْنِ حَيَّةَ، حَدَّثَنِي زِيَادُ بْنُ جُبَيْرِ بْنِ حَيَّةَ، سَمِعَ الْمُغِيرَةَ بْنَ شُعْبَةَ، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ  " الرَّاكِبُ خَلْفَ الْجِنَازَةِ وَالْمَاشِي مِنْهَا حَيْثُ شَاءَ " .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1481

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1482

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي الْمَشْىِ أَمَامَ الْجِنَازَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning walking ahead of the funeral (procession)

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Salim that his father said:
           “I saw the Prophet ﷺ, Abu Bakr and ‘Umar walking ahead of the funeral (procession).”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Salim that his father said:
hadiths.body: “I saw the Prophet ﷺ, Abu Bakr and ‘Umar walking ahead of the funeral (procession).”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، وَهِشَامُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، وَسَهْلُ بْنُ أَبِي سَهْلٍ، قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ رَأَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ وَأَبَا بَكْرٍ وَعُمَرَ يَمْشُونَ أَمَامَ الْجِنَازَةِ .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1482

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1483

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي الْمَشْىِ أَمَامَ الْجِنَازَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning walking ahead of the funeral (procession)

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Anas bin Malik said:
           “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ, Abu Bakr, ‘Umar and ‘Uthman used to walk ahead of the funeral (procession).”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Anas bin Malik said:
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ, Abu Bakr, ‘Umar and ‘Uthman used to walk ahead of the funeral (procession).”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا نَصْرُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ الْجَهْضَمِيُّ، وَهَارُونُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْحَمَّالُ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَكْرٍ الْبُرْسَانِيُّ، أَنْبَأَنَا يُونُسُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ الأَيْلِيُّ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَأَبُو بَكْرٍ وَ عُمَرُ وَعُثْمَانُ يَمْشُونَ أَمَامَ الْجِنَازَةِ .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1483

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1484

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي الْمَشْىِ أَمَامَ الْجِنَازَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning walking ahead of the funeral (procession)

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from ‘Abdullah bin Mas’ud that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
           ‘The funeral should be followed and should not follow. There should be no one with it who walks ahead of it.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from ‘Abdullah bin Mas’ud that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: ‘The funeral should be followed and should not follow. There should be no one with it who walks ahead of it.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدَةَ، أَنْبَأَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ بْنُ زِيَادٍ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ التَّيْمِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي مَاجِدَةَ الْحَنَفِيِّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " الْجِنَازَةُ مَتْبُوعَةٌ وَلَيْسَتْ بِتَابِعَةٍ لَيْسَ مِنْهَا مَنْ تَقَدَّمَهَا " .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1484

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1485

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي النَّهْىِ عَنِ التَّسَلُّبِ، مَعَ الْجِنَازَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning the prohibition of wearing mourning dress during the funeral procession

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that ‘Imran bin Husain and Abu Barzah said:
           “We went out with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ to attend a funeral, and he saw some people who had cast aside their upper sheets and were walking in their shirts only. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: ‘Are you adopting the practice of the days of ignorance?’ or; ‘Are you imitating the behaviour of the days of ignorance? I was about to supplicate against you that you would return in a different form.’ So they put their sheets back on and never did that again.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that ‘Imran bin Husain and Abu Barzah said:
hadiths.body: “We went out with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ to attend a funeral, and he saw some people who had cast aside their upper sheets and were walking in their shirts only. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: ‘Are you adopting the practice of the days of ignorance?’ or; ‘Are you imitating the behaviour of the days of ignorance? I was about to supplicate against you that you would return in a different form.’ So they put their sheets back on and never did that again.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدَةَ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ النُّعْمَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ الْحَزَوَّرِ، عَنْ نُفَيْعٍ، عَنْ عِمْرَانَ بْنِ الْحُصَيْنِ، وَأَبِي، بَرْزَةَ قَالاَ خَرَجْنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فِي جِنَازَةٍ فَرَأَى قَوْمًا قَدْ طَرَحُوا أَرْدِيَتَهُمْ يَمْشُونَ فِي قُمُصٍ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " أَبِفِعْلِ الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ تَأْخُذُونَ - أَوْ بِصُنْعِ الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ تَشَبَّهُونَ - لَقَدْ هَمَمْتُ أَنْ أَدْعُوَ عَلَيْكُمْ دَعْوَةً تَرْجِعُونَ فِي غَيْرِ صُوَرِكُمْ " . قَالَ فَأَخَذُوا أَرْدِيَتَهُمْ وَلَمْ يَعُودُوا لِذَلِكَ .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1485

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1486

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي الْجِنَازَةِ لاَ تُؤَخَّرُ إِذَا حَضَرَتْ وَلاَ تُتْبَعُ بِنَارٍ
chapter.englishTitle: The funeral should not be delayed once the bier is ready, and the funeral procession should not be followed with fire

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from ‘Ali bin Abu Talib that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
           “Do not delay the funeral once it is ready.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from ‘Ali bin Abu Talib that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “Do not delay the funeral once it is ready.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْجُهَنِيُّ، أَنَّ مُحَمَّدَ بْنَ عُمَرَ بْنِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ، حَدَّثَهُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ، عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ  " لاَ تُؤَخِّرُوا الْجِنَازَةَ إِذَا حَضَرَتْ " .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1486

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1487

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي الْجِنَازَةِ لاَ تُؤَخَّرُ إِذَا حَضَرَتْ وَلاَ تُتْبَعُ بِنَارٍ
chapter.englishTitle: The funeral should not be delayed once the bier is ready, and the funeral procession should not be followed with fire

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Hariz that Abu Burdah said:
           “Abu Musa Ash’ari left instructions, when he was dying, saying: ‘Do not follow me with a censer.’* They said to him: ‘Did you hear something concerning that?’ He said: ‘Yes, from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ.’”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Hariz that Abu Burdah said:
hadiths.body: “Abu Musa Ash’ari left instructions, when he was dying, saying: ‘Do not follow me with a censer.’* They said to him: ‘Did you hear something concerning that?’ He said: ‘Yes, from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ.’”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الأَعْلَى الصَّنْعَانِيُّ، أَنْبَأَنَا مُعْتَمِرُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى الْفُضَيْلِ بْنِ مَيْسَرَةَ عَنْ أَبِي حَرِيزٍ، أَنَّ أَبَا بُرْدَةَ، حَدَّثَهُ قَالَ أَوْصَى أَبُو مُوسَى الأَشْعَرِيُّ حِينَ حَضَرَهُ الْمَوْتُ فَقَالَ لاَ تُتْبِعُونِي بِمِجْمَرٍ . قَالُوا لَهُ أَوَ سَمِعْتَ فِيهِ شَيْئًا قَالَ نَعَمْ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1487

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1488

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِيمَنْ صَلَّى عَلَيْهِ جَمَاعَةٌ مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning one for whom the funeral prayer is offered by a group of Muslims

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Prophet ﷺ said:
            “Whoever has the funeral prayer offered for him by one hundred Muslims, he will be forgiven.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Prophet ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “Whoever has the funeral prayer offered for him by one hundred Muslims, he will be forgiven.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، أَنْبَأَنَا شَيْبَانُ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ  " مَنْ صَلَّى عَلَيْهِ مِائَةٌ مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ غُفِرَ لَهُ " .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1488

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1489

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِيمَنْ صَلَّى عَلَيْهِ جَمَاعَةٌ مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning one for whom the funeral prayer is offered by a group of Muslims

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Kuraib the freed slave of ‘Abdullah bin ‘Abbas said:
           “A son of ‘Abdullah bin ‘Abbas died, and he said to me: ‘O Kuraib! Get up and see if anyone has assembled (to pray) for my son.’ I said: ‘Yes.’ He said: ‘Woe to you, how many do you see? Forty?’ I said: ‘No, rather there are more.’ He said: ‘Take my son out, for I bear witness that I hear the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: “No (group of) forty believers intercede for a believer, but Allah will accept their intercession.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Kuraib the freed slave of ‘Abdullah bin ‘Abbas said:
hadiths.body: “A son of ‘Abdullah bin ‘Abbas died, and he said to me: ‘O Kuraib! Get up and see if anyone has assembled (to pray) for my son.’ I said: ‘Yes.’ He said: ‘Woe to you, how many do you see? Forty?’ I said: ‘No, rather there are more.’ He said: ‘Take my son out, for I bear witness that I hear the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: “No (group of) forty believers intercede for a believer, but Allah will accept their intercession.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ الْمُنْذِرِ الْحِزَامِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا بَكْرُ بْنُ سُلَيْمٍ، حَدَّثَنِي حُمَيْدُ بْنُ زِيَادٍ الْخَرَّاطُ، عَنْ كُرَيْبٍ، مَوْلَى عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ هَلَكَ ابْنٌ لِعَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبَّاسٍ فَقَالَ لِي يَا كُرَيْبُ قُمْ فَانْظُرْ هَلِ اجْتَمَعَ لاِبْنِي أَحَدٌ فَقُلْتُ نَعَمْ . فَقَالَ وَيْحَكَ كَمْ تَرَاهُمْ أَرْبَعِينَ قُلْتُ لاَ بَلْ هُمْ أَكْثَرُ . قَالَ فَاخْرُجُوا بِابْنِي فَأَشْهَدُ لَسَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ  " مَا مِنْ أَرْبَعِينَ مِنْ مُؤْمِنٍ يَشْفَعُونَ لِمُؤْمِنٍ إِلاَّ شَفَّعَهُمُ اللَّهُ " .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1489

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1490

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِيمَنْ صَلَّى عَلَيْهِ جَمَاعَةٌ مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning one for whom the funeral prayer is offered by a group of Muslims

hadiths.englishRaw:
Malik bin Hubairah Ash-Shami, who was a Companion of the Prophet ﷺ, said:
           “If a funeral procession was brought and the number of people who followed it was considered to be small, they would be organized into three rows, then the funeral prayer would be offered.” He said: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: ‘No three rows of Muslims offer the funeral prayer for one who has died, but he will be guaranteed (Paradise).’”
hadiths.narrator: Malik bin Hubairah Ash-Shami, who was a Companion of the Prophet ﷺ, said:
hadiths.body: “If a funeral procession was brought and the number of people who followed it was considered to be small, they would be organized into three rows, then the funeral prayer would be offered.” He said: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: ‘No three rows of Muslims offer the funeral prayer for one who has died, but he will be guaranteed (Paradise).’”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَعَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ، عَنْ مَرْثَدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْيَزَنِيِّ، عَنْ مَالِكِ بْنِ هُبَيْرَةَ الشَّامِيِّ، - وَكَانَتْ لَهُ صُحْبَةٌ - قَالَ كَانَ إِذَا أُتِيَ بِجِنَازَةٍ فَتَقَالَّ مَنْ تَبِعَهَا جَزَّأَهُمْ ثَلاَثَةَ صُفُوفٍ ثُمَّ صَلَّى عَلَيْهَا وَقَالَ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ  " مَا صَفَّ صُفُوفٌ ثَلاَثَةٌ مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ عَلَى مَيِّتٍ إِلاَّ أَوْجَبَ " .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1490

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1491

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي الثَّنَاءِ عَلَى الْجِنَازَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning praising the deceased

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Anas bin Malik said:
           “A funeral (procession) passed by the Prophet ﷺ and they praised (the deceased) and spoke well of him. He said: ‘(Paradise is) guaranteed for him.’ Then another funeral passed by and they spoke badly of him, and he (the Prophet ﷺ) said: ‘(Hell is) guaranteed for him.’ It was said: ‘O Messenger of Allah, you said that (Paradise was) guaranteed for this one and that (Hell was) guaranteed for the other one.’ He said: ‘It is the testimony of the people, and the believers are the witnesses of Allah on earth.’”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Anas bin Malik said:
hadiths.body: “A funeral (procession) passed by the Prophet ﷺ and they praised (the deceased) and spoke well of him. He said: ‘(Paradise is) guaranteed for him.’ Then another funeral passed by and they spoke badly of him, and he (the Prophet ﷺ) said: ‘(Hell is) guaranteed for him.’ It was said: ‘O Messenger of Allah, you said that (Paradise was) guaranteed for this one and that (Hell was) guaranteed for the other one.’ He said: ‘It is the testimony of the people, and the believers are the witnesses of Allah on earth.’”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ مُرَّ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ ﷺ بِجِنَازَةٍ فَأُثْنِيَ عَلَيْهَا خَيْرًا فَقَالَ " وَجَبَتْ " . ثُمَّ مُرَّ عَلَيْهِ بِجِنَازَةٍ فَأُثْنِيَ عَلَيْهَا شَرًّا فَقَالَ " وَجَبَتْ " . فَقِيلَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قُلْتَ لِهَذِهِ وَجَبَتْ وَلِهَذِهِ وَجَبَتْ فَقَالَ " شَهَادَةُ الْقَوْمِ وَالْمُؤْمِنُونَ شُهُودُ اللَّهِ فِي الأَرْضِ " .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1491

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1492

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي الثَّنَاءِ عَلَى الْجِنَازَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning praising the deceased

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Abu Hurairah said:
           “A funeral passed by the Prophet ﷺ and they praised (the deceased) and spoke well of him and mentioned his good characteristics. He said: ‘(Paradise is) guaranteed for him.’ Then another funeral passed by and they spoke badly of him and mentioned his bad characteristics, and he (the Prophet ﷺ) said: ‘(Hell is) guaranteed for him. You are the witnesses of Allah on earth.’”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Abu Hurairah said:
hadiths.body: “A funeral passed by the Prophet ﷺ and they praised (the deceased) and spoke well of him and mentioned his good characteristics. He said: ‘(Paradise is) guaranteed for him.’ Then another funeral passed by and they spoke badly of him and mentioned his bad characteristics, and he (the Prophet ﷺ) said: ‘(Hell is) guaranteed for him. You are the witnesses of Allah on earth.’”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُسْهِرٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ مُرَّ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ ﷺ بِجِنَازَةٍ - فَأُثْنِيَ عَلَيْهَا خَيْرًا فِي مَنَاقِبِ الْخَيْرِ فَقَالَ " وَجَبَتْ " . ثُمَّ مَرُّوا عَلَيْهِ بِأُخْرَى فَأُثْنِيَ عَلَيْهَا شَرًّا فِي مَنَاقِبِ الشَّرِّ فَقَالَ " وَجَبَتْ إِنَّكُمْ شُهَدَاءُ اللَّهِ فِي الأَرْضِ " .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1492

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1493

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي أَيْنَ يَقُومُ الإِمَامُ إِذَا صَلَّى عَلَى الْجِنَازَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: Where should the Imam stand when he prays over the body?

hadiths.englishRaw: It was narrated from Samurah bin Jundab Al-Fazari that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ offered the funeral prayer for a woman who had died in Nifas,* and he stood level with her middle (i.e. her waist).”
hadiths.body: It was narrated from Samurah bin Jundab Al-Fazari that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ offered the funeral prayer for a woman who had died in Nifas,* and he stood level with her middle (i.e. her waist).”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، قَالَ الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ ذَكْوَانَ أَخْبَرَنِي عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ بُرَيْدَةَ الأَسْلَمِيِّ، عَنْ سَمُرَةَ بْنِ جُنْدُبٍ الْفَزَارِيِّ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ صَلَّى عَلَى امْرَأَةٍ مَاتَتْ فِي نِفَاسِهَا فَقَامَ وَسَطَهَا .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1493

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1494

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي أَيْنَ يَقُومُ الإِمَامُ إِذَا صَلَّى عَلَى الْجِنَازَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: Where should the Imam stand when he prays over the body?

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Abu Ghalib said:
           “I saw Anas bin Malik offering the funeral prayer for a man, and he stood level with his head. Then another funeral was brought, that of a woman, and they said: ‘O Abu Hamzah! Offer the funeral prayer for her.’ So he stood level with the middle of the bed (the body was upon). ‘Ala’ bin Ziyad said to him: ‘O Abu Hamzah! Is this how you saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ standing in relation to the body of a man and a woman as you have stood?’ He said: ‘Yes.’ Then he turned to us and said: ‘Remember this.’”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Abu Ghalib said:
hadiths.body: “I saw Anas bin Malik offering the funeral prayer for a man, and he stood level with his head. Then another funeral was brought, that of a woman, and they said: ‘O Abu Hamzah! Offer the funeral prayer for her.’ So he stood level with the middle of the bed (the body was upon). ‘Ala’ bin Ziyad said to him: ‘O Abu Hamzah! Is this how you saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ standing in relation to the body of a man and a woman as you have stood?’ He said: ‘Yes.’ Then he turned to us and said: ‘Remember this.’”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا نَصْرُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ الْجَهْضَمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ، عَنْ هَمَّامٍ، عَنْ أَبِي غَالِبٍ، قَالَ رَأَيْتُ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ صَلَّى عَلَى جِنَازَةِ رَجُلٍ فَقَامَ حِيَالَ رَأْسِهِ فَجِيءَ بِجِنَازَةٍ أُخْرَى بِامْرَأَةٍ فَقَالُوا يَا أَبَا حَمْزَةَ صَلِّ عَلَيْهَا . فَقَامَ حِيَالَ وَسَطِ السَّرِيرِ فَقَالَ لَهُ الْعَلاَءُ بْنُ زِيَادٍ يَا أَبَا حَمْزَةَ هَكَذَا رَأَيْتَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَامَ مِنَ الْجِنَازَةِ مُقَامَكَ مِنَ الرَّجُلِ وَقَامَ مِنَ الْمَرْأَةِ مُقَامَكَ مِنَ الْمَرْأَةِ قَالَ نَعَمْ . فَأَقْبَلَ عَلَيْنَا فَقَالَ احْفَظُوا .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1494

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1495

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي الْقِرَاءَةِ عَلَى الْجِنَازَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning recitation of Qur’an in the funeral prayer

hadiths.englishRaw: It was narrated from Ibn ‘Abbas that the Prophet ﷺ recited the Opening of the Book (Al-Fatihah) in the funeral prayer.
hadiths.body: It was narrated from Ibn ‘Abbas that the Prophet ﷺ recited the Opening of the Book (Al-Fatihah) in the funeral prayer.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مَنِيعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا زَيْدُ بْنُ الْحُبَابِ، حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ عُثْمَانَ، عَنِ الْحَكَمِ، عَنْ مِقْسَمٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ قَرَأَ عَلَى الْجِنَازَةِ بِفَاتِحَةِ الْكِتَابِ .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1495

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1496

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي الْقِرَاءَةِ عَلَى الْجِنَازَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning recitation of Qur’an in the funeral prayer

hadiths.englishRaw:
Umm Sharik Al-Ansari said:
           “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ commanded us to recite the Opening of the Book (Al-Fatihah) in the funeral prayer.”
hadiths.narrator: Umm Sharik Al-Ansari said:
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ commanded us to recite the Opening of the Book (Al-Fatihah) in the funeral prayer.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ أَبِي عَاصِمٍ النَّبِيلُ، وَإِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ الْمُسْتَمِرِّ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ الْعَبْدِيُّ، حَدَّثَنِي شَهْرُ بْنُ حَوْشَبٍ، حَدَّثَتْنِي أُمُّ شَرِيكٍ الأَنْصَارِيَّةُ، قَالَتْ أَمَرَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَنْ نَقْرَأَ عَلَى الْجِنَازَةِ بِفَاتِحَةِ الْكِتَابِ .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1496

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1497

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي الدُّعَاءِ فِي الصَّلاَةِ عَلَى الْجِنَازَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning supplication during the funeral prayer

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Abu Hurairah said:
           “I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: ‘When you offer the prayer for the deceased, supplicate sincerely for him.’”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Abu Hurairah said:
hadiths.body: “I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: ‘When you offer the prayer for the deceased, supplicate sincerely for him.’”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عُبَيْدٍ، مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ مَيْمُونٍ الْمَدِينِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ الْحَرَّانِيُّ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ التَّيْمِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ  " إِذَا صَلَّيْتُمْ عَلَى الْمَيِّتِ فَأَخْلِصُوا لَهُ الدُّعَاءَ " .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1497

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1498

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي الدُّعَاءِ فِي الصَّلاَةِ عَلَى الْجِنَازَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning supplication during the funeral prayer

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Abu Hurairah said:
           “When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ offered the funeral prayer he would say: ‘Allahummaghfir lihayyina wa mayyitina, wa shahidina wa gha’ibina, wa saghirina wa kabirina, wa dhakarina wa unthana. Allahumma man ahyaitahu minna faahyihi ‘alal-Islam, wa man tawaffaytahu minna fa tawaffahu ‘alal- iman. Allahumma la tahrimna ajrahu wa la tudillana ba’dah. [O Allah, forgive our living and our dead, those who are present and those who are absent, our young and our old, our males and our females. O Allah, whomever of us You cause to live, let him live in Islam, and whomever of us You cause to die, let him die in (a state of) faith. O Allah, do not deprive us of his reward, and do not let us go astray after him].’”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Abu Hurairah said:
hadiths.body: “When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ offered the funeral prayer he would say: ‘Allahummaghfir lihayyina wa mayyitina, wa shahidina wa gha’ibina, wa saghirina wa kabirina, wa dhakarina wa unthana. Allahumma man ahyaitahu minna faahyihi ‘alal-Islam, wa man tawaffaytahu minna fa tawaffahu ‘alal- iman. Allahumma la tahrimna ajrahu wa la tudillana ba’dah. [O Allah, forgive our living and our dead, those who are present and those who are absent, our young and our old, our males and our females. O Allah, whomever of us You cause to live, let him live in Islam, and whomever of us You cause to die, let him die in (a state of) faith. O Allah, do not deprive us of his reward, and do not let us go astray after him].’”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا سُوَيْدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُسْهِرٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ إِذَا صَلَّى عَلَى جِنَازَةٍ يَقُولُ  " اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِحَيِّنَا وَمَيِّتِنَا وَشَاهِدِنَا وَغَائِبِنَا وَصَغِيرِنَا وَكَبِيرِنَا وَذَكَرِنَا وَأُنْثَانَا اللَّهُمَّ مَنْ أَحْيَيْتَهُ مِنَّا فَأَحْيِهِ عَلَى الإِسْلاَمِ وَمَنْ تَوَفَّيْتَهُ مِنَّا فَتَوَفَّهُ عَلَى الإِيمَانِ اللَّهُمَّ لاَ تَحْرِمْنَا أَجْرَهُ وَلاَ تُضِلَّنَا بَعْدَهُ " .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1498

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1499

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي الدُّعَاءِ فِي الصَّلاَةِ عَلَى الْجِنَازَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning supplication during the funeral prayer

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Wathilah bin Asqa’ said:
           “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ offered the funeral prayer for a man among the Muslims and I heard him say: ‘O Allah, so-and-so the son of so-and-so is in Your case and under Your protection. Protect him from the trial of the grave and the torment of the Fire, for You are the One Who keeps the promise and You are the Truth. Forgive him and have mercy on him, for You are the Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Wathilah bin Asqa’ said:
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ offered the funeral prayer for a man among the Muslims and I heard him say: ‘O Allah, so-and-so the son of so-and-so is in Your case and under Your protection. Protect him from the trial of the grave and the torment of the Fire, for You are the One Who keeps the promise and You are the Truth. Forgive him and have mercy on him, for You are the Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الدِّمَشْقِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مَرْوَانُ بْنُ جَنَاحٍ، حَدَّثَنِي يُونُسُ بْنُ مَيْسَرَةَ بْنِ حَلْبَسٍ، عَنْ وَاثِلَةَ بْنِ الأَسْقَعِ، قَالَ صَلَّى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَلَى رَجُلٍ مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ فَأَسْمَعُهُ يَقُولُ  " اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّ فُلاَنَ بْنَ فُلاَنٍ فِي ذِمَّتِكَ وَحَبْلِ جِوَارِكَ فَقِهِ مِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْقَبْرِ وَعَذَابِ النَّارِ وَأَنْتَ أَهْلُ الْوَفَاءِ وَالْحَقِّ فَاغْفِرْ لَهُ وَارْحَمْهُ إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ " .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1499

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1500

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي الدُّعَاءِ فِي الصَّلاَةِ عَلَى الْجِنَازَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning supplication during the funeral prayer

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that ‘Awf bin Malik said:
           “I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ offering the funeral prayer for a man among the Ansar, and I heard him say: ‘Allahumma salli ‘alayhi waghfirlahu warhamhu, wa ‘afihi wa’fu ‘anhu, waghsilhu bi ma’in wa thaljin wa baradin, wa naqqihi min adh-dhunubi wal-khataya kama yunaqqath-thawbul-abyadu minad-danas, wa abdilhu bi darihi daran khayran min darihi, wa ahlan khayran min ahlili, wa qihi fitnatal-qabri wa ‘adhaban-nar. (O Allah, send blessing upon him, forgive him, have mercy on him, keep him safe and sound, and pardon him; wash him with water and snow and hail, and cleanse him of sins just as a white garment is cleansed of dirt. Give him in exchange for his house that is better than his house, and a family that is better than his family. Protect him from the trial of the grave and the torment of the Fire).’”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that ‘Awf bin Malik said:
hadiths.body: “I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ offering the funeral prayer for a man among the Ansar, and I heard him say: ‘Allahumma salli ‘alayhi waghfirlahu warhamhu, wa ‘afihi wa’fu ‘anhu, waghsilhu bi ma’in wa thaljin wa baradin, wa naqqihi min adh-dhunubi wal-khataya kama yunaqqath-thawbul-abyadu minad-danas, wa abdilhu bi darihi daran khayran min darihi, wa ahlan khayran min ahlili, wa qihi fitnatal-qabri wa ‘adhaban-nar. (O Allah, send blessing upon him, forgive him, have mercy on him, keep him safe and sound, and pardon him; wash him with water and snow and hail, and cleanse him of sins just as a white garment is cleansed of dirt. Give him in exchange for his house that is better than his house, and a family that is better than his family. Protect him from the trial of the grave and the torment of the Fire).’”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَكِيمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ الطَّيَالِسِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا فَرَجُ بْنُ الْفَضَالَةِ، حَدَّثَنِي عِصْمَةُ بْنُ رَاشِدٍ، عَنْ حَبِيبِ بْنِ عُبَيْدٍ، عَنْ عَوْفِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ شَهِدْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ صَلَّى عَلَى رَجُلٍ مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ فَسَمِعْتُهُ يَقُولُ  " اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَيْهِ وَاغْفِرْ لَهُ وَارْحَمْهُ وَعَافِهِ وَاعْفُ عَنْهُ وَاغْسِلْهُ بِمَاءٍ وَثَلْجٍ وَبَرَدٍ وَنَقِّهِ مِنَ الذُّنُوبِ وَالْخَطَايَا كَمَا يُنَقَّى الثَّوْبُ الأَبْيَضُ مِنَ الدَّنَسِ وَأَبْدِلْهُ بِدَارِهِ دَارًا خَيْرًا مِنْ دَارِهِ وَأَهْلاً خَيْرًا مِنْ أَهْلِهِ وَقِهِ فِتْنَةَ الْقَبْرِ وَعَذَابَ النَّارِ " . قَالَ عَوْفٌ فَلَقَدْ رَأَيْتُنِي فِي مُقَامِي ذَلِكَ أَتَمَنَّى أَنْ أَكُونَ مَكَانَ ذَلِكَ الرَّجُلِ .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1500

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1501

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي الدُّعَاءِ فِي الصَّلاَةِ عَلَى الْجِنَازَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning supplication during the funeral prayer

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Jabir said:
           “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ, Abu Bakr and ‘Umar did not give us so much leeway in anything as they did with regard to the prayer for the deceased,” meaning that there was nothing affixed.
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Jabir said:
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ, Abu Bakr and ‘Umar did not give us so much leeway in anything as they did with regard to the prayer for the deceased,” meaning that there was nothing affixed.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصُ بْنُ غِيَاثٍ، عَنْ حَجَّاجٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ مَا أَبَاحَ لَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَلاَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ وَلاَ عُمَرُ فِي شَىْءٍ مَا أَبَاحُوا فِي الصَّلاَةِ عَلَى الْمَيِّتِ . يَعْنِي لَمْ يُوَقِّتْ .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1501

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1502

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي التَّكْبِيرِ عَلَى الْجِنَازَةِ أَرْبَعًا
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning saying four takbir in the funeral prayer

hadiths.englishRaw: It was narrated from ‘Uthman bin ‘Affan that the Prophet ﷺ offered the funeral prayer for ‘Uthman bin Maz’un, and he said four Takbir over him.
hadiths.body: It was narrated from ‘Uthman bin ‘Affan that the Prophet ﷺ offered the funeral prayer for ‘Uthman bin Maz’un, and he said four Takbir over him.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ كَاسِبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْمُغِيرَةُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ إِلْيَاسَ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْعَاصِ، عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ، عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ عَفَّانَ، . أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ صَلَّى عَلَى عُثْمَانَ بْنِ مَظْعُونٍ وَكَبَّرَ عَلَيْهِ أَرْبَعًا .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1502

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1503

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي التَّكْبِيرِ عَلَى الْجِنَازَةِ أَرْبَعًا
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning saying four takbir in the funeral prayer

hadiths.englishRaw:
Al-Hajari said:
           “I prayed with ‘Abdullah bin Abi Awfa Al-Aslami, the Companion of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, offering the funeral prayer for a daughter of his. He said Takbir over her four times, and he paused for a while after the fourth. I heard the people saying Subhan- Allah to him throughout the rows. Then he said the Salam and said: ‘Did you think that I was going to say a fifth Takbir?’ They said: ‘We were afraid of that.’ He said: ‘I was not going to do that, but the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to say four Takbir, then pause for a while, and he would say whatever Allah willed he should say, then he would say the Salam.’”
hadiths.narrator: Al-Hajari said:
hadiths.body: “I prayed with ‘Abdullah bin Abi Awfa Al-Aslami, the Companion of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, offering the funeral prayer for a daughter of his. He said Takbir over her four times, and he paused for a while after the fourth. I heard the people saying Subhan- Allah to him throughout the rows. Then he said the Salam and said: ‘Did you think that I was going to say a fifth Takbir?’ They said: ‘We were afraid of that.’ He said: ‘I was not going to do that, but the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to say four Takbir, then pause for a while, and he would say whatever Allah willed he should say, then he would say the Salam.’”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ الْمُحَارِبِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا الْهَجَرِيُّ، قَالَ صَلَيْتُ مَعَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي أَوْفَى الأَسْلَمِيِّ صَاحِبِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَلَى جِنَازَةِ ابْنَةٍ لَهُ فَكَبَّرَ عَلَيْهَا أَرْبَعًا فَمَكَثَ بَعْدَ الرَّابِعَةِ شَيْئًا . قَالَ فَسَمِعْتُ الْقَوْمَ يُسَبِّحُونَ بِهِ مِنْ نَوَاحِي الصُّفُوفِ فَسَلَّمَ ثُمَّ قَالَ أَكُنْتُمْ تُرَوْنَ أَنِّي مُكَبِّرٌ خَمْسًا قَالُوا تَخَوَّفْنَا ذَلِكَ . قَالَ لَمْ أَكُنْ لأَفْعَلَ . وَلَكِنْ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ كَانَ يُكَبِّرُ أَرْبَعًا ثُمَّ يَمْكُثُ سَاعَةً فَيَقُولُ مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ أَنْ يَقُولَ ثُمَّ يُسَلِّمُ .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1503

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1504

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي التَّكْبِيرِ عَلَى الْجِنَازَةِ أَرْبَعًا
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning saying four takbir in the funeral prayer

hadiths.englishRaw: It was narrated from Ibn ‘Abbas that the Prophet ﷺ said Takbir four times.
hadiths.body: It was narrated from Ibn ‘Abbas that the Prophet ﷺ said Takbir four times.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو هِشَامٍ الرِّفَاعِيُّ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الصَّبَّاحِ، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ خَلاَّدٍ قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ الْيَمَانِ، عَنِ الْمِنْهَالِ بْنِ خَلِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَجَّاجٍ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ كَبَّرَ أَرْبَعًا .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1504

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1505

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِيمَنْ كَبَّرَ خَمْسًا
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning one who says the takbir five times

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that ‘Abdur-Rahman bin Abi Laila said:
           “Zaid bin Arqan used to say the Takbir four times in the funeral prayer, and he said the Takbir five times for one funeral. I asked him (about that) and he said: ‘The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to do that.’”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that ‘Abdur-Rahman bin Abi Laila said:
hadiths.body: “Zaid bin Arqan used to say the Takbir four times in the funeral prayer, and he said the Takbir five times for one funeral. I asked him (about that) and he said: ‘The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to do that.’”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَكِيمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عَدِيٍّ، وَأَبُو دَاوُدَ عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مُرَّةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى، قَالَ كَانَ زَيْدُ بْنُ أَرْقَمَ يُكَبِّرُ عَلَى جَنَائِزِنَا أَرْبَعًا وَأَنَّهُ كَبَّرَ عَلَى جِنَازَةٍ خَمْسًا فَسَأَلْتُهُ فَقَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ يُكَبِّرُهَا .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1505

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1506

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِيمَنْ كَبَّرَ خَمْسًا
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning one who says the takbir five times

hadiths.englishRaw: It was narrated from Kathir bin ‘Abdullah, from his father, from his grandfather, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said the Takbir five times.
hadiths.body: It was narrated from Kathir bin ‘Abdullah, from his father, from his grandfather, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said the Takbir five times.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ الْمُنْذِرِ الْحِزَامِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ الرَّافِعِيُّ، عَنْ كَثِيرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ كَبَّرَ خَمْسًا .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1506

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1507

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي الصَّلاَةِ عَلَى الطِّفْلِ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning offering the funeral prayer for a child

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Jubair bin Hayyah narrated that he heard Mughirah bin Shu’bah say:
            “I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: ‘The (funeral) prayer should be offered for a child.’”
hadiths.narrator: Abu Jubair bin Hayyah narrated that he heard Mughirah bin Shu’bah say:
hadiths.body: “I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: ‘The (funeral) prayer should be offered for a child.’”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا رَوْحُ بْنُ عُبَادَةَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ جُبَيْرِ بْنِ حَيَّةَ، حَدَّثَنِي عَمِّي، زِيَادُ بْنُ جُبَيْرٍ حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي جُبَيْرُ بْنُ حَيَّةَ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ الْمُغِيرَةَ بْنَ شُعْبَةَ، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ  " الطِّفْلُ يُصَلَّى عَلَيْهِ " .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1507

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1508

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي الصَّلاَةِ عَلَى الطِّفْلِ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning offering the funeral prayer for a child

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Jabir bin ‘Abdullah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
           “If a child utters a sound (after being born), the funeral prayer should be offered for him and (his relatives) may inherit from him.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Jabir bin ‘Abdullah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “If a child utters a sound (after being born), the funeral prayer should be offered for him and (his relatives) may inherit from him.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الرَّبِيعُ بْنُ بَدْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " إِذَا اسْتَهَلَّ الصَّبِيُّ صُلِّيَ عَلَيْهِ وَوُرِثَ " .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1508

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1509

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي الصَّلاَةِ عَلَى الطِّفْلِ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning offering the funeral prayer for a child

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Abu Hurairah said:
           “The Prophet ﷺ said: ‘Offer the (funeral) prayer for your children, for they have gone ahead of you (i.e. to prepare your place in Paradise for you).”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Abu Hurairah said:
hadiths.body: “The Prophet ﷺ said: ‘Offer the (funeral) prayer for your children, for they have gone ahead of you (i.e. to prepare your place in Paradise for you).”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْبَخْتَرِيُّ بْنُ عُبَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ  " صَلُّوا عَلَى أَطْفَالِكُمْ فَإِنَّهُمْ مِنْ أَفْرَاطِكُمْ " .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1509

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1510

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي الصَّلاَةِ عَلَى ابْنِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَذِكْرِ وَفَاتِهِ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning the funeral prayer offered for the son of the Messenger of Allah (SAW) and the report of his death

hadiths.englishRaw:
Isma’il bin Abu Khalid said:
           “I said to ‘Abdullah bin Abi Awfa: ‘Did you see Ibrahim, the son of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ?’ He said: ‘He died when he was small, and if it had been decreed that there should be any Prophet after Muhammad ﷺ, his son would have lived. But there is no Prophet after him.’”
hadiths.narrator: Isma’il bin Abu Khalid said:
hadiths.body: “I said to ‘Abdullah bin Abi Awfa: ‘Did you see Ibrahim, the son of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ?’ He said: ‘He died when he was small, and if it had been decreed that there should be any Prophet after Muhammad ﷺ, his son would have lived. But there is no Prophet after him.’”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بِشْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ أَبِي خَالِدٍ، قَالَ قُلْتُ لِعَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي أَوْفَى رَأَيْتَ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ابْنَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ مَاتَ وَهُوَ صَغِيرٌ وَلَوْ قُضِيَ أَنْ يَكُونَ بَعْدَ مُحَمَّدٍ ﷺ نَبِيٌّ لَعَاشَ ابْنُهُ وَلَكِنْ لاَ نَبِيَّ بَعْدَهُ .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1510

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1511

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي الصَّلاَةِ عَلَى ابْنِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَذِكْرِ وَفَاتِهِ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning the funeral prayer offered for the son of the Messenger of Allah (SAW) and the report of his death

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Ibn ‘Abbas said:
           “Then Ibrahim the son of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ died, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ prayed and said: ‘He has a wet-nurse in Paradise, and if he had lived he would have been a Siddiq and a Prophet. If he had lived his maternal uncles, the Egyptians, would have been set free and no Egyptian would ever have been enslaved.’”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Ibn ‘Abbas said:
hadiths.body: “Then Ibrahim the son of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ died, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ prayed and said: ‘He has a wet-nurse in Paradise, and if he had lived he would have been a Siddiq and a Prophet. If he had lived his maternal uncles, the Egyptians, would have been set free and no Egyptian would ever have been enslaved.’”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْقُدُّوسِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا دَاوُدُ بْنُ شَبِيبٍ الْبَاهِلِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ عُثْمَانَ، حَدَّثَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ عُتَيْبَةَ، عَنْ مِقْسَمٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ لَمَّا مَاتَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ ابْنُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ صَلَّى عَلَيْهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَقَالَ  " إِنَّ لَهُ مُرْضِعًا فِي الْجَنَّةِ وَلَوْ عَاشَ لَكَانَ صِدِّيقًا نَبِيًّا . وَلَوْ عَاشَ لَعَتَقَتْ أَخْوَالُهُ الْقِبْطُ وَمَا اسْتُرِقَّ قِبْطِيٌّ " .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1511

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1512

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي الصَّلاَةِ عَلَى ابْنِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَذِكْرِ وَفَاتِهِ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning the funeral prayer offered for the son of the Messenger of Allah (SAW) and the report of his death

hadiths.englishRaw:
Husain bin ‘Ali said:
           “When Qasim the son of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ died, Khadijah said: ‘O Messenger of Allah, the milk of Qasim’s mother is overflowing. Would that Allah had let him live until he had finished breastfeeding.’ The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: ‘He will complete his breastfeeding in Paradise.’ She said: ‘If I know that, O Messenger of Allah, it makes it easier for me to bear.’ The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: ‘If you wish, I will pray to Allah to let you hear his voice.’ She said: ‘O Messenger of Allah, rather I believe Allah and His Messenger.’”
hadiths.narrator: Husain bin ‘Ali said:
hadiths.body: “When Qasim the son of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ died, Khadijah said: ‘O Messenger of Allah, the milk of Qasim’s mother is overflowing. Would that Allah had let him live until he had finished breastfeeding.’ The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: ‘He will complete his breastfeeding in Paradise.’ She said: ‘If I know that, O Messenger of Allah, it makes it easier for me to bear.’ The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: ‘If you wish, I will pray to Allah to let you hear his voice.’ She said: ‘O Messenger of Allah, rather I believe Allah and His Messenger.’”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عِمْرَانَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ أَبِي الْوَلِيدِ، عَنْ أُمِّهِ، عَنْ فَاطِمَةَ بِنْتِ الْحُسَيْنِ، عَنْ أَبِيهَا الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ، قَالَ لَمَّا تُوُفِّيَ الْقَاسِمُ ابْنُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَتْ خَدِيجَةُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ دَرَّتْ لُبَيْنَةُ الْقَاسِمِ فَلَوْ كَانَ اللَّهُ أَبْقَاهُ حَتَّى يَسْتَكْمِلَ رَضَاعَهُ . فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ " إِنَّ تَمَامَ رَضَاعِهِ فِي الْجَنَّةِ " . قَالَتْ لَوْ أَعْلَمُ ذَلِكَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ لَهَوَّنَ عَلَىَّ أَمْرَهُ . فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ " إِنْ شِئْتِ دَعَوْتُ اللَّهَ تَعَالَى فَأَسْمَعَكِ صَوْتَهُ " . قَالَتْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ بَلْ أُصَدِّقُ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1512

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1513

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي الصَّلاَةِ عَلَى الشُّهَدَاءِ وَدَفْنِهِمْ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning the funeral prayer for the martyrs and their burial

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Ibn ‘Abbas said:
           “They (the martyrs) were brought to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ on the Day of Uhud, and he started to offer the funeral prayer for them, ten by ten. Hamzah lay where he lay, and they were taken away but he was left where he was.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Ibn ‘Abbas said:
hadiths.body: “They (the martyrs) were brought to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ on the Day of Uhud, and he started to offer the funeral prayer for them, ten by ten. Hamzah lay where he lay, and they were taken away but he was left where he was.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ عَيَّاشٍ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي زِيَادٍ، عَنْ مِقْسَمٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ أُتِيَ بِهِمْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَوْمَ أُحُدٍ فَجَعَلَ يُصَلِّي عَلَى عَشَرَةٍ عَشَرَةٍ وَحَمْزَةُ هُوَ كَمَا هُوَ يُرْفَعُونَ وَهُوَ كَمَا هُوَ مَوْضُوعٌ .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1513

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1514

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي الصَّلاَةِ عَلَى الشُّهَدَاءِ وَدَفْنِهِمْ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning the funeral prayer for the martyrs and their burial

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Jabir bin ‘Abdullah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to put two or three of the slain of Uhud in one shroud. He would ask:
