           “Which of them had memorized more Qur’an?” And if one of them was pointed out to him, he would put him in the niche-grave first. And he said: “I am a witness over them.” He commanded that they should be buried with their blood, and that the funeral prayer should not be offered for them and they should not be washed.
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Jabir bin ‘Abdullah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to put two or three of the slain of Uhud in one shroud. He would ask:
hadiths.body: “Which of them had memorized more Qur’an?” And if one of them was pointed out to him, he would put him in the niche-grave first. And he said: “I am a witness over them.” He commanded that they should be buried with their blood, and that the funeral prayer should not be offered for them and they should not be washed.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رُمْحٍ، أَنْبَأَنَا اللَّيْثُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ كَعْبِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ كَانَ يَجْمَعُ بَيْنَ الرَّجُلَيْنِ وَالثَّلاَثَةِ مِنْ قَتْلَى أُحُدٍ فِي ثَوْبٍ وَاحِدٍ ثُمَّ يَقُولُ " أَيُّهُمْ أَكْثَرُ أَخْذًا لِلْقُرْآنِ " . فَإِذَا أُشِيرَ لَهُ إِلَى أَحَدِهِمْ قَدَّمَهُ فِي اللَّحْدِ وَقَالَ " أَنَا شَهِيدٌ عَلَى هَؤُلاَءِ " . وَأَمَرَ بِدَفْنِهِمْ فِي دِمَائِهِمْ وَلَمْ يُصَلِّ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَمْ يُغَسَّلُوا .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1514

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1515

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي الصَّلاَةِ عَلَى الشُّهَدَاءِ وَدَفْنِهِمْ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning the funeral prayer for the martyrs and their burial

hadiths.englishRaw: It was narrated from Ibn ‘Abbas that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ commanded that the weapons and armor should be removed from the slain of Uhud, and they should be buried in their clothes stained with blood.
hadiths.body: It was narrated from Ibn ‘Abbas that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ commanded that the weapons and armor should be removed from the slain of Uhud, and they should be buried in their clothes stained with blood.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ زِيَادٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَاصِمٍ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ السَّائِبِ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَمَرَ بِقَتْلَى أُحُدٍ أَنْ يُنْزَعَ عَنْهُمُ الْحَدِيدُ وَالْجُلُودُ وَأَنْ يُدْفَنُوا فِي ثِيَابِهِمْ بِدِمَائِهِمْ .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1515

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1516

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي الصَّلاَةِ عَلَى الشُّهَدَاءِ وَدَفْنِهِمْ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning the funeral prayer for the martyrs and their burial

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Aswad bin Qais that he heard Nubaih Al-‘Anazi say:
           “I heard Jabir bin ‘Abdullah say: ‘The Messenger of Allah ﷺ commanded that the slain of the battle of Uhud should be returned to the battlefield; they had been moved to Al-Madinah.’”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Aswad bin Qais that he heard Nubaih Al-‘Anazi say:
hadiths.body: “I heard Jabir bin ‘Abdullah say: ‘The Messenger of Allah ﷺ commanded that the slain of the battle of Uhud should be returned to the battlefield; they had been moved to Al-Madinah.’”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، وَسَهْلُ بْنُ أَبِي سَهْلٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ الأَسْوَدِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ، سَمِعَ نُبَيْحًا الْعَنَزِيَّ، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، يَقُولُ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَمَرَ بِقَتْلَى أُحُدٍ أَنْ يُرَدُّوا إِلَى مَصَارِعِهِمْ وَكَانُوا نُقِلُوا إِلَى الْمَدِينَةِ .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1516

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1517

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي الصَّلاَةِ عَلَى الْجَنَائِزِ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning offering the funeral prayer in the mosque

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Abu Hurairah said:
           “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: ‘Whoever offers the funeral prayer in the mosque will have nothing (i.e., no reward).’”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Abu Hurairah said:
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: ‘Whoever offers the funeral prayer in the mosque will have nothing (i.e., no reward).’”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ، عَنْ صَالِحٍ، مَوْلَى التَّوْأَمَةِ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " مَنْ صَلَّى عَلَى جِنَازَةٍ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ فَلَيْسَ لَهُ شَىْءٌ " .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1517

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1518

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي الصَّلاَةِ عَلَى الْجَنَائِزِ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning offering the funeral prayer in the mosque

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that ‘Aishah said:
           “By Allah! The Messenger of Allah ﷺ did not offer the funeral prayer for Suhail bin Baida’ anywhere but in the mosque.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that ‘Aishah said:
hadiths.body: “By Allah! The Messenger of Allah ﷺ did not offer the funeral prayer for Suhail bin Baida’ anywhere but in the mosque.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا فُلَيْحُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ صَالِحِ بْنِ عَجْلاَنَ، عَنْ عَبَّادِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ وَاللَّهِ مَا صَلَّى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَلَى سُهَيْلِ ابْنِ بَيْضَاءَ إِلاَّ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ . قَالَ ابْنُ مَاجَهْ حَدِيثُ عَائِشَةَ أَقْوَى .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1518

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1519

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي الأَوْقَاتِ الَّتِي لاَ يُصَلَّى فِيهَا عَلَى الْمَيِّتِ وَلاَ يُدْفَنُ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning the times when the funeral prayer should not be offered and the deceased should not be buried

hadiths.englishRaw:
‘Uqbah bin ‘Amir Al-Juhani said:
           “There are three times during the day when the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade us to offer the funeral prayer or bury our dead: When the sun has fully risen (until it is higher up in the sky); when it is overhead at noon, until it has passed the meridian: and when it is starting to set until it has set.”
hadiths.narrator: ‘Uqbah bin ‘Amir Al-Juhani said:
hadiths.body: “There are three times during the day when the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade us to offer the funeral prayer or bury our dead: When the sun has fully risen (until it is higher up in the sky); when it is overhead at noon, until it has passed the meridian: and when it is starting to set until it has set.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ عُلَىِّ بْنِ رَبَاحٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبِي يَقُولُ، سَمِعْتُ عُقْبَةَ بْنَ عَامِرٍ الْجُهَنِيَّ، يَقُولُ ثَلاَثُ سَاعَاتٍ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَنْهَانَا أَنْ نُصَلِّيَ فِيهِنَّ أَوْ نَقْبِرَ فِيهِنَّ مَوْتَانَا حِينَ تَطْلُعُ الشَّمْسُ بَازِغَةً وَحِينَ يَقُومُ قَائِمُ الظَّهِيرَةِ حَتَّى تَمِيلَ الشَّمْسُ وَحِينَ تَضَيَّفُ لِلْغُرُوبِ حَتَّى تَغْرُبَ .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1519

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1520

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي الأَوْقَاتِ الَّتِي لاَ يُصَلَّى فِيهَا عَلَى الْمَيِّتِ وَلاَ يُدْفَنُ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning the times when the funeral prayer should not be offered and the deceased should not be buried

hadiths.englishRaw: It was narrated from Ibn ‘Abbas that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ placed a man in his grave at night, and he lit a lamp in his grave.
hadiths.body: It was narrated from Ibn ‘Abbas that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ placed a man in his grave at night, and he lit a lamp in his grave.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الصَّبَّاحِ، أَنْبَأَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ الْيَمَانِ، عَنْ مِنْهَالِ بْنِ خَلِيفَةَ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَدْخَلَ رَجُلاً قَبْرَهُ لَيْلاً وَأَسْرَجَ فِي قَبْرِهِ .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1520

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1521

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي الأَوْقَاتِ الَّتِي لاَ يُصَلَّى فِيهَا عَلَى الْمَيِّتِ وَلاَ يُدْفَنُ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning the times when the funeral prayer should not be offered and the deceased should not be buried

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Jabir bin ‘Abdullah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
           “Do not bury your dead at night unless you are forced to.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Jabir bin ‘Abdullah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “Do not bury your dead at night unless you are forced to.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الأَوْدِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ الْمَكِّيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " لاَ تَدْفِنُوا مَوْتَاكُمْ بِاللَّيْلِ إِلاَّ أَنْ تُضْطَرُّوا " .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1521

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1522

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي الأَوْقَاتِ الَّتِي لاَ يُصَلَّى فِيهَا عَلَى الْمَيِّتِ وَلاَ يُدْفَنُ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning the times when the funeral prayer should not be offered and the deceased should not be buried

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Jabir bin ‘Abdullah that the Prophet ﷺ said:
            “Offer the funeral prayer for your dead by night or by day.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Jabir bin ‘Abdullah that the Prophet ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “Offer the funeral prayer for your dead by night or by day.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا الْعَبَّاسُ بْنُ عُثْمَانَ الدِّمَشْقِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ لَهِيعَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ قَالَ  " صَلُّوا عَلَى مَوْتَاكُمْ بِاللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ " .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1522

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1523

chapter.arabicTitle: باب فِي الصَّلاَةِ عَلَى أَهْلِ الْقِبْلَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: Prayer for the people of the Qiblah

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Ibn ‘Umar said:
           “When ‘Abdullah bin Ubayy died, his son came to the Prophet ﷺ and said: ‘O Messenger of Allah, give me your shirt so that I may shroud him in it.’ The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: ‘Notify me when he is ready (i.e., when he has been washed and shrouded).’ When the Prophet ﷺ wanted to offer the funeral prayer for him: ‘You should not do that.’ The Prophet (aw) offered the funeral prayer for him, and the Prophet ﷺ said to him: ‘I have been given two choices: “...ask forgiveness for them (hypocrites) or ask not forgiveness for them...’” [9:80] Then Allah revealed: ‘And never pray (the funeral prayer) for any of them (hypocrites) who dies, nor stand at his grave.’” [9:84]
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Ibn ‘Umar said:
hadiths.body: “When ‘Abdullah bin Ubayy died, his son came to the Prophet ﷺ and said: ‘O Messenger of Allah, give me your shirt so that I may shroud him in it.’ The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: ‘Notify me when he is ready (i.e., when he has been washed and shrouded).’ When the Prophet ﷺ wanted to offer the funeral prayer for him: ‘You should not do that.’ The Prophet (aw) offered the funeral prayer for him, and the Prophet ﷺ said to him: ‘I have been given two choices: “...ask forgiveness for them (hypocrites) or ask not forgiveness for them...’” [9:80] Then Allah revealed: ‘And never pray (the funeral prayer) for any of them (hypocrites) who dies, nor stand at his grave.’” [9:84]
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بِشْرٍ، بَكْرُ بْنُ خَلَفٍ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ لَمَّا تُوُفِّيَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أُبَىٍّ جَاءَ ابْنُهُ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ ﷺ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَعْطِنِي قَمِيصَكَ أُكَفِّنْهُ فِيهِ . فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ " آذِنُونِي بِهِ " . فَلَمَّا أَرَادَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ أَنْ يُصَلِّيَ عَلَيْهِ قَالَ لَهُ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ مَا ذَاكَ لَكَ . فَصَلَّى عَلَيْهِ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ فَقَالَ لَهُ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ " أَنَا بَيْنَ خِيرَتَيْنِ {اسْتَغْفِرْ لَهُمْ أَوْ لاَ تَسْتَغْفِرْ لَهُمْ } " . فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ سُبْحَانَهُ {وَلاَ تُصَلِّ عَلَى أَحَدٍ مِنْهُمْ مَاتَ أَبَدًا وَلاَ تَقُمْ عَلَى قَبْرِهِ} .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1523

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1524

chapter.arabicTitle: باب فِي الصَّلاَةِ عَلَى أَهْلِ الْقِبْلَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: Prayer for the people of the Qiblah

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Jabir said:
           “The leader of the hypocrites in Al- Madinah died, and left instructions that the Prophet ﷺ should offer the funeral prayer for him and shroud him in his shirt. He offered the funeral prayer for him and shrouded him in his shirt, and stood by his grave. Then Allah revealed the words: ‘And never pray (the funeral prayer) for any of them (hypocrites) who dies, nor stand at his grave.” [9:84]
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Jabir said:
hadiths.body: “The leader of the hypocrites in Al- Madinah died, and left instructions that the Prophet ﷺ should offer the funeral prayer for him and shroud him in his shirt. He offered the funeral prayer for him and shrouded him in his shirt, and stood by his grave. Then Allah revealed the words: ‘And never pray (the funeral prayer) for any of them (hypocrites) who dies, nor stand at his grave.” [9:84]
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَمَّارُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ الْوَاسِطِيُّ، وَسَهْلُ بْنُ أَبِي سَهْلٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ مُجَالِدٍ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ مَاتَ رَأْسُ الْمُنَافِقِينَ بِالْمَدِينَةِ وَأَوْصَى أَنْ يُصَلِّيَ عَلَيْهِ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ وَأَنْ يُكَفِّنَهُ فِي قَمِيصِهِ فَصَلَّى عَلَيْهِ وَكَفَّنَهُ فِي قَمِيصِهِ وَقَامَ عَلَى قَبْرِهِ فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ {وَلاَ تُصَلِّ عَلَى أَحَدٍ مِنْهُمْ مَاتَ أَبَدًا وَلاَ تَقُمْ عَلَى قَبْرِهِ} .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1524

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1525

chapter.arabicTitle: باب فِي الصَّلاَةِ عَلَى أَهْلِ الْقِبْلَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: Prayer for the people of the Qiblah

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Wathilah bin Asqa’ that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
           ‘Offer prayer for everyone who dies, and strive in Jihad under every chief.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Wathilah bin Asqa’ that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: ‘Offer prayer for everyone who dies, and strive in Jihad under every chief.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ السُّلَمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا مُسْلِمُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَدَّثَنَا الْحَارِثُ بْنُ نَبْهَانَ، حَدَّثَنَا عُتْبَةُ بْنُ يَقْظَانَ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ مَكْحُولٍ، عَنْ وَاثِلَةَ بْنِ الأَسْقَعِ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " صَلُّوا عَلَى كُلِّ مَيِّتٍ وَجَاهِدُوا مَعَ كُلِّ أَمِيرٍ " .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1525

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1526

chapter.arabicTitle: باب فِي الصَّلاَةِ عَلَى أَهْلِ الْقِبْلَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: Prayer for the people of the Qiblah

hadiths.englishRaw: It was narrated from Jabir bin Samurah that a man from among the Companions of the Prophet ﷺ was wounded, and the wound caused him a great deal of pain. He went and took a spearhead, and slaughtered himself with it. The Prophet ﷺ did not offer the funeral prayer for him, and that was as an admonition for others.
hadiths.body: It was narrated from Jabir bin Samurah that a man from among the Companions of the Prophet ﷺ was wounded, and the wound caused him a great deal of pain. He went and took a spearhead, and slaughtered himself with it. The Prophet ﷺ did not offer the funeral prayer for him, and that was as an admonition for others.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَامِرِ بْنِ زُرَارَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ سِمَاكِ بْنِ حَرْبٍ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ سَمُرَةَ، أَنَّ رَجُلاً، مِنْ أَصْحَابِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ جُرِحَ فَآذَتْهُ الْجِرَاحَةُ فَدَبَّ إِلَى مَشَاقِصِهِ فَذَبَحَ بِهِ نَفْسَهُ فَلَمْ يُصَلِّ عَلَيْهِ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ . قَالَ وَكَانَ ذَلِكَ أَدَبًا مِنْهُ .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1526

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1527

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي الصَّلاَةِ عَلَى الْقَبْرِ
chapter.englishTitle: Offering the funeral prayer at the grave

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that a black woman used to sweep the mosque. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ noticed she was missing and he asked about her after a few days. He was told that she had died. He said:
           “Why did you not tell me?” Then he went to her grave and offered the funeral prayer for her.
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that a black woman used to sweep the mosque. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ noticed she was missing and he asked about her after a few days. He was told that she had died. He said:
hadiths.body: “Why did you not tell me?” Then he went to her grave and offered the funeral prayer for her.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدَةَ، أَنْبَأَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ثَابِتٌ، عَنْ أَبِي رَافِعٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، . أَنَّ امْرَأَةً، سَوْدَاءَ كَانَتْ تَقُمُّ الْمَسْجِدَ فَفَقَدَهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَسَأَلَ عَنْهَا بَعْدَ أَيَّامٍ فَقِيلَ لَهُ إِنَّهَا مَاتَتْ . قَالَ  " فَهَلاَّ آذَنْتُمُونِي " . فَأَتَى قَبْرَهَا فَصَلَّى عَلَيْهَا .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1527

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1528

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي الصَّلاَةِ عَلَى الْقَبْرِ
chapter.englishTitle: Offering the funeral prayer at the grave

hadiths.englishRaw:
Kharijah bin Zaid bin Thabit narrated that Yazid bin Thabit, who was older than Zaid, said:
           “We went out with the Prophet ﷺ and when we reached Al-Baqi’, we saw a new grave. He asked about it and they said: ‘(It is) so-and-so (a woman).’ He recognized the name and said: ‘Why did you not tell me about her?’ They said: ‘You were taking a nap and you were fasting, and we did not like to disturb you.’ He said: ‘Do not do that; I do not want to see it happen again that one of you dies, while I am still among you, and you do not tell me, for my prayer for him is a mercy.’ Then he went to the grave and we lined up in rows behind him, and he said four Takbir (i.e. for the funeral prayer).”
hadiths.narrator: Kharijah bin Zaid bin Thabit narrated that Yazid bin Thabit, who was older than Zaid, said:
hadiths.body: “We went out with the Prophet ﷺ and when we reached Al-Baqi’, we saw a new grave. He asked about it and they said: ‘(It is) so-and-so (a woman).’ He recognized the name and said: ‘Why did you not tell me about her?’ They said: ‘You were taking a nap and you were fasting, and we did not like to disturb you.’ He said: ‘Do not do that; I do not want to see it happen again that one of you dies, while I am still among you, and you do not tell me, for my prayer for him is a mercy.’ Then he went to the grave and we lined up in rows behind him, and he said four Takbir (i.e. for the funeral prayer).”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ حَكِيمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا خَارِجَةُ بْنُ زَيْدِ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ، وَكَانَ، أَكْبَرَ مِنْ زَيْدٍ قَالَ خَرَجْنَا مَعَ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ فَلَمَّا وَرَدَ الْبَقِيعَ فَإِذَا هُوَ بِقَبْرٍ جَدِيدٍ فَسَأَلَ عَنْهُ فَقَالُوا فُلاَنَةُ . قَالَ فَعَرَفَهَا وَقَالَ " أَلاَ آذَنْتُمُونِي بِهَا " . قَالُوا كُنْتَ قَائِلاً صَائِمًا فَكَرِهْنَا أَنْ نُؤْذِيَكَ . قَالَ " فَلاَ تَفْعَلُوا لاَ أَعْرِفَنَّ مَا مَاتَ فِيكُمْ مَيِّتٌ مَا كُنْتُ بَيْنَ أَظْهُرِكُمْ إِلاَّ آذَنْتُمُونِي بِهِ فَإِنَّ صَلاَتِي عَلَيْهِ لَهُ رَحْمَةٌ " . ثُمَّ أَتَى الْقَبْرَ فَصَفَّنَا خَلْفَهُ فَكَبَّرَ عَلَيْهِ أَرْبَعًا .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1528

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1529

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي الصَّلاَةِ عَلَى الْقَبْرِ
chapter.englishTitle: Offering the funeral prayer at the grave

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from ‘Abdullah bin ‘Amir bin Rabi’ah, from his father, that a black woman died and the Prophet ﷺ was not told about that. Then he was informed of it, and he said:
           “Why did you not tell me?” Then he said to his Companions: “Line up in rows to pray for her,” and he offered the funeral prayer for her.
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from ‘Abdullah bin ‘Amir bin Rabi’ah, from his father, that a black woman died and the Prophet ﷺ was not told about that. Then he was informed of it, and he said:
hadiths.body: “Why did you not tell me?” Then he said to his Companions: “Line up in rows to pray for her,” and he offered the funeral prayer for her.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ كَاسِبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ الدَّرَاوَرْدِيُّ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ زَيْدِ بْنِ الْمُهَاجِرِ بْنِ قُنْفُذٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَامِرِ بْنِ رَبِيعَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ امْرَأَةً، سَوْدَاءَ مَاتَتْ لَمْ يُؤْذَنْ بِهَا النَّبِيُّ ﷺ فَأُخْبِرَ بِذَلِكَ فَقَالَ " هَلاَّ آذَنْتُمُونِي بِهَا " . ثُمَّ قَالَ لأَصْحَابِهِ " صُفُّوا عَلَيْهَا " . فَصَلَّى عَلَيْهَا .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1529

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1530

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي الصَّلاَةِ عَلَى الْقَبْرِ
chapter.englishTitle: Offering the funeral prayer at the grave

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Ibn ‘Abbas said:
           “A man died whom the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to visit, and they buried him at night. When morning came, they told him. He said: ‘What kept you from telling me?’ They said: ‘It was night and it was dark, and we did not like to cause you any inconvenience.’ Then he went to the grave and offered the funeral prayer for him.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Ibn ‘Abbas said:
hadiths.body: “A man died whom the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to visit, and they buried him at night. When morning came, they told him. He said: ‘What kept you from telling me?’ They said: ‘It was night and it was dark, and we did not like to cause you any inconvenience.’ Then he went to the grave and offered the funeral prayer for him.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ الشَّيْبَانِيِّ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ مَاتَ رَجُلٌ وَكَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَعُودُهُ فَدَفَنُوهُ بِاللَّيْلِ فَلَمَّا أَصْبَحَ أَعْلَمُوهُ فَقَالَ  " مَا مَنَعَكُمْ أَنْ تُعْلِمُونِي " . قَالُوا كَانَ اللَّيْلُ وَكَانَتِ الظُّلْمَةُ فَكَرِهْنَا أَنْ نَشُقَّ عَلَيْكَ . فَأَتَى قَبْرَهُ فَصَلَّى عَلَيْهِ .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1530

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1531

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي الصَّلاَةِ عَلَى الْقَبْرِ
chapter.englishTitle: Offering the funeral prayer at the grave

hadiths.englishRaw: It was narrated from Anas that the Prophet ﷺ offered the funeral prayer at a grave after the burial.
hadiths.body: It was narrated from Anas that the Prophet ﷺ offered the funeral prayer at a grave after the burial.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا الْعَبَّاسُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْعَظِيمِ الْعَنْبَرِيُّ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ حَنْبَلٍ، حَدَّثَنَا غُنْدَرٌ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ حَبِيبِ بْنِ الشَّهِيدِ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ صَلَّى عَلَى قَبْرٍ بَعْدَ مَا قُبِرَ .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1531

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1532

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي الصَّلاَةِ عَلَى الْقَبْرِ
chapter.englishTitle: Offering the funeral prayer at the grave

hadiths.englishRaw: It was narrated from Ibn Buraidah from his father that the Prophet ﷺ offered the funeral prayer for a deceased person after he had been buried.
hadiths.body: It was narrated from Ibn Buraidah from his father that the Prophet ﷺ offered the funeral prayer for a deceased person after he had been buried.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مِهْرَانُ بْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، عَنْ أَبِي سِنَانٍ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ بْنِ مَرْثَدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ بُرَيْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ صَلَّى عَلَى مَيِّتٍ بَعْدَ مَا دُفِنَ .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1532

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1533

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي الصَّلاَةِ عَلَى الْقَبْرِ
chapter.englishTitle: Offering the funeral prayer at the grave

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Abu Sa’eed said:
           “There was a black woman who used to sweep the mosque, and she passed away at night. The following morning the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was told of her death. He said: ‘Why did you not call me?’ Then he went out with his Companions and stood at her grave, and said Takbir over her, with the people behind him, and he supplicated for her, then he went away.’”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Abu Sa’eed said:
hadiths.body: “There was a black woman who used to sweep the mosque, and she passed away at night. The following morning the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was told of her death. He said: ‘Why did you not call me?’ Then he went out with his Companions and stood at her grave, and said Takbir over her, with the people behind him, and he supplicated for her, then he went away.’”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ شُرَحْبِيلَ، عَنِ ابْنِ لَهِيعَةَ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ، عَنْ أَبِي الْهَيْثَمِ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، قَالَ كَانَتْ سَوْدَاءُ تَقُمُّ الْمَسْجِدَ فَتُوُفِّيَتْ لَيْلاً فَلَمَّا أَصْبَحَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ أُخْبِرَ بِمَوْتِهَا فَقَالَ  " أَلاَ آذَنْتُمُونِي بِهَا " . فَخَرَجَ بِأَصْحَابِهِ فَوَقَفَ عَلَى قَبْرِهَا فَكَبَّرَ عَلَيْهَا وَالنَّاسُ مِنْ خَلْفِهِ وَدَعَا لَهَا ثُمَّ انْصَرَفَ .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1533

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1534

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي الصَّلاَةِ عَلَى النَّجَاشِيِّ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning the prayers for Najashi

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Hurairah:
           “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: ‘Najashi has died.’ The Messenger of Allah ﷺ and his Companions went out to Al-Baqi’, and we lined up in rows behind him, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ went forward, then he said four Takbir.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah:
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: ‘Najashi has died.’ The Messenger of Allah ﷺ and his Companions went out to Al-Baqi’, and we lined up in rows behind him, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ went forward, then he said four Takbir.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الأَعْلَى، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ  " إِنَّ النَّجَاشِيَّ قَدْ مَاتَ " . فَخَرَجَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَأَصْحَابُهُ إِلَى الْبَقِيعِ . فَصَفَّنَا خَلْفَهُ وَتَقَدَّمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَكَبَّرَ أَرْبَعَ تَكْبِيرَاتٍ .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1534

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1535

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي الصَّلاَةِ عَلَى النَّجَاشِيِّ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning the prayers for Najashi

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from ‘Imran bin Husain:
           “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: ‘Your brother Najashi has died, so offer the funeral prayer for him.” Then he stood and we prayed behind him. I was in the second row and two rows prayed for him.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from ‘Imran bin Husain:
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: ‘Your brother Najashi has died, so offer the funeral prayer for him.” Then he stood and we prayed behind him. I was in the second row and two rows prayed for him.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ خَلَفٍ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ زِيَادٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ الْمُفَضَّلِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ يُونُسَ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلاَبَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي الْمُهَلَّبِ، عَنْ عِمْرَانَ بْنِ الْحُصَيْنِ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ  " إِنَّ أَخَاكُمُ النَّجَاشِيَّ قَدْ مَاتَ فَصَلُّوا عَلَيْهِ " . قَالَ فَقَامَ فَصَلَّيْنَا خَلْفَهُ وَإِنِّي لَفِي الصَّفِّ الثَّانِي فَصَلَّى عَلَيْهِ .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1535

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1536

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي الصَّلاَةِ عَلَى النَّجَاشِيِّ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning the prayers for Najashi

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Mujammi’ bin Jariyah Al-Ansari that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
           “Your brother Najashi has died, so stand and pray for him.” So we formed two rows behind him.
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Mujammi’ bin Jariyah Al-Ansari that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “Your brother Najashi has died, so stand and pray for him.” So we formed two rows behind him.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاوِيَةُ بْنُ هِشَامٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ حُمْرَانَ بْنِ أَعْيَنَ، عَنْ أَبِي الطُّفَيْلِ، عَنْ مُجَمِّعِ بْنِ جَارِيَةَ الأَنْصَارِيِّ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ  " إِنَّ أَخَاكُمُ النَّجَاشِيَّ قَدْ مَاتَ فَقُومُوا فَصَلُّوا عَلَيْهِ " . فَصَفَّنَا خَلْفَهُ صَفَّيْنِ .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1536

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1537

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي الصَّلاَةِ عَلَى النَّجَاشِيِّ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning the prayers for Najashi

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Hudhaifah bin Asid that the Prophet ﷺ led them out and said:
           “Pray for a brother of yours who has died in a land other than yours.” They said: “Who is he?” He said: “Najashi.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Hudhaifah bin Asid that the Prophet ﷺ led them out and said:
hadiths.body: “Pray for a brother of yours who has died in a land other than yours.” They said: “Who is he?” He said: “Najashi.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ، عَنِ الْمُثَنَّى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي الطُّفَيْلِ، عَنْ حُذَيْفَةَ بْنِ أَسِيدٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ خَرَجَ بِهِمْ فَقَالَ " صَلُّوا عَلَى أَخٍ لَكُمْ مَاتَ بِغَيْرِ أَرْضِكُمْ " . قَالُوا مَنْ هُوَ قَالَ " النَّجَاشِيُّ " .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1537

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1538

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي الصَّلاَةِ عَلَى النَّجَاشِيِّ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning the prayers for Najashi

hadiths.englishRaw: It was narrated from Ibn ‘Umar that the Prophet ﷺ offered the funeral prayer for Najashi and said four Takbir.
hadiths.body: It was narrated from Ibn ‘Umar that the Prophet ﷺ offered the funeral prayer for Najashi and said four Takbir.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا سَهْلُ بْنُ أَبِي سَهْلٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مَكِّيُّ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ أَبُو السَّكَنِ، عَنْ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ صَلَّى عَلَى النَّجَاشِيِّ فَكَبَّرَ أَرْبَعًا .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1538

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1539

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي ثَوَابِ مَنْ صَلَّى عَلَى جِنَازَةٍ وَمَنِ انْتَظَرَ دَفْنَهَا
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning the reward for the one who offers the funeral prayer and the one who waits until the burial

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Prophet ﷺ said:
            “Whoever offers the funeral prayer will have one Qirat and whoever awaits until (the burial) is finished will have two Qirat.” They said: ‘What are these two Qirat?’ He said: ‘Like two mountains.’”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Prophet ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “Whoever offers the funeral prayer will have one Qirat and whoever awaits until (the burial) is finished will have two Qirat.” They said: ‘What are these two Qirat?’ He said: ‘Like two mountains.’”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الأَعْلَى، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ " مَنْ صَلَّى عَلَى جِنَازَةٍ فَلَهُ قِيرَاطٌ وَمَنِ انْتَظَرَ حَتَّى يُفْرَغَ مِنْهَا فَلَهُ قِيرَاطَانِ " . قَالُوا وَمَا الْقِيرَاطَانِ قَالَ " مِثْلُ الْجَبَلَيْنِ " .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1539

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1540

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي ثَوَابِ مَنْ صَلَّى عَلَى جِنَازَةٍ وَمَنِ انْتَظَرَ دَفْنَهَا
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning the reward for the one who offers the funeral prayer and the one who waits until the burial

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Thawban that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            “Whoever offers the funeral prayer will have one Qirat and whoever attends the burial will have two Qirat.” The Prophet ﷺ was asked about the Qirat and he said: “(It is) like Uhud.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Thawban that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “Whoever offers the funeral prayer will have one Qirat and whoever attends the burial will have two Qirat.” The Prophet ﷺ was asked about the Qirat and he said: “(It is) like Uhud.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا حُمَيْدُ بْنُ مَسْعَدَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ الْحَارِثِ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدٌ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، حَدَّثَنِي سَالِمُ بْنُ أَبِي الْجَعْدِ، عَنْ مَعْدَانَ بْنِ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ، عَنْ ثَوْبَانَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ " مَنْ صَلَّى عَلَى جِنَازَةٍ فَلَهُ قِيرَاطٌ وَمَنْ شَهِدَ دَفْنَهَا فَلَهُ قِيرَاطَانِ " . قَالَ فَسُئِلَ نَبِيُّ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَنِ الْقِيرَاطِ فَقَالَ " مِثْلُ أُحُدٍ " .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1540

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1541

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي ثَوَابِ مَنْ صَلَّى عَلَى جِنَازَةٍ وَمَنِ انْتَظَرَ دَفْنَهَا
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning the reward for the one who offers the funeral prayer and the one who waits until the burial

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Ubayy bin Ka’b that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
           ‘Whoever offers the funeral prayer will have one Qirat; and whoever attends until the burial is over, will have two Qirat. By the One in Whose Hand is the soul of Muhammad! The Qirat is greater than this (mountain of) Uhud.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Ubayy bin Ka’b that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: ‘Whoever offers the funeral prayer will have one Qirat; and whoever attends until the burial is over, will have two Qirat. By the One in Whose Hand is the soul of Muhammad! The Qirat is greater than this (mountain of) Uhud.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ الْمُحَارِبِيُّ، عَنْ حَجَّاجِ بْنِ أَرْطَاةَ، عَنْ عَدِيِّ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ زِرِّ بْنِ حُبَيْشٍ، عَنْ أُبَىِّ بْنِ كَعْبٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " مَنْ صَلَّى عَلَى جِنَازَةٍ فَلَهُ قِيرَاطٌ وَمَنْ شَهِدَهَا حَتَّى تُدْفَنَ فَلَهُ قِيرَاطَانِ وَالَّذِي نَفْسُ مُحَمَّدٍ بِيَدِهِ الْقِيرَاطُ أَعْظَمُ مِنْ أُحُدٍ هَذَا " .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1541

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1542

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي الْقِيَامِ لِلْجِنَازَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning standing up for the funeral (procession)

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from ‘Amir bin Rabi’ah that the Prophet ﷺ said:
            “When you see a funeral (procession) stand up for it until it has passed by or it is placed on the ground.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from ‘Amir bin Rabi’ah that the Prophet ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “When you see a funeral (procession) stand up for it until it has passed by or it is placed on the ground.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رُمْحٍ، أَنْبَأَنَا اللَّيْثُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنْ عَامِرِ بْنِ رَبِيعَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ ح وَحَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَامِرِ بْنِ رَبِيعَةَ، سَمِعَهُ يُحَدِّثُ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ  " إِذَا رَأَيْتُمُ الْجِنَازَةَ فَقُومُوا لَهَا حَتَّى تُخَلِّفَكُمْ أَوْ تُوضَعَ " .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1542

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1543

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي الْقِيَامِ لِلْجِنَازَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning standing up for the funeral (procession)

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Abu Hurairah said:
           “A funeral has passed by the Prophet ﷺ and he stood up and said: ‘Stand up out of recognition of the enormity of death.’”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Abu Hurairah said:
hadiths.body: “A funeral has passed by the Prophet ﷺ and he stood up and said: ‘Stand up out of recognition of the enormity of death.’”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَهَنَّادُ بْنُ السَّرِيِّ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَةُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ مُرَّ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ ﷺ بِجِنَازَةٍ فَقَامَ وَقَالَ  " قُومُوا فَإِنَّ لِلْمَوْتِ فَزَعًا " .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1543

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1544

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي الْقِيَامِ لِلْجِنَازَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning standing up for the funeral (procession)

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that ‘Ali bin Abu Talib said:
           “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ stood up for a funeral, and we stood up, until he sat down, then we sat down.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that ‘Ali bin Abu Talib said:
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ stood up for a funeral, and we stood up, until he sat down, then we sat down.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْمُنْكَدِرِ، عَنْ مَسْعُودِ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ، قَالَ قَامَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ لِجِنَازَةٍ فَقُمْنَا حَتَّى جَلَسَ فَجَلَسْنَا .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1544

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1545

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي الْقِيَامِ لِلْجِنَازَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning standing up for the funeral (procession)

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that ‘Ubadah bin Samit said:
           “When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ followed a funeral, he would not sit down until it had been placed in the niche-grave. A rabbi came to him and said: ‘This is what we do, O Muhammad!’ So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ sat down and said: ‘Be different from them.’”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that ‘Ubadah bin Samit said:
hadiths.body: “When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ followed a funeral, he would not sit down until it had been placed in the niche-grave. A rabbi came to him and said: ‘This is what we do, O Muhammad!’ So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ sat down and said: ‘Be different from them.’”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، وَعُقْبَةُ بْنُ مُكْرَمٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا صَفْوَانُ بْنُ عِيسَى، حَدَّثَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ جُنَادَةَ بْنِ أَبِي أُمَيَّةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ، عَنْ عُبَادَةَ بْنِ الصَّامِتِ، قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ إِذَا اتَّبَعَ جِنَازَةً لَمْ يَقْعُدْ حَتَّى تُوضَعَ فِي اللَّحْدِ فَعَرَضَ لَهُ حَبْرٌ فَقَالَ هَكَذَا نَصْنَعُ يَا مُحَمَّدُ . فَجَلَسَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَقَالَ  " خَالِفُوهُمْ " .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1545

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1546

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِيمَا يُقَالُ إِذَا دَخَلَ الْمَقَابِرَ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning what is to be said when entering the graveyard

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that ‘Aishah said:
           “I could not find him, meaning the Prophet ﷺ, and he was in Al-Baqi’. He said: “As-salamu ‘alaykum dara qawmin mu’minin. Antum lana faratun wa inna bikum lahiqun. Allahumma la tahrimna ajrahum wa la taftinna ba’dahum. (Peace be upon you, O abode of believing people. You have gone ahead of us and verily we will join you soon. O Allah, do not deprive us of their reward and do not put us to trial after them).”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that ‘Aishah said:
hadiths.body: “I could not find him, meaning the Prophet ﷺ, and he was in Al-Baqi’. He said: “As-salamu ‘alaykum dara qawmin mu’minin. Antum lana faratun wa inna bikum lahiqun. Allahumma la tahrimna ajrahum wa la taftinna ba’dahum. (Peace be upon you, O abode of believing people. You have gone ahead of us and verily we will join you soon. O Allah, do not deprive us of their reward and do not put us to trial after them).”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ مُوسَى، حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ عَاصِمِ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَامِرِ بْنِ رَبِيعَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ فَقَدْتُهُ - تَعْنِي النَّبِيَّ ﷺ - فَإِذَا هُوَ بِالْبَقِيعِ فَقَالَ  " السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكُمْ دَارَ قَوْمٍ مُؤْمِنِينَ أَنْتُمْ لَنَا فَرَطٌ وَإِنَّا بِكُمْ لاَحِقُونَ اللَّهُمَّ لاَ تَحْرِمْنَا أَجْرَهُمْ وَلاَ تَفْتِنَّا بَعْدَهُمْ " .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1546

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1547

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِيمَا يُقَالُ إِذَا دَخَلَ الْمَقَابِرَ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning what is to be said when entering the graveyard

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Sulaiman bin Buraidah that his father said:
           “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to teach them, when they went out to the graveyard, to say: As-salamu ‘alaykum ahlad-diyar minal-mu’minina wal- muslimin, wa inna insha’ Allah bikum lahiqun, nas’alul-laha lana wa lakumul-‘afiyah (Peace be upon you, O inhabitants of the abodes, believers and Muslims, and we will join you soon if Allah wills. We ask Allah for well-being for us and for you).’”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Sulaiman bin Buraidah that his father said:
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to teach them, when they went out to the graveyard, to say: As-salamu ‘alaykum ahlad-diyar minal-mu’minina wal- muslimin, wa inna insha’ Allah bikum lahiqun, nas’alul-laha lana wa lakumul-‘afiyah (Peace be upon you, O inhabitants of the abodes, believers and Muslims, and we will join you soon if Allah wills. We ask Allah for well-being for us and for you).’”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبَّادِ بْنِ آدَمَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أَحْمَدَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ بْنِ مَرْثَدٍ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ بُرَيْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ يُعَلِّمُهُمْ إِذَا خَرَجُوا إِلَى الْمَقَابِرِ كَانَ قَائِلُهُمْ يَقُولُ السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكُمْ أَهْلَ الدِّيَارِ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُسْلِمِينَ وَإِنَّا إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ بِكُمْ لاَحِقُونَ نَسْأَلُ اللَّهَ لَنَا وَلَكُمُ الْعَافِيَةَ .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1547

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1548

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي الْجُلُوسِ فِي الْمَقَابِرِ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning sitting in the graveyards

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Bara’ bin ‘Azib said:
           “We went out with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ for a funeral, and he sat facing the Qiblah (prayer direction).”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Bara’ bin ‘Azib said:
hadiths.body: “We went out with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ for a funeral, and he sat facing the Qiblah (prayer direction).”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ زِيَادٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ خَبَّابٍ، عَنِ الْمِنْهَالِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو، عَنْ زَاذَانَ، عَنِ الْبَرَاءِ بْنِ عَازِبٍ، قَالَ خَرَجْنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فِي جِنَازَةٍ فَقَعَدَ حِيَالَ الْقِبْلَةِ .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1548

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1549

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي الْجُلُوسِ فِي الْمَقَابِرِ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning sitting in the graveyards

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Bara’ bin ‘Azib said:
           “We went out with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ for a funeral, and we came to a grave. He sat down and we sat down, as if there were birds on our heads.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Bara’ bin ‘Azib said:
hadiths.body: “We went out with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ for a funeral, and we came to a grave. He sat down and we sat down, as if there were birds on our heads.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو خَالِدٍ الأَحْمَرُ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ قَيْسٍ، عَنِ الْمِنْهَالِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو، عَنْ زَاذَانَ، عَنِ الْبَرَاءِ بْنِ عَازِبٍ، قَالَ خَرَجْنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فِي جِنَازَةٍ فَانْتَهَيْنَا إِلَى الْقَبْرِ فَجَلَسَ وَجَلَسْنَا كَأَنَّ عَلَى رُءُوسِنَا الطَّيْرَ .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1549

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1550

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي إِدْخَالِ الْمَيِّتِ الْقَبْرَ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning placing the deceased in the grave

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Ibn ‘Umar said:
           “When the deceased was placed in the grave, the Prophet ﷺ would say: ‘Bismillah, wa ‘ala millati rasul-illah (In the Name of Allah and according to the religion of the Messenger of Allah).’” Abu Khalid said on one occasion, when the deceased was placed in the grave: “Bismillah wa ‘ala sunnati rasul- illah (In the Name of Allah and according to the Sunnah of the Messenger of Allah).” Hisham said in his narration: “Bismillah, wa fi sabil-illah, wa ‘ala millati rasul-illah (In the Name of Allah, for the sake of Allah and according to the religion of the Messenger of Allah).”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Ibn ‘Umar said:
hadiths.body: “When the deceased was placed in the grave, the Prophet ﷺ would say: ‘Bismillah, wa ‘ala millati rasul-illah (In the Name of Allah and according to the religion of the Messenger of Allah).’” Abu Khalid said on one occasion, when the deceased was placed in the grave: “Bismillah wa ‘ala sunnati rasul- illah (In the Name of Allah and according to the Sunnah of the Messenger of Allah).” Hisham said in his narration: “Bismillah, wa fi sabil-illah, wa ‘ala millati rasul-illah (In the Name of Allah, for the sake of Allah and according to the religion of the Messenger of Allah).”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ عَيَّاشٍ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثُ بْنُ أَبِي سُلَيْمٍ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو خَالِدٍ الأَحْمَرُ، حَدَّثَنَا الْحَجَّاجُ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ إِذَا أُدْخِلَ الْمَيِّتُ الْقَبْرَ قَالَ " بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَعَلَى مِلَّةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ " . وَقَالَ أَبُو خَالِدٍ مَرَّةً إِذَا وُضِعَ الْمَيِّتُ فِي لَحْدِهِ قَالَ " بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَعَلَى سُنَّةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ " . وَقَالَ هِشَامٌ فِي حَدِيثِهِ " بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَفِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ وَعَلَى مِلَّةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ " .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1550

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1551

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي إِدْخَالِ الْمَيِّتِ الْقَبْرَ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning placing the deceased in the grave

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Abu Rafi’ said:
           “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ placed Sa’d gently in his grave and sprinkled water on it.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Abu Rafi’ said:
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ placed Sa’d gently in his grave and sprinkled water on it.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ الرَّقَاشِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ، حَدَّثَنَا مِنْدَلُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ، أَخْبَرَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي رَافِعٍ، عَنْ دَاوُدَ بْنِ الْحُصَيْنِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي رَافِعٍ، قَالَ سَلَّ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ سَعْدًا وَرَشَّ عَلَى قَبْرِهِ مَاءً .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1551

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1552

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي إِدْخَالِ الْمَيِّتِ الْقَبْرَ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning placing the deceased in the grave

hadiths.englishRaw: It was narrated from Abu Sa’eed that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was brought into his grave from the direction of the Qiblah, and he was placed in his grave gently.
hadiths.body: It was narrated from Abu Sa’eed that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was brought into his grave from the direction of the Qiblah, and he was placed in his grave gently.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا هَارُونُ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ، حَدَّثَنَا الْمُحَارِبِيُّ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ قَيْسٍ، عَنْ عَطِيَّةَ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ أُخِذَ مِنْ قِبَلِ الْقِبْلَةِ وَاسْتُقْبِلَ اسْتِقْبَالاً وَاسْتُلَّ اسْتِلاَلاً .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1552

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1553

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي إِدْخَالِ الْمَيِّتِ الْقَبْرَ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning placing the deceased in the grave

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Sa’eed bin Musayyab said:
           “I was present with Ibn ‘Umar at a funeral. When the body was placed in the niche-grave) he said, ‘Bismillah wa fi sabil-illah wa ‘ala millati rasul-illah’ (In the Name of Allah, for the sake of Allah and according to the religion of the Messenger of Allah). When he started to place bricks in the niche-grave he said: ‘Allahumma ajirha min ash-shaitani wa min ‘adhabil-qabr. Allahumma Jafil-arda ‘an janbaiha, wa sa’id ruhaha, wa laqqiha minka ridwana (O Allah, protect him from Satan and from the torment of the grave; O Allah, keep the earth away from his two sides and take his soul up and grant him pleasure from Yourself).’ I said: ‘O Ibn ‘Umar, is this something that you heard from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ or is it your own words?’ He said: ‘I could have said something like that, but this is something that I heard from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ.’”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Sa’eed bin Musayyab said:
hadiths.body: “I was present with Ibn ‘Umar at a funeral. When the body was placed in the niche-grave) he said, ‘Bismillah wa fi sabil-illah wa ‘ala millati rasul-illah’ (In the Name of Allah, for the sake of Allah and according to the religion of the Messenger of Allah). When he started to place bricks in the niche-grave he said: ‘Allahumma ajirha min ash-shaitani wa min ‘adhabil-qabr. Allahumma Jafil-arda ‘an janbaiha, wa sa’id ruhaha, wa laqqiha minka ridwana (O Allah, protect him from Satan and from the torment of the grave; O Allah, keep the earth away from his two sides and take his soul up and grant him pleasure from Yourself).’ I said: ‘O Ibn ‘Umar, is this something that you heard from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ or is it your own words?’ He said: ‘I could have said something like that, but this is something that I heard from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ.’”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْكَلْبِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا إِدْرِيسُ الأَوْدِيُّ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، قَالَ حَضَرْتُ ابْنَ عُمَرَ فِي جِنَازَةٍ فَلَمَّا وَضَعَهَا فِي اللَّحْدِ قَالَ بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَفِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ وَعَلَى مِلَّةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ . فَلَمَّا أُخِذَ فِي تَسْوِيَةِ اللَّبِنِ عَلَى اللَّحْدِ قَالَ اللَّهُمَّ أَجِرْهَا مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ وَمِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ اللَّهُمَّ جَافِ الأَرْضَ عَنْ جَنْبَيْهَا وَصَعِّدْ رُوحَهَا وَلَقِّهَا مِنْكَ رِضْوَانًا . قُلْتُ يَا ابْنَ عُمَرَ أَشَىْءٌ سَمِعْتَهُ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَمْ قُلْتَهُ بِرَأْيِكَ قَالَ إِنِّي إِذًا لَقَادِرٌ عَلَى الْقَوْلِ بَلْ شَىْءٌ سَمِعْتُهُ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1553

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1554

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي اسْتِحْبَابِ اللَّحْدِ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning the niche-grave being recommended

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Ibn ‘Abbas said:
           “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: ‘The niche-grave is for us and the ditch-grave is for others.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Ibn ‘Abbas said:
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: ‘The niche-grave is for us and the ditch-grave is for others.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَكَّامُ بْنُ سَلْمٍ الرَّازِيُّ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَلِيَّ بْنَ عَبْدِ الأَعْلَى، يَذْكُرُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " اللَّحْدُ لَنَا وَالشَّقُّ لِغَيْرِنَا " .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1554

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1555

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي اسْتِحْبَابِ اللَّحْدِ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning the niche-grave being recommended

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Jarir bin ‘Abdullah Al-Bajali said:
           “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: ‘The niche-grave is for us and the ditch-grave is for others.’”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Jarir bin ‘Abdullah Al-Bajali said:
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: ‘The niche-grave is for us and the ditch-grave is for others.’”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ مُوسَى السُّدِّيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ، عَنْ أَبِي الْيَقْظَانِ، عَنْ زَاذَانَ، عَنْ جَرِيرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْبَجَلِيِّ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " اللَّحْدُ لَنَا وَالشَّقُّ لِغَيْرِنَا " .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1555

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1556

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي اسْتِحْبَابِ اللَّحْدِ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning the niche-grave being recommended

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Sa’d said:
           “Make a niche-grave for me, and block it up with bricks as was done for the Messenger of Allah ﷺ.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Sa’d said:
hadiths.body: “Make a niche-grave for me, and block it up with bricks as was done for the Messenger of Allah ﷺ.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَامِرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ الزُّهْرِيُّ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ عَامِرِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ سَعْدٍ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ أَلْحِدُوا لِي لَحْدًا وَانْصِبُوا عَلَىَّ اللَّبِنَ نَصْبًا كَمَا فُعِلَ بِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1556

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1557

chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning the ditch-grave

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Anas bin Malik said:
           “When the Prophet ﷺ died, there was a man in Al-Madinah who used to make a niche in the grave and another who used to dig graves without a niche. They said: ‘Let us pray Istikharah to our Lord and call for them both, and whichever of them comes first, we will let him do it.’ So they were both sent for, and the one who used to make the niche-grave came first, so they made a niche-grave for the Prophet ﷺ.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Anas bin Malik said:
hadiths.body: “When the Prophet ﷺ died, there was a man in Al-Madinah who used to make a niche in the grave and another who used to dig graves without a niche. They said: ‘Let us pray Istikharah to our Lord and call for them both, and whichever of them comes first, we will let him do it.’ So they were both sent for, and the one who used to make the niche-grave came first, so they made a niche-grave for the Prophet ﷺ.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مَحْمُودُ بْنُ غَيْلاَنَ، حَدَّثَنَا هَاشِمُ بْنُ الْقَاسِمِ، حَدَّثَنَا مُبَارَكُ بْنُ فَضَالَةَ، حَدَّثَنِي حُمَيْدٌ الطَّوِيلُ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ لَمَّا تُوُفِّيَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ كَانَ بِالْمَدِينَةِ رَجُلٌ يَلْحَدُ وَآخَرُ يَضْرَحُ فَقَالُوا نَسْتَخِيرُ رَبَّنَا وَنَبْعَثُ إِلَيْهِمَا فَأَيُّهُمَا سَبَقَ تَرَكْنَاهُ . فَأُرْسِلَ إِلَيْهِمَا فَسَبَقَ صَاحِبُ اللَّحْدِ فَلَحَدُوا لِلنَّبِيِّ ﷺ .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1557

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1558

chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning the ditch-grave

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that ‘Aishah said:
           “When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ died, they differed as to whether his grave should have a niche or a ditch in the ground, until they spoke and raised their voices concerning that. Then ‘Umar said: ‘Do not shout in the presence of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, living or dead,’ or words to that effect. So they sent for both the one who made a niche and the one who dug graves without a niche, and the one who used to make a niche came and dug a grave with a niche for the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, then he ﷺ was buried.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that ‘Aishah said:
hadiths.body: “When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ died, they differed as to whether his grave should have a niche or a ditch in the ground, until they spoke and raised their voices concerning that. Then ‘Umar said: ‘Do not shout in the presence of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, living or dead,’ or words to that effect. So they sent for both the one who made a niche and the one who dug graves without a niche, and the one who used to make a niche came and dug a grave with a niche for the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, then he ﷺ was buried.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ شَبَّةَ بْنِ عُبَيْدَةَ بْنِ زَيْدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ بْنُ طُفَيْلٍ الْمُقْرِئُ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ أَبِي مُلَيْكَةَ الْقُرَشِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي مُلَيْكَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ لَمَّا مَاتَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ اخْتَلَفُوا فِي اللَّحْدِ وَالشَّقِّ حَتَّى تَكَلَّمُوا فِي ذَلِكَ وَارْتَفَعَتْ أَصْوَاتُهُمْ . فَقَالَ عُمَرُ لاَ تَصْخَبُوا عِنْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ حَيًّا وَلاَ مَيِّتًا أَوْ كَلِمَةً نَحْوَهَا . فَأَرْسَلُوا إِلَى الشَّقَّاقِ وَاللاَّحِدِ جَمِيعًا فَجَاءَ اللاَّحِدُ فَلَحَدَ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ ثُمَّ دُفِنَ ﷺ .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1558

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1559

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي حَفْرِ الْقَبْرِ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning digging the grave

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Adra’ As-Sulami said:
           “I came one night to guard the Prophet ﷺ, and there was a man reciting loudly. The Prophet ﷺ came out and I said: ‘O Messenger of Allah, this man is showing off.’ Then he died in Al-Madinah, and they finished preparing him, then they carried his dead body. The Prophet ﷺ said: ‘Be gentle with him, may Allah be gentle with him, for he loved Allah and His Messenger.’ Then his grave was dug and he (the Prophet ﷺ) said: ‘Make it spacious for him, and may Allah make it spacious for him.’ Some of his Companions said: ‘O Messenger of Allah, you are grieving for him.’ He said: ‘Yes indeed, for he loved Allah and His Messenger.’”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Adra’ As-Sulami said:
hadiths.body: “I came one night to guard the Prophet ﷺ, and there was a man reciting loudly. The Prophet ﷺ came out and I said: ‘O Messenger of Allah, this man is showing off.’ Then he died in Al-Madinah, and they finished preparing him, then they carried his dead body. The Prophet ﷺ said: ‘Be gentle with him, may Allah be gentle with him, for he loved Allah and His Messenger.’ Then his grave was dug and he (the Prophet ﷺ) said: ‘Make it spacious for him, and may Allah make it spacious for him.’ Some of his Companions said: ‘O Messenger of Allah, you are grieving for him.’ He said: ‘Yes indeed, for he loved Allah and His Messenger.’”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا زَيْدُ بْنُ الْحُبَابِ، حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ عُبَيْدَةَ، حَدَّثَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، عَنِ الأَدْرَعِ السُّلَمِيِّ، قَالَ جِئْتُ لَيْلَةً أَحْرُسُ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ فَإِذَا رَجُلٌ قِرَاءَتُهُ عَالِيَةٌ فَخَرَجَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ هَذَا مُرَاءٍ . قَالَ فَمَاتَ بِالْمَدِينَةِ فَفَرَغُوا مِنْ جِهَازِهِ فَحَمَلُوا نَعْشَهُ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ " ارْفُقُوا بِهِ رَفَقَ اللَّهُ بِهِ إِنَّهُ كَانَ يُحِبُّ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ " . قَالَ وَحَفَرَ حُفْرَتَهُ فَقَالَ " أَوْسِعُوا لَهُ وَسَّعَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ " . فَقَالَ بَعْضُ أَصْحَابِهِ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ لَقَدْ حَزِنْتَ عَلَيْهِ . فَقَالَ " أَجَلْ إِنَّهُ كَانَ يُحِبُّ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ " .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1559

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1560

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي حَفْرِ الْقَبْرِ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning digging the grave

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Hisham bin ‘Amir that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
           “Dig the grave deep, make it spacious and prepare it well.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Hisham bin ‘Amir that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “Dig the grave deep, make it spacious and prepare it well.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَزْهَرُ بْنُ مَرْوَانَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَارِثِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ، عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ هِلاَلٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الدَّهْمَاءِ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عَامِرٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " احْفِرُوا وَأَوْسِعُوا وَأَحْسِنُوا " .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1560

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1561

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي الْعلَّامَةِ فِي الْقَبْرِ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning markers on graves

hadiths.englishRaw: It was narrated from Anas bin Malik that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ marked the grave of ‘Uthman bin Maz’un with a rock.
hadiths.body: It was narrated from Anas bin Malik that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ marked the grave of ‘Uthman bin Maz’un with a rock.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا الْعَبَّاسُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَيُّوبَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ الْوَاسِطِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ كَثِيرِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ زَيْنَبَ بِنْتِ نُبَيْطٍ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَعْلَمَ قَبْرَ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ مَظْعُونٍ بِصَخْرَةٍ .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1561

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1562

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي النَّهْىِ عَنِ الْبِنَاءِ، عَلَى الْقُبُورِ وَتَجْصِيصِهَا وَالْكِتَابَةِ عَلَيْهَا
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning the prohibition of building over graves, plastering over them and writing on them

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Jabir said:
           “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade plastering over graves.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Jabir said:
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade plastering over graves.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَزْهَرُ بْنُ مَرْوَانَ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ زِيَادٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَارِثِ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَنْ تَقْصِيصِ الْقُبُورِ .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1562

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1563

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي النَّهْىِ عَنِ الْبِنَاءِ، عَلَى الْقُبُورِ وَتَجْصِيصِهَا وَالْكِتَابَةِ عَلَيْهَا
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning the prohibition of building over graves, plastering over them and writing on them

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Jabir said:
           “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade writing anything on graves.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Jabir said:
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade writing anything on graves.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصُ بْنُ غِيَاثٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ مُوسَى، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَنْ يُكْتَبَ عَلَى الْقَبْرِ شَىْءٌ .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1563

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1564

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي النَّهْىِ عَنِ الْبِنَاءِ، عَلَى الْقُبُورِ وَتَجْصِيصِهَا وَالْكِتَابَةِ عَلَيْهَا
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning the prohibition of building over graves, plastering over them and writing on them

hadiths.englishRaw: It was narrated from Abu Sa’eed that the Prophet ﷺ forbade building structures over graves.
hadiths.body: It was narrated from Abu Sa’eed that the Prophet ﷺ forbade building structures over graves.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الرَّقَاشِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ يَزِيدَ بْنِ جَابِرٍ، عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مُخَيْمِرَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ نَهَى أَنْ يُبْنَى عَلَى الْقَبْرِ .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1564

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1565

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي حَثْوِ التُّرَابِ فِي الْقَبْرِ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning scattering earth in the grave

hadiths.englishRaw: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ offered the funeral prayer, then he came to the grave of the deceased and scattered three handfuls of earth from the side of (the deceased’s) head.
hadiths.body: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ offered the funeral prayer, then he came to the grave of the deceased and scattered three handfuls of earth from the side of (the deceased’s) head.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا الْعَبَّاسُ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ الدِّمَشْقِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ صَالِحٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سَلَمَةُ بْنُ كُلْثُومٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَوْزَاعِيُّ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ صَلَّى عَلَى جِنَازَةٍ ثُمَّ أَتَى قَبْرَ الْمَيِّتِ فَحَثَى عَلَيْهِ مِنْ قِبَلِ رَأْسِهِ ثَلاَثًا .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1565

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1566

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي النَّهْىِ عَنِ الْمَشْىِ عَلَى الْقُبُورِ وَالْجُلُوسِ عَلَيْهَا
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning the prohibition of walking or sitting on graves

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Hurairah said:
           The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “If one of you were to sit on a live coal that burns him, that would be better for him than if he were to sit on a grave.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah said:
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “If one of you were to sit on a live coal that burns him, that would be better for him than if he were to sit on a grave.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا سُوَيْدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ سُهَيْلٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " لأَنْ يَجْلِسَ أَحَدُكُمْ عَلَى جَمْرَةٍ تُحْرِقُهُ خَيْرٌ لَهُ مِنْ أَنْ يَجْلِسَ عَلَى قَبْرٍ " .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1566

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1567

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي النَّهْىِ عَنِ الْمَشْىِ عَلَى الْقُبُورِ وَالْجُلُوسِ عَلَيْهَا
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning the prohibition of walking or sitting on graves

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from ‘Uqbah bin ‘Amir that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
           ‘If I were to walk on a live coal or a sword, or if I were to sew shows to my feet, that would be better for me than walking on the grave of a Muslim. And I see no difference between relieving myself in the midst of graves or in the middle of the marketplace.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from ‘Uqbah bin ‘Amir that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: ‘If I were to walk on a live coal or a sword, or if I were to sew shows to my feet, that would be better for me than walking on the grave of a Muslim. And I see no difference between relieving myself in the midst of graves or in the middle of the marketplace.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ سَمُرَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا الْمُحَارِبِيُّ، عَنِ اللَّيْثِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الْخَيْرِ، مَرْثَدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْيَزَنِيِّ عَنْ عُقْبَةَ بْنِ عَامِرٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " لأَنْ أَمْشِيَ عَلَى جَمْرَةٍ أَوْ سَيْفٍ أَوْ أَخْصِفَ نَعْلِي بِرِجْلِي أَحَبُّ إِلَىَّ مِنْ أَنْ أَمْشِيَ عَلَى قَبْرِ مُسْلِمٍ وَمَا أُبَالِي أَوَسَطَ الْقُبُورِ قَضَيْتُ حَاجَتِي أَوْ وَسَطَ السُّوقِ " .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1567

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1568

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي خَلْعِ النَّعْلَيْنِ فِي الْمَقَابِرِ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning taking off one’s shoes in the graveyard

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that basher bin Khasasiyyah said:
           “While I was walking with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ he said: ‘O son of Khasasiyyah, why are you angry with Allah when you are walking with the Messenger of Allah?’ I said: ‘O Messenger of Allah! I am not angry with Allah at all. Allah has bestowed all good on me.’ Then he passed by the graves of the Muslims and said: ‘They have caught up with a great deal of good.’ Then he passed by the graves of the idolaters and said: ‘They died before a great deal of good came to them.’ Then he turned and saw a man walking between the graves in his shows and he said: ‘O you with the shows, take them off.’”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that basher bin Khasasiyyah said:
hadiths.body: “While I was walking with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ he said: ‘O son of Khasasiyyah, why are you angry with Allah when you are walking with the Messenger of Allah?’ I said: ‘O Messenger of Allah! I am not angry with Allah at all. Allah has bestowed all good on me.’ Then he passed by the graves of the Muslims and said: ‘They have caught up with a great deal of good.’ Then he passed by the graves of the idolaters and said: ‘They died before a great deal of good came to them.’ Then he turned and saw a man walking between the graves in his shows and he said: ‘O you with the shows, take them off.’”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَسْوَدُ بْنُ شَيْبَانَ، عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ سُمَيْرٍ، عَنْ بَشِيرِ بْنِ نَهِيكٍ، عَنْ بَشِيرِ بْنِ الْخَصَاصِيَةِ، قَالَ بَيْنَمَا أَنَا أَمْشِي، مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَقَالَ " يَا ابْنَ الْخَصَاصِيَةِ مَا تَنْقِمُ عَلَى اللَّهِ أَصْبَحْتَ تُمَاشِي رَسُولَ اللَّهِ " . فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ مَا أَنْقِمُ عَلَى اللَّهِ شَيْئًا كُلُّ خَيْرٍ قَدْ أَتَانِيهِ اللَّهُ . فَمَرَّ عَلَى مَقَابِرِ الْمُسْلِمِينَ فَقَالَ " أَدْرَكَ هَؤُلاَءِ خَيْرًا كَثِيرًا " . ثُمَّ مَرَّ عَلَى مَقَابِرِ الْمُشْرِكِينَ فَقَالَ " سَبَقَ هَؤُلاَءِ خَيْرٌ كَثِيرٌ " . قَالَ فَالْتَفَتَ فَرَأَى رَجُلاً يَمْشِي بَيْنَ الْمَقَابِرِ فِي نَعْلَيْهِ فَقَالَ " يَا صَاحِبَ السِّبْتِيَّتَيْنِ أَلْقِهِمَا " . حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ قَالَ كَانَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُثْمَانَ يَقُولُ حَدِيثٌ جَيِّدٌ وَرَجُلٌ ثِقَةٌ .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1568

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1569

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي زِيَارَةِ الْقُبُورِ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning visiting the graves

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            “Visit the graves, for they will remind you of the Hereafter.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “Visit the graves, for they will remind you of the Hereafter.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُبَيْدٍ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ كَيْسَانَ، عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " زُورُوا الْقُبُورَ فَإِنَّهَا تُذَكِّرُكُمُ الآخِرَةَ " .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1569

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1570

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي زِيَارَةِ الْقُبُورِ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning visiting the graves

hadiths.englishRaw: It was narrated from ‘Aishah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ gave permission for visiting the graves.
hadiths.body: It was narrated from ‘Aishah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ gave permission for visiting the graves.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الْجَوْهَرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا رَوْحٌ، حَدَّثَنَا بِسْطَامُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا التَّيَّاحِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ أَبِي مُلَيْكَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ رَخَّصَ فِي زِيَارَةِ الْقُبُورِ .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1570

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1571

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي زِيَارَةِ الْقُبُورِ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning visiting the graves

hadiths.englishRaw: It was narrated from Ibn Mas’ud that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, “I used to forbid you to visit the graves, but now visit them, for they will draw your attention away from this world and remind you of the Hereafter.”
hadiths.body: It was narrated from Ibn Mas’ud that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, “I used to forbid you to visit the graves, but now visit them, for they will draw your attention away from this world and remind you of the Hereafter.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الأَعْلَى، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَنْبَأَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ بْنِ هَانِئٍ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقِ بْنِ الأَجْدَعِ، عَنِ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ  " كُنْتُ نَهَيْتُكُمْ عَنْ زِيَارَةِ الْقُبُورِ فَزُورُوا الْقُبُورَ فَإِنَّهَا تُزَهِّدُ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَتُذَكِّرُ الآخِرَةَ " .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1571

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1572

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي زِيَارَةِ قُبُورِ الْمُشْرِكِينَ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning visiting the graves of the idolaters

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Abu Hurairah said:
           “The Prophet ﷺ visited the grave of his mother and wept, causing the people around him to weep. Then he said: ‘I asked my Lord for permission to seek forgiveness for her, but He did not give me permission. Then I asked my Lord for permission to visit her grave and He gave me permission. So visit the graves, for they will remind you of death.’”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Abu Hurairah said:
hadiths.body: “The Prophet ﷺ visited the grave of his mother and wept, causing the people around him to weep. Then he said: ‘I asked my Lord for permission to seek forgiveness for her, but He did not give me permission. Then I asked my Lord for permission to visit her grave and He gave me permission. So visit the graves, for they will remind you of death.’”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُبَيْدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ كَيْسَانَ، عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ زَارَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ قَبْرَ أُمِّهِ فَبَكَى وَأَبْكَى مَنْ حَوْلَهُ فَقَالَ  " اسْتَأْذَنْتُ رَبِّي فِي أَنْ أَسْتَغْفِرَ لَهَا فَلَمْ يَأْذَنْ لِي وَاسْتَأْذَنْتُ رَبِّي فِي أَنْ أَزُورَ قَبْرَهَا فَأَذِنَ لِي فَزُورُوا الْقُبُورَ فَإِنَّهَا تُذَكِّرُكُمُ الْمَوْتَ " .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1572

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1573

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي زِيَارَةِ قُبُورِ الْمُشْرِكِينَ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning visiting the graves of the idolaters

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Salim that his father said:
           “A Bedouin came to the Prophet ﷺ and said: ‘O Messenger of Allah, my father used to uphold the ties of kinship, and so and so forth, where is he?’ He said: ‘In the Fire.’ It was as if he found that difficult to bear. Then he said: ‘O Messenger of Allah. Where is your father?’ The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: ‘Whenever you pass by the grave of an idolater, give him the tidings of Hell-fire.’ The Bedouin later became Muslim, and he said: ‘The Messenger of Allah ﷺ gave me a difficult task. I never passed the grave of an idolater but I gave him the tidings of Hell-fire.’”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Salim that his father said:
hadiths.body: “A Bedouin came to the Prophet ﷺ and said: ‘O Messenger of Allah, my father used to uphold the ties of kinship, and so and so forth, where is he?’ He said: ‘In the Fire.’ It was as if he found that difficult to bear. Then he said: ‘O Messenger of Allah. Where is your father?’ The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: ‘Whenever you pass by the grave of an idolater, give him the tidings of Hell-fire.’ The Bedouin later became Muslim, and he said: ‘The Messenger of Allah ﷺ gave me a difficult task. I never passed the grave of an idolater but I gave him the tidings of Hell-fire.’”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ الْبَخْتَرِيِّ الْوَاسِطِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ جَاءَ أَعْرَابِيٌّ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ ﷺ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّ أَبِي كَانَ يَصِلُ الرَّحِمَ وَكَانَ وَكَانَ فَأَيْنَ هُوَ قَالَ " فِي النَّارِ " . قَالَ فَكَأَنَّهُ وَجَدَ مِنْ ذَلِكَ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ فَأَيْنَ أَبُوكَ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ " حَيْثُمَا مَرَرْتَ بِقَبْرِ كَافِرٍ فَبَشِّرْهُ بِالنَّارِ " . قَالَ فَأَسْلَمَ الأَعْرَابِيُّ بَعْدُ وَقَالَ لَقَدْ كَلَّفَنِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ تَعَبًا مَا مَرَرْتُ بِقَبْرِ كَافِرٍ إِلاَّ بَشَّرْتُهُ بِالنَّارِ .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1573

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1574

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي النَّهْىِ عَنْ زِيَارَةِ النِّسَاءِ الْقُبُورَ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning the prohibition of women visiting the graves

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from ‘Abdur-Rahman bin Hassan bin Thabit that his father said:
           “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ cursed women who visit graves.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from ‘Abdur-Rahman bin Hassan bin Thabit that his father said:
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ cursed women who visit graves.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو بِشْرٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا قَبِيصَةُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ خَلَفٍ الْعَسْقَلاَنِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا الْفِرْيَابِيُّ، وَقَبِيصَةُ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ خُثَيْمٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ بَهْمَانَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ حَسَّانَ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ لَعَنَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ زُوَّارَاتِ الْقُبُورِ .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1574

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1575

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي النَّهْىِ عَنْ زِيَارَةِ النِّسَاءِ الْقُبُورَ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning the prohibition of women visiting the graves

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Ibn ‘Abbas said:
           “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ cursed women who visit graves.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Ibn ‘Abbas said:
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ cursed women who visit graves.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَزْهَرُ بْنُ مَرْوَانَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَارِثِ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جُحَادَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ لَعَنَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ زُوَّارَاتِ الْقُبُورِ .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1575

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1576

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي النَّهْىِ عَنْ زِيَارَةِ النِّسَاءِ الْقُبُورَ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning the prohibition of women visiting the graves

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Abu Hurairah said:
           “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ cursed women who visit graves.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Abu Hurairah said:
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ cursed women who visit graves.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ خَلَفٍ الْعَسْقَلاَنِيُّ أَبُو نَصْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ طَالِبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ لَعَنَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ زُوَّارَاتِ الْقُبُورِ .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1576

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1577

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي اتِّبَاعِ النِّسَاءِ الْجَنَائِزَ
chapter.englishTitle: What was narrated concerning women following the funeral (procession)

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Umm ‘Atiyyah said:
           “We were prevented from following the funeral, but that was not made binding on us.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Umm ‘Atiyyah said:
hadiths.body: “We were prevented from following the funeral, but that was not made binding on us.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ حَفْصَةَ، عَنْ أُمِّ عَطِيَّةَ، قَالَتْ نُهِينَا عَنِ اتِّبَاعِ الْجَنَائِزِ، وَلَمْ يُعْزَمْ عَلَيْنَا .
references: Vol. 2, Book of Funerals, Hadith 1577

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 1578

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي اتِّبَاعِ النِّسَاءِ الْجَنَائِزَ
