hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى، عَنْ إِسْرَائِيلَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَكِيمٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ مَهْدِيٍّ، عَنْ إِسْرَائِيلَ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الأَعْلَى، عَنْ جَدَّتِهِ، عَنْ أَبِيهَا، سُوَيْدِ بْنِ حَنْظَلَةَ قَالَ خَرَجْنَا نُرِيدُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَمَعَنَا وَائِلُ بْنُ حُجْرٍ فَأَخَذَهُ عَدُوٌّ لَهُ فَتَحَرَّجَ النَّاسُ أَنْ يَحْلِفُوا فَحَلَفْتُ أَنَا أَنَّهُ أَخِي فَخَلَّى سَبِيلَهُ فَأَتَيْنَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَأَخْبَرْتُهُ أَنَّ الْقَوْمَ تَحَرَّجُوا أَنْ يَحْلِفُوا وَحَلَفْتُ أَنَا أَنَّهُ أَخِي فَقَالَ  " صَدَقْتَ الْمُسْلِمُ أَخُو الْمُسْلِمِ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Expiation, Hadith 2119

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2120

chapter.englishTitle: One who uses ambiguous words in his oath

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            "The oath is only according to the intention of the one who requests the oath to be taken."'
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: "The oath is only according to the intention of the one who requests the oath to be taken."'
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ، أَنْبَأَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، عَنْ عَبَّادِ بْنِ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " إِنَّمَا الْيَمِينُ عَلَى نِيَّةِ الْمُسْتَحْلِفِ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Expiation, Hadith 2120

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2121

chapter.englishTitle: One who uses ambiguous words in his oath

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            "Your oath is as your companion understands it to be."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: "Your oath is as your companion understands it to be."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، أَنْبَأَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " يَمِينُكَ عَلَى مَا يُصَدِّقُكَ بِهِ صَاحِبُكَ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Expiation, Hadith 2121

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2122

chapter.englishTitle: The prohibition of vows

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that 'Abdullah bin 'Umar said:
            "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade vows and said: 'They are just a means of taking wealth from the miserly."'
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that 'Abdullah bin 'Umar said:
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade vows and said: 'They are just a means of taking wealth from the miserly."'
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مُرَّةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَنِ النَّذْرِ وَقَالَ  " إِنَّمَا يُسْتَخْرَجُ بِهِ مِنَ اللَّئِيمِ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Expiation, Hadith 2122

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2123

chapter.englishTitle: The prohibition of vows

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            "Vows do not bring the son of Adam anything unless it has been decreed for him. But he is dominated by Divine preordainment, and will get what is decreed for him. And (vows) are a means of making the miser give something, so what he desires becomes obtainable for him, which was not obtainable before his vow. And Allah says: 'Spend, I will spend on you.'
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: "Vows do not bring the son of Adam anything unless it has been decreed for him. But he is dominated by Divine preordainment, and will get what is decreed for him. And (vows) are a means of making the miser give something, so what he desires becomes obtainable for him, which was not obtainable before his vow. And Allah says: 'Spend, I will spend on you.'
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " إِنَّ النَّذْرَ لاَ يَأْتِي ابْنَ آدَمَ بِشَىْءٍ إِلاَّ مَا قُدِّرَ لَهُ وَلَكِنْ يَغْلِبُهُ الْقَدَرُ مَا قُدِّرَ لَهُ فَيُسْتَخْرَجُ بِهِ مِنَ الْبَخِيلِ فَيَتَيَسَّرُ عَلَيْهِ مَا لَمْ يَكُنْ يَتَيَسَّرُ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ قَبْلِ ذَلِكَ وَقَدْ قَالَ اللَّهُ أَنْفِقْ أُنْفِقْ عَلَيْكَ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Expiation, Hadith 2123

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2124

chapter.englishTitle: Vows for disobedience

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from 'Imran bin Husain that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            "[There is no vow to commit disobedience and] no vow concerning that which the son of Adam does not possess."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from 'Imran bin Husain that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: "[There is no vow to commit disobedience and] no vow concerning that which the son of Adam does not possess."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا سَهْلُ بْنُ أَبِي سَهْلٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلاَبَةَ، عَنْ عَمِّهِ، عَنْ عِمْرَانَ بْنِ الْحُصَيْنِ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " لاَ نَذْرَ فِي مَعْصِيَةٍ وَلاَ نَذْرَ فِيمَا لاَ يَمْلِكُ ابْنُ آدَمَ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Expiation, Hadith 2124

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2125

chapter.englishTitle: Vows for disobedience

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from 'Aishah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            "There is no vow to commit disobedience, and the expiation (for such a vow) is the expiation for breaking an oath."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from 'Aishah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: "There is no vow to commit disobedience, and the expiation (for such a vow) is the expiation for breaking an oath."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَمْرِو بْنِ السَّرْحِ الْمِصْرِيُّ أَبُو طَاهِرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَنْبَأَنَا يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ  " لاَ نَذْرَ فِي مَعْصِيَةٍ وَكَفَّارَتُهُ كَفَّارَةُ يَمِينٍ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Expiation, Hadith 2125

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2126

chapter.englishTitle: Vows for disobedience

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from 'Aishah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            "Whoever vows to obey Allah, let him obey Him, and whoever vows to disobey Allah, let him not disobey Him. "
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from 'Aishah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: "Whoever vows to obey Allah, let him obey Him, and whoever vows to disobey Allah, let him not disobey Him. "
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ طَلْحَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ، عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " مَنْ نَذَرَ أَنْ يُطِيعَ اللَّهَ فَلْيُطِعْهُ وَمَنْ نَذَرَ أَنْ يَعْصِيَ اللَّهَ فَلاَ يَعْصِهِ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Expiation, Hadith 2126

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2127

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَنْ نَذَرَ نَذْرًا وَلَمْ يُسَمِّهِ
chapter.englishTitle: One who makes a vow but does not state it specifically

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from 'Uqbah bin 'Amit Al-Juhani that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            "Whoever makes a vow and does not state it specifically, the expiation (for such a vow) is the expiation for breaking an oath. "
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from 'Uqbah bin 'Amit Al-Juhani that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: "Whoever makes a vow and does not state it specifically, the expiation (for such a vow) is the expiation for breaking an oath. "
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ، عَنْ عُقْبَةَ بْنِ عَامِرٍ الْجُهَنِيِّ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " مَنْ نَذَرَ نَذْرًا وَلَمْ يُسَمِّهِ فَكَفَّارَتُهُ كَفَّارَةُ يَمِينٍ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Expiation, Hadith 2127

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2128

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَنْ نَذَرَ نَذْرًا وَلَمْ يُسَمِّهِ
chapter.englishTitle: One who makes a vow but does not state it specifically

hadiths.englishRaw:
lt was narrated from Ibn 'Abbas that the Prophet ﷺ said:
            "Whoever makes a vow and does not state it specifically, the expiation (for such a vow) is the expiation for breaking an oath. Whoever makes a vow and is not able to fulfill it, the expiation for that is the expiation for breaking an oath. Whoever makes a vow and is able to fulfill it, let him do so."
hadiths.narrator: lt was narrated from Ibn 'Abbas that the Prophet ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: "Whoever makes a vow and does not state it specifically, the expiation (for such a vow) is the expiation for breaking an oath. Whoever makes a vow and is not able to fulfill it, the expiation for that is the expiation for breaking an oath. Whoever makes a vow and is able to fulfill it, let him do so."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ الصَّنْعَانِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا خَارِجَةُ بْنُ مُصْعَبٍ، عَنْ بُكَيْرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الأَشَجِّ، عَنْ كُرَيْبٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ  " مَنْ نَذَرَ نَذْرًا وَلَمْ يُسَمِّهِ فَكَفَّارَتُهُ كَفَّارَةُ يَمِينٍ وَمَنْ نَذَرَ نَذْرًا لَمْ يُطِقْهُ فَكَفَّارَتُهُ كَفَّارَةُ يَمِينٍ وَمَنْ نَذَرَ نَذْرًا أَطَاقَهُ فَلْيَفِ بِهِ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Expiation, Hadith 2128

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2129

chapter.englishTitle: Fulfilling vows

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that 'Umar bin Khattab said:
            "I made a vow during the Ignorance period and I asked the Prophet ﷺ (about it) after I became Muslim. He told me to fulfill my vow."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that 'Umar bin Khattab said:
hadiths.body: "I made a vow during the Ignorance period and I asked the Prophet ﷺ (about it) after I became Muslim. He told me to fulfill my vow."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصُ بْنُ غِيَاثٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ، قَالَ نَذَرْتُ نَذْرًا فِي الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ فَسَأَلْتُ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ بَعْدَ مَا أَسْلَمْتُ فَأَمَرَنِي أَنْ أُوفِيَ بِنَذْرِي .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Expiation, Hadith 2129

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2130

chapter.englishTitle: Fulfilling vows

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Ibn Abbas that a man came to the Prophet ﷺ and said:
            "O Messenger of Allah, I vowed to offer a sacrifice at Buwanah." He said: "Do you intend any action of Ignorance period?" He said: "No." He said: "Then fulfill your vow."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Ibn Abbas that a man came to the Prophet ﷺ and said:
hadiths.body: "O Messenger of Allah, I vowed to offer a sacrifice at Buwanah." He said: "Do you intend any action of Ignorance period?" He said: "No." He said: "Then fulfill your vow."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَعَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ الْجَوْهَرِيُّ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ رَجَاءٍ، أَنْبَأَنَا الْمَسْعُودِيُّ، عَنْ حَبِيبِ بْنِ أَبِي ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّ رَجُلاً، جَاءَ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ ﷺ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي نَذَرْتُ أَنْ أَنْحَرَ بِبُوَانَةَ فَقَالَ " فِي نَفْسِكَ شَىْءٌ مِنْ أَمْرِ الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ " . قَالَ لاَ . قَالَ " أَوْفِ بِنَذْرِكَ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Expiation, Hadith 2130

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2131

chapter.englishTitle: Fulfilling vows

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Maimunah bint Kardam Al-Yasariyyah that :
            her father met the Prophet ﷺ when she was riding behind him. He said: "I vowed to offer a sacrifice at Buwanah." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Is there any idol there?" He said: "No." He said: " Fulfill your vow." Another chain with similar wording.
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Maimunah bint Kardam Al-Yasariyyah that :
hadiths.body: her father met the Prophet ﷺ when she was riding behind him. He said: "I vowed to offer a sacrifice at Buwanah." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Is there any idol there?" He said: "No." He said: " Fulfill your vow." Another chain with similar wording.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا مَرْوَانُ بْنُ مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الطَّائِفِيِّ، عَنْ مَيْمُونَةَ بِنْتِ كَرْدَمٍ الْيَسَارِيَّةِ، أَنَّ أَبَاهَا، لَقِيَ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ وَهِيَ رَدِيفَةٌ لَهُ فَقَالَ إِنِّي نَذَرْتُ أَنْ أَنْحَرَ بِبُوَانَةَ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ " هَلْ بِهَا وَثَنٌ " . قَالَ لاَ . قَالَ " أَوْفِ بِنَذْرِكَ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Expiation, Hadith 2131

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2132

chapter.englishTitle: One who dies with a vow left to fulfill

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Ibn 'Abbas' that :
            Sa'd bin 'Ubadah asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ about a vow which his mother had made, but she had died without fulfilling it. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Fulfill it on her behalf ."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Ibn 'Abbas' that :
hadiths.body: Sa'd bin 'Ubadah asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ about a vow which his mother had made, but she had died without fulfilling it. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Fulfill it on her behalf ."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رُمْحٍ، أَنْبَأَنَا اللَّيْثُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّ سَعْدَ بْنَ عُبَادَةَ، اسْتَفْتَى رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ فِي نَذْرٍ كَانَ عَلَى أُمِّهِ تُوُفِّيَتْ وَلَمْ تَقْضِهِ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " اقْضِهِ عَنْهَا " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Expiation, Hadith 2132

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2133

chapter.englishTitle: One who dies with a vow left to fulfill

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Jabir bin 'Abdullsh that :
            a woman came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and said: "My mother has died, and she had made a vow to fast, but she died before she could fulfill it. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'Let her guardian fast on her behalf ."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Jabir bin 'Abdullsh that :
hadiths.body: a woman came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and said: "My mother has died, and she had made a vow to fast, but she died before she could fulfill it. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'Let her guardian fast on her behalf ."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ بُكَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ لَهِيعَةَ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، . أَنَّ امْرَأَةً، أَتَتْ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَقَالَتْ إِنَّ أُمِّي تُوُفِّيَتْ وَعَلَيْهَا نَذْرُ صِيَامٍ فَتُوُفِّيَتْ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَقْضِيَهُ . فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " لِيَصُمْ عَنْهَا الْوَلِيُّ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Expiation, Hadith 2133

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2134

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَنْ نَذَرَ أَنْ يَحُجَّ مَاشِيًا
chapter.englishTitle: One who vows to go for Hajj walking

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Sa'eed Ar-Ru'aini that 'Abdullah bin Malik told him, that :
            'Uqbah bin 'Amir told him, that his sister vowed to walk, barefoot and bareheaded, and he mentioned that to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ He said: "Order her to ride and to cover her head, and to fast for three days."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Sa'eed Ar-Ru'aini that 'Abdullah bin Malik told him, that :
hadiths.body: 'Uqbah bin 'Amir told him, that his sister vowed to walk, barefoot and bareheaded, and he mentioned that to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ He said: "Order her to ride and to cover her head, and to fast for three days."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ زَحْرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الرُّعَيْنِيِّ، أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ مَالِكٍ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ عُقْبَةَ بْنَ عَامِرٍ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ أُخْتَهُ نَذَرَتْ أَنْ تَمْشِيَ حَافِيَةً غَيْرَ مُخْتَمِرَةٍ وَأَنَّهُ ذَكَرَ ذَلِكَ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَقَالَ  " مُرْهَا فَلْتَرْكَبْ وَلْتَخْتَمِرْ وَلْتَصُمْ ثَلاَثَةَ أَيَّامٍ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Expiation, Hadith 2134

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2135

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَنْ نَذَرَ أَنْ يَحُجَّ مَاشِيًا
chapter.englishTitle: One who vows to go for Hajj walking

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Abu Hurairah said:
            "The Prophet ﷺ saw an old man walking between his two sons, and he said: What is the matter with him?' His sons said: 'A vow, O Messenger of Allah.' He said: 'Let this old man ride, for Allah has no need of you or your vow."'
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Abu Hurairah said:
hadiths.body: "The Prophet ﷺ saw an old man walking between his two sons, and he said: What is the matter with him?' His sons said: 'A vow, O Messenger of Allah.' He said: 'Let this old man ride, for Allah has no need of you or your vow."'
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ كَاسِبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ أَبِي عَمْرٍو، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ رَأَى النَّبِيُّ ﷺ شَيْخًا يَمْشِي بَيْنَ ابْنَيْهِ فَقَالَ " مَا شَأْنُ هَذَا " . قَالَ ابْنَاهُ نَذْرٌ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ . قَالَ " ارْكَبْ أَيُّهَا الشَّيْخُ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ غَنِيٌّ عَنْكَ وَعَنْ نَذْرِكَ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Expiation, Hadith 2135

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2136

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَنْ خَلَطَ فِي نَذْرِهِ طَاعَةً بِمَعْصِيَةٍ
chapter.englishTitle: One who mixes obedience and sin in his vow

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Ibn Abbas that the :
            Messenger of Allah ﷺ passed by a man in Makkah who was standing in the sun. He said: "What is this?" They said: "He vowed to fast and not to seek shade until night comes, and not to speak, and to remain standing." He said: "Let him speak and seek shade and let him sit down, but let him complete his fast."Another chain from Ibn 'Abbas, from the Prophet ﷺ, with similar wording. expiation for breaking an oath."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Ibn Abbas that the :
hadiths.body: Messenger of Allah ﷺ passed by a man in Makkah who was standing in the sun. He said: "What is this?" They said: "He vowed to fast and not to seek shade until night comes, and not to speak, and to remain standing." He said: "Let him speak and seek shade and let him sit down, but let him complete his fast."Another chain from Ibn 'Abbas, from the Prophet ﷺ, with similar wording. expiation for breaking an oath."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ الْفَرْوِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ مَرَّ بِرَجُلٍ بِمَكَّةَ وَهُوَ قَائِمٌ فِي الشَّمْسِ فَقَالَ " مَا هَذَا " . قَالُوا نَذَرَ أَنْ يَصُومَ وَلاَ يَسْتَظِلَّ إِلَى اللَّيْلِ وَلاَ يَتَكَلَّمَ وَلاَ يَزَالَ قَائِمًا . قَالَ " لِيَتَكَلَّمْ وَلْيَسْتَظِلَّ وَلْيَجْلِسْ وَلْيُتِمَّ صِيَامَهُ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Expiation, Hadith 2136

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2137

chapter.englishTitle: Encouragement To Earn A Living

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from 'Aishah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            'The best (most pure) food a man consumes is that which he has earned himself, and his child (and his child's wealth) is part of his earnings."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from 'Aishah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: 'The best (most pure) food a man consumes is that which he has earned himself, and his child (and his child's wealth) is part of his earnings."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَعَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ حَبِيبٍ، قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنِ الأَسْوَدِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " إِنَّ أَطْيَبَ مَا أَكَلَ الرَّجُلُ مِنْ كَسْبِهِ وَإِنَّ وَلَدَهُ مِنْ كَسْبِهِ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Business Transactions, Hadith 2137

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2138

chapter.englishTitle: Encouragement To Earn A Living

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Miqdam bin Ma'dikarib (Ar- Zubaidi) that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            "No man earns anything better than that which he earns with his own hands, and what a man spends on himself, his wife, his child and his servant, then it is charity."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Miqdam bin Ma'dikarib (Ar- Zubaidi) that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: "No man earns anything better than that which he earns with his own hands, and what a man spends on himself, his wife, his child and his servant, then it is charity."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ عَيَّاشٍ، عَنْ بَحِيرِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ مَعْدَانَ، عَنِ الْمِقْدَامِ بْنِ مَعْدِيكَرِبَ الزُّبَيْدِيِّ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ  " مَا كَسَبَ الرَّجُلُ كَسْبًا أَطْيَبَ مِنْ عَمَلِ يَدِهِ وَمَا أَنْفَقَ الرَّجُلُ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ وَأَهْلِهِ وَوَلَدِهِ وَخَادِمِهِ فَهُوَ صَدَقَةٌ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Business Transactions, Hadith 2138

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2139

chapter.englishTitle: Encouragement To Earn A Living

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Ibn 'Umar that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            'The trustworthy, honest Muslim merchant will be with the martyrs on the Day of Resurrection."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Ibn 'Umar that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: 'The trustworthy, honest Muslim merchant will be with the martyrs on the Day of Resurrection."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ سِنَانٍ، حَدَّثَنَا كَثِيرُ بْنُ هِشَامٍ، حَدَّثَنَا كُلْثُومُ بْنُ جَوْشَنٍ الْقُشَيْرِيُّ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " التَّاجِرُ الأَمِينُ الصَّدُوقُ الْمُسْلِمُ مَعَ الشُّهَدَاءِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Business Transactions, Hadith 2139

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2140

chapter.englishTitle: Encouragement To Earn A Living

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Prophet ﷺ said:
            'The one who strives to support the widow and the poor is like a Mujahid who fights in the cause of Allah, and like one who stands in the night (in voluntary prayer) and fasts by day."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Prophet ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: 'The one who strives to support the widow and the poor is like a Mujahid who fights in the cause of Allah, and like one who stands in the night (in voluntary prayer) and fasts by day."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ كَاسِبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ الدَّرَاوَرْدِيُّ، عَنْ ثَوْرِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ الدِّيلِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي الْغَيْثِ، مَوْلَى ابْنِ مُطِيعٍ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ قَالَ  " السَّاعِي عَلَى الأَرْمَلَةِ وَالْمِسْكِينِ كَالْمُجَاهِدِ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ وَكَالَّذِي يَقُومُ اللَّيْلَ وَيَصُومُ النَّهَارَ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Business Transactions, Hadith 2140

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2141

chapter.englishTitle: Encouragement To Earn A Living

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Mu'adh bin 'Abdullah bin Khubaib, from his father, that his paternal uncle said:
           
 "We were sitting in a gathering, and the Prophet ﷺ came with traces of water on his head. One of us said to him: 'We see that you are of good cheer today.' He said: 'Yes, praise is to Allah.' Then he spoke to the people about being rich. He said: 'There is nothing wrong with being rich for one who has piety, but good health for one who has piety is better than riches, and being of good cheer is a blessing."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Mu'adh bin 'Abdullah bin Khubaib, from his father, that his paternal uncle said:
hadiths.body: "We were sitting in a gathering, and the Prophet ﷺ came with traces of water on his head. One of us said to him: 'We see that you are of good cheer today.' He said: 'Yes, praise is to Allah.' Then he spoke to the people about being rich. He said: 'There is nothing wrong with being rich for one who has piety, but good health for one who has piety is better than riches, and being of good cheer is a blessing."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ مُعَاذِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ خُبَيْبٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَمِّهِ، قَالَ كُنَّا فِي مَجْلِسٍ فَجَاءَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ وَعَلَى رَأْسِهِ أَثَرُ مَاءٍ فَقَالَ لَهُ بَعْضُنَا نَرَاكَ الْيَوْمَ طَيِّبَ النَّفْسِ . فَقَالَ " أَجَلْ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ " . ثُمَّ أَفَاضَ الْقَوْمُ فِي ذِكْرِ الْغِنَى فَقَالَ " لاَ بَأْسَ بِالْغِنَى لِمَنِ اتَّقَى وَالصِّحَّةُ لِمَنِ اتَّقَى خَيْرٌ مِنَ الْغِنَى وَطِيبُ النَّفْسِ مِنَ النِّعَمِ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Business Transactions, Hadith 2141

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2142

chapter.englishTitle: Moderation In Seeking To Earn A Living

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Humaid As-Sa'idi that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            Be moderate in seeking worldly things, for everyone will be facilitated for which he was created."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Humaid As-Sa'idi that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: Be moderate in seeking worldly things, for everyone will be facilitated for which he was created."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ عَيَّاشٍ، عَنْ عُمَارَةَ بْنِ غَزِيَّةَ، عَنْ رَبِيعَةَ بْنِ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ الأَنْصَارِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي حُمَيْدٍ السَّاعِدِيِّ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " أَجْمِلُوا فِي طَلَبِ الدُّنْيَا فَإِنَّ كُلاًّ مُيَسَّرٌ لِمَا خُلِقَ لَهُ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Business Transactions, Hadith 2142

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2143

chapter.englishTitle: Moderation In Seeking To Earn A Living

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Anas bin Malik that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            The one who has the most concerns is the believer who is concerned about both his worldly affairs and his Hereafter."' (Da'if)Abu 'Abdullah said: "This Hadith is Gharib' Isma'il, alone, has narrated it."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Anas bin Malik that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: The one who has the most concerns is the believer who is concerned about both his worldly affairs and his Hereafter."' (Da'if)Abu 'Abdullah said: "This Hadith is Gharib' Isma'il, alone, has narrated it."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ بَهْرَامَ، حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ، زَوْجُ بِنْتِ الشَّعْبِيِّ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ الرَّقَاشِيِّ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " أَعْظَمُ النَّاسِ هَمًّا الْمُؤْمِنُ الَّذِي يَهُمُّ بِأَمْرِ دُنْيَاهُ وَأَمْرِ آخِرَتِهِ " . قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ هَذَا حَدِيثٌ غَرِيبٌ تَفَرَّدَ بِهِ إِسْمَاعِيلُ .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Business Transactions, Hadith 2143

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2144

chapter.englishTitle: Moderation In Seeking To Earn A Living

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Jabir bin 'Abdullah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            "O people, fear Allah and be moderate in seeking a living, for no soul will die until it has received all its provision, even if it is slow in coming. So fear Allah and be moderate in seeking provision; take that which is permissible and leave that which is forbidden. "
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Jabir bin 'Abdullah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: "O people, fear Allah and be moderate in seeking a living, for no soul will die until it has received all its provision, even if it is slow in coming. So fear Allah and be moderate in seeking provision; take that which is permissible and leave that which is forbidden. "
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُصَفَّى الْحِمْصِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ اتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَأَجْمِلُوا فِي الطَّلَبِ فَإِنَّ نَفْسًا لَنْ تَمُوتَ حَتَّى تَسْتَوْفِيَ رِزْقَهَا وَإِنْ أَبْطَأَ عَنْهَا فَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَأَجْمِلُوا فِي الطَّلَبِ خُذُوا مَا حَلَّ وَدَعُوا مَا حَرُمَ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Business Transactions, Hadith 2144

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2145

chapter.englishTitle: Fearing Allah In Business

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Qais bin Abu Gharazah said:
            "At the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ we used to be called brokers, but the Messenger of Allah ﷺ passed by us and called by a name that was better than that. He said: 'O merchants, selling involves (false) oaths and idle talk, so mix some charity with it."'
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Qais bin Abu Gharazah said:
hadiths.body: "At the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ we used to be called brokers, but the Messenger of Allah ﷺ passed by us and called by a name that was better than that. He said: 'O merchants, selling involves (false) oaths and idle talk, so mix some charity with it."'
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ شَقِيقٍ، عَنْ قَيْسِ بْنِ أَبِي غَرَزَةَ، قَالَ كُنَّا نُسَمَّى فِي عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ السَّمَاسِرَةَ فَمَرَّ بِنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَسَمَّانَا بِاسْمٍ هُوَ أَحْسَنُ مِنْهُ فَقَالَ  " يَا مَعْشَرَ التُّجَّارِ إِنَّ الْبَيْعَ يَحْضُرُهُ الْحَلِفُ وَاللَّغْوُ فَشُوبُوهُ بِالصَّدَقَةِ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Business Transactions, Hadith 2145

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2146

chapter.englishTitle: Fearing Allah In Business

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Isma'il bin 'Ubaid bin Rifa'ah, from his father, that his grandfather Rifa'ah said:
            "We went out with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and the people were trading early in the morning. He called them: 'O merchants!' and when they looked up and craned their necks, he said : 'The merchants will be raised on the Day of Resurrection as immoral people, apart from those who fear Allah and act righteously and speak the truth (i.e. those who are honest)."'
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Isma'il bin 'Ubaid bin Rifa'ah, from his father, that his grandfather Rifa'ah said:
hadiths.body: "We went out with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and the people were trading early in the morning. He called them: 'O merchants!' and when they looked up and craned their necks, he said : 'The merchants will be raised on the Day of Resurrection as immoral people, apart from those who fear Allah and act righteously and speak the truth (i.e. those who are honest)."'
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ كَاسِبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سُلَيْمٍ الطَّائِفِيُّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ خُثَيْمٍ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ رِفَاعَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ، رِفَاعَةَ قَالَ خَرَجْنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَإِذَا النَّاسُ يَتَبَايَعُونَ بُكْرَةً فَنَادَاهُمْ " يَا مَعْشَرَ التُّجَّارِ " . فَلَمَّا رَفَعُوا أَبْصَارَهُمْ وَمَدُّوا أَعْنَاقَهُمْ قَالَ " إِنَّ التُّجَّارَ يُبْعَثُونَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ فُجَّارًا إِلاَّ مَنِ اتَّقَى اللَّهَ وَبَرَّ وَصَدَقَ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Business Transactions, Hadith 2146

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2147

chapter.arabicTitle: باب إِذَا قُسِمَ لِلرَّجُلِ رِزْقٌ مِنْ وَجْهٍ فَلْيَلْزَمْهُ
chapter.englishTitle: If A Man Finds A Way Of Earning A Living, Let Him Stick With It

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Anas bin Malik that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            'Whoever achieves at something, let him stick with It.'"
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Anas bin Malik that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: 'Whoever achieves at something, let him stick with It.'"
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا فَرْوَةُ أَبُو يُونُسَ، عَنْ هِلاَلِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " مَنْ أَصَابَ مِنْ شَىْءٍ فَلْيَلْزَمْهُ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Business Transactions, Hadith 2147

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2148

chapter.arabicTitle: باب إِذَا قُسِمَ لِلرَّجُلِ رِزْقٌ مِنْ وَجْهٍ فَلْيَلْزَمْهُ
chapter.englishTitle: If A Man Finds A Way Of Earning A Living, Let Him Stick With It

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Nafi' said:
            I used to send trade goods to Sham and Egypt, then I prepared to send trade goods to 'Iraq. I went to 'Aishah, the Mother of the Believers, and said to her: " O Mother of the Believers I used to send trade goods to Sham and I am preparing to send trade goods to 'Iraq." She said: "Do not do that. What is wrong with the way you have been doing it? I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: 'If Allah causes provision to come to one of you through a certain means, he should not leave it unless it changes or deteriorates."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Nafi' said:
hadiths.body: I used to send trade goods to Sham and Egypt, then I prepared to send trade goods to 'Iraq. I went to 'Aishah, the Mother of the Believers, and said to her: " O Mother of the Believers I used to send trade goods to Sham and I am preparing to send trade goods to 'Iraq." She said: "Do not do that. What is wrong with the way you have been doing it? I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: 'If Allah causes provision to come to one of you through a certain means, he should not leave it unless it changes or deteriorates."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي أَبِي، عَنِ الزُّبَيْرِ بْنِ عُبَيْدٍ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، قَالَ كُنْتُ أُجَهِّزُ إِلَى الشَّامِ وَإِلَى مِصْرَ فَجَهَّزْتُ إِلَى الْعِرَاقِ فَأَتَيْتُ عَائِشَةَ أُمَّ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ فَقُلْتُ لَهَا يَا أُمَّ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ كُنْتُ أُجَهِّزُ إِلَى الشَّامِ فَجَهَّزْتُ إِلَى الْعِرَاقِ . فَقَالَتْ لاَ تَفْعَلْ مَالَكَ وَلِمَتْجَرِكَ فَإِنِّي سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ  " إِذَا سَبَّبَ اللَّهُ لأَحَدِكُمْ رِزْقًا مِنْ وَجْهٍ فَلاَ يَدَعْهُ حَتَّى يَتَغَيَّرَ لَهُ أَوْ يَتَنَكَّرَ لَهُ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Business Transactions, Hadith 2148

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2149

chapter.englishTitle: Occupations

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            "Allah has not sent any Prophet but he was a shepherd." His Companions said to him: "Even you, O Messenger of Allah?" He said: "Even me I used to tend the sheep of the people of Makkah for a few Qirats." (One of the narrators) Suwaid said: " Meaning one Qirat for every sheep."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: "Allah has not sent any Prophet but he was a shepherd." His Companions said to him: "Even you, O Messenger of Allah?" He said: "Even me I used to tend the sheep of the people of Makkah for a few Qirats." (One of the narrators) Suwaid said: " Meaning one Qirat for every sheep."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا سُوَيْدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ الْقُرَشِيُّ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ، سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي أُحَيْحَةَ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ " مَا بَعَثَ اللَّهُ نَبِيًّا إِلاَّ رَاعِيَ غَنَمٍ " . قَالَ لَهُ أَصْحَابُهُ وَأَنْتَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ . قَالَ " وَأَنَا كُنْتُ أَرْعَاهَا لأَهْلِ مَكَّةَ بِالْقَرَارِيطِ " . قَالَ سُوَيْدٌ يَعْنِي كُلُّ شَاةٍ بِقِيرَاطٍ .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Business Transactions, Hadith 2149

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2150

chapter.englishTitle: Occupations

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            "Zakariyya was a carpenter."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: "Zakariyya was a carpenter."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْخُزَاعِيُّ، وَالْحَجَّاجُ، وَالْهَيْثَمُ بْنُ جَمِيلٍ، قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ أَبِي رَافِعٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ  " كَانَ زَكَرِيَّا نَجَّارًا " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Business Transactions, Hadith 2150

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2151

chapter.englishTitle: Occupations

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from 'Aishah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            "The image-makers will be punished on the Day of Resurrection and will be told: 'Give life to that which you have created.' "
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from 'Aishah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: "The image-makers will be punished on the Day of Resurrection and will be told: 'Give life to that which you have created.' "
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رُمْحٍ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ  " إِنَّ أَصْحَابَ الصُّوَرِ يُعَذَّبُونَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ يُقَالُ لَهُمْ أَحْيُوا مَا خَلَقْتُمْ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Business Transactions, Hadith 2151

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2152

chapter.englishTitle: Occupations

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            "The most dishonest of people are the dyers and the goldsmiths. "[1]
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: "The most dishonest of people are the dyers and the goldsmiths. "[1]
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ هَارُونَ، عَنْ هَمَّامٍ، عَنْ فَرْقَدٍ السَّبَخِيِّ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الشِّخِّيرِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " أَكْذَبُ النَّاسِ الصَّبَّاغُونَ وَالصَّوَّاغُونَ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Business Transactions, Hadith 2152

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2153

chapter.englishTitle: Hoarding And Importing

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from 'Umar bin Khattab that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            "The importer is blessed with provision and the hoarder is cursed."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from 'Umar bin Khattab that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: "The importer is blessed with provision and the hoarder is cursed."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا نَصْرُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ الْجَهْضَمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أَحْمَدَ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ سَالِمِ بْنِ ثَوْبَانَ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ زَيْدِ بْنِ جُدْعَانَ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " الْجَالِبُ مَرْزُوقٌ وَالْمُحْتَكِرُ مَلْعُونٌ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Business Transactions, Hadith 2153

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2154

chapter.englishTitle: Hoarding And Importing

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Ma'mar bin 'Abdullah bin Nadlah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            "No one hoards but a sinner."'
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Ma'mar bin 'Abdullah bin Nadlah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: "No one hoards but a sinner."'
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نَضْلَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " لاَ يَحْتَكِرُ إِلاَّ خَاطِئٌ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Business Transactions, Hadith 2154

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2155

chapter.englishTitle: Hoarding And Importing

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that 'Umar bin Khattab said:
            "I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: 'Whoever hoards food (and keeps it from) the Muslims, Allah will afflict him with leprosy and bankruptcy."'
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that 'Umar bin Khattab said:
hadiths.body: "I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: 'Whoever hoards food (and keeps it from) the Muslims, Allah will afflict him with leprosy and bankruptcy."'
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَكِيمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ الْحَنَفِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا الْهَيْثَمُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو يَحْيَى الْمَكِّيُّ، عَنْ فَرُّوخَ، مَوْلَى عُثْمَانَ بْنِ عَفَّانَ عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ  " مَنِ احْتَكَرَ عَلَى الْمُسْلِمِينَ طَعَامَهُمْ ضَرَبَهُ اللَّهُ بِالْجُذَامِ وَالإِفْلاَسِ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Business Transactions, Hadith 2155

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2156

chapter.englishTitle: The Wages If The Raqt

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri said:
            "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ sent us, thirty horsemen, on a military campaign. We camped near some people and asked them for hospitality but they refused. Then their leader was stung by a scorpion and they said: 'Is there anyone among you who can recite Ruqyah for a scorpion sting?' I said: 'Yes, I can, but I will not recite Ruqyah for him until you give us some sheep.' They said: 'We will give you thirty sheep.' So we accepted them, and I recited Al-Hamd (i.e. Al-Fatihah) over him seven times. Then he recovered, and I took the sheep. Then some doubts occurred within ourselves. Then we said: 'Let us not hasten (to make a decision concerning the sheep) until we come to the Prophet ﷺ' So when we came back: 'I told him what I had done. He said: 'How did you know that it is a Ruqyah? Divide them up and give me a share as well.'"
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri said:
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ sent us, thirty horsemen, on a military campaign. We camped near some people and asked them for hospitality but they refused. Then their leader was stung by a scorpion and they said: 'Is there anyone among you who can recite Ruqyah for a scorpion sting?' I said: 'Yes, I can, but I will not recite Ruqyah for him until you give us some sheep.' They said: 'We will give you thirty sheep.' So we accepted them, and I recited Al-Hamd (i.e. Al-Fatihah) over him seven times. Then he recovered, and I took the sheep. Then some doubts occurred within ourselves. Then we said: 'Let us not hasten (to make a decision concerning the sheep) until we come to the Prophet ﷺ' So when we came back: 'I told him what I had done. He said: 'How did you know that it is a Ruqyah? Divide them up and give me a share as well.'"
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ إِيَاسٍ، عَنْ أَبِي نَضْرَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، قَالَ بَعَثَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ ثَلاَثِينَ رَاكِبًا فِي سَرِيَّةٍ فَنَزَلْنَا بِقَوْمٍ فَسَأَلْنَاهُمْ أَنْ يَقْرُونَا فَأَبَوْا فَلُدِغَ سَيِّدُهُمْ فَأَتَوْنَا فَقَالُوا أَفِيكُمْ أَحَدٌ يَرْقِي مِنَ الْعَقْرَبِ فَقُلْتُ نَعَمْ أَنَا وَلَكِنْ لاَ أَرْقِيهِ حَتَّى تُعْطُونَا غَنَمًا . قَالُوا فَإِنَّا نُعْطِيكُمْ ثَلاَثِينَ شَاةً . فَقَبِلْنَاهَا فَقَرَأْتُ عَلَيْهِ ( الْحَمْدُ ) سَبْعَ مَرَّاتٍ فَبَرِئَ وَقَبَضْنَا الْغَنَمَ فَعَرَضَ فِي أَنْفُسِنَا مِنْهَا شَىْءٌ فَقُلْنَا لاَ تَعْجَلُوا حَتَّى نَأْتِيَ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ فَلَمَّا قَدِمْنَا ذَكَرْتُ لَهُ الَّذِي صَنَعْتُ فَقَالَ  " أَوَ مَا عَلِمْتَ أَنَّهَا رُقْيَةٌ اقْتَسِمُوهَا وَاضْرِبُوا لِي مَعَكُمْ سَهْمًا " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Business Transactions, Hadith 2156

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2157

chapter.englishTitle: Wages For Teaching Quran

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that 'Ubadah bin Samit said:
            "I taught people from Ahtus-Suffah" Qur'an and how to write, and one of them gave me a bow. I said: 'It is not money, and I can shoot (with it) for the sake of Allah., I asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ about it and he said: 'If it would please you to have a necklace of fire placed around your neck, then accept it.'"
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that 'Ubadah bin Samit said:
hadiths.body: "I taught people from Ahtus-Suffah" Qur'an and how to write, and one of them gave me a bow. I said: 'It is not money, and I can shoot (with it) for the sake of Allah., I asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ about it and he said: 'If it would please you to have a necklace of fire placed around your neck, then accept it.'"
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، حَدَّثَنَا مُغِيرَةُ بْنُ زِيَادٍ الْمَوْصِلِيُّ، عَنْ عُبَادَةَ بْنِ نُسَىٍّ، عَنِ الأَسْوَدِ بْنِ ثَعْلَبَةَ، عَنْ عُبَادَةَ بْنِ الصَّامِتِ، قَالَ عَلَّمْتُ نَاسًا مِنْ أَهْلِ الصُّفَّةِ الْقُرْآنَ وَالْكِتَابَةَ فَأَهْدَى إِلَىَّ رَجُلٌ مِنْهُمْ قَوْسًا فَقُلْتُ لَيْسَتْ بِمَالٍ وَأَرْمِي عَنْهَا فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ فَسَأَلْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَنْهَا فَقَالَ  " إِنْ سَرَّكَ أَنْ تُطَوَّقَ بِهَا طَوْقًا مِنْ نَارٍ فَاقْبَلْهَا " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Business Transactions, Hadith 2157

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2158

chapter.englishTitle: Wages For Teaching Quran

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Ubayy bin Ka'b said:
            "I taught a man the Qur'an, and he gave me a bow. I mentioned that to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and he said: 'If you accept it you will be accepting a bow of fire.' So I returned it."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Ubayy bin Ka'b said:
hadiths.body: "I taught a man the Qur'an, and he gave me a bow. I mentioned that to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and he said: 'If you accept it you will be accepting a bow of fire.' So I returned it."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا سَهْلُ بْنُ أَبِي سَهْلٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ ثَوْرِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَعْدَانَ، حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ سَلْمٍ، عَنْ عَطِيَّةَ الْكَلاَعِيِّ، عَنْ أُبَىِّ بْنِ كَعْبٍ، قَالَ عَلَّمْتُ رَجُلاً الْقُرْآنَ فَأَهْدَى إِلَىَّ قَوْسًا فَذَكَرْتُ ذَلِكَ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَقَالَ  " إِنْ أَخَذْتَهَا أَخَذْتَ قَوْسًا مِنْ نَارٍ " . فَرَدَدْتُهَا .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Business Transactions, Hadith 2158

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2159

chapter.arabicTitle: باب النَّهْىِ عَنْ ثَمَنِ الْكَلْبِ، وَمَهْرِ الْبَغِيِّ، وَحُلْوَانِ الْكَاهِنِ، وَعَسْبِ الْفَحْلِ
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition Of The Price (Given) to A Prostitute, The Payment Made To A Soothsayer And St

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Mas'ud that :
            the Prophet ﷺ forbade the price of a dog, the payment (given to a prostitute) and the payment made to a soothsayer.
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Mas'ud that :
hadiths.body: the Prophet ﷺ forbade the price of a dog, the payment (given to a prostitute) and the payment made to a soothsayer.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الصَّبَّاحِ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ أَبِي مَسْعُودٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ نَهَى عَنْ ثَمَنِ الْكَلْبِ وَمَهْرِ الْبَغِيِّ وَحُلْوَانِ الْكَاهِنِ .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Business Transactions, Hadith 2159

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2160

chapter.arabicTitle: باب النَّهْىِ عَنْ ثَمَنِ الْكَلْبِ، وَمَهْرِ الْبَغِيِّ، وَحُلْوَانِ الْكَاهِنِ، وَعَسْبِ الْفَحْلِ
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition Of The Price (Given) to A Prostitute, The Payment Made To A Soothsayer And St

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Abu Hurairah said:
            "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade the price of a dog and studding a stallion."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Abu Hurairah said:
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade the price of a dog and studding a stallion."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ طَرِيفٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ فُضَيْلٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَنْ ثَمَنِ الْكَلْبِ وَعَسْبِ الْفَحْلِ.
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Business Transactions, Hadith 2160

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2161

chapter.arabicTitle: باب النَّهْىِ عَنْ ثَمَنِ الْكَلْبِ، وَمَهْرِ الْبَغِيِّ، وَحُلْوَانِ الْكَاهِنِ، وَعَسْبِ الْفَحْلِ
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition Of The Price (Given) to A Prostitute, The Payment Made To A Soothsayer And St

hadiths.englishRaw:
lt was narrated from Abu Az-Zubair that Jabir said:
            "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade the price of a cat."
hadiths.narrator: lt was narrated from Abu Az-Zubair that Jabir said:
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade the price of a cat."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ، أَنْبَأَنَا ابْنُ لَهِيعَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَنْ ثَمَنِ السِّنَّوْرِ .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Business Transactions, Hadith 2161

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2162

chapter.englishTitle: Earnings Of A Cupper

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Ibn 'Abbas that :
            the Prophet ﷺ was treated with cupping and he gave him (the cupper) his wages. Ibn Abu 'Umar was alone in narrating it. That was said by Ibn Majah. [1]
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Ibn 'Abbas that :
hadiths.body: the Prophet ﷺ was treated with cupping and he gave him (the cupper) his wages. Ibn Abu 'Umar was alone in narrating it. That was said by Ibn Majah. [1]
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ الْعَدَنِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ طَاوُسٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ احْتَجَمَ وَأَعْطَاهُ أَجْرَهُ . قَالَ ابْنُ مَاجَهْ تَفَرَّدَ بِهِ ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ وَحْدَهُ .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Business Transactions, Hadith 2162

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2163

chapter.englishTitle: Earnings Of A Cupper

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that 'Ali said:
            "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ was treated with cupping and he told me to give the cupper his wages."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that 'Ali said:
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ was treated with cupping and he told me to give the cupper his wages."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَلِيٍّ أَبُو حَفْصٍ الصَّيْرَفِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبَادَةَ الْوَاسِطِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الأَعْلَى، عَنْ أَبِي جَمِيلَةَ عَنْ عَلِيٍّ، قَالَ احْتَجَمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَأَمَرَنِي فَأَعْطَيْتُ الْحَجَّامَ أَجْرَهُ .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Business Transactions, Hadith 2163

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2164

chapter.englishTitle: Earnings Of A Cupper

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Anas bin Malik that:
            the Prophet ﷺ was treated with cupping and gave the cupper his wages.
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Anas bin Malik that:
hadiths.body: the Prophet ﷺ was treated with cupping and gave the cupper his wages.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْحَمِيدِ بْنُ بَيَانٍ الْوَاسِطِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ يُونُسَ، عَنِ ابْنِ سِيرِينَ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ احْتَجَمَ وَأَعْطَى الْحَجَّامَ أَجْرَهُ .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Business Transactions, Hadith 2164

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2165

chapter.englishTitle: Earnings Of A Cupper

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Abu Mas'ud, 'Uqbah bin 'Amr, said:
            "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ, forbade the earnings of a cupper."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Abu Mas'ud, 'Uqbah bin 'Amr, said:
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ, forbade the earnings of a cupper."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَمْزَةَ، حَدَّثَنِي الأَوْزَاعِيُّ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ بْنِ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ أَبِي مَسْعُودٍ، عُقْبَةَ بْنِ عَمْرٍو قَالَ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَنْ كَسْبِ الْحَجَّامِ .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Business Transactions, Hadith 2165

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2166

chapter.englishTitle: Earnings Of A Cupper

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Haram bin Munayyisah that :
            his father asked the Prophet ﷺ about the earnings of a cupper and he forbade him from that. Then he mentioned his need and he said: "Spend it on feeding your she-camels that draw water."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Haram bin Munayyisah that :
hadiths.body: his father asked the Prophet ﷺ about the earnings of a cupper and he forbade him from that. Then he mentioned his need and he said: "Spend it on feeding your she-camels that draw water."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا شَبَابَةُ بْنُ سَوَّارٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ حَرَامِ بْنِ مُحَيِّصَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّهُ سَأَلَ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ عَنْ كَسْبِ الْحَجَّامِ فَنَهَاهُ عَنْهُ فَذَكَرَ لَهُ الْحَاجَةَ فَقَالَ  " اعْلِفْهُ نَوَاضِحَكَ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Business Transactions, Hadith 2166

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2167

chapter.englishTitle: What It Is Not Permissible To Sell

hadiths.englishRaw:
Ata' bin Abu Rabah said:
            I heard Jabir bin 'Abdullah say: "In the Year of the Conquest, while he was in Makkah the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, said: 'Allah and His Messenger have forbidden the sale of wines, meat of dead animals, pigs and 'idols.' It was said to him: 'O Messenger of Allah, what do you think of the fat of dead animals, for it is used to caulk ships, it is daubed on animal skins and people use it to light their lamps?' He said: 'No, it is unlawful.' Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'May Allah curse the jews, for Allah forbade them the fat (of animals) but they rendered it, (i.e. melted it) sold it and consumed its price."'
hadiths.narrator: Ata' bin Abu Rabah said:
hadiths.body: I heard Jabir bin 'Abdullah say: "In the Year of the Conquest, while he was in Makkah the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, said: 'Allah and His Messenger have forbidden the sale of wines, meat of dead animals, pigs and 'idols.' It was said to him: 'O Messenger of Allah, what do you think of the fat of dead animals, for it is used to caulk ships, it is daubed on animal skins and people use it to light their lamps?' He said: 'No, it is unlawful.' Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'May Allah curse the jews, for Allah forbade them the fat (of animals) but they rendered it, (i.e. melted it) sold it and consumed its price."'
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عِيسَى بْنُ حَمَّادٍ الْمِصْرِيُّ، أَنْبَأَنَا اللَّيْثُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ قَالَ عَطَاءُ بْنُ أَبِي رَبَاحٍ سَمِعْتُ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَامَ الْفَتْحِ وَهُوَ بِمَكَّةَ " إِنَّ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ حَرَّمَ بَيْعَ الْخَمْرِ وَالْمَيْتَةِ وَالْخِنْزِيرِ وَالأَصْنَامِ " . فَقِيلَ لَهُ عِنْدَ ذَلِكَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَرَأَيْتَ شُحُومَ الْمَيْتَةِ فَإِنَّهُ يُدْهَنُ بِهَا السُّفُنُ وَيُدْهَنُ بِهَا الْجُلُودُ وَيَسْتَصْبِحُ بِهَا النَّاسُ قَالَ " لاَ هُنَّ حَرَامٌ " . ثُمَّ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ " قَاتَلَ اللَّهُ الْيَهُودَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ حَرَّمَ عَلَيْهِمُ الشُّحُومَ فَأَجْمَلُوهُ ثُمَّ بَاعُوهُ فَأَكَلُوا ثَمَنَهُ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Business Transactions, Hadith 2167

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2168

chapter.englishTitle: What It Is Not Permissible To Sell

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Abu Umamah said:
            "The Messenger of Allah, forbade selling or buying singing girls, and their wages, and consuming their price."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Abu Umamah said:
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah, forbade selling or buying singing girls, and their wages, and consuming their price."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ الْقَطَّانُ، حَدَّثَنَا هَاشِمُ بْنُ الْقَاسِمِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ الرَّازِيُّ، عَنْ عَاصِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الْمُهَلَّبِ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ الإِفْرِيقِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي أُمَامَةَ، قَالَ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَنْ بَيْعِ الْمُغَنِّيَاتِ وَعَنْ شِرَائِهِنَّ وَعَنْ كَسْبِهِنَّ وَعَنْ أَكْلِ أَثْمَانِهِنَّ .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Business Transactions, Hadith 2168

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2169

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي النَّهْىِ عَنِ الْمُنَابَذَةِ، وَالْمُلاَمَسَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: What Was Narrated Concerning The Prohibition Of Muhabadhah And Mulamsah

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Abu Hurairah said:
            "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade two kinds of transactions: Mulimasah and Mundbadhah.
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Abu Hurairah said:
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade two kinds of transactions: Mulimasah and Mundbadhah.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، وَأَبُو أُسَامَةَ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنْ خُبَيْبِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ حَفْصِ بْنِ عَاصِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَنْ بَيْعَتَيْنِ عَنِ الْمُلاَمَسَةِ وَالْمُنَابَذَةِ .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Business Transactions, Hadith 2169

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2170

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي النَّهْىِ عَنِ الْمُنَابَذَةِ، وَالْمُلاَمَسَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: What Was Narrated Concerning The Prohibition Of Muhabadhah And Mulamsah

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri that :
            the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade Mulamasah and Munabadhah.  Sahl added: "Sufyan said: 'Mulamasah means when a man touches something with his hand without seeing it, and Munabadhah means when he says: "Toss me what you have, and I will toss you what have."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri that :
hadiths.body: the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade Mulamasah and Munabadhah.  Sahl added: "Sufyan said: 'Mulamasah means when a man touches something with his hand without seeing it, and Munabadhah means when he says: "Toss me what you have, and I will toss you what have."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَسَهْلُ بْنُ أَبِي سَهْلٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ اللَّيْثِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ نَهَى عَنِ الْمُلاَمَسَةِ وَالْمُنَابَذَةِ . زَادَ سَهْلٌ قَالَ سُفْيَانُ الْمُلاَمَسَةُ أَنْ يَلْمِسَ الرَّجُلُ الشَّىْءَ بِيَدِهِ وَلاَ يَرَاهُ وَالْمُنَابَذَةُ أَنْ يَقُولَ أَلْقِ إِلَىَّ مَا مَعَكَ وَأُلْقِي إِلَيْكَ مَا مَعِي .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Business Transactions, Hadith 2170

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2171

chapter.arabicTitle: باب لاَ يَبِيعُ الرَّجُلُ عَلَى بَيْعِ أَخِيهِ وَلاَ يَسُومُ عَلَى سَوْمِهِ
chapter.englishTitle: “A Man Is Not To Undersell The Sale Of His Brother, Nor Is He To Try To Out-Haggle His B

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Ibn 'Umar that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            "Let one of you not undersell another."[1]
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Ibn 'Umar that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: "Let one of you not undersell another."[1]
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا سُوَيْدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ  " لاَ يَبِيعُ بَعْضُكُمْ عَلَى بَيْعِ بَعْضٍ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Business Transactions, Hadith 2171

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2172

chapter.arabicTitle: باب لاَ يَبِيعُ الرَّجُلُ عَلَى بَيْعِ أَخِيهِ وَلاَ يَسُومُ عَلَى سَوْمِهِ
chapter.englishTitle: “A Man Is Not To Undersell The Sale Of His Brother, Nor Is He To Try To Out-Haggle His B

hadiths.englishRaw:
lt was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Prophet ﷺ said:
            "A man is not to undersell his brother, nor is he to fry to outhaggle his brother."
hadiths.narrator: lt was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Prophet ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: "A man is not to undersell his brother, nor is he to fry to outhaggle his brother."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ  " لاَ يَبِيعُ الرَّجُلُ عَلَى بَيْعِ أَخِيهِ وَلاَ يَسُومُ عَلَى سَوْمِ أَخِيهِ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Business Transactions, Hadith 2172

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2173

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي النَّهْىِ عَنِ النَّجْشِ
chapter.englishTitle: What Was Narrated Concerning The Prohibition Of Najsh

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Ibn 'Umar that :
            the Prophet ﷺ forbade the Najsh.
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Ibn 'Umar that :
hadiths.body: the Prophet ﷺ forbade the Najsh.
hadiths.arabic: قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مُصْعَبِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الزُّبَيْرِيِّ عَنْ مَالِكٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حُذَافَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ نَهَى عَنِ النَّجْشِ .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Business Transactions, Hadith 2173

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2174

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي النَّهْىِ عَنِ النَّجْشِ
chapter.englishTitle: What Was Narrated Concerning The Prohibition Of Najsh

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Prophet ﷺ said:
            "Do not practice Najsh."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Prophet ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: "Do not practice Najsh."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، وَسَهْلُ بْنُ أَبِي سَهْلٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ  " لاَ تَنَاجَشُوا " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Business Transactions, Hadith 2174

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2175

chapter.arabicTitle: باب النَّهْىِ أَنْ يَبِيعَ حَاضِرٌ لِبَادٍ
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition Of A City-Dweller Selling On Behalf Of A Bedouin

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            "A City-dweller should not sell for a Bedouin."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: "A City-dweller should not sell for a Bedouin."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ  " لاَ يَبِيعُ حَاضِرٌ لِبَادٍ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Business Transactions, Hadith 2175

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2176

chapter.arabicTitle: باب النَّهْىِ أَنْ يَبِيعَ حَاضِرٌ لِبَادٍ
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition Of A City-Dweller Selling On Behalf Of A Bedouin

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Jabir bin 'Abdullah that the Prophet ﷺ said:
            "A city-dweller should not sell for a Bedouin. Leave people to (engage in trade) and Allah will grant them provision through one another."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Jabir bin 'Abdullah that the Prophet ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: "A city-dweller should not sell for a Bedouin. Leave people to (engage in trade) and Allah will grant them provision through one another."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ قَالَ  " لاَ يَبِيعُ حَاضِرٌ لِبَادٍ دَعُوا النَّاسَ يَرْزُقُ اللَّهُ بَعْضَهُمْ مِنْ بَعْضٍ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Business Transactions, Hadith 2176

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2177

chapter.arabicTitle: باب النَّهْىِ أَنْ يَبِيعَ حَاضِرٌ لِبَادٍ
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition Of A City-Dweller Selling On Behalf Of A Bedouin

hadiths.englishRaw:
Ibn Tawus narrated from his father that Ibn 'Abbas said:
            "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade a city-dweller to sell for a Bedouin." I (Tawus) said to Ibn 'Abbas: "What is meant by the words: 'A city-dweller selling for a Bedouin?' He said: "He should not be a broker for him."
hadiths.narrator: Ibn Tawus narrated from his father that Ibn 'Abbas said:
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade a city-dweller to sell for a Bedouin." I (Tawus) said to Ibn 'Abbas: "What is meant by the words: 'A city-dweller selling for a Bedouin?' He said: "He should not be a broker for him."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا الْعَبَّاسُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْعَظِيمِ الْعَنْبَرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَنْبَأَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ طَاوُسٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَنْ يَبِيعَ حَاضِرٌ لِبَادٍ . قُلْتُ لاِبْنِ عَبَّاسٍ مَا قَوْلُهُ حَاضِرٌ لِبَادٍ قَالَ لاَ يَكُونُ لَهُ سِمْسَارًا .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Business Transactions, Hadith 2177

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2178

chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition Of Meeting Traders On The Way

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Prophet ﷺ said:
            "Do not meet the traders on the way, and whoever meets any of them and buys from him, the vendor has the choice of annulling the transaction when he comes to the marketplace.''
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Prophet ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: "Do not meet the traders on the way, and whoever meets any of them and buys from him, the vendor has the choice of annulling the transaction when he comes to the marketplace.''
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَعَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنِ هِشَامِ بْنِ حَسَّانَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِيرِينَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ  " لاَ تَلَقَّوُا الأَجْلاَبَ فَمَنْ تَلَقَّى مِنْهُ شَيْئًا فَاشْتَرَى فَصَاحِبُهُ بِالْخِيَارِ إِذَا أَتَى السُّوقَ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Business Transactions, Hadith 2178

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2179

chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition Of Meeting Traders On The Way

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Ibn 'Umar said:
            "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade meeting traders on the way."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Ibn 'Umar said:
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade meeting traders on the way."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَةُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَنْ تَلَقِّي الْجَلَبِ .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Business Transactions, Hadith 2179

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2180

chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition Of Meeting Traders On The Way

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that 'Abdullah bin Mas'ud said:
            "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade. meeting the owners of goods (away from the market)."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that 'Abdullah bin Mas'ud said:
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade. meeting the owners of goods (away from the market)."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَكِيمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَحَمَّادُ بْنُ مَسْعَدَةَ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ التَّيْمِيِّ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ حَبِيبِ بْنِ الشَّهِيدِ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعْتَمِرُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبِي قَالَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عُثْمَانَ النَّهْدِيُّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، قَالَ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَنْ تَلَقِّي الْبُيُوعِ .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Business Transactions, Hadith 2180

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2181

chapter.arabicTitle: باب الْبَيِّعَانِ بِالْخِيَارِ مَا لَمْ يَفْتَرِقَا
chapter.englishTitle: The Two Parties To A Transaction Have The Choice (Of Annulling It) So Long As They Have

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from 'Abdullah bin 'Umar that the Messenger of Allah said:
            "When two men enter into a transaction, each of them has the choice (of annulling it) so long as they have not yet parted and are still together, or one of them has given the option or choice to the other. Once he has accepted the terms of the other, then the transaction is binding. If they part after concluding the transaction and neither of them has rescinded the transaction then the transaction is binding.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from 'Abdullah bin 'Umar that the Messenger of Allah said:
hadiths.body: "When two men enter into a transaction, each of them has the choice (of annulling it) so long as they have not yet parted and are still together, or one of them has given the option or choice to the other. Once he has accepted the terms of the other, then the transaction is binding. If they part after concluding the transaction and neither of them has rescinded the transaction then the transaction is binding.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رُمْحٍ الْمِصْرِيُّ، أَنْبَأَنَا اللَّيْثُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ  " إِذَا تَبَايَعَ الرَّجُلاَنِ فَكُلُّ وَاحِدٍ مِنْهُمَا بِالْخِيَارِ مَا لَمْ يَتَفَرَّقَا وَكَانَا جَمِيعًا أَوْ يُخَيِّرْ أَحَدُهُمَا الآخَرَ فَإِنْ خَيَّرَ أَحَدُهُمَا الآخَرَ فَتَبَايَعَا عَلَى ذَلِكَ فَقَدْ وَجَبَ الْبَيْعُ . وَإِنْ تَفَرَّقَا بَعْدَ أَنْ تَبَايَعَا وَلَمْ يَتْرُكْ وَاحِدٌ مِنْهُمَا الْبَيْعَ فَقَدْ وَجَبَ الْبَيْعُ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Business Transactions, Hadith 2181

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2182

chapter.arabicTitle: باب الْبَيِّعَانِ بِالْخِيَارِ مَا لَمْ يَفْتَرِقَا
chapter.englishTitle: The Two Parties To A Transaction Have The Choice (Of Annulling It) So Long As They Have

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Barzah Al-Aslami that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            ”The two parties to a transaction have the choice (of annulling it) so long as they have not yet parted."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Barzah Al-Aslami that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: ”The two parties to a transaction have the choice (of annulling it) so long as they have not yet parted."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدَةَ، وَأَحْمَدُ بْنُ الْمِقْدَامِ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ جَمِيلِ بْنِ مُرَّةَ، عَنْ أَبِي الْوَضِيءِ، عَنْ أَبِي بَرْزَةَ الأَسْلَمِيِّ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " الْبَيِّعَانِ بِالْخِيَارِ مَا لَمْ يَتَفَرَّقَا " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Business Transactions, Hadith 2182

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2183

chapter.arabicTitle: باب الْبَيِّعَانِ بِالْخِيَارِ مَا لَمْ يَفْتَرِقَا
chapter.englishTitle: The Two Parties To A Transaction Have The Choice (Of Annulling It) So Long As They Have

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Samurah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            "The two parties to a transaction have the choice (of annulling it) so long as they have not yet parted. "
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Samurah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: "The two parties to a transaction have the choice (of annulling it) so long as they have not yet parted. "
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الصَّمَدِ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، عَنْ سَمُرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " الْبَيِّعَانِ بِالْخِيَارِ مَا لَمْ يَتَفَرَّقَا " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Business Transactions, Hadith 2183

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2184

chapter.englishTitle: A Transaction With The Option To Cancel

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Jabir bin' Abdullah said:
            "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ bought a load of fodder from a Bedouin man. When the transaction was concluded, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'Choose (either to go ahead or to cancel the transaction).' The Bedouin said: 'May Allah grant you a long life of good transaction!"'
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Jabir bin' Abdullah said:
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ bought a load of fodder from a Bedouin man. When the transaction was concluded, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'Choose (either to go ahead or to cancel the transaction).' The Bedouin said: 'May Allah grant you a long life of good transaction!"'
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَأَحْمَدُ بْنُ عِيسَى الْمِصْرِيَّانِ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ اشْتَرَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ مِنْ رَجُلٍ مِنَ الأَعْرَابِ حِمْلَ خَبَطٍ فَلَمَّا وَجَبَ الْبَيْعُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " اخْتَرْ " . فَقَالَ الأَعْرَابِيُّ عَمْرَكَ اللَّهَ بَيِّعًا .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Business Transactions, Hadith 2184

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2185

chapter.englishTitle: A Transaction With The Option To Cancel

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Dawud bin Salih Al Madani that his father said:
            I heard Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri say: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'Transactions may only be done by mutual consent."'
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Dawud bin Salih Al Madani that his father said:
hadiths.body: I heard Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri say: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'Transactions may only be done by mutual consent."'
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا الْعَبَّاسُ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ الدِّمَشْقِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا مَرْوَانُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ دَاوُدَ بْنِ صَالِحٍ الْمَدَنِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيَّ، يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " إِنَّمَا الْبَيْعُ عَنْ تَرَاضٍ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Business Transactions, Hadith 2185

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2186

chapter.englishTitle: Parties To A Transaction Who Differ With One Another

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Qasim bin 'Abdur Rahman from his father that :
            Abdullah bin Mas'ud sold one of the slaves from the state[1] to Ash'ath bin Qais, and they differed concerning the price. Ibn Mas'ud said: "I sold him to you for twenty thousand,' but Ash'ath bin Qais said: "I bought him from you for ten thousand." 'Abdullah said: "If you want, I will tell you a Hadith which I heard from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ" He said: "Tell me it." He said: "I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: 'If two parties to a transaction differ, and they have no proof, and the sale item remains (unredeemed), then what the seller says is valid. Or they may cancel the transaction." He said: "I want to cancel the transaction." And he cancelled it.
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Qasim bin 'Abdur Rahman from his father that :
hadiths.body: Abdullah bin Mas'ud sold one of the slaves from the state[1] to Ash'ath bin Qais, and they differed concerning the price. Ibn Mas'ud said: "I sold him to you for twenty thousand,' but Ash'ath bin Qais said: "I bought him from you for ten thousand." 'Abdullah said: "If you want, I will tell you a Hadith which I heard from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ" He said: "Tell me it." He said: "I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: 'If two parties to a transaction differ, and they have no proof, and the sale item remains (unredeemed), then what the seller says is valid. Or they may cancel the transaction." He said: "I want to cancel the transaction." And he cancelled it.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الصَّبَّاحِ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، أَنْبَأَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي لَيْلَى، عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ مَسْعُودٍ، بَاعَ مِنَ الأَشْعَثِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ رَقِيقًا مِنْ رَقِيقِ الإِمَارَةِ فَاخْتَلَفَا فِي الثَّمَنِ . فَقَالَ ابْنُ مَسْعُودٍ بِعْتُكَ بِعِشْرِينَ أَلْفًا . وَقَالَ الأَشْعَثُ بْنُ قَيْسٍ إِنَّمَا اشْتَرَيْتُ مِنْكَ بِعَشْرَةِ آلاَفٍ . فَقَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ إِنْ شِئْتَ حَدَّثْتُكَ بِحَدِيثٍ سَمِعْتُهُ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ . فَقَالَ هَاتِهِ . قَالَ فَإِنِّي سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ  " إِذَا اخْتَلَفَ الْبَيِّعَانِ وَلَيْسَ بَيْنَهُمَا بَيِّنَةٌ وَالْبَيْعُ قَائِمٌ بِعَيْنِهِ فَالْقَوْلُ مَا قَالَ الْبَائِعُ أَوْ يَتَرَادَّانِ الْبَيْعَ " . قَالَ فَإِنِّي أَرَى أَنْ أَرُدَّ الْبَيْعَ . فَرَدَّهُ .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Business Transactions, Hadith 2186

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2187

chapter.arabicTitle: باب النَّهْىِ عَنْ بَيْعِ، مَا لَيْسَ عِنْدَكَ وَعَنْ رِبْحِ، مَا لَمْ يُضْمَنْ
chapter.englishTitle: The Prohibition Of Selling What Is Not With You, And From Profiting On What You Do Not P

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Hakim bin Hizam said:
            "I said: 'O Messenger of Allah, a man is asking me to sell him something that I do not possess; Shall I sell it to him?' He said: 'Do not sell what is not with you."'
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Hakim bin Hizam said:
hadiths.body: "I said: 'O Messenger of Allah, a man is asking me to sell him something that I do not possess; Shall I sell it to him?' He said: 'Do not sell what is not with you."'
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ أَبِي بِشْرٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ يُوسُفَ بْنَ مَاهَكَ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ حَكِيمِ بْنِ حِزَامٍ، قَالَ قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ الرَّجُلُ يَسْأَلُنِي الْبَيْعَ وَلَيْسَ عِنْدِي أَفَأَبِيعُهُ قَالَ  " لاَ تَبِعْ مَا لَيْسَ عِنْدَكَ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Business Transactions, Hadith 2187

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2188

chapter.arabicTitle: باب النَّهْىِ عَنْ بَيْعِ، مَا لَيْسَ عِنْدَكَ وَعَنْ رِبْحِ، مَا لَمْ يُضْمَنْ
chapter.englishTitle: The Prohibition Of Selling What Is Not With You, And From Profiting On What You Do Not P

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from 'Amr bin Shu'aib, from his father, that his grandfather said:
            "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'It is not permissible to sell something that is not with you, nor to profit from what you do not possess."'
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from 'Amr bin Shu'aib, from his father, that his grandfather said:
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'It is not permissible to sell something that is not with you, nor to profit from what you do not possess."'
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَزْهَرُ بْنُ مَرْوَانَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ شُعَيْبٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " لاَ يَحِلُّ بَيْعُ مَا لَيْسَ عِنْدَكَ وَلاَ رِبْحُ مَا لَمْ يُضْمَنْ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Business Transactions, Hadith 2188

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2189

chapter.arabicTitle: باب النَّهْىِ عَنْ بَيْعِ، مَا لَيْسَ عِنْدَكَ وَعَنْ رِبْحِ، مَا لَمْ يُضْمَنْ
chapter.englishTitle: The Prohibition Of Selling What Is Not With You, And From Profiting On What You Do Not P

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from 'Ata that 'Attab bin Asid said that :
            when the Messenger of Allah ﷺ sent him to Makkah, he forbade him from profiting off of what he did not possess.
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from 'Ata that 'Attab bin Asid said that :
hadiths.body: when the Messenger of Allah ﷺ sent him to Makkah, he forbade him from profiting off of what he did not possess.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْفُضَيْلِ، عَنْ لَيْثٍ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، عَنْ عَتَّابِ بْنِ أَسِيدٍ، قَالَ لَمَّا بَعَثَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ إِلَى مَكَّةَ نَهَاهُ عَنْ شِفِّ مَا لَمْ يُضْمَنْ .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Business Transactions, Hadith 2189

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2190

chapter.arabicTitle: باب إِذَا بَاعَ الْمُجِيزَانِ فَهُوَ لِلأَوَّلِ
chapter.englishTitle: If Two Authorized Persons Make A Sale, Then The First Transaction Is The One That Is Val

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from 'Uqbah bin 'Amir or Samurah bin Jundab that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            "Any man who sells to two men, it is for the one who was first."[1]
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from 'Uqbah bin 'Amir or Samurah bin Jundab that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: "Any man who sells to two men, it is for the one who was first."[1]
