hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا حُمَيْدُ بْنُ مَسْعَدَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ الْحَارِثِ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدٌ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، عَنْ عُقْبَةَ بْنِ عَامِرٍ، أَوْ سَمُرَةَ بْنِ جُنْدُبٍ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ  " أَيُّمَا رَجُلٍ بَاعَ بَيْعًا مِنْ رَجُلَيْنِ فَهُوَ لِلأَوَّلِ مِنْهُمَا " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Business Transactions, Hadith 2190

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2191

chapter.arabicTitle: باب إِذَا بَاعَ الْمُجِيزَانِ فَهُوَ لِلأَوَّلِ
chapter.englishTitle: If Two Authorized Persons Make A Sale, Then The First Transaction Is The One That Is Val

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Samurah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, said:
            "If two (separate) authorized persons make a sale (of the same thing), then the first transaction is the one that is valid. "
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Samurah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, said:
hadiths.body: "If two (separate) authorized persons make a sale (of the same thing), then the first transaction is the one that is valid. "
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ أَبِي السَّرِيِّ الْعَسْقَلاَنِيُّ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ بَشِيرٍ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، عَنْ سَمُرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " إِذَا بَاعَ الْمُجِيزَانِ فَهُوَ لِلأَوَّلِ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Business Transactions, Hadith 2191

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2192

chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition On Earnest Money

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from 'Amr bin Shu'aib, from his father, from his grandfather that :
            the Prophet ﷺ forbade the deal involving earnest money .
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from 'Amr bin Shu'aib, from his father, from his grandfather that :
hadiths.body: the Prophet ﷺ forbade the deal involving earnest money .
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ بَلَغَنِي عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ شُعَيْبٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ نَهَى عَنْ بَيْعِ الْعُرْبَانِ .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Business Transactions, Hadith 2192

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2193

chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition On Earnest Money

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from 'Amr bin Shu'aib, from his father, from his grandfather that :
            the Prophet ﷺ forbade the deal involving earnest money. Abu 'Abdullah said: Earnest money refers to when a man buys an animal for one hundred Dinar, then he gives the seller two Dinar in advance and says: "If I do not buy the animal, then the two Dinar are yours." And it was said that it refers, and Allah knows best, to when a man buys something, and gives the seller a Dirham or less or more, and says: "If I take it (all well and good), and if I do not, then the Dirham is yours."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from 'Amr bin Shu'aib, from his father, from his grandfather that :
hadiths.body: the Prophet ﷺ forbade the deal involving earnest money. Abu 'Abdullah said: Earnest money refers to when a man buys an animal for one hundred Dinar, then he gives the seller two Dinar in advance and says: "If I do not buy the animal, then the two Dinar are yours." And it was said that it refers, and Allah knows best, to when a man buys something, and gives the seller a Dirham or less or more, and says: "If I take it (all well and good), and if I do not, then the Dirham is yours."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا الْفَضْلُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ الرُّخَامِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا حَبِيبُ بْنُ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ أَبُو مُحَمَّدٍ، كَاتِبُ مَالِكِ بْنِ أَنَسٍ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَامِرٍ الأَسْلَمِيُّ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ شُعَيْبٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ نَهَى عَنْ بَيْعِ الْعُرْبَانِ . قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْعُرْبَانُ أَنْ يَشْتَرِيَ الرَّجُلُ دَابَّةً بِمِائَةِ دِينَارٍ فَيُعْطِيَهُ دِينَارَيْنِ أَرْبُونًا فَيَقُولَ إِنْ لَمْ أَشْتَرِ الدَّابَّةَ فَالدِّينَارَانِ لَكَ .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Business Transactions, Hadith 2193

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2194

chapter.arabicTitle: باب النَّهْىِ عَنْ بَيْعِ الْحَصَاةِ، وَعَنْ بَيْعِ الْغَرَرِ
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition Of Hasah And Gharar Transactions

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Abu Hurairah said:
            "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade Gharar transaction sand Hasah transactions. "
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Abu Hurairah said:
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade Gharar transaction sand Hasah transactions. "
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحْرِزُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ الْعَدَنِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَنْ بَيْعِ الْغَرَرِ وَعَنْ بَيْعِ الْحَصَاةِ .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Business Transactions, Hadith 2194

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2195

chapter.arabicTitle: باب النَّهْىِ عَنْ بَيْعِ الْحَصَاةِ، وَعَنْ بَيْعِ الْغَرَرِ
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition Of Hasah And Gharar Transactions

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Ibn 'Abbas said:
            "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade Gharar transactions. "
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Ibn 'Abbas said:
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade Gharar transactions. "
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، وَالْعَبَّاسُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْعَظِيمِ الْعَنْبَرِيُّ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا الأَسْوَدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ بْنُ عُتْبَةَ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَنْ بَيْعِ الْغَرَرِ .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Business Transactions, Hadith 2195

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2196

chapter.arabicTitle: باب النَّهْىِ عَنْ شِرَاءِ، مَا فِي بُطُونِ الأَنْعَامِ وَضُرُوعِهَا وَضَرْبَةِ الْغَائِصِ
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition Of Buying What Is In The Wombs And Udders Of Cattle, And Whatever A Diver Is

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri said:
            “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade selling what is in the wombs of cattle until they give birth, and selling what is in their udders unless it is measured out, and selling a slave who has fled, and selling spoils of war until it has been distributed, and selling Sadaqah until it has been received, and what a diver is going to bring up."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri said:
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade selling what is in the wombs of cattle until they give birth, and selling what is in their udders unless it is measured out, and selling a slave who has fled, and selling spoils of war until it has been distributed, and selling Sadaqah until it has been received, and what a diver is going to bring up."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَاتِمُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا جَهْضَمُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْيَمَامِيُّ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الْبَاهِلِيِّ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ الْعَبْدِيِّ، عَنْ شَهْرِ بْنِ حَوْشَبٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، قَالَ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَنْ شِرَاءِ مَا فِي بُطُونِ الأَنْعَامِ حَتَّى تَضَعَ وَعَمَّا فِي ضُرُوعِهَا إِلاَّ بِكَيْلٍ وَعَنْ شِرَاءِ الْعَبْدِ وَهُوَ آبِقٌ وَعَنْ شِرَاءِ الْمَغَانِمِ حَتَّى تُقْسَمَ وَعَنْ شِرَاءِ الصَّدَقَاتِ حَتَّى تُقْبَضَ وَعَنْ ضَرْبَةِ الْغَائِصِ .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Business Transactions, Hadith 2196

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2197

chapter.arabicTitle: باب النَّهْىِ عَنْ شِرَاءِ، مَا فِي بُطُونِ الأَنْعَامِ وَضُرُوعِهَا وَضَرْبَةِ الْغَائِصِ
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition Of Buying What Is In The Wombs And Udders Of Cattle, And Whatever A Diver Is

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Ibn 'Umar that :
            the Prophet ﷺ forbade selling Hablul-Habalah.
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Ibn 'Umar that :
hadiths.body: the Prophet ﷺ forbade selling Hablul-Habalah.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ نَهَى عَنْ بَيْعِ حَبَلِ الْحَبَلَةِ .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Business Transactions, Hadith 2197

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2198

chapter.englishTitle: Auctions

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Anas bin Malik that :
            a man from among the Ansar came to the Prophet ﷺ and begged from him. He said, "Do you have anything in your house?" He said: "Yes, a blanket, part of which we cover ourselves with and part we spread beneath us, and a bowl from which we drink water." He said: "Givethem to me." So he brought them to him, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ took them in his hand and said, "Who will by these two things?" A man said: "I will by them for one Dirham." He said: "Who will offer more than a Dirham?" two or three times. A man said: "I will buy them for two Dirham." So he gave them to him and took the two Dirham, which he gave to the Ansari and said: "Buy food with one of them and give it to your family, and buy an axe with the other and bring it to me." So he did that, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ took it and fixed a handle to it, and said: "Go and gather firewood, and I do not want to see you for fifteen days." So he went and gathered firewood and sold it, then he came back, and he had earned ten Dirham. (The Prophet ﷺ) said: "Buy food with some of it and clothes with some." Then he said: "This is better for you than coming with begging (appearing) as a spot on your face on the Day of Resurrection. Begging is only appropriate for one who is extremely poor or who is in severe debt, or one who must pay painful blood money.”[1]
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Anas bin Malik that :
hadiths.body: a man from among the Ansar came to the Prophet ﷺ and begged from him. He said, "Do you have anything in your house?" He said: "Yes, a blanket, part of which we cover ourselves with and part we spread beneath us, and a bowl from which we drink water." He said: "Givethem to me." So he brought them to him, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ took them in his hand and said, "Who will by these two things?" A man said: "I will by them for one Dirham." He said: "Who will offer more than a Dirham?" two or three times. A man said: "I will buy them for two Dirham." So he gave them to him and took the two Dirham, which he gave to the Ansari and said: "Buy food with one of them and give it to your family, and buy an axe with the other and bring it to me." So he did that, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ took it and fixed a handle to it, and said: "Go and gather firewood, and I do not want to see you for fifteen days." So he went and gathered firewood and sold it, then he came back, and he had earned ten Dirham. (The Prophet ﷺ) said: "Buy food with some of it and clothes with some." Then he said: "This is better for you than coming with begging (appearing) as a spot on your face on the Day of Resurrection. Begging is only appropriate for one who is extremely poor or who is in severe debt, or one who must pay painful blood money.”[1]
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عِيسَى بْنُ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَخْضَرُ بْنُ عَجْلاَنَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ الْحَنَفِيُّ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّ رَجُلاً، مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ جَاءَ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ ﷺ يَسْأَلُهُ فَقَالَ " لَكَ فِي بَيْتِكَ شَىْءٌ " . قَالَ بَلَى حِلْسٌ نَلْبَسُ بَعْضَهُ وَنَبْسُطُ بَعْضَهُ وَقَدَحٌ نَشْرَبُ فِيهِ الْمَاءَ . قَالَ " ائْتِنِي بِهِمَا " . قَالَ فَأَتَاهُ بِهِمَا فَأَخَذَهُمَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ بِيَدِهِ ثُمَّ قَالَ " مَنْ يَشْتَرِي هَذَيْنِ " . فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ أَنَا آخُذُهُمَا بِدِرْهَمٍ . قَالَ " مَنْ يَزِيدُ عَلَى دِرْهَمٍ " . مَرَّتَيْنِ أَوْ ثَلاَثًا قَالَ رَجُلٌ أَنَا آخُذُهُمَا بِدِرْهَمَيْنِ . فَأَعْطَاهُمَا إِيَّاهُ وَأَخَذَ الدِّرْهَمَيْنِ فَأَعْطَاهُمَا الأَنْصَارِيَّ وَقَالَ " اشْتَرِ بِأَحَدِهِمَا طَعَامًا فَانْبِذْهُ إِلَى أَهْلِكَ وَاشْتَرِ بِالآخَرِ قَدُومًا فَأْتِنِي بِهِ " . فَفَعَلَ فَأَخَذَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَشَدَّ فِيهِ عُودًا بِيَدِهِ وَقَالَ " اذْهَبْ فَاحْتَطِبْ وَلاَ أَرَاكَ خَمْسَةَ عَشَرَ يَوْمًا " . فَجَعَلَ يَحْتَطِبُ وَيَبِيعُ فَجَاءَ وَقَدْ أَصَابَ عَشْرَةَ دَرَاهِمَ فَقَالَ " اشْتَرِ بِبَعْضِهَا طَعَامًا وَبِبَعْضِهَا ثَوْبًا " . ثُمَّ قَالَ " هَذَا خَيْرٌ لَكَ مِنْ أَنْ تَجِيءَ وَالْمَسْأَلَةُ نُكْتَةٌ فِي وَجْهِكَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ إِنَّ الْمَسْأَلَةَ لاَ تَصْلُحُ إِلاَّ لِذِي فَقْرٍ مُدْقِعٍ أَوْ لِذِي غُرْمٍ مُفْظِعٍ أَوْ دَمٍ مُوجِعٍ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Business Transactions, Hadith 2198

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2199

chapter.englishTitle: Letting Someone Off

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            Whoever agrees with a Muslim to cancel a transaction Allah will forgive his sins on the Day of Resurrection. "
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: Whoever agrees with a Muslim to cancel a transaction Allah will forgive his sins on the Day of Resurrection. "
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا زِيَادُ بْنُ يَحْيَى أَبُو الْخَطَّابِ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكُ بْنُ سُعَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " مَنْ أَقَالَ مُسْلِمًا أَقَالَهُ اللَّهُ عَثْرَتَهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Business Transactions, Hadith 2199

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2200

chapter.englishTitle: Whoever Does Not Like To Fix Prices

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was nanated that Anas bin Malik said:
            "Prices rose during the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and they said: 'O Messenger of Allah, prices have risen, so fix the prices for us.' He said: 'Indeed Allah is the Musa'ir, [1] the Qabid, (Restrainer) the Basit,[2] the Razzaq (Provider). And I am hopeful that I meet my Lord and none of you are seeking (recompense from) me for an injustice involving blood or wealth."
hadiths.narrator: It was nanated that Anas bin Malik said:
hadiths.body: "Prices rose during the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and they said: 'O Messenger of Allah, prices have risen, so fix the prices for us.' He said: 'Indeed Allah is the Musa'ir, [1] the Qabid, (Restrainer) the Basit,[2] the Razzaq (Provider). And I am hopeful that I meet my Lord and none of you are seeking (recompense from) me for an injustice involving blood or wealth."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجٌ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، وَحُمَيْدٍ، وَثَابِتٍ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ غَلاَ السِّعْرُ عَلَى عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَقَالُوا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَدْ غَلاَ السِّعْرُ فَسَعِّرْ لَنَا . فَقَالَ  " إِنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ الْمُسَعِّرُ الْقَابِضُ الْبَاسِطُ الرَّازِقُ إِنِّي لأَرْجُو أَنْ أَلْقَى رَبِّي وَلَيْسَ أَحَدٌ يَطْلُبُنِي بِمَظْلَمَةٍ فِي دَمٍ وَلاَ مَالٍ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Business Transactions, Hadith 2200

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2201

chapter.englishTitle: Whoever Does Not Like To Fix Prices

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Abu Sa'eed said:
            "Prices rose at the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and they said: 'Why do you not fix the food prices, O Messenger of Allah?' He said: 'I hope that when I leave you, no one among you will be demanding restitution for a wrong that I have done to him."'
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Abu Sa'eed said:
hadiths.body: "Prices rose at the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and they said: 'Why do you not fix the food prices, O Messenger of Allah?' He said: 'I hope that when I leave you, no one among you will be demanding restitution for a wrong that I have done to him."'
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ زِيَادٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الأَعْلَى، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدٌ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي نَضْرَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، قَالَ غَلاَ السِّعْرُ عَلَى عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَقَالُوا لَوْ قَوَّمْتَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ  " إِنِّي لأَرْجُو أَنْ أُفَارِقَكُمْ وَلاَ يَطْلُبَنِي أَحَدٌ مِنْكُمْ بِمَظْلَمَةٍ ظَلَمْتُهُ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Business Transactions, Hadith 2201

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2202

chapter.englishTitle: Being Lenient During Transactions

hadiths.englishRaw:
'Uthman bin 'Affan narrated that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            “Allah will admit to Paradise a man who was lenient when he sold and when he bought. "
hadiths.narrator: 'Uthman bin 'Affan narrated that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “Allah will admit to Paradise a man who was lenient when he sold and when he bought. "
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَبَانَ الْبَلْخِيُّ أَبُو بَكْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ، عَنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ عُبَيْدٍ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ فَرُّوخَ، قَالَ قَالَ عُثْمَانُ بْنُ عَفَّانَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " أَدْخَلَ اللَّهُ رَجُلاً الْجَنَّةَ كَانَ سَهْلاً بَائِعًا وَمُشْتَرِيًا " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Business Transactions, Hadith 2202

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2203

chapter.englishTitle: Being Lenient During Transactions

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Jabir bin 'Abdullah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            "May Allah have mercy on a person who is lenient when he sells, lenient when he buys, and lenient when he asks for payment. "
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Jabir bin 'Abdullah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: "May Allah have mercy on a person who is lenient when he sells, lenient when he buys, and lenient when he asks for payment. "
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ سَعِيدِ بْنِ كَثِيرِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ الْحِمْصِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو غَسَّانَ، مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مُطَرِّفٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْمُنْكَدِرِ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " رَحِمَ اللَّهُ عَبْدًا سَمْحًا إِذَا بَاعَ سَمْحًا إِذَا اشْتَرَى سَمْحًا إِذَا اقْتَضَى " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Business Transactions, Hadith 2203

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2204

chapter.englishTitle: Haggling

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Qailah Umm Bani Anmar said:
            "I came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, during one of his 'Umrah at Marwah and said: 'O Messenger of Allah, I am a woman who buys and sells. When I want to buy something, I state a price less than I want to pay, then I raise it gradually until it reaches the price I want to pay. And when I want to sell something, I state a price more than I want, then I lower it until it reaches the price I want.' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'Do not do that, O Qailah. When you want to buy something, state the price you want, whether it is given or not. And when you want to sell something, state the price you want, whether it is given or not.'"
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Qailah Umm Bani Anmar said:
hadiths.body: "I came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, during one of his 'Umrah at Marwah and said: 'O Messenger of Allah, I am a woman who buys and sells. When I want to buy something, I state a price less than I want to pay, then I raise it gradually until it reaches the price I want to pay. And when I want to sell something, I state a price more than I want, then I lower it until it reaches the price I want.' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'Do not do that, O Qailah. When you want to buy something, state the price you want, whether it is given or not. And when you want to sell something, state the price you want, whether it is given or not.'"
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ كَاسِبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْلَى بْنُ شَبِيبٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ خُثَيْمٍ، عَنْ قَيْلَةَ أُمِّ بَنِي أَنْمَارٍ، قَالَتْ أَتَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ فِي بَعْضِ عُمَرِهِ عِنْدَ الْمَرْوَةِ فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي امْرَأَةٌ أَبِيعُ وَأَشْتَرِي فَإِذَا أَرَدْتُ أَنْ أَبْتَاعَ الشَّىْءَ سُمْتُ بِهِ أَقَلَّ مِمَّا أُرِيدُ ثُمَّ زِدْتُ ثُمَّ زِدْتُ حَتَّى أَبْلُغَ الَّذِي أُرِيدُ وَإِذَا أَرَدْتُ أَنْ أَبِيعَ الشَّىْءَ سُمْتُ بِهِ أَكْثَرَ مِنَ الَّذِي أُرِيدُ ثُمَّ وَضَعْتُ حَتَّى أَبْلُغَ الَّذِي أُرِيدُ . فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ " لاَ تَفْعَلِي يَا قَيْلَةُ إِذَا أَرَدْتِ أَنْ تَبْتَاعِي شَيْئًا فَاسْتَامِي بِهِ الَّذِي تُرِيدِينَ أُعْطِيتِ أَوْ مُنِعْتِ " . وَقَالَ " إِذَا أَرَدْتِ أَنْ تَبِيعِي شَيْئًا فَاسْتَامِي بِهِ الَّذِي تُرِيدِينَ أَعْطَيْتِ أَوْ مَنَعْتِ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Business Transactions, Hadith 2204

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2205

chapter.englishTitle: Haggling

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Jabir bin 'Abdullah said:
            "I was with the Prophet ﷺ on a military campaign, and he said to me: 'Will you sell this camel of yours for a Dinar?' I said: 'O Messenger of Allah, it is yours when I get to Al-Madinah.' He said: 'Then sell it for two Dinar, may Allah forgive you.' And he kept increasing the price for me, saying: 'May Allah forgive you,' each time, until the amount reached twenty Dinar. When I came to Al-Madinah, I took hold of the camel's head and brought it to the Prophet ﷺ and he said: 'O Bilal, give him twenty Dinar from the spoils of war.' And he said: 'Take your camel away and go to your people with it.'"
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Jabir bin 'Abdullah said:
hadiths.body: "I was with the Prophet ﷺ on a military campaign, and he said to me: 'Will you sell this camel of yours for a Dinar?' I said: 'O Messenger of Allah, it is yours when I get to Al-Madinah.' He said: 'Then sell it for two Dinar, may Allah forgive you.' And he kept increasing the price for me, saying: 'May Allah forgive you,' each time, until the amount reached twenty Dinar. When I came to Al-Madinah, I took hold of the camel's head and brought it to the Prophet ﷺ and he said: 'O Bilal, give him twenty Dinar from the spoils of war.' And he said: 'Take your camel away and go to your people with it.'"
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ، عَنِ الْجُرَيْرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي نَضْرَةَ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ كُنْتُ مَعَ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ فِي غَزْوَةٍ فَقَالَ لِي " أَتَبِيعُ نَاضِحَكَ هَذَا بِدِينَارٍ وَاللَّهُ يَغْفِرُ لَكَ " . قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ هُوَ نَاضِحُكُمْ إِذَا أَتَيْتُ الْمَدِينَةَ . قَالَ " فَتَبِيعُهُ بِدِينَارَيْنِ وَاللَّهُ يَغْفِرُ لَكَ " . قَالَ فَمَا زَالَ يَزِيدُنِي دِينَارًا دِينَارًا وَيَقُولُ مَكَانَ كُلِّ دِينَارٍ " وَاللَّهُ يَغْفِرُ لَكَ " . حَتَّى بَلَغَ عِشْرِينَ دِينَارًا فَلَمَّا أَتَيْتُ الْمَدِينَةَ أَخَذْتُ بِرَأْسِ النَّاضِحِ فَأَتَيْتُ بِهِ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ فَقَالَ " يَا بِلاَلُ أَعْطِهِ مِنَ الْعَيْبَةِ عِشْرِينَ دِينَارًا " . وَقَالَ " انْطَلِقْ بِنَاضِحِكَ وَاذْهَبْ بِهِ إِلَى أَهْلِكَ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Business Transactions, Hadith 2205

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2206

chapter.englishTitle: Haggling

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that 'Ali said:
            "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade haggling before sunrise, and (he forbade) slaughtering animals that yield milk."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that 'Ali said:
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade haggling before sunrise, and (he forbade) slaughtering animals that yield milk."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، وَسَهْلُ بْنُ أَبِي سَهْلٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى، أَنْبَأَنَا الرَّبِيعُ بْنُ حَبِيبٍ، عَنْ نَوْفَلِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ، قَالَ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَنِ السَّوْمِ قَبْلَ طُلُوعِ الشَّمْسِ وَعَنْ ذَبْحِ ذَوَاتِ الدَّرِّ .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Business Transactions, Hadith 2206

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2207

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي كَرَاهِيَةِ الأَيْمَانِ فِي الشِّرَاءِ وَالْبَيْعِ
chapter.englishTitle: What Was Narrated About It Being Disliked To Swear Oaths When Buying And Selling

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            "There are three to whom Allah will not speak on the Day of Resurrection, nor will He look at them or purify them, and theirs will be a painful torment: A man who has surplus water in the desert but refuses to give any to a wayfarer; a man who sells a product to a man after 'Asr and swears by Allah that he bought it for such and such amount, and he believes him, when that is not the case; and a man who swears allegiance to a ruler, and only does so for worldly gains, so if he gives him some of (these worldly benefits) he fulfills his oath of allegiance, and if he is not given anything he does not uphold his oath of allegiance. "
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: "There are three to whom Allah will not speak on the Day of Resurrection, nor will He look at them or purify them, and theirs will be a painful torment: A man who has surplus water in the desert but refuses to give any to a wayfarer; a man who sells a product to a man after 'Asr and swears by Allah that he bought it for such and such amount, and he believes him, when that is not the case; and a man who swears allegiance to a ruler, and only does so for worldly gains, so if he gives him some of (these worldly benefits) he fulfills his oath of allegiance, and if he is not given anything he does not uphold his oath of allegiance. "
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَعَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، وَأَحْمَدُ بْنُ سِنَانٍ، قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " ثَلاَثَةٌ لاَ يُكَلِّمُهُمُ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ وَلاَ يَنْظُرُ إِلَيْهِمْ وَلاَ يُزَكِّيهِمْ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ رَجُلٌ عَلَى فَضْلِ مَاءٍ بِالْفَلاَةِ يَمْنَعُهُ ابْنَ السَّبِيلِ وَرَجُلٌ بَايَعَ رَجُلاً سِلْعَةً بَعْدَ الْعَصْرِ فَحَلَفَ بِاللَّهِ لأَخَذَهَا بِكَذَا وَكَذَا فَصَدَّقَهُ وَهُوَ عَلَى غَيْرِ ذَلِكَ وَرَجُلٌ بَايَعَ إِمَامًا لاَ يُبَايِعُهُ إِلاَّ لِدُنْيَا فَإِنْ أَعْطَاهُ مِنْهَا وَفَى لَهُ وَإِنْ لَمْ يُعْطِهِ مِنْهَا لَمْ يَفِ لَهُ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Business Transactions, Hadith 2207

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2208

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي كَرَاهِيَةِ الأَيْمَانِ فِي الشِّرَاءِ وَالْبَيْعِ
chapter.englishTitle: What Was Narrated About It Being Disliked To Swear Oaths When Buying And Selling

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Dharr that the Prophet ﷺ said:
            "There are three to whom Allah will not speak on the Day of Resurrection nor will He look at them or purify them, and theirs will be a painful torment." I said: "Who are they, O Messenger of Allah? For they are indeed losers." He said: "The one who lets his garment hang beneath his ankles, the one who reminds another of what he has given him, and the one who sells his product by means of false oaths."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Dharr that the Prophet ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: "There are three to whom Allah will not speak on the Day of Resurrection nor will He look at them or purify them, and theirs will be a painful torment." I said: "Who are they, O Messenger of Allah? For they are indeed losers." He said: "The one who lets his garment hang beneath his ankles, the one who reminds another of what he has given him, and the one who sells his product by means of false oaths."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنِ الْمَسْعُودِيِّ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مُدْرِكٍ، عَنْ خَرَشَةَ بْنِ الْحُرِّ، عَنْ أَبِي ذَرٍّ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مُدْرِكٍ، عَنْ أَبِي زُرْعَةَ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ جَرِيرٍ، عَنْ خَرَشَةَ بْنِ الْحُرِّ، عَنْ أَبِي ذَرٍّ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ " ثَلاَثَةٌ لاَ يُكَلِّمُهُمُ اللَّهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ وَلاَ يَنْظُرُ إِلَيْهِمْ وَلاَ يُزَكِّيهِمْ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ " . فَقُلْتُ مَنْ هُمْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ فَقَدْ خَابُوا وَخَسِرُوا . قَالَ " الْمُسْبِلُ إِزَارَهُ وَالْمَنَّانُ عَطَاءَهُ وَالْمُنَفِّقُ سِلْعَتَهُ بِالْحَلِفِ الْكَاذِبِ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Business Transactions, Hadith 2208

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2209

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي كَرَاهِيَةِ الأَيْمَانِ فِي الشِّرَاءِ وَالْبَيْعِ
chapter.englishTitle: What Was Narrated About It Being Disliked To Swear Oaths When Buying And Selling

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Qatadah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, said:
            "Beware of swearing oaths when selling, for it may help you to make a sale but it destroys the blessing."'
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Qatadah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, said:
hadiths.body: "Beware of swearing oaths when selling, for it may help you to make a sale but it destroys the blessing."'
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ خَلَفٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الأَعْلَى، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ عَيَّاشٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ مَعْبَدِ بْنِ كَعْبِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " إِيَّاكُمْ وَالْحَلِفَ فِي الْبَيْعِ فَإِنَّهُ يُنَفِّقُ ثُمَّ يَمْحَقُ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Business Transactions, Hadith 2209

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2210

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِيمَنْ بَاعَ نَخْلاً مُؤَبَّرًا أَوْ عَبْدًا لَهُ مَالٌ
chapter.englishTitle: What Was Narrated Concerning One Who Sells A Pollinated Palm Tree Or A Slave Who Has Wea

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Ibn 'Umar that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            "Whoever buys a palm tree that has been pollinated, its fruits belong to the seller, unless the purchaser stipulated a condition." 
Another chain from Ibn 'Umar, from the Prophet ﷺ, with similar wording.
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Ibn 'Umar that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body:
"Whoever buys a palm tree that has been pollinated, its fruits belong to the seller, unless the purchaser stipulated a condition." 
Another chain from Ibn 'Umar, from the Prophet ﷺ, with similar wording.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي نَافِعٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ قَالَ  " مَنِ اشْتَرَى نَخْلاً قَدْ أُبِّرَتْ فَثَمَرَتُهَا لِلْبَائِعِ إِلاَّ أَنْ يَشْتَرِطَ الْمُبْتَاعُ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Business Transactions, Hadith 2210

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2211

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِيمَنْ بَاعَ نَخْلاً مُؤَبَّرًا أَوْ عَبْدًا لَهُ مَالٌ
chapter.englishTitle: What Was Narrated Concerning One Who Sells A Pollinated Palm Tree Or A Slave Who Has Wea

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Salim bin 'Abdullah, bin 'Umar, from Ibn 'Umar, that :
            the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever sells a palm tree that has been pollinated, its fruits belong to the seller, unless the purchaser stipulated a condition. And whoever buys a slave who has wealth, his wealth belongs to the seller, unless the purchaser stipulated a condition."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Salim bin 'Abdullah, bin 'Umar, from Ibn 'Umar, that :
hadiths.body: the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever sells a palm tree that has been pollinated, its fruits belong to the seller, unless the purchaser stipulated a condition. And whoever buys a slave who has wealth, his wealth belongs to the seller, unless the purchaser stipulated a condition."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رُمْحٍ، أَنْبَأَنَا اللَّيْثُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، جَمِيعًا عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ  " مَنْ بَاعَ نَخْلاً قَدْ أُبِّرَتْ فَثَمَرَتُهَا لِلَّذِي بَاعَهَا إِلاَّ أَنْ يَشْتَرِطَ الْمُبْتَاعُ وَمَنِ ابْتَاعَ عَبْدًا وَلَهُ مَالٌ فَمَالُهُ لِلَّذِي بَاعَهُ إِلاَّ أَنْ يَشْتَرِطَ الْمُبْتَاعُ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Business Transactions, Hadith 2211

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2212

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِيمَنْ بَاعَ نَخْلاً مُؤَبَّرًا أَوْ عَبْدًا لَهُ مَالٌ
chapter.englishTitle: What Was Narrated Concerning One Who Sells A Pollinated Palm Tree Or A Slave Who Has Wea

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Nafi' from Ibn 'Umar that the Prophet ﷺ said:
            "Whoever sells a palm tree and sells a slave." Mentioning both of them together.[1]
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Nafi' from Ibn 'Umar that the Prophet ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: "Whoever sells a palm tree and sells a slave." Mentioning both of them together.[1]
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ رَبِّهِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ أَنَّهُ قَالَ  " مَنْ بَاعَ نَخْلاً وَبَاعَ عَبْدًا جَمَعَهُمَا جَمِيعًا " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Business Transactions, Hadith 2212

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2213

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا جَاءَ فِيمَنْ بَاعَ نَخْلاً مُؤَبَّرًا أَوْ عَبْدًا لَهُ مَالٌ
chapter.englishTitle: What Was Narrated Concerning One Who Sells A Pollinated Palm Tree Or A Slave Who Has Wea

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that 'Ubadah bin Samit said:
            "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ ruled that the fruit of a palm tree belongs to the one who pollinated it, and that the wealth of a slave belongs to the one who sold him, unless the purchaser stipulated a condition."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that 'Ubadah bin Samit said:
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ ruled that the fruit of a palm tree belongs to the one who pollinated it, and that the wealth of a slave belongs to the one who sold him, unless the purchaser stipulated a condition."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ رَبِّهِ بْنُ خَالِدٍ النُّمَيْرِيُّ أَبُو الْمُغَلِّسِ، حَدَّثَنَا الْفُضَيْلُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ عُقْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنِي إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ يَحْيَى بْنِ الْوَلِيدِ بْنِ عُبَادَةَ بْنِ الصَّامِتِ، عَنْ عُبَادَةَ بْنِ الصَّامِتِ، قَالَ قَضَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَنَّ ثَمَرَ النَّخْلِ لِمَنْ أَبَّرَهَا إِلاَّ أَنْ يَشْتَرِطَ الْمُبْتَاعُ وَأَنَّ مَالَ الْمَمْلُوكِ لِمَنْ بَاعَهُ إِلاَّ أَنْ يَشْتَرِطَ الْمُبْتَاعُ .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Business Transactions, Hadith 2213

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2214

chapter.arabicTitle: باب النَّهْىِ عَنْ بَيْعِ الثِّمَارِ، قَبْلَ أَنْ يَبْدُوَ، صَلاَحُهَا
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition Of Selling Fruits Before They Have Ripened

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Ibn 'Umar that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            "Do not sell fruits until they have ripened." And he forbade (both) the seller and the purchaser (to engage in such a transaction).
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Ibn 'Umar that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: "Do not sell fruits until they have ripened." And he forbade (both) the seller and the purchaser (to engage in such a transaction).
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رُمْحٍ، أَنْبَأَنَا اللَّيْثُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ  " لاَ تَبِيعُوا الثَّمَرَةَ حَتَّى يَبْدُوَ صَلاَحُهَا " . نَهَى الْبَائِعَ وَالْمُشْتَرِيَ .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Business Transactions, Hadith 2214

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2215

chapter.arabicTitle: باب النَّهْىِ عَنْ بَيْعِ الثِّمَارِ، قَبْلَ أَنْ يَبْدُوَ، صَلاَحُهَا
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition Of Selling Fruits Before They Have Ripened

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            "Do not sell fruits until they have ripened."'
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: "Do not sell fruits until they have ripened."'
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عِيسَى الْمِصْرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، عَنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، حَدَّثَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُسَيَّبِ، وَأَبُو سَلَمَةَ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " لاَ تَبِيعُوا الثَّمَرَ حَتَّى يَبْدُوَ صَلاَحُهُ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Business Transactions, Hadith 2215

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2216

chapter.arabicTitle: باب النَّهْىِ عَنْ بَيْعِ الثِّمَارِ، قَبْلَ أَنْ يَبْدُوَ، صَلاَحُهَا
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition Of Selling Fruits Before They Have Ripened

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Jabir that :
            the Prophet ﷺ forbade selling fruits until they have ripened.
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Jabir that :
hadiths.body: the Prophet ﷺ forbade selling fruits until they have ripened.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ نَهَى عَنْ بَيْعِ الثَّمَرِ حَتَّى يَبْدُوَ صَلاَحُهُ .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Business Transactions, Hadith 2216

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2217

chapter.arabicTitle: باب النَّهْىِ عَنْ بَيْعِ الثِّمَارِ، قَبْلَ أَنْ يَبْدُوَ، صَلاَحُهَا
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition Of Selling Fruits Before They Have Ripened

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Anas bin Malik that :
            the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade selling fruits until they have changed the color, and selling grapes until they have turned black, and selling grains until they have hardened.
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Anas bin Malik that :
hadiths.body: the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade selling fruits until they have changed the color, and selling grapes until they have turned black, and selling grains until they have hardened.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجٌ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، عَنْ حُمَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ نَهَى عَنْ بَيْعِ الثَّمَرَةِ حَتَّى تَزْهُوَ وَعَنْ بَيْعِ الْعِنَبِ حَتَّى يَسْوَدَّ وَعَنْ بَيْعِ الْحَبِّ حَتَّى يَشْتَدَّ .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Business Transactions, Hadith 2217

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2218

chapter.englishTitle: Selling Fruits For Many Years Ahead [1] And Crop Failure

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Jabir bin 'Abdullah that :
            the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade selling for many years ahead.
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Jabir bin 'Abdullah that :
hadiths.body: the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade selling for many years ahead.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الصَّبَّاحِ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ حُمَيْدٍ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ عَتِيقٍ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ نَهَى عَنْ بَيْعِ السِّنِينَ .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Business Transactions, Hadith 2218

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2219

chapter.englishTitle: Selling Fruits For Many Years Ahead [1] And Crop Failure

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Jabir bin 'Abdullah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            "Whoever sells fruits then the crop fails, should not take any of his brother's money. Why would any of you take the money of his Muslim brother?"
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Jabir bin 'Abdullah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: "Whoever sells fruits then the crop fails, should not take any of his brother's money. Why would any of you take the money of his Muslim brother?"
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَمْزَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا ثَوْرُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ  " مَنْ بَاعَ ثَمَرًا فَأَصَابَتْهُ جَائِحَةٌ فَلاَ يَأْخُذْ مِنْ مَالِ أَخِيهِ شَيْئًا عَلاَمَ يَأْخُذُ أَحَدُكُمْ مَالَ أَخِيهِ الْمُسْلِمِ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Business Transactions, Hadith 2219

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2220

chapter.englishTitle: Allowing More When Weighing Goods For Sale

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Suwaid bin Qais said:
            "Makhrafah Al' Abdi and I brought linens from Hajar[1] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ came to us to bargain with us with some trousers. There was someone with me who weighed (the goods) in exchange for a wage. So the Prophet ﷺ said to the one weighing: 'Weigh and add more.'"
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Suwaid bin Qais said:
hadiths.body: "Makhrafah Al' Abdi and I brought linens from Hajar[1] The Messenger of Allah ﷺ came to us to bargain with us with some trousers. There was someone with me who weighed (the goods) in exchange for a wage. So the Prophet ﷺ said to the one weighing: 'Weigh and add more.'"
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَعَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ سِمَاكِ بْنِ حَرْبٍ، عَنْ سُوَيْدِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ، قَالَ جَلَبْتُ أَنَا وَمَخْرَفَةُ الْعَبْدِيُّ، بَزًّا مِنْ هَجَرَ فَجَاءَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَسَاوَمَنَا سَرَاوِيلَ وَعِنْدَنَا وَزَّانٌ يَزِنُ بِالأَجْرِ فَقَالَ لَهُ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ  " يَا وَزَّانُ زِنْ وَأَرْجِحْ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Business Transactions, Hadith 2220

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2221

chapter.englishTitle: Allowing More When Weighing Goods For Sale

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Simak bin Harb said:
            "I heard Malik Abu Safwan bin 'Umairah, say: 'I bought a pair of trousers from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ before the Hijrah, and he weighed it for me and allowed more."'
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Simak bin Harb said:
hadiths.body: "I heard Malik Abu Safwan bin 'Umairah, say: 'I bought a pair of trousers from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ before the Hijrah, and he weighed it for me and allowed more."'
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ سِمَاكِ بْنِ حَرْبٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ مَالِكًا أَبَا صَفْوَانَ بْنَ عُمَيْرَةَ، قَالَ بِعْتُ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ رِجْلَ سَرَاوِيلَ قَبْلَ الْهِجْرَةِ فَوَزَنَ لِي فَأَرْجَحَ لِي .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Business Transactions, Hadith 2221

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2222

chapter.englishTitle: Allowing More When Weighing Goods For Sale

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Jabir bin 'Abdullah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            "When you weigh, allow more. "
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Jabir bin 'Abdullah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: "When you weigh, allow more. "
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الصَّمَدِ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ مُحَارِبِ بْنِ دِثَارٍ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " إِذَا وَزَنْتُمْ فَأَرْجِحُوا " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Business Transactions, Hadith 2222

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2223

chapter.englishTitle: Being Cautious With Regard To Weights And Measures

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Ibn 'Abbas said:
            "When the Prophet ﷺ came to Al-Madinah, they were the worst people in weights and measures. Then Allah, Glorious is He revealed: "Woe to the Mutaffifun (those who give less in measure and weight)",[1] and they were fair in weights and measures after that.
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Ibn 'Abbas said:
hadiths.body: "When the Prophet ﷺ came to Al-Madinah, they were the worst people in weights and measures. Then Allah, Glorious is He revealed: "Woe to the Mutaffifun (those who give less in measure and weight)",[1] and they were fair in weights and measures after that.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ بِشْرِ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَقِيلِ بْنِ خُوَيْلِدٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ وَاقِدٍ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، حَدَّثَنِي يَزِيدُ النَّحْوِيُّ، أَنَّ عِكْرِمَةَ، حَدَّثَهُ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ لَمَّا قَدِمَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ الْمَدِينَةَ كَانُوا مِنْ أَخْبَثِ النَّاسِ كَيْلاً فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ سُبْحَانَهُ {وَيْلٌ لِلْمُطَفِّفِينَ} فَأَحْسَنُوا الْكَيْلَ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Business Transactions, Hadith 2223

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2224

chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition Of Cheating

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Abu Hurairah said:
            "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ passed by a man who was selling food. He put his hand in it and saw that there was something wrong with it. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, 'He is not one of us who cheats."'
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Abu Hurairah said:
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ passed by a man who was selling food. He put his hand in it and saw that there was something wrong with it. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, 'He is not one of us who cheats."'
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ الْعَلاَءِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ مَرَّ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ بِرَجُلٍ يَبِيِعُ طَعَامًا فَأَدْخَلَ يَدَهُ فِيهِ فَإِذَا هُوَ مَغْشُوشٌ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " لَيْسَ مِنَّا مَنْ غَشَّ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Business Transactions, Hadith 2224

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2225

chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition Of Cheating

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Abu Hamra' said:
            "I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ pass by a man having food in a vessel. He put his hand in it and said: 'Perhaps you are cheating. Whoever cheats us is not one of us."'
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Abu Hamra' said:
hadiths.body: "I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ pass by a man having food in a vessel. He put his hand in it and said: 'Perhaps you are cheating. Whoever cheats us is not one of us."'
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ بْنُ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ أَبِي دَاوُدَ، عَنْ أَبِي الْحَمْرَاءِ، قَالَ رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ مَرَّ بِجَنَبَاتِ رَجُلٍ عِنْدَهُ طَعَامٌ فِي وِعَاءٍ فَأَدْخَلَ يَدَهُ فِيهِ فَقَالَ  " لَعَلَّكَ غَشَشْتَهُ مَنْ غَشَّنَا فَلَيْسَ مِنَّا " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Business Transactions, Hadith 2225

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2226

chapter.arabicTitle: باب النَّهْىِ عَنْ بَيْعِ الطَّعَامِ، قَبْلَ أَنْ يُقْبَضَ
chapter.englishTitle: The Prohibition Of Selling Food Before Taking Possession Of It

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Ibn 'Umar that the Prophet ﷺ said:
            "Whoever buys food, let him not sell it until he has taken full possession of it."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Ibn 'Umar that the Prophet ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: "Whoever buys food, let him not sell it until he has taken full possession of it."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا سُوَيْدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ قَالَ  " مَنِ ابْتَاعَ طَعَامًا فَلاَ يَبِعْهُ حَتَّى يَسْتَوْفِيَهُ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Business Transactions, Hadith 2226

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2227

chapter.arabicTitle: باب النَّهْىِ عَنْ بَيْعِ الطَّعَامِ، قَبْلَ أَنْ يُقْبَضَ
chapter.englishTitle: The Prohibition Of Selling Food Before Taking Possession Of It

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Ibn 'Abbas said:
            "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'Whoever buys food, let him not sell it until he has taken full possession of it.'"  In his narration, (one of the narrators) Abu 'Awanah said: "Ibn 'Abbas said: 'I think everything is like food."'
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Ibn 'Abbas said:
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'Whoever buys food, let him not sell it until he has taken full possession of it.'"  In his narration, (one of the narrators) Abu 'Awanah said: "Ibn 'Abbas said: 'I think everything is like food."'
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عِمْرَانُ بْنُ مُوسَى اللَّيْثِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ الضَّرِيرُ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، وَحَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ دِينَارٍ، عَنْ طَاوُسٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " مَنِ ابْتَاعَ طَعَامًا فَلاَ يَبِعْهُ حَتَّى يَسْتَوْفِيَهُ " . قَالَ أَبُو عَوَانَةَ فِي حَدِيثِهِ قَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ وَأَحْسِبُ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ مِثْلَ الطَّعَامِ .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Business Transactions, Hadith 2227

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2228

chapter.arabicTitle: باب النَّهْىِ عَنْ بَيْعِ الطَّعَامِ، قَبْلَ أَنْ يُقْبَضَ
chapter.englishTitle: The Prohibition Of Selling Food Before Taking Possession Of It

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Jabir said:
            'The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade selling food bought by measure until two Sa' have been measured - the Sa' of the seller and the Sa' of the buyer."[1]
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Jabir said:
hadiths.body: 'The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade selling food bought by measure until two Sa' have been measured - the Sa' of the seller and the Sa' of the buyer."[1]
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَنْ بَيْعِ الطَّعَامِ حَتَّى يَجْرِيَ فِيهِ الصَّاعَانِ صَاعُ الْبَائِعِ وَصَاعُ الْمُشْتَرِي .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Business Transactions, Hadith 2228

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2229

chapter.englishTitle: ales Involving Risk (Due To Its Amount Being Unknown)

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Ibn 'Umar said:
            "We used to buy food from troops of riders (i.e., the caravans) without knowing the amount, but the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade us to sell it until it had been delivered to us."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Ibn 'Umar said:
hadiths.body: "We used to buy food from troops of riders (i.e., the caravans) without knowing the amount, but the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade us to sell it until it had been delivered to us."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا سَهْلُ بْنُ أَبِي سَهْلٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ كُنَّا نَشْتَرِي الطَّعَامَ مِنَ الرُّكْبَانِ جِزَافًا فَنَهَانَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَنْ نَبِيعَهُ حَتَّى نَنْقُلَهُ مِنْ مَكَانِهِ .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Business Transactions, Hadith 2229

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2230

chapter.englishTitle: ales Involving Risk (Due To Its Amount Being Unknown)

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that 'Uthman bin 'Affan said:
            "I used to sell dates in the marketplace, and I would say: 'This was such and such an amount (when I bought it).' I Would give the purchaser a specific amount of dates according to the way it had been measured for me, and take my profit. Then I began to have some doubts about that, so I asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and he said: ‘When you name the amount, measure it in front of the purchaser."'
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that 'Uthman bin 'Affan said:
hadiths.body: "I used to sell dates in the marketplace, and I would say: 'This was such and such an amount (when I bought it).' I Would give the purchaser a specific amount of dates according to the way it had been measured for me, and take my profit. Then I began to have some doubts about that, so I asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and he said: ‘When you name the amount, measure it in front of the purchaser."'
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مَيْمُونٍ الرَّقِّيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يَزِيدَ، عَنِ ابْنِ لَهِيعَةَ، عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ وَرْدَانَ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ عَفَّانَ، قَالَ كُنْتُ أَبِيعُ التَّمْرَ فِي السُّوقِ فَأَقُولُ كِلْتُ فِي وَسْقِي هَذَا كَذَا . فَأَدْفَعُ أَوْسَاقَ التَّمْرِ بِكَيْلِهِ وَآخُذُ شِفِّي فَدَخَلَنِي مِنْ ذَلِكَ شَىْءٌ فَسَأَلْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَقَالَ  " إِذَا سَمَّيْتَ الْكَيْلَ فَكِلْهُ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Business Transactions, Hadith 2230

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2231

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا يُرْجَى فِي كَيْلِ الطَّعَامِ مِنَ الْبَرَكَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: The Blessing That Is Hoped For When Measuring Food

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Abdullah bin Busr Al-Mazini said:
            "I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: 'Measure your food, may you be blessed therein."'
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Abdullah bin Busr Al-Mazini said:
hadiths.body: "I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: 'Measure your food, may you be blessed therein."'
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ عَيَّاشٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْيَحْصُبِيُّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ بُسْرٍ الْمَازِنِيِّ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ  " كِيلُوا طَعَامَكُمْ يُبَارَكْ لَكُمْ فِيهِ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Business Transactions, Hadith 2231

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2232

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا يُرْجَى فِي كَيْلِ الطَّعَامِ مِنَ الْبَرَكَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: The Blessing That Is Hoped For When Measuring Food

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Ayyub that the Prophet ﷺ said:
            "Measure your food, may you be blessed therein."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Ayyub that the Prophet ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: "Measure your food, may you be blessed therein."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ سَعِيدِ بْنِ كَثِيرِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ الْحِمْصِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا بَقِيَّةُ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ، عَنْ بَحِيرِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ مَعْدَانَ، عَنِ الْمِقْدَامِ بْنِ مَعْدِيكَرِبَ، عَنْ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ  " كِيلُوا طَعَامَكُمْ يُبَارَكْ لَكُمْ فِيهِ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Business Transactions, Hadith 2232

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2233

chapter.englishTitle: Marketplaces And Entering Them

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Abu Usaid said that :
            the Messenger of Allah ﷺ went to the market of Nabit,[1] and looked at it, and said: "This is not a market for you." Then we went to another market and looked at it, and said: "This is not a market for you." Then he came back to this market and walked around in it then he said: "This is your market. It will always be your market and no duty will be levied on it." (Do,if)
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Abu Usaid said that :
hadiths.body: the Messenger of Allah ﷺ went to the market of Nabit,[1] and looked at it, and said: "This is not a market for you." Then we went to another market and looked at it, and said: "This is not a market for you." Then he came back to this market and walked around in it then he said: "This is your market. It will always be your market and no duty will be levied on it." (Do,if)
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ الْمُنْذِرِ الْحِزَامِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنِي صَفْوَانُ بْنُ سُلَيْمٍ، حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدٌ، وَعَلِيٌّ، ابْنَا الْحَسَنِ بْنِ أَبِي الْحَسَنِ الْبَرَّادِ أَنَّ الزُّبَيْرَ بْنَ الْمُنْذِرِ بْنِ أَبِي أُسَيْدٍ السَّاعِدِيِّ، حَدَّثَهُمَا أَنَّ أَبَاهُ الْمُنْذِرَ حَدَّثَهُ عَنْ أَبِي أُسَيْدٍ، أَنَّ أَبَا أُسَيْدٍ، حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ ذَهَبَ إِلَى سُوقِ النَّبِيطِ فَنَظَرَ إِلَيْهِ فَقَالَ " لَيْسَ هَذَا لَكُمْ بِسُوقٍ " . ثُمَّ ذَهَبَ إِلَى سُوقٍ فَنَظَرَ إِلَيْهِ فَقَالَ " لَيْسَ هَذَا لَكُمْ بِسُوقٍ " . ثُمَّ رَجَعَ إِلَى هَذَا السُّوقِ فَطَافَ فِيهِ ثُمَّ قَالَ " هَذَا سُوقُكُمْ فَلاَ يُنْتَقَصَنَّ وَلاَ يُضْرَبَنَّ عَلَيْهِ خَرَاجٌ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Business Transactions, Hadith 2233

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2234

chapter.englishTitle: Marketplaces And Entering Them

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Salman said :
            "I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying: 'Whoever goes to the Morning prayer first thing in the morning, he goes out with the banner of faith but whoever goes out to the marketplace first thing in the morning, he goes out under the banner of Iblis (Satan).' "
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Salman said :
hadiths.body: "I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying: 'Whoever goes to the Morning prayer first thing in the morning, he goes out with the banner of faith but whoever goes out to the marketplace first thing in the morning, he goes out under the banner of Iblis (Satan).' "
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ الْمُسْتَمِرِّ الْعُرُوقِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْسُ بْنُ مَيْمُونٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَوْنٌ الْعُقَيْلِيُّ، عَنْ أَبِي عُثْمَانَ النَّهْدِيِّ، عَنْ سَلْمَانَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ  " مَنْ غَدَا إِلَى صَلاَةِ الصُّبْحِ غَدَا بِرَايَةِ الإِيمَانِ وَمَنْ غَدَا إِلَى السُّوقِ غَدَا بِرَايَةِ إِبْلِيسَ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Business Transactions, Hadith 2234

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2235

chapter.englishTitle: Marketplaces And Entering Them

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Salim bin 'Abdullah bin 'Umar, from his father, that his grandfather told that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            "Whoever says, when he enters the marketplace: 'La ilaha illallah wahdahu la sharika lahu, lahul-mulk wa lahul-hamdu, yuhyi wa yumitu, wa Huwa hayyun la yamutu, bi yadihil-khairu kulluhu, wa Huwa ala kulli shay’in Qadir (None has the right to be worshiped but Allah alone, with no partner, to Him belongs all sovereignty and to Him is the praise, He gives life and gives death, and He is Ever-Living and does not die; in His Hand is all goodness and He is Able to do all things),' Allah will record for him one million good deeds, and will erase from him one million bad deeds, and will build for him a house in Paradise. "
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Salim bin 'Abdullah bin 'Umar, from his father, that his grandfather told that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: "Whoever says, when he enters the marketplace: 'La ilaha illallah wahdahu la sharika lahu, lahul-mulk wa lahul-hamdu, yuhyi wa yumitu, wa Huwa hayyun la yamutu, bi yadihil-khairu kulluhu, wa Huwa ala kulli shay’in Qadir (None has the right to be worshiped but Allah alone, with no partner, to Him belongs all sovereignty and to Him is the praise, He gives life and gives death, and He is Ever-Living and does not die; in His Hand is all goodness and He is Able to do all things),' Allah will record for him one million good deeds, and will erase from him one million bad deeds, and will build for him a house in Paradise. "
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ الضَّرِيرُ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ، مَوْلَى آلِ الزُّبَيْرِ عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " مَنْ قَالَ حِينَ يَدْخُلُ السُّوقَ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ وَهُوَ حَىٌّ لاَ يَمُوتُ بِيَدِهِ الْخَيْرُ كُلُّهُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ - كَتَبَ اللَّهُ لَهُ أَلْفَ أَلْفِ حَسَنَةٍ وَمَحَا عَنْهُ أَلْفَ أَلْفِ سَيِّئَةٍ وَبَنَى لَهُ بَيْتًا فِي الْجَنَّةِ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Business Transactions, Hadith 2235

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2236

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا يُرْجَى مِنَ الْبَرَكَةِ فِي الْبُكُورِ
chapter.englishTitle: The Blessing That Is Hoped For When Starting One’s Day Early

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Sakhr Al-Ghamidi that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            "O Allah, bless my nation in their early mornings (i.e., what they do early in the morning)." He said: "When he sent out a raiding party or an army, he would send them at the beginning of the day." He said: (1) "Sakhr was a man engaged in trade, and he used to send his goods out at the beginning of the day, and his wealth grew and increased."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Sakhr Al-Ghamidi that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: "O Allah, bless my nation in their early mornings (i.e., what they do early in the morning)." He said: "When he sent out a raiding party or an army, he would send them at the beginning of the day." He said: (1) "Sakhr was a man engaged in trade, and he used to send his goods out at the beginning of the day, and his wealth grew and increased."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، عَنْ يَعْلَى بْنِ عَطَاءٍ، عَنْ عُمَارَةَ بْنِ حَدِيدٍ، عَنْ صَخْرٍ الْغَامِدِيِّ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لأُمَّتِي فِي بُكُورِهَا " . قَالَ وَكَانَ إِذَا بَعَثَ سَرِيَّةً أَوْ جَيْشًا بَعَثَهُمْ فِي أَوَّلِ النَّهَارِ . قَالَ وَكَانَ صَخْرٌ رَجُلاً تَاجِرًا فَكَانَ يَبْعَثُ تِجَارَتَهُ فِي أَوَّلِ النَّهَارِ فَأَثْرَى وَكَثُرَ مَالُهُ .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Business Transactions, Hadith 2236

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2237

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا يُرْجَى مِنَ الْبَرَكَةِ فِي الْبُكُورِ
chapter.englishTitle: The Blessing That Is Hoped For When Starting One’s Day Early

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            "O Allah, bless my nation early in the morning of Thursday.' "
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: "O Allah, bless my nation early in the morning of Thursday.' "
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مَرْوَانَ، مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُثْمَانَ الْعُثْمَانِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مَيْمُونٍ الْمَدَنِيُّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لأُمَّتِي فِي بُكُورِهَا يَوْمَ الْخَمِيسِ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Business Transactions, Hadith 2237

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2238

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا يُرْجَى مِنَ الْبَرَكَةِ فِي الْبُكُورِ
chapter.englishTitle: The Blessing That Is Hoped For When Starting One’s Day Early

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Ibn 'Umar that the Prophet ﷺ said:
            "O Allah, bless my nation in their early mornings.". It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Prophet ﷺ said: "Whoever buys a Musarrah, he has the choice (of annulling the deal) for three days. If he returns it, then he must also give a Sa' of dates, not Samra'." Meaning wheat.
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Ibn 'Umar that the Prophet ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: "O Allah, bless my nation in their early mornings.". It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Prophet ﷺ said: "Whoever buys a Musarrah, he has the choice (of annulling the deal) for three days. If he returns it, then he must also give a Sa' of dates, not Samra'." Meaning wheat.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَعَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ حَسَّانَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِيرِينَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ  " مَنِ ابْتَاعَ مُصَرَّاةً فَهُوَ بِالْخِيَارِ ثَلاَثَةَ أَيَّامٍ فَإِنْ رَدَّهَا رَدَّ مَعَهَا صَاعًا مِنْ تَمْرٍ لاَ سَمْرَاءَ " . يَعْنِي الْحِنْطَةَ .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Business Transactions, Hadith 2238

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2240

chapter.englishTitle: Sale of the Musarrah (animal whose udders were tied up)

hadiths.englishRaw:
'Abdullah bin 'Umar said:
            "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'Whoever buys a Muhaffalah, (1) he has the choice (of annulling the deal) for three days. If he returns it, then he must also give wheat equal to twice, the amount of its milk, or equal to the amount of its milk."'
hadiths.narrator: 'Abdullah bin 'Umar said:
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'Whoever buys a Muhaffalah, (1) he has the choice (of annulling the deal) for three days. If he returns it, then he must also give wheat equal to twice, the amount of its milk, or equal to the amount of its milk."'
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ أَبِي الشَّوَارِبِ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ بْنُ زِيَادٍ، حَدَّثَنَا صَدَقَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الْحَنَفِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا جُمَيْعُ بْنُ عُمَيْرٍ التَّيْمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ مَنْ بَاعَ مُحَفَّلَةً فَهُوَ بِالْخِيَارِ ثَلاَثَةَ أَيَّامٍ فَإِنْ رَدَّهَا رَدَّ مَعَهَا مِثْلَىْ لَبَنِهَا - أَوْ قَالَ مِثْلَ لَبَنِهَا - قَمْحًا " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Business Transactions, Hadith 2240

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2241

chapter.englishTitle: Sale of the Musarrah (animal whose udders were tied up)

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that 'Abdullah bin Mas'ud said:
            "I bear witness that the true and truly inspired one Abul-Qasim ﷺ told us: 'Selling a Muhaffalah is Khilabah, and Khilabah is not lawful for the Muslim."' (Ibn Majah said: " Meaning: 'Deception.")
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that 'Abdullah bin Mas'ud said:
hadiths.body: "I bear witness that the true and truly inspired one Abul-Qasim ﷺ told us: 'Selling a Muhaffalah is Khilabah, and Khilabah is not lawful for the Muslim."' (Ibn Majah said: " Meaning: 'Deception.")
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، حَدَّثَنَا الْمَسْعُودِيُّ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الضُّحَى، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ أَشْهَدُ عَلَى الصَّادِقِ الْمَصْدُوقِ أَبِي الْقَاسِمِ ﷺ أَنَّهُ حَدَّثَنَا قَالَ  " بَيْعُ الْمُحَفَّلاَتِ خِلاَبَةٌ وَلاَ تَحِلُّ الْخِلاَبَةُ لِمُسْلِمٍ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Business Transactions, Hadith 2241

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2242

chapter.englishTitle: A Slave’s Earning Belong To His Guarantor

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Aishah that :
            the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ruled that what a slave earns belongs to his guarantor.
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Aishah that :
hadiths.body: the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ruled that what a slave earns belongs to his guarantor.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَعَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ، عَنْ مَخْلَدِ بْنِ خُفَافِ بْنِ إِيمَاءَ بْنِ رَحَضَةَ الْغِفَارِيِّ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَضَى أَنَّ خَرَاجَ الْعَبْدِ بِضَمَانِهِ .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Business Transactions, Hadith 2242

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2243

chapter.englishTitle: A Slave’s Earning Belong To His Guarantor

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from 'Aishah that:
            a man bought a slave and put him to work, then he found some defect in him, so he returned him. He (the seller) said: "O Messenger of Allah he put my slave to work." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "A slave's earnings belong to his guarantor."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from 'Aishah that:
hadiths.body: a man bought a slave and put him to work, then he found some defect in him, so he returned him. He (the seller) said: "O Messenger of Allah he put my slave to work." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "A slave's earnings belong to his guarantor."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُسْلِمُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ الزَّنْجِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ رَجُلاً، اشْتَرَى عَبْدًا فَاسْتَغَلَّهُ ثُمَّ وَجَدَ بِهِ عَيْبًا فَرَدَّهُ . فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّهُ قَدِ اسْتَغَلَّ غُلاَمِي . فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " الْخَرَاجُ بِالضَّمَانِ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Business Transactions, Hadith 2243

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2244

chapter.englishTitle: Contractual Obligation Regarding A Slave

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Samurah bin Jundab that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            "The contractual obligation regarding a slave lasts for three days." (1)
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Samurah bin Jundab that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: "The contractual obligation regarding a slave lasts for three days." (1)
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَةُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ عَنْ سَمُرَةَ بْنِ جُنْدُبٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " عُهْدَةُ الرَّقِيقِ ثَلاَثَةُ أَيَّامٍ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Business Transactions, Hadith 2244

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2245

chapter.englishTitle: Contractual Obligation Regarding A Slave

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from 'Uqbah bin 'Amir that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            "There is no contractual obligation after four (days)."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from 'Uqbah bin 'Amir that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: "There is no contractual obligation after four (days)."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، عَنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ عُبَيْدٍ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، عَنْ عُقْبَةَ بْنِ عَامِرٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ  " لاَ عُهْدَةَ بَعْدَ أَرْبَعٍ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Business Transactions, Hadith 2245

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2246

chapter.englishTitle: One Who Sells Defective Goods Should Point Out The Defect

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that 'Uqbah bin 'Amir said:
            "I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: 'The Muslim is the brother of another Muslim, and it is not permissible for a Muslim to sell his brother goods in which there is a defect, without pointing that out to him."'
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that 'Uqbah bin 'Amir said:
hadiths.body: "I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: 'The Muslim is the brother of another Muslim, and it is not permissible for a Muslim to sell his brother goods in which there is a defect, without pointing that out to him."'
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وَهْبُ بْنُ جَرِيرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، سَمِعْتُ يَحْيَى بْنَ أَيُّوبَ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ شُمَاسَةَ، عَنْ عُقْبَةَ بْنِ عَامِرٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ  " الْمُسْلِمُ أَخُو الْمُسْلِمِ وَلاَ يَحِلُّ لِمُسْلِمٍ بَاعَ مِنْ أَخِيهِ بَيْعًا فِيهِ عَيْبٌ إِلاَّ بَيَّنَهُ لَهُ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Business Transactions, Hadith 2246

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2247

chapter.englishTitle: One Who Sells Defective Goods Should Point Out The Defect

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Wathilah bin Asqa' said:
            "I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: 'Whoever sells defective goods without pointing it out, he will remain subject to the wrath of Allah, and the angels will continue to curse him.'"
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Wathilah bin Asqa' said:
hadiths.body: "I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: 'Whoever sells defective goods without pointing it out, he will remain subject to the wrath of Allah, and the angels will continue to curse him.'"
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ بْنُ الضَّحَّاكِ، حَدَّثَنَا بَقِيَّةُ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ، عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ يَحْيَى، عَنْ مَكْحُولٍ، وَسُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ مُوسَى، عَنْ وَاثِلَةَ بْنِ الأَسْقَعِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ  " مَنْ بَاعَ عَيْبًا لَمْ يُبَيِّنْهُ لَمْ يَزَلْ فِي مَقْتٍ مِنَ اللَّهِ وَلَمْ تَزَلِ الْمَلاَئِكَةُ تَلْعَنُهُ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Business Transactions, Hadith 2247

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2248

chapter.arabicTitle: باب النَّهْىِ عَنِ التَّفْرِيقِ، بَيْنَ السَّبْىِ
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition Of Seperating Caprives

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that 'Abdullah bin Mas'ud said:
            "When captives were brought to him, the Prophet ﷺ would give the members of one family together (to one person), not wanting to separate them."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that 'Abdullah bin Mas'ud said:
hadiths.body: "When captives were brought to him, the Prophet ﷺ would give the members of one family together (to one person), not wanting to separate them."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، قَالَ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ إِذَا أُتِيَ بِالسَّبْىِ أَعْطَى أَهْلَ الْبَيْتِ جَمِيعًا كَرَاهِيَةَ أَنْ يُفَرِّقَ بَيْنَهُمْ .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Business Transactions, Hadith 2248

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2249

chapter.arabicTitle: باب النَّهْىِ عَنِ التَّفْرِيقِ، بَيْنَ السَّبْىِ
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition Of Seperating Caprives

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that 'Ali said:
            "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ gave me two slaves who were brothers, and I sold one of them. He said: 'What happened with the two slaves?' I said: 'I sold one of them.' He said: 'Take him back."'
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that 'Ali said:
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ gave me two slaves who were brothers, and I sold one of them. He said: 'What happened with the two slaves?' I said: 'I sold one of them.' He said: 'Take him back."'
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا عَفَّانُ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، أَنْبَأَنَا الْحَجَّاجُ، عَنِ الْحَكَمِ، عَنْ مَيْمُونِ بْنِ أَبِي شَبِيبٍ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ، قَالَ وَهَبَ لِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ غُلاَمَيْنِ أَخَوَيْنِ فَبِعْتُ أَحَدَهُمَا فَقَالَ " مَا فَعَلَ الْغُلاَمَانِ " . قُلْتُ بِعْتُ أَحَدَهُمَا قَالَ " رُدَّهُ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Business Transactions, Hadith 2249

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2250

chapter.arabicTitle: باب النَّهْىِ عَنِ التَّفْرِيقِ، بَيْنَ السَّبْىِ
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition Of Seperating Caprives

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Abu Musa said:
            "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ cursed the one who separates a mother and her child, or a brother from his brother."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Abu Musa said:
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ cursed the one who separates a mother and her child, or a brother from his brother."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْهَيَّاجِ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى، أَنْبَأَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، عَنْ طَلِيقِ بْنِ عِمْرَانَ، عَنْ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى، قَالَ لَعَنَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ مَنْ فَرَّقَ بَيْنَ الْوَالِدَةِ وَوَلَدِهَا وَبَيْنَ الأَخِ وَبَيْنَ أَخِيهِ .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Business Transactions, Hadith 2250

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2251

chapter.englishTitle: Buying Slaves

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that 'Abdul-Majid bin Wahb said:
            "Adda' bin Khalid bin Hawdhah said to me: 'Shall I not read to you a letter that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, wrote to me?' I said: 'Yes.' So he took out a letter. In it was: 'This is what 'Adda' bin Khalid bin Hawdhah bought [from] Muhammad the Messenger of Allah ﷺ He bought from him a slave' or 'a female slave, having no ailments, nor being a runaway, not having any malicious behavior. Sold by a Muslim to a Muslim.'"
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that 'Abdul-Majid bin Wahb said:
hadiths.body: "Adda' bin Khalid bin Hawdhah said to me: 'Shall I not read to you a letter that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, wrote to me?' I said: 'Yes.' So he took out a letter. In it was: 'This is what 'Adda' bin Khalid bin Hawdhah bought [from] Muhammad the Messenger of Allah ﷺ He bought from him a slave' or 'a female slave, having no ailments, nor being a runaway, not having any malicious behavior. Sold by a Muslim to a Muslim.'"
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبَّادُ بْنُ لَيْثٍ، صَاحِبُ الْكَرَابِيسِيِّ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْمَجِيدِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، قَالَ قَالَ لِي الْعَدَّاءُ بْنُ خَالِدِ بْنِ هَوْذَةَ أَلاَ نُقْرِئُكَ كِتَابًا كَتَبَهُ لِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ . قَالَ قُلْتُ بَلَى . فَأَخْرَجَ لِي كِتَابًا فَإِذَا فِيهِ  " هَذَا مَا اشْتَرَى الْعَدَّاءُ بْنُ خَالِدِ بْنِ هَوْذَةَ مِنْ مُحَمَّدٍ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ اشْتَرَى مِنْهُ عَبْدًا أَوْ أَمَةً لاَ دَاءَ وَلاَ غَائِلَةَ وَلاَ خِبْثَةَ بَيْعَ الْمُسْلِمِ لِلْمُسْلِمِ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Business Transactions, Hadith 2251

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2252

chapter.englishTitle: Buying Slaves

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from 'Amr bin Shu'aib from his father that his grandfather told that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            "When anyone of you buys a slave woman let him say: 'Allahumma inni as'aluka khairaha wa khaira ma jabaltaha alaihi, wa a'udhu bika min sharriha wa sharri ma jabaltaha alaihi (O Allah, I ask You for the goodness within her and the goodness that You have made her inclined towards, and I seek refuge with You from the evil within her and the evil that You have made her inclined towards).' And he should pray for blessing. And if anyone of you buys a camel then he should take hold of its hump and pray for. blessing and say similar words."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from 'Amr bin Shu'aib from his father that his grandfather told that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: "When anyone of you buys a slave woman let him say: 'Allahumma inni as'aluka khairaha wa khaira ma jabaltaha alaihi, wa a'udhu bika min sharriha wa sharri ma jabaltaha alaihi (O Allah, I ask You for the goodness within her and the goodness that You have made her inclined towards, and I seek refuge with You from the evil within her and the evil that You have made her inclined towards).' And he should pray for blessing. And if anyone of you buys a camel then he should take hold of its hump and pray for. blessing and say similar words."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو خَالِدٍ الأَحْمَرُ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَجْلاَنَ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ شُعَيْبٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " إِذَا اشْتَرَى أَحَدُكُمُ الْجَارِيَةَ فَلْيَقُلِ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَهَا وَخَيْرَ مَا جَبَلْتَهَا عَلَيْهِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا وَشَرِّ مَا جَبَلْتَهَا عَلَيْهِ وَلْيَدْعُ بِالْبَرَكَةِ وَإِذَا اشْتَرَى أَحَدُكُمْ بَعِيرًا فَلْيَأْخُذْ بِذِرْوَةِ سَنَامِهِ وَلْيَدْعُ بِالْبَرَكَةِ وَلْيَقُلْ مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Business Transactions, Hadith 2252

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2253

chapter.arabicTitle: باب الصَّرْفِ وَمَا لاَ يَجُوزُ مُتَفَاضِلاً يَدًا بِيَدٍ
chapter.englishTitle: Bartering And Excesses Not Permitted In Hand-To-Hand Exchange

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Malik bin Aws bin Hadathan Nasri said:
            "I heard 'Umar bin Al-Khattab say: 'The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Exchanging gold for gold is usury unless it is done on the spot. (Exchanging) wheat for wheat is usury, unless it is done on the spot. (Exchanging) barley for barley is usury unless it is done on the spot. (Exchanging) dates for dates is usury, unless it is done on the spot."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Malik bin Aws bin Hadathan Nasri said:
hadiths.body: "I heard 'Umar bin Al-Khattab say: 'The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Exchanging gold for gold is usury unless it is done on the spot. (Exchanging) wheat for wheat is usury, unless it is done on the spot. (Exchanging) barley for barley is usury unless it is done on the spot. (Exchanging) dates for dates is usury, unless it is done on the spot."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَعَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، وَهِشَامُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، وَنَصْرُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الصَّبَّاحِ، قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ مَالِكِ بْنِ أَوْسِ بْنِ الْحَدَثَانِ النَّصْرِيِّ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ، يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " الذَّهَبُ بِالذَّهَبِ رِبًا إِلاَّ هَاءَ وَهَاءَ وَالْبُرُّ بِالْبُرِّ رِبًا إِلاَّ هَاءَ وَهَاءَ وَالشَّعِيرُ بِالشَّعِيرِ رِبًا إِلاَّ هَاءَ وَهَاءَ وَالتَّمْرُ بِالتَّمْرِ رِبًا إِلاَّ هَاءَ وَهَاءَ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Business Transactions, Hadith 2253

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2254

chapter.arabicTitle: باب الصَّرْفِ وَمَا لاَ يَجُوزُ مُتَفَاضِلاً يَدًا بِيَدٍ
chapter.englishTitle: Bartering And Excesses Not Permitted In Hand-To-Hand Exchange

hadiths.englishRaw:
Muslim bin Yasar and 'Abdullah bin 'Ubaid said :
            "Ubadah bin Samit and Mu'awiyah happened to meet, either in a church or in a synagogue. 'Ubadah bin Samit narrated to them and said: 'The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade us from selling silver for silver, gold for gold, wheat for wheat, barley for barley, and dates for dates.'I one of them said: "And salt for salt," but the other did not say it. "And he commanded us to sell wheat for barley, or barley for wheat, hand-to-hand, however we wished."
hadiths.narrator: Muslim bin Yasar and 'Abdullah bin 'Ubaid said :
