chapter.englishTitle: One Who Gives His Child A Gift Then Takes It Back

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Ibn 'Abbas and Ibn 'Umar, who attributed the Hadith to the Prophet ﷺ that he said:
            “It is not permissible for a man to give a gift then take it back, except what a father gives to his child.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Ibn 'Abbas and Ibn 'Umar, who attributed the Hadith to the Prophet ﷺ that he said:
hadiths.body: “It is not permissible for a man to give a gift then take it back, except what a father gives to his child.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ خَلاَّدٍ الْبَاهِلِيُّ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عَدِيٍّ، عَنْ حُسَيْنٍ الْمُعَلِّمِ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ شُعَيْبٍ، عَنْ طَاوُسٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، وَابْنِ، عُمَرَ يَرْفَعَانِ الْحَدِيثَ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ  " لاَ يَحِلُّ لِلرَّجُلِ أَنْ يُعْطِيَ الْعَطِيَّةَ ثُمَّ يَرْجِعَ فِيهَا إِلاَّ الْوَالِدَ فِيمَا يُعْطِي وَلَدَهُ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Gifts, Hadith 2377

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2378

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَنْ أَعْطَى وَلَدَهُ ثُمَّ رَجَعَ فِيهِ
chapter.englishTitle: One Who Gives His Child A Gift Then Takes It Back

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Amr bin Shu'aib, from his father, from, his Grandfather, that the Prophet ﷺ of Allah (Subhanahu-wa-Taala) said:
            “None of you should take back his gift, except a father (taking it back) from his son.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Amr bin Shu'aib, from his father, from, his Grandfather, that the Prophet ﷺ of Allah (Subhanahu-wa-Taala) said:
hadiths.body: “None of you should take back his gift, except a father (taking it back) from his son.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا جَمِيلُ بْنُ الْحَسَنِ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الأَعْلَى، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدٌ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ الأَحْوَلِ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ شُعَيْبٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ، أَنَّ نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ  " لاَ يَرْجِعْ أَحَدُكُمْ فِي هِبَتِهِ إِلاَّ الْوَالِدَ مِنْ وَلَدِهِ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Gifts, Hadith 2378

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2379

chapter.englishTitle: Lifelong Grant

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            “There is no lifelong grant. Whoever is given something as a lifelong grant, it is his.' ”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “There is no lifelong grant. Whoever is given something as a lifelong grant, it is his.' ”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ زَكَرِيَّا بْنِ أَبِي زَائِدَةَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " لاَ عُمْرَى فَمَنْ أُعْمِرَ شَيْئًا فَهُوَ لَهُ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Gifts, Hadith 2379

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2380

chapter.englishTitle: Lifelong Grant

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Jabir said:
            “I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: 'Whoever gives a lifelong grant to a man, it belongs to him (the recipient) and to his heirs. His (the giver's) words put an end to his right to it, and it belongs to the one to whom it was given for life and to his heirs.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Jabir said:
hadiths.body: “I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: 'Whoever gives a lifelong grant to a man, it belongs to him (the recipient) and to his heirs. His (the giver's) words put an end to his right to it, and it belongs to the one to whom it was given for life and to his heirs.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رُمْحٍ، أَنْبَأَنَا اللَّيْثُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ  " مَنْ أَعْمَرَ رَجُلاً عُمْرَى لَهُ وَلِعَقِبِهِ فَقَدْ قَطَعَ قَوْلُهُ حَقَّهُ فِيهَا فَهِيَ لِمَنْ أُعْمِرَ وَلِعَقِبِهِ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Gifts, Hadith 2380

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2381

chapter.englishTitle: Lifelong Grant

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Zaid bin Thabit that :
            the Prophet ﷺ ruled that a gift given for life belongs to the heirs (of the recipient).
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Zaid bin Thabit that :
hadiths.body: the Prophet ﷺ ruled that a gift given for life belongs to the heirs (of the recipient).
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنْ طَاوُسٍ، عَنْ حُجْرٍ الْمَدَرِيِّ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ جَعَلَ الْعُمْرَى لِلْوَارِثِ .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Gifts, Hadith 2381

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2382

chapter.englishTitle: The Ruqba

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Ibn 'Umar that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            “There is no Ruqba. Whoever is given a gift on the basis of Ruqba, it belongs to him, whether he lives or dies.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Ibn 'Umar that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “There is no Ruqba. Whoever is given a gift on the basis of Ruqba, it belongs to him, whether he lives or dies.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، أَنْبَأَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَنْبَأَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، عَنْ حَبِيبِ بْنِ أَبِي ثَابِتٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " لاَ رُقْبَى فَمَنْ أُرْقِبَ شَيْئًا فَهُوَ لَهُ حَيَاتَهُ وَمَمَاتَهُ " . قَالَ وَالرُّقْبَى أَنْ يَقُولَ هُوَ لِلآخَرِ مِنِّي وَمِنْكَ مَوْتًا .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Gifts, Hadith 2382

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2383

chapter.englishTitle: The Ruqba

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Jabir bin 'Abdullah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            “Umra belongs to the one to whom it is given, and Ruqba belongs to the one to whom it is given.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Jabir bin 'Abdullah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “Umra belongs to the one to whom it is given, and Ruqba belongs to the one to whom it is given.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا دَاوُدُ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " الْعُمْرَى جَائِزَةٌ لِمَنْ أُعْمِرَهَا وَالرُّقْبَى جَائِزَةٌ لِمَنْ أُرْقِبَهَا " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Gifts, Hadith 2383

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2384

chapter.englishTitle: Taking Back A Gift

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            “The likeness of one who takes back his gift is that of a dog that eats until it is full and vomits; then it goes back to its vomit and eats it again.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “The likeness of one who takes back his gift is that of a dog that eats until it is full and vomits; then it goes back to its vomit and eats it again.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ عَوْفٍ، عَنْ خِلاَسٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " إِنَّ مَثَلَ الَّذِي يَعُودُ فِي عَطِيَّتِهِ كَمَثَلِ الْكَلْبِ أَكَلَ حَتَّى إِذَا شَبِعَ قَاءَ ثُمَّ عَادَ فِي قَيْئِهِ فَأَكَلَهُ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Gifts, Hadith 2384

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2385

chapter.englishTitle: Taking Back A Gift

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Ibn 'Abbas that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            “The one who takes back his gift is like the one who goes back to his vomit.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Ibn 'Abbas that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “The one who takes back his gift is like the one who goes back to his vomit.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ قَتَادَةَ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " الْعَائِدُ فِي هِبَتِهِ كَالْعَائِدِ فِي قَيْئِهِ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Gifts, Hadith 2385

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2386

chapter.englishTitle: Taking Back A Gift

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Ibn`Umar that the Prophet ﷺ said:
            “The one who takes back his gift is like the dog that goes back to its vomit.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Ibn`Umar that the Prophet ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “The one who takes back his gift is like the dog that goes back to its vomit.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ يُوسُفَ الْعَرْعَرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي حَكِيمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْعُمَرِيُّ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ  " الْعَائِدُ فِي هِبَتِهِ كَالْكَلْبِ يَعُودُ فِي قَيْئِهِ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Gifts, Hadith 2386

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2387

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَنْ وَهَبَ هِبَةً رَجَاءَ ثَوَابِهَا
chapter.englishTitle: One Who Gives A Gift Hoping To Get Something Back In Return

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            “A man has more right to his gift so long as he has not gotten something in return for it.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “A man has more right to his gift so long as he has not gotten something in return for it.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ مُجَمِّعِ بْنِ جَارِيَةَ الأَنْصَارِيُّ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " الرَّجُلُ أَحَقُّ بِهِبَتِهِ مَا لَمْ يُثَبْ مِنْهَا " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Gifts, Hadith 2387

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2388

chapter.arabicTitle: باب عَطِيَّةِ الْمَرْأَةِ بِغَيْرِ إِذْنِ زَوْجِهَا
chapter.englishTitle: A Woman Giving Something without Her Husband's Permission

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from 'Amr bin Shu'aib, from his father that he delivered:
            “It is not permissible for a woman to dispose of her wealth except with her husband's permission, once he has married her.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from 'Amr bin Shu'aib, from his father that he delivered:
hadiths.body: “It is not permissible for a woman to dispose of her wealth except with her husband's permission, once he has married her.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو يُوسُفَ الرَّقِّيُّ، مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ الصَّيْدَلاَنِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، عَنِ الْمُثَنَّى بْنِ الصَّبَّاحِ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ شُعَيْبٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ فِي خُطْبَةٍ خَطَبَهَا  " لاَ يَجُوزُ لاِمْرَأَةٍ فِي مَالِهَا إِلاَّ بِإِذْنِ زَوْجِهَا إِذَا هُوَ مَلَكَ عِصْمَتَهَا " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Gifts, Hadith 2388

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2389

chapter.arabicTitle: باب عَطِيَّةِ الْمَرْأَةِ بِغَيْرِ إِذْنِ زَوْجِهَا
chapter.englishTitle: A Woman Giving Something without Her Husband's Permission

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from 'Abdullah bin Yahya, one of the sons of Ka'b bin Malik, from his grandfather, that :
            his grandmother Khairah, the wife of Ka'b bin Malik, came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ with some jewelry belonging to her and said, I am giving this in charity. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to her: “It is not permissible for a woman to dispose of her wealth without her husband's permission. Did you ask Ka'b's permission?” She said: “Yes.” So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ sent for Ka'b bin Malik, her husband, and said, “Did you give Khairah permission to give her jewelry in charity?” He said: “Yes.” So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ accepted it from her.
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from 'Abdullah bin Yahya, one of the sons of Ka'b bin Malik, from his grandfather, that :
hadiths.body: his grandmother Khairah, the wife of Ka'b bin Malik, came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ with some jewelry belonging to her and said, I am giving this in charity. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to her: “It is not permissible for a woman to dispose of her wealth without her husband's permission. Did you ask Ka'b's permission?” She said: “Yes.” So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ sent for Ka'b bin Malik, her husband, and said, “Did you give Khairah permission to give her jewelry in charity?” He said: “Yes.” So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ accepted it from her.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي اللَّيْثُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ يَحْيَى، - رَجُلٌ مِنْ وَلَدِ كَعْبِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ - عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ، أَنَّ جَدَّتَهُ، خَيْرَةَ - امْرَأَةَ كَعْبِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ - أَتَتْ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ بِحُلِيٍّ لَهَا فَقَالَتْ إِنِّي تَصَدَّقْتُ بِهَذَا فَقَالَ لَهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ " لاَ يَجُوزُ لِلْمَرْأَةِ فِي مَالِهَا إِلاَّ بِإِذْنِ زَوْجِهَا فَهَلِ اسْتَأْذَنْتِ كَعْبًا " . قَالَتْ نَعَمْ . فَبَعَثَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ إِلَى كَعْبِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ زَوْجِهَا فَقَالَ " هَلْ أَذِنْتَ لِخَيْرَةَ أَنْ تَتَصَدَّقَ بِحُلِيِّهَا " . فَقَالَ نَعَمْ . فَقَبِلَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ مِنْهَا .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Gifts, Hadith 2389

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2390

chapter.englishTitle: Taking Back One's Charity

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from 'Umar bin Khattab that:
            the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Do not take back your charity.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from 'Umar bin Khattab that:
hadiths.body: the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Do not take back your charity.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ  " لاَ تَعُدْ فِي صَدَقَتِكَ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Charity, Hadith 2390

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2391

chapter.englishTitle: Taking Back One's Charity

hadiths.englishRaw:
'Abdullah bin 'Abbas narrated that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            “The likeness of the one who gives charity then takes it back is that of a dog who vomits then goes back and eats its vomit.”
hadiths.narrator: 'Abdullah bin 'Abbas narrated that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “The likeness of the one who gives charity then takes it back is that of a dog who vomits then goes back and eats its vomit.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الدِّمَشْقِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَوْزَاعِيُّ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ، مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ حَدَّثَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُسَيَّبِ، حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الْعَبَّاسِ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " مَثَلُ الَّذِي يَتَصَدَّقُ ثُمَّ يَرْجِعُ فِي صَدَقَتِهِ مَثَلُ الْكَلْبِ يَقِيءُ ثُمَّ يَرْجِعُ فَيَأْكُلُ قَيْئَهُ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Charity, Hadith 2391

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2392

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَنْ تَصَدَّقَ بِصَدَقَةٍ فَوَجَدَهَا تُبَاعُ هَلْ يَشْتَرِيهَا
chapter.englishTitle: One Who Gives Charity Then Finds His Gift Being Sold - Should He Buy It ?

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from 'Umar, meaning, from his father, his grandfather 'Umar, that :
            he gave a horse in charity at the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, then he saw its owner selling it for a low price. He went to the Prophet ﷺ and asked him about that, and he said: “Do not buy what you gave in charity.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from 'Umar, meaning, from his father, his grandfather 'Umar, that :
hadiths.body: he gave a horse in charity at the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, then he saw its owner selling it for a low price. He went to the Prophet ﷺ and asked him about that, and he said: “Do not buy what you gave in charity.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا تَمِيمُ بْنُ الْمُنْتَصِرِ الْوَاسِطِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، عَنْ شَرِيكٍ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ يَعْنِي، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ، عُمَرَ أَنَّهُ تَصَدَّقَ بِفَرَسٍ عَلَى عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَأَبْصَرَ صَاحِبَهَا يَبِيعُهَا بِكَسْرٍ فَأَتَى النَّبِيَّ ﷺ فَسَأَلَهُ عَنْ ذَلِكَ فَقَالَ  " لاَ تَبْتَعْ صَدَقَتَكَ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Charity, Hadith 2392

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2393

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَنْ تَصَدَّقَ بِصَدَقَةٍ فَوَجَدَهَا تُبَاعُ هَلْ يَشْتَرِيهَا
chapter.englishTitle: One Who Gives Charity Then Finds His Gift Being Sold - Should He Buy It ?

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Zubair bin 'Awwam that :
            he gave a horse called Ghamr or Ghamrah to someone, then he saw one of its colts or fillies attributed to his horse being sold, but he refrained from (buging) it.
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Zubair bin 'Awwam that :
hadiths.body: he gave a horse called Ghamr or Ghamrah to someone, then he saw one of its colts or fillies attributed to his horse being sold, but he refrained from (buging) it.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَكِيمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ التَّيْمِيُّ، عَنْ أَبِي عُثْمَانَ النَّهْدِيِّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَامِرٍ، عَنِ الزُّبَيْرِ بْنِ الْعَوَّامِ، أَنَّهُ حَمَلَ عَلَى فَرَسٍ يُقَالُ لَهُ غَمْرٌ أَوْ غَمْرَةٌ فَرَأَى مُهْرًا أَوْ مُهْرَةً مِنْ أَفْلاَئِهَا يُبَاعُ يُنْسَبُ إِلَى فَرَسِهِ فَنَهَى عَنْهَا .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Charity, Hadith 2393

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2394

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَنْ تَصَدَّقَ بِصَدَقَةٍ ثُمَّ وَرِثَهَا
chapter.englishTitle: One Who Gives Something In Charity Then Inherits It

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from 'Abdullah bin Buraidah that his father said:
            “A woman came to-the Prophet ﷺ and said: 'O Messenger of Allah ﷺ, I gave my mother a slave girl of mine, and she has died.' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'Allah (Subhanahu-wa-Taala) has rewarded you, and returned to you your inheritance (without your seeking that.' ”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from 'Abdullah bin Buraidah that his father said:
hadiths.body: “A woman came to-the Prophet ﷺ and said: 'O Messenger of Allah ﷺ, I gave my mother a slave girl of mine, and she has died.' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'Allah (Subhanahu-wa-Taala) has rewarded you, and returned to you your inheritance (without your seeking that.' ”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَطَاءٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ بُرَيْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ جَاءَتِ امْرَأَةٌ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ ﷺ فَقَالَتْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي تَصَدَّقْتُ عَلَى أُمِّي بِجَارِيَةٍ وَإِنَّهَا مَاتَتْ . فَقَالَ  " آجَرَكِ اللَّهُ وَرَدَّ عَلَيْكِ الْمِيرَاثَ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Charity, Hadith 2394

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2395

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَنْ تَصَدَّقَ بِصَدَقَةٍ ثُمَّ وَرِثَهَا
chapter.englishTitle: One Who Gives Something In Charity Then Inherits It

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from 'Amr bin Shu'aib, from his father, that his grandfather said:
            “A man came to the Prophet ﷺ and said: 'I gave my mother a garden of mine, and she has died and has no other heir but me.' The Messenger of Allahﷺ said: 'Your charity is valid and your garden has been returned to you.' ”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from 'Amr bin Shu'aib, from his father, that his grandfather said:
hadiths.body: “A man came to the Prophet ﷺ and said: 'I gave my mother a garden of mine, and she has died and has no other heir but me.' The Messenger of Allahﷺ said: 'Your charity is valid and your garden has been returned to you.' ”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ الرَّقِّيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْكَرِيمِ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ شُعَيْبٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ، قَالَ جَاءَ رَجُلٌ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ ﷺ فَقَالَ إِنِّي أَعْطَيْتُ أُمِّي حَدِيقَةً لِي وَإِنَّهَا مَاتَتْ وَلَمْ تَتْرُكْ وَارِثًا غَيْرِي فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " وَجَبَتْ صَدَقَتُكَ وَرَجَعَتْ إِلَيْكَ حَدِيقَتُكَ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Charity, Hadith 2395

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2396

chapter.englishTitle: One Who Establishes A Waqf (An Endowment)

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Ibn 'Umar said:
            “Umar bin Khattab acquired some land at Khaibar, and he came to the Prophet ﷺ and consulted him. He said: 'O Messenger of Allahﷺ, I have been given some wealth at Khaibar and I have never been given any wealth that is more precious to me than it. What do you command me to do with it? He said: 'If you wish, you can make it an endowment and give (its produce) in charity.' So 'Umar gave it on the basis that it would not be sold, given away or inherited, and (its produce) was to be given to the poor, to relatives, for freeing slaves, in the cause of Allah, to way fares and to guests; and there was nothing wrong if a person appointed to be in charge of it consumed from it on a reasonable basis or feeding a fried, without accumulating it for himself.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Ibn 'Umar said:
hadiths.body: “Umar bin Khattab acquired some land at Khaibar, and he came to the Prophet ﷺ and consulted him. He said: 'O Messenger of Allahﷺ, I have been given some wealth at Khaibar and I have never been given any wealth that is more precious to me than it. What do you command me to do with it? He said: 'If you wish, you can make it an endowment and give (its produce) in charity.' So 'Umar gave it on the basis that it would not be sold, given away or inherited, and (its produce) was to be given to the poor, to relatives, for freeing slaves, in the cause of Allah, to way fares and to guests; and there was nothing wrong if a person appointed to be in charge of it consumed from it on a reasonable basis or feeding a fried, without accumulating it for himself.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا نَصْرُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ الْجَهْضَمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعْتَمِرُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَوْنٍ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ أَصَابَ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ أَرْضًا بِخَيْبَرَ فَأَتَى النَّبِيَّ ﷺ فَاسْتَأْمَرَهُ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي أَصَبْتُ مَالاً بِخَيْبَرَ لَمْ أُصِبْ مَالاً قَطُّ هُوَ أَنْفَسُ عِنْدِي مِنْهُ فَمَا تَأْمُرُنِي بِهِ فَقَالَ  " إِنْ شِئْتَ حَبَسْتَ أَصْلَهَا وَتَصَدَّقْتَ بِهَا " . قَالَ فَعَمِلَ بِهَا عُمَرُ عَلَى أَنْ لاَ يُبَاعَ أَصْلُهَا وَلاَ يُوهَبَ وَلاَ يُورَثَ تَصَدَّقَ بِهَا لِلْفُقَرَاءِ وَفِي الْقُرْبَى وَفِي الرِّقَابِ وَفِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ وَابْنِ السَّبِيلِ وَالضَّيْفِ لاَ جُنَاحَ عَلَى مَنْ وَلِيَهَا أَنْ يَأْكُلَ مِنْهَا بِالْمَعْرُوفِ أَوْ يُطْعِمَ صَدِيقًا غَيْرَ مُتَمَوِّلٍ .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Charity, Hadith 2396

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2397

chapter.englishTitle: One Who Establishes A Waqf (An Endowment)

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Ibn 'Umar said:
            “Umar bin Khattab said: 'O Messenger of Allah ﷺ, the one hundred shares of the Khaibar I have never been given any wealth that is more beloved to me than them, and I wanted to give them in charity.' The Prophet ﷺ said: 'Make it an endowment and give its produce in the cause of Allah (Subhanahu-wa-Taala).”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Ibn 'Umar said:
hadiths.body: “Umar bin Khattab said: 'O Messenger of Allah ﷺ, the one hundred shares of the Khaibar I have never been given any wealth that is more beloved to me than them, and I wanted to give them in charity.' The Prophet ﷺ said: 'Make it an endowment and give its produce in the cause of Allah (Subhanahu-wa-Taala).”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ الْعَدَنِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ قَالَ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّ الْمِائَةَ سَهْمٍ الَّتِي بِخَيْبَرَ لَمْ أُصِبْ مَالاً قَطُّ هُوَ أَحَبُّ إِلَىَّ مِنْهَا وَقَدْ أَرَدْتُ أَنْ أَتَصَدَّقَ بِهَا فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ  " احْبِسْ أَصْلَهَا وَسَبِّلْ ثَمَرَتَهَا " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Charity, Hadith 2397

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2398

chapter.englishTitle: Borrowed Items

hadiths.englishRaw:
Shurahbil Muslim said:
           I heard Abu Umamah say: “I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: 'Borrowed items are to be returned and an animal borrowed for milking is to be returned.”
hadiths.narrator: Shurahbil Muslim said:
hadiths.body: I heard Abu Umamah say: “I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: 'Borrowed items are to be returned and an animal borrowed for milking is to be returned.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ عَيَّاشٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُرَحْبِيلُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا أُمَامَةَ، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ  " الْعَارِيَةُ مُؤَدَّاةٌ وَالْمِنْحَةُ مَرْدُودَةٌ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Charity, Hadith 2398

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2399

chapter.englishTitle: Borrowed Items

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Anas bin Malik said:
            “I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: 'Borrowed items are to be returned and an animal borrowed for milking is to be returned.' ”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Anas bin Malik said:
hadiths.body: “I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: 'Borrowed items are to be returned and an animal borrowed for milking is to be returned.' ”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، وَعَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الدِّمَشْقِيَّانِ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ شُعَيْبٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ  " الْعَارِيَةُ مُؤَدَّاةٌ وَالْمِنْحَةُ مَرْدُودَةٌ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Charity, Hadith 2399

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2400

chapter.englishTitle: Borrowed Items

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Samurah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            “The hand that takes is responsible for what it has taken until it returns it.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Samurah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “The hand that takes is responsible for what it has taken until it returns it.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ الْمُسْتَمِرِّ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَكِيمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عَدِيٍّ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، عَنْ سَمُرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ  " عَلَى الْيَدِ مَا أَخَذَتْ حَتَّى تُؤَدِّيَهُ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Charity, Hadith 2400

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2401

chapter.englishTitle: Items Placed In Trust

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from 'Amr bin Shu'aib, from his father, that his grandfather said:
            “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'Whoever is entrusted with an item for safekeeping, is not responsible for it (so long as he is not negligent).' ”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from 'Amr bin Shu'aib, from his father, that his grandfather said:
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'Whoever is entrusted with an item for safekeeping, is not responsible for it (so long as he is not negligent).' ”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الْجَهْمِ الأَنْمَاطِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ بْنُ سُوَيْدٍ، عَنِ الْمُثَنَّى، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ شُعَيْبٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " مَنْ أُودِعَ وَدِيعَةً فَلاَ ضَمَانَ عَلَيْهِ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Charity, Hadith 2401

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2402

chapter.englishTitle: When The One Who is Entrusted With Something Engages In Trade With It And Makes A Profit

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from 'Urwah Al-Bariqi that :
            the Prophet ﷺ gave him a Dinar to buy him a sheep, and he bought two sheep for him, then he sold one of them for a Dinar, and bought a Dinar and a sheep to the Prophet ﷺ. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ prayed for blessing for him.
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from 'Urwah Al-Bariqi that :
hadiths.body: the Prophet ﷺ gave him a Dinar to buy him a sheep, and he bought two sheep for him, then he sold one of them for a Dinar, and bought a Dinar and a sheep to the Prophet ﷺ. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ prayed for blessing for him.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ شَبِيبِ بْنِ غَرْقَدَةَ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ الْبَارِقِيِّ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ أَعْطَاهُ دِينَارًا يَشْتَرِي لَهُ شَاةً فَاشْتَرَى لَهُ شَاتَيْنِ فَبَاعَ إِحْدَاهُمَا بِدِينَارٍ فَأَتَى النَّبِيَّ ﷺ بِدِينَارٍ وَشَاةٍ فَدَعَا لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ بِالْبَرَكَةِ . قَالَ فَكَانَ لَوِ اشْتَرَى التُّرَابَ لَرَبِحَ فِيهِ .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Charity, Hadith 2402

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2403

chapter.englishTitle: Transferring Debt

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            “(Wrongdoing) is when a rich man takes a long time to repay a debt, and if one of you is referred to a rich man (to collect a debt), he should accept that referral.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “(Wrongdoing) is when a rich man takes a long time to repay a debt, and if one of you is referred to a rich man (to collect a debt), he should accept that referral.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " الظُّلْمُ مَطْلُ الْغَنِيِّ وَإِذَا أُتْبِعَ أَحَدُكُمْ عَلَى مَلِيءٍ فَلْيَتْبَعْ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Charity, Hadith 2403

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2404

chapter.englishTitle: Transferring Debt

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Ibn 'Umar that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            “When a rich man takes too long to repay a debt, this is wrongdoing, and if the debt is transferred to a rich man, you should accept if.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Ibn 'Umar that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “When a rich man takes too long to repay a debt, this is wrongdoing, and if the debt is transferred to a rich man, you should accept if.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ تَوْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، عَنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ عُبَيْدٍ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " مَطْلُ الْغَنِيِّ ظُلْمٌ وَإِذَا أُحِلْتَ عَلَى مَلِيءٍ فَاتْبَعْهُ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Charity, Hadith 2404

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2405

chapter.englishTitle: Guaranty

hadiths.englishRaw:
Shurahbil bin Muslim Al-Khawlani said:
            I heard Abu Umamah Al-Bahil say: “I heard the Messenger of Allahﷺ say: “The guarantor is responsible and the debt must be repaid.' ”
hadiths.narrator: Shurahbil bin Muslim Al-Khawlani said:
hadiths.body: I heard Abu Umamah Al-Bahil say: “I heard the Messenger of Allahﷺ say: “The guarantor is responsible and the debt must be repaid.' ”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، وَالْحَسَنُ بْنُ عَرَفَةَ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ عَيَّاشٍ، حَدَّثَنِي شُرَحْبِيلُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ الْخَوْلاَنِيُّ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا أُمَامَةَ الْبَاهِلِيَّ، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ  " الزَّعِيمُ غَارِمٌ وَالدَّيْنُ مَقْضِيٌّ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Charity, Hadith 2405

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2406

chapter.englishTitle: Guaranty

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Ibn 'Abbas:
            That during the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, a man pursued a debtor who owed him ten Dinar, and he said: “I do not have anything to give you.” He (the creditor) said: “No, by Allah, I will not leave you until you pay the debt or you bring me a guarantor.” Then he dragged him to the Prophet ﷺ and the Prophet ﷺ said to him: “How long will you wait?” He said: “One month.” The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “I will be a guarantor for him.” Then he came to him at the time the Prophet ﷺ had said, and the Prophet ﷺ said to him: “Where did you get this from?” He said: “From a mine.” He said: “There is nothing good in it,” and he paid the debt for him.
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Ibn 'Abbas:
hadiths.body: That during the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, a man pursued a debtor who owed him ten Dinar, and he said: “I do not have anything to give you.” He (the creditor) said: “No, by Allah, I will not leave you until you pay the debt or you bring me a guarantor.” Then he dragged him to the Prophet ﷺ and the Prophet ﷺ said to him: “How long will you wait?” He said: “One month.” The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “I will be a guarantor for him.” Then he came to him at the time the Prophet ﷺ had said, and the Prophet ﷺ said to him: “Where did you get this from?” He said: “From a mine.” He said: “There is nothing good in it,” and he paid the debt for him.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الصَّبَّاحِ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ الدَّرَاوَرْدِيُّ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ أَبِي عَمْرٍو، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّ رَجُلاً، لَزِمَ غَرِيمًا لَهُ بِعَشَرَةِ دَنَانِيرَ عَلَى عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَقَالَ مَا عِنْدِي شَىْءٌ أُعْطِيكَهُ فَقَالَ لاَ وَاللَّهِ لاَ أُفَارِقُكَ حَتَّى تَقْضِيَنِي أَوْ تَأْتِيَنِي بِحَمِيلٍ فَجَرَّهُ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ ﷺ فَقَالَ لَهُ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ " كَمْ تَسْتَنْظِرُهُ " . فَقَالَ شَهْرًا فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ " فَأَنَا أَحْمِلُ لَهُ " . فَجَاءَهُ فِي الْوَقْتِ الَّذِي قَالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ فَقَالَ لَهُ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ " مِنْ أَيْنَ أَصَبْتَ هَذَا " . قَالَ مِنْ مَعْدِنٍ قَالَ " لاَ خَيْرَ فِيهَا " . وَقَضَاهَا عَنْهُ .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Charity, Hadith 2406

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2407

chapter.englishTitle: Guaranty

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that 'Uthman bin 'Abdullah bin Mawhab said:
            “I heard 'Abdullah bin Abu Qatadah narrate from his father that a corpse was brought to the Prophet ﷺ for him to offer the funeral prayer, and he said: 'Pray for your companion, for he owes a debt.' Abu Qatadah said: 'I will stand surely for him?' The Prophet ﷺ said: 'In full?' He said: 'In full.” And the debt he owed was eighteen or nineteen Dirham.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that 'Uthman bin 'Abdullah bin Mawhab said:
hadiths.body: “I heard 'Abdullah bin Abu Qatadah narrate from his father that a corpse was brought to the Prophet ﷺ for him to offer the funeral prayer, and he said: 'Pray for your companion, for he owes a debt.' Abu Qatadah said: 'I will stand surely for him?' The Prophet ﷺ said: 'In full?' He said: 'In full.” And the debt he owed was eighteen or nineteen Dirham.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَامِرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَوْهَبٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ أُتِيَ بِجِنَازَةٍ لِيُصَلِّيَ عَلَيْهَا فَقَالَ " صَلُّوا عَلَى صَاحِبِكُمْ فَإِنَّ عَلَيْهِ دَيْنًا " . فَقَالَ أَبُو قَتَادَةَ أَنَا أَتَكَفَّلُ بِهِ . قَالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ " بِالْوَفَاءِ " . قَالَ بِالْوَفَاءِ . وَكَانَ الَّذِي عَلَيْهِ ثَمَانِيَةَ عَشَرَ أَوْ تِسْعَةَ عَشَرَ دِرْهَمًا .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Charity, Hadith 2407

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2408

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَنِ ادَّانَ دَيْنًا وَهُوَ يَنْوِي قَضَاءَهُ
chapter.englishTitle: One Who Takes A Loan With The Intention Of Repaying It

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that :
            the Mother of the Believers Maimunah used to take out loans frequently, and some of her family said: “Do not that,” and they denounced her for that. She said: “No. I heard my Prophet ﷺ and my close friend say: ‘There is no Muslim who takes out a loan and Allah(Subhanahu-wa-Taala) knows that he intends to pay it back, but Allah(Subhanahu-wa-Taala) will pay it back for him in this world.'”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that :
hadiths.body: the Mother of the Believers Maimunah used to take out loans frequently, and some of her family said: “Do not that,” and they denounced her for that. She said: “No. I heard my Prophet ﷺ and my close friend say: ‘There is no Muslim who takes out a loan and Allah(Subhanahu-wa-Taala) knows that he intends to pay it back, but Allah(Subhanahu-wa-Taala) will pay it back for him in this world.'”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبِيدَةُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ زِيَادِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ هِنْدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ حُذَيْفَةَ، - هُوَ عِمْرَانُ - عَنْ أُمِّ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ، مَيْمُونَةَ قَالَ كَانَتْ تَدَّانُ دَيْنًا فَقَالَ لَهَا بَعْضُ أَهْلِهَا لاَ تَفْعَلِي وَأَنْكَرَ ذَلِكَ عَلَيْهَا قَالَتْ بَلَى إِنِّي سَمِعْتُ نَبِيِّي وَخَلِيلِي ﷺ يَقُولُ  " مَا مِنْ مُسْلِمٍ يَدَّانُ دَيْنًا يَعْلَمُ اللَّهُ مِنْهُ أَنَّهُ يُرِيدُ أَدَاءَهُ إِلاَّ أَدَّاهُ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ فِي الدُّنْيَا " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Charity, Hadith 2408

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2409

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَنِ ادَّانَ دَيْنًا وَهُوَ يَنْوِي قَضَاءَهُ
chapter.englishTitle: One Who Takes A Loan With The Intention Of Repaying It

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from 'Abdullah bin Ja'far that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            “Allah will be the borrower until he pays off his debt, so long as it (the loan) is not for something that Allah dislikes.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from 'Abdullah bin Ja'far that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “Allah will be the borrower until he pays off his debt, so long as it (the loan) is not for something that Allah dislikes.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ الْمُنْذِرِ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي فُدَيْكٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ سُفْيَانَ، - مَوْلَى الأَسْلَمِيِّينَ - عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " إِنَّ اللَّهَ مَعَ الدَّائِنِ حَتَّى يَقْضِيَ دَيْنَهُ مَا لَمْ يَكُنْ فِيمَا يَكْرَهُ اللَّهُ " . قَالَ فَكَانَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ يَقُولُ لِخَازِنِهِ اذْهَبْ فَخُذْ لِي بِدَيْنٍ فَإِنِّي أَكْرَهُ أَنْ أَبِيتَ لَيْلَةً إِلاَّ وَاللَّهُ مَعِي بَعْدَ الَّذِي سَمِعْتُ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Charity, Hadith 2409

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2410

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَنِ ادَّانَ دَيْنًا لَمْ يَنْوِ قَضَاءَهُ
chapter.englishTitle: One Who Takes A Loan With No Intention Of Repaying It

hadiths.englishRaw:
Suhaib Al-Khair narrated that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
           “ Any Man who takes out a loan, having resolved not to pay it back, will meet Allah (Subhanahu-wa-Taala) as a thief.”
hadiths.narrator: Suhaib Al-Khair narrated that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “ Any Man who takes out a loan, having resolved not to pay it back, will meet Allah (Subhanahu-wa-Taala) as a thief.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ صَيْفِيِّ بْنِ صُهَيْبِ الْخَيْرِ، حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الْحَمِيدِ بْنُ زِيَادِ بْنِ صَيْفِيِّ بْنِ صُهَيْبٍ، عَنْ شُعَيْبِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو، حَدَّثَنَا صُهَيْبُ الْخَيْرِ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ  " أَيُّمَا رَجُلٍ يَدَيَّنُ دَيْنًا وَهُوَ مُجْمِعٌ أَنْ لاَ يُوَفِّيَهُ إِيَّاهُ لَقِيَ اللَّهَ سَارِقًا " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Charity, Hadith 2410

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2411

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَنِ ادَّانَ دَيْنًا لَمْ يَنْوِ قَضَاءَهُ
chapter.englishTitle: One Who Takes A Loan With No Intention Of Repaying It

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Prophet ﷺ said:
            “Whoever takes people's wealth with the intention of destroying it, Allah (Subhanahu-wa-Taala) will destroy him.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Prophet ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “Whoever takes people's wealth with the intention of destroying it, Allah (Subhanahu-wa-Taala) will destroy him.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ كَاسِبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ ثَوْرِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ الدِّيلِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي الْغَيْثِ، - مَوْلَى ابْنِ مُطِيعٍ - عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ قَالَ  " مَنْ أَخَذَ أَمْوَالَ النَّاسِ يُرِيدُ إِتْلاَفَهَا أَتْلَفَهُ اللَّهُ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Charity, Hadith 2411

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2412

chapter.englishTitle: Stern Warning Concerning Debt

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Thawban, the freed slave of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            “Anyone whose soul leaves his body and he is free of three things, will enter Paradise: Arrogance, stealing from the spoils of war, and debt.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Thawban, the freed slave of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “Anyone whose soul leaves his body and he is free of three things, will enter Paradise: Arrogance, stealing from the spoils of war, and debt.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا حُمَيْدُ بْنُ مَسْعَدَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ الْحَارِثِ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدٌ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ أَبِي الْجَعْدِ، عَنْ مَعْدَانَ بْنِ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ، عَنْ ثَوْبَانَ، - مَوْلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ - عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَنَّهُ قَالَ  " مَنْ فَارَقَ الرُّوحُ الْجَسَدَ وَهُوَ بَرِيءٌ مِنْ ثَلاَثٍ دَخَلَ الْجَنَّةَ مِنَ الْكِبْرِ وَالْغُلُولِ وَالدَّيْنِ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Charity, Hadith 2412

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2413

chapter.englishTitle: Stern Warning Concerning Debt

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            “The soul of the believer is attached to his debt until it is paid off.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “The soul of the believer is attached to his debt until it is paid off.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مَرْوَانَ الْعُثْمَانِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " نَفْسُ الْمُؤْمِنِ مُعَلَّقَةٌ بِدَيْنِهِ حَتَّى يُقْضَى عَنْهُ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Charity, Hadith 2413

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2414

chapter.englishTitle: Stern Warning Concerning Debt

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Ibn 'Umar that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            “Whoever dies owing a Dinar or a Dirham, it will be paid back from his good deeds, because then there will be no Dinar or Dirham.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Ibn 'Umar that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “Whoever dies owing a Dinar or a Dirham, it will be paid back from his good deeds, because then there will be no Dinar or Dirham.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ ثَعْلَبَةَ بْنِ سَوَاءٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَمِّي، مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سَوَاءٍ عَنْ حُسَيْنٍ الْمُعَلِّمِ، عَنْ مَطَرٍ الْوَرَّاقِ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " مَنْ مَاتَ وَعَلَيْهِ دِينَارٌ أَوْ دِرْهَمٌ قُضِيَ مِنْ حَسَنَاتِهِ لَيْسَ ثَمَّ دِينَارٌ وَلاَ دِرْهَمٌ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Charity, Hadith 2414

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2415

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَنْ تَرَكَ دَيْنًا أَوْ ضَيَاعًا فَعَلَى اللَّهِ وَعَلَى رَسُولِهِ
chapter.englishTitle: If A Man Leaves Behind A Debt Or Children, Then Allah (SWT) And His Messenger Are Respon

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that:
            if a believer died at the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and he had debts, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ would ask: “Did he leave anything with which to off his debt?” If they said yes, then he would offer the funeral prayer for him, but if they said no, then he would say: “Pray for your companion.” When Allah granted his Prophet ﷺ the conquests, he said: “I am nearer to the believers than their own selves. Whoever dies owing a debt, I will pay it off for him, and whoever leaves behind wealth, it will be for his heirs.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that:
hadiths.body: if a believer died at the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and he had debts, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ would ask: “Did he leave anything with which to off his debt?” If they said yes, then he would offer the funeral prayer for him, but if they said no, then he would say: “Pray for your companion.” When Allah granted his Prophet ﷺ the conquests, he said: “I am nearer to the believers than their own selves. Whoever dies owing a debt, I will pay it off for him, and whoever leaves behind wealth, it will be for his heirs.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَمْرِو بْنِ السَّرْحِ الْمِصْرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ كَانَ يَقُولُ إِذَا تُوُفِّيَ الْمُؤْمِنُ فِي عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَعَلَيْهِ الدَّيْنُ فَيَسْأَلُ " هَلْ تَرَكَ لِدَيْنِهِ مِنْ قَضَاءٍ " . فَإِنْ قَالُوا نَعَمْ . صَلَّى عَلَيْهِ وَإِنْ قَالُوا لاَ . قَالَ " صَلُّوا عَلَى صَاحِبِكُمْ " . فَلَمَّا فَتَحَ اللَّهُ عَلَى رَسُولِهِ الْفُتُوحَ قَالَ " أَنَا أَوْلَى بِالْمُؤْمِنِينَ مِنْ أَنْفُسِهِمْ فَمَنْ تُوُفِّيَ وَعَلَيْهِ دَيْنٌ فَعَلَىَّ قَضَاؤُهُ وَمَنْ تَرَكَ مَالاً فَهُوَ لِوَرَثَتِهِ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Charity, Hadith 2415

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2416

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَنْ تَرَكَ دَيْنًا أَوْ ضَيَاعًا فَعَلَى اللَّهِ وَعَلَى رَسُولِهِ
chapter.englishTitle: If A Man Leaves Behind A Debt Or Children, Then Allah (SWT) And His Messenger Are Respon

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Jabir that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            “Whoever leaves behind money, it is for his heirs, and whoever leaves behind a debt for children, I am nearer to the believers.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Jabir that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “Whoever leaves behind money, it is for his heirs, and whoever leaves behind a debt for children, I am nearer to the believers.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " مَنْ تَرَكَ مَالاً فَلِوَرَثَتِهِ وَمَنْ تَرَكَ دَيْنًا أَوْ ضَيَاعًا فَعَلَىَّ وَإِلَىَّ وَأَنَا أَوْلَى بِالْمُؤْمِنِينَ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Charity, Hadith 2416

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2417

chapter.englishTitle: Giving Respite To One Who Is In Difficulty

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            Whoever is easy with (a debtor) who is in difficulty, Allah will be easy with him in this world and in the Hereafter.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: Whoever is easy with (a debtor) who is in difficulty, Allah will be easy with him in this world and in the Hereafter.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " مَنْ يَسَّرَ عَلَى مُعْسِرٍ يَسَّرَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالآخِرَةِ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Charity, Hadith 2417

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2418

chapter.englishTitle: Giving Respite To One Who Is In Difficulty

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Buraidah Al-Aslami that the Prophet ﷺ said:
            “Whoever gives respite to one in difficulty, he will have (the reward of) an act of charity for each day. Whoever gives him respite after payment becomes due, will have (the reward of) an act of charity equal to (the amount of the loan) for each day.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Buraidah Al-Aslami that the Prophet ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “Whoever gives respite to one in difficulty, he will have (the reward of) an act of charity for each day. Whoever gives him respite after payment becomes due, will have (the reward of) an act of charity equal to (the amount of the loan) for each day.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، عَنْ نُفَيْعٍ أَبِي دَاوُدَ، عَنْ بُرَيْدَةَ الأَسْلَمِيِّ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ  " مَنْ أَنْظَرَ مُعْسِرًا كَانَ لَهُ بِكُلِّ يَوْمٍ صَدَقَةٌ وَمَنْ أَنْظَرَهُ بَعْدَ حِلِّهِ كَانَ لَهُ مِثْلُهُ فِي كُلِّ يَوْمٍ صَدَقَةٌ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Charity, Hadith 2418

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2419

chapter.englishTitle: Giving Respite To One Who Is In Difficulty

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Yasar, the Companion of the Prophet ﷺ that :
            the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whoever would like Allah to shade him with His shade, let him give respite to one in difficulty, or waive repayment of the loan.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Yasar, the Companion of the Prophet ﷺ that :
hadiths.body: the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whoever would like Allah to shade him with His shade, let him give respite to one in difficulty, or waive repayment of the loan.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الدَّوْرَقِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنْ حَنْظَلَةَ بْنِ قَيْسٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الْيَسَرِ، صَاحِبِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " مَنْ أَحَبَّ أَنْ يُظِلَّهُ اللَّهُ فِي ظِلِّهِ - فَلْيُنْظِرْ مُعْسِرًا أَوْ لِيَضَعْ لَهُ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Charity, Hadith 2419

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2420

chapter.englishTitle: Giving Respite To One Who Is In Difficulty

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Hudhaifah that the Prophet ﷺ said:
            “A man died and it was said to him: 'What did you do?' Either he remembered or was reminded and said: 'I used to be easy going in coins and cash collecting debts due, and I used to give respite to (the debtor) who was in difficulty. So, Allah (Subhanahu-wa-Taala) forgave him.' ” Abu Masud said: “I heard that from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Hudhaifah that the Prophet ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “A man died and it was said to him: 'What did you do?' Either he remembered or was reminded and said: 'I used to be easy going in coins and cash collecting debts due, and I used to give respite to (the debtor) who was in difficulty. So, Allah (Subhanahu-wa-Taala) forgave him.' ” Abu Masud said: “I heard that from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَامِرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رِبْعِيَّ بْنَ حِرَاشٍ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ حُذَيْفَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ  " أَنَّ رَجُلاً مَاتَ فَقِيلَ لَهُ مَا عَمِلْتَ - فَإِمَّا ذَكَرَ أَوْ ذُكِّرَ - قَالَ إِنِّي كُنْتُ أَتَجَوَّزُ فِي السِّكَّةِ وَالنَّقْدِ وَأُنْظِرُ الْمُعْسِرَ . فَغَفَرَ اللَّهُ لَهُ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Charity, Hadith 2420

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2421

chapter.arabicTitle: باب حُسْنِ الْمُطَالَبَةِ وَأَخْذِ الْحَقِّ فِي عَفَافٍ
chapter.englishTitle: Asking In A Polite Manner And Taking One's Rights Without Behaving In An Indecent Manner

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Ibn 'Umar and 'Aishah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            “Whoever demands his rights let him do so in a decent manner as much as he can.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Ibn 'Umar and 'Aishah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “Whoever demands his rights let him do so in a decent manner as much as he can.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ خَلَفٍ الْعَسْقَلاَنِيُّ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي مَرْيَمَ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، وَعَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ  " مَنْ طَلَبَ حَقًّا فَلْيَطْلُبْهُ فِي عَفَافٍ وَافٍ أَوْ غَيْرِ وَافٍ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Charity, Hadith 2421

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2422

chapter.arabicTitle: باب حُسْنِ الْمُطَالَبَةِ وَأَخْذِ الْحَقِّ فِي عَفَافٍ
chapter.englishTitle: Asking In A Polite Manner And Taking One's Rights Without Behaving In An Indecent Manner

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to the one who was entitled to something:
            “Take your rights in a decent manner as much as he can.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to the one who was entitled to something:
hadiths.body: “Take your rights in a decent manner as much as he can.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُؤَمَّلِ بْنِ الصَّبَّاحِ الْقَيْسِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مُحَبَّبٍ الْقُرَشِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ السَّائِبِ الطَّائِفِيُّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ يَامِينَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ لِصَاحِبِ الْحَقِّ  " خُذْ حَقَّكَ فِي عَفَافٍ وَافٍ أَوْ غَيْرِ وَافٍ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Charity, Hadith 2422

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2423

chapter.englishTitle: Paying Off Debts In A Good Manner

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            “The best of you - or among the best of you - are those who pay off their debts in the best manner.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “The best of you - or among the best of you - are those who pay off their debts in the best manner.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا شَبَابَةُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ سَلَمَةَ بْنِ كُهَيْلٍ، سَمِعْتُ أَبَا سَلَمَةَ بْنَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " إِنَّ خَيْرَكُمْ - أَوْ مِنْ خَيْرِكُمْ - أَحَاسِنُكُمْ قَضَاءً " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Charity, Hadith 2423

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2424

chapter.englishTitle: Paying Off Debts In A Good Manner

hadiths.englishRaw:
Isma'il bin Abi Rabi'ah Al-Makhzumi narrated from his father, from his grandfather, that :
            the Prophet ﷺ borrowed thirty or forty thousand from him, when he fought at Hunain. When he came back he paid the loan, then the Prophet ﷺ said to him: 'May Allah (Subhanahu-wa-Taala) bless your family and your wealth for you. The reward for lending is repayment and words of paradise.”
hadiths.narrator: Isma'il bin Abi Rabi'ah Al-Makhzumi narrated from his father, from his grandfather, that :
hadiths.body: the Prophet ﷺ borrowed thirty or forty thousand from him, when he fought at Hunain. When he came back he paid the loan, then the Prophet ﷺ said to him: 'May Allah (Subhanahu-wa-Taala) bless your family and your wealth for you. The reward for lending is repayment and words of paradise.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي رَبِيعَةَ الْمَخْزُومِيُّ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ اسْتَسْلَفَ مِنْهُ حِينَ غَزَا حُنَيْنًا ثَلاَثِينَ أَوْ أَرْبَعِينَ أَلْفًا فَلَمَّا قَدِمَ قَضَاهَا إِيَّاهُ ثُمَّ قَالَ لَهُ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ  " بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ فِي أَهْلِكَ وَمَالِكَ إِنَّمَا جَزَاءُ السَّلَفِ الْوَفَاءُ وَالْحَمْدُ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Charity, Hadith 2424

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2425

chapter.englishTitle: The One Who Has A Right Authority (Over The Debtor)

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Ibn 'Abbas said:
            “A man came to ask the Prophet of Allah ﷺ for some debt or some right, and he spoke harshly to him, and the Companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ wanted to rebuke him. But the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'Let him be, for the one who is owed something has authority over the debtor, until it is paid off.' ”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Ibn 'Abbas said:
hadiths.body: “A man came to ask the Prophet of Allah ﷺ for some debt or some right, and he spoke harshly to him, and the Companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ wanted to rebuke him. But the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'Let him be, for the one who is owed something has authority over the debtor, until it is paid off.' ”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الأَعْلَى الصَّنْعَانِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعْتَمِرُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ حَنَشٍ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ جَاءَ رَجُلٌ يَطْلُبُ نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ ﷺ بِدَيْنٍ أَوْ بِحَقٍّ فَتَكَلَّمَ بِبَعْضِ الْكَلاَمِ فَهَمَّ صَحَابَةُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ بِهِ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " مَهْ إِنَّ صَاحِبَ الدَّيْنِ لَهُ سُلْطَانٌ عَلَى صَاحِبِهِ حَتَّى يَقْضِيَهُ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Charity, Hadith 2425

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2426

chapter.englishTitle: The One Who Has A Right Authority (Over The Debtor)

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri said:
            “A Bedouin came to the Prophet ﷺ to ask him to pay back a debt that he owed him, and he spoke harshly, saying: 'I will make things difficult for you unless you repay me.' His Companions rebuked him and said: 'Woe to you, do you know who you are speaking to?' He said: 'I am only asking for my rights.' The Prophet ﷺ said: 'Why do you not support the one who has a right?' Then he sent word to Khawlah bint Qais, saying to her: 'If you have dates, lend them to us until our dates come, then we will pay you back.' She said: 'Yes, may my father be ransomed for you, O Messenger of Allah ﷺ!' So she gave him a loan, and he paid back the Bedouin and fed him. He (the Bedouin) said: 'You have paid me in full, may Allah (Subhanahu-wa-Taala) pay you in full.' He (the Prophet ﷺ ) said: 'Those are the best of people. May that nation not be cleansed (of sin) among whom the weak cannot get their rights without trouble.' ”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri said:
hadiths.body: “A Bedouin came to the Prophet ﷺ to ask him to pay back a debt that he owed him, and he spoke harshly, saying: 'I will make things difficult for you unless you repay me.' His Companions rebuked him and said: 'Woe to you, do you know who you are speaking to?' He said: 'I am only asking for my rights.' The Prophet ﷺ said: 'Why do you not support the one who has a right?' Then he sent word to Khawlah bint Qais, saying to her: 'If you have dates, lend them to us until our dates come, then we will pay you back.' She said: 'Yes, may my father be ransomed for you, O Messenger of Allah ﷺ!' So she gave him a loan, and he paid back the Bedouin and fed him. He (the Bedouin) said: 'You have paid me in full, may Allah (Subhanahu-wa-Taala) pay you in full.' He (the Prophet ﷺ ) said: 'Those are the best of people. May that nation not be cleansed (of sin) among whom the weak cannot get their rights without trouble.' ”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ أَبُو شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عُبَيْدَةَ، - أَظُنُّهُ قَالَ - حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، قَالَ جَاءَ أَعْرَابِيٌّ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ ﷺ يَتَقَاضَاهُ دَيْنًا كَانَ عَلَيْهِ فَاشْتَدَّ عَلَيْهِ حَتَّى قَالَ لَهُ أُحَرِّجُ عَلَيْكَ إِلاَّ قَضَيْتَنِي . فَانْتَهَرَهُ أَصْحَابُهُ وَقَالُوا وَيْحَكَ تَدْرِي مَنْ تُكَلِّمُ قَالَ إِنِّي أَطْلُبُ حَقِّي . فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ " هَلاَّ مَعَ صَاحِبِ الْحَقِّ كُنْتُمْ " . ثُمَّ أَرْسَلَ إِلَى خَوْلَةَ بِنْتِ قَيْسٍ فَقَالَ لَهَا " إِنْ كَانَ عِنْدَكِ تَمْرٌ فَأَقْرِضِينَا حَتَّى يَأْتِيَنَا تَمْرٌ فَنَقْضِيَكِ " . فَقَالَتْ نَعَمْ بِأَبِي أَنْتَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ . قَالَ فَأَقْرَضَتْهُ فَقَضَى الأَعْرَابِيَّ وَأَطْعَمَهُ فَقَالَ أَوْفَيْتَ أَوْفَى اللَّهُ لَكَ . فَقَالَ " أُولَئِكَ خِيَارُ النَّاسِ إِنَّهُ لاَ قُدِّسَتْ أُمَّةٌ لاَ يَأْخُذُ الضَّعِيفُ فِيهَا حَقَّهُ غَيْرَ مُتَعْتَعٍ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Charity, Hadith 2426

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2427

chapter.englishTitle: Imprisonment Because Of Debts And Pursuing Debtors

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from 'Amr bin Sharid that his father said that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            “If one who can afford it delays repayment, his honor and punishment become permissible.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from 'Amr bin Sharid that his father said that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “If one who can afford it delays repayment, his honor and punishment become permissible.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَعَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، حَدَّثَنَا وَبْرُ بْنُ أَبِي دُلَيْلَةَ الطَّائِفِيُّ، حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مَيْمُونِ بْنِ مُسَيْكَةَ، - قَالَ وَكِيعٌ وَأَثْنَى عَلَيْهِ خَيْرًا - عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ الشَّرِيدِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " لَىُّ الْوَاجِدِ يُحِلُّ عِرْضَهُ وَعُقُوبَتَهُ " . قَالَ عَلِيٌّ الطَّنَافِسِيُّ يَعْنِي عِرْضَهُ شِكَايَتَهُ وَعُقُوبَتَهُ سِجْنَهُ .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Charity, Hadith 2427

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2428

chapter.englishTitle: Imprisonment Because Of Debts And Pursuing Debtors

hadiths.englishRaw:
Hirmas bin Habib narrated from his father that his grandfather said:
            “I came to the Prophet ﷺ with a man who owed me money, and he said to me: 'Keep him.' Then he passed by me at the end of the day and said: 'What did your prisoner do, O brother of Banu Tamim?' ”
hadiths.narrator: Hirmas bin Habib narrated from his father that his grandfather said:
hadiths.body: “I came to the Prophet ﷺ with a man who owed me money, and he said to me: 'Keep him.' Then he passed by me at the end of the day and said: 'What did your prisoner do, O brother of Banu Tamim?' ”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا هَدِيَّةُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْوَهَّابِ، حَدَّثَنَا النَّضْرُ بْنُ شُمَيْلٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْهِرْمَاسُ بْنُ حَبِيبٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ، قَالَ أَتَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ بِغَرِيمٍ لِي فَقَالَ لِي " الْزَمْهُ " . ثُمَّ مَرَّ بِي آخِرَ النَّهَارِ فَقَالَ " مَا فَعَلَ أَسِيرُكَ يَا أَخَا بَنِي تَمِيمٍ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Charity, Hadith 2428

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2429

chapter.englishTitle: Imprisonment Because Of Debts And Pursuing Debtors

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from 'Abdullah bin Ka'b bin Malik from his father that :
            he demanded payment owed by Ibn Abi Hadrad in the mosque. Their voices became so loud that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ heard them when he was in his house. He came out and called Ka'b who said: “Here I am, O Messenger of Allah ﷺ!” He said: “Waive this much of your loan,” and gestured with his hand to indicate half. He said: “I will do that,” and he said: “Get up and repay it.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from 'Abdullah bin Ka'b bin Malik from his father that :
hadiths.body: he demanded payment owed by Ibn Abi Hadrad in the mosque. Their voices became so loud that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ heard them when he was in his house. He came out and called Ka'b who said: “Here I am, O Messenger of Allah ﷺ!” He said: “Waive this much of your loan,” and gestured with his hand to indicate half. He said: “I will do that,” and he said: “Get up and repay it.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَيَحْيَى بْنُ حَكِيمٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ عُمَرَ، أَنْبَأَنَا يُونُسُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ كَعْبِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّهُ تَقَاضَى ابْنَ أَبِي حَدْرَدٍ دَيْنًا لَهُ عَلَيْهِ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ حَتَّى ارْتَفَعَتْ أَصْوَاتُهُمَا حَتَّى سَمِعَهُمَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَهُوَ فِي بَيْتِهِ فَخَرَجَ إِلَيْهِمَا فَنَادَى كَعْبًا فَقَالَ لَبَّيْكَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ " دَعْ مِنْ دَيْنِكَ هَذَا " . وَأَوْمَأَ بِيَدِهِ إِلَى الشَّطْرِ فَقَالَ قَدْ فَعَلْتُ . قَالَ " قُمْ فَاقْضِهِ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Charity, Hadith 2429

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2430

chapter.englishTitle: Lending

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Qais bin Rumi said:
            “Sulaiman bin Udhunan lent 'Alqamah one thousand Dirham until he got his salary, When he got his salary, he demanded that he pay him back and treated him harshly. He paid him back, and it was as if 'Alqamah was angry. Several months passed then he came to him and said: 'Lend me one thousand Dirham until my salary comes.' He said 'Yes, it would be an honor. O Umm 'Utbah! Bring me that sealed leather bag that you have.' He said: 'By Allah(Subhanahu-wa-Taala), these are your Dirham that you paid back to me; I did not touch a single Dirham., ' What made you do what you did to me (i.e., treat me so harshly)?' He said: 'What I heard from you.' He said: 'What did you hear from me?' He said: 'I heard you narrated from Ibn Mas'ud that the Prophet ﷺ said: “There is no Muslim who lends something to another Muslim twice, but it will be like giving charity once.”He said: 'That is what Ibn Mas'ud told me.' ”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Qais bin Rumi said:
hadiths.body: “Sulaiman bin Udhunan lent 'Alqamah one thousand Dirham until he got his salary, When he got his salary, he demanded that he pay him back and treated him harshly. He paid him back, and it was as if 'Alqamah was angry. Several months passed then he came to him and said: 'Lend me one thousand Dirham until my salary comes.' He said 'Yes, it would be an honor. O Umm 'Utbah! Bring me that sealed leather bag that you have.' He said: 'By Allah(Subhanahu-wa-Taala), these are your Dirham that you paid back to me; I did not touch a single Dirham., ' What made you do what you did to me (i.e., treat me so harshly)?' He said: 'What I heard from you.' He said: 'What did you hear from me?' He said: 'I heard you narrated from Ibn Mas'ud that the Prophet ﷺ said: “There is no Muslim who lends something to another Muslim twice, but it will be like giving charity once.”He said: 'That is what Ibn Mas'ud told me.' ”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ خَلَفٍ الْعَسْقَلاَنِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْلَى، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ يُسَيْرٍ، عَنْ قَيْسِ بْنِ رُومِيٍّ، قَالَ كَانَ سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ أُذُنَانٍ يُقْرِضُ عَلْقَمَةَ أَلْفَ دِرْهَمٍ إِلَى عَطَائِهِ فَلَمَّا خَرَجَ عَطَاؤُهُ تَقَاضَاهَا مِنْهُ وَاشْتَدَّ عَلَيْهِ فَقَضَاهُ فَكَأَنَّ عَلْقَمَةَ غَضِبَ فَمَكَثَ أَشْهُرًا ثُمَّ أَتَاهُ فَقَالَ أَقْرِضْنِي أَلْفَ دِرْهَمٍ إِلَى عَطَائِي قَالَ نَعَمْ وَكَرَامَةً يَا أُمَّ عُتْبَةَ هَلُمِّي تِلْكَ الْخَرِيطَةَ الْمَخْتُومَةَ الَّتِي عِنْدَكِ . فَجَاءَتْ بِهَا فَقَالَ أَمَا وَاللَّهِ إِنَّهَا لَدَرَاهِمُكَ الَّتِي قَضَيْتَنِي مَا حَرَّكْتُ مِنْهَا دِرْهَمًا وَاحِدًا . قَالَ فَلِلَّهِ أَبُوكَ مَا حَمَلَكَ عَلَى مَا فَعَلْتَ بِي . قَالَ مَا سَمِعْتُ مِنْكَ . قَالَ مَا سَمِعْتَ مِنِّي قَالَ سَمِعْتُكَ تَذْكُرُ عَنِ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ قَالَ  " مَا مِنْ مُسْلِمٍ يُقْرِضُ مُسْلِمًا قَرْضًا مَرَّتَيْنِ إِلاَّ كَانَ كَصَدَقَتِهَا مَرَّةً " . قَالَ كَذَلِكَ أَنْبَأَنِي ابْنُ مَسْعُودٍ .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Charity, Hadith 2430

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2431

chapter.englishTitle: Lending

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Anas bin Malik that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            “On the night on which I was taken on the Night Journey (Isra), I saw written at the gate of Paradise: 'Charity brings a tenfold reward and a loan brings an eighteen fold reward.' I said: 'O Jibril! Why is a loan better than charity?' He said: 'Because the beggar asks when he has something, but the one who asks for loan does so only because he is in need.' ”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Anas bin Malik that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “On the night on which I was taken on the Night Journey (Isra), I saw written at the gate of Paradise: 'Charity brings a tenfold reward and a loan brings an eighteen fold reward.' I said: 'O Jibril! Why is a loan better than charity?' He said: 'Because the beggar asks when he has something, but the one who asks for loan does so only because he is in need.' ”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْكَرِيمِ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي مَالِكٍ، وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي مَالِكٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " رَأَيْتُ لَيْلَةَ أُسْرِيَ بِي عَلَى بَابِ الْجَنَّةِ مَكْتُوبًا الصَّدَقَةُ بِعَشْرِ أَمْثَالِهَا وَالْقَرْضُ بِثَمَانِيَةَ عَشَرَ . فَقُلْتُ يَا جِبْرِيلُ مَا بَالُ الْقَرْضِ أَفْضَلُ مِنَ الصَّدَقَةِ . قَالَ لأَنَّ السَّائِلَ يَسْأَلُ وَعِنْدَهُ وَالْمُسْتَقْرِضُ لاَ يَسْتَقْرِضُ إِلاَّ مِنْ حَاجَةٍ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Charity, Hadith 2431

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2432

chapter.englishTitle: Lending

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Yahya bin Abu Ishaq Al-Huna'i said:
            “I asked Anas bin Malik: 'What if a man gives his brother a loan, then (the borrower) give him a gift?’ The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: ‘If anyone of you borrow something then he gives (the lender) a gift or gives him a ride on his riding-beast, he should not accept the gift or the ride, unless they used to treat each other in that manner beforehand.'”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Yahya bin Abu Ishaq Al-Huna'i said:
hadiths.body: “I asked Anas bin Malik: 'What if a man gives his brother a loan, then (the borrower) give him a gift?’ The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: ‘If anyone of you borrow something then he gives (the lender) a gift or gives him a ride on his riding-beast, he should not accept the gift or the ride, unless they used to treat each other in that manner beforehand.'”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ عَيَّاشٍ، حَدَّثَنِي عُتْبَةُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ الضَّبِّيُّ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ الْهُنَائِيِّ، قَالَ سَأَلْتُ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ الرَّجُلُ مِنَّا يُقْرِضُ أَخَاهُ الْمَالَ فَيُهْدِي لَهُ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " إِذَا أَقْرَضَ أَحَدُكُمْ قَرْضًا فَأَهْدَى لَهُ أَوْ حَمَلَهُ عَلَى الدَّابَّةِ فَلاَ يَرْكَبْهَا وَلاَ يَقْبَلْهُ إِلاَّ أَنْ يَكُونَ جَرَى بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَهُ قَبْلَ ذَلِكَ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Charity, Hadith 2432

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2433

chapter.englishTitle: Paying A Debt On Behalf Of The Deceased

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Sa'd bin Atwal that :
            his brother died, leaving behind three hundred Dirham and dependents. “I wanted to spend (his money) on his dependents, but the Prophet ﷺ said: 'Your brother is being detained by his debt, so pay it off for him.'” He said “O Messenger of Allah ﷺ, I have paid it off apart from two Dinar, which a woman is claiming but she has no proof.” He said: “Give them to her for she is telling the truth.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Sa'd bin Atwal that :
hadiths.body: his brother died, leaving behind three hundred Dirham and dependents. “I wanted to spend (his money) on his dependents, but the Prophet ﷺ said: 'Your brother is being detained by his debt, so pay it off for him.'” He said “O Messenger of Allah ﷺ, I have paid it off apart from two Dinar, which a woman is claiming but she has no proof.” He said: “Give them to her for she is telling the truth.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَفَّانُ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي نَضْرَةَ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ الأَطْوَلِ، أَنَّ أَخَاهُ، مَاتَ وَتَرَكَ ثَلاَثَمِائَةِ دِرْهَمٍ وَتَرَكَ عِيَالاً فَأَرَدْتُ أَنْ أُنْفِقَهَا عَلَى عِيَالِهِ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ " إِنَّ أَخَاكَ مُحْتَبَسٌ بِدَيْنِهِ فَاقْضِ عَنْهُ " . فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَدْ أَدَّيْتُ عَنْهُ إِلاَّ دِينَارَيْنِ ادَّعَتْهُمَا امْرَأَةٌ وَلَيْسَ لَهَا بَيِّنَةٌ . قَالَ " فَأَعْطِهَا فَإِنَّهَا مُحِقَّةٌ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Charity, Hadith 2433

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2434

chapter.englishTitle: Paying A Debt On Behalf Of The Deceased

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Jabir bin 'Abdullah that :
            his father died owing thirty Wasq to a Jewish man. Jabir bin Abdullah asked him for respite but he refused. Jabir asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ to intercede for him with him, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ went and spoke to the Jew, asking him to accept dates in lieu of what was owed, but he refused. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ spoke to him but he refused to give respite. Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ went in among the date-palm trees and walked among them. Then he said to Jabir: “Pick (dates) for him and pay off what is owed to him in full.” So he picked thirty Wasq of dates after the Messenger of Allah ﷺ came back, and there were twelve Wasq more (than what was owed). Jabir came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ to tell him what had happened, and he found that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was absent. When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ came back he came to him and told him that he had paid off the debt in full, and he told him about the extra dates. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Tell 'Umar bin Khattab about that.” So Jabir went to 'Umar said to him: “I knew when the Messenger of Allah ﷺ walked amongst them that Allah (Subhanahu-wa-Taala) would bless them for us.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Jabir bin 'Abdullah that :
hadiths.body: his father died owing thirty Wasq to a Jewish man. Jabir bin Abdullah asked him for respite but he refused. Jabir asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ to intercede for him with him, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ went and spoke to the Jew, asking him to accept dates in lieu of what was owed, but he refused. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ spoke to him but he refused to give respite. Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ went in among the date-palm trees and walked among them. Then he said to Jabir: “Pick (dates) for him and pay off what is owed to him in full.” So he picked thirty Wasq of dates after the Messenger of Allah ﷺ came back, and there were twelve Wasq more (than what was owed). Jabir came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ to tell him what had happened, and he found that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was absent. When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ came back he came to him and told him that he had paid off the debt in full, and he told him about the extra dates. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Tell 'Umar bin Khattab about that.” So Jabir went to 'Umar said to him: “I knew when the Messenger of Allah ﷺ walked amongst them that Allah (Subhanahu-wa-Taala) would bless them for us.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الدِّمَشْقِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعَيْبُ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ وَهْبِ بْنِ كَيْسَانَ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَنَّ أَبَاهُ، تُوُفِّيَ وَتَرَكَ عَلَيْهِ ثَلاَثِينَ وَسْقًا لِرَجُلٍ مِنَ الْيَهُودِ فَاسْتَنْظَرَهُ جَابِرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ فَأَبَى أَنْ يُنْظِرَهُ فَكَلَّمَ جَابِرٌ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ لِيَشْفَعَ لَهُ إِلَيْهِ فَجَاءَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَكَلَّمَ الْيَهُودِيَّ لِيَأْخُذَ ثَمَرَ نَخْلِهِ بِالَّذِي لَهُ عَلَيْهِ فَأَبَى عَلَيْهِ فَكَلَّمَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَأَبَى أَنْ يُنْظِرَهُ فَدَخَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ النَّخْلَ فَمَشَى فِيهَا ثُمَّ قَالَ لِجَابِرٍ " جُدَّ لَهُ فَأَوْفِهِ الَّذِي لَهُ " . فَجَدَّ لَهُ بَعْدَ مَا رَجَعَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ ثَلاَثِينَ وَسْقًا وَفَضَلَ لَهُ اثْنَا عَشَرَ وَسْقًا فَجَاءَ جَابِرٌ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ لِيُخْبِرَهُ بِالَّذِي كَانَ فَوَجَدَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ غَائِبًا فَلَمَّا انْصَرَفَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ جَاءَهُ فَأَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّهُ قَدْ أَوْفَاهُ وَأَخْبَرَهُ بِالْفَضْلِ الَّذِي فَضَلَ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ " أَخْبِرْ بِذَلِكَ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ " . فَذَهَبَ جَابِرٌ إِلَى عُمَرَ فَأَخْبَرَهُ فَقَالَ لَهُ عُمَرُ لَقَدْ عَلِمْتُ حِينَ مَشَى فِيهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ لَيُبَارِكَنَّ اللَّهُ فِيهَا .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Charity, Hadith 2434

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2435

chapter.arabicTitle: باب ثَلاَثٍ مَنِ ادَّانَ فِيهِنَّ قَضَى اللَّهُ عَنْهُ
chapter.englishTitle: Three Things Which, If A Person Takes Out A Loan Because Of Them, Allah (SWT) Will Pay I

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from 'Abdullah bin 'Amr that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            “A debt will be settled on the Day of Resurrection if the one who owes it dies, apart from three: A man who lost his strength fighting in the cause of Allah (Subhanahu-wa-Taala), so he borrows in order to become strong again to fighting in the cause of Allah (Subhanahu-wa-Taala), so he borrows in order to become strong again to fight the enemy of Allah (Subhanahu-wa-Taala) and his enemy. A man who sees a Muslims die and he cannot find anything with which to shroud him except by taking a loan. A man who sees a Muslim die and he cannot find anything with which to shroud him except, by taking a loan. A man who fears Allah (Subhanahu-wa-Taala) if he stays single, so he gets married for fear of (losing) his religious commitment. Allah will pay off the debt for these people on the Day of Resurrection.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from 'Abdullah bin 'Amr that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “A debt will be settled on the Day of Resurrection if the one who owes it dies, apart from three: A man who lost his strength fighting in the cause of Allah (Subhanahu-wa-Taala), so he borrows in order to become strong again to fighting in the cause of Allah (Subhanahu-wa-Taala), so he borrows in order to become strong again to fight the enemy of Allah (Subhanahu-wa-Taala) and his enemy. A man who sees a Muslims die and he cannot find anything with which to shroud him except by taking a loan. A man who sees a Muslim die and he cannot find anything with which to shroud him except, by taking a loan. A man who fears Allah (Subhanahu-wa-Taala) if he stays single, so he gets married for fear of (losing) his religious commitment. Allah will pay off the debt for these people on the Day of Resurrection.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا رِشْدِينُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، وَعَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ الْمُحَارِبِيُّ، وَأَبُو أُسَامَةَ وَجَعْفَرُ بْنُ عَوْنٍ عَنِ ابْنِ أَنْعُمٍ، قَالَ أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ وَحَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَنْعُمٍ، عَنِ عِمْرَانَ بْنِ عَبْدٍ الْمَعَافِرِيِّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " إِنَّ الدَّيْنَ يُقْضَى مِنْ صَاحِبِهِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ إِذَا مَاتَ إِلاَّ مَنْ يَدَيَّنُ فِي ثَلاَثِ خِلاَلٍ الرَّجُلُ تَضْعُفُ قُوَّتُهُ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ فَيَسْتَدِينُ يَتَقَوَّى بِهِ لِعَدُوِّ اللَّهِ وَعَدُوِّهِ وَرَجُلٌ يَمُوتُ عِنْدَهُ مُسْلِمٌ لاَ يَجِدُ مَا يُكَفِّنُهُ وَيُوَارِيهِ إِلاَّ بِدَيْنٍ وَرَجُلٌ خَافَ اللَّهَ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ الْعُزْبَةَ فَيَنْكِحُ خَشْيَةً عَلَى دِينِهِ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ يَقْضِي عَنْ هَؤُلاَءِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Charity, Hadith 2435

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2436

chapter.englishTitle: [Abu Bakr Bin Abi Shaibah Narrated To Us]

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from 'Aisha that :
            the Messenger of Allah ﷺ bought some food from a Jew with payment to be made later, and he pawned his armor for that.
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from 'Aisha that :
hadiths.body: the Messenger of Allah ﷺ bought some food from a Jew with payment to be made later, and he pawned his armor for that.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصُ بْنُ غِيَاثٍ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَدَّثَنِي الأَسْوَدُ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ اشْتَرَى مِنْ يَهُودِيٍّ طَعَامًا إِلَى أَجَلٍ وَأَرْهَنَهُ دِرْعَهُ .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Pawning, Hadith 2436

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2437

chapter.englishTitle: [Abu Bakr Bin Abi Shaibah Narrated To Us]

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Anas said:
            “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ pawned his armor to a jew in Al-Madinah, and took barely for his family in return.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Anas said:
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ pawned his armor to a jew in Al-Madinah, and took barely for his family in return.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا نَصْرُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ الْجَهْضَمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ لَقَدْ رَهَنَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ دِرْعَهُ عِنْدَ يَهُودِيٍّ بِالْمَدِينَةِ فَأَخَذَ لأَهْلِهِ مِنْهُ شَعِيرًا .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Pawning, Hadith 2437

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2438
