chapter.englishTitle: [Abu Bakr Bin Abi Shaibah Narrated To Us]

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Asma' bin Yazid that:
            the Prophet ﷺ died while his armor was pawned to a Jew for food.
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Asma' bin Yazid that:
hadiths.body: the Prophet ﷺ died while his armor was pawned to a Jew for food.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْحَمِيدِ بْنِ بَهْرَامَ، عَنْ شَهْرِ بْنِ حَوْشَبٍ، عَنْ أَسْمَاءَ بِنْتِ يَزِيدَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ تُوُفِّيَ وَدِرْعُهُ مَرْهُونَةٌ عِنْدَ يَهُودِيٍّ بِطَعَامٍ .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Pawning, Hadith 2438

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2439

chapter.englishTitle: [Abu Bakr Bin Abi Shaibah Narrated To Us]

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Ibn 'Abbas that:
            the Messenger of Allah ﷺ died while his armor was pawned to a Jew for thirty Sa’s of barley.' ”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Ibn 'Abbas that:
hadiths.body: the Messenger of Allah ﷺ died while his armor was pawned to a Jew for thirty Sa’s of barley.' ”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاوِيَةَ الْجُمَحِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا ثَابِتُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ، حَدَّثَنَا هِلاَلُ بْنُ خَبَّابٍ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ مَاتَ وَدِرْعُهُ رَهْنٌ عِنْدَ يَهُودِيٍّ بِثَلاَثِينَ صَاعًا مِنْ شَعِيرٍ .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Pawning, Hadith 2439

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2440

chapter.englishTitle: The Pawned Animal May Be Ridden And Milked

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            “A mount may be ridden when it is pawned, and its milk may be drunk when it is pawned, but the one who rides it or milks it must pay for its upkeep.' ”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “A mount may be ridden when it is pawned, and its milk may be drunk when it is pawned, but the one who rides it or milks it must pay for its upkeep.' ”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ زَكَرِيَّا، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " الظَّهْرُ يُرْكَبُ إِذَا كَانَ مَرْهُونًا وَلَبَنُ الدَّرِّ يُشْرَبُ إِذَا كَانَ مَرْهُونًا وَعَلَى الَّذِي يَرْكَبُ وَيَشْرَبُ نَفَقَتُهُ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Pawning, Hadith 2440

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2441

chapter.englishTitle: Pawned Items Are Not To Be Forfeited

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            “Do not forfeit items held in pledge.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “Do not forfeit items held in pledge.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ الْمُخْتَارِ، عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ رَاشِدٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ  " لاَ يَغْلَقُ الرَّهْنُ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Pawning, Hadith 2441

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2442

chapter.englishTitle: Wages Of Workers

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            (Allah (Subhanahu-wa-Taala) says:) “I am the opponent of three on the Day of Resurrection, and if I am someone's opponent I will defeat him: A man who makes promises in My Name, then proves treacherous; a man who sells a free man and consumes his price; and a man who hires a worker, makes use to him, then does not give him his wages.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: (Allah (Subhanahu-wa-Taala) says:) “I am the opponent of three on the Day of Resurrection, and if I am someone's opponent I will defeat him: A man who makes promises in My Name, then proves treacherous; a man who sells a free man and consumes his price; and a man who hires a worker, makes use to him, then does not give him his wages.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا سُوَيْدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سُلَيْمٍ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ أُمَيَّةَ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْمَقْبُرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " ثَلاَثَةٌ أَنَا خَصْمُهُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ وَمَنْ كُنْتُ خَصْمَهُ خَصَمْتُهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ رَجُلٌ أَعْطَى بِي ثُمَّ غَدَرَ وَرَجُلٌ بَاعَ حُرًّا فَأَكَلَ ثَمَنَهُ وَرَجُلٌ اسْتَأْجَرَ أَجِيرًا فَاسْتَوْفَى مِنْهُ وَلَمْ يُوفِهِ أَجْرَهُ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Pawning, Hadith 2442

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2443

chapter.englishTitle: Wages Of Workers

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from 'Abdullah bin 'Umar that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            “Give the worker his wages before his sweat dries.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from 'Abdullah bin 'Umar that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “Give the worker his wages before his sweat dries.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا الْعَبَّاسُ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ الدِّمَشْقِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا وَهْبُ بْنُ سَعِيدِ بْنِ عَطِيَّةَ السُّلَمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " أَعْطُوا الأَجِيرَ أَجْرَهُ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَجِفَّ عَرَقُهُ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Pawning, Hadith 2443

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2444

chapter.arabicTitle: باب إِجَارَةِ الأَجِيرِ عَلَى طَعَامِ بَطْنِهِ
chapter.englishTitle: Hiring A Worker In Return For Food

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that 'Ali bin Rabah said:
            “I heard 'Utbah bin Nuddar say: 'We were with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and he recited Ta-Sin. When he reached the story of Musa, he said: 'Musa (A.S) hired himself out for eight years, or ten, in return for his chastity and food in his stomach.' ”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that 'Ali bin Rabah said:
hadiths.body: “I heard 'Utbah bin Nuddar say: 'We were with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and he recited Ta-Sin. When he reached the story of Musa, he said: 'Musa (A.S) hired himself out for eight years, or ten, in return for his chastity and food in his stomach.' ”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُصَفَّى الْحِمْصِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا بَقِيَّةُ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ، عَنْ مَسْلَمَةَ بْنِ عُلَىٍّ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ، عَنِ الْحَارِثِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ، عَنْ عُلَىِّ بْنِ رَبَاحٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عُتْبَةَ بْنَ النُّدَّرِ، يَقُولُ كُنَّا عِنْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَقَرَأَ طسم حَتَّى إِذَا بَلَغَ قِصَّةَ مُوسَى قَالَ  " إِنَّ مُوسَى ﷺ أَجَّرَ نَفْسَهُ ثَمَانِيَ سِنِينَ أَوْ عَشْرًا عَلَى عِفَّةِ فَرْجِهِ وَطَعَامِ بَطْنِهِ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Pawning, Hadith 2444

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2445

chapter.arabicTitle: باب إِجَارَةِ الأَجِيرِ عَلَى طَعَامِ بَطْنِهِ
chapter.englishTitle: Hiring A Worker In Return For Food

hadiths.englishRaw:
Salim bin Hayyan said:
            I heard Abu Hurairah say: “I grew up an orphan, and I emigrated as a poor man, and I was hired by the daughter of Ghazwan in return for food and a turn riding the camel. I would gather firewood for them when they stopped to camp and urge their camels along for them by singing when they rode. Praise is to Allah (Subhanahu-wa-Taala) who has caused His religion to prevail and has made Abu Hurairah an Imam.”
hadiths.narrator: Salim bin Hayyan said:
hadiths.body: I heard Abu Hurairah say: “I grew up an orphan, and I emigrated as a poor man, and I was hired by the daughter of Ghazwan in return for food and a turn riding the camel. I would gather firewood for them when they stopped to camp and urge their camels along for them by singing when they rode. Praise is to Allah (Subhanahu-wa-Taala) who has caused His religion to prevail and has made Abu Hurairah an Imam.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عُمَرَ، حَفْصُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ، حَدَّثَنَا سَلِيمُ بْنُ حَيَّانَ، سَمِعْتُ أَبِي يَقُولُ، سَمِعْتُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، يَقُولُ نَشَأْتُ يَتِيمًا وَهَاجَرْتُ مِسْكِينًا وَكُنْتُ أَجِيرًا لاِبْنَةِ غَزْوَانَ بِطَعَامِ بَطْنِي وَعُقْبَةِ رِجْلِي أَحْطِبْ لَهُمْ إِذَا نَزَلُوا وَأَحْدُو لَهُمْ إِذَا رَكِبُوا فَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي جَعَلَ الدِّينَ قِوَامًا وَجَعَلَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ إِمَامًا .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Pawning, Hadith 2445

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2446

chapter.arabicTitle: باب الرَّجُلِ يَسْتَقِي كُلَّ دَلْوٍ بِتَمْرَةٍ وَيَشْتَرِطُ جَلْدَةً
chapter.englishTitle: A Man Who Draws A Bucket Of Water In Return For A Date And Stipulates That They Must Be G

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Ibn 'Abbas said:
            “The Prophet ﷺ was in need of food, and news of that reached 'Ali. He went out seeking work so that he could earn something to give to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. He came to a garden belonging to a Jewish man, and he drew seventeen buckets of water for him, each bucket for a date. The Jew gave him the option to take seventeen of his 'Ajwah dates (a high quality of dates) and he brought them to the Prophet of Allah ﷺ.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Ibn 'Abbas said:
hadiths.body: “The Prophet ﷺ was in need of food, and news of that reached 'Ali. He went out seeking work so that he could earn something to give to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. He came to a garden belonging to a Jewish man, and he drew seventeen buckets of water for him, each bucket for a date. The Jew gave him the option to take seventeen of his 'Ajwah dates (a high quality of dates) and he brought them to the Prophet of Allah ﷺ.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الأَعْلَى الصَّنْعَانِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا الْمُعْتَمِرُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ حَنَشٍ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ أَصَابَ نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ ﷺ خَصَاصَةٌ فَبَلَغَ ذَلِكَ عَلِيًّا فَخَرَجَ يَلْتَمِسُ عَمَلاً يُصِيبُ فِيهِ شَيْئًا لِيُغِيثَ بِهِ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَأَتَى بُسْتَانًا لِرَجُلٍ مِنَ الْيَهُودِ فَاسْتَقَى لَهُ سَبْعَةَ عَشَرَ دَلْوًا كُلُّ دَلْوٍ بِتَمْرَةٍ فَخَيَّرَهُ الْيَهُودِيُّ مِنْ تَمْرِهِ سَبْعَ عَشَرَةَ عَجْوَةً فَجَاءَ بِهَا إِلَى نَبِيِّ اللَّهِ ﷺ .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Pawning, Hadith 2446

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2447

chapter.arabicTitle: باب الرَّجُلِ يَسْتَقِي كُلَّ دَلْوٍ بِتَمْرَةٍ وَيَشْتَرِطُ جَلْدَةً
chapter.englishTitle: A Man Who Draws A Bucket Of Water In Return For A Date And Stipulates That They Must Be G

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that 'Ali said:
            “I used to draw water, one bucket for a date, and I stipulated that they should be good quality, dried dates.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that 'Ali said:
hadiths.body: “I used to draw water, one bucket for a date, and I stipulated that they should be good quality, dried dates.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ أَبِي حَيَّةَ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ، قَالَ كُنْتُ أَدْلُو الدَّلْوَ بِتَمْرَةٍ وَأَشْتَرِطُ أَنَّهَا جَلْدَةٌ .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Pawning, Hadith 2447

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2448

chapter.arabicTitle: باب الرَّجُلِ يَسْتَقِي كُلَّ دَلْوٍ بِتَمْرَةٍ وَيَشْتَرِطُ جَلْدَةً
chapter.englishTitle: A Man Who Draws A Bucket Of Water In Return For A Date And Stipulates That They Must Be G

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Abu Hurairah said:
            “A man from among the Ansar Came and said: 'O Messenger of Allah ﷺ, why do I see that your color has changed?' He said: 'Hunger.' So the Ansari went to his dwelling, but he did not find anything in his dwelling, so he went out looking, and he found a Jew watering his date-palm trees. The Ansari stipulated that he would not take any dates that were black (rotten), hard and dried out or inferior, and he would only take good quality dates. He earned nearly two Sa's (of dates), and he brought it to the Prophet ﷺ.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Abu Hurairah said:
hadiths.body: “A man from among the Ansar Came and said: 'O Messenger of Allah ﷺ, why do I see that your color has changed?' He said: 'Hunger.' So the Ansari went to his dwelling, but he did not find anything in his dwelling, so he went out looking, and he found a Jew watering his date-palm trees. The Ansari stipulated that he would not take any dates that were black (rotten), hard and dried out or inferior, and he would only take good quality dates. He earned nearly two Sa's (of dates), and he brought it to the Prophet ﷺ.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ الْمُنْذِرِ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ فُضَيْلٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ جَاءَ رَجُلٌ مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ مَا لِي أَرَى لَوْنَكَ مُنْكَفِئًا . قَالَ  " الْخَمْصُ " . فَانْطَلَقَ الأَنْصَارِيُّ إِلَى رَحْلِهِ فَلَمْ يَجِدْ فِي رَحْلِهِ شَيْئًا فَخَرَجَ يَطْلُبُ فَإِذَا هُوَ بِيَهُودِيٍّ يَسْقِي نَخْلاً فَقَالَ الأَنْصَارِيُّ لِلْيَهُودِيِّ أَسْقِي نَخْلَكَ قَالَ نَعَمْ . قَالَ كُلُّ دَلْوٍ بِتَمْرَةٍ . وَاشْتَرَطَ الأَنْصَارِيُّ أَنْ لاَ يَأْخُذَ خَدِرَةً وَلاَ تَارِزَةً وَلاَ حَشَفَةً وَلاَ يَأْخُذَ إِلاَّ جَلْدَةً . فَاسْتَقَى بِنَحْوٍ مِنْ صَاعَيْنِ فَجَاءَ بِهِ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ ﷺ .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Pawning, Hadith 2448

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2449

chapter.englishTitle: Lending Land In Return For One Third Or One Quarter (Of The Crop)

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Rafi 'bin Khadji said:
            “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade Muhaqalah and Muzabanah, and said: 'Only three may cultivate: A man who has land which he cultivates a man who was given some land and cultivates what he was given; and a man who takes land on lease for gold or silver.' ”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Rafi 'bin Khadji said:
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade Muhaqalah and Muzabanah, and said: 'Only three may cultivate: A man who has land which he cultivates a man who was given some land and cultivates what he was given; and a man who takes land on lease for gold or silver.' ”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا هَنَّادُ بْنُ السَّرِيِّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الأَحْوَصِ، عَنْ طَارِقِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، عَنْ رَافِعِ بْنِ خَدِيجٍ، قَالَ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَنِ الْمُحَاقَلَةِ وَالْمُزَابَنَةِ . وَقَالَ  " إِنَّمَا يَزْرَعُ ثَلاَثَةٌ رَجُلٌ لَهُ أَرْضٌ فَهُوَ يَزْرَعُهَا وَرَجُلٌ مُنِحَ أَرْضًا فَهُوَ يَزْرَعُ مَا مُنِحَ وَرَجُلٌ اسْتَكْرَى أَرْضًا بِذَهَبٍ أَوْ فِضَّةٍ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Pawning, Hadith 2449

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2450

chapter.englishTitle: Lending Land In Return For One Third Or One Quarter (Of The Crop)

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that 'Amr bin Dinar said:
            “I heard Ibn 'Umar say: 'We used to lend land for cultivation in return for a share of the harvest, and we did not see anything wrong with that, until we heard Rafi' bin Khadij say: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade it.” Then we stopped because of what he said.' ”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that 'Amr bin Dinar said:
hadiths.body: “I heard Ibn 'Umar say: 'We used to lend land for cultivation in return for a share of the harvest, and we did not see anything wrong with that, until we heard Rafi' bin Khadij say: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade it.” Then we stopped because of what he said.' ”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الصَّبَّاحِ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ عُمَرَ، يَقُولُ كُنَّا نُخَابِرُ وَلاَ نَرَى بِذَلِكَ بَأْسًا حَتَّى سَمِعْنَا رَافِعَ بْنَ خَدِيجٍ يَقُولُ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَنْهُ . فَتَرَكْنَاهُ لِقَوْلِهِ .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Pawning, Hadith 2450

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2451

chapter.englishTitle: Lending Land In Return For One Third Or One Quarter (Of The Crop)

hadiths.englishRaw:
'Ata' said:
            “I heard Jabir bin 'Abdullah say: Some men among us had extra land which they would rent out for one third or one quarter (of the crop). The Prophet ﷺ said: “Whoever has extra land, let him cultivate it (himself) or let him give it to his brother (for free, to cultivate it), and if he does not want to do that, let him keep his land.”
hadiths.narrator: 'Ata' said:
hadiths.body: “I heard Jabir bin 'Abdullah say: Some men among us had extra land which they would rent out for one third or one quarter (of the crop). The Prophet ﷺ said: “Whoever has extra land, let him cultivate it (himself) or let him give it to his brother (for free, to cultivate it), and if he does not want to do that, let him keep his land.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الدِّمَشْقِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَوْزَاعِيُّ، حَدَّثَنِي عَطَاءٌ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، يَقُولُ كَانَتْ لِرِجَالٍ مِنَّا فُضُولُ أَرَضِينَ يُؤَاجِرُونَهَا عَلَى الثُّلُثِ وَالرُّبُعِ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ  " مَنْ كَانَتْ لَهُ فُضُولُ أَرَضِينَ فَلْيَزْرَعْهَا أَوْ لِيُزْرِعْهَا أَخَاهُ فَإِنْ أَبَى فَلْيُمْسِكْ أَرْضَهُ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Pawning, Hadith 2451

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2452

chapter.englishTitle: Lending Land In Return For One Third Or One Quarter (Of The Crop)

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            “Whoever has land, let him cultivate it (himself) or let him give it to his brother (for free, to cultivate it), and if he does not want to do that, let him keep his land.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “Whoever has land, let him cultivate it (himself) or let him give it to his brother (for free, to cultivate it), and if he does not want to do that, let him keep his land.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الْجَوْهَرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو تَوْبَةَ الرَّبِيعُ بْنُ نَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاوِيَةُ بْنُ سَلاَّمٍ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " مَنْ كَانَتْ لَهُ أَرْضٌ فَلْيَزْرَعْهَا أَوْ لِيَمْنَحْهَا أَخَاهُ فَإِنْ أَبَى فَلْيُمْسِكْ أَرْضَهُ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Pawning, Hadith 2452

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2453

chapter.englishTitle: Leasing Out Land

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Ibn 'Umar that:
            he used to lease out some land that belonged to him, for cultivation. Then someone came to him and told him that Rafi' bin Khadij said that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ had forbidden leasing out land for cultivation. Ibn 'Umar went, and I went with him, until he met him in Balat, and asked him about that, and he told him that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ had forbidden leasing out land for cultivation. So 'Abdullah stopped lessening out land.
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Ibn 'Umar that:
hadiths.body: he used to lease out some land that belonged to him, for cultivation. Then someone came to him and told him that Rafi' bin Khadij said that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ had forbidden leasing out land for cultivation. Ibn 'Umar went, and I went with him, until he met him in Balat, and asked him about that, and he told him that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ had forbidden leasing out land for cultivation. So 'Abdullah stopped lessening out land.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَةُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، وَأَبُو أُسَامَةَ وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُبَيْدٍ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، - أَوْ قَالَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ - عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّهُ كَانَ يُكْرِي أَرْضًا لَهُ مَزَارِعًا فَأَتَاهُ إِنْسَانٌ فَأَخْبَرَهُ عَنْ رَافِعِ بْنِ خَدِيجٍ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ نَهَى عَنْ كِرَاءِ الْمَزَارِعِ فَذَهَبَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ وَذَهَبْتُ مَعَهُ حَتَّى أَتَاهُ بِالْبَلاَطِ فَسَأَلَهُ عَنْ ذَلِكَ فَأَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ نَهَى عَنْ كِرَاءِ الْمَزَارِعِ فَتَرَكَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ كِرَاءَهَا .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Pawning, Hadith 2453

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2454

chapter.englishTitle: Leasing Out Land

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Jabir bin 'Abdullah said:
            “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ addressed us and said: 'Whoever has land, let him cultivate it or allow someone else to cultivate it, and not rent it out.' ”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Jabir bin 'Abdullah said:
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ addressed us and said: 'Whoever has land, let him cultivate it or allow someone else to cultivate it, and not rent it out.' ”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ سَعِيدِ بْنِ كَثِيرِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ الْحِمْصِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا ضَمْرَةُ بْنُ رَبِيعَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ شَوْذَبٍ، عَنْ مَطَرٍ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ خَطَبَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَقَالَ  " مَنْ كَانَتْ لَهُ أَرْضٌ فَلْيَزْرَعْهَا أَوْ لِيُزْرِعْهَا وَلاَ يُؤَاجِرْهَا " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Pawning, Hadith 2454

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2455

chapter.englishTitle: Leasing Out Land

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Sufyan, the freed slave of Ibn Abu Ahmad, that he told him that he heard Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri say:
            “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade Muhaqlah.” Muhaqlah means leasing out land
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Sufyan, the freed slave of Ibn Abu Ahmad, that he told him that he heard Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri say:
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade Muhaqlah.” Muhaqlah means leasing out land
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا مُطَرِّفُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ دَاوُدَ بْنِ الْحُصَيْنِ، عَنْ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ، - مَوْلَى ابْنِ أَبِي أَحْمَدَ - أَنَّهُ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّهُ، سَمِعَ أَبَا سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيَّ، يَقُولُ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَنِ الْمُحَاقَلَةِ . وَالْمُحَاقَلَةُ اسْتِكْرَاءُ الأَرْضِ .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Pawning, Hadith 2455

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2456

chapter.arabicTitle: باب الرُّخْصَةِ فِي كِرَاءِ الأَرْضِ الْبَيْضَاءِ بِالذَّهَبِ وَالْفِضَّةِ
chapter.englishTitle: Concession Allowing Leasing Out Barren Land For Gold And Silver

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Ibn 'Abbas that he heard that people were leasing out land more. He said:
            “Subhan-Allah, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'Why does not one of you lend it to his brother?' But he did not forbid leasing it out.' ”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Ibn 'Abbas that he heard that people were leasing out land more. He said:
hadiths.body: “Subhan-Allah, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'Why does not one of you lend it to his brother?' But he did not forbid leasing it out.' ”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رُمْحٍ، أَنْبَأَنَا اللَّيْثُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ بْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنْ طَاوُسٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّهُ لَمَّا سَمِعَ إِكْثَارَ النَّاسِ، فِي كِرَاءِ الأَرْضِ قَالَ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ إِنَّمَا قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " أَلاَ مَنَحَهَا أَحَدُكُمْ أَخَاهُ " . وَلَمْ يَنْهَ عَنْ كِرَائِهَا .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Pawning, Hadith 2456

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2457

chapter.arabicTitle: باب الرُّخْصَةِ فِي كِرَاءِ الأَرْضِ الْبَيْضَاءِ بِالذَّهَبِ وَالْفِضَّةِ
chapter.englishTitle: Concession Allowing Leasing Out Barren Land For Gold And Silver

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Ibn 'Abbas that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            “If one of you were to lend his brother his land, it would be better for him than taking such and such rent for it.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Ibn 'Abbas that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “If one of you were to lend his brother his land, it would be better for him than taking such and such rent for it.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا الْعَبَّاسُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْعَظِيمِ الْعَنْبَرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَنْبَأَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ طَاوُسٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " لأَنْ يَمْنَحَ أَحَدُكُمْ أَخَاهُ أَرْضَهُ خَيْرٌ لَهُ مِنْ أَنْ يَأْخُذَ عَلَيْهَا كَذَا وَكَذَا " . لِشَىْءٍ مَعْلُومٍ . وَقَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ هُوَ الْحَقْلُ وَهُوَ بِلِسَانِ الأَنْصَارِ الْمُحَاقَلَةُ .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Pawning, Hadith 2457

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2458

chapter.arabicTitle: باب الرُّخْصَةِ فِي كِرَاءِ الأَرْضِ الْبَيْضَاءِ بِالذَّهَبِ وَالْفِضَّةِ
chapter.englishTitle: Concession Allowing Leasing Out Barren Land For Gold And Silver

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Hazalah bin Qais said:
            “I asked Rafi' bin Khadij and he said: 'We used to lease out land on the basis that you would have what is produced by this piece of land, and I would have what is produced by this (other) piece of land, and we were forbidden to lease it out on the basis of crop-sharing but he did not forbid us to rent out land for silver.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Hazalah bin Qais said:
hadiths.body: “I asked Rafi' bin Khadij and he said: 'We used to lease out land on the basis that you would have what is produced by this piece of land, and I would have what is produced by this (other) piece of land, and we were forbidden to lease it out on the basis of crop-sharing but he did not forbid us to rent out land for silver.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الصَّبَّاحِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ حَنْظَلَةَ بْنِ قَيْسٍ، قَالَ سَأَلْتُ رَافِعَ بْنَ خَدِيجٍ قَالَ كُنَّا نُكْرِي الأَرْضَ عَلَى أَنَّ لَكَ مَا أَخْرَجَتْ هَذِهِ وَلِي مَا أَخْرَجَتْ هَذِهِ فَنُهِينَا أَنْ نُكْرِيَهَا بِمَا أَخْرَجَتْ وَلَمْ نُنْهَ أَنْ نُكْرِيَ الأَرْضَ بِالْوَرِقِ .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Pawning, Hadith 2458

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2459

chapter.englishTitle: Kinds Of Cultivation That Are Disliked

hadiths.englishRaw:
Rafi'bin Khadi'j narrated that his paternal uncle Zuhair said:
            “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade us from doing something that was convenient for us.” I said: “What the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said is true.” He said that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “What do you with your farms?” We said: “We rent them out for one third or one quarter of their yield, and a certain amount of wheat and barley.” He said: “Do not do that; cultivate them or let others cultivate them.”
hadiths.narrator: Rafi'bin Khadi'j narrated that his paternal uncle Zuhair said:
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade us from doing something that was convenient for us.” I said: “What the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said is true.” He said that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “What do you with your farms?” We said: “We rent them out for one third or one quarter of their yield, and a certain amount of wheat and barley.” He said: “Do not do that; cultivate them or let others cultivate them.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الدِّمَشْقِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَوْزَاعِيُّ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو النَّجَاشِيِّ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ رَافِعَ بْنَ خَدِيجٍ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ عَمِّهِ، ظُهَيْرٍ قَالَ نَهَانَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَنْ أَمْرٍ كَانَ لَنَا رَافِقًا . فَقُلْتُ مَا قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَهُوَ حَقٌّ . فَقَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ " مَا تَصْنَعُونَ بِمَحَاقِلِكُمْ " . قُلْنَا نُؤَاجِرُهَا عَلَى الثُّلُثِ وَالرُّبُعِ وَالأَوْسُقِ مِنَ الْبُرِّ وَالشَّعِيرِ . فَقَالَ " فَلاَ تَفْعَلُوا ازْرَعُوهَا أَوْ أَزْرِعُوهَا " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Pawning, Hadith 2459

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2460

chapter.englishTitle: Kinds Of Cultivation That Are Disliked

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Usaid bin Zuhair, the paternal nephew of Rafi' bin Khdij, that Rafi' bin Khadij said:
            “If one of us did not need his land, he would give it (to someone else to cultivate) in return for one third, or one half of the yield , and he would stipulate (that the should receive) the produce grows on the banks of three streams, and the grains that remain in the ear after threshing, and the produce irrigated by a stream. Life at that time was hard, and he would work (the land) with iron and whatever Allah (Subhanahu-wa-Taala) willed, and he would benefit from it. Then Rafi bin Khadij came to us and said: ‘The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade you to do something that may seem beneficial to you, but obedience to Allah and obedience to His Messenger are more beneficial for you. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade Haq for you, and he said: “Whoever has no need of his land, let him give it to his brother (to cultivate) or let him leave it (uncultivated).”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Usaid bin Zuhair, the paternal nephew of Rafi' bin Khdij, that Rafi' bin Khadij said:
hadiths.body: “If one of us did not need his land, he would give it (to someone else to cultivate) in return for one third, or one half of the yield , and he would stipulate (that the should receive) the produce grows on the banks of three streams, and the grains that remain in the ear after threshing, and the produce irrigated by a stream. Life at that time was hard, and he would work (the land) with iron and whatever Allah (Subhanahu-wa-Taala) willed, and he would benefit from it. Then Rafi bin Khadij came to us and said: ‘The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade you to do something that may seem beneficial to you, but obedience to Allah and obedience to His Messenger are more beneficial for you. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade Haq for you, and he said: “Whoever has no need of his land, let him give it to his brother (to cultivate) or let him leave it (uncultivated).”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَنْبَأَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَنْبَأَنَا الثَّوْرِيُّ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، عَنْ أُسَيْدِ بْنِ ظُهَيْرٍ ابْنِ أَخِي، رَافِعِ بْنِ خَدِيجٍ عَنْ رَافِعِ بْنِ خَدِيجٍ، قَالَ كَانَ أَحَدُنَا إِذَا اسْتَغْنَى عَنْ أَرْضِهِ، أَعْطَاهَا بِالثُّلُثِ وَالرُّبُعِ وَالنِّصْفِ وَاشْتَرَطَ ثَلاَثَةَ جَدَاوِلَ وَالْقُصَارَةَ وَمَا سَقَى الرَّبِيعُ وَكَانَ الْعَيْشُ إِذْ ذَاكَ شَدِيدًا وَكَانَ يَعْمَلُ فِيهَا بِالْحَدِيدِ وَبِمَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ وَيُصِيبُ مِنْهَا مَنْفَعَةً فَأَتَانَا رَافِعُ بْنُ خَدِيجٍ فَقَالَ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ نَهَاكُمْ عَنْ أَمْرٍ كَانَ لَكُمْ نَافِعًا وَطَاعَةُ اللَّهِ وَطَاعَةُ رَسُولِهِ أَنْفَعُ لَكُمْ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَنْهَاكُمْ عَنِ الْحَقْلِ وَيَقُولُ  " مَنِ اسْتَغْنَى عَنْ أَرْضِهِ فَلْيَمْنَحْهَا أَخَاهُ أَوْ لِيَدَعْ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Pawning, Hadith 2460

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2461

chapter.englishTitle: Kinds Of Cultivation That Are Disliked

hadiths.englishRaw:
Zaid bin Thabit said:
            “May Allah (Subhanahu-wa-Taala) forgive Rafi' bin Khadij. By Allah (Subhanahu-wa-Taala)! I have more knowledge of Ahadith than he does. Two men who had quarreled came to the Prophet ﷺ and he said: 'If this is your situation, do not lease farms,' and what Rafi' bin khadij heard was 'Do not lease farms.' ”
hadiths.narrator: Zaid bin Thabit said:
hadiths.body: “May Allah (Subhanahu-wa-Taala) forgive Rafi' bin Khadij. By Allah (Subhanahu-wa-Taala)! I have more knowledge of Ahadith than he does. Two men who had quarreled came to the Prophet ﷺ and he said: 'If this is your situation, do not lease farms,' and what Rafi' bin khadij heard was 'Do not lease farms.' ”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الدَّوْرَقِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو عُبَيْدَةَ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمَّارِ بْنِ يَاسِرٍ، عَنِ الْوَلِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي الْوَلِيدِ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ، قَالَ قَالَ زَيْدُ بْنُ ثَابِتٍ يَغْفِرُ اللَّهُ لِرَافِعِ بْنِ خَدِيجٍ أَنَا وَاللَّهِ، أَعْلَمُ بِالْحَدِيثِ مِنْهُ إِنَّمَا أَتَى رَجُلاَنِ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ وَقَدِ اقْتَتَلاَ فَقَالَ " إِنْ كَانَ هَذَا شَأْنَكُمْ فَلاَ تُكْرُوا الْمَزَارِعَ " . قَالَ فَسَمِعَ رَافِعُ بْنُ خَدِيجٍ قَوْلَهُ " فَلاَ تُكْرُوا الْمَزَارِعَ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Pawning, Hadith 2461

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2462

chapter.arabicTitle: باب الرُّخْصَةِ فِي الْمُزَارَعَةِ بِالثُّلُثِ وَالرُّبُعِ
chapter.englishTitle: Concession Allowing Cultivation for One Third And One Quarter (Of The Crop)

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that 'Amr bin Dinar said:
           I said to Tawus: “O Abu 'Abdur-Rahman, why do you not give up this Mukhabarah because they claim that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade it.” He said: “O 'Amr, I help them by taking their land and cultivating it, and giving them something in return, and Mu`adh bin Jabal allowed people here to do that. The most knowledgeable of them - meaning Ibn`Abbas - told me that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ did not forbid it, rather he said: 'For one you to give (land) to his brother is better than if he were to take a set amount in rent for it.'”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that 'Amr bin Dinar said:
hadiths.body: I said to Tawus: “O Abu 'Abdur-Rahman, why do you not give up this Mukhabarah because they claim that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade it.” He said: “O 'Amr, I help them by taking their land and cultivating it, and giving them something in return, and Mu`adh bin Jabal allowed people here to do that. The most knowledgeable of them - meaning Ibn`Abbas - told me that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ did not forbid it, rather he said: 'For one you to give (land) to his brother is better than if he were to take a set amount in rent for it.'”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الصَّبَّاحِ، أَنْبَأَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ، قَالَ قُلْتُ لِطَاوُسٍ يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ لَوْ تَرَكْتَ هَذِهِ الْمُخَابَرَةَ فَإِنَّهُمْ يَزْعُمُونَ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ نَهَى عَنْهُ . فَقَالَ أَىْ عَمْرُو إِنِّي أُعِينُهُمْ وَأُعْطِيهِمْ وَإِنَّ مُعَاذَ بْنَ جَبَلٍ أَخَذَ النَّاسَ عَلَيْهَا عِنْدَنَا وَإِنَّ أَعْلَمَهُمْ - يَعْنِي ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ - أَخْبَرَنِي أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ لَمْ يَنْهَ عَنْهَا وَلَكِنْ قَالَ  " لأَنْ يَمْنَحَ أَحَدُكُمْ أَخَاهُ خَيْرٌ لَهُ مِنْ أَنْ يَأْخُذَ عَلَيْهَا أَجْرًا مَعْلُومًا " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Pawning, Hadith 2462

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2463

chapter.arabicTitle: باب الرُّخْصَةِ فِي الْمُزَارَعَةِ بِالثُّلُثِ وَالرُّبُعِ
chapter.englishTitle: Concession Allowing Cultivation for One Third And One Quarter (Of The Crop)

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Tawus that :
            Mu`adh bin Jabl leased some land during the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, Abu Bakr, 'Umar and 'Uthmah, in return for one third or one fourth (of the yield), and he was still doing that until this day of yours.
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Tawus that :
hadiths.body: Mu`adh bin Jabl leased some land during the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, Abu Bakr, 'Umar and 'Uthmah, in return for one third or one fourth (of the yield), and he was still doing that until this day of yours.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ ثَابِتٍ الْجَحْدَرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ، عَنْ خَالِدٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، عَنْ طَاوُسٍ، أَنَّ مُعَاذَ بْنَ جَبَلٍ، أَكْرَى الأَرْضَ عَلَى عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَأَبِي بَكْرٍ وَعُمَرَ وَعُثْمَانَ عَلَى الثُّلُثِ وَالرُّبُعِ فَهُوَ يَعْمَلُ بِهِ إِلَى يَوْمِكَ هَذَا .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Pawning, Hadith 2463

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2464

chapter.arabicTitle: باب الرُّخْصَةِ فِي الْمُزَارَعَةِ بِالثُّلُثِ وَالرُّبُعِ
chapter.englishTitle: Concession Allowing Cultivation for One Third And One Quarter (Of The Crop)

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Tawus that Ibn`Abbas told that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ merely said:
            “For one of you to give (land) to his brother is better for him than if he were to take a set amount in rent for it.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Tawus that Ibn`Abbas told that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ merely said:
hadiths.body: “For one of you to give (land) to his brother is better for him than if he were to take a set amount in rent for it.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ خَلاَّدٍ الْبَاهِلِيُّ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنْ طَاوُسٍ، قَالَ قَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ إِنَّمَا قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " لأَنْ يَمْنَحَ أَحَدُكُمْ أَخَاهُ الأَرْضَ خَيْرٌ لَهُ مِنْ أَنْ يَأْخُذَ لَهَا خَرَاجًا مَعْلُومًا " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Pawning, Hadith 2464

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2465

chapter.englishTitle: Renting Out Land In Return For Food

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Rafi` bin khadij said:
            We used to give land in return for food at the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and some of my paternal uncles came to them and said: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'Whoever has land, he should not rent it out for a set amount of food.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Rafi` bin khadij said:
hadiths.body: We used to give land in return for food at the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and some of my paternal uncles came to them and said: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'Whoever has land, he should not rent it out for a set amount of food.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا حُمَيْدُ بْنُ مَسْعَدَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ الْحَارِثِ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي عَرُوبَةَ، عَنْ يَعْلَى بْنِ حَكِيمٍ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ يَسَارٍ، عَنْ رَافِعِ بْنِ خَدِيجٍ، قَالَ كُنَّا نُحَاقِلُ عَلَى عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَزَعَمَ أَنَّ بَعْضَ عُمُومَتِهِ أَتَاهُمْ فَقَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " مَنْ كَانَتْ لَهُ أَرْضٌ فَلاَ يُكْرِيهَا بِطَعَامٍ مُسَمًّى " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Pawning, Hadith 2465

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2466

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَنْ زَرَعَ فِي أَرْضِ قَوْمٍ بِغَيْرِ إِذْنِهِمْ
chapter.englishTitle: Whoever Cultivates People`s Land Without Their Permission

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Rafi` bin Khadij said:
            “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'Whoever cultivates people`s land without their permission, he has no right to any produce, but he should be recompensed for his expenditure.' ”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Rafi` bin Khadij said:
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'Whoever cultivates people`s land without their permission, he has no right to any produce, but he should be recompensed for his expenditure.' ”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَامِرِ بْنِ زُرَارَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، عَنْ رَافِعِ بْنِ خَدِيجٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " مَنْ زَرَعَ فِي أَرْضِ قَوْمٍ بِغَيْرِ إِذْنِهِمْ فَلَيْسَ لَهُ مِنَ الزَّرْعِ شَىْءٌ وَتُرَدُّ عَلَيْهِ نَفَقَتُهُ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Pawning, Hadith 2466

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2467

chapter.englishTitle: Dealing with People Who Have Date-Palm Trees And Grape Vines

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Ibn `Umar that :
            the Messenger of Allah ﷺ entered into a contract with the people of Khaibar for one half of the fruits or crops yielded.
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Ibn `Umar that :
hadiths.body: the Messenger of Allah ﷺ entered into a contract with the people of Khaibar for one half of the fruits or crops yielded.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الصَّبَّاحِ، وَسَهْلُ بْنُ أَبِي سَهْلٍ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الْقَطَّانُ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَامَلَ أَهْلَ خَيْبَرَ بِالشَّطْرِ مِمَّا يَخْرُجُ مِنْ ثَمَرٍ أَوْ زَرْعٍ .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Pawning, Hadith 2467

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2468

chapter.englishTitle: Dealing with People Who Have Date-Palm Trees And Grape Vines

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Anas bin Malik said:
            “When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ gave Khaibar to its people in return of its palm trees and land.
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Anas bin Malik said:
hadiths.body: “When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ gave Khaibar to its people in return of its palm trees and land.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ تَوْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى، عَنِ الْحَكَمِ بْنِ عُتَيْبَةَ، عَنْ مِقْسَمٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَعْطَى خَيْبَرَ أَهْلَهَا عَلَى النِّصْفِ نَخْلُهَا وَأَرْضُهَا .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Pawning, Hadith 2468

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2469

chapter.englishTitle: Dealing with People Who Have Date-Palm Trees And Grape Vines

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Anas bin Malik said:
            “When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ conquered Khaibar, he gave it (to its people) in return for half (of its yield).”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Anas bin Malik said:
hadiths.body: “When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ conquered Khaibar, he gave it (to its people) in return for half (of its yield).”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ الْمُنْذِرِ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ فُضَيْلٍ، عَنْ مُسْلِمٍ الأَعْوَرِ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ لَمَّا افْتَتَحَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ خَيْبَرَ أَعْطَاهَا عَلَى النِّصْفِ .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Pawning, Hadith 2469

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2470

chapter.englishTitle: Pollinating Palm Trees

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Simak that the heard Musa bin Talhah bin `Ubaidullah narrating that his father said:
            “I passed by some palm trees with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and he saw some people pollinating the trees. He said: 'What are these people doing?' They said: 'They are taking something from the male part (of the plant) and putting it in the female part.' He said: 'I do not think that this will do any good.' News of that reached them, so they stopped doing it, and their yield declined. News of that reached the Prophet ﷺ and he said: 'That was only my thought. If it will do any good, then do it. I am only a human being like you, and what I think may be right or wrong. But When I tell you: “Allah (Subhanahu-wa-Taala) says,” I will never tell lies about Allah (Subhanahu-wa-Taala).' ”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Simak that the heard Musa bin Talhah bin `Ubaidullah narrating that his father said:
hadiths.body: “I passed by some palm trees with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and he saw some people pollinating the trees. He said: 'What are these people doing?' They said: 'They are taking something from the male part (of the plant) and putting it in the female part.' He said: 'I do not think that this will do any good.' News of that reached them, so they stopped doing it, and their yield declined. News of that reached the Prophet ﷺ and he said: 'That was only my thought. If it will do any good, then do it. I am only a human being like you, and what I think may be right or wrong. But When I tell you: “Allah (Subhanahu-wa-Taala) says,” I will never tell lies about Allah (Subhanahu-wa-Taala).' ”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى، عَنْ إِسْرَائِيلَ، عَنْ سِمَاكٍ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ مُوسَى بْنَ طَلْحَةَ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ مَرَرْتُ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فِي نَخْلٍ فَرَأَى قَوْمًا يُلَقِّحُونَ النَّخْلَ فَقَالَ " مَا يَصْنَعُ هَؤُلاَءِ " . قَالُوا يَأْخُذُونَ مِنَ الذَّكَرِ فَيَجْعَلُونَهُ فِي الأُنْثَى . قَالَ " مَا أَظُنُّ ذَاكَ يُغْنِي شَيْئًا " . فَبَلَغَهُمْ فَتَرَكُوهُ وَنَزَلُوا عَنْهَا فَبَلَغَ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ فَقَالَ " إِنَّمَا هُوَ ظَنٌّ إِنْ كَانَ يُغْنِي شَيْئًا فَاصْنَعُوهُ فَإِنَّمَا أَنَا بَشَرٌ مِثْلُكُمْ وَإِنَّ الظَّنَّ يُخْطِئُ وَيُصِيبُ وَلَكِنْ مَا قُلْتُ لَكُمْ قَالَ اللَّهُ فَلَنْ أَكْذِبَ عَلَى اللَّهِ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Pawning, Hadith 2470

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2471

chapter.englishTitle: Pollinating Palm Trees

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from 'Aisha that the Prophet ﷺ heard some sounds and said:
            “What is this noise?” They said: “Palm trees that are being pollinated.” He said: “If they did not do that it would be better.” So they did not pollinate them that year, and the dates did not mature properly. they mentioned that to the Prophet ﷺ and he said: “If it is one of the matters of your religion, then refer to me.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from 'Aisha that the Prophet ﷺ heard some sounds and said:
hadiths.body: “What is this noise?” They said: “Palm trees that are being pollinated.” He said: “If they did not do that it would be better.” So they did not pollinate them that year, and the dates did not mature properly. they mentioned that to the Prophet ﷺ and he said: “If it is one of the matters of your religion, then refer to me.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا عَفَّانُ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، حَدَّثَنَا ثَابِتٌ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، وَهِشَامُ بْنُ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ سَمِعَ أَصْوَاتًا . فَقَالَ " مَا هَذَا الصَّوْتُ " . قَالُوا النَّخْلُ يُؤَبِّرُونَهُ فَقَالَ " لَوْ لَمْ يَفْعَلُوا لَصَلَحَ " . فَلَمْ يُؤَبِّرُوا عَامَئِذٍ فَصَارَ شِيصًا فَذَكَرُوا لِلنَّبِيِّ ﷺ فَقَالَ " إِنْ كَانَ شَيْئًا مِنْ أَمْرِ دُنْيَاكُمْ فَشَأْنَكُمْ بِهِ وَإِنْ كَانَ شَيْئًا مِنْ أُمُورِ دِينِكُمْ فَإِلَىَّ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Pawning, Hadith 2471

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2472

chapter.englishTitle: The Muslims Are Partners In Three Things

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Ibn 'Abbas that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            “The Muslims are partners in three things: water, pasture and fire, and their price is unlawful.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Ibn 'Abbas that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “The Muslims are partners in three things: water, pasture and fire, and their price is unlawful.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ خِرَاشِ بْنِ حَوْشَبٍ الشَّيْبَانِيُّ، عَنِ الْعَوَّامِ بْنِ حَوْشَبٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " الْمُسْلِمُونَ شُرَكَاءُ فِي ثَلاَثٍ فِي الْمَاءِ وَالْكَلإِ وَالنَّارِ وَثَمَنُهُ حَرَامٌ " . قَالَ أَبُو سَعِيدٍ يَعْنِي الْمَاءَ الْجَارِيَ .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Pawning, Hadith 2472

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2473

chapter.englishTitle: The Muslims Are Partners In Three Things

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            “Three things cannot be denied to anyone: water, pasture and fire.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “Three things cannot be denied to anyone: water, pasture and fire.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ  " ثَلاَثٌ لاَ يُمْنَعْنَ الْمَاءُ وَالْكَلأُ وَالنَّارُ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Pawning, Hadith 2473

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2474

chapter.englishTitle: The Muslims Are Partners In Three Things

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that 'Aishah said:
            “O Messenger of Allah ﷺ, what are the things which are not permissible to withhold?” He said: “Water, salt and fire.” She said: “I said: 'O Messenger of Allah ﷺ, we know what water is, but what about salt and fire?” He said: “O Humaira', whoever gives fire (to another), it is as if he has given in charity all the food that is cooked on that fire. And whoever gives salt, it is as if he has given in charity all that the salt makes good. And whoever gives a Muslim water to drink when water is available, it is as if he freed a slave; and whoever gives a Muslim water to drink when there is no water available, it is as if he brought him back to life.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that 'Aishah said:
hadiths.body: “O Messenger of Allah ﷺ, what are the things which are not permissible to withhold?” He said: “Water, salt and fire.” She said: “I said: 'O Messenger of Allah ﷺ, we know what water is, but what about salt and fire?” He said: “O Humaira', whoever gives fire (to another), it is as if he has given in charity all the food that is cooked on that fire. And whoever gives salt, it is as if he has given in charity all that the salt makes good. And whoever gives a Muslim water to drink when water is available, it is as if he freed a slave; and whoever gives a Muslim water to drink when there is no water available, it is as if he brought him back to life.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَمَّارُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ الْوَاسِطِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ غُرَابٍ، عَنْ زُهَيْرِ بْنِ مَرْزُوقٍ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ زَيْدِ بْنِ جُدْعَانَ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ مَا الشَّىْءُ الَّذِي لاَ يَحِلُّ مَنْعُهُ قَالَ الْمَاءُ وَالْمِلْحُ وَالنَّارُ " . قَالَتْ قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ هَذَا الْمَاءُ قَدْ عَرَفْنَاهُ فَمَا بَالُ الْمِلْحِ وَالنَّارِ قَالَ " يَا حُمَيْرَاءُ مَنْ أَعْطَى نَارًا فَكَأَنَّمَا تَصَدَّقَ بِجَمِيعِ مَا أَنْضَجَتْ تِلْكَ النَّارُ وَمَنْ أَعْطَى مِلْحًا . فَكَأَنَّمَا تَصَدَّقَ بِجَمِيعِ مَا طَيَّبَ ذَلِكَ الْمِلْحُ وَمَنْ سَقَى مُسْلِمًا شَرْبَةً مِنْ مَاءٍ حَيْثُ يُوجَدُ الْمَاءُ فَكَأَنَّمَا أَعْتَقَ رَقَبَةً وَمَنْ سَقَى مُسْلِمًا شَرْبَةً مِنْ مَاءٍ حَيْثُ لاَ يُوجَدُ الْمَاءُ فَكَأَنَّمَا أَحْيَاهَا " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Pawning, Hadith 2474

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2475

chapter.englishTitle: Giving Rivers And Springs To People

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abyad bin Hammal:
            That he asked for a salt flat called the Ma'rib Dam to be given to him, and it was given to him. Then Aqra bin Habis At-Tamimi came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and said: “O Messenger of Allah ﷺ, I used to come to the salt flat during the Ignorance period and it was in a land in which there was no water, and whoever came to it took from it. It was (plentiful) like flowing water.” So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ asked Abyad bin Hammal to give back his share of the salt flat. He said: “I give it to you on the basis that you make it charity given by me.” The Messenger of Allah said: “It is a charity from you, and it is like flowing water, whoever comes to it may take from it.”(One of the narrators) Faraj said: “That is how it is today, whoever comes to it takes from it.” He said: “The Prophet ﷺ gave him land and palm trees in Jurf Murad instead, when he took back the salt flat from him.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abyad bin Hammal:
hadiths.body: That he asked for a salt flat called the Ma'rib Dam to be given to him, and it was given to him. Then Aqra bin Habis At-Tamimi came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and said: “O Messenger of Allah ﷺ, I used to come to the salt flat during the Ignorance period and it was in a land in which there was no water, and whoever came to it took from it. It was (plentiful) like flowing water.” So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ asked Abyad bin Hammal to give back his share of the salt flat. He said: “I give it to you on the basis that you make it charity given by me.” The Messenger of Allah said: “It is a charity from you, and it is like flowing water, whoever comes to it may take from it.”(One of the narrators) Faraj said: “That is how it is today, whoever comes to it takes from it.” He said: “The Prophet ﷺ gave him land and palm trees in Jurf Murad instead, when he took back the salt flat from him.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ الْعَدَنِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا فَرَجُ بْنُ سَعِيدِ بْنِ عَلْقَمَةَ بْنِ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبْيَضَ بْنِ حَمَّالٍ، حَدَّثَنِي عَمِّي، ثَابِتُ بْنُ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبْيَضَ بْنِ حَمَّالٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، سَعِيدٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَبْيَضَ بْنِ حَمَّالٍ . أَنَّهُ اسْتَقْطَعَ الْمِلْحَ الَّذِي يُقَالُ لَهُ مِلْحُ سَدِّ مَأْرِبٍ . فَأَقْطَعَهُ لَهُ ثُمَّ إِنَّ الأَقْرَعَ بْنَ حَابِسٍ التَّمِيمِيَّ أَتَى رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي قَدْ وَرَدْتُ الْمِلْحَ فِي الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ وَهُوَ بِأَرْضٍ لَيْسَ بِهَا مَاءٌ وَمَنْ وَرَدَهُ أَخَذَهُ وَهُوَ مِثْلُ الْمَاءِ الْعِدِّ . فَاسْتَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَبْيَضَ بْنَ حَمَّالٍ فِي قَطِيعَتِهِ فِي الْمِلْحِ . فَقَالَ قَدْ أَقَلْتُكَ مِنْهُ عَلَى أَنْ تَجْعَلَهُ مِنِّي صَدَقَةً . فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " هُوَ مِنْكَ صَدَقَةٌ وَهُوَ مِثْلُ الْمَاءِ الْعِدِّ مَنْ وَرَدَهُ أَخَذَهُ " . قَالَ فَرَجٌ وَهُوَ الْيَوْمَ عَلَى ذَلِكَ مَنْ وَرَدَهُ أَخَذَهُ . قَالَ فَقَطَعَ لَهُ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ أَرْضًا وَنَخْلاً بِالْجُرْفِ جُرْفِ مُرَادٍ مَكَانَهُ حِينَ أَقَالَهُ مِنْهُ .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Pawning, Hadith 2475

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2476

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا يَقَعُ بِهِ الطَّلاَقُ مِنَ الْكَلاَمِ
chapter.englishTitle: (Words) by which divorce takes place

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Aishah said:
            'Three Sunan were established because of Barirah: She was given the choice (of whether to remain married) when she was freed, and her husband was a slave; they used to give her charity and she used to give it as a gift to the Prophet ﷺ, and he would say: 'It is charity for her and a gift for us,' and he said, the 'Wala' is for the one who set the slave free.'"
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Aishah said:
hadiths.body: 'Three Sunan were established because of Barirah: She was given the choice (of whether to remain married) when she was freed, and her husband was a slave; they used to give her charity and she used to give it as a gift to the Prophet ﷺ, and he would say: 'It is charity for her and a gift for us,' and he said, the 'Wala' is for the one who set the slave free.'"
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ أُسَامَةَ بْنِ زَيْدٍ، عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ مَضَى فِي بَرِيرَةَ ثَلاَثُ سُنَنٍ خُيِّرَتْ حِينَ أُعْتِقَتْ وَكَانَ زَوْجُهَا مَمْلُوكًا وَكَانُوا يَتَصَدَّقُونَ عَلَيْهَا فَتُهْدِي إِلَى النَّبِيِّ ﷺ فَيَقُولُ " هُوَ عَلَيْهَا صَدَقَةٌ وَهُوَ لَنَا هَدِيَّةٌ " . وَقَالَ " الْوَلاَءُ لِمَنْ أَعْتَقَ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Divorce, Hadith 2476

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2477

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا يَقَعُ بِهِ الطَّلاَقُ مِنَ الْكَلاَمِ
chapter.englishTitle: (Words) by which divorce takes place

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that 'Aishah said:
            "Barirah was told to observe the waiting period for three menstrual cycles."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that 'Aishah said:
hadiths.body: "Barirah was told to observe the waiting period for three menstrual cycles."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنِ الأَسْوَدِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ أُمِرَتْ بَرِيرَةُ أَنْ تَعْتَدَّ، بِثَلاَثِ حِيَضٍ .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Divorce, Hadith 2477

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2478

chapter.arabicTitle: باب النَّهْىِ عَنْ مَنْعِ، فَضْلِ الْمَاءِ لِيَمْنَعَ بِهِ الْكَلأَ
chapter.englishTitle: The Prohibition Of Withholding Surplus Water From Common Pastureland

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Prophet ﷺ said:
            “No one of you should withhold surplus water from common pastureland.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Prophet ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “No one of you should withhold surplus water from common pastureland.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ  " لاَ يَمْنَعْ أَحَدُكُمْ فَضْلَ مَاءٍ لِيَمْنَعَ بِهِ الْكَلأَ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Pawning, Hadith 2478

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2479

chapter.arabicTitle: باب النَّهْىِ عَنْ مَنْعِ، فَضْلِ الْمَاءِ لِيَمْنَعَ بِهِ الْكَلأَ
chapter.englishTitle: The Prohibition Of Withholding Surplus Water From Common Pastureland

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Aishah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            “Surplus water should not be withheld, and neither should surplus water from a well.
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Aishah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “Surplus water should not be withheld, and neither should surplus water from a well.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَةُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ حَارِثَةَ، عَنْ عَمْرَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " لاَ يُمْنَعُ فَضْلُ الْمَاءِ وَلاَ يُمْنَعُ نَقْعُ الْبِئْرِ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Pawning, Hadith 2479

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2480

chapter.arabicTitle: باب الشُّرْبِ مِنَ الأَوْدِيَةِ وَمِقْدَارِ حَبْسِ الْمَاءِ
chapter.englishTitle: Irrigation From Rivers And How Much Water May Be Retained

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from 'Abdullah bin Zubair that :
            a man from among the Ansar had a dispute with Zubair in the presence of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ concerning the streams of the Harrah with which he irrigated his palm trees. The Ansari said: “Let the water flow,” but he refused. So they referred their dispute to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Irrigate (your trees) O Zubair, then let the water flow to your neighbor.” The Ansari became angry and said: “O Messenger of Allah ﷺ, is it because he is your cousin (son of your paternal aunt)?” The expression of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ changed, then he said: “O Zubair, irrigate (your trees) then retain the water until it reaches the walls.” Zubair said: “I think this Verse was revealed concerning that: “But no, by your Lord, they make you (O Muhammad) judge in all disputes between them, and find in themselves no resistance against your decisions, and accept (them) with full submission [1].'”  [1] An-Nisa 4.65
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from 'Abdullah bin Zubair that :
hadiths.body: a man from among the Ansar had a dispute with Zubair in the presence of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ concerning the streams of the Harrah with which he irrigated his palm trees. The Ansari said: “Let the water flow,” but he refused. So they referred their dispute to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Irrigate (your trees) O Zubair, then let the water flow to your neighbor.” The Ansari became angry and said: “O Messenger of Allah ﷺ, is it because he is your cousin (son of your paternal aunt)?” The expression of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ changed, then he said: “O Zubair, irrigate (your trees) then retain the water until it reaches the walls.” Zubair said: “I think this Verse was revealed concerning that: “But no, by your Lord, they make you (O Muhammad) judge in all disputes between them, and find in themselves no resistance against your decisions, and accept (them) with full submission [1].'”  [1] An-Nisa 4.65
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رُمْحٍ، أَنْبَأَنَا اللَّيْثُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ، أَنَّ رَجُلاً، مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ خَاصَمَ الزُّبَيْرَ عِنْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فِي شِرَاجِ الْحَرَّةِ الَّتِي يَسْقُونَ بِهَا النَّخْلَ فَقَالَ الأَنْصَارِيُّ سَرِّحِ الْمَاءَ يَمُرَّ . فَأَبَى عَلَيْهِ فَاخْتَصَمَا عِنْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ " اسْقِ يَا زُبَيْرُ ثُمَّ أَرْسِلِ الْمَاءَ إِلَى جَارِكَ " . فَغَضِبَ الأَنْصَارِيُّ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَنْ كَانَ ابْنَ عَمَّتِكَ فَتَلَوَّنَ وَجْهُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ ثُمَّ قَالَ " يَا زُبَيْرُ اسْقِ ثُمَّ احْبِسِ الْمَاءَ حَتَّى يَرْجِعَ إِلَى الْجَدْرِ " . قَالَ فَقَالَ الزُّبَيْرُ وَاللَّهِ إِنِّي لأَحْسَبُ هَذِهِ الآيَةَ أُنْزِلَتْ فِي ذَلِكَ {فَلاَ وَرَبِّكَ لاَ يُؤْمِنُونَ حَتَّى يُحَكِّمُوكَ فِيمَا شَجَرَ بَيْنَهُمْ ثُمَّ لاَ يَجِدُوا فِي أَنْفُسِهِمْ حَرَجًا مِمَّا قَضَيْتَ وَيُسَلِّمُوا تَسْلِيمًا}.
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Pawning, Hadith 2480

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2481

chapter.arabicTitle: باب الشُّرْبِ مِنَ الأَوْدِيَةِ وَمِقْدَارِ حَبْسِ الْمَاءِ
chapter.englishTitle: Irrigation From Rivers And How Much Water May Be Retained

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Tha'labah bin Abu Malik said:
            “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ ruled concerning the stream of Mahzur that the higher ground took precedence over the lower, so the higher ground should be irrigated until the water reached the ankles, then it should be released to those who were lower.
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Tha'labah bin Abu Malik said:
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ ruled concerning the stream of Mahzur that the higher ground took precedence over the lower, so the higher ground should be irrigated until the water reached the ankles, then it should be released to those who were lower.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ الْمُنْذِرِ الْحِزَامِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا زَكَرِيَّا بْنُ مَنْظُورِ بْنِ ثَعْلَبَةَ بْنِ أَبِي مَالِكٍ، حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُقْبَةَ بْنِ أَبِي مَالِكٍ، عَنْ عَمِّهِ، ثَعْلَبَةَ بْنِ أَبِي مَالِكٍ قَالَ قَضَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ فِي سَيْلِ مَهْزُورٍ الأَعْلَى فَوْقَ الأَسْفَلِ يَسْقِي الأَعْلَى إِلَى الْكَعْبَيْنِ ثُمَّ يُرْسِلُ إِلَى مَنْ هُوَ أَسْفَلُ مِنْهُ .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Pawning, Hadith 2481

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2482

chapter.arabicTitle: باب الشُّرْبِ مِنَ الأَوْدِيَةِ وَمِقْدَارِ حَبْسِ الْمَاءِ
chapter.englishTitle: Irrigation From Rivers And How Much Water May Be Retained

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from 'Amr bin Shu`aib, from his father, from his grandfather, that :
            the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ruled concerning the stream of Mahzur that the water should be retained until it reached the ankles, then released.
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from 'Amr bin Shu`aib, from his father, from his grandfather, that :
hadiths.body: the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ruled concerning the stream of Mahzur that the water should be retained until it reached the ankles, then released.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدَةَ، أَنْبَأَنَا الْمُغِيرَةُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ شُعَيْبٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَضَى فِي سَيْلِ مَهْزُورٍ أَنْ يُمْسِكَ حَتَّى يَبْلُغَ الْكَعْبَيْنِ ثُمَّ يُرْسِلَ الْمَاءَ .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Pawning, Hadith 2482

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2483

chapter.arabicTitle: باب الشُّرْبِ مِنَ الأَوْدِيَةِ وَمِقْدَارِ حَبْسِ الْمَاءِ
chapter.englishTitle: Irrigation From Rivers And How Much Water May Be Retained

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from 'Ubadah bin Samit that :
            the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ruled concerning the irrigation of palm trees from streams, that the higher ground should be irrigated before the lower, and that the water should be allowed to reach the ankles, then released to flow the nearest lower ground, and so on, until all the fields were watered or until the water ran out.
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from 'Ubadah bin Samit that :
hadiths.body: the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ruled concerning the irrigation of palm trees from streams, that the higher ground should be irrigated before the lower, and that the water should be allowed to reach the ankles, then released to flow the nearest lower ground, and so on, until all the fields were watered or until the water ran out.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْمُغَلِّسِ، حَدَّثَنَا فُضَيْلُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ عُقْبَةَ، عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ يَحْيَى بْنِ الْوَلِيدِ، عَنْ عُبَادَةَ بْنِ الصَّامِتِ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَضَى فِي شُرْبِ النَّخْلِ مِنَ السَّيْلِ أَنَّ الأَعْلَى فَالأَعْلَى يَشْرَبُ قَبْلَ الأَسْفَلِ وَيُتْرَكُ الْمَاءُ إِلَى الْكَعْبَيْنِ ثُمَّ يُرْسَلُ الْمَاءُ إِلَى الأَسْفَلِ الَّذِي يَلِيهِ وَكَذَلِكَ حَتَّى تَنْقَضِيَ الْحَوَائِطُ أَوْ يَفْنَى الْمَاءُ .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Pawning, Hadith 2483

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2484

chapter.englishTitle: Distribution Of Water

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Kathir bin 'Abdullah bin 'Amr bin 'Awf Al-Muzani, from his father, that his grandfather said:
            “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'Start with the horses on the day that you bring (the animals to drink).' ”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Kathir bin 'Abdullah bin 'Amr bin 'Awf Al-Muzani, from his father, that his grandfather said:
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'Start with the horses on the day that you bring (the animals to drink).' ”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ الْمُنْذِرِ الْحِزَامِيُّ، أَنْبَأَنَا أَبُو الْجَعْدِ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ كَثِيرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ عَوْفٍ الْمُزَنِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " يُبْدَأُ بِالْخَيْلِ يَوْمَ وِرْدِهَا " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Pawning, Hadith 2484

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2485

chapter.englishTitle: Distribution Of Water

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Ibn `Abbas that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            “Every division that was allocated according to (the rules of) the Ignorance days, stands as it is, and every division that was allocated according to (the rules of) Islam, stands according to the rules of Islam.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Ibn `Abbas that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “Every division that was allocated according to (the rules of) the Ignorance days, stands as it is, and every division that was allocated according to (the rules of) Islam, stands according to the rules of Islam.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا الْعَبَّاسُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ دَاوُدَ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ الطَّائِفِيُّ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الشَّعْثَاءِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " كُلُّ قَسْمٍ قُسِمَ فِي الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ فَهُوَ عَلَى مَا قُسِمَ وَكُلُّ قَسْمٍ أَدْرَكَهُ الإِسْلاَمُ فَهُوَ عَلَى قَسْمِ الإِسْلاَمِ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Pawning, Hadith 2485

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2486

chapter.englishTitle: The Land Around A Well (Which Belongs Only To The Well Owner)

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from 'Abdullah bin Mughaffal that the Prophet ﷺ said:
            “Whoever digs a well, is entitled to forty forearms' length surrounding it is as a resting place for his flocks.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from 'Abdullah bin Mughaffal that the Prophet ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “Whoever digs a well, is entitled to forty forearms' length surrounding it is as a resting place for his flocks.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ عَمْرِو بْنِ سُكَيْنٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْمُثَنَّى، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الصَّبَّاحِ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ بْنُ عَطَاءٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ الْمَكِّيُّ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مُغَفَّلٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ قَالَ  " مَنْ حَفَرَ بِئْرًا فَلَهُ أَرْبَعُونَ ذِرَاعًا عَطَنًا لِمَاشِيَتِهِ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Pawning, Hadith 2486

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2487

chapter.englishTitle: The Land Around A Well (Which Belongs Only To The Well Owner)

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            “The land around a well (that is considered to be part of it) is the length of the well rope (in all directions).”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “The land around a well (that is considered to be part of it) is the length of the well rope (in all directions).”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا سَهْلُ بْنُ أَبِي الصُّغْدِيِّ، حَدَّثَنَا مَنْصُورُ بْنُ صُقَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ثَابِتُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ أَبِي غَالِبٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " حَرِيمُ الْبِئْرِ مَدُّ رِشَائِهَا " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Pawning, Hadith 2487

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2488

chapter.englishTitle: The Precincts Of Trees

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from 'Ubadah bin Samit that :
            the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ruled concerning one, two or three date palms belonging to a man among other palm trees - when they differ concerning entitlement to the surrounding land. He ruled that the land around each of those trees, as far as their leaves reach, measured from the bottom of the tree, belongs to the owner of the tree.
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from 'Ubadah bin Samit that :
hadiths.body: the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ruled concerning one, two or three date palms belonging to a man among other palm trees - when they differ concerning entitlement to the surrounding land. He ruled that the land around each of those trees, as far as their leaves reach, measured from the bottom of the tree, belongs to the owner of the tree.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ رَبِّهِ بْنُ خَالِدٍ النُّمَيْرِيُّ أَبُو الْمُغَلِّسِ، حَدَّثَنَا الْفُضَيْلُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ عُقْبَةَ، أَخْبَرَنِي إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ يَحْيَى بْنِ الْوَلِيدِ، عَنْ عُبَادَةَ بْنِ الصَّامِتِ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَضَى فِي النَّخْلَةِ وَالنَّخْلَتَيْنِ وَالثَّلاَثَةِ لِلرَّجُلِ فِي النَّخْلِ فَيَخْتَلِفُونَ فِي حُقُوقِ ذَلِكَ فَقَضَى أَنَّ لِكُلِّ نَخْلَةٍ مِنْ أُولَئِكَ مِنَ الأَرْضِ مَبْلَغُ جَرِيدِهَا حَرِيمٌ لَهَا .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Pawning, Hadith 2488

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2489

chapter.englishTitle: The Precincts Of Trees

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Ibn 'Umar that the Messenger of Allah Said:
            “The land around a date-palm tree, as far as its branches reach, belongs to the owner of the tree.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Ibn 'Umar that the Messenger of Allah Said:
hadiths.body: “The land around a date-palm tree, as far as its branches reach, belongs to the owner of the tree.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا سَهْلُ بْنُ أَبِي الصُّغْدِيِّ، حَدَّثَنَا مَنْصُورُ بْنُ صُقَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ثَابِتُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ الْعَبْدِيُّ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " حَرِيمُ النَّخْلَةِ مَدُّ جَرِيدِهَا " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Pawning, Hadith 2489

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2490

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَنْ بَاعَ عَقَارًا وَلَمْ يَجْعَلْ ثَمَنَهُ فِي مِثْلِهِ
chapter.englishTitle: One Who Sells Property And Does Not Use The Money For Something Similar

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Sa'eed bin Huraith said:
            “I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'Whoever sells a house or property and does not use the money for something similar, deserves not to be blessed therein.' ”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Sa'eed bin Huraith said:
hadiths.body: “I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'Whoever sells a house or property and does not use the money for something similar, deserves not to be blessed therein.' ”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ مُهَاجِرٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ حُرَيْثٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ  " مَنْ بَاعَ دَارًا أَوْ عَقَارًا فَلَمْ يَجْعَلْ ثَمَنَهُ فِي مِثْلِهِ كَانَ قَمِنًا أَنْ لاَ يُبَارَكَ فِيهِ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Pawning, Hadith 2490

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2491

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَنْ بَاعَ عَقَارًا وَلَمْ يَجْعَلْ ثَمَنَهُ فِي مِثْلِهِ
chapter.englishTitle: One Who Sells Property And Does Not Use The Money For Something Similar

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Hudhaifah bin Yaman that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            “Whoever sells a house and does not use the money for something similar, will not to be blessed therein.' ”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Hudhaifah bin Yaman that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “Whoever sells a house and does not use the money for something similar, will not to be blessed therein.' ”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، وَعَمْرُو بْنُ رَافِعٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مَرْوَانُ بْنُ مُعَاوِيَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مَالِكٍ النَّخَعِيُّ، عَنْ يُوسُفَ بْنِ مَيْمُونٍ، عَنْ أَبِي عُبَيْدَةَ بْنِ حُذَيْفَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، حُذَيْفَةَ بْنِ الْيَمَانِ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " مَنْ بَاعَ دَارًا وَلَمْ يَجْعَلْ ثَمَنَهَا فِي مِثْلِهَا لَمْ يُبَارَكْ لَهُ فِيهَا " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Pawning, Hadith 2491

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2492

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَنْ بَاعَ رِبَاعًا فَلْيُؤْذِنْ شَرِيكَهُ
chapter.englishTitle: One Who Sells A Property Should Notify His Partner (Of His Intention)

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Jabir said:
            “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'Whoever has a date-palm tree or land, should not sell it until he has offered it to his partner.' ”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Jabir said:
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'Whoever has a date-palm tree or land, should not sell it until he has offered it to his partner.' ”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الصَّبَّاحِ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " مَنْ كَانَتْ لَهُ نَخْلٌ أَوْ أَرْضٌ فَلاَ يَبِيعُهَا حَتَّى يَعْرِضَهَا عَلَى شَرِيكِهِ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Pre-emption, Hadith 2492

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2493

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَنْ بَاعَ رِبَاعًا فَلْيُؤْذِنْ شَرِيكَهُ
chapter.englishTitle: One Who Sells A Property Should Notify His Partner (Of His Intention)

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Ibn Abbas that the Prophet ﷺ said:
            “Whoever has land and wants to sell it, let him offer it to his neighbor.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Ibn Abbas that the Prophet ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “Whoever has land and wants to sell it, let him offer it to his neighbor.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ سِنَانٍ، وَالْعَلاَءُ بْنُ سَالِمٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ، أَنْبَأَنَا شَرِيكٌ، عَنْ سِمَاكٍ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ  " مَنْ كَانَتْ لَهُ أَرْضٌ فَأَرَادَ بَيْعَهَا فَلْيَعْرِضْهَا عَلَى جَارِهِ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Pre-emption, Hadith 2493

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2494

chapter.englishTitle: Preemption By Virtue Of Being Neighbors

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Jabir that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            “The neighbor has more right to preemption of his neighbor, so let him wait for him even if he is absent, if they share a path.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Jabir that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “The neighbor has more right to preemption of his neighbor, so let him wait for him even if he is absent, if they share a path.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، أَنْبَأَنَا عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " الْجَارُ أَحَقُّ بِشُفْعَةِ جَارِهِ يَنْتَظِرُ بِهَا إِنْ كَانَ غَائِبًا إِذَا كَانَ طَرِيقُهُمَا وَاحِدًا " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Pre-emption, Hadith 2494

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2495

chapter.englishTitle: Preemption By Virtue Of Being Neighbors

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Rafi' that the Prophet ﷺ said:
            “The neighbor has more right to property that is near.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Rafi' that the Prophet ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “The neighbor has more right to property that is near.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَعَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ مَيْسَرَةَ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ الشَّرِيدِ، عَنْ أَبِي رَافِعٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ قَالَ  " الْجَارُ أَحَقُّ بِسَقَبِهِ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Pre-emption, Hadith 2495

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2496

chapter.englishTitle: Preemption By Virtue Of Being Neighbors

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Sharid bin Suwaid said:
           “I said: 'O Messenger of Allah, (what do you think of) land owned by only one person but this land has neighbors?' He said: 'The neighbor has more right to property that is near.' ”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Sharid bin Suwaid said:
hadiths.body: “I said: 'O Messenger of Allah, (what do you think of) land owned by only one person but this land has neighbors?' He said: 'The neighbor has more right to property that is near.' ”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ حُسَيْنٍ الْمُعَلِّمِ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ شُعَيْبٍ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ الشَّرِيدِ بْنِ سُوَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ الشَّرِيدِ بْنِ سُوَيْدٍ، قَالَ قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَرْضٌ لَيْسَ فِيهَا لأَحَدٍ قِسْمٌ وَلاَ شِرْكٌ إِلاَّ الْجِوَارُ . قَالَ  " الْجَارُ أَحَقُّ بِسَقَبِهِ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Pre-emption, Hadith 2496

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2497

chapter.arabicTitle: باب إِذَا وَقَعَتِ الْحُدُودُ فَلاَ شُفْعَةَ
chapter.englishTitle: If The Boundaries Have Been Fixed Then There Is No Preemption

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that:
            the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ruled concerning preemption of land that has not been divided; if the boundaries have been set then there is no preemption.
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that:
hadiths.body: the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ruled concerning preemption of land that has not been divided; if the boundaries have been set then there is no preemption.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَعَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ عُمَرَ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، وَأَبِي، سَلَمَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضي الله عنه ـ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَضَى بِالشُّفْعَةِ فِيمَا لَمْ يُقْسَمْ فَإِذَا وَقَعَتِ الْحُدُودُ فَلاَ شُفْعَةَ .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Pre-emption, Hadith 2497

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2498

chapter.arabicTitle: باب إِذَا وَقَعَتِ الْحُدُودُ فَلاَ شُفْعَةَ
chapter.englishTitle: If The Boundaries Have Been Fixed Then There Is No Preemption

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Rafi' that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            “The partner has more right to what is near him, so long as he is still a partner.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Rafi' that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “The partner has more right to what is near him, so long as he is still a partner.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الْجَرَّاحِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ مَيْسَرَةَ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ الشَّرِيدِ، عَنْ أَبِي رَافِعٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " الشَّرِيكُ أَحَقُّ بِسَقَبِهِ مَا كَانَ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Pre-emption, Hadith 2498

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2499

chapter.arabicTitle: باب إِذَا وَقَعَتِ الْحُدُودُ فَلاَ شُفْعَةَ
chapter.englishTitle: If The Boundaries Have Been Fixed Then There Is No Preemption

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Jabir bin Abdullah that:
            the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ruled that preemption takes effect in all cases where land has not been divided. But if the boundaries have been set and the roads laid out, then there is no preemption.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Jabir bin Abdullah that:
hadiths.body: the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ruled that preemption takes effect in all cases where land has not been divided. But if the boundaries have been set and the roads laid out, then there is no preemption.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ إِنَّمَا جَعَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ الشُّفْعَةَ فِي كُلِّ مَا لَمْ يُقْسَمْ فَإِذَا وَقَعَتِ الْحُدُودُ وَصُرِّفَتِ الطُّرُقُ فَلاَ شُفْعَةَ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Pre-emption, Hadith 2499

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2500

chapter.englishTitle: Requesting Preemption

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Ibn 'Umar that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            “Preemption is like undoing the `Iqal.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Ibn 'Umar that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “Preemption is like undoing the `Iqal.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْحَارِثِ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْبَيْلَمَانِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " الشُّفْعَةُ كَحَلِّ الْعِقَالِ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Pre-emption, Hadith 2500

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2501
