hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2558

chapter.englishTitle: Stoning A Jewish Man And Jewish Woman

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Bara' bin Azib said:
            “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ passed by a Jew with a blackened face who had been flogged. He called them and said: 'Is this the punishment for the adulterer that you find in your Book?' They said: 'Yes.' Then he called one of their scholars and said: 'I adjure you by Allah (Subhanahu-wa-Taala) Who sent down the Tawrah (Torah) to Musa! Is this the punishment for the adulterer that you find in your Book?' He said: 'No; if you had not adjured me by Allah (Subhanahu-wa-Taala), I would not have told you. The punishment for the adulterer that we find in our Book is stoning, but many of our nobles were being stoned (because of the prevalence of adultery among them), so if we caught one of our nobles (committing adultery), we would let him go; but if we caught one of the weak among us, we would carry out the punishment on him. We said: “Come, let us agree upon something that we may impose on both noble and weak alike.” So we agreed to blacken the face and whip them, instead of stoning.' The Prophet ﷺ 'O Allah (Subhanahu-wa-Taala), I am the first of those who revive your command which they had killed off,' and he issued orders that (the man) be stoned.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Bara' bin Azib said:
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ passed by a Jew with a blackened face who had been flogged. He called them and said: 'Is this the punishment for the adulterer that you find in your Book?' They said: 'Yes.' Then he called one of their scholars and said: 'I adjure you by Allah (Subhanahu-wa-Taala) Who sent down the Tawrah (Torah) to Musa! Is this the punishment for the adulterer that you find in your Book?' He said: 'No; if you had not adjured me by Allah (Subhanahu-wa-Taala), I would not have told you. The punishment for the adulterer that we find in our Book is stoning, but many of our nobles were being stoned (because of the prevalence of adultery among them), so if we caught one of our nobles (committing adultery), we would let him go; but if we caught one of the weak among us, we would carry out the punishment on him. We said: “Come, let us agree upon something that we may impose on both noble and weak alike.” So we agreed to blacken the face and whip them, instead of stoning.' The Prophet ﷺ 'O Allah (Subhanahu-wa-Taala), I am the first of those who revive your command which they had killed off,' and he issued orders that (the man) be stoned.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مُرَّةَ، عَنِ الْبَرَاءِ بْنِ عَازِبٍ، قَالَ مَرَّ النَّبِيُّ بِيَهُودِيٍّ مُحَمَّمٍ مَجْلُودٍ فَدَعَاهُمْ فَقَالَ " هَكَذَا تَجِدُونَ فِي كِتَابِكُمْ حَدَّ الزَّانِي " . قَالُوا نَعَمْ . فَدَعَا رَجُلاً مِنْ عُلَمَائِهِمْ فَقَالَ " أَنْشُدُكَ بِاللَّهِ الَّذِي أَنْزَلَ التَّوْرَاةَ عَلَى مُوسَى أَهَكَذَا تَجِدُونَ حَدَّ الزَّانِي قَالَ لاَ وَلَوْلاَ أَنَّكَ نَشَدْتَنِي لَمْ أُخْبِرْكَ نَجِدُ حَدَّ الزَّانِي فِي كِتَابِنَا الرَّجْمَ وَلَكِنَّهُ كَثُرَ فِي أَشْرَافِنَا فَكُنَّا إِذَا أَخَذْنَا الشَّرِيفَ تَرَكْنَاهُ وَكُنَّا إِذَا أَخَذْنَا الضَّعِيفَ أَقَمْنَا عَلَيْهِ الْحَدَّ . فَقُلْنَا تَعَالَوْا فَلْنَجْتَمِعْ عَلَى شَىْءٍ نُقِيمُهُ عَلَى الشَّرِيفِ وَالْوَضِيعِ فَاجْتَمَعْنَا عَلَى التَّحْمِيمِ وَالْجَلْدِ مَكَانَ الرَّجْمِ . فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَوَّلُ مَنْ أَحْيَا أَمْرَكَ إِذْ أَمَاتُوهُ " . وَأَمَرَ بِهِ فَرُجِمَ .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Legal Punishments, Hadith 2558

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2559

chapter.englishTitle: One Who Commits Immoral Actions Openly

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Ibn`Abbas that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            “If I were to stone anyone without proof, I would have stoned so-and-so, for there is obviously doubt concerning her speech, her appearance and those who enter upon her.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Ibn`Abbas that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “If I were to stone anyone without proof, I would have stoned so-and-so, for there is obviously doubt concerning her speech, her appearance and those who enter upon her.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا الْعَبَّاسُ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ الدِّمَشْقِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا زَيْدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى بْنِ عُبَيْدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الأَسْوَدِ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " لَوْ كُنْتُ رَاجِمًا أَحَدًا بِغَيْرِ بَيِّنَةٍ لَرَجَمْتُ فُلاَنَةَ فَقَدْ ظَهَرَ فِيهَا الرِّيبَةُ فِي مَنْطِقِهَا وَهَيْئَتِهَا وَمَنْ يَدْخُلُ عَلَيْهَا " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Legal Punishments, Hadith 2559

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2560

chapter.englishTitle: One Who Commits Immoral Actions Openly

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Qasim bin Muhammad said:
            “Ibn `Abbas mentioned two people who had engaged in the process of Li`an. Ibn Shaddad said to him: 'Is this the one of whom the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “If I were to stone anyone without proof I would have stoned so-and-so.” Ibn`Abbas said: 'No, that was a woman who, (although she was a Muslim), used to expose herself.'”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Qasim bin Muhammad said:
hadiths.body: “Ibn `Abbas mentioned two people who had engaged in the process of Li`an. Ibn Shaddad said to him: 'Is this the one of whom the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “If I were to stone anyone without proof I would have stoned so-and-so.” Ibn`Abbas said: 'No, that was a woman who, (although she was a Muslim), used to expose herself.'”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ خَلاَّدٍ الْبَاهِلِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ، قَالَ ذَكَرَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ الْمُتَلاَعِنَيْنِ . فَقَالَ لَهُ ابْنُ شَدَّادٍ هِيَ الَّتِي قَالَ لَهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " لَوْ كُنْتُ رَاجِمًا أَحَدًا بِغَيْرِ بَيِّنَةٍ لَرَجَمْتُهَا " . فَقَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ تِلْكَ امْرَأَةٌ أَعْلَنَتْ .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Legal Punishments, Hadith 2560

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2561

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَنْ عَمِلَ عَمَلَ قَوْمِ لُوطٍ
chapter.englishTitle: Those Who Do The Action Of The People Of Lut

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Ibn`Abbas that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            “Whoever you find doing the action of the people of Lut, kill the one who does it, and the one to whom it is done.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Ibn`Abbas that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “Whoever you find doing the action of the people of Lut, kill the one who does it, and the one to whom it is done.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الصَّبَّاحِ، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ خَلاَّدٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ أَبِي عَمْرٍو، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ  " مَنْ وَجَدْتُمُوهُ يَعْمَلُ عَمَلَ قَوْمِ لُوطٍ فَاقْتُلُوا الْفَاعِلَ وَالْمَفْعُولَ بِهِ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Legal Punishments, Hadith 2561

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2562

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَنْ عَمِلَ عَمَلَ قَوْمِ لُوطٍ
chapter.englishTitle: Those Who Do The Action Of The People Of Lut

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Prophet ﷺ said concerning those who do the action of the people of Lut:
            “Stone the upper and the lower, stone them both.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Prophet ﷺ said concerning those who do the action of the people of Lut:
hadiths.body: “Stone the upper and the lower, stone them both.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الأَعْلَى، أَخْبَرَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ نَافِعٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَاصِمُ بْنُ عُمَرَ، عَنْ سُهَيْلٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ فِي الَّذِي يَعْمَلُ عَمَلَ قَوْمِ لُوطٍ قَالَ  " ارْجُمُوا الأَعْلَى وَالأَسْفَلَ ارْجُمُوهُمَا جَمِيعًا " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Legal Punishments, Hadith 2562

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2563

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَنْ عَمِلَ عَمَلَ قَوْمِ لُوطٍ
chapter.englishTitle: Those Who Do The Action Of The People Of Lut

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Jabir bin`Abdullah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            “The thing that I most fear for my nation is the action of the people of Lut.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Jabir bin`Abdullah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “The thing that I most fear for my nation is the action of the people of Lut.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَزْهَرُ بْنُ مَرْوَانَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَارِثِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْقَاسِمُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْوَاحِدِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَقِيلٍ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " إِنَّ أَخْوَفَ مَا أَخَافُ عَلَى أُمَّتِي عَمَلُ قَوْمِ لُوطٍ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Legal Punishments, Hadith 2563

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2564

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَنْ أَتَى ذَاتَ مَحْرَمٍ وَمَنْ أَتَى بَهِيمَةً
chapter.englishTitle: One Who Has Intercourse With A Mahram Relative And One Who Has Intercourse With An Animal

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Ibn`Abbas that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            “Whoever has intercourse with a Mahram relative, kill him; and whoever has intercourse with an animal, kill him, and kill the animal.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Ibn`Abbas that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “Whoever has intercourse with a Mahram relative, kill him; and whoever has intercourse with an animal, kill him, and kill the animal.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الدِّمَشْقِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي فُدَيْكٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، عَنْ دَاوُدَ بْنِ الْحُصَيْنِ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " مَنْ وَقَعَ عَلَى ذَاتِ مَحْرَمٍ فَاقْتُلُوهُ وَمَنْ وَقَعَ عَلَى بَهِيمَةٍ فَاقْتُلُوهُ وَاقْتُلُوا الْبَهِيمَةَ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Legal Punishments, Hadith 2564

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2565

chapter.englishTitle: Carrying Out Legal Punishment On Slave Women

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Abu Hurairah, Zaid bin Khalid and Shibl said:
            “We were with the Prophet ﷺ and a man asked him about a slave woman who commits fornication (again), whip her, even if that is for a rope of hair.' ”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Abu Hurairah, Zaid bin Khalid and Shibl said:
hadiths.body: “We were with the Prophet ﷺ and a man asked him about a slave woman who commits fornication (again), whip her, even if that is for a rope of hair.' ”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الصَّبَّاحِ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، وَزَيْدِ بْنِ خَالِدٍ، وَشِبْلٍ، قَالُوا كُنَّا عِنْدَ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ فَسَأَلَهُ رَجُلٌ عَنِ الأَمَةِ تَزْنِي قَبْلَ أَنْ تُحْصَنَ . فَقَالَ " اجْلِدْهَا فَإِنْ زَنَتْ فَاجْلِدْهَا فَإِنْ زَنَتْ فَاجْلِدْهَا " . ثُمَّ قَالَ فِي الثَّالِثَةِ أَوْ فِي الرَّابِعَةِ " فَبِعْهَا وَلَوْ بِحَبْلٍ مِنْ شَعَرٍ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Legal Punishments, Hadith 2565

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2566

chapter.englishTitle: Carrying Out Legal Punishment On Slave Women

hadiths.englishRaw:
'Aishah narrated that the Messenger of Allahﷺ said:
            “If a slave woman commits fornication then whip her, and if she commits fornication then whip her, and if she commits fornication then whip her, then sell her even if that is for a rope.”
hadiths.narrator: 'Aishah narrated that the Messenger of Allahﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “If a slave woman commits fornication then whip her, and if she commits fornication then whip her, and if she commits fornication then whip her, then sell her even if that is for a rope.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رُمْحٍ، قَالَ أَنْبَأَنَا اللَّيْثُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ، عَنْ عَمَّارِ بْنِ أَبِي فَرْوَةَ، أَنَّ مُحَمَّدَ بْنَ مُسْلِمٍ، حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّ عُرْوَةَ حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّ عَمْرَةَ بِنْتَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ حَدَّثَتْهُ أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ حَدَّثَتْهَا أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ  " إِذَا زَنَتِ الأَمَةُ فَاجْلِدُوهَا فَإِنْ زَنَتْ فَاجْلِدُوهَا فَإِنْ زَنَتْ فَاجْلِدُوهَا فَإِنْ زَنَتْ فَاجْلِدُوهَا ثُمَّ بِيعُوهَا وَلَوْ بِضَفِيرٍ " . وَالضَّفِيرُ الْحَبْلُ .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Legal Punishments, Hadith 2566

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2567

chapter.englishTitle: The Legal Punishment For Slander

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that 'Aishah said:
            “When my innocence was revealed, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ stood on the pulpit and mentioned that, and he recited Quran. When he came down, he ordered that the legal punishment (of slandering) be carried out on two men and a woman.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that 'Aishah said:
hadiths.body: “When my innocence was revealed, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ stood on the pulpit and mentioned that, and he recited Quran. When he came down, he ordered that the legal punishment (of slandering) be carried out on two men and a woman.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عَدِيٍّ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ، عَنْ عَمْرَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ لَمَّا نَزَلَ عُذْرِي قَامَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَلَى الْمِنْبَرِ فَذَكَرَ ذَلِكَ وَتَلاَ الْقُرْآنَ فَلَمَّا نَزَلَ أَمَرَ بِرَجُلَيْنِ وَامْرَأَةٍ فَضُرِبُوا حَدَّهُمْ .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Legal Punishments, Hadith 2567

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2568

chapter.englishTitle: The Legal Punishment For Slander

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Ibn Abbas that the Prophet ﷺ said:
            “If one man says another: 'O effeminate one!' give him twenty lashes. And if one man says to another: 'O homosexual!' give him twenty twenty lashes.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Ibn Abbas that the Prophet ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “If one man says another: 'O effeminate one!' give him twenty lashes. And if one man says to another: 'O homosexual!' give him twenty twenty lashes.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي فُدَيْكٍ، حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ أَبِي حَبِيبَةَ، عَنْ دَاوُدَ بْنِ الْحُصَيْنِ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ  " إِذَا قَالَ الرَّجُلُ لِلرَّجُلِ يَا مُخَنَّثُ فَاجْلِدُوهُ عِشْرِينَ وَإِذَا قَالَ الرَّجُلُ لِلرَّجُلِ يَا لُوطِيُّ فَاجْلِدُوهُ عِشْرِينَ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Legal Punishments, Hadith 2568

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2569

chapter.englishTitle: The Legal Punishment For Drunkenness

hadiths.englishRaw:
Ali bin Abi Talib said:
            “I would not pay the blood money (Diyah) for those on whom I carried out the legal punishment, except for the wine-drinker. The Messenger of Allah did not institute anything in that case, rather it is something that we would do.”
hadiths.narrator: Ali bin Abi Talib said:
hadiths.body: “I would not pay the blood money (Diyah) for those on whom I carried out the legal punishment, except for the wine-drinker. The Messenger of Allah did not institute anything in that case, rather it is something that we would do.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ مُوسَى، حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ، عَنْ أَبِي حُصَيْنٍ، عَنْ عُمَيْرِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ الزُّهْرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا مُطَرِّفٌ، سَمِعْتُهُ عَنْ عُمَيْرِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، قَالَ قَالَ عَلِيُّ بْنُ أَبِي طَالِبٍ مَا كُنْتُ أَدِي مَنْ أَقَمْتُ عَلَيْهِ الْحَدَّ إِلاَّ شَارِبَ الْخَمْرِ فَإِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ لَمْ يَسُنَّ فِيهِ شَيْئًا إِنَّمَا هُوَ شَىْءٌ جَعَلْنَاهُ نَحْنُ .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Legal Punishments, Hadith 2569

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2570

chapter.englishTitle: The Legal Punishment For Drunkenness

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Anas bin Malik said:
            “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to beat (offenders) for drinking wine with sandals and date-palm stalks.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Anas bin Malik said:
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to beat (offenders) for drinking wine with sandals and date-palm stalks.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا نَصْرُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ الْجَهْضَمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ الدَّسْتَوَائِيِّ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَضْرِبُ فِي الْخَمْرِ بِالنِّعَالِ وَالْجَرِيدِ .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Legal Punishments, Hadith 2570

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2571

chapter.englishTitle: The Legal Punishment For Drunkenness

hadiths.englishRaw:
Hudain bin Mundhir said:
            “When Walid bin `Uqbah was brought to `Uthman, they had testified against him. He said to 'Ali: 'You are close to your uncle's son, so carry out the legal punishment on him.' So 'Ali whipped him. He said: 'The Messenger of Allah ﷺ gave forty lashes, and Abu Bakr gave forty lashes, and 'Umar gave eighty all are Sunnah.'”
hadiths.narrator: Hudain bin Mundhir said:
hadiths.body: “When Walid bin `Uqbah was brought to `Uthman, they had testified against him. He said to 'Ali: 'You are close to your uncle's son, so carry out the legal punishment on him.' So 'Ali whipped him. He said: 'The Messenger of Allah ﷺ gave forty lashes, and Abu Bakr gave forty lashes, and 'Umar gave eighty all are Sunnah.'”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي عَرُوبَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الدَّانَاجِ، سَمِعْتُ حُضَيْنَ بْنَ الْمُنْذِرِ الرَّقَاشِيَّ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ أَبِي الشَّوَارِبِ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ الْمُخْتَارِ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ فَيْرُوزَ الدَّانَاجُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي حُضَيْنُ بْنُ الْمُنْذِرِ، قَالَ لَمَّا جِيءَ بِالْوَلِيدِ بْنِ عُقْبَةَ إِلَى عُثْمَانَ قَدْ شَهِدُوا عَلَيْهِ قَالَ لِعَلِيٍّ دُونَكَ ابْنَ عَمِّكَ فَأَقِمْ عَلَيْهِ الْحَدَّ . فَجَلَدَهُ عَلِيٌّ وَقَالَ جَلَدَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَرْبَعِينَ وَجَلَدَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ أَرْبَعِينَ وَجَلَدَ عُمَرُ ثَمَانِينَ وَكُلٌّ سُنَّةٌ .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Legal Punishments, Hadith 2571

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2572

chapter.englishTitle: One Who Drinks Wine Repeatedly

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            “If he gets drunk, then whip him. If he does it again, then whip him. If he does it again, then whip him.' And he said concerning the fourth time: 'If he does it again, then strike his neck (i.e., execute him).' ”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “If he gets drunk, then whip him. If he does it again, then whip him. If he does it again, then whip him.' And he said concerning the fourth time: 'If he does it again, then strike his neck (i.e., execute him).' ”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا شَبَابَةُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ، عَنِ الْحَارِثِ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ " إِذَا سَكِرَ فَاجْلِدُوهُ فَإِنْ عَادَ فَاجْلِدُوهُ فَإِنْ عَادَ فَاجْلِدُوهُ " . ثُمَّ قَالَ فِي الرَّابِعَةِ " فَإِنْ عَادَ فَاضْرِبُوا عُنُقَهُ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Legal Punishments, Hadith 2572

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2573

chapter.englishTitle: One Who Drinks Wine Repeatedly

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Mu`awiyah bin Abu Sufyan that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            “If they drink (again), then whip them. If they drink (again), then whip them. If they drink (again), then whip them. If they drink (again), then kill them.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Mu`awiyah bin Abu Sufyan that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “If they drink (again), then whip them. If they drink (again), then whip them. If they drink (again), then whip them. If they drink (again), then kill them.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعَيْبُ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي عَرُوبَةَ، عَنْ عَاصِمِ بْنِ بَهْدَلَةَ، عَنْ ذَكْوَانَ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ  " إِذَا شَرِبُوا الْخَمْرَ فَاجْلِدُوهُمْ ثُمَّ إِذَا شَرِبُوا فَاجْلِدُوهُمْ ثُمَّ إِذَا شَرِبُوا فَاجْلِدُوهُمْ ثُمَّ إِذَا شَرِبُوا فَاقْتُلُوهُمْ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Legal Punishments, Hadith 2573

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2574

chapter.arabicTitle: باب الْكَبِيرِ وَالْمَرِيضِ يَجِبُ عَلَيْهِ الْحَدُّ
chapter.englishTitle: The Legal Punishment Must Be Carried Out On The Old And The Sick (When They Deserve It)

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Sa'eed bin Sa'd bin `Ubadah said:
            “There was a man living among our dwellings who had a physical defect, and to our astonishment he was seen with one of the slave women of the dwellings, committing illegal sex with her. Sa'd bin 'Ubadah referred his case to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, who said: 'Give him one hundred lashes.' They said: 'O Prophet ﷺ of Allah ﷺ, he is too weak to bear that. If we give him one hundred lashes he will die.' He said: “Then take a branch with a hundred twigs and hit him once.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Sa'eed bin Sa'd bin `Ubadah said:
hadiths.body: “There was a man living among our dwellings who had a physical defect, and to our astonishment he was seen with one of the slave women of the dwellings, committing illegal sex with her. Sa'd bin 'Ubadah referred his case to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, who said: 'Give him one hundred lashes.' They said: 'O Prophet ﷺ of Allah ﷺ, he is too weak to bear that. If we give him one hundred lashes he will die.' He said: “Then take a branch with a hundred twigs and hit him once.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الأَشَجِّ، عَنْ أَبِي أُمَامَةَ بْنِ سَهْلِ بْنِ حُنَيْفٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ سَعْدِ بْنِ عُبَادَةَ، قَالَ كَانَ بَيْنَ أَبْيَاتِنَا رَجُلٌ مُخْدَجٌ ضَعِيفٌ فَلَمْ يُرَعْ إِلاَّ وَهُوَ عَلَى أَمَةٍ مِنْ إِمَاءِ الدَّارِ يَخْبُثُ بِهَا فَرَفَعَ شَأْنَهُ سَعْدُ بْنُ عُبَادَةَ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَقَالَ " اجْلِدُوهُ ضَرْبَ مِائَةِ سَوْطٍ " . قَالُوا يَا نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ هُوَ أَضْعَفُ مِنْ ذَلِكَ لَوْ ضَرَبْنَاهُ مِائَةَ سَوْطٍ مَاتَ . قَالَ " فَخُذُوا لَهُ عِثْكَالاً فِيهِ مِائَةُ شِمْرَاخٍ فَاضْرِبُوهُ ضَرْبَةً وَاحِدَةً " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Legal Punishments, Hadith 2574

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2575

chapter.englishTitle: One Who Brandishes His Weapon

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            “Whoever bears weapons against us is not one of us.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “Whoever bears weapons against us is not one of us.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ كَاسِبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ سُهَيْلِ بْنِ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنَا الْمُغِيرَةُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَجْلاَنَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنَا أَنَسُ بْنُ عِيَاضٍ، عَنْ أَبِي مَعْشَرٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ كَعْبٍ، وَمُوسَى بْنِ يَسَارٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ قَالَ  " مَنْ حَمَلَ عَلَيْنَا السِّلاَحَ فَلَيْسَ مِنَّا " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Legal Punishments, Hadith 2575

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2576

chapter.englishTitle: One Who Brandishes His Weapon

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Ibn `Umar that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            “Whoever bears weapons against us is not one of us.'”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Ibn `Umar that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “Whoever bears weapons against us is not one of us.'”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَامِرِ بْنِ الْبَرَّادِ بْنِ يُوسُفَ بْنِ بُرَيْدِ بْنِ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ بْنِ أَبِي مُوسَى الأَشْعَرِيِّ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " مَنْ حَمَلَ عَلَيْنَا السِّلاَحَ فَلَيْسَ مِنَّا " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Legal Punishments, Hadith 2576

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2577

chapter.englishTitle: One Who Brandishes His Weapon

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Musa Al-Ash'ari that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            “Whoever brandishes weapons against us is not one of us.'”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Musa Al-Ash'ari that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “Whoever brandishes weapons against us is not one of us.'”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مَحْمُودُ بْنُ غَيْلاَنَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ وَيُوسُفُ بْنُ مُوسَى وَعَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الْبَرَّادِ قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ بُرَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى الأَشْعَرِيِّ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " مَنْ شَهَرَ عَلَيْنَا السِّلاَحَ فَلَيْسَ مِنَّا " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Legal Punishments, Hadith 2577

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2578

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَنْ حَارَبَ وَسَعَى فِي الأَرْضِ فَسَادًا
chapter.englishTitle: Those Who Engage In Banditry and Spread Mischief In The Land

hadiths.englishRaw:
Anas bin Malik narrated that :
            some people from (the tribe of) `Urainah came to us (to Al-Madinah) during the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, but they did not want to stay in Al-Madinah because the climate did not suit them. He said: “Go out to the camels which belong to us, and drink their milk and urine.” So they did that (and recovered), then they apostatized from Islam and killed the herdsman of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and stole his camels. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ sent people after them, and they were brought back. Then he cut off their hands and feet, branded their eyes and left them in Harrah until they died.
hadiths.narrator: Anas bin Malik narrated that :
hadiths.body: some people from (the tribe of) `Urainah came to us (to Al-Madinah) during the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, but they did not want to stay in Al-Madinah because the climate did not suit them. He said: “Go out to the camels which belong to us, and drink their milk and urine.” So they did that (and recovered), then they apostatized from Islam and killed the herdsman of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and stole his camels. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ sent people after them, and they were brought back. Then he cut off their hands and feet, branded their eyes and left them in Harrah until they died.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا نَصْرُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ الْجَهْضَمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ، حَدَّثَنَا حُمَيْدٌ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّ أُنَاسًا، مِنْ عُرَيْنَةَ قَدِمُوا عَلَى عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَاجْتَوَوُا الْمَدِينَةَ فَقَالَ  " لَوْ خَرَجْتُمْ إِلَى ذَوْدٍ لَنَا فَشَرِبْتُمْ مِنْ أَلْبَانِهَا وَأَبْوَالِهَا " . فَفَعَلُوا فَارْتَدُّوا عَنِ الإِسْلاَمِ وَقَتَلُوا رَاعِيَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَاسْتَاقُوا ذَوْدَهُ فَبَعَثَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ فِي طَلَبِهِمْ فَجِيءَ بِهِمْ فَقَطَعَ أَيْدِيَهُمْ وَأَرْجُلَهُمْ وَسَمَرَ أَعْيُنَهُمْ وَتَرَكَهُمْ بِالْحَرَّةِ حَتَّى مَاتُوا .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Legal Punishments, Hadith 2578

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2579

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَنْ حَارَبَ وَسَعَى فِي الأَرْضِ فَسَادًا
chapter.englishTitle: Those Who Engage In Banditry and Spread Mischief In The Land

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from 'Aishah that :
            some people raided the she-camels of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , so the Prophet ﷺ cut off their hands and feet (on opposite sides) and lanced (gouged out) their eyes.
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from 'Aishah that :
hadiths.body: some people raided the she-camels of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , so the Prophet ﷺ cut off their hands and feet (on opposite sides) and lanced (gouged out) their eyes.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ أَبِي الْوَزِيرِ، حَدَّثَنَا الدَّرَاوَرْدِيُّ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ قَوْمًا، أَغَارُوا عَلَى لِقَاحِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَقَطَعَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ أَيْدِيَهُمْ وَأَرْجُلَهُمْ وَسَمَلَ أَعْيُنَهُمْ .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Legal Punishments, Hadith 2579

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2580

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَنْ قُتِلَ دُونَ مَالِهِ فَهُوَ شَهِيدٌ
chapter.englishTitle: One Who Is Killed Defending His Property Is Martyr

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Sa'eed bin Zaid bin 'Amr bin Nufail that the Prophet ﷺ said:
            “Whoever is killed defending his property, he is a martyr.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Sa'eed bin Zaid bin 'Amr bin Nufail that the Prophet ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “Whoever is killed defending his property, he is a martyr.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ طَلْحَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَوْفٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ زَيْدِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ نُفَيْلٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ  " مَنْ قُتِلَ دُونَ مَالِهِ فَهُوَ شَهِيدٌ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Legal Punishments, Hadith 2580

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2581

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَنْ قُتِلَ دُونَ مَالِهِ فَهُوَ شَهِيدٌ
chapter.englishTitle: One Who Is Killed Defending His Property Is Martyr

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Ibn `Umar that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            “If a man's property is targeted, and he is fought and fights back and is killed, he is a martyr.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Ibn `Umar that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “If a man's property is targeted, and he is fought and fights back and is killed, he is a martyr.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا الْخَلِيلُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو، حَدَّثَنَا مَرْوَانُ بْنُ مُعَاوِيَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ سِنَانٍ الْجَزَرِيُّ، عَنْ مَيْمُونِ بْنِ مِهْرَانَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " مَنْ أُتِيَ عِنْدَ مَالِهِ فُقُوتِلَ فَقَاتَلَ فَقُتِلَ فَهُوَ شَهِيدٌ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Legal Punishments, Hadith 2581

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2582

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَنْ قُتِلَ دُونَ مَالِهِ فَهُوَ شَهِيدٌ
chapter.englishTitle: One Who Is Killed Defending His Property Is Martyr

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Abu Hurairah said:
            “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'If a man's property is wrongfully targeted, and he is killed, he is a martyr.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Abu Hurairah said:
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'If a man's property is wrongfully targeted, and he is killed, he is a martyr.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَامِرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ الْمُطَّلِبِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " مَنْ أُرِيدَ مَالُهُ ظُلْمًا فَقُتِلَ فَهُوَ شَهِيدٌ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Legal Punishments, Hadith 2582

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2583

chapter.englishTitle: The Legal Punishment for the Thief

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            “May Allah curse the thief! He steals an egg and his hand is cut off, and he steals a rope and his hand is cut off”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “May Allah curse the thief! He steals an egg and his hand is cut off, and he steals a rope and his hand is cut off”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " لَعَنَ اللَّهُ السَّارِقَ يَسْرِقُ الْبَيْضَةَ فَتُقْطَعُ يَدُهُ وَيَسْرِقُ الْحَبْلَ فَتُقْطَعُ يَدُهُ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Legal Punishments, Hadith 2583

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2584

chapter.englishTitle: The Legal Punishment for the Thief

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Ibn Umar said:
            “The Prophet ﷺ cut off (the hand of a thief) for a shield worth three Dirham.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Ibn Umar said:
hadiths.body: “The Prophet ﷺ cut off (the hand of a thief) for a shield worth three Dirham.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بَنُ مُسْهِرٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ قَطَعَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ فِي مِجَنٍّ قِيمَتُهُ ثَلاَثَةُ دَرَاهِمَ .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Legal Punishments, Hadith 2584

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2585

chapter.englishTitle: The Legal Punishment for the Thief

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Aishah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            “Do not cut off (the thief's hand) except for something worth one quarter of a Dinar or more
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Aishah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “Do not cut off (the thief's hand) except for something worth one quarter of a Dinar or more
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مَرْوَانَ الْعُثْمَانِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، أَنَّ عَمْرَةَ، أَخْبَرَتْهُ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " لاَ تُقْطَعُ الْيَدُ إِلاَّ فِي رُبُعِ دِينَارٍ فَصَاعِدًا " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Legal Punishments, Hadith 2585

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2586

chapter.englishTitle: The Legal Punishment for the Thief

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Amir bin Sa'd, from this father, that the Prophet ﷺ said:
            “The hand of the thief is to be cut off for the price of a shield.
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Amir bin Sa'd, from this father, that the Prophet ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “The hand of the thief is to be cut off for the price of a shield.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو هِشَامٍ الْمَخْزُومِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو وَاقِدٍ، عَنْ عَامِرِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ  " تُقْطَعُ يَدُ السَّارِقِ فِي ثَمَنِ الْمِجَنِّ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Legal Punishments, Hadith 2586

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2587

chapter.englishTitle: Hanging The Hand From The Neck.

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Ibn Muhairiz said:
            “I asked Fadalah bin Ubaid about hanging the hand (of the thief) from this neck, and he said: 'It is sunnah. The messenger of Allah ﷺ cut off a man's hand then hung it from his neck'''
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Ibn Muhairiz said:
hadiths.body: “I asked Fadalah bin Ubaid about hanging the hand (of the thief) from this neck, and he said: 'It is sunnah. The messenger of Allah ﷺ cut off a man's hand then hung it from his neck'''
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو بِشْرٍ بَكْرُ بْنُ خَلَفٍ وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ وَأَبُو سَلَمَةَ الْجُوبَارِيُّ يَحْيَى بْنُ خَلَفٍ قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ عَلِيِّ بْنِ عَطَاءِ بْنِ مُقَدَّمٍ، عَنْ حَجَّاجٍ، عَنْ مَكْحُولٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ مُحَيْرِيزٍ، قَالَ سَأَلْتُ فَضَالَةَ بْنَ عُبَيْدٍ عَنْ تَعْلِيقِ الْيَدِ، فِي الْعُنُقِ فَقَالَ السُّنَّةُ قَطَعَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَدَ رَجُلٍ ثُمَّ عَلَّقَهَا فِي عُنُقِهِ .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Legal Punishments, Hadith 2587

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2588

chapter.englishTitle: A  Thief Who Confesses.

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abdur-Rahman bin Tha’labah Al-Ansari, from his father, that Amr bin Samurah bin Habib bin Abd Shams came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and said:
            “O Messenger of Allah ﷺ! I stole a camel belonging to Banu so-and-so; purify me!” The Prophet ﷺ sent word to them and they said: “(Yes), we have lost a camel of ours.” So the Prophet ﷺ ordered that his hand be cut off. Tha'labah said: “I was looking at him when his hand fell and he said (to it) 'Praise is to Allah (STW) Who has purified me of you; you wanted to cause my whole body to enter Hell.'''
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abdur-Rahman bin Tha’labah Al-Ansari, from his father, that Amr bin Samurah bin Habib bin Abd Shams came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and said:
hadiths.body: “O Messenger of Allah ﷺ! I stole a camel belonging to Banu so-and-so; purify me!” The Prophet ﷺ sent word to them and they said: “(Yes), we have lost a camel of ours.” So the Prophet ﷺ ordered that his hand be cut off. Tha'labah said: “I was looking at him when his hand fell and he said (to it) 'Praise is to Allah (STW) Who has purified me of you; you wanted to cause my whole body to enter Hell.'''
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي مَرْيَمَ، أَنْبَأَنَا ابْنُ لَهِيعَةَ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ ثَعْلَبَةَ الأَنْصَارِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ عَمْرَو بْنَ سَمُرَةَ بْنِ حَبِيبِ بْنِ عَبْدِ شَمْسٍ، جَاءَ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي سَرَقْتُ جَمَلاً لِبَنِي فُلاَنٍ فَطَهِّرْنِي . فَأَرْسَلَ إِلَيْهِمُ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ فَقَالُوا إِنَّا افْتَقَدْنَا جَمَلاً لَنَا فَأَمَرَ بِهِ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ فَقُطِعَتْ يَدُهُ . قَالَ ثَعْلَبَةُ أَنَا أَنْظُرُ إِلَيْهِ حِينَ وَقَعَتْ يَدُهُ وَهُوَ يَقُولُ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي طَهَّرَنِي مِنْكِ أَرَدْتِ أَنْ تُدْخِلِي جَسَدِي النَّارَ .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Legal Punishments, Hadith 2588

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2589

chapter.englishTitle: : A Slave Who Steals.

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            “If a slave steals, then sell him, even for half Price.' ”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “If a slave steals, then sell him, even for half Price.' ”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي عَوَانَةَ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " إِذَا سَرَقَ الْعَبْدُ فَبِيعُوهُ وَلَوْ بِنَشٍّ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Legal Punishments, Hadith 2589

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2590

chapter.englishTitle: : A Slave Who Steals.

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Ibn Abbas that :
            one of the slaves of Khumus stole something from the Khumus, and the matter was referred to the Prophet ﷺ but he did not cut off his hand, and he said ' The Property of Allah, (STW) part of it stealing another part.' ”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Ibn Abbas that :
hadiths.body: one of the slaves of Khumus stole something from the Khumus, and the matter was referred to the Prophet ﷺ but he did not cut off his hand, and he said ' The Property of Allah, (STW) part of it stealing another part.' ”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا جُبَارَةُ بْنُ الْمُغَلِّسِ، حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ تَمِيمٍ، عَنْ مَيْمُونِ بْنِ مِهْرَانَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّ عَبْدًا، مِنْ رَقِيقِ الْخُمُسِ سَرَقَ مِنَ الْخُمُسِ فَرُفِعَ ذَلِكَ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ ﷺ فَلَمْ يَقْطَعْهُ وَقَالَ  " مَالُ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ سَرَقَ بَعْضُهُ بَعْضًا " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Legal Punishments, Hadith 2590

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2591

chapter.englishTitle: Those Who Betray Trusts, Robbers and

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Jabir bin Abdullah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            “The hand of the one who betrays a trust, the robber and the pilferer is not to be cut off”.
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Jabir bin Abdullah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “The hand of the one who betrays a trust, the robber and the pilferer is not to be cut off”.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ  " لاَ يُقْطَعُ الْخَائِنُ وَلاَ الْمُنْتَهِبُ وَلاَ الْمُخْتَلِسُ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Legal Punishments, Hadith 2591

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2592

chapter.englishTitle: Those Who Betray Trusts, Robbers and

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Ibrahim bin Abdur-Rahman bin Awf that his father said:
            “I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: 'The hand of the pilferer is not to be cut off”.
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Ibrahim bin Abdur-Rahman bin Awf that his father said:
hadiths.body: “I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: 'The hand of the pilferer is not to be cut off”.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَاصِمِ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ الْمِصْرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا الْمُفَضَّلُ بْنُ فَضَالَةَ، عَنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَوْفٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ  " لَيْسَ عَلَى الْمُخْتَلِسِ قَطْعٌ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Legal Punishments, Hadith 2592

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2593

chapter.arabicTitle: باب لاَ يُقْطَعُ فِي ثَمَرٍ وَلاَ كَثَرٍ
chapter.englishTitle: : The Hand Is Not To Be Cut Off For (Stealing) Produce Or The Spadix (Marrow) of Palm Tree

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Rafi bin Khadij that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            “The hand is not to be cut off for (stealing) produce or the spadix of palm trees.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Rafi bin Khadij that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “The hand is not to be cut off for (stealing) produce or the spadix of palm trees.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى بْنِ حَبَّانَ، عَنْ عَمِّهِ، وَاسِعِ بْنِ حَبَّانَ، عَنْ رَافِعِ بْنِ خَدِيجٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " لاَ قَطْعَ فِي ثَمَرٍ وَلاَ كَثَرٍ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Legal Punishments, Hadith 2593

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2594

chapter.arabicTitle: باب لاَ يُقْطَعُ فِي ثَمَرٍ وَلاَ كَثَرٍ
chapter.englishTitle: : The Hand Is Not To Be Cut Off For (Stealing) Produce Or The Spadix (Marrow) of Palm Tree

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            “The hand is not to be cut off for (stealing) produce or the spadix of palm trees.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “The hand is not to be cut off for (stealing) produce or the spadix of palm trees.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعْدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الْمَقْبُرِيُّ، عَنْ أَخِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " لاَ قَطْعَ فِي ثَمَرٍ وَلاَ كَثَرٍ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Legal Punishments, Hadith 2594

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2595

chapter.englishTitle: : One Who Steals Something That Is Guarded

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abdullah bin Safwan that :
            his father slept in the mosque, using his upper wrap as a pillow, and it was taken from beneath his head. He brought the thief to the Prophet ﷺ and the Prophet ﷺ ordered that his hand be cut off. Safwan said: “O Messenger of Allah , ﷺ I did not want this! I give my upper wrap to him in charity.” The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Why did you not give it to him before you brought him to me?”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abdullah bin Safwan that :
hadiths.body: his father slept in the mosque, using his upper wrap as a pillow, and it was taken from beneath his head. He brought the thief to the Prophet ﷺ and the Prophet ﷺ ordered that his hand be cut off. Safwan said: “O Messenger of Allah , ﷺ I did not want this! I give my upper wrap to him in charity.” The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Why did you not give it to him before you brought him to me?”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا شَبَابَةُ، عَنْ مَالِكِ بْنِ أَنَسٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ صَفْوَانَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّهُ نَامَ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ وَتَوَسَّدَ رِدَاءَهُ فَأُخِذَ مِنْ تَحْتِ رَأْسِهِ فَجَاءَ بِسَارِقِهِ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ ﷺ فَأَمَرَ بِهِ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ أَنْ يُقْطَعَ فَقَالَ صَفْوَانُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ لَمْ أُرِدْ هَذَا رِدَائِي عَلَيْهِ صَدَقَةٌ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " فَهَلاَّ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَأْتِيَنِي بِهِ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Legal Punishments, Hadith 2595

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2596

chapter.englishTitle: : One Who Steals Something That Is Guarded

hadiths.englishRaw:
XOIt was narrated from Amr bin Shu'aib, from his father, from his grandfather, that a man from Muzainah asked the Prophet ﷺ about fruits. :
            He said: “What is taken from the tree and carried away, its value and the like of it along with it (meaning double its price must be paid). What (is taken) from the place where dates are dried, (the penalty) is cutting off the hand if the amount taken is equal to the price of a shield. But if (the person) eats it and does not take it away, there is no penalty.” He said: “What about the sheep taken from the pasture, O Messenger of Allah ﷺ?” He said: “(The thief) must pay double its price and be punished, and if it was in the pen then his hand should be cut off, if what was taken was worth the price of a shield.”
hadiths.narrator: XOIt was narrated from Amr bin Shu'aib, from his father, from his grandfather, that a man from Muzainah asked the Prophet ﷺ about fruits. :
hadiths.body: He said: “What is taken from the tree and carried away, its value and the like of it along with it (meaning double its price must be paid). What (is taken) from the place where dates are dried, (the penalty) is cutting off the hand if the amount taken is equal to the price of a shield. But if (the person) eats it and does not take it away, there is no penalty.” He said: “What about the sheep taken from the pasture, O Messenger of Allah ﷺ?” He said: “(The thief) must pay double its price and be punished, and if it was in the pen then his hand should be cut off, if what was taken was worth the price of a shield.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنِ الْوَلِيدِ بْنِ كَثِيرٍ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ شُعَيْبٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ، أَنَّ رَجُلاً، مِنْ مُزَيْنَةَ سَأَلَ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ عَنِ الثِّمَارِ فَقَالَ " مَا أُخِذَ فِي أَكْمَامِهِ فَاحْتُمِلَ فَثَمَنُهُ وَمِثْلُهُ مَعَهُ وَمَا كَانَ فِي الْجِرَانِ فَفِيهِ الْقَطْعُ إِذَا بَلَغَ ذَلِكَ ثَمَنَ الْمِجَنِّ وَإِنْ أَكَلَ وَلَمْ يَأْخُذْ فَلَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ " . قَالَ الشَّاةُ الْحَرِيسَةُ مِنْهُنَّ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ " ثَمَنُهَا وَمِثْلُهُ مَعَهُ وَالنَّكَالُ وَمَا كَانَ فِي الْمُرَاحِ فَفِيهِ الْقَطْعُ إِذَا كَانَ مَا يَأْخُذُ مِنْ ذَلِكَ ثَمَنَ الْمِجَنِّ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Legal Punishments, Hadith 2596

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2597

chapter.englishTitle: Prompting A Thief.

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Ishaq bin Abu Talhah:
            “I heard Abu Mundhir, the freed slave of Abu Dharr, say that Abu Umayyah narrated to him, that a thief was brought to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and he admitted his crime, although the stolen goods were not found with him. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'I do not think you stole them.’ He said: 'Yes I did.' Then he said (again): ‘I do not think that you stole them.’ and he said: 'Yes I did.' Then he ordered that his hand be cut off. The Prophet ﷺ ' Say: I seek Allah's forgiveness and I repent to Him.' So he (the thief) said: 'I seek Allah's forgiveness and I repent to him.' He (the Prophet ﷺ said twice: 'O Allah! Accept his repentance.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Ishaq bin Abu Talhah:
hadiths.body: “I heard Abu Mundhir, the freed slave of Abu Dharr, say that Abu Umayyah narrated to him, that a thief was brought to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and he admitted his crime, although the stolen goods were not found with him. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'I do not think you stole them.’ He said: 'Yes I did.' Then he said (again): ‘I do not think that you stole them.’ and he said: 'Yes I did.' Then he ordered that his hand be cut off. The Prophet ﷺ ' Say: I seek Allah's forgiveness and I repent to Him.' So he (the thief) said: 'I seek Allah's forgiveness and I repent to him.' He (the Prophet ﷺ said twice: 'O Allah! Accept his repentance.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ، سَمِعْتُ أَبَا الْمُنْذِرِ، - مَوْلَى أَبِي ذَرٍّ - يَذْكُرُ أَنَّ أَبَا أُمَيَّةَ، حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ أُتِيَ بِلِصٍّ فَاعْتَرَفَ اعْتِرَافًا وَلَمْ يُوجَدْ مَعَهُ الْمَتَاعُ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ " مَا إِخَالُكَ سَرَقْتَ " . قَالَ بَلَى . ثُمَّ قَالَ " مَا إِخَالُكَ سَرَقْتَ " . قَالَ بَلَى . فَأَمَرَ بِهِ فَقُطِعَ . فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ " قُلْ أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ " . قَالَ أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ . قَالَ " اللَّهُمَّ تُبْ عَلَيْهِ " . مَرَّتَيْنِ .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Legal Punishments, Hadith 2597

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2598

chapter.englishTitle: One Who Is Coerced

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from 'Abdul Jabbar bin Wa'il that his father said:
            “A Woman was coerced (i.e., raped) during the time of Messenger of Allah ﷺ He waived the legal punishment for her and carried it out on the one who had attacked her, but he (the narrator) did not say that he rules that she should be given a bridal-money.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from 'Abdul Jabbar bin Wa'il that his father said:
hadiths.body: “A Woman was coerced (i.e., raped) during the time of Messenger of Allah ﷺ He waived the legal punishment for her and carried it out on the one who had attacked her, but he (the narrator) did not say that he rules that she should be given a bridal-money.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مَيْمُونٍ الرَّقِّيُّ، وَأَيُّوبُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ الْوَزَّانُ، وَعَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا مُعَمَّرُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، أَنْبَأَنَا الْحَجَّاجُ بْنُ أَرْطَاةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْجَبَّارِ بْنِ وَائِلٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ اسْتُكْرِهَتِ امْرَأَةٌ عَلَى عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَدَرَأَ عَنْهَا الْحَدَّ وَأَقَامَهُ عَلَى الَّذِي أَصَابَهَا . وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ أَنَّهُ جَعَلَ لَهَا مَهْرًا .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Legal Punishments, Hadith 2598

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2599

chapter.arabicTitle: باب النَّهْىِ عَنْ إِقَامَةِ الْحُدُودِ، فِي الْمَسَاجِدِ
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Carrying Out The Legal Punishments In The Mosque.

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Ibn Abbas that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            “Do not carry out the legal punishment in the mosque.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Ibn Abbas that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “Do not carry out the legal punishment in the mosque.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا سُوَيْدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُسْهِرٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ عَرَفَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَفْصٍ الأَبَّارُ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنْ طَاوُسٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ  " لاَ تُقَامُ الْحُدُودُ فِي الْمَسَاجِدِ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Legal Punishments, Hadith 2599

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2600

chapter.arabicTitle: باب النَّهْىِ عَنْ إِقَامَةِ الْحُدُودِ، فِي الْمَسَاجِدِ
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Carrying Out The Legal Punishments In The Mosque.

hadiths.englishRaw:
'Amr bin Shu'aib narrated from his father, from his grandfather, that:
            the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade lashing for the legal punishment in the mosques.
hadiths.narrator: 'Amr bin Shu'aib narrated from his father, from his grandfather, that:
hadiths.body: the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade lashing for the legal punishment in the mosques.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رُمْحٍ، أَنْبَأَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ لَهِيعَةَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَجْلاَنَ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ عَمْرَو بْنَ شُعَيْبٍ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ نَهَى عَنْ جَلْدِ الْحَدِّ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Legal Punishments, Hadith 2600

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2601

chapter.englishTitle: Penalty or Discretionary Punishments (Decided by The Judge)

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Burdah bin Niyar that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to say:
            “No one should be given more than ten lashes, except in the case of one of the legal punishments of Allah (Subhanahu-wa-Taala).”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Burdah bin Niyar that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to say:
hadiths.body: “No one should be given more than ten lashes, except in the case of one of the legal punishments of Allah (Subhanahu-wa-Taala).”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رُمْحٍ، أَنْبَأَنَا اللَّيْثُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ، عَنْ بُكَيْرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الأَشَجِّ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ يَسَارٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ بْنِ نِيَارٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ كَانَ يَقُولُ  " لاَ يُجْلَدُ أَحَدٌ فَوْقَ عَشْرِ جَلَدَاتٍ إِلاَّ فِي حَدٍّ مِنْ حُدُودِ اللَّهِ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Legal Punishments, Hadith 2601

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2602

chapter.englishTitle: Penalty or Discretionary Punishments (Decided by The Judge)

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            “Do not punish with more than ten whips.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “Do not punish with more than ten whips.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ عَيَّاشٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبَّادُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " لاَ تُعَزِّرُوا فَوْقَ عَشَرَةِ أَسْوَاطٍ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Legal Punishments, Hadith 2602

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2603

chapter.englishTitle: The Legal Punishment Is Expiation

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Ubadah bin Samit that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            “Whoever among you undergoes a Hadd, his punishment has been brought forward, and it is an expiation for him otherwise his case rests with Allah.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Ubadah bin Samit that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “Whoever among you undergoes a Hadd, his punishment has been brought forward, and it is an expiation for him otherwise his case rests with Allah.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ، وَابْنُ أَبِي عَدِيٍّ، عَنْ خَالِدٍ الْحَذَّاءِ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلاَبَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي الأَشْعَثِ، عَنْ عُبَادَةَ بْنِ الصَّامِتِ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " مَنْ أَصَابَ مِنْكُمْ حَدًّا فَعُجِّلَتْ لَهُ عُقُوبَتُهُ فَهُوَ كَفَّارَتُهُ وَإِلاَّ فَأَمْرُهُ إِلَى اللَّهِ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Legal Punishments, Hadith 2603

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2604

chapter.englishTitle: The Legal Punishment Is Expiation

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Ali that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            “Whoever commits a sin in this world and is punished for it, Allah (STW) is too just to repeat the punishment for his slave (in the hereafter). And whoever commits a sin in this world and Allah conceals him, Allah is too generous to go back to something that He has pardoned.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Ali that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “Whoever commits a sin in this world and is punished for it, Allah (STW) is too just to repeat the punishment for his slave (in the hereafter). And whoever commits a sin in this world and Allah conceals him, Allah is too generous to go back to something that He has pardoned.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا هَارُونُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْحَمَّالُ، حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ بْنُ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ أَبِي جُحَيْفَةَ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " مَنْ أَصَابَ فِي الدُّنْيَا ذَنْبًا فَعُوقِبَ بِهِ فَاللَّهُ أَعْدَلُ مِنْ أَنْ يُثَنِّيَ عُقُوبَتَهُ عَلَى عَبْدِهِ وَمَنْ أَذْنَبَ ذَنْبًا فِي الدُّنْيَا فَسَتَرَهُ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ فَاللَّهُ أَكْرَمُ مِنْ أَنْ يَعُودَ فِي شَىْءٍ قَدْ عَفَا عَنْهُ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Legal Punishments, Hadith 2604

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2605

chapter.arabicTitle: باب الرَّجُلِ يَجِدُ مَعَ امْرَأَتِهِ رَجُلاً
chapter.englishTitle: A Man Who Finds Another Man with his Wife.

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that Sa'd bin Ubadah Al-Ansari said:
            “O Messenger of Allah ﷺ if a man finds another man with his wife, should he kill him?” The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “No.” Sa'd said: “Yes he should, by the one who honored you with the Truth!” The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Listen to what your leader says!”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that Sa'd bin Ubadah Al-Ansari said:
hadiths.body: “O Messenger of Allah ﷺ if a man finds another man with his wife, should he kill him?” The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “No.” Sa'd said: “Yes he should, by the one who honored you with the Truth!” The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Listen to what your leader says!”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدَةَ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُبَيْدٍ الْمَدِينِيُّ أَبُو عُبَيْدٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ الدَّرَاوَرْدِيُّ، عَنْ سُهَيْلِ بْنِ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ سَعْدَ بْنَ عُبَادَةَ الأَنْصَارِيَّ، قَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ الرَّجُلُ يَجِدُ مَعَ امْرَأَتِهِ رَجُلاً أَيَقْتُلُهُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ " لاَ " . قَالَ سَعْدٌ بَلَى وَالَّذِي أَكْرَمَكَ بِالْحَقِّ . فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ " اسْمَعُوا مَا يَقُولُ سَيِّدُكُمْ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Legal Punishments, Hadith 2605

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2606

chapter.arabicTitle: باب الرَّجُلِ يَجِدُ مَعَ امْرَأَتِهِ رَجُلاً
chapter.englishTitle: A Man Who Finds Another Man with his Wife.

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Salamah bin Muhabbiq said:
            “When the Verse of legal punishments was revealed, it was said to Abu Thabit Sa'd bin Ubadah, who was a jealous man: ‘If you found another man with your wife, what would you do?’ He said: “I would strike them both wife the sword; do you think I should wait until I bring four (witness) and he has satisfied himself and gone away? Or should I say I saw such and such, and you will carry out the legal punishment punishment on me (for slander) and never accept my testimony thereafter?' Mention of that was made to the prophet ﷺ and he said: “The sword is sufficient as a witness.' Then he said: 'No (on second thought) I am afraid that the drunkard and the jealous would pursue that.” (Da'if)
Abu Abdullah - meaning Ibn Majah - said: “I heard Abu Zurah saying: “This is a Hadith of Ali bin Muhammad At-Tanafisi, I did not hear it from him.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Salamah bin Muhabbiq said:
hadiths.body:
“When the Verse of legal punishments was revealed, it was said to Abu Thabit Sa'd bin Ubadah, who was a jealous man: ‘If you found another man with your wife, what would you do?’ He said: “I would strike them both wife the sword; do you think I should wait until I bring four (witness) and he has satisfied himself and gone away? Or should I say I saw such and such, and you will carry out the legal punishment punishment on me (for slander) and never accept my testimony thereafter?' Mention of that was made to the prophet ﷺ and he said: “The sword is sufficient as a witness.' Then he said: 'No (on second thought) I am afraid that the drunkard and the jealous would pursue that.” (Da'if)
Abu Abdullah - meaning Ibn Majah - said: “I heard Abu Zurah saying: “This is a Hadith of Ali bin Muhammad At-Tanafisi, I did not hear it from him.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنِ الْفَضْلِ بْنِ دَلْهَمٍ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، عَنْ قَبِيصَةَ بْنِ حُرَيْثٍ، عَنْ سَلَمَةَ بْنِ الْمُحَبِّقِ، قَالَ قِيلَ لأَبِي ثَابِتٍ سَعْدِ بْنِ عُبَادَةَ حِينَ نَزَلَتْ آيَةُ الْحُدُودِ وَكَانَ رَجُلاً غَيُورًا أَرَأَيْتَ لَوْ أَنَّكَ وَجَدْتَ مَعَ أُمِّ ثَابِتٍ رَجُلاً أَىَّ شَىْءٍ كُنْتَ تَصْنَعُ قَالَ كُنْتُ ضَارِبَهُمَا بِالسَّيْفِ أَنْتَظِرُ حَتَّى أَجِيءَ بِأَرْبَعَةٍ إِلَى مَا ذَاكَ قَدْ قَضَى حَاجَتَهُ وَذَهَبَ . أَوْ أَقُولُ رَأَيْتُ كَذَا وَكَذَا فَتَضْرِبُونِي الْحَدَّ وَلاَ تَقْبَلُوا لِي شَهَادَةً أَبَدًا . قَالَ فَذُكِرَ ذَلِكَ لِلنَّبِيِّ ﷺ فَقَالَ " كَفَى بِالسَّيْفِ شَاهِدًا " . ثُمَّ قَالَ " لاَ إِنِّي أَخَافُ أَنْ يَتَتَايَعَ فِي ذَلِكَ السَّكْرَانُ وَالْغَيْرَانُ " . قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ يَعْنِي ابْنَ مَاجَهْ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا زُرْعَةَ يَقُولُ هَذَا حَدِيثُ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ الطَّنَافِسِيِّ وَفَاتَنِي مِنْهُ .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Legal Punishments, Hadith 2606

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2607

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَنْ تَزَوَّجَ امْرَأَةَ أَبِيهِ مِنْ بَعْدِهِ
chapter.englishTitle: One Who Marries His Father's Wife After He Dies.

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Bara bin Azib said:
            “My maternal uncle passed by me - (one of the narrators) Hushaim named him in his narration as Harith bin Amr - and the Prophet ﷺ had given him a banner to carry. I said to him: 'Where are you going?’ He said: 'The Messenger of Allah ﷺ has sent me to a man who married his father's wife after he died, and has commanded me to strike his neck (i.e. execute him).”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Bara bin Azib said:
hadiths.body: “My maternal uncle passed by me - (one of the narrators) Hushaim named him in his narration as Harith bin Amr - and the Prophet ﷺ had given him a banner to carry. I said to him: 'Where are you going?’ He said: 'The Messenger of Allah ﷺ has sent me to a man who married his father's wife after he died, and has commanded me to strike his neck (i.e. execute him).”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ مُوسَى، حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا سَهْلُ بْنُ أَبِي سَهْلٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصُ بْنُ غِيَاثٍ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ أَشْعَثَ، عَنْ عَدِيِّ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ، عَنِ الْبَرَاءِ بْنِ عَازِبٍ، قَالَ مَرَّ بِي خَالِي - سَمَّاهُ هُشَيْمٌ فِي حَدِيثِهِ الْحَارِثَ بْنَ عَمْرٍو - وَقَدْ عَقَدَ لَهُ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ لِوَاءً فَقُلْتُ لَهُ أَيْنَ تُرِيدُ فَقَالَ بَعَثَنِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ إِلَى رَجُلٍ تَزَوَّجَ امْرَأَةَ أَبِيهِ مِنْ بَعْدِهِ فَأَمَرَنِي أَنْ أَضْرِبَ عُنُقَهُ .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Legal Punishments, Hadith 2607

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2608

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَنْ تَزَوَّجَ امْرَأَةَ أَبِيهِ مِنْ بَعْدِهِ
chapter.englishTitle: One Who Marries His Father's Wife After He Dies.

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Mu'awiyah bin Qurrah that his father said:
            “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ sent me to a man who had married his father's wife after he died, to strike his neck (execute him) and confiscate his wealth.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Mu'awiyah bin Qurrah that his father said:
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ sent me to a man who had married his father's wife after he died, to strike his neck (execute him) and confiscate his wealth.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ ابْنُ أَخِي الْحُسَيْنِ الْجُعْفِيِّ، حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ بْنُ مَنَازِلَ التَّيْمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ إِدْرِيسَ، عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ أَبِي كَرِيمَةَ، عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ قُرَّةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ بَعَثَنِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ إِلَى رَجُلٍ تَزَوَّجَ امْرَأَةَ أَبِيهِ أَنْ أَضْرِبَ عُنُقَهُ وَأُصَفِّيَ مَالَهُ .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Legal Punishments, Hadith 2608

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2609

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَنِ ادَّعَى إِلَى غَيْرِ أَبِيهِ أَوْ تَوَلَّى غَيْرَ مَوَالِيهِ
chapter.englishTitle: One Who Claims To Belong To Someone Other Than His Father, Or (A Slave) Who Claims Who That his Wala is for Other Than His Real Master

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Ibn Abbas that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            “Whoever claims to belong to someone other than his father, or (a freed slave) who claims that his Wala is for other than his real master, the curse of Allah (Subhanahu-wa-Taala), the angels and all the people will be upon him.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Ibn Abbas that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “Whoever claims to belong to someone other than his father, or (a freed slave) who claims that his Wala is for other than his real master, the curse of Allah (Subhanahu-wa-Taala), the angels and all the people will be upon him.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بِشْرٍ، بَكْرُ بْنُ خَلَفٍ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي الضَّيْفِ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ خُثَيْمٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " مَنِ انْتَسَبَ إِلَى غَيْرِ أَبِيهِ أَوْ تَوَلَّى غَيْرَ مَوَالِيهِ فَعَلَيْهِ لَعْنَةُ اللَّهِ وَالْمَلاَئِكَةِ وَالنَّاسِ أَجْمَعِينَ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Legal Punishments, Hadith 2609

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2610

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَنِ ادَّعَى إِلَى غَيْرِ أَبِيهِ أَوْ تَوَلَّى غَيْرَ مَوَالِيهِ
chapter.englishTitle: One Who Claims To Belong To Someone Other Than His Father, Or (A Slave) Who Claims Who That his Wala is for Other Than His Real Master

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Abu Uthman Nahdi said:
            “I heard Sa'd and Abu Bakrah both say that they heard directly from Muhammad ﷺ saying it and memorized: 'Whoever claims to belong to someone other than his father knowing the he is not his father, Paradise will be forbidden to him.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Abu Uthman Nahdi said:
hadiths.body: “I heard Sa'd and Abu Bakrah both say that they heard directly from Muhammad ﷺ saying it and memorized: 'Whoever claims to belong to someone other than his father knowing the he is not his father, Paradise will be forbidden to him.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنْ عَاصِمٍ الأَحْوَلِ، عَنْ أَبِي عُثْمَانَ النَّهْدِيِّ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ سَعْدًا، وَأَبَا، بَكْرَةَ وَكُلُّ وَاحِدٍ مِنْهُمَا يَقُولُ سَمِعَتْ أُذُنَاىَ، وَوَعَى، قَلْبِي مُحَمَّدًا ﷺ يَقُولُ  " مَنِ ادَّعَى إِلَى غَيْرِ أَبِيهِ وَهُوَ يَعْلَمُ أَنَّهُ غَيْرُ أَبِيهِ فَالْجَنَّةُ عَلَيْهِ حَرَامٌ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Legal Punishments, Hadith 2610

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2611

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَنِ ادَّعَى إِلَى غَيْرِ أَبِيهِ أَوْ تَوَلَّى غَيْرَ مَوَالِيهِ
chapter.englishTitle: One Who Claims To Belong To Someone Other Than His Father, Or (A Slave) Who Claims Who That his Wala is for Other Than His Real Master

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abdullah bin Amr that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            “Whoever claims to belong to someone other than his father will not smell the fragrance of Paradise, even though its fragrance may be detected from a distance of five hundred years.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abdullah bin Amr that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “Whoever claims to belong to someone other than his father will not smell the fragrance of Paradise, even though its fragrance may be detected from a distance of five hundred years.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الصَّبَّاحِ، أَنْبَأَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْكَرِيمِ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " مَنِ ادَّعَى إِلَى غَيْرِ أَبِيهِ لَمْ يَرَحْ رَائِحَةَ الْجَنَّةِ وَإِنَّ رِيحَهَا لَيُوجَدُ مِنْ مَسِيرَةِ خَمْسِمِائَةِ عَامٍ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Legal Punishments, Hadith 2611

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2612

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَنْ نَفَى رَجُلاً مِنْ قَبِيلَةٍ
chapter.englishTitle: One Who Says That A Man Does Not Belong To his Tribe.

hadiths.englishRaw:
Muslim bin Haisam narrated from Ash'ath bin Qais who said:
            “I came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ with a delegation from Kindah, and they thought that I was the best of them. I said: 'O Messenger of Allah ﷺ are you not from among us?' He said: 'We are the tribe of Banu Nadr bin Kinanah, and we do not attribute ourselves to our mother and we do not deny our forefathers.'”He said: “Ash'ath bin Qais used to say: 'If any man is brought to me who suggests that a man from Quraish does not belong to Nadr bin Kinanah, I would carry out the legal punishment (for slander) on him.'”
hadiths.narrator: Muslim bin Haisam narrated from Ash'ath bin Qais who said:
hadiths.body: “I came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ with a delegation from Kindah, and they thought that I was the best of them. I said: 'O Messenger of Allah ﷺ are you not from among us?' He said: 'We are the tribe of Banu Nadr bin Kinanah, and we do not attribute ourselves to our mother and we do not deny our forefathers.'”He said: “Ash'ath bin Qais used to say: 'If any man is brought to me who suggests that a man from Quraish does not belong to Nadr bin Kinanah, I would carry out the legal punishment (for slander) on him.'”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا هَارُونُ بْنُ حَيَّانَ، أَنْبَأَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ الْمُغِيرَةِ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ عَقِيلِ بْنِ طَلْحَةَ السُّلَمِيِّ، عَنْ مُسْلِمِ بْنِ هَيْصَمٍ، عَنِ الأَشْعَثِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ، قَالَ أَتَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ فِي وَفْدِ كِنْدَةَ وَلاَ يَرَوْنِي أَفْضَلَهُمْ فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَلَسْتُمْ مِنَّا . فَقَالَ  " نَحْنُ بَنُو النَّضْرِ بْنِ كِنَانَةَ لاَ نَقْفُو أُمَّنَا وَلاَ نَنْتَفِي مِنْ أَبِينَا " . قَالَ فَكَانَ الأَشْعَثُ بْنُ قَيْسٍ يَقُولُ لاَ أُوتَى بِرَجُلٍ نَفَى رَجُلاً مِنْ قُرَيْشٍ مِنَ النَّضْرِ بْنِ كِنَانَةَ إِلاَّ جَلَدْتُهُ الْحَدَّ .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Legal Punishments, Hadith 2612

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2613

chapter.englishTitle: Effeminate Men

hadiths.englishRaw:
Safwan bin Umayyah said:
            “We were with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and Amr bin Murrah came and said: 'O Messenger of Allah ﷺ, Allah (Subhanahu-wa-Taala) has decreed that I be doomed, and He has not guided me to earn a living except by beating my tambourine with my hand; give me permission to sing without doing anything immoral.' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'I will not give you permission, or honor you nor give you, what you want. You are lying, O enemy of Allah. Allah (Subhanahu-wa-Taala) has granted you a good, lawful provision, but you have chosen the provision that Allah (Subhanahu-wa-Taala) has forbidden to you instead of that which He has permitted. If I had warned you before, I would have done such and such to you. Get away from me and repent to Allah (Subhanahu-wa-Taala). If you do that again, after this warning, I will give you a painful beating and shave your head, to make an example of you, and I will banish you from among your people, and tell the young men of Al-Madinah to come and take your goods,'Amr stood up, suffering grief and humiliation that is known only to Allah (Subhanahu-wa-Taala). When he went away, the Prophet ﷺ said: 'Those sinners, whoever among them dies without having repented, Allah (Subhanahu-wa-Taala) will gather him on the Day of Resurrection just as he was in this world, effeminate and naked, with not even a piece of cloth to conceal him from the people. Every time he gets up, he will fall to the ground.'”
hadiths.narrator: Safwan bin Umayyah said:
hadiths.body: “We were with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and Amr bin Murrah came and said: 'O Messenger of Allah ﷺ, Allah (Subhanahu-wa-Taala) has decreed that I be doomed, and He has not guided me to earn a living except by beating my tambourine with my hand; give me permission to sing without doing anything immoral.' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'I will not give you permission, or honor you nor give you, what you want. You are lying, O enemy of Allah. Allah (Subhanahu-wa-Taala) has granted you a good, lawful provision, but you have chosen the provision that Allah (Subhanahu-wa-Taala) has forbidden to you instead of that which He has permitted. If I had warned you before, I would have done such and such to you. Get away from me and repent to Allah (Subhanahu-wa-Taala). If you do that again, after this warning, I will give you a painful beating and shave your head, to make an example of you, and I will banish you from among your people, and tell the young men of Al-Madinah to come and take your goods,'Amr stood up, suffering grief and humiliation that is known only to Allah (Subhanahu-wa-Taala). When he went away, the Prophet ﷺ said: 'Those sinners, whoever among them dies without having repented, Allah (Subhanahu-wa-Taala) will gather him on the Day of Resurrection just as he was in this world, effeminate and naked, with not even a piece of cloth to conceal him from the people. Every time he gets up, he will fall to the ground.'”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ أَبِي الرَّبِيعِ الْجُرْجَانِيُّ، أَنْبَأَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ الْعَلاَءِ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ بِشْرَ بْنَ نُمَيْرٍ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ مَكْحُولاً، يَقُولُ إِنَّهُ سَمِعَ يَزِيدَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ صَفْوَانَ بْنَ أُمَيَّةَ، قَالَ كُنَّا عِنْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَجَاءَ عَمْرُو بْنُ قُرَّةَ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ قَدْ كَتَبَ عَلَىَّ الشِّقْوَةَ فَمَا أُرَانِي أُرْزَقُ إِلاَّ مِنْ دُفِّي بِكَفِّي فَأْذَنْ لِي فِي الْغِنَاءِ فِي غَيْرِ فَاحِشَةٍ . فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ " لاَ آذَنُ لَكَ وَلاَ كَرَامَةَ وَلاَ نُعْمَةَ عَيْنٍ كَذَبْتَ أَىْ عَدُوَّ اللَّهِ لَقَدْ رَزَقَكَ اللَّهُ طَيِّبًا حَلاَلاً فَاخْتَرْتَ مَا حَرَّمَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْكَ مِنْ رِزْقِهِ مَكَانَ مَا أَحَلَّ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ لَكَ مِنْ حَلاَلِهِ . وَلَوْ كُنْتُ تَقَدَّمْتُ إِلَيْكَ لَفَعَلْتُ بِكَ وَفَعَلْتُ قُمْ عَنِّي وَتُبْ إِلَى اللَّهِ أَمَا إِنَّكَ إِنْ فَعَلْتَ بَعْدَ التَّقْدِمَةِ إِلَيْكَ ضَرَبْتُكَ ضَرْبًا وَجِيعًا وَحَلَقْتُ رَأْسَكَ مُثْلَةً وَنَفَيْتُكَ مِنْ أَهْلِكَ وَأَحْلَلْتُ سَلَبَكَ نُهْبَةً لِفِتْيَانِ أَهْلِ الْمَدِينَةِ " . فَقَامَ عَمْرٌو وَبِهِ مِنَ الشَّرِّ وَالْخِزْىِ مَا لاَ يَعْلَمُهُ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ فَلَمَّا وَلَّى قَالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ " هَؤُلاَءِ الْعُصَاةُ مَنْ مَاتَ مِنْهُمْ بِغَيْرِ تَوْبَةٍ حَشَرَهُ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ كَمَا كَانَ فِي الدُّنْيَا مُخَنَّثًا عُرْيَانًا لاَ يَسْتَتِرُ مِنَ النَّاسِ بِهُدْبَةٍ كُلَّمَا قَامَ صُرِعَ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Legal Punishments, Hadith 2613

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2614

chapter.englishTitle: Effeminate Men

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Umm Salamah that :
            the Prophet ﷺ entered upon her, and heard an effeminate man saying to Abdullah bin Abu Umayyah: “If Allah enable us to conquer Ta'if tomorrow, I will show you a woman who comes in on four (roll of fat) and goes out on eight” The Prophet ﷺ said: “Throw them out of your houses.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Umm Salamah that :
hadiths.body: the Prophet ﷺ entered upon her, and heard an effeminate man saying to Abdullah bin Abu Umayyah: “If Allah enable us to conquer Ta'if tomorrow, I will show you a woman who comes in on four (roll of fat) and goes out on eight” The Prophet ﷺ said: “Throw them out of your houses.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ زَيْنَبَ بِنْتِ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ دَخَلَ عَلَيْهَا فَسَمِعَ مُخَنَّثًا وَهُو يَقُولُ لِعَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي أُمَيَّةَ إِنْ يَفْتَحِ اللَّهُ الطَّائِفَ غَدًا دَلَلْتُكَ عَلَى امْرَأَةٍ تُقْبِلُ بِأَرْبَعٍ وَتُدْبِرُ بِثَمَانٍ . فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ  " أَخْرِجُوهُمْ مِنْ بُيُوتِكُمْ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Legal Punishments, Hadith 2614

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2615

chapter.arabicTitle: باب التَّغْلِيظِ فِي قَتْلِ مُسْلِمٍ ظُلْمًا
chapter.englishTitle: The Severity Of Killing A Muslim

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abdullah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            “The first matter concerning which judgment will be passed among the people on the Day of Resurrection will be bloodshed.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abdullah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “The first matter concerning which judgment will be passed among the people on the Day of Resurrection will be bloodshed.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، وَعَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، عَنْ شَقِيقٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " أَوَّلُ مَا يُقْضَى بَيْنَ النَّاسِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ فِي الدِّمَاءِ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Blood Money, Hadith 2615

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2616

chapter.arabicTitle: باب التَّغْلِيظِ فِي قَتْلِ مُسْلِمٍ ظُلْمًا
chapter.englishTitle: The Severity Of Killing A Muslim

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abdullah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            “No person is killed wrongfully, but a share of responsibility for his blood will be upon, the first son of Adam, because he was the first one to kill.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abdullah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “No person is killed wrongfully, but a share of responsibility for his blood will be upon, the first son of Adam, because he was the first one to kill.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عِيسَى بْنُ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مُرَّةَ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " لاَ تُقْتَلُ نَفْسٌ ظُلْمًا إِلاَّ كَانَ عَلَى ابْنِ آدَمَ الأَوَّلِ كِفْلٌ مِنْ دَمِهَا لأَنَّهُ أَوَّلُ مَنْ سَنَّ الْقَتْلَ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Blood Money, Hadith 2616

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2617

chapter.arabicTitle: باب التَّغْلِيظِ فِي قَتْلِ مُسْلِمٍ ظُلْمًا
chapter.englishTitle: The Severity Of Killing A Muslim

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abdullah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            The first matter concerning which judgment will be passed among the people on the Day of Resurrection will be bloodshed.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abdullah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: The first matter concerning which judgment will be passed among the people on the Day of Resurrection will be bloodshed.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى بْنِ الأَزْهَرِ الْوَاسِطِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ الأَزْرَقُ، عَنْ شَرِيكٍ، عَنْ عَاصِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " أَوَّلُ مَا يُقْضَى بَيْنَ النَّاسِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ فِي الدِّمَاءِ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Blood Money, Hadith 2617

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2618

chapter.arabicTitle: باب التَّغْلِيظِ فِي قَتْلِ مُسْلِمٍ ظُلْمًا
chapter.englishTitle: The Severity Of Killing A Muslim

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Uqbah bin Amir Al-Juhani that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            “Whoever meets Allah (Subhanahu-wa-Taala) not associating anything in worship with him, and not having shed any blood unlawfully, will enter Paradise.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Uqbah bin Amir Al-Juhani that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “Whoever meets Allah (Subhanahu-wa-Taala) not associating anything in worship with him, and not having shed any blood unlawfully, will enter Paradise.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ أَبِي خَالِدٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَائِذٍ، عَنْ عُقْبَةَ بْنِ عَامِرٍ الْجُهَنِيِّ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " مَنْ لَقِيَ اللَّهَ لاَ يُشْرِكُ بِهِ شَيْئًا لَمْ يَتَنَدَّ بِدَمٍ حَرَامٍ دَخَلَ الْجَنَّةَ " .
references: Vol. 3, Book of The Blood Money, Hadith 2618

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 2619
