            “Many men have attained perfection but no women have attained perfection except Maryam bint ‘Imran (Mary) and Asiyah the wife of Fir’awn. And the superiority of ‘Aishah over other women is like the superiority of Tharid over all other foods.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Musa Al-Ash’ari that the Prophet ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “Many men have attained perfection but no women have attained perfection except Maryam bint ‘Imran (Mary) and Asiyah the wife of Fir’awn. And the superiority of ‘Aishah over other women is like the superiority of Tharid over all other foods.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مُرَّةَ، عَنْ مُرَّةَ الْهَمْدَانِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى الأَشْعَرِيِّ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ  " كَمَلَ مِنَ الرِّجَالِ كَثِيرٌ وَلَمْ يَكْمُلْ مِنَ النِّسَاءِ إِلاَّ مَرْيَمُ بِنْتُ عِمْرَانَ وَآسِيَةُ امْرَأَةُ فِرْعَوْنَ وَإِنَّ فَضْلَ عَائِشَةَ عَلَى النِّسَاءِ كَفَضْلِ الثَّرِيدِ عَلَى سَائِرِ الطَّعَامِ " .
references: Vol. 4, Book of  Food, Hadith 3280

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3281

chapter.englishTitle: The superiority of tharid over other foods

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from ‘Abdullah bin ‘Abdur-Rahman that he heard Anas bin Malik say:
           “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: ‘The superiority of ‘Aishah over other women is like the superiority of Tharid over all other foods.’”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from ‘Abdullah bin ‘Abdur-Rahman that he heard Anas bin Malik say:
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: ‘The superiority of ‘Aishah over other women is like the superiority of Tharid over all other foods.’”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَنْبَأَنَا مُسْلِمُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ، يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " فَضْلُ عَائِشَةَ عَلَى النِّسَاءِ كَفَضْلِ الثَّرِيدِ عَلَى سَائِرِ الطَّعَامِ " .
references: Vol. 4, Book of  Food, Hadith 3281

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3282

chapter.englishTitle: Wiping the hands after eating

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Jabir bin ‘Abdullah said:
           “During the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ we often did not find anything to eat, and if we did, we did not have handkerchiefs, except our hands, arms and feet. Then we would pray without performing ablution.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Jabir bin ‘Abdullah said:
hadiths.body: “During the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ we often did not find anything to eat, and if we did, we did not have handkerchiefs, except our hands, arms and feet. Then we would pray without performing ablution.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ الْمِصْرِيُّ أَبُو الْحَارِثِ الْمُرَادِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي يَحْيَى، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ كُنَّا زَمَانَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَقَلِيلٌ مَا نَجِدُ الطَّعَامَ فَإِذَا نَحْنُ وَجَدْنَاهُ لَمْ يَكُنْ لَنَا مَنَادِيلُ إِلاَّ أَكُفَّنَا وَسَوَاعِدَنَا وَأَقْدَامَنَا ثُمَّ نُصَلِّي وَلاَ نَتَوَضَّأْ . قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ غَرِيبٌ لَيْسَ إِلاَّ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سَلَمَةَ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of  Food, Hadith 3282

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3283

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا يُقَالُ إِذَا فَرَغَ مِنَ الطَّعَامِ
chapter.englishTitle: What is to be said when one has finished eating

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Abu Sa’eed said:
           “Whenever the Prophet ﷺ ate, he would say: Al-hamdu lillahil-ladhi at’amana wa saqana wa ja’alana Muslimin (Praise is to Allah Who has fed us, given us to drink, and made us Muslims).”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Abu Sa’eed said:
hadiths.body: “Whenever the Prophet ﷺ ate, he would say: Al-hamdu lillahil-ladhi at’amana wa saqana wa ja’alana Muslimin (Praise is to Allah Who has fed us, given us to drink, and made us Muslims).”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو خَالِدٍ الأَحْمَرُ، عَنْ حَجَّاجٍ، عَنْ رِيَاحِ بْنِ عَبِيدَةَ، عَنْ مَوْلًى، لأَبِي سَعِيدٍ عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، قَالَ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ إِذَا أَكَلَ طَعَامًا قَالَ  " الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنَا وَسَقَانَا وَجَعَلَنَا مُسْلِمِينَ " .
references: Vol. 4, Book of  Food, Hadith 3283

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3284

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا يُقَالُ إِذَا فَرَغَ مِنَ الطَّعَامِ
chapter.englishTitle: What is to be said when one has finished eating

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Umamah Al-Bahili that when his food, or whatever was in front of him was cleared away, the Prophet ﷺ used to say:
            “Al-hamdu lillahi hamdan kathiran tayyiban mubarakan ghaira makfiyyin wa la muwadda’in wa la mustaghnan ‘anhu, Rabbana (Praise is to Allah, abundant good and blessed praise, a never-ending praise, a praise that we will never bid farewell to and an indispensible praise, He is our Lord).”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Umamah Al-Bahili that when his food, or whatever was in front of him was cleared away, the Prophet ﷺ used to say:
hadiths.body: “Al-hamdu lillahi hamdan kathiran tayyiban mubarakan ghaira makfiyyin wa la muwadda’in wa la mustaghnan ‘anhu, Rabbana (Praise is to Allah, abundant good and blessed praise, a never-ending praise, a praise that we will never bid farewell to and an indispensible praise, He is our Lord).”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ثَوْرُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ، عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ مَعْدَانَ، عَنْ أَبِي أُمَامَةَ الْبَاهِلِيِّ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَقُولُ إِذَا رُفِعَ طَعَامُهُ أَوْ مَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ قَالَ  " الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ حَمْدًا كَثِيرًا طَيِّبًا مُبَارَكًا غَيْرَ مَكْفِيٍّ وَلاَ مُوَدَّعٍ وَلاَ مُسْتَغْنًى عَنْهُ رَبَّنَا " .
references: Vol. 4, Book of  Food, Hadith 3284

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3285

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا يُقَالُ إِذَا فَرَغَ مِنَ الطَّعَامِ
chapter.englishTitle: What is to be said when one has finished eating

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Sahl bin Mu’adh bin Anas Al-Juhani, from his father, that the Prophet ﷺ said:
           “Whoever eats food and said: Al- hamdu lillahil-ladhi at’amani hadha wa razaqanihi min ghayri hawlin minni wa la quwwatin (Praise is to Allah Who has fed me this and provided it for me without any strength or power on my part), - his previous sins will be forgiven.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Sahl bin Mu’adh bin Anas Al-Juhani, from his father, that the Prophet ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “Whoever eats food and said: Al- hamdu lillahil-ladhi at’amani hadha wa razaqanihi min ghayri hawlin minni wa la quwwatin (Praise is to Allah Who has fed me this and provided it for me without any strength or power on my part), - his previous sins will be forgiven.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ أَبِي مَرْحُومٍ عَبْدِ الرَّحِيمِ، عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ مُعَاذِ بْنِ أَنَسٍ الْجُهَنِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ  " مَنْ أَكَلَ طَعَامًا فَقَالَ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنِي هَذَا وَرَزَقَنِيهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلاَ قُوَّةٍ غُفِرَ لَهُ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِنْ ذَنْبِهِ " .
references: Vol. 4, Book of  Food, Hadith 3285

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3286

chapter.englishTitle: Gathering to eat together

hadiths.englishRaw:
Wahshi bin Harb bin Wahshi bin Harb narrated from his father, from his grandfather, that they said:
           “O Messenger of Allah, we eat and do not feel full.” He said: “Perhaps you eat separately?” They said: “Yes.” He said: “Gather to eat together, and mention the Name of Allah over it, then it will be blessed for you.”
hadiths.narrator: Wahshi bin Harb bin Wahshi bin Harb narrated from his father, from his grandfather, that they said:
hadiths.body: “O Messenger of Allah, we eat and do not feel full.” He said: “Perhaps you eat separately?” They said: “Yes.” He said: “Gather to eat together, and mention the Name of Allah over it, then it will be blessed for you.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، وَدَاوُدُ بْنُ رُشَيْدٍ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الصَّبَّاحِ، قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وَحْشِيُّ بْنُ حَرْبِ بْنِ وَحْشِيِّ بْنِ حَرْبٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ، وَحْشِيٍّ، أَنَّهُمْ قَالُوا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّا نَأْكُلُ وَلاَ نَشْبَعُ . قَالَ " فَلَعَلَّكُمْ تَأْكُلُونَ مُتَفَرِّقِينَ " . قَالُوا نَعَمْ . قَالَ " فَاجْتَمِعُوا عَلَى طَعَامِكُمْ وَاذْكُرُوا اسْمَ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ يُبَارَكْ لَكُمْ فِيهِ " .
references: Vol. 4, Book of  Food, Hadith 3286

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3287

chapter.englishTitle: Gathering to eat together

hadiths.englishRaw:
Salim bin ‘Abdullah bin ‘Umar said:
           “I heard my father say: ‘I heard ‘Umar bin Khattab say: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: ‘Eat together and do not eat separately, for the blessing is in being together.’”
hadiths.narrator: Salim bin ‘Abdullah bin ‘Umar said:
hadiths.body: “I heard my father say: ‘I heard ‘Umar bin Khattab say: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: ‘Eat together and do not eat separately, for the blessing is in being together.’”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ الْخَلاَّلُ، حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ مُوسَى، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ دِينَارٍ، قَهْرَمَانُ آلِ الزُّبَيْرِ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ سَالِمَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبِي يَقُولُ، سَمِعْتُ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ، يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " كُلُوا جَمِيعًا وَلاَ تَفَرَّقُوا فَإِنَّ الْبَرَكَةَ مَعَ الْجَمَاعَةِ " .
references: Vol. 4, Book of  Food, Hadith 3287

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3288

chapter.englishTitle: Blowing on food

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Ibn ‘Abbas said:
           “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ never blew onto his food or drink, and he did not breathe into the vessel.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Ibn ‘Abbas said:
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ never blew onto his food or drink, and he did not breathe into the vessel.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحِيمِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْمُحَارِبِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْكَرِيمِ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ لَمْ يَكُنْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَنْفُخُ فِي طَعَامٍ وَلاَ شَرَابٍ وَلاَ يَتَنَفَّسُ فِي الإِنَاءِ " .
references: Vol. 4, Book of  Food, Hadith 3288

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3289

chapter.arabicTitle: باب إِذَا أَتَى أَحَدَكُمْ خَادِمُهُ بِطَعَامِهِ فَلْيُنَاوِلْهُ مِنْهُ
chapter.englishTitle: When one’s servant brings his food or drink, let him give him some of it

hadiths.englishRaw:
Isma’il bin Abu Khalid narrated from his father:
           “I heard Abu Hurairah say: ‘The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “When the servant of anyone of you brings him his food, let him make him sit by his side and eat with him, and if he refuses then let him give him some.”
hadiths.narrator: Isma’il bin Abu Khalid narrated from his father:
hadiths.body: “I heard Abu Hurairah say: ‘The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “When the servant of anyone of you brings him his food, let him make him sit by his side and eat with him, and if he refuses then let him give him some.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ أَبِي خَالِدٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، سَمِعْتُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " إِذَا جَاءَ أَحَدَكُمْ خَادِمُهُ بِطَعَامِهِ فَلْيُجْلِسْهُ فَلْيَأْكُلْ مَعَهُ فَإِنْ أَبَى فَلْيُنَاوِلْهُ مِنْهُ " .
references: Vol. 4, Book of  Food, Hadith 3289

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3290

chapter.arabicTitle: باب إِذَا أَتَى أَحَدَكُمْ خَادِمُهُ بِطَعَامِهِ فَلْيُنَاوِلْهُ مِنْهُ
chapter.englishTitle: When one’s servant brings his food or drink, let him give him some of it

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            “When the slave of anyone of you brings his food to him, for which he (the slave) has worked hard and endured heat, let him invite him to eat with him, and if he does not do that then let him take a morsel and put it in his hand.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “When the slave of anyone of you brings his food to him, for which he (the slave) has worked hard and endured heat, let him invite him to eat with him, and if he does not do that then let him take a morsel and put it in his hand.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عِيسَى بْنُ حَمَّادٍ الْمِصْرِيُّ، أَنْبَأَنَا اللَّيْثُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ رَبِيعَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " إِذَا أَحَدُكُمْ قَرَّبَ إِلَيْهِ مَمْلُوكُهُ طَعَامًا قَدْ كَفَاهُ عَنَاءَهُ وَحَرَّهُ فَلْيَدْعُهُ فَلْيَأْكُلْ مَعَهُ فَإِنْ لَمْ يَفْعَلْ فَلْيَأْخُذْ لُقْمَةً فَلْيَجْعَلْهَا فِي يَدِهِ " .
references: Vol. 4, Book of  Food, Hadith 3290

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3291

chapter.arabicTitle: باب إِذَا أَتَى أَحَدَكُمْ خَادِمُهُ بِطَعَامِهِ فَلْيُنَاوِلْهُ مِنْهُ
chapter.englishTitle: When one’s servant brings his food or drink, let him give him some of it

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from ‘Abdullah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            “When the servant of anyone of you brings his food, let him make him sit down with him or give him some of it, for he is the one who put up with its heat and smoke.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from ‘Abdullah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “When the servant of anyone of you brings his food, let him make him sit down with him or give him some of it, for he is the one who put up with its heat and smoke.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ الْمُنْذِرِ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ فُضَيْلٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ الْهَجَرِيُّ، عَنْ أَبِي الأَحْوَصِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " إِذَا جَاءَ خَادِمُ أَحَدِكُمْ بِطَعَامِهِ فَلْيُقْعِدْهُ مَعَهُ أَوْ لِيُنَاوِلْهُ مِنْهُ فَإِنَّهُ هُوَ الَّذِي وَلِيَ حَرَّهُ وَدُخَانَهُ " .
references: Vol. 4, Book of  Food, Hadith 3291

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3292

chapter.englishTitle: Eating at a dining sheet or an eating cloth

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Qatadah, that Anas bin Malik said:
           “The Prophet ﷺ never ate from a dish or from an individual plate.” He said: “From where did he eat?” He said: “From the dining sheet.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Qatadah, that Anas bin Malik said:
hadiths.body: “The Prophet ﷺ never ate from a dish or from an individual plate.” He said: “From where did he eat?” He said: “From the dining sheet.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذُ بْنُ هِشَامٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، عَنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ أَبِي الْفُرَاتِ الإِسْكَافِ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ مَا أَكَلَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ عَلَى خِوَانٍ وَلاَ فِي سُكُرُّجَةٍ . قَالَ فَعَلاَمَ كَانُوا يَأْكُلُونَ قَالَ عَلَى السُّفَرِ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of  Food, Hadith 3292

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3293

chapter.englishTitle: Eating at a dining sheet or an eating cloth

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Anas said:
           “I never saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ eat from a dish until he died.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Anas said:
hadiths.body: “I never saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ eat from a dish until he died.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ الْجُبَيْرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَحْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي عَرُوبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ مَا رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَكَلَ عَلَى خِوَانٍ حَتَّى مَاتَ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of  Food, Hadith 3293

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3294

chapter.arabicTitle: باب النَّهْىِ أَنْ يُقَامَ عَنِ الطَّعَامِ، حَتَّى يُرْفَعَ وَأَنْ يَكُفَّ يَدَهُ حَتَّى يَفْرُغَ الْقَوْمُ
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of standing up until the food has been cleared away, and that one take his hand away until the people have finished eating

hadiths.englishRaw: It was narrated from ‘Aishah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade standing up before the food had been cleared away.
hadiths.body: It was narrated from ‘Aishah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade standing up before the food had been cleared away.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ بَشِيرِ بْنِ ذَكْوَانَ الدِّمَشْقِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ، عَنْ مُنِيرِ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ مَكْحُولٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ نَهَى أَنْ يُقَامَ عَنِ الطَّعَامِ حَتَّى يُرْفَعَ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of  Food, Hadith 3294

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3295

chapter.arabicTitle: باب النَّهْىِ أَنْ يُقَامَ عَنِ الطَّعَامِ، حَتَّى يُرْفَعَ وَأَنْ يَكُفَّ يَدَهُ حَتَّى يَفْرُغَ الْقَوْمُ
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of standing up until the food has been cleared away, and that one take his hand away until the people have finished eating

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Ibn ‘Umar that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            “When a meal is served, a man should not stand up until it is removed, and he should not take his hand away, even if he is full, until the people have finished. And let him continue eating.* For a man may make his companion shy, causing him to withhold his hand, and perhaps he has a need for the food.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Ibn ‘Umar that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “When a meal is served, a man should not stand up until it is removed, and he should not take his hand away, even if he is full, until the people have finished. And let him continue eating.* For a man may make his companion shy, causing him to withhold his hand, and perhaps he has a need for the food.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ خَلَفٍ الْعَسْقَلاَنِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، أَنْبَأَنَا عَبْدُ الأَعْلَى، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " إِذَا وُضِعَتِ الْمَائِدَةُ فَلاَ يَقُومُ رَجُلٌ حَتَّى تُرْفَعَ الْمَائِدَةُ وَلاَ يَرْفَعُ يَدَهُ وَإِنْ شَبِعَ حَتَّى يَفْرُغَ الْقَوْمُ وَلْيُعْذِرْ فَإِنَّ الرَّجُلَ يُخْجِلُ جَلِيسَهُ فَيَقْبِضُ يَدَهُ وَعَسَى أَنْ يَكُونَ لَهُ فِي الطَّعَامِ حَاجَةٌ " .
references: Vol. 4, Book of  Food, Hadith 3295

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3296

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَنْ بَاتَ وَفِي يَدِهِ رِيحُ غَمَرٍ
chapter.englishTitle: One who goes to bed with smell emanating from his hand

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Husain bin ‘Ali that his mother, Fatimah the daughter of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, said:
           “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: ‘A man has no one to blame but himself, if he goes to bed with a smell emanating from his hand.’”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Husain bin ‘Ali that his mother, Fatimah the daughter of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, said:
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: ‘A man has no one to blame but himself, if he goes to bed with a smell emanating from his hand.’”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا جُبَارَةُ بْنُ الْمُغَلِّسِ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ بْنُ وَسِيمٍ الْجَمَّالُ، حَدَّثَنِي الْحَسَنُ بْنُ الْحَسَنِ، عَنْ أُمِّهِ، فَاطِمَةَ بِنْتِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنِ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ، عَنْ أُمِّهِ، فَاطِمَةَ ابْنَةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَتْ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " أَلاَ لاَ يَلُومَنَّ امْرُؤٌ إِلاَّ نَفْسَهُ يَبِيتُ وَفِي يَدِهِ رِيحُ غَمَرٍ " .
references: Vol. 4, Book of  Food, Hadith 3296

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3297

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَنْ بَاتَ وَفِي يَدِهِ رِيحُ غَمَرٍ
chapter.englishTitle: One who goes to bed with smell emanating from his hand

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Prophet ﷺ said:
           “If anyone of you goes to bed with a smell emanating from his hand, and he does not wash his hand, and something happens to him, he should not blame anyone but himself.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Prophet ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “If anyone of you goes to bed with a smell emanating from his hand, and he does not wash his hand, and something happens to him, he should not blame anyone but himself.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ أَبِي الشَّوَارِبِ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ الْمُخْتَارِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُهَيْلُ بْنُ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ  " إِذَا نَامَ أَحَدُكُمْ وَفِي يَدِهِ رِيحُ غَمَرٍ فَلَمْ يَغْسِلْ يَدَهُ فَأَصَابَهُ شَىْءٌ فَلاَ يَلُومَنَّ إِلاَّ نَفْسَهُ " .
references: Vol. 4, Book of  Food, Hadith 3297

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3298

chapter.englishTitle: When food is served

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Asma’ bint Yazid said:
           “Some food was brought to the Prophet ﷺ and it was offered to us. We said: ‘We do not have any appetite for it.’ He said: ‘Do not combine hunger and lies.’”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Asma’ bint Yazid said:
hadiths.body: “Some food was brought to the Prophet ﷺ and it was offered to us. We said: ‘We do not have any appetite for it.’ He said: ‘Do not combine hunger and lies.’”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَعَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّ ثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي حُسَيْنٍ، عَنْ شَهْرِ بْنِ حَوْشَبٍ، عَنْ أَسْمَاءَ بِنْتِ يَزِيدَ، قَالَتْ أُتِيَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ بِطَعَامٍ فَعُرِضَ عَلَيْنَا فَقُلْنَا لاَ نَشْتَهِيهِ . فَقَالَ  " لاَ تَجْمَعْنَ جُوعًا وَكَذِبًا " .
references: Vol. 4, Book of  Food, Hadith 3298

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3299

chapter.englishTitle: When food is served

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Anas bin Malik – a man from the tribe of Banu ‘Abdul-Ashhal – said:
           * “I came to the Prophet ﷺ when he was eating breakfast and he said: ‘Come and eat.’ I said: ‘I am fasting. Alas! Would that I had eaten of the food of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ.’”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Anas bin Malik – a man from the tribe of Banu ‘Abdul-Ashhal – said:
hadiths.body: * “I came to the Prophet ﷺ when he was eating breakfast and he said: ‘Come and eat.’ I said: ‘I am fasting. Alas! Would that I had eaten of the food of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ.’”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَعَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ أَبِي هِلاَلٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ سَوَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، - رَجُلٌ مِنْ بَنِي عَبْدِ الأَشْهَلِ - قَالَ أَتَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ وَهُوَ يَتَغَدَّى فَقَالَ  " ادْنُ فَكُلْ " . فَقُلْتُ إِنِّي صَائِمٌ فَيَا لَهْفَ نَفْسِي هَلاَّ كُنْتُ طَعِمْتُ مِنْ طَعَامِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of  Food, Hadith 3299

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3300

chapter.englishTitle: Eating in the mosque

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that ‘Abdullah bin Harith bin Jaz’ Az-Zubaidi said:
            “At the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ we used to eat bread and meat in the mosque.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that ‘Abdullah bin Harith bin Jaz’ Az-Zubaidi said:
hadiths.body: “At the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ we used to eat bread and meat in the mosque.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ كَاسِبٍ، وَحَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ الْحَارِثِ، حَدَّثَنِي سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ زِيَادٍ الْحَضْرَمِيُّ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ الْحَارِثِ بْنِ جَزْءٍ الزُّبَيْدِيَّ، يَقُولُ كُنَّا نَأْكُلُ عَلَى عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ الْخُبْزَ وَاللَّحْمَ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of  Food, Hadith 3300

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3301

chapter.englishTitle: Eating while standing up

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Ibn ‘Umar said:
           “At the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ we used to eat while walking, and drink while standing up.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Ibn ‘Umar said:
hadiths.body: “At the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ we used to eat while walking, and drink while standing up.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو السَّائِبِ، سَلْمُ بْنُ جُنَادَةَ حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصُ بْنُ غِيَاثٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ كُنَّا عَلَى عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ نَأْكُلُ وَنَحْنُ نَمْشِي وَنَشْرَبُ وَنَحْنُ قِيَامٌ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of  Food, Hadith 3301

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3302

chapter.englishTitle: Gourd, pumpkin

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Anas said:
           “The Prophet ﷺ like gourd.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Anas said:
hadiths.body: “The Prophet ﷺ like gourd.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مَنِيعٍ، أَنْبَأَنَا عَبِيدَةُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، عَنْ حُمَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ يُحِبُّ الْقَرْعَ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of  Food, Hadith 3302

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3303

chapter.englishTitle: Gourd, pumpkin

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Anas said:
           “Umm Sulaim sent with me a basket of fresh dates for the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, but I did not find him, as he had just gone out to a freed slave of his who had invited him and made food for him. I came to him and he was eating, and he called me to eat with him. He (the freed slave) had served him Tharid with meat and gourd, and he liked the gourd, so I started to collect the (pieces of) gourd and put them near him. When he had eaten he went back to him house and I put the basket (of dates) before him, and he started to eat them and share them, until he finished the last of them.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Anas said:
hadiths.body: “Umm Sulaim sent with me a basket of fresh dates for the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, but I did not find him, as he had just gone out to a freed slave of his who had invited him and made food for him. I came to him and he was eating, and he called me to eat with him. He (the freed slave) had served him Tharid with meat and gourd, and he liked the gourd, so I started to collect the (pieces of) gourd and put them near him. When he had eaten he went back to him house and I put the basket (of dates) before him, and he started to eat them and share them, until he finished the last of them.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عَدِيٍّ، عَنْ حُمَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ بَعَثَتْ مَعِي أُمُّ سُلَيْمٍ بِمِكْتَلٍ فِيهِ رُطَبٌ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَلَمْ أَجِدْهُ وَخَرَجَ قَرِيبًا إِلَى مَوْلًى لَهُ دَعَاهُ فَصَنَعَ لَهُ طَعَامًا فَأَتَيْتُهُ وَهُوَ يَأْكُلُ . قَالَ فَدَعَانِي لآكُلَ مَعَهُ . قَالَ وَصَنَعَ ثَرِيدَةً بِلَحْمٍ وَقَرْعٍ . قَالَ فَإِذَا هُوَ يُعْجِبُهُ الْقَرْعُ . قَالَ فَجَعَلْتُ أَجْمَعُهُ فَأُدْنِيهِ مِنْهُ فَلَمَّا طَعِمْنَا مِنْهُ رَجَعَ إِلَى مَنْزِلِهِ وَوَضَعْتُ الْمِكْتَلَ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ فَجَعَلَ يَأْكُلُ وَيَقْسِمُ حَتَّى فَرَغَ مِنْ آخِرِهِ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of  Food, Hadith 3303

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3304

chapter.englishTitle: Gourd, pumpkin

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Hakin bin Jabr that his father said:
           “I entered upon the Prophet ﷺ in his house, and he had some of this gourd. I said: ‘What is this?’ He said: ‘This is Qar’; it is Dubba’. We augment our food with it.”*
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Hakin bin Jabr that his father said:
hadiths.body: “I entered upon the Prophet ﷺ in his house, and he had some of this gourd. I said: ‘What is this?’ He said: ‘This is Qar’; it is Dubba’. We augment our food with it.”*
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ أَبِي خَالِدٍ، عَنْ حَكِيمِ بْنِ جَابِرٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ دَخَلْتُ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ ﷺ فِي بَيْتِهِ وَعِنْدَهُ هَذِهِ الدُّبَّاءُ فَقُلْتُ أَىُّ شَىْءٍ هَذَا قَالَ  " هَذَا الْقَرْعُ هُوَ الدُّبَّاءُ نُكَثِّرُ بِهِ طَعَامَنَا " .
references: Vol. 4, Book of  Food, Hadith 3304

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3305

chapter.englishTitle: Meat

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Darda’ that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            “The best food of the people of this world and the people of Paradise is meat.’”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Darda’ that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “The best food of the people of this world and the people of Paradise is meat.’”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا الْعَبَّاسُ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ الْخَلاَّلُ الدِّمَشْقِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ صَالِحٍ، حَدَّثَنِي سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ عَطَاءٍ الْجَزَرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنِي مَسْلَمَةُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْجُهَنِيُّ، عَنْ عَمِّهِ أَبِي مَشْجَعَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي الدَّرْدَاءِ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " سَيِّدُ طَعَامِ أَهْلِ الدُّنْيَا وَأَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ اللَّحْمُ " .
references: Vol. 4, Book of  Food, Hadith 3305

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3306

chapter.englishTitle: Meat

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Abu Darda’ said:
           “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ was never invited to eat meat but he would respond, and he was never offered meat as a gift but he would accept it.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Abu Darda’ said:
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ was never invited to eat meat but he would respond, and he was never offered meat as a gift but he would accept it.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا الْعَبَّاسُ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ الدِّمَشْقِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ صَالِحٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ عَطَاءٍ الْجَزَرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا مَسْلَمَةُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْجُهَنِيُّ، عَنْ عَمِّهِ أَبِي مَشْجَعَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي الدَّرْدَاءِ، قَالَ مَا دُعِيَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ إِلَى لَحْمٍ قَطُّ إِلاَّ أَجَابَ وَلاَ أُهْدِيَ لَهُ لَحْمٌ قَطُّ إِلاَّ قَبِلَهُ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of  Food, Hadith 3306

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3307

chapter.englishTitle: The best meat

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Abu Hurairah said:
           “One day some meat was brought to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and the foreleg was offered to him which he liked, so he bit it with his front teeth.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Abu Hurairah said:
hadiths.body: “One day some meat was brought to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and the foreleg was offered to him which he liked, so he bit it with his front teeth.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بِشْرٍ الْعَبْدِيُّ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ فُضَيْلٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَيَّانَ التَّيْمِيُّ، عَنْ أَبِي زُرْعَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ أُتِيَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ ذَاتَ يَوْمٍ بِلَحْمٍ فَرُفِعَ إِلَيْهِ الذِّرَاعُ وَكَانَتْ تُعْجِبُهُ فَنَهَسَ مِنْهَا .
references: Vol. 4, Book of  Food, Hadith 3307

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3308

chapter.englishTitle: The best meat

hadiths.englishRaw:
‘Abdullah bin Ja’far told Ibn Zubair, who had slaughtered a camel for them, that he heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and he (‘Abdullah) said:
           “Some people were bringing meat to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and he said: ‘The best meat is the meat of the back.’”
hadiths.narrator: ‘Abdullah bin Ja’far told Ibn Zubair, who had slaughtered a camel for them, that he heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and he (‘Abdullah) said:
hadiths.body: “Some people were bringing meat to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and he said: ‘The best meat is the meat of the back.’”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا بَكْرُ بْنُ خَلَفٍ أَبُو بِشْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنِ مِسْعَرٍ، حَدَّثَنِي شَيْخٌ، مِنْ فَهْمٍ - قَالَ وَأَظُنُّهُ يُسَمَّى مُحَمَّدَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ - أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ جَعْفَرٍ يُحَدِّثُ ابْنَ الزُّبَيْرِ وَقَدْ نَحَرَ لَهُمْ جَزُورًا أَوْ بَعِيرًا أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ - قَالَ وَالْقَوْمُ يُلْقُونَ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ اللَّحْمَ - يَقُولُ  " أَطْيَبُ اللَّحْمِ لَحْمُ الظَّهْرِ " .
references: Vol. 4, Book of  Food, Hadith 3308

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3309

chapter.englishTitle: Roasted meat

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Anas bin Malik said:
           “I do not know of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ever seeing a roasted sheep* until he met Allah.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Anas bin Malik said:
hadiths.body: “I do not know of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ever seeing a roasted sheep* until he met Allah.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ، حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ مَا أَعْلَمُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ رَأَى شَاةً سَمِيطًا حَتَّى لَحِقَ بِاللَّهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of  Food, Hadith 3309

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3310

chapter.englishTitle: Roasted meat

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Anas bin Malik said:
           “No leftovers of roast meat* were ever cleared from in front of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and no carpet was ever carried with him.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Anas bin Malik said:
hadiths.body: “No leftovers of roast meat* were ever cleared from in front of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and no carpet was ever carried with him.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا جُبَارَةُ بْنُ الْمُغَلِّسِ، حَدَّثَنَا كَثِيرُ بْنُ سُلَيْمٍ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ مَا رُفِعَ مِنْ بَيْنِ يَدَىْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَضْلُ شِوَاءٍ قَطُّ وَلاَ حُمِلَتْ مَعَهُ طِنْفِسَةٌ ﷺ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of  Food, Hadith 3310

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3311

chapter.englishTitle: Roasted meat

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that ‘Abdullah bin Harith bin Jaz’ Az-Zubaidi said:
            “We ate food with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ in the mosque, meat that had been roasted. Then we wiped our hands on the pebbles and got up to perform prayer without performing ablution.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that ‘Abdullah bin Harith bin Jaz’ Az-Zubaidi said:
hadiths.body: “We ate food with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ in the mosque, meat that had been roasted. Then we wiped our hands on the pebbles and got up to perform prayer without performing ablution.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ بُكَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ لَهِيعَةَ، أَخْبَرَنِي سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ زِيَادٍ الْحَضْرَمِيُّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ بْنِ الْجَزْءِ الزُّبَيْدِيِّ، قَالَ أَكَلْنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ طَعَامًا فِي الْمَسْجِدِ لَحْمًا قَدْ شُوِيَ فَمَسَحْنَا أَيْدِيَنَا بِالْحَصْبَاءِ ثُمَّ قُمْنَا فَصَلَّى وَلَمْ يَتَوَضَّأْ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of  Food, Hadith 3311

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3312

chapter.englishTitle: Dried meat

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Ibn Mas’ud said:
           “A man came to the Prophet ﷺ, so he spoke to him, and he started to tremble with awe. He said to him: ‘Take it easy. I am not a king; I am just a man whose mother ate dried meat.’”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Ibn Mas’ud said:
hadiths.body: “A man came to the Prophet ﷺ, so he spoke to him, and he started to tremble with awe. He said to him: ‘Take it easy. I am not a king; I am just a man whose mother ate dried meat.’”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ أَسَدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ عَوْنٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ أَبِي خَالِدٍ، عَنْ قَيْسِ بْنِ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِي مَسْعُودٍ، قَالَ أَتَى النَّبِيَّ ﷺ رَجُلٌ فَكَلَّمَهُ فَجَعَلَ تُرْعَدُ فَرَائِصُهُ فَقَالَ لَهُ  " هَوِّنْ عَلَيْكَ فَإِنِّي لَسْتُ بِمَلِكٍ إِنَّمَا أَنَا ابْنُ امْرَأَةٍ تَأْكُلُ الْقَدِيدَ " . قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ إِسْمَاعِيلُ وَحْدَهُ وَصَلَهُ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of  Food, Hadith 3312

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3313

chapter.englishTitle: Dried meat

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that ‘Aishah said:
           “We used to store trotters and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ would eat them fifteen days after the sacrifice.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that ‘Aishah said:
hadiths.body: “We used to store trotters and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ would eat them fifteen days after the sacrifice.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَابِسٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ لَقَدْ كُنَّا نَرْفَعُ الْكُرَاعَ فَيَأْكُلُهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ بَعْدَ خَمْسَ عَشْرَةَ مِنَ الأَضَاحِيِّ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of  Food, Hadith 3313

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3314

chapter.englishTitle: Liver and spleen

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from ‘Abdullah bin ‘Umar that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
           “Two kinds of dead meat and two kinds of blood have been permitted to us. The two kinds of dead meat are fish and locusts, and the two kinds of blood are the liver and spleen.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from ‘Abdullah bin ‘Umar that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “Two kinds of dead meat and two kinds of blood have been permitted to us. The two kinds of dead meat are fish and locusts, and the two kinds of blood are the liver and spleen.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُصْعَبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ  " أُحِلَّتْ لَنَا مَيْتَتَانِ وَدَمَانِ فَأَمَّا الْمَيْتَتَانِ فَالْحُوتُ وَالْجَرَادُ وَأَمَّا الدَّمَانِ فَالْكَبِدُ وَالطِّحَالُ " .
references: Vol. 4, Book of  Food, Hadith 3314

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3315

chapter.englishTitle: Salt

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Anas bin Malik that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            ‘The best of your seasonings is salt.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Anas bin Malik that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: ‘The best of your seasonings is salt.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مَرْوَانُ بْنُ مُعَاوِيَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عِيسَى بْنُ أَبِي عِيسَى، عَنْ رَجُلٍ، - أُرَاهُ مُوسَى - عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " سَيِّدُ إِدَامِكُمُ الْمِلْحُ " .
references: Vol. 4, Book of  Food, Hadith 3315

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3316

chapter.englishTitle: Using vinegar as a condiment

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from ‘Aishah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            “What a blessed condiment vinegar is.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from ‘Aishah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “What a blessed condiment vinegar is.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ أَبِي الْحَوَارِيِّ، حَدَّثَنَا مَرْوَانُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ بِلاَلٍ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " نِعْمَ الإِدَامُ الْخَلُّ " .
references: Vol. 4, Book of  Food, Hadith 3316

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3317

chapter.englishTitle: Using vinegar as a condiment

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Jabir bin ‘Abdullah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
           “What a blessed condiment vinegar is.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Jabir bin ‘Abdullah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “What a blessed condiment vinegar is.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا جُبَارَةُ بْنُ الْمُغَلِّسِ، حَدَّثَنَا قَيْسُ بْنُ الرَّبِيعِ، عَنْ مُحَارِبِ بْنِ دِثَارٍ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " نِعْمَ الإِدَامُ الْخَلُّ " .
references: Vol. 4, Book of  Food, Hadith 3317

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3318

chapter.englishTitle: Using vinegar as a condiment

hadiths.englishRaw:
Umm Sa’d said:
           “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ entered upon ‘Aishah, when I was with her, and said: ‘Is there any food?’ She said: ‘We have bread, dates and vinegar.’ The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: ‘What a blessed condiment vinegar is. O Allah, bless vinegar, for it was the condiment of the Prophets before me, and no house will ever be poor in which there is vinegar.’”
hadiths.narrator: Umm Sa’d said:
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ entered upon ‘Aishah, when I was with her, and said: ‘Is there any food?’ She said: ‘We have bread, dates and vinegar.’ The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: ‘What a blessed condiment vinegar is. O Allah, bless vinegar, for it was the condiment of the Prophets before me, and no house will ever be poor in which there is vinegar.’”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا الْعَبَّاسُ بْنُ عُثْمَانَ الدِّمَشْقِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَنْبَسَةُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ زَاذَانَ، أَنَّهُ حَدَّثَهُ قَالَ حَدَّثَتْنِي أُمُّ سَعْدٍ، قَالَتْ دَخَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَلَى عَائِشَةَ وَأَنَا عِنْدَهَا فَقَالَ " هَلْ مِنْ غَدَاءٍ " . قَالَتْ عِنْدَنَا خُبْزٌ وَتَمْرٌ وَخَلٌّ . فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ " نِعْمَ الإِدَامُ الْخَلُّ اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ فِي الْخَلِّ فَإِنَّهُ كَانَ إِدَامَ الأَنْبِيَاءِ قَبْلِي وَلَمْ يَفْتَقِرْ بَيْتٌ فِيهِ خَلٌّ " .
references: Vol. 4, Book of  Food, Hadith 3318

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3319

chapter.englishTitle: (Olive) oil

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from ‘Umar that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            ‘Season (your food) with olive oil and anoint yourselves with it, for it comes from a blessed tree.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from ‘Umar that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: ‘Season (your food) with olive oil and anoint yourselves with it, for it comes from a blessed tree.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَنْبَأَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عُمَرَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " اِئْتَدِمُوا بِالزَّيْتِ وَادَّهِنُوا بِهِ فَإِنَّهُ مِنْ شَجَرَةٍ مُبَارَكَةٍ " .
references: Vol. 4, Book of  Food, Hadith 3319

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3320

chapter.englishTitle: (Olive) oil

hadiths.englishRaw:
‘Abdullah bin Sa’eed narrated that his grandfather said:
           “I heard Abu Hurairah say: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: ‘Eat (olive) oil and anoint yourselves with it, for it is blessed.’”
hadiths.narrator: ‘Abdullah bin Sa’eed narrated that his grandfather said:
hadiths.body: “I heard Abu Hurairah say: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: ‘Eat (olive) oil and anoint yourselves with it, for it is blessed.’”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عُقْبَةُ بْنُ مُكْرَمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا صَفْوَانُ بْنُ عِيسَى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " كُلُوا الزَّيْتَ وَادَّهِنُوا بِهِ فَإِنَّهُ مُبَارَكٌ " .
references: Vol. 4, Book of  Food, Hadith 3320

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3321

chapter.englishTitle: Milk

hadiths.englishRaw:
I heard ‘Aishah say:
           “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ would say, when milk was brought to him: ‘A blessing,’ or ‘Two blessings.’”
hadiths.narrator: I heard ‘Aishah say:
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ would say, when milk was brought to him: ‘A blessing,’ or ‘Two blessings.’”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا زَيْدُ بْنُ الْحُبَابِ، عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ بُرْدٍ الرَّاسِبِيِّ، حَدَّثَتْنِي مَوْلاَتِي أُمُّ سَالِمٍ الرَّاسِبِيَّةُ، قَالَتْ سَمِعْتُ عَائِشَةَ، تَقُولُ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ إِذَا أُتِيَ بِلَبَنٍ قَالَ  " بَرَكَةٌ أَوْ بَرَكَتَانِ " .
references: Vol. 4, Book of  Food, Hadith 3321

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3322

chapter.englishTitle: Milk

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Ibn ‘Abbas that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            “Whoever is given food by Allah, let him say: Allahumma barik lana fihi wa arzuqna khairan minhu (O Allah, bless it for us and provide us with something better than it). And whoever is given milk to drink by Allah, let him say: Allahumma barik lana fihi wa zidna minhu (O Allah, bless it for us and give us more of it). For I do not know of any food or drink that suffices, apart from milk.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Ibn ‘Abbas that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “Whoever is given food by Allah, let him say: Allahumma barik lana fihi wa arzuqna khairan minhu (O Allah, bless it for us and provide us with something better than it). And whoever is given milk to drink by Allah, let him say: Allahumma barik lana fihi wa zidna minhu (O Allah, bless it for us and give us more of it). For I do not know of any food or drink that suffices, apart from milk.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ عَيَّاشٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " مَنْ أَطْعَمَهُ اللَّهُ طَعَامًا فَلْيَقُلِ اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِيهِ وَارْزُقْنَا خَيْرًا مِنْهُ . وَمَنْ سَقَاهُ اللَّهُ لَبَنًا فَلْيَقُلِ اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِيهِ وَزِدْنَا مِنْهُ فَإِنِّي لاَ أَعْلَمُ مَا يُجْزِئُ مِنَ الطَّعَامِ وَالشَّرَابِ إِلاَّ اللَّبَنُ " .
references: Vol. 4, Book of  Food, Hadith 3322

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3323

chapter.englishTitle: Sweets

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that ‘Aishah said:
           “The Messenger of Allah 9saw) used to like sweets and honey.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that ‘Aishah said:
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah 9saw) used to like sweets and honey.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَعَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، وَعَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ يُحِبُّ الْحَلْوَاءَ وَالْعَسَلَ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of  Food, Hadith 3323

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3324

chapter.englishTitle: Cucumbers and fresh dates eaten together

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that ‘Aishah said:
           “My mother was trying to fatten me up when she wanted to send me to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ (when she got married), but nothing worked until I ate cucumbers with dates; then I grew plump like the best kind of plump.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that ‘Aishah said:
hadiths.body: “My mother was trying to fatten me up when she wanted to send me to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ (when she got married), but nothing worked until I ate cucumbers with dates; then I grew plump like the best kind of plump.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ بْنُ بُكَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ كَانَتْ أُمِّي تُعَالِجُنِي لِلسُّمْنَةِ تُرِيدُ أَنْ تُدْخِلَنِي عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَمَا اسْتَقَامَ لَهَا ذَلِكَ حَتَّى أَكَلْتُ الْقِثَّاءَ بِالرُّطَبِ فَسَمِنْتُ كَأَحْسَنِ سُمْنَةٍ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of  Food, Hadith 3324

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3325

chapter.englishTitle: Cucumbers and fresh dates eaten together

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated ‘Abdullah bin Ja’far said:
           “I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ eating cucumbers with dates.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated ‘Abdullah bin Ja’far said:
hadiths.body: “I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ eating cucumbers with dates.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ كَاسِبٍ، وَإِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ مُوسَى، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ، قَالَ رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَأْكُلُ الْقِثَّاءَ بِالرُّطَبِ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of  Food, Hadith 3325

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3326

chapter.englishTitle: Cucumbers and fresh dates eaten together

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Sahl bin Sa’d said:
           “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to eat dates with melon.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Sahl bin Sa’d said:
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to eat dates with melon.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الصَّبَّاحِ، وَعَمْرُو بْنُ رَافِعٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي هِلاَلٍ الْمَدَنِيُّ، عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَأْكُلُ الرُّطَبَ بِالْبِطِّيخِ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of  Food, Hadith 3326

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3327

chapter.englishTitle: Dates

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from ‘Aishah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            “A house in which there are no dates, its people will go hungry.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from ‘Aishah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “A house in which there are no dates, its people will go hungry.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ أَبِي الْحَوَارِيِّ الدِّمَشْقِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا مَرْوَانُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ بِلاَلٍ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " بَيْتٌ لاَ تَمْرَ فِيهِ جِيَاعٌ أَهْلُهُ " .
references: Vol. 4, Book of  Food, Hadith 3327

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3328

chapter.englishTitle: Dates

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from ‘Ubaidullah bin Abu Rafi’, from his grandmother Salma, that the Prophet ﷺ said:
           “A house in which there are no dates is like a house in which there is no food.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from ‘Ubaidullah bin Abu Rafi’, from his grandmother Salma, that the Prophet ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “A house in which there are no dates is like a house in which there is no food.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الدِّمَشْقِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي فُدَيْكٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي رَافِعٍ، عَنْ جَدَّتِهِ، سَلْمَى أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ قَالَ  " بَيْتٌ لاَ تَمْرَ فِيهِ كَالْبَيْتِ لاَ طَعَامَ فِيهِ " .
references: Vol. 4, Book of  Food, Hadith 3328

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3329

chapter.englishTitle: When the first fruits are brought

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that when the first fruits (of the season) were brought, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ would say:
           “O Allah, bless us in our city and in our fruits, in our Mudd and in our Sa’,* blessing upon blessing.” Then he would give it to the smallest of the children present.
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that when the first fruits (of the season) were brought, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ would say:
hadiths.body: “O Allah, bless us in our city and in our fruits, in our Mudd and in our Sa’,* blessing upon blessing.” Then he would give it to the smallest of the children present.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الصَّبَّاحِ، وَيَعْقُوبُ بْنُ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ كَاسِبٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي سُهَيْلُ بْنُ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ كَانَ إِذَا أُتِيَ بِأَوَّلِ الثَّمَرَةِ قَالَ  " اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِي مَدِينَتِنَا وَفِي ثِمَارِنَا وَفِي مُدِّنَا وَفِي صَاعِنَا بَرَكَةً مَعَ بَرَكَةٍ " . ثُمَّ يُنَاوِلُهُ أَصْغَرَ مَنْ بِحَضْرَتِهِ مِنَ الْوِلْدَانِ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of  Food, Hadith 3329

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3330

chapter.englishTitle: Eating unripe dates with ripe dates

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from ‘Aishah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            “Eat unripe dates with ripe one and eat old dates with new ones, for Satan gets angry and says: ‘The son of Adam will survive so long as he eats old dates with new ones.’”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from ‘Aishah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “Eat unripe dates with ripe one and eat old dates with new ones, for Satan gets angry and says: ‘The son of Adam will survive so long as he eats old dates with new ones.’”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بِشْرٍ، بَكْرُ بْنُ خَلَفٍ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ الْمَدَنِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " كُلُوا الْبَلَحَ بِالتَّمْرِ كُلُوا الْخَلَقَ بِالْجَدِيدِ فَإِنَّ الشَّيْطَانَ يَغْضَبُ وَيَقُولُ بَقِيَ ابْنُ آدَمَ حَتَّى أَكَلَ الْخَلَقَ بِالْجَدِيدِ " .
references: Vol. 4, Book of  Food, Hadith 3330

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3331

chapter.englishTitle: The prohibition of eating two dates at once

hadiths.englishRaw:
Ibn ‘Umar said:
           “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade eating two dates at once unless he asks his companions permission to do so.”
hadiths.narrator: Ibn ‘Umar said:
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade eating two dates at once unless he asks his companions permission to do so.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ جَبَلَةَ بْنِ سُحَيْمٍ، سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ عُمَرَ، يَقُولُ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَنْ يَقْرِنَ الرَّجُلُ بَيْنَ التَّمْرَتَيْنِ حَتَّى يَسْتَأْذِنَ أَصْحَابَهُ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of  Food, Hadith 3331

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3332

chapter.englishTitle: The prohibition of eating two dates at once

hadiths.englishRaw: It was narrated from Sa’d, the freed slave of Abu Bakr – and Sa’d used to serve the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and he liked this Hadith – that the Prophet ﷺ forbade eating two dates at once.
hadiths.body: It was narrated from Sa’d, the freed slave of Abu Bakr – and Sa’d used to serve the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and he liked this Hadith – that the Prophet ﷺ forbade eating two dates at once.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَامِرٍ الْخَزَّازُ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، عَنْ سَعْدٍ، مَوْلَى أَبِي بَكْرٍ - وَكَانَ سَعْدٌ يَخْدُمُ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ وَكَانَ يُعْجِبُهُ حَدِيثُهُ - أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ نَهَى عَنِ الإِقْرَانِ . يَعْنِي فِي التَّمْرِ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of  Food, Hadith 3332

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3333

chapter.englishTitle: Inspecting dates

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Anas bin Malik said:
           “I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ when he was brought some old dates; he started to inspect them.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Anas bin Malik said:
hadiths.body: “I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ when he was brought some old dates; he started to inspect them.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بِشْرٍ، بَكْرُ بْنُ خَلَفٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو قُتَيْبَةَ، عَنْ هَمَّامٍ، عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ أُتِيَ بِتَمْرٍ عَتِيقٍ فَجَعَلَ يُفَتِّشُهُ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of  Food, Hadith 3333

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3334

chapter.englishTitle: Dates with butter

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that the two sons of Busr, who were of the tribe of Sulaim, said:
           “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ entered upon us. We placed a velvet cloth of ours beneath him and sprinkled water on it.* He sat on it, and Allah sent down Revelation to him in our house. We offered him butter and dates, and he ﷺ liked butter.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that the two sons of Busr, who were of the tribe of Sulaim, said:
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ entered upon us. We placed a velvet cloth of ours beneath him and sprinkled water on it.* He sat on it, and Allah sent down Revelation to him in our house. We offered him butter and dates, and he ﷺ liked butter.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا صَدَقَةُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ، حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ جَابِرٍ، حَدَّثَنِي سُلَيْمُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ، عَنِ ابْنَىْ، بُسْرٍ السُّلَمِيَّيْنِ قَالاَ دَخَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَوَضَعْنَا تَحْتَهُ قَطِيفَةً لَنَا صَبَبْنَاهَا لَهُ صَبًّا فَجَلَسَ عَلَيْهَا فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ عَلَيْهِ الْوَحْىَ فِي بَيْتِنَا وَقَدَّمْنَا لَهُ زُبْدًا وَتَمْرًا وَكَانَ يُحِبُّ الزُّبْدَ ﷺ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of  Food, Hadith 3334

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3335

chapter.englishTitle: White bread

hadiths.englishRaw:
‘Abdul-‘Aziz bin Abu Hazim said:
           My father told me: I asked Sahl bin Sa’d: “Did you ever see dough made from well-sifted flour?” He said: “I never saw dough made from well-sifted flour until the Messenger of Allah ﷺ passed away.” I said: “Did they have sieves at the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ?” He said: “I never saw a sieve until the Messenger of Allah ﷺ passed away.” I said: “How did you eat barley that was not sifted?” He said: “We used to blow on it, and whatever flew away, flew away, and whatever was left we made dough with it.”
hadiths.narrator: ‘Abdul-‘Aziz bin Abu Hazim said:
hadiths.body: My father told me: I asked Sahl bin Sa’d: “Did you ever see dough made from well-sifted flour?” He said: “I never saw dough made from well-sifted flour until the Messenger of Allah ﷺ passed away.” I said: “Did they have sieves at the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ?” He said: “I never saw a sieve until the Messenger of Allah ﷺ passed away.” I said: “How did you eat barley that was not sifted?” He said: “We used to blow on it, and whatever flew away, flew away, and whatever was left we made dough with it.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الصَّبَّاحِ، وَسُوَيْدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي قَالَ، سَأَلْتُ سَهْلَ بْنَ سَعْدٍ هَلْ رَأَيْتَ النَّقِيَّ قَالَ مَا رَأَيْتُ النَّقِيَّ حَتَّى قُبِضَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ . فَقُلْتُ فَهَلْ كَانَ لَهُمْ مَنَاخِلُ عَلَى عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ مَا رَأَيْتُ مُنْخُلاً حَتَّى قُبِضَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ . قُلْتُ فَكَيْفَ كُنْتُمْ تَأْكُلُونَ الشَّعِيرَ غَيْرَ مَنْخُولٍ قَالَ نَعَمْ نَنْفُخُهُ فَيَطِيرُ مِنْهُ مَا طَارَ وَمَا بَقِيَ ثَرَّيْنَاهُ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of  Food, Hadith 3335

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3336

chapter.englishTitle: White bread

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Umm Ayman that she sifted some flour and made a loaf of bread for the Prophet ﷺ. He said:
           “What is this?” She said: “It is food that we make in our land, and I wanted to make a loaf of it for you. He said: “Fold it onto itself and knead it.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Umm Ayman that she sifted some flour and made a loaf of bread for the Prophet ﷺ. He said:
hadiths.body: “What is this?” She said: “It is food that we make in our land, and I wanted to make a loaf of it for you. He said: “Fold it onto itself and knead it.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ كَاسِبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ الْحَارِثِ، أَخْبَرَنِي بَكْرُ بْنُ سَوَادَةَ، أَنَّ حَنَشَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَهُ عَنْ أُمِّ أَيْمَنَ، أَنَّهَا غَرْبَلَتْ دَقِيقًا فَصَنَعَتْهُ لِلنَّبِيِّ ﷺ رَغِيفًا فَقَالَ " مَا هَذَا " . قَالَتْ طَعَامٌ نَصْنَعُهُ بِأَرْضِنَا فَأَحْبَبْتُ أَنْ أَصْنَعَ مِنْهُ لَكَ رَغِيفًا . فَقَالَ " رُدِّيهِ فِيهِ ثُمَّ اعْجِنِيهِ " .
references: Vol. 4, Book of  Food, Hadith 3336

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3337

chapter.englishTitle: White bread

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Anas bin Malik said:
           “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ never saw a thin loaf made from well-sifted flour with his own eyes, until he met Allah.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Anas bin Malik said:
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ never saw a thin loaf made from well-sifted flour with his own eyes, until he met Allah.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا الْعَبَّاسُ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ الدِّمَشْقِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُثْمَانَ أَبُو الْجَمَاهِرِ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ بَشِيرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ مَا رَأَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ رَغِيفًا مُحَوَّرًا بِوَاحِدٍ مِنْ عَيْنَيْهِ حَتَّى لَحِقَ بِاللَّهِ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of  Food, Hadith 3337

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3338

chapter.englishTitle: Thin loaves of bread

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Ibn ‘Ata that his father said:
           “Abu Hurairah visited his people, meaning, a village” – I (one of the narrators) think he said: “Yuna” – “And they brought him some of the first thin loaves of bread. He wept and said: ‘The Messenger of Allah ﷺ never saw such a thing with his own eyes.’”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Ibn ‘Ata that his father said:
hadiths.body: “Abu Hurairah visited his people, meaning, a village” – I (one of the narrators) think he said: “Yuna” – “And they brought him some of the first thin loaves of bread. He wept and said: ‘The Messenger of Allah ﷺ never saw such a thing with his own eyes.’”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عُمَيْرٍ، عِيسَى بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ النَّحَّاسِ الرَّمْلِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا ضَمْرَةُ بْنُ رَبِيعَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَطَاءٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ زَارَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ قَوْمَهُ بِيُبْنَا فَأَتَوْهُ بِرُقَاقٍ مِنْ رُقَاقِ الأُوَلِ فَبَكَى وَقَالَ مَا رَأَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ هَذَا بِعَيْنِهِ قَطُّ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of  Food, Hadith 3338

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3339

chapter.englishTitle: Thin loaves of bread

hadiths.englishRaw:
Qatadah said:
           “We used to go to (visit) Anas bin Malik.” (One of the narrators) Ishaq said: “And his baker was standing there.” (In another narration) Darimi said: “And his table was set. He said one day: ‘(Come and) eat, for the Messenger of Allah ﷺ never saw any thin loaf of bread until he met Allah, nor any roasted sheep (with skin).’”*
hadiths.narrator: Qatadah said:
hadiths.body: “We used to go to (visit) Anas bin Malik.” (One of the narrators) Ishaq said: “And his baker was standing there.” (In another narration) Darimi said: “And his table was set. He said one day: ‘(Come and) eat, for the Messenger of Allah ﷺ never saw any thin loaf of bread until he met Allah, nor any roasted sheep (with skin).’”*
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، وَأَحْمَدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الدَّارِمِيُّ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الصَّمَدِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْوَارِثِ، حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ، حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ، قَالَ كُنَّا نَأْتِي أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ - قَالَ إِسْحَاقُ وَخَبَّازُهُ قَائِمٌ وَقَالَ الدَّارِمِيُّ وَخِوَانُهُ مَوْضُوعٌ - فَقَالَ يَوْمًا كُلُوا فَمَا أَعْلَمُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ رَأَى رَغِيفًا مُرَقَّقًا بِعَيْنِهِ حَتَّى لَحِقَ بِاللَّهِ وَلاَ شَاةً سَمِيطًا قَطُّ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of  Food, Hadith 3339

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3340

chapter.englishTitle: Faludhaj

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Ibn ‘Abbas said:
           “The first we heard of Faludhaj* was when Jibril (as) came to the Prophet ﷺ and said: ‘The world will be opened for your nation and they will conquer the world, until they eat Faludhaj.’ The Prophet ﷺ said: ‘What is Faludhaj?’ He said: ‘They mix ghee and honey together.’ At that, the Prophet ﷺ sobbed.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Ibn ‘Abbas said:
hadiths.body: “The first we heard of Faludhaj* was when Jibril (as) came to the Prophet ﷺ and said: ‘The world will be opened for your nation and they will conquer the world, until they eat Faludhaj.’ The Prophet ﷺ said: ‘What is Faludhaj?’ He said: ‘They mix ghee and honey together.’ At that, the Prophet ﷺ sobbed.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ بْنُ الضَّحَّاكِ السُّلَمِيُّ أَبُو الْحَارِثِ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ عَيَّاشٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ طَلْحَةَ، عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ يَحْيَى، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ أَوَّلُ مَا سَمِعْنَا بِالْفَالُوذَجِ، أَنَّ جِبْرِيلَ، عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ أَتَى النَّبِيَّ ﷺ فَقَالَ إِنَّ أُمَّتَكَ تُفْتَحُ عَلَيْهِمُ الأَرْضُ فَيُفَاضُ عَلَيْهِمْ مِنَ الدُّنْيَا حَتَّى إِنَّهُمْ لَيَأْكُلُونَ الْفَالُوذَجَ . فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ  " وَمَا الْفَالُوذَجُ " . قَالَ يَخْلِطُونَ السَّمْنَ وَالْعَسَلَ جَمِيعًا . فَشَهَقَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ لِذَلِكَ شَهْقَةً .
references: Vol. 4, Book of  Food, Hadith 3340

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3341

chapter.englishTitle: Bread softened with ghee

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Ibn ‘Umar said:
           “One day, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: ‘I wish that we had some white bread made of brown wheat, softened with ghee, that we could eat.’ A man from among the Ansar heard that, so he took some (of that food) and brought it to him. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: ‘Where was this ghee kept?’ He said: ‘In a container made of mastigure skin.’ And he refused to eat it.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Ibn ‘Umar said:
hadiths.body: “One day, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: ‘I wish that we had some white bread made of brown wheat, softened with ghee, that we could eat.’ A man from among the Ansar heard that, so he took some (of that food) and brought it to him. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: ‘Where was this ghee kept?’ He said: ‘In a container made of mastigure skin.’ And he refused to eat it.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا هَدِيَّةُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْوَهَّابِ، حَدَّثَنَا الْفَضْلُ بْنُ مُوسَى السِّيْنَانِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ وَاقِدٍ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ ذَاتَ يَوْمٍ " وَدِدْتُ لَوْ أَنَّ عِنْدَنَا خُبْزَةً بَيْضَاءَ مِنْ بُرَّةٍ سَمْرَاءَ مُلَبَّقَةٍ بِسَمْنٍ نَأْكُلُهَا " . قَالَ فَسَمِعَ بِذَلِكَ رَجُلٌ مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ فَاتَّخَذَهُ فَجَاءَ بِهِ إِلَيْهِ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ " فِي أَىِّ شَىْءٍ كَانَ هَذَا السَّمْنُ " . قَالَ فِي عُكَّةِ ضَبٍّ . قَالَ فَأَبَى أَنْ يَأْكُلَهُ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of  Food, Hadith 3341

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3342

chapter.englishTitle: Bread softened with ghee

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Anas bin Malik said:
           “Umm Sulaim made some bread for the Prophet ﷺ, and she put a little ghee on it. Then she said: ‘Go to the Prophet ﷺ and invite him (to come and eat).’ So I went and told him: ‘My mother is inviting you (to come and eat).’ So he stood up, and said to the people who were with him: ‘Get up.’ I went ahead of him and told her. Then the Prophet ﷺ came and said: ‘Bring what you have made.’ She said: ‘I only made it for you alone.’ He said: ‘Bring it.’ Then he said: ‘O Anas, bring (them) in to me ten by ten.’ So I kept bringing them in ten by ten, and they ate their fill, and there were eighty of them.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Anas bin Malik said:
hadiths.body: “Umm Sulaim made some bread for the Prophet ﷺ, and she put a little ghee on it. Then she said: ‘Go to the Prophet ﷺ and invite him (to come and eat).’ So I went and told him: ‘My mother is inviting you (to come and eat).’ So he stood up, and said to the people who were with him: ‘Get up.’ I went ahead of him and told her. Then the Prophet ﷺ came and said: ‘Bring what you have made.’ She said: ‘I only made it for you alone.’ He said: ‘Bring it.’ Then he said: ‘O Anas, bring (them) in to me ten by ten.’ So I kept bringing them in ten by ten, and they ate their fill, and there were eighty of them.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، حَدَّثَنَا حُمَيْدُ الطَّوِيلُ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ صَنَعَتْ أُمُّ سُلَيْمٍ لِلنَّبِيِّ ﷺ خُبْزَةً وَضَعَتْ فِيهَا شَيْئًا مِنْ سَمْنٍ ثُمَّ قَالَتِ اذْهَبْ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ ﷺ فَادْعُهُ قَالَ فَأَتَيْتُهُ فَقُلْتُ أُمِّي تَدْعُوكَ . قَالَ فَقَامَ وَقَالَ لِمَنْ كَانَ عِنْدَهُ مِنَ النَّاسِ " قُومُوا " . قَالَ فَسَبَقْتُهُمْ إِلَيْهَا فَأَخْبَرْتُهَا فَجَاءَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ فَقَالَ " هَاتِي مَا صَنَعْتِ " . فَقَالَتْ إِنَّمَا صَنَعْتُهُ لَكَ وَحْدَكَ . فَقَالَ " هَاتِيهِ " . فَقَالَ " يَا أَنَسُ أَدْخِلْ عَلَىَّ عَشْرَةً عَشْرَةً " . قَالَ فَمَا زِلْتُ أُدْخِلُ عَلَيْهِ عَشْرَةً عَشْرَةً فَأَكَلُوا حَتَّى شَبِعُوا وَكَانُوا ثَمَانِينَ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of  Food, Hadith 3342

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3343

chapter.englishTitle: Wheat bread

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Abu Hurairah said:
           “By the One in Whose Hand is my soul, the Prophet of Allah ﷺ never ate his fill of wheat bread for three days in a row, until Allah took his soul.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Abu Hurairah said:
hadiths.body: “By the One in Whose Hand is my soul, the Prophet of Allah ﷺ never ate his fill of wheat bread for three days in a row, until Allah took his soul.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ كَاسِبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مَرْوَانُ بْنُ مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ كَيْسَانَ، عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ وَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ مَا شَبِعَ نَبِيُّ اللَّهِ ﷺ ثَلاَثَةَ أَيَّامٍ تِبَاعًا مِنْ خُبْزِ الْحِنْطَةِ حَتَّى تَوَفَّاهُ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of  Food, Hadith 3343

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3344

chapter.englishTitle: Wheat bread

hadiths.englishRaw:
it was narrated that ‘Aishah said:
           “The family of Muhammad ﷺ never ate their fill of wheat bread for three nights in a row, from the time they came to Al-Madinah until he passed away.”
hadiths.narrator: it was narrated that ‘Aishah said:
hadiths.body: “The family of Muhammad ﷺ never ate their fill of wheat bread for three nights in a row, from the time they came to Al-Madinah until he passed away.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاوِيَةُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو، حَدَّثَنَا زَائِدَةُ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنِ الأَسْوَدِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ مَا شَبِعَ آلُ مُحَمَّدٍ ﷺ مُنْذُ قَدِمُوا الْمَدِينَةَ ثَلاَثَ لَيَالٍ تِبَاعًا مِنْ خُبْزِ بُرٍّ حَتَّى تُوُفِّيَ ﷺ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of  Food, Hadith 3344

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3345

chapter.englishTitle: Barley bread

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that ‘Aishah said:
           “When the Prophet ﷺ passed away, there was nothing in my house that any living soul could eat, except a little bit of barley on a shelf of mine. I ate it for a long time, then I weighed it and soon it was all gone.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that ‘Aishah said:
hadiths.body: “When the Prophet ﷺ passed away, there was nothing in my house that any living soul could eat, except a little bit of barley on a shelf of mine. I ate it for a long time, then I weighed it and soon it was all gone.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ لَقَدْ تُوُفِّيَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ وَمَا فِي بَيْتِي مِنْ شَىْءٍ يَأْكُلُهُ ذُو كَبِدٍ إِلاَّ شَطْرُ شَعِيرٍ فِي رَفٍّ لِي فَأَكَلْتُ مِنْهُ حَتَّى طَالَ عَلَىَّ فَكِلْتُهُ فَفَنِيَ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of  Food, Hadith 3345

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3346

chapter.englishTitle: Barley bread

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that ‘Aishah said:
           “The family of Muhammad ﷺ never ate their fill of barley bread until he was taken (i.e. died).”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that ‘Aishah said:
hadiths.body: “The family of Muhammad ﷺ never ate their fill of barley bread until he was taken (i.e. died).”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنَ يَزِيدَ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنِ الأَسْوَدِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ مَا شَبِعَ آلُ مُحَمَّدٍ ﷺ مِنْ خُبْزِ الشَّعِيرِ حَتَّى قُبِضَ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of  Food, Hadith 3346

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3347

chapter.englishTitle: Barley bread

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Ibn ‘Abbas said:
           “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to spend many nights in a row hungry and his family could find no supper, and usually their bread was barley bread.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Ibn ‘Abbas said:
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to spend many nights in a row hungry and his family could find no supper, and usually their bread was barley bread.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاوِيَةَ الْجُمَحِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا ثَابِتُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ، عَنْ هِلاَلِ بْنِ خَبَّابٍ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَبِيتُ اللَّيَالِيَ الْمُتَتَابِعَةَ طَاوِيًا وَأَهْلُهُ لاَ يَجِدُونَ الْعَشَاءَ وَكَانَ عَامَّةَ خُبْزِهِمْ خُبْزُ الشَّعِيرِ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of  Food, Hadith 3347

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3348

chapter.englishTitle: Barley bread

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Hasan that Anas bin Malik said:
           “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ wore wool, and his shows were sandals.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Hasan that Anas bin Malik said:
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ wore wool, and his shows were sandals.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ سَعِيدِ بْنِ كَثِيرِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ الْحِمْصِيُّ، - وَكَانَ يُعَدُّ مِنَ الأَبْدَالِ - حَدَّثَنَا بَقِيَّةُ، حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ بْنُ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، عَنْ نُوحِ بْنِ ذَكْوَانَ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ لَبِسَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ الصُّوفَ وَاحْتَذَى الْمَخْصُوفَ . وَقَالَ أَكَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ بَشِعًا وَلَبِسَ خَشِنًا . فَقِيلَ لِلْحَسَنِ مَا الْبَشِعُ قَالَ غَلِيظُ الشَّعِيرِ مَا كَانَ يُسِيغُهُ إِلاَّ بِجُرْعَةِ مَاءٍ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of  Food, Hadith 3348

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3349

chapter.arabicTitle: باب الاِقْتِصَادِ فِي الأَكْلِ وَكَرَاهِيَةِ الشِّبَعِ
chapter.englishTitle: Being economical with food and the undesirability of eating one’s fill

hadiths.englishRaw:
Miqdam bin Madikarib said:
           “I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: ‘A human being fills no worse vessel than his stomach. It is sufficient for a human being to eat a few mouthfuls to keep his spine straight. But if he must (fill it), then one third of food, one third for drink and one third for air.’”
hadiths.narrator: Miqdam bin Madikarib said:
hadiths.body: “I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: ‘A human being fills no worse vessel than his stomach. It is sufficient for a human being to eat a few mouthfuls to keep his spine straight. But if he must (fill it), then one third of food, one third for drink and one third for air.’”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ الْحِمْصِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَتْنِي أُمِّي، عَنْ أُمِّهَا، أَنَّهَا سَمِعَتِ الْمِقْدَامَ بْنَ مَعْدِيكَرِبَ، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ  " مَا مَلأَ آدَمِيٌّ وِعَاءً شَرًّا مِنْ بَطْنٍ حَسْبُ الآدَمِيِّ لُقَيْمَاتٌ يُقِمْنَ صُلْبَهُ فَإِنْ غَلَبَتِ الآدَمِيَّ نَفْسُهُ فَثُلُثٌ لِلطَّعَامِ وَثُلُثٌ لِلشَّرَابِ وَثُلُثٌ لِلنَّفَسِ " .
references: Vol. 4, Book of  Food, Hadith 3349

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3350

chapter.arabicTitle: باب الاِقْتِصَادِ فِي الأَكْلِ وَكَرَاهِيَةِ الشِّبَعِ
chapter.englishTitle: Being economical with food and the undesirability of eating one’s fill

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Ibn ‘Umar said:
           “A man burped in the presence of the Prophet ﷺ and he said: ‘Withhold your burps from us! For the most hungry of you on the Day of Resurrection will be those who most ate their fill in this world.’”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Ibn ‘Umar said:
hadiths.body: “A man burped in the presence of the Prophet ﷺ and he said: ‘Withhold your burps from us! For the most hungry of you on the Day of Resurrection will be those who most ate their fill in this world.’”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ أَبُو يَحْيَى، عَنْ يَحْيَى الْبَكَّاءِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ تَجَشَّأَ رَجُلٌ عِنْدَ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ فَقَالَ  " كُفَّ جُشَاءَكَ عَنَّا فَإِنَّ أَطْوَلَكُمْ جُوعًا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ أَكْثَرُكُمْ شِبَعًا فِي دَارِ الدُّنْيَا " .
references: Vol. 4, Book of  Food, Hadith 3350

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3351

chapter.arabicTitle: باب الاِقْتِصَادِ فِي الأَكْلِ وَكَرَاهِيَةِ الشِّبَعِ
chapter.englishTitle: Being economical with food and the undesirability of eating one’s fill

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that ‘Atiyyah bin ‘Amir Al-Juhani said:
           “I heard Salman, when he was forced to eat food, say: ‘It is sufficient for me that I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: The people who most eat their fill in this world will be the most hungry on the Day of Resurrection.’”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that ‘Atiyyah bin ‘Amir Al-Juhani said:
hadiths.body: “I heard Salman, when he was forced to eat food, say: ‘It is sufficient for me that I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: The people who most eat their fill in this world will be the most hungry on the Day of Resurrection.’”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا دَاوُدُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ الْعَسْكَرِيُّ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الصَّبَّاحِ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ الثَّقَفِيُّ، عَنْ مُوسَى الْجُهَنِيِّ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ وَهْبٍ، عَنْ عَطِيَّةَ بْنِ عَامِرٍ الْجُهَنِيِّ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ سَلْمَانَ، وَأُكْرِهَ، عَلَى طَعَامٍ يَأْكُلُهُ فَقَالَ حَسْبِي إِنِّي سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ  " إِنَّ أَكْثَرَ النَّاسِ شِبَعًا فِي الدُّنْيَا أَطْوَلُهُمْ جُوعًا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ " .
references: Vol. 4, Book of  Food, Hadith 3351

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3352

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مِنَ الإِسْرَافِ أَنْ تَأْكُلَ كُلَّ مَا اشْتَهَيْتَ
chapter.englishTitle: It is extravagance to eat everything you want

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Anas bin Malik that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            “It is extravagance to eat everything you want.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Anas bin Malik that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “It is extravagance to eat everything you want.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، وَسُوَيْدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَيَحْيَى بْنُ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ سَعِيدِ بْنِ كَثِيرِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ الْحِمْصِيُّ، قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا بَقِيَّةُ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ، حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ بْنُ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، عَنْ نُوحِ بْنِ ذَكْوَانَ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " إِنَّ مِنَ السَّرَفِ أَنْ تَأْكُلَ كُلَّ مَا اشْتَهَيْتَ " .
references: Vol. 4, Book of  Food, Hadith 3352

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3353

chapter.englishTitle: The prohibition of throwing food

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that ‘Aishah said:
           “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ entered the house and saw a piece of bread that had been thrown (on the floor). He picked it up, wiped it and ate it, and said: ‘O ‘Aishah, show honor to the precious (i.e., food), for is the blessing of food departs from people, it never comes back.’”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that ‘Aishah said:
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ entered the house and saw a piece of bread that had been thrown (on the floor). He picked it up, wiped it and ate it, and said: ‘O ‘Aishah, show honor to the precious (i.e., food), for is the blessing of food departs from people, it never comes back.’”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يُوسُفَ الْفِرْيَابِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا وَسَّاجُ بْنُ عُقْبَةَ بْنِ وَسَّاجٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ الْمُوَقَّرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا الزُّهْرِيُّ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ دَخَلَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ الْبَيْتَ فَرَأَى كِسْرَةً مُلْقَاةً فَأَخَذَهَا فَمَسَحَهَا ثُمَّ أَكَلَهَا وَقَالَ  " يَا عَائِشَةُ أَكْرِمِي كَرِيمَكِ فَإِنَّهَا مَا نَفَرَتْ عَنْ قَوْمٍ قَطُّ فَعَادَتْ إِلَيْهِمْ " .
references: Vol. 4, Book of  Food, Hadith 3353

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3354

chapter.englishTitle: Seeking refuge with Allah from hunger

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Abu Hurairah said:
           “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to say: ‘Allahumma inni a’udhu bika minal-ju’, fa innahu bi’sad- daji’, wa a’udhu bika minal-khiyanah, fa innaha bi’satil-bitanah (O Allah, I seek refuge with You from hunger, for it is a bad companion, and I seek refuge with You from treachery, for it is a bad thing to hide in one’s heart).’”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Abu Hurairah said:
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to say: ‘Allahumma inni a’udhu bika minal-ju’, fa innahu bi’sad- daji’, wa a’udhu bika minal-khiyanah, fa innaha bi’satil-bitanah (O Allah, I seek refuge with You from hunger, for it is a bad companion, and I seek refuge with You from treachery, for it is a bad thing to hide in one’s heart).’”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هُرَيْمٌ، عَنْ لَيْثٍ، عَنْ كَعْبٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ  " اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْجُوعِ فَإِنَّهُ بِئْسَ الضَّجِيعُ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْخِيَانَةِ فَإِنَّهَا بِئْسَتِ الْبِطَانَةُ " .
references: Vol. 4, Book of  Food, Hadith 3354

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3355

chapter.englishTitle: Abandoning dinner

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Jabir bin ‘Abdullah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
           “Do not leave dinner, even if it is only a handful of dates, because abandoning it makes one weak.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Jabir bin ‘Abdullah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “Do not leave dinner, even if it is only a handful of dates, because abandoning it makes one weak.”
