hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الرَّقِّيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ عَبْدِ السَّلاَمِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ بَابَاهْ الْمَخْزُومِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَيْمُونٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْمُنْكَدِرِ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " لاَ تَدَعُوا الْعَشَاءَ وَلَوْ بِكَفٍّ مِنْ تَمْرٍ فَإِنَّ تَرْكَهُ يُهْرِمُ " .
references: Vol. 4, Book of  Food, Hadith 3355

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3356

chapter.englishTitle: Hospitality

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Anas bin Malik that the Messenger of Allah 9saw) said:
            “Goodness comes more quickly to a house where there are frequent guests than a knife to camel’s hump.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Anas bin Malik that the Messenger of Allah 9saw) said:
hadiths.body: “Goodness comes more quickly to a house where there are frequent guests than a knife to camel’s hump.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا جُبَارَةُ بْنُ الْمُغَلِّسِ، حَدَّثَنَا كَثِيرُ بْنُ سُلَيْمٍ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " الْخَيْرُ أَسْرَعُ إِلَى الْبَيْتِ الَّذِي يُغْشَى مِنَ الشَّفْرَةِ إِلَى سَنَامِ الْبَعِيرِ " .
references: Vol. 4, Book of  Food, Hadith 3356

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3357

chapter.englishTitle: Hospitality

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Ibn ‘Abbas that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            “Goodness comes more quickly to a house where food is eaten than a knife to a camel’s hump.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Ibn ‘Abbas that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “Goodness comes more quickly to a house where food is eaten than a knife to a camel’s hump.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا جُبَارَةُ بْنُ الْمُغَلِّسِ، حَدَّثَنَا الْمُحَارِبِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ نَهْشَلٍ، عَنِ الضَّحَّاكِ بْنِ مُزَاحِمٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " الْخَيْرُ أَسْرَعُ إِلَى الْبَيْتِ الَّذِي يُؤْكَلُ فِيهِ مِنَ الشَّفْرَةِ إِلَى سَنَامِ الْبَعِيرِ " .
references: Vol. 4, Book of  Food, Hadith 3357

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3358

chapter.englishTitle: Hospitality

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            “It is the Sunnah for a man to go out with his guest to the door of the house.’”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “It is the Sunnah for a man to go out with his guest to the door of the house.’”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مَيْمُونٍ الرَّقِّيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " إِنَّ مِنَ السُّنَّةِ أَنْ يَخْرُجَ الرَّجُلُ مَعَ ضَيْفِهِ إِلَى بَابِ الدَّارِ " .
references: Vol. 4, Book of  Food, Hadith 3358

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3359

chapter.arabicTitle: باب إِذَا رَأَى الضَّيْفُ مُنْكَرًا رَجَعَ
chapter.englishTitle: If a guest sees something bad, he should go back

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that ‘Ali said:
           “I made some food and called the Messenger of Allah ﷺ (to come and eat). He came and saw some images in the house, so he went back.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that ‘Ali said:
hadiths.body: “I made some food and called the Messenger of Allah ﷺ (to come and eat). He came and saw some images in the house, so he went back.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ الدَّسْتَوَائِيِّ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ، قَالَ صَنَعْتُ طَعَامًا فَدَعَوْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَجَاءَ فَرَأَى فِي الْبَيْتِ تَصَاوِيرَ فَرَجَعَ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of  Food, Hadith 3359

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3360

chapter.arabicTitle: باب إِذَا رَأَى الضَّيْفُ مُنْكَرًا رَجَعَ
chapter.englishTitle: If a guest sees something bad, he should go back

hadiths.englishRaw:
Safinah, Abu ‘Abdur-Rahman, narrated that a man visited ‘Ali bin Abu Talib and he made some food for him.* Fatimah said:
           “Why don’t we invite the Prophet ﷺ to eat with us?” So they invited him and he came. He put his hand on the doorpost of the house and saw a thin curtain in the corner of the house, so he went back. Fatimah said to ‘Ali: “Go and catch up with him, and ask him: ‘What made you go back, O Messenger of Allah?” He said: “I do not enter a well-decorated house.”
hadiths.narrator: Safinah, Abu ‘Abdur-Rahman, narrated that a man visited ‘Ali bin Abu Talib and he made some food for him.* Fatimah said:
hadiths.body: “Why don’t we invite the Prophet ﷺ to eat with us?” So they invited him and he came. He put his hand on the doorpost of the house and saw a thin curtain in the corner of the house, so he went back. Fatimah said to ‘Ali: “Go and catch up with him, and ask him: ‘What made you go back, O Messenger of Allah?” He said: “I do not enter a well-decorated house.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْجَزَرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَفَّانُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ جُمْهَانَ، حَدَّثَنَا سَفِينَةُ أَبُو عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، أَنَّ رَجُلاً، أَضَافَ عَلِيَّ بْنَ أَبِي طَالِبٍ فَصَنَعَ لَهُ طَعَامًا فَقَالَتْ فَاطِمَةُ لَوْ دَعَوْنَا النَّبِيَّ ﷺ فَأَكَلَ مَعَنَا . فَدَعَوْهُ فَجَاءَ فَوَضَعَ يَدَهُ عَلَى عِضَادَتَىِ الْبَابِ فَرَأَى قِرَامًا فِي نَاحِيَةِ الْبَيْتِ فَرَجَعَ فَقَالَتْ فَاطِمَةُ لِعَلِيٍّ الْحَقْ فَقُلْ لَهُ مَا رَجَعَكَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ  " إِنَّهُ لَيْسَ لِي أَنْ أَدْخُلَ بَيْتًا مُزَوَّقًا " .
references: Vol. 4, Book of  Food, Hadith 3360

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3361

chapter.englishTitle: Ghee and meat together

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Ibn ‘Umar said that ‘Umar entered upon him when he was eating, and he made room for him in the middle of the gathering. He said:
           Bismillah, then he took a morsel and ate it, then a second. Then he said: “I notice some fat in the food but it is not the fat of the meat.” ‘Abdullah said: “O Commander of the Believers! I went out to the marketplace looking for some fatty meat (bones with plenty of meat on them) to buy, but it was expensive, so I bought some lean meat (bones with not much meat on them) for a Dirham, and added a Dirham’s worth of ghee. I wanted my family to go through it bone by bone.” ‘Umar said: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ never had these two things together; he would eat one and give the other in charity.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Ibn ‘Umar said that ‘Umar entered upon him when he was eating, and he made room for him in the middle of the gathering. He said:
hadiths.body: Bismillah, then he took a morsel and ate it, then a second. Then he said: “I notice some fat in the food but it is not the fat of the meat.” ‘Abdullah said: “O Commander of the Believers! I went out to the marketplace looking for some fatty meat (bones with plenty of meat on them) to buy, but it was expensive, so I bought some lean meat (bones with not much meat on them) for a Dirham, and added a Dirham’s worth of ghee. I wanted my family to go through it bone by bone.” ‘Umar said: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ never had these two things together; he would eat one and give the other in charity.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الأَرْحَبِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ بْنُ أَبِي الْيَعْفُورِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ دَخَلَ عَلَيْهِ عُمَرُ وَهُوَ عَلَى مَائِدَتِهِ فَأَوْسَعَ لَهُ عَنْ صَدْرِ الْمَجْلِسِ فَقَالَ بِسْمِ اللَّهِ . ثُمَّ ضَرَبَ بِيَدِهِ فَلَقِمَ لُقْمَةً ثُمَّ ثَنَّى بِأُخْرَى ثُمَّ قَالَ إِنِّي لأَجِدُ طَعْمَ دَسَمٍ مَا هُوَ بِدَسَمِ اللَّحْمِ . فَقَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ يَا أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ إِنِّي خَرَجْتُ إِلَى السُّوقِ أَطْلُبُ السَّمِينَ لأَشْتَرِيَهُ فَوَجَدْتُهُ غَالِيًا فَاشْتَرَيْتُ بِدِرْهَمٍ مِنَ الْمَهْزُولِ وَحَمَلْتُ عَلَيْهِ بِدِرْهَمٍ سَمْنًا فَأَرَدْتُ أَنْ يَتَرَدَّدَ عِيَالِي عَظْمًا عَظْمًا . فَقَالَ عُمَرُ مَا اجْتَمَعَا عِنْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَطُّ إِلاَّ أَكَلَ أَحَدَهُمَا وَتَصَدَّقَ بِالآخَرِ . قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ خُذْ يَا أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ فَلَنْ يَجْتَمِعَا عِنْدِي إِلاَّ فَعَلْتُ ذَلِكَ . قَالَ مَا كُنْتُ لأَفْعَلَ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of  Food, Hadith 3361

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3362

chapter.englishTitle: Whoever cooks, let him add more water

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Dharr that the Prophet ﷺ said:
           “When you make broth, add more water and give some to your neighbor.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Dharr that the Prophet ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “When you make broth, add more water and give some to your neighbor.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَامِرٍ الْخَزَّازُ، عَنْ أَبِي عِمْرَانَ الْجَوْنِيِّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الصَّامِتِ، عَنْ أَبِي ذَرٍّ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ  " إِذَا عَمِلْتَ مَرَقَةً فَأَكْثِرْ مَاءَهَا وَاغْتَرِفْ لِجِيرَانِكَ مِنْهَا " .
references: Vol. 4, Book of  Food, Hadith 3362

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3363

chapter.englishTitle: Eating garlic, onions and leeks

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Ma’dan bin Abu Talhah Al-Ya’muri that ‘Umar bin Khattab stood up one Friday delivering a sermon. He praised and glorified Allah, then he said:
           “O people, you eat two plants which I do not regard as anything but offensive: This garlic and these onions. At the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, I would see a man, if the smell (of these vegetables) was found on him, being taken by the hand and led out to Baqi’ (graveyard). Whoever must eat them, let him cook them to death.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Ma’dan bin Abu Talhah Al-Ya’muri that ‘Umar bin Khattab stood up one Friday delivering a sermon. He praised and glorified Allah, then he said:
hadiths.body: “O people, you eat two plants which I do not regard as anything but offensive: This garlic and these onions. At the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, I would see a man, if the smell (of these vegetables) was found on him, being taken by the hand and led out to Baqi’ (graveyard). Whoever must eat them, let him cook them to death.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي عَرُوبَةَ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ أَبِي الْجَعْدِ الْغَطَفَانِيِّ، عَنْ مَعْدَانَ بْنِ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ الْيَعْمُرِيِّ، أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ، قَامَ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ خَطِيبًا فَحَمِدَ اللَّهَ وَأَثْنَى عَلَيْهِ ثُمَّ قَالَ يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ إِنَّكُمْ تَأْكُلُونَ شَجَرَتَيْنِ لاَ أُرَاهُمَا إِلاَّ خَبِيثَتَيْنِ هَذَا الثُّومُ وَهَذَا الْبَصَلُ وَلَقَدْ كُنْتُ أَرَى الرَّجُلَ عَلَى عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ يُوجَدُ رِيحُهُ مِنْهُ فَيُؤْخَذُ بِيَدِهِ حَتَّى يُخْرَجَ بِهِ إِلَى الْبَقِيعِ فَمَنْ كَانَ آكِلَهُمَا لاَ بُدَّ فَلْيُمِتْهُمَا طَبْخًا .
references: Vol. 4, Book of  Food, Hadith 3363

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3364

chapter.englishTitle: Eating garlic, onions and leeks

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Umm Ayyub said:
           “I made some food for the Prophet ﷺ in which there were some vegetables. He did not eat it, and he said: ‘I do not like to annoy my companion.’”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Umm Ayyub said:
hadiths.body: “I made some food for the Prophet ﷺ in which there were some vegetables. He did not eat it, and he said: ‘I do not like to annoy my companion.’”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي يَزِيدَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أُمِّ أَيُّوبَ، قَالَتْ صَنَعْتُ لِلنَّبِيِّ ﷺ طَعَامًا فِيهِ مِنْ بَعْضِ الْبُقُولِ فَلَمْ يَأْكُلْ وَقَالَ  " إِنِّي أَكْرَهُ أَنْ أُوذِيَ صَاحِبِي " .
references: Vol. 4, Book of  Food, Hadith 3364

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3365

chapter.englishTitle: Eating garlic, onions and leeks

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Jabir that a group of people came to the Prophet ﷺ and he noticed the smell of leeks coming from them. He said:
            “Did I not forbid you to eat these vegetables? For the angels are offended by that which offends people.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Jabir that a group of people came to the Prophet ﷺ and he noticed the smell of leeks coming from them. He said:
hadiths.body: “Did I not forbid you to eat these vegetables? For the angels are offended by that which offends people.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَنْبَأَنَا أَبُو شُرَيْحٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ نِمْرَانَ الْحَجْرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، أَنَّ نَفَرًا، أَتَوُا النَّبِيَّ ﷺ فَوَجَدَ مِنْهُمْ رِيحَ الْكُرَّاثِ فَقَالَ  " أَلَمْ أَكُنْ نَهَيْتُكُمْ عَنْ أَكْلِ هَذِهِ الشَّجَرَةِ إِنَّ الْمَلاَئِكَةَ تَتَأَذَّى مِمَّا يَتَأَذَّى مِنْهُ الإِنْسَانُ " .
references: Vol. 4, Book of  Food, Hadith 3365

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3366

chapter.englishTitle: Eating garlic, onions and leeks

hadiths.englishRaw:
‘Uqbah bin ‘Amir Al-Juhani said:
           “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to his Companions: ‘Do not eat onions,’ then he said in a low voice: ‘Raw.’”
hadiths.narrator: ‘Uqbah bin ‘Amir Al-Juhani said:
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to his Companions: ‘Do not eat onions,’ then he said in a low voice: ‘Raw.’”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ لَهِيعَةَ، عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ نُعَيْمٍ، عَنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ بْنِ نَهِيكٍ، عَنْ دُخَيْنٍ الْحَجْرِيِّ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ عُقْبَةَ بْنَ عَامِرٍ الْجُهَنِيَّ، يَقُولُ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ لأَصْحَابِهِ " لاَ تَأْكُلُوا الْبَصَلَ " . ثُمَّ قَالَ كَلِمَةً خَفِيَّةً " النِّيءَ " .
references: Vol. 4, Book of  Food, Hadith 3366

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3367

chapter.englishTitle: Eating cheese and ghee

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Salman Al-Farisi said:
           “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ was asked about ghee, cheese and wild donkeys. He said: ‘What is lawful is that which Allah has permitted, in His Book and what is unlawful is that which Allah has forbidden in His Book. What He remained silent about is what is pardoned.’”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Salman Al-Farisi said:
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ was asked about ghee, cheese and wild donkeys. He said: ‘What is lawful is that which Allah has permitted, in His Book and what is unlawful is that which Allah has forbidden in His Book. What He remained silent about is what is pardoned.’”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ مُوسَى السُّدِّيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا سَيْفُ بْنُ هَارُونَ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ التَّيْمِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي عُثْمَانَ النَّهْدِيِّ، عَنْ سَلْمَانَ الْفَارِسِيِّ، قَالَ سُئِلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَنِ السَّمْنِ وَالْجُبْنِ وَالْفِرَاءِ قَالَ  " الْحَلاَلُ مَا أَحَلَّ اللَّهُ فِي كِتَابِهِ وَالْحَرَامُ مَا حَرَّمَ اللَّهُ فِي كِتَابِهِ وَمَا سَكَتَ عَنْهُ فَهُوَ مِمَّا عَفَا عَنْهُ " .
references: Vol. 4, Book of  Food, Hadith 3367

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3368

chapter.englishTitle: Eating fruits

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Nu’man bin Bashir said:
           “The Prophet ﷺ was given a gift of some grapes from Ta’if. He called me and said: ‘Take this bunch of grapes and give it to your mother.’ But I ate it before I gave it to her. A few night later he said to me: ‘What happened to the bunch of grapes? Did you give it to your mother?’ I said: ‘No, So he called me treacherous.’”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Nu’man bin Bashir said:
hadiths.body: “The Prophet ﷺ was given a gift of some grapes from Ta’if. He called me and said: ‘Take this bunch of grapes and give it to your mother.’ But I ate it before I gave it to her. A few night later he said to me: ‘What happened to the bunch of grapes? Did you give it to your mother?’ I said: ‘No, So he called me treacherous.’”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ سَعِيدِ بْنِ كَثِيرِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ الْحِمْصِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عِرْقٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ النُّعْمَانِ بْنِ بَشِيرٍ، قَالَ أُهْدِيَ لِلنَّبِيِّ ﷺ عِنَبٌ مِنَ الطَّائِفِ فَدَعَانِي فَقَالَ " خُذْ هَذَا الْعُنْقُودَ فَأَبْلِغْهُ أُمَّكَ " . فَأَكَلْتُهُ قَبْلَ أَنْ أُبْلِغَهُ إِيَّاهَا فَلَمَّا كَانَ بَعْدَ لَيَالٍ قَالَ لِي " مَا فَعَلَ الْعُنْقُودُ هَلْ أَبْلَغْتَهُ أُمَّكَ " . قُلْتُ لاَ . قَالَ فَسَمَّانِي غُدَرَ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of  Food, Hadith 3368

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3369

chapter.englishTitle: Eating fruits

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Talhah said:
           ”I entered upon the Prophet ﷺ and in his hand was some quince. He said: ‘Take it, O Talhah, for it soothes the heart.’”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Talhah said:
hadiths.body: ”I entered upon the Prophet ﷺ and in his hand was some quince. He said: ‘Take it, O Talhah, for it soothes the heart.’”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ الطَّلْحِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا نُقَيْبُ بْنُ حَاجِبٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ الزُّبَيْرِيِّ، عَنْ طَلْحَةَ، قَالَ دَخَلْتُ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ ﷺ وَبِيَدِهِ سَفَرْجَلَةٌ فَقَالَ  " دُونَكَهَا يَا طَلْحَةُ فَإِنَّهَا تُجِمُّ الْفُؤَادَ " .
references: Vol. 4, Book of  Food, Hadith 3369

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3370

chapter.englishTitle: The prohibition of eating while lying down prostrate

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Salim that his father said:
           “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade a man from eating while lying down on his face.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Salim that his father said:
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade a man from eating while lying down on his face.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا كَثِيرُ بْنُ هِشَامٍ، حَدَّثَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ بُرْقَانَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَنْ يَأْكُلَ الرَّجُلُ وَهُوَ مُنْبَطِحٌ عَلَى وَجْهِهِ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of  Food, Hadith 3370

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3371

chapter.englishTitle: Wine is the key to all evils

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Abu Darda’ said:
           ‘My close friend ﷺ advised me: ‘Do not drink wine, for it is the key to all evils.’”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Abu Darda’ said:
hadiths.body: ‘My close friend ﷺ advised me: ‘Do not drink wine, for it is the key to all evils.’”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ الْحَسَنِ الْمَرْوَزِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عَدِيٍّ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الْجَوْهَرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ رَاشِدٍ أَبِي مُحَمَّدٍ الْحِمَّانِيِّ، عَنْ شَهْرِ بْنِ حَوْشَبٍ، عَنْ أُمِّ الدَّرْدَاءِ، عَنْ أَبِي الدَّرْدَاءِ، قَالَ أَوْصَانِي خَلِيلِي ﷺ  " لاَ تَشْرَبِ الْخَمْرَ فَإِنَّهَا مِفْتَاحُ كُلِّ شَرٍّ " .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Drinks, Hadith 3371

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3372

chapter.englishTitle: Wine is the key to all evils

hadiths.englishRaw:
‘Ubadah bin Samit said:
           “I heard Khabbab bin Arat narrating that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: ‘Beware of wine! For its sins overwhelm other sins, just as the grapevine overwhelms other trees.’”
hadiths.narrator: ‘Ubadah bin Samit said:
hadiths.body: “I heard Khabbab bin Arat narrating that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: ‘Beware of wine! For its sins overwhelm other sins, just as the grapevine overwhelms other trees.’”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا الْعَبَّاسُ بْنُ عُثْمَانَ الدِّمَشْقِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُنِيرُ بْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ عُبَادَةَ بْنَ نُسَىٍّ، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ خَبَّابَ بْنَ الأَرَتِّ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَنَّهُ قَالَ  " إِيَّاكَ وَالْخَمْرَ فَإِنَّ خَطِيئَتَهَا تَفْرَعُ الْخَطَايَا كَمَا أَنَّ شَجَرَتَهَا تَفْرَعُ الشَّجَرَ " .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Drinks, Hadith 3372

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3373

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَنْ شَرِبَ الْخَمْرَ فِي الدُّنْيَا لَمْ يَشْرَبْهَا فِي الآخِرَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: Whoever drinks wine in this world, he will not drink it in the hereafter

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Ibn ‘Umar that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            “Whoever drinks wine in this world, he will not drink it in the Hereafter, unless he repents.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Ibn ‘Umar that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “Whoever drinks wine in this world, he will not drink it in the Hereafter, unless he repents.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ  " مَنْ شَرِبَ الْخَمْرَ فِي الدُّنْيَا لَمْ يَشْرَبْهَا فِي الآخِرَةِ إِلاَّ أَنْ يَتُوبَ " .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Drinks, Hadith 3373

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3374

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَنْ شَرِبَ الْخَمْرَ فِي الدُّنْيَا لَمْ يَشْرَبْهَا فِي الآخِرَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: Whoever drinks wine in this world, he will not drink it in the hereafter

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah narrated that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            “Whoever drinks wine in this world, he will not drink it in the Hereafter.”
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah narrated that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “Whoever drinks wine in this world, he will not drink it in the Hereafter.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَمْزَةَ، حَدَّثَنِي زَيْدُ بْنُ وَاقِدٍ، أَنَّ خَالِدَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ حُسَيْنٍ، حَدَّثَهُ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ  " مَنْ شَرِبَ الْخَمْرَ فِي الدُّنْيَا لَمْ يَشْرَبْهَا فِي الآخِرَةِ " .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Drinks, Hadith 3374

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3375

chapter.englishTitle: The one who is addicted to wine

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            “The one who is addicted to wine is like one who worships idols.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “The one who is addicted to wine is like one who worships idols.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الصَّبَّاحِ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ الأَصْبَهَانِيِّ، عَنْ سُهَيْلٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " مُدْمِنُ الْخَمْرِ كَعَابِدِ وَثَنٍ " .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Drinks, Hadith 3375

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3376

chapter.englishTitle: The one who is addicted to wine

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Darda’ that the Prophet ﷺ said:
           “No one who is addicted to wine will enter Paradise.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Darda’ that the Prophet ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “No one who is addicted to wine will enter Paradise.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ عُتْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنِي يُونُسُ بْنُ مَيْسَرَةَ بْنِ حَلْبَسٍ، عَنْ أَبِي إِدْرِيسَ، عَنْ أَبِي الدَّرْدَاءِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ  " لاَ يَدْخُلُ الْجَنَّةَ مُدْمِنُ خَمْرٍ " .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Drinks, Hadith 3376

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3377

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَنْ شَرِبَ الْخَمْرَ لَمْ تُقْبَلْ لَهُ صَلاَةٌ
chapter.englishTitle: If a person drinks wine, his prayer will not be accepted

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from ‘Abdullah bin ‘Amr that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
           “Whoever drinks wine and gets drunk, his prayer will not be accepted for forty days, and if he dies he will enter Hell, but if he repents, Allah will accept his repentance. If he drinks wine again and gets drunk, his prayer will not be accepted for forty days, and if he dies he will enter Hell, but if he repents, Allah will accept his repentance. If he drinks wine again and gets drunk, his prayer will not be accepted for forty days, and if he dies he will enter Hell, but if he repents Allah will accept his repentance. But if he does it again, then Allah will most certainly make him drink of the mire of the puss or sweat on the Day of Resurrection.” They said: “O Messenger of Allah, what is the mire of the pus or sweat? He said: “The drippings of the people of Hell.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from ‘Abdullah bin ‘Amr that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “Whoever drinks wine and gets drunk, his prayer will not be accepted for forty days, and if he dies he will enter Hell, but if he repents, Allah will accept his repentance. If he drinks wine again and gets drunk, his prayer will not be accepted for forty days, and if he dies he will enter Hell, but if he repents, Allah will accept his repentance. If he drinks wine again and gets drunk, his prayer will not be accepted for forty days, and if he dies he will enter Hell, but if he repents Allah will accept his repentance. But if he does it again, then Allah will most certainly make him drink of the mire of the puss or sweat on the Day of Resurrection.” They said: “O Messenger of Allah, what is the mire of the pus or sweat? He said: “The drippings of the people of Hell.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الدِّمَشْقِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَوْزَاعِيُّ، عَنْ رَبِيعَةَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ، عَنِ ابْنِ الدَّيْلَمِيِّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ " مَنْ شَرِبَ الْخَمْرَ وَسَكِرَ لَمْ تُقْبَلْ لَهُ صَلاَةٌ أَرْبَعِينَ صَبَاحًا وَإِنْ مَاتَ دَخَلَ النَّارَ فَإِنْ تَابَ تَابَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَإِنْ عَادَ فَشَرِبَ فَسَكِرَ لَمْ تُقْبَلْ لَهُ صَلاَةٌ أَرْبَعِينَ صَبَاحًا فَإِنْ مَاتَ دَخَلَ النَّارَ فَإِنْ تَابَ تَابَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَإِنْ عَادَ فَشَرِبَ فَسَكِرَ لَمْ تُقْبَلْ لَهُ صَلاَةٌ أَرْبَعِينَ صَبَاحًا فَإِنْ مَاتَ دَخَلَ النَّارَ فَإِنْ تَابَ تَابَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَإِنْ عَادَ كَانَ حَقًّا عَلَى اللَّهِ أَنْ يَسْقِيَهُ مِنْ رَدْغَةِ الْخَبَالِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ " . قَالُوا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ وَمَا رَدْغَةُ الْخَبَالِ قَالَ " عُصَارَةُ أَهْلِ النَّارِ " .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Drinks, Hadith 3377

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3378

chapter.englishTitle: What wine is made from

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            “Wine comes from these two trees: The date palm and the grapevine.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “Wine comes from these two trees: The date palm and the grapevine.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْيَمَامِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عِكْرِمَةُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كَثِيرٍ السُّحَيْمِيُّ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " الْخَمْرُ مِنْ هَاتَيْنِ الشَّجَرَتَيْنِ النَّخْلَةِ وَالْعِنَبَةِ " .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Drinks, Hadith 3378

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3379

chapter.englishTitle: What wine is made from

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Nu’man bin Bashir that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
           “From wheat comes wine, from barley comes wine, from raisins comes wine, from dates comes wine and from honey comes wine.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Nu’man bin Bashir that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “From wheat comes wine, from barley comes wine, from raisins comes wine, from dates comes wine and from honey comes wine.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رُمْحٍ، أَنْبَأَنَا اللَّيْثُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ، أَنَّ خَالِدَ بْنَ كَثِيرٍ الْهَمْدَانِيَّ، حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّ السَّرِيَّ بْنَ إِسْمَاعِيلَ حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّ الشَّعْبِيَّ حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّهُ، سَمِعَ النُّعْمَانَ بْنَ بَشِيرٍ، يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " إِنَّ مِنَ الْحِنْطَةِ خَمْرًا وَمِنَ الشَّعِيرِ خَمْرًا وَمِنَ الزَّبِيبِ خَمْرًا وَمِنَ التَّمْرِ خَمْرًا وَمِنَ الْعَسَلِ خَمْرًا " .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Drinks, Hadith 3379

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3380

chapter.arabicTitle: باب لُعِنَتِ الْخَمْرُ عَلَى عَشَرَةِ أَوْجُهٍ
chapter.englishTitle: Wine is cursed from ten angles

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Ibn ‘Umar that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            “Wine is cursed from ten angles: The wine itself, the one who squeezes (the grapes etc), the one for whom it is squeezed, the one who sells it, the one who buys it, the one who carries it, the one to whom it is carried, the one who consumes its price, the one who drinks it and the one who pours it.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Ibn ‘Umar that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “Wine is cursed from ten angles: The wine itself, the one who squeezes (the grapes etc), the one for whom it is squeezed, the one who sells it, the one who buys it, the one who carries it, the one to whom it is carried, the one who consumes its price, the one who drinks it and the one who pours it.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ عُمَرَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْغَافِقِيِّ، وَأَبِي، طُعْمَةَ مَوْلاَهُمْ أَنَّهُمَا سَمِعَا ابْنَ عُمَرَ، يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " لُعِنَتِ الْخَمْرُ عَلَى عَشَرَةِ أَوْجُهٍ بِعَيْنِهَا وَعَاصِرِهَا وَمُعْتَصِرِهَا وَبَائِعِهَا وَمُبْتَاعِهَا وَحَامِلِهَا وَالْمَحْمُولَةِ إِلَيْهِ وَآكِلِ ثَمَنِهَا وَشَارِبِهَا وَسَاقِيهَا " .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Drinks, Hadith 3380

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3381

chapter.arabicTitle: باب لُعِنَتِ الْخَمْرُ عَلَى عَشَرَةِ أَوْجُهٍ
chapter.englishTitle: Wine is cursed from ten angles

hadiths.englishRaw:
Anas said:
           “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ cursed ten with regard to wine: The one who squeezes (the grapes etc.), the one who asks for it to be squeezed, the one for whom it is squeezed, the one who carries it, the one to whom it is carried, the one who sells it, the one for whom it is brought, the one who pours it, the one for whom it is poured, until he counted ten like this.”
hadiths.narrator: Anas said:
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ cursed ten with regard to wine: The one who squeezes (the grapes etc.), the one who asks for it to be squeezed, the one for whom it is squeezed, the one who carries it, the one to whom it is carried, the one who sells it, the one for whom it is brought, the one who pours it, the one for whom it is poured, until he counted ten like this.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سَعِيدِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ التُّسْتَرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ، عَنْ شَبِيبٍ، سَمِعْتُ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ، - أَوْ حَدَّثَنِي أَنَسٌ، - قَالَ لَعَنَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ فِي الْخَمْرِ عَشَرَةً عَاصِرَهَا وَمُعْتَصِرَهَا وَالْمَعْصُورَةَ لَهُ وَحَامِلَهَا وَالْمَحْمُولَةَ لَهُ وَبَائِعَهَا وَالْمُبْتَاعَةَ لَهُ وَسَاقِيَهَا وَالْمُسْتَقَاةَ لَهُ " . حَتَّى عَدَّ عَشَرَةً مِنْ هَذَا الضَّرْبِ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Drinks, Hadith 3381

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3382

chapter.englishTitle: Dealing in wine

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that ‘Aishah said:
           “When the Verses at the end of Surat Al-Baqarah concerning usury were revealed, the Messenger of Allahﷺ went out and forbade dealing in wine.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that ‘Aishah said:
hadiths.body: “When the Verses at the end of Surat Al-Baqarah concerning usury were revealed, the Messenger of Allahﷺ went out and forbade dealing in wine.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَعَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، عَنْ مُسْلِمٍ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ لَمَّا نَزَلَتِ الآيَاتُ مِنْ آخِرِ سُورَةِ الْبَقَرَةِ فِي الرِّبَا خَرَجَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَحَرَّمَ التِّجَارَةَ فِي الْخَمْرِ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Drinks, Hadith 3382

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3383

chapter.englishTitle: Dealing in wine

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Ibn ‘Abbas said:
           Umar heard that Samurah had sold some wine, and he said: “May Allah ruin Samurah! Does he not know that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: ‘May Allah curse the Jews, for animal fat was forbidden to them, so they melted it down and sold it.’”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Ibn ‘Abbas said:
hadiths.body: Umar heard that Samurah had sold some wine, and he said: “May Allah ruin Samurah! Does he not know that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: ‘May Allah curse the Jews, for animal fat was forbidden to them, so they melted it down and sold it.’”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنْ طَاوُسٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ بَلَغَ عُمَرَ أَنَّ سَمُرَةَ، بَاعَ خَمْرًا فَقَالَ قَاتَلَ اللَّهُ سَمُرَةَ أَلَمْ يَعْلَمْ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ  " لَعَنَ اللَّهُ الْيَهُودَ حُرِّمَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ الشُّحُومُ فَجَمَلُوهَا فَبَاعُوهَا " .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Drinks, Hadith 3383

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3384

chapter.englishTitle: They will call wine by other names

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Umamah Al-Bahili that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
           “Night and day will not cease until a group among my nation drinks wine, calling it by some other name.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Umamah Al-Bahili that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “Night and day will not cease until a group among my nation drinks wine, calling it by some other name.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا الْعَبَّاسُ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ الدِّمَشْقِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ السَّلاَمِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْقُدُّوسِ، حَدَّثَنَا ثَوْرُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ، عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ مَعْدَانَ، عَنْ أَبِي أُمَامَةَ الْبَاهِلِيِّ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " لاَ تَذْهَبُ اللَّيَالِي وَالأَيَّامُ حَتَّى تَشْرَبَ طَائِفَةٌ مِنْ أُمَّتِي الْخَمْرَ يُسَمُّونَهَا بِغَيْرِ اسْمِهَا " .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Drinks, Hadith 3384

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3385

chapter.englishTitle: They will call wine by other names

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from ‘Ubadah bin Samit that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
           “People among my nation will drink wine, under some other name that they will give it.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from ‘Ubadah bin Samit that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “People among my nation will drink wine, under some other name that they will give it.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ أَبِي السَّرِيِّ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعْدُ بْنُ أَوْسٍ الْعَبْسِيُّ، عَنْ بِلاَلِ بْنِ يَحْيَى الْعَبْسِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ حَفْصٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ مُحَيْرِيزٍ، عَنْ ثَابِتِ بْنِ السِّمْطِ، عَنْ عُبَادَةَ بْنِ الصَّامِتِ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " يَشْرَبُ نَاسٌ مِنْ أُمَّتِي الْخَمْرَ بِاسْمٍ يُسَمُّونَهَا إِيَّاهُ " .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Drinks, Hadith 3385

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3386

chapter.englishTitle: Every intoxicant is haram

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from ‘Aishah, narrating it from the Prophet ﷺ:
            “Every drink that causes intoxication is unlawful.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from ‘Aishah, narrating it from the Prophet ﷺ:
hadiths.body: “Every drink that causes intoxication is unlawful.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، تَبْلُغُ بِهِ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ قَالَ  " كُلُّ شَرَابٍ أَسْكَرَ فَهُوَ حَرَامٌ " .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Drinks, Hadith 3386

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3387

chapter.englishTitle: Every intoxicant is haram

hadiths.englishRaw:
Salim bin ‘Abdullah bin ‘Umar narrated that his father said:
           “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: ‘Every intoxicant is unlawful.’”
hadiths.narrator: Salim bin ‘Abdullah bin ‘Umar narrated that his father said:
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: ‘Every intoxicant is unlawful.’”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا صَدَقَةُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ الْحَارِثِ الذِّمَارِيُّ، سَمِعْتُ سَالِمَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " كُلُّ مُسْكِرٍ حَرَامٌ " .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Drinks, Hadith 3387

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3388

chapter.englishTitle: Every intoxicant is haram

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Ibn Mas’ud that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            “Every intoxicant is unlawful.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Ibn Mas’ud that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “Every intoxicant is unlawful.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الأَعْلَى، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ بْنِ هَانِئٍ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ  " كُلُّ مُسْكِرٍ حَرَامٌ " . قَالَ ابْنُ مَاجَهْ هَذَا حَدِيثُ الْمِصْرِيِّينَ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Drinks, Hadith 3388

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3389

chapter.englishTitle: Every intoxicant is haram

hadiths.englishRaw:
Mu’awiyah said:
           “I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: ‘Every intoxicant is unlawful for every believer.’”
hadiths.narrator: Mu’awiyah said:
hadiths.body: “I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: ‘Every intoxicant is unlawful for every believer.’”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مَيْمُونٍ الرَّقِّيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ حَيَّانَ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الزِّبْرِقَانِ، عَنْ يَعْلَى بْنِ شَدَّادِ بْنِ أَوْسٍ، سَمِعْتُ مُعَاوِيَةَ، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ  " كُلُّ مُسْكِرٍ حَرَامٌ عَلَى كُلِّ مُؤْمِنٍ " . وَهَذَا حَدِيثُ الرَّقِّيِّينَ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Drinks, Hadith 3389

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3390

chapter.englishTitle: Every intoxicant is haram

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Ibn ‘Umar that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            “Every intoxicant is Khamr (wine) and every Khamr is unlawful.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Ibn ‘Umar that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “Every intoxicant is Khamr (wine) and every Khamr is unlawful.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا سَهْلٌ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ عَلْقَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " كُلُّ مُسْكِرٍ خَمْرٌ وَكُلُّ خَمْرٍ حَرَامٌ " .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Drinks, Hadith 3390

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3391

chapter.englishTitle: Every intoxicant is haram

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Musa that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            “Every intoxicant is unlawful.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Musa that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “Every intoxicant is unlawful.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " كُلُّ مُسْكِرٍ حَرَامٌ " .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Drinks, Hadith 3391

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3392

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا أَسْكَرَ كَثِيرُهُ فَقَلِيلُهُ حَرَامٌ
chapter.englishTitle: What causes intoxication in large amounts, a small amount of it is (also) unlawful

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from ‘Abdullah bin ‘Umar that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
           “Every intoxicant is unlawful and whatever causes intoxication in large amounts, a small amount of it is (also) unlawful.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from ‘Abdullah bin ‘Umar that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “Every intoxicant is unlawful and whatever causes intoxication in large amounts, a small amount of it is (also) unlawful.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ الْمُنْذِرِ الْحِزَامِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو يَحْيَى، زَكَرِيَّا بْنُ مَنْظُورٍ عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " كُلُّ مُسْكِرٍ حَرَامٌ وَمَا أَسْكَرَ كَثِيرُهُ فَقَلِيلُهُ حَرَامٌ " .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Drinks, Hadith 3392

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3393

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا أَسْكَرَ كَثِيرُهُ فَقَلِيلُهُ حَرَامٌ
chapter.englishTitle: What causes intoxication in large amounts, a small amount of it is (also) unlawful

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Jabir bin ‘Abdullah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
           “Whatever causes intoxication in large amounts, a small amount of it is (also) unlawful.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Jabir bin ‘Abdullah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “Whatever causes intoxication in large amounts, a small amount of it is (also) unlawful.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَنَسُ بْنُ عِيَاضٍ، حَدَّثَنِي دَاوُدُ بْنُ بَكْرٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْمُنْكَدِرِ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ  " مَا أَسْكَرَ كَثِيرُهُ فَقَلِيلُهُ حَرَامٌ " .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Drinks, Hadith 3393

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3394

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا أَسْكَرَ كَثِيرُهُ فَقَلِيلُهُ حَرَامٌ
chapter.englishTitle: What causes intoxication in large amounts, a small amount of it is (also) unlawful

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from ‘Amr bin Shu’aib, from his father, from his grandfather, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
           “Whatever causes intoxication in large amounts a small amount of it is (also) unlawful.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from ‘Amr bin Shu’aib, from his father, from his grandfather, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “Whatever causes intoxication in large amounts a small amount of it is (also) unlawful.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَنَسُ بْنُ عِيَاضٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ شُعَيْبٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ  " مَا أَسْكَرَ كَثِيرُهُ فَقَلِيلُهُ حَرَامٌ " .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Drinks, Hadith 3394

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3395

chapter.englishTitle: The prohibition of mixing two fruits

hadiths.englishRaw: It was narrated from Jabir bin ‘Abdullah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade making Nabidh* with dates and raisins together, or with unripe dates and fresh dates together.”
hadiths.body: It was narrated from Jabir bin ‘Abdullah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade making Nabidh* with dates and raisins together, or with unripe dates and fresh dates together.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رُمْحٍ، أَنْبَأَنَا اللَّيْثُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ نَهَى أَنْ يُنْبَذَ التَّمْرُ وَالزَّبِيبُ جَمِيعًا وَنَهَى أَنْ يُنْبَذَ الْبُسْرُ وَالرُّطَبُ جَمِيعًا .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Drinks, Hadith 3395

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3396

chapter.englishTitle: The prohibition of mixing two fruits

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            ‘Do not make Nabidh with dried dates and unripe dates together, make Nabidh with each of them on its own.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: ‘Do not make Nabidh with dried dates and unripe dates together, make Nabidh with each of them on its own.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْيَمَامِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عِكْرِمَةُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، عَنْ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " لاَ تَنْبِذُوا التَّمْرَ وَالْبُسْرَ جَمِيعًا وَانْبِذُوا كُلَّ وَاحِدٍ مِنْهُمَا عَلَى حِدَتِهِ " .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Drinks, Hadith 3396

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3397

chapter.englishTitle: The prohibition of mixing two fruits

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from ‘Abdullah bin Abu Qatadah, from his father, that he heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say:
           “Do not combine fresh dates and unripe dates, or raisins and dates; rather make Nabidh with each one of them on its own.”*
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from ‘Abdullah bin Abu Qatadah, from his father, that he heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say:
hadiths.body: “Do not combine fresh dates and unripe dates, or raisins and dates; rather make Nabidh with each one of them on its own.”*
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَوْزَاعِيُّ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ  " لاَ تَجْمَعُوا بَيْنَ الرُّطَبِ وَالزَّهْوِ وَلاَ بَيْنَ الزَّبِيبِ وَالتَّمْرِ وَانْبِذُوا كُلَّ وَاحِدٍ مِنْهُمَا عَلَى حِدَتِهِ " .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Drinks, Hadith 3397

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3398

chapter.englishTitle: Description of Nabidh and how it is drunk

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that ‘Aishah said:
           “We used to make Nabidh for the Messenger of Allah ﷺ in a water skin. We would take a handful of dates or a handful of raisins, and put them in it, then pour water over it. We would make that in the morning and he would rink it in the evening, or we would make it in the evening and he would drink it in the morning.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that ‘Aishah said:
hadiths.body: “We used to make Nabidh for the Messenger of Allah ﷺ in a water skin. We would take a handful of dates or a handful of raisins, and put them in it, then pour water over it. We would make that in the morning and he would rink it in the evening, or we would make it in the evening and he would drink it in the morning.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ أَبِي الشَّوَارِبِ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ بْنُ زِيَادٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا عَاصِمٌ الأَحْوَلُ، حَدَّثَتْنَا بَنَانَةُ بِنْتُ يَزِيدَ الْعَبْشَمِيَّةُ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ كُنَّا نَنْبِذُ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فِي سِقَاءٍ فَنَأْخُذُ قَبْضَةً مِنْ تَمْرٍ أَوْ قَبْضَةً مِنْ زَبِيبٍ فَنَطْرَحُهَا فِيهِ ثُمَّ نَصُبُّ عَلَيْهِ الْمَاءَ فَنَنْبِذُهُ غُدْوَةً فَيَشْرَبُهُ عَشِيَّةً وَنَنْبِذُهُ عَشِيَّةً فَيَشْرَبُهُ غُدْوَةً . وَقَالَ أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ نَهَارًا فَيَشْرَبُهُ لَيْلاً أَوْ لَيْلاً فَيَشْرَبُهُ نَهَارًا .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Drinks, Hadith 3398

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3399

chapter.englishTitle: Description of Nabidh and how it is drunk

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Ibn ‘Abbas said:
           “Nabidh would be made for the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and he would drink it on the same day, or the next day, or the third day, and if there was any left he would throw it away or give orders that it was to be thrown away.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Ibn ‘Abbas said:
hadiths.body: “Nabidh would be made for the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and he would drink it on the same day, or the next day, or the third day, and if there was any left he would throw it away or give orders that it was to be thrown away.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ صَبِيحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْرَائِيلَ، عَنْ أَبِي عُمَرَ الْبَهْرَانِيِّ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ كَانَ يُنْبَذُ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَيَشْرَبُهُ يَوْمَهُ ذَلِكَ وَالْغَدَ وَالْيَوْمَ الثَّالِثَ فَإِنْ بَقِيَ مِنْهُ شَىْءٌ أَهْرَاقَهُ أَوْ أَمَرَ بِهِ فَأُهْرِيقَ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Drinks, Hadith 3399

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3400

chapter.englishTitle: Description of Nabidh and how it is drunk

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Jabir bin ‘Abdullah said:
           “Nabidh would be made for the Messenger of Allah ﷺ in a vessel of stone.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Jabir bin ‘Abdullah said:
hadiths.body: “Nabidh would be made for the Messenger of Allah ﷺ in a vessel of stone.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ أَبِي الشَّوَارِبِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ كَانَ يُنْبَذُ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فِي تَوْرٍ مِنْ حِجَارَةٍ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Drinks, Hadith 3400

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3401

chapter.englishTitle: The prohibition of making Nabidh in certain vessels

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Abu Hurairah said:
           “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade making Nabidh in Naqir, Muzaffat, Dubba’, and Hantamah. And he said: ‘Every intoxicant is unlawful.”*
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Abu Hurairah said:
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade making Nabidh in Naqir, Muzaffat, Dubba’, and Hantamah. And he said: ‘Every intoxicant is unlawful.”*
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بِشْرٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَنْ يُنْبَذَ فِي النَّقِيرِ وَالْمُزَفَّتِ وَالدُّبَّاءِ وَالْحَنْتَمَةِ وَقَالَ  " كُلُّ مُسْكِرٍ حَرَامٌ " .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Drinks, Hadith 3401

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3402

chapter.englishTitle: The prohibition of making Nabidh in certain vessels

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Ibn ‘Umar said:
           “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade making Nabidh in Muzaffat or a gourd.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Ibn ‘Umar said:
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade making Nabidh in Muzaffat or a gourd.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رُمْحٍ، أَنْبَأَنَا اللَّيْثُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَنْ يُنْبَذَ فِي الْمُزَفَّتِ وَالْقَرْعِ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Drinks, Hadith 3402

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3403

chapter.englishTitle: The prohibition of making Nabidh in certain vessels

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Abu Sa’eed Al-Khudri said:
           “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade drinking from Hantam, Dubba’ and Naqir.
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Abu Sa’eed Al-Khudri said:
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade drinking from Hantam, Dubba’ and Naqir.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا نَصْرُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، عَنِ الْمُثَنَّى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الْمُتَوَكِّلِ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، قَالَ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَنِ الشُّرْبِ فِي الْحَنْتَمِ وَالدُّبَّاءِ وَالنَّقِيرِ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Drinks, Hadith 3403

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3404

chapter.englishTitle: The prohibition of making Nabidh in certain vessels

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that ‘Abdur-Rahman bin Ya’mar said:
           “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade Dubba’ and Hantam.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that ‘Abdur-Rahman bin Ya’mar said:
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade Dubba’ and Hantam.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ، وَالْعَبَّاسُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْعَظِيمِ الْعَنْبَرِيُّ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا شَبَابَةُ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ بُكَيْرِ بْنِ عَطَاءٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ يَعْمَرَ، قَالَ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَنِ الدُّبَّاءِ وَالْحَنْتَمِ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Drinks, Hadith 3404

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3405

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا رُخِّصَ فِيهِ مِنْ ذَلِكَ
chapter.englishTitle: Concessions regarding that

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Ibn Buraidah from his father that the Prophet ﷺ said:
           “I used to forbid you to use certain vessels, but now make Nabidh in them, but avoid all intoxicants.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Ibn Buraidah from his father that the Prophet ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “I used to forbid you to use certain vessels, but now make Nabidh in them, but avoid all intoxicants.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْحَمِيدِ بْنُ بَيَانٍ الْوَاسِطِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، عَنْ شَرِيكٍ، عَنْ سِمَاكٍ، عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مُخَيْمِرَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ بُرَيْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ  " كُنْتُ نَهَيْتُكُمْ عَنِ الأَوْعِيَةِ فَانْتَبِذُوا فِيهِ وَاجْتَنِبُوا كُلَّ مُسْكِرٍ " .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Drinks, Hadith 3405

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3406

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا رُخِّصَ فِيهِ مِنْ ذَلِكَ
chapter.englishTitle: Concessions regarding that

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Ibn Mas’ud that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
           “I used to forbid you from making Nabidh in certain vessels, but a vessel does not make something unlawful. All intoxicants are unlawful.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Ibn Mas’ud that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “I used to forbid you from making Nabidh in certain vessels, but a vessel does not make something unlawful. All intoxicants are unlawful.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الأَعْلَى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَنْبَأَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ بْنِ هَانِئٍ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقِ بْنِ الأَجْدَعِ، عَنِ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ  " إِنِّي كُنْتُ نَهَيْتُكُمْ عَنْ نَبِيذِ الأَوْعِيَةِ أَلاَ وَإِنَّ وِعَاءً لاَ يُحَرِّمُ شَيْئًا كُلُّ مُسْكِرٍ حَرَامٌ " .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Drinks, Hadith 3406

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3407

chapter.englishTitle: Nabidh made in (earthenware) jars

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that ‘Aishah said:
           “Is anyone of you incapable of taking a water skin from the skin of her sacrifice each year?” Then she said: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade making Nabidh in (earthenware) jars, and in such and such, and such and such, except for vinegar.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that ‘Aishah said:
hadiths.body: “Is anyone of you incapable of taking a water skin from the skin of her sacrifice each year?” Then she said: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade making Nabidh in (earthenware) jars, and in such and such, and such and such, except for vinegar.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا سُوَيْدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْمُعْتَمِرُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، حَدَّثَتْنِي رُمَيْثَةُ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ أَتَعْجِزُ إِحْدَاكُنَّ أَنْ تَتَّخِذَ كُلَّ عَامٍ مِنْ جِلْدِ أُضْحِيَّتِهَا سِقَاءً ثُمَّ قَالَتْ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَنْ يُنْبَذَ فِي الْجَرِّ وَفِي كَذَا وَفِي كَذَا إِلاَّ الْخَلَّ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Drinks, Hadith 3407

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3408

chapter.englishTitle: Nabidh made in (earthenware) jars

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Abu Hurairah said:
           “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade making Nabidh in (earthenware) jars.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Abu Hurairah said:
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade making Nabidh in (earthenware) jars.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مُوسَى الْخَطْمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَوْزَاعِيُّ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَنْ يُنْبَذَ فِي الْجِرَارِ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Drinks, Hadith 3408

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3409

chapter.englishTitle: Nabidh made in (earthenware) jars

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Abu Hurairah said:
           “Some Nabidh from an (earthenware) jar was brought to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and it was bubbling. He said: ‘Throw this against the wall, for this is the drink of one who does not believe in Allah and the Last Day.’”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Abu Hurairah said:
hadiths.body: “Some Nabidh from an (earthenware) jar was brought to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and it was bubbling. He said: ‘Throw this against the wall, for this is the drink of one who does not believe in Allah and the Last Day.’”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُجَاهِدُ بْنُ مُوسَى، حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ، عَنْ صَدَقَةَ أَبِي مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ وَاقِدٍ، عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ أُتِيَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ بِنَبِيذِ جَرٍّ يَنِشُّ فَقَالَ  " اضْرِبْ بِهَذَا الْحَائِطَ فَإِنَّ هَذَا شَرَابُ مَنْ لاَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ " .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Drinks, Hadith 3409

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3410

chapter.englishTitle: Covering vessels

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Jabir bin ‘Abdullah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
           “Cover your vessels, tie your water skins, extinguish your lamps and lock your doors, for Satan does not untie a water skin, open a door or uncover a vessel. If a person cannot find anything but a stick with which to cover his vessel and mention the Name of Allah, then let him do so. And the mouse could set fire to the house with its people inside.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Jabir bin ‘Abdullah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “Cover your vessels, tie your water skins, extinguish your lamps and lock your doors, for Satan does not untie a water skin, open a door or uncover a vessel. If a person cannot find anything but a stick with which to cover his vessel and mention the Name of Allah, then let him do so. And the mouse could set fire to the house with its people inside.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رُمْحٍ، أَنْبَأَنَا اللَّيْثُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَنَّهُ قَالَ  " غَطُّوا الإِنَاءَ وَأَوْكُوا السِّقَاءَ وَأَطْفِئُوا السِّرَاجَ وَأَغْلِقُوا الْبَابَ فَإِنَّ الشَّيْطَانَ لاَ يَحُلُّ سِقَاءً وَلاَ يَفْتَحُ بَابًا وَلاَ يَكْشِفُ إِنَاءً فَإِنْ لَمْ يَجِدْ أَحَدُكُمْ إِلاَّ أَنْ يَعْرُضَ عَلَى إِنَائِهِ عُودًا وَيَذْكُرَ اسْمَ اللَّهِ فَلْيَفْعَلْ فَإِنَّ الْفُوَيْسِقَةَ تُضْرِمُ عَلَى أَهْلِ الْبَيْتِ بَيْتَهُمْ " .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Drinks, Hadith 3410

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3411

chapter.englishTitle: Covering vessels

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Abu Hurairah said:
           “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ commanded us to cover our vessels, tie up our water skins and turn over our vessels.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Abu Hurairah said:
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ commanded us to cover our vessels, tie up our water skins and turn over our vessels.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْحَمِيدِ بْنُ بَيَانٍ الْوَاسِطِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ سُهَيْلٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ أَمَرَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ بِتَغْطِيَةِ الإِنَاءِ وَإِيكَاءِ السِّقَاءِ وَإِكْفَاءِ الإِنَاءِ " .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Drinks, Hadith 3411

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3412

chapter.englishTitle: Covering vessels

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that ‘Aishah said:
           “I used to prepare three covered vessels for the Messenger of Allah ﷺ at night: A vessel for his water for purification, a vessel for his tooth stick and a vessel for his drink.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that ‘Aishah said:
hadiths.body: “I used to prepare three covered vessels for the Messenger of Allah ﷺ at night: A vessel for his water for purification, a vessel for his tooth stick and a vessel for his drink.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عِصْمَةُ بْنُ الْفَضْلِ، حَدَّثَنَا حَرَمِيُّ بْنُ عُمَارَةَ بْنِ أَبِي حَفْصَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا حَرِيشُ بْنُ خِرِّيتٍ، أَنْبَأَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي مُلَيْكَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ كُنْتُ أَصْنَعُ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ ثَلاَثَةَ آنِيَةٍ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ مُخَمَّرَةً إِنَاءً لِطَهُورِهِ وَإِنَاءً لِسِوَاكِهِ وَإِنَاءً لِشَرَابِهِ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Drinks, Hadith 3412

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3413

chapter.englishTitle: Drinking from a silver vessel

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Umm Salamah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            “The one who drinks from a silver vessel is swallowing Hell-fire into his belly.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Umm Salamah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “The one who drinks from a silver vessel is swallowing Hell-fire into his belly.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رُمْحٍ، أَنْبَأَنَا اللَّيْثُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ، عَنْ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ، أَنَّهَا أَخْبَرَتْهُ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ  " إِنَّ الَّذِي يَشْرَبُ فِي إِنَاءِ الْفِضَّةِ إِنَّمَا يُجَرْجِرُ فِي بَطْنِهِ نَارَ جَهَنَّمَ " .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Drinks, Hadith 3413

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3414

chapter.englishTitle: Drinking from a silver vessel

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Hudhaifah said:
           “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade drinking from vessels of gold and silver. He said: “They are for them in this world and for you in the Hereafter.’”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Hudhaifah said:
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade drinking from vessels of gold and silver. He said: “They are for them in this world and for you in the Hereafter.’”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ أَبِي الشَّوَارِبِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي بِشْرٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى، عَنْ حُذَيْفَةَ، قَالَ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَنِ الشُّرْبِ فِي آنِيَةِ الذَّهَبِ وَالْفِضَّةِ وَقَالَ  " هِيَ لَهُمْ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَهِيَ لَكُمْ فِي الآخِرَةِ " .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Drinks, Hadith 3414

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3415

chapter.englishTitle: Drinking from a silver vessel

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from ‘Aishah that the Prophet ﷺ said:
           “Whoever drinks from a silver vessel, it is as if he is swallowing Hell-fire into his belly.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from ‘Aishah that the Prophet ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “Whoever drinks from a silver vessel, it is as if he is swallowing Hell-fire into his belly.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا غُنْدَرٌ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ امْرَأَةِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ  " مَنْ شَرِبَ فِي إِنَاءِ فِضَّةٍ فَكَأَنَّمَا يُجَرْجِرُ فِي بَطْنِهِ نَارَ جَهَنَّمَ " .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Drinks, Hadith 3415

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3416

chapter.englishTitle: Drinking in three draughts

hadiths.englishRaw: It was narrated from Anas that he used to drink from a vessel in three draughts, and Anas said that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to drink from a vessel in three draughts.
hadiths.body: It was narrated from Anas that he used to drink from a vessel in three draughts, and Anas said that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to drink from a vessel in three draughts.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَزْرَةُ بْنُ ثَابِتٍ الأَنْصَارِيُّ، عَنْ ثُمَامَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَتَنَفَّسُ فِي الإِنَاءِ ثَلاَثًا وَزَعَمَ أَنَسٌ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ كَانَ يَتَنَفَّسُ فِي الإِنَاءِ ثَلاَثًا .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Drinks, Hadith 3416

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3417

chapter.englishTitle: Drinking in three draughts

hadiths.englishRaw: It was narrated from Ibn ‘Abbas that the Prophet ﷺ drank, and took two breaths while doing so.
hadiths.body: It was narrated from Ibn ‘Abbas that the Prophet ﷺ drank, and took two breaths while doing so.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الصَّبَّاحِ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مَرْوَانُ بْنُ مُعَاوِيَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا رِشْدِينُ بْنُ كُرَيْبٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ شَرِبَ فَتَنَفَّسَ فِيهِ مَرَّتَيْنِ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Drinks, Hadith 3417

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3418

chapter.englishTitle: Tipping up water skins

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Abu Sa’eed Al-Khudri said:
           “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade tipping up water skins in order to drink from their mouths.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Abu Sa’eed Al-Khudri said:
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade tipping up water skins in order to drink from their mouths.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَمْرِو بْنِ السَّرْحِ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، عَنْ يُونُسَ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، قَالَ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَنِ اخْتِنَاثِ الأَسْقِيَةِ أَنْ يُشْرَبَ مِنْ أَفْوَاهِهَا .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Drinks, Hadith 3418

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3419

chapter.englishTitle: Tipping up water skins

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Ibn ‘Abbas said:
           “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade tipping up water skins. After the Messenger of Allah ﷺ had forbidden that, a man got up at night and tipped up a water skin, and a snake fell out of it onto him.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Ibn ‘Abbas said:
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade tipping up water skins. After the Messenger of Allah ﷺ had forbidden that, a man got up at night and tipped up a water skin, and a snake fell out of it onto him.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَامِرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا زَمْعَةُ بْنُ صَالِحٍ، عَنْ سَلَمَةَ بْنِ وَهْرَامَ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَنِ اخْتِنَاثِ الأَسْقِيَةِ وَإِنَّ رَجُلاً بَعْدَمَا نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَنْ ذَلِكَ قَامَ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ إِلَى سِقَاءٍ فَاخْتَنَثَهُ فَخَرَجَتْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْهُ حَيَّةٌ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Drinks, Hadith 3419

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3420

chapter.englishTitle: Drinking from the mouth of a water skin

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Abu Hurairah said:
           “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade drinking (directly) from the mouth of a water skin.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Abu Hurairah said:
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade drinking (directly) from the mouth of a water skin.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ هِلاَلٍ الصَّوَّافُ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَارِثِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَنِ الشُّرْبِ مِنْ فِي السِّقَاءِ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Drinks, Hadith 3420

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3421

chapter.englishTitle: Drinking from the mouth of a water skin

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Ibn ‘Abbas said:
           “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade drinking (directly) from the mouth of a water skin.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Ibn ‘Abbas said:
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade drinking (directly) from the mouth of a water skin.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا بَكْرُ بْنُ خَلَفٍ أَبُو بِشْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ الْحَذَّاءُ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ نَهَى أَنْ يُشْرَبَ مِنْ فَمِ السِّقَاءِ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Drinks, Hadith 3421

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3422

chapter.englishTitle: Drinking while standing up

hadiths.englishRaw:
‘Asim narrated from Sha’bi, from Ibn ‘Abbas who said:
           “I drew water from Zamzam for the Prophet ﷺ and he drank standing up.”
hadiths.narrator: ‘Asim narrated from Sha’bi, from Ibn ‘Abbas who said:
hadiths.body: “I drew water from Zamzam for the Prophet ﷺ and he drank standing up.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا سُوَيْدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُسْهِرٍ، عَنْ عَاصِمٍ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ سَقَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ مِنْ زَمْزَمَ فَشَرِبَ قَائِمًا . فَذَكَرْتُ ذَلِكَ لِعِكْرِمَةَ فَحَلَفَ بِاللَّهِ مَا فَعَلَ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Drinks, Hadith 3422

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3423

chapter.englishTitle: Drinking while standing up

hadiths.englishRaw: It was narrated from ‘Abdur-Rahman bin Abi ‘Amrah, from a grandmother of his who was called Kabshah Al-Ansariyyah, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ entered upon her, and there was a water skin hanging there. He drank from it while standing, and she cut off the mouth of the water skin, seeking the blessing of the place where the mouth of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ had been.
hadiths.body: It was narrated from ‘Abdur-Rahman bin Abi ‘Amrah, from a grandmother of his who was called Kabshah Al-Ansariyyah, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ entered upon her, and there was a water skin hanging there. He drank from it while standing, and she cut off the mouth of the water skin, seeking the blessing of the place where the mouth of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ had been.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الصَّبَّاحِ، أَنْبَأَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ بْنِ جَابِرٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي عَمْرَةَ، عَنْ جَدَّةٍ، لَهُ يُقَالُ لَهَا كَبْشَةُ الأَنْصَارِيَّةُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ دَخَلَ عَلَيْهَا وَعِنْدَهَا قِرْبَةٌ مُعَلَّقَةٌ فَشَرِبَ مِنْهَا وَهُوَ قَائِمٌ فَقَطَعَتْ فَمَ الْقِرْبَةِ تَبْتَغِي بَرَكَةَ مَوْضِعِ فِي رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Drinks, Hadith 3423

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3424

chapter.englishTitle: Drinking while standing up

hadiths.englishRaw: It was narrated from Anas that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade drinking while standing up.
hadiths.body: It was narrated from Anas that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade drinking while standing up.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا حُمَيْدُ بْنُ مَسْعَدَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ الْمُفَضَّلِ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدٌ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ نَهَى عَنِ الشُّرْبِ قَائِمًا .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Drinks, Hadith 3424

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3425

chapter.arabicTitle: باب إِذَا شَرِبَ أَعْطَى الأَيْمَنَ فَالأَيْمَنَ
chapter.englishTitle: When drinking, the (vessel) should be passed around to the right

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Anas bin Malik that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was brought some milk mixed with water. On his right there was a Bedouin and on his left was Abu Bakr. He drank some, then he gave it to the Bedouin and said:
           “Pass it around to the right.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Anas bin Malik that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was brought some milk mixed with water. On his right there was a Bedouin and on his left was Abu Bakr. He drank some, then he gave it to the Bedouin and said:
hadiths.body: “Pass it around to the right.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ أُتِيَ بِلَبَنٍ قَدْ شِيبَ بِمَاءٍ وَعَنْ يَمِينِهِ أَعْرَابِيٌّ وَعَنْ يَسَارِهِ أَبُو بَكْرٍ فَشَرِبَ ثُمَّ أَعْطَى الأَعْرَابِيَّ وَقَالَ  " الأَيْمَنُ فَالأَيْمَنُ " .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Drinks, Hadith 3425

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3426

chapter.arabicTitle: باب إِذَا شَرِبَ أَعْطَى الأَيْمَنَ فَالأَيْمَنَ
chapter.englishTitle: When drinking, the (vessel) should be passed around to the right

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Ibn ‘Abbas said:
           “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ was brought some milk. On his right was Ibn ‘Abbas and on his left was Khalid bin Walid. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to Ibn ‘Abbas: ‘Will you permit me to give Khalid to drink?’ Ibn ‘Abbas said: ‘I would not like to give preference to anyone over myself when it comes to the leftover drink of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. So Ibn ‘Abbas took it and drank some, then Khalid drank some.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Ibn ‘Abbas said:
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ was brought some milk. On his right was Ibn ‘Abbas and on his left was Khalid bin Walid. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to Ibn ‘Abbas: ‘Will you permit me to give Khalid to drink?’ Ibn ‘Abbas said: ‘I would not like to give preference to anyone over myself when it comes to the leftover drink of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. So Ibn ‘Abbas took it and drank some, then Khalid drank some.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ عَيَّاشٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ أُتِيَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ بِلَبَنٍ وَعَنْ يَمِينِهِ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ وَعَنْ يَسَارِهِ خَالِدُ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ لاِبْنِ عَبَّاسٍ  " أَتَأْذَنُ لِي أَنْ أَسْقِيَ خَالِدًا " . قَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ مَا أُحِبُّ أَنْ أُوثِرَ بِسُؤْرِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَلَى نَفْسِي أَحَدًا . فَأَخَذَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ فَشَرِبَ وَشَرِبَ خَالِدٌ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Drinks, Hadith 3426

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3427

chapter.englishTitle: Breathing into the vessel

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            “When anyone of you drinks, let him not breathe into the vessel. If he wants to continue drinking, let him move the vessel away (in order to breathe) then bring it back, if he wants.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “When anyone of you drinks, let him not breathe into the vessel. If he wants to continue drinking, let him move the vessel away (in order to breathe) then bring it back, if he wants.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا دَاوُدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنِ الْحَارِثِ بْنِ أَبِي ذُبَابٍ، عَنْ عَمِّهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " إِذَا شَرِبَ أَحَدُكُمْ فَلاَ يَتَنَفَّسْ فِي الإِنَاءِ فَإِذَا أَرَادَ أَنْ يَعُودَ فَلْيُنَحِّ الإِنَاءَ ثُمَّ لْيَعُدْ إِنْ كَانَ يُرِيدُ " .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Drinks, Hadith 3427

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3428

chapter.englishTitle: Breathing into the vessel

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Ibn ‘Abbas said:
           “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade breathing into the vessel.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Ibn ‘Abbas said:
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade breathing into the vessel.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا بَكْرُ بْنُ خَلَفٍ أَبُو بِشْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ، عَنْ خَالِدٍ الْحَذَّاءِ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَنِ التَّنَفُّسِ فِي الإِنَاءِ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Drinks, Hadith 3428

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3429

chapter.englishTitle: Blowing into the drink

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Ibn ‘Abbas said:
           “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade blowing into the vessel.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Ibn ‘Abbas said:
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade blowing into the vessel.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ خَلاَّدٍ الْبَاهِلِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْكَرِيمِ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَنْ يُنْفَخَ فِي الإِنَاءِ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Drinks, Hadith 3429

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3430

chapter.englishTitle: Blowing into the drink

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Ibn ‘Abbas said:
           “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ did not blow into his drinks.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Ibn ‘Abbas said:
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ did not blow into his drinks.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحِيمِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْمُحَارِبِيُّ، عَنْ شَرِيكٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْكَرِيمِ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ لَمْ يَكُنْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَنْفُخُ فِي الشَّرَابِ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Drinks, Hadith 3430

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3431

chapter.englishTitle: Drinking from one’s hand and lapping up water (like an animal)

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from ‘Asim bin Muhammad bin Zaid bin ‘Abdullah, from his father, that his grandfather said:
           “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade us to drink while (lying) on our bellies, lapping up water, and he forbade us to drink from one hand only. He said: ‘None of you should lap up water as a dog does, and he should not drink water from one hand as the people with whom Allah is angry do, and he should not drink from a vessel at night without stirring it first, unless the vessel was covered. Whoever drinks from his hand when he is able to drink from a vessel, with the intention of humility, Allah will record good deeds equivalent to the number of fingers for him. It (i.e., the hand) is the vessel of ‘Eisa bin Maryam, (as) when he threw away the cup and said: ‘Ugh! That belongs to this world.’”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from ‘Asim bin Muhammad bin Zaid bin ‘Abdullah, from his father, that his grandfather said:
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade us to drink while (lying) on our bellies, lapping up water, and he forbade us to drink from one hand only. He said: ‘None of you should lap up water as a dog does, and he should not drink water from one hand as the people with whom Allah is angry do, and he should not drink from a vessel at night without stirring it first, unless the vessel was covered. Whoever drinks from his hand when he is able to drink from a vessel, with the intention of humility, Allah will record good deeds equivalent to the number of fingers for him. It (i.e., the hand) is the vessel of ‘Eisa bin Maryam, (as) when he threw away the cup and said: ‘Ugh! That belongs to this world.’”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُصَفَّى الْحِمْصِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا بَقِيَّةُ، عَنْ مُسْلِمِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ زِيَادِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ عَاصِمِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ زَيْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ، قَالَ نَهَانَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَنْ نَشْرَبَ عَلَى بُطُونِنَا وَهُوَ الْكَرْعُ وَنَهَانَا أَنْ نَغْتَرِفَ بِالْيَدِ الْوَاحِدَةِ وَقَالَ  " لاَ يَلَغْ أَحَدُكُمْ كَمَا يَلَغُ الْكَلْبُ وَلاَ يَشْرَبْ بِالْيَدِ الْوَاحِدَةِ كَمَا يَشْرَبُ الْقَوْمُ الَّذِينَ سَخِطَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلاَ يَشْرَبْ بِاللَّيْلِ مِنْ إِنَاءٍ حَتَّى يُحَرِّكَهُ إِلاَّ أَنْ يَكُونَ إِنَاءً مُخَمَّرًا وَمَنْ شَرِبَ بِيَدِهِ وَهُوَ يَقْدِرُ عَلَى إِنَاءٍ يُرِيدُ التَّوَاضُعَ كَتَبَ اللَّهُ لَهُ بِعَدَدِ أَصَابِعِهِ حَسَنَاتٍ وَهُوَ إِنَاءُ عِيسَى ابْنِ مَرْيَمَ عَلَيْهِمَا السَّلاَمُ إِذْ طَرَحَ الْقَدَحَ فَقَالَ أُفٍّ هَذَا مَعَ الدُّنْيَا " .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Drinks, Hadith 3431

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3432

chapter.englishTitle: Drinking from one’s hand and lapping up water (like an animal)

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Jabir bin ‘Abdullah said:
           “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ entered upon a man among the Ansar when he was watering his garden. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to him: ‘If you have any water that has been kept overnight in a water skin, then give us some to drink, otherwise we will drink by putting out mouths in the basin.’ He said: ‘I have water that has been kept in a water skin. So he went and we went with him, to the shelter, where he milked a sheep for him and (mixed it with) the water that had been kept overnight in a water skin. He drank from it, then he did likewise for his Companion who was with him.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Jabir bin ‘Abdullah said:
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ entered upon a man among the Ansar when he was watering his garden. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to him: ‘If you have any water that has been kept overnight in a water skin, then give us some to drink, otherwise we will drink by putting out mouths in the basin.’ He said: ‘I have water that has been kept in a water skin. So he went and we went with him, to the shelter, where he milked a sheep for him and (mixed it with) the water that had been kept overnight in a water skin. He drank from it, then he did likewise for his Companion who was with him.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ أَبُو بَكْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا فُلَيْحُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ دَخَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَلَى رَجُلٍ مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ وَهُوَ يُحَوِّلُ الْمَاءَ فِي حَائِطِهِ فَقَالَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " إِنْ كَانَ عِنْدَكَ مَاءٌ بَاتَ فِي شَنٍّ فَاسْقِنَا وَإِلاَّ كَرَعْنَا " . قَالَ عِنْدِي مَاءٌ بَاتَ فِي شَنٍّ . فَانْطَلَقَ وَانْطَلَقْنَا مَعَهُ إِلَى الْعَرِيشِ فَحَلَبَ لَهُ شَاةً عَلَى مَاءٍ بَاتَ فِي شَنٍّ فَشَرِبَ ثُمَّ فَعَلَ مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ بِصَاحِبِهِ الَّذِي مَعَهُ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Drinks, Hadith 3432

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3433

chapter.englishTitle: Drinking from one’s hand and lapping up water (like an animal)

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Ibn ‘Umar said:
           “We passed by a pond and we started to lap up water from it. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: ‘Do not lap up the water, rather wash your hands then drink from them, for there is no better vessel than the hand.’”
