hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3560

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا نُهِيَ عَنْهُ مِنَ اللِّبَاسِ
chapter.englishTitle: Clothes that are forbidden

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade two kinds of dress:
           Ishtimalus-Samma’ and Ihtiba’, exposing one’s private part to the sky.
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade two kinds of dress:
hadiths.body: Ishtimalus-Samma’ and Ihtiba’, exposing one’s private part to the sky.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، وَأَبُو أُسَامَةَ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنْ خُبَيْبِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ حَفْصِ بْنِ عَاصِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، . أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ نَهَى عَنْ لِبْسَتَيْنِ عَنِ اشْتِمَالِ الصَّمَّاءِ وَعَنِ الاِحْتِبَاءِ فِي الثَّوْبِ الْوَاحِدِ يُفْضِي بِفَرْجِهِ إِلَى السَّمَاءِ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Dress, Hadith 3560

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3561

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَا نُهِيَ عَنْهُ مِنَ اللِّبَاسِ
chapter.englishTitle: Clothes that are forbidden

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that ‘Aishah said:
           “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade two kinds of dress: Ishtimalus-Samma’ and Ihtiba’ in one garment, when you are exposing your private part to the sky.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that ‘Aishah said:
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade two kinds of dress: Ishtimalus-Samma’ and Ihtiba’ in one garment, when you are exposing your private part to the sky.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، وَأَبُو أُسَامَةَ عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ عَمْرَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَنْ لِبْسَتَيْنِ اشْتِمَالِ الصَّمَّاءِ وَالاِحْتِبَاءِ فِي ثَوْبٍ وَاحِدٍ وَأَنْتَ مُفْضٍ فَرْجَكَ إِلَى السَّمَاءِ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Dress, Hadith 3561

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3562

chapter.englishTitle: Wearing wool

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Burdah that his father said to him:
           “O my son, if only you could have seen us when we were with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, when rain fell on us; you would have thought that we smelled like sheep.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Burdah that his father said to him:
hadiths.body: “O my son, if only you could have seen us when we were with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, when rain fell on us; you would have thought that we smelled like sheep.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ مُوسَى، عَنْ شَيْبَانَ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ قَالَ لِي يَا بُنَىَّ لَوْ شَهِدْتَنَا وَنَحْنُ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ إِذَا أَصَابَتْنَا السَّمَاءُ لَحَسِبْتَ أَنَّ رِيحَنَا رِيحُ الضَّأْنِ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Dress, Hadith 3562

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3563

chapter.englishTitle: Wearing wool

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that ‘Ubadah bin Samit said:
           “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ came out to us one day, wearing a Roman cloak of wool with narrow sleeves. He led us in prayer wearing that, and nothing else.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that ‘Ubadah bin Samit said:
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ came out to us one day, wearing a Roman cloak of wool with narrow sleeves. He led us in prayer wearing that, and nothing else.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ كَرَامَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَحْوَصُ بْنُ حَكِيمٍ، عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ مَعْدَانَ، عَنْ عُبَادَةَ بْنِ الصَّامِتِ، قَالَ خَرَجَ عَلَيْنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ ذَاتَ يَوْمٍ وَعَلَيْهِ جُبَّةٌ رُومِيَّةٌ مِنْ صُوفٍ ضَيِّقَةُ الْكُمَّيْنِ فَصَلَّى بِنَا فِيهَا لَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ شَىْءٌ غَيْرُهَا .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Dress, Hadith 3563

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3564

chapter.englishTitle: Wearing wool

hadiths.englishRaw: It was narrated from Salman Farisi that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ performed ablution, then he turned his woolen cloak that he was wearing inside out and wiped his face with it.
hadiths.body: It was narrated from Salman Farisi that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ performed ablution, then he turned his woolen cloak that he was wearing inside out and wiped his face with it.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا الْعَبَّاسُ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ الدِّمَشْقِيُّ، وَأَحْمَدُ بْنُ الأَزْهَرِ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مَرْوَانُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ السِّمْطِ، حَدَّثَنِي الْوَضِينُ بْنُ عَطَاءٍ، عَنْ مَحْفُوظِ بْنِ عَلْقَمَةَ، عَنْ سَلْمَانَ الْفَارِسِيِّ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ تَوَضَّأَ فَقَلَبَ جُبَّةَ صُوفٍ كَانَتْ عَلَيْهِ فَمَسَحَ بِهَا وَجْهَهُ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Dress, Hadith 3564

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3565

chapter.englishTitle: Wearing wool

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Anas bin Malik said:
           “I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ marking sheep on their ears, and I saw him wearing a cloak around his wrist.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Anas bin Malik said:
hadiths.body: “I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ marking sheep on their ears, and I saw him wearing a cloak around his wrist.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا سُوَيْدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ الْفَضْلِ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَسِمُ غَنَمًا فِي آذَانِهَا وَرَأَيْتُهُ مُتَّزِرًا بِكِسَاءٍ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Dress, Hadith 3565

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3566

chapter.englishTitle: White garments

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Ibn ‘Abbas that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            “The best of your garments are the white ones, so wear them and shroud your dead in them.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Ibn ‘Abbas that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “The best of your garments are the white ones, so wear them and shroud your dead in them.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الصَّبَّاحِ، أَنْبَأَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ رَجَاءٍ الْمَكِّيُّ، عَنِ ابْنِ خُثَيْمٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " خَيْرُ ثِيَابِكُمُ الْبَيَاضُ فَالْبَسُوهَا وَكَفِّنُوا فِيهَا مَوْتَاكُمْ " .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Dress, Hadith 3566

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3567

chapter.englishTitle: White garments

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Samurah bin Jundab that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
           “Wear white garments, for they are purer and better.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Samurah bin Jundab that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “Wear white garments, for they are purer and better.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ حَبِيبِ بْنِ أَبِي ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ مَيْمُونِ بْنِ أَبِي شَبِيبٍ، عَنْ سَمُرَةَ بْنِ جُنْدَبٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " الْبَسُوا ثِيَابَ الْبَيَاضِ فَإِنَّهَا أَطْهَرُ وَأَطْيَبُ " .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Dress, Hadith 3567

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3568

chapter.englishTitle: White garments

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Darda’ that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            “The best of that in which you visit Allah in your graves and your mosque is white (garments).”*
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Darda’ that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “The best of that in which you visit Allah in your graves and your mosque is white (garments).”*
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَسَّانَ الأَزْرَقُ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْمَجِيدِ بْنُ أَبِي رَوَّادٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مَرْوَانُ بْنُ سَالِمٍ، عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ عَمْرٍو، عَنْ شُرَيْحِ بْنِ عُبَيْدٍ الْحَضْرَمِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي الدَّرْدَاءِ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " إِنَّ أَحْسَنَ مَا زُرْتُمُ اللَّهَ بِهِ فِي قُبُورِكُمْ وَمَسَاجِدِكُمُ الْبَيَاضُ " .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Dress, Hadith 3568

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3569

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَنْ جَرَّ ثَوْبَهُ مِنَ الْخُيَلاَءِ
chapter.englishTitle: One who lets his garment drag out of pride

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Ibn ‘Umar that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            “Whoever lets his garment drag out of pride, Allah will not look at him on the Day of Resurrection.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Ibn ‘Umar that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “Whoever lets his garment drag out of pride, Allah will not look at him on the Day of Resurrection.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ  " إِنَّ الَّذِي يَجُرُّ ثَوْبَهُ مِنَ الْخُيَلاَءِ لاَ يَنْظُرُ اللَّهُ إِلَيْهِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ " .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Dress, Hadith 3569

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3570

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَنْ جَرَّ ثَوْبَهُ مِنَ الْخُيَلاَءِ
chapter.englishTitle: One who lets his garment drag out of pride

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from ‘Atiyyah, that Abu Sa’eed said:
           “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: ‘Whoever lets his lower wrap drag out of pride, Allah will not look at him on the Day of Resurrection.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from ‘Atiyyah, that Abu Sa’eed said:
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: ‘Whoever lets his lower wrap drag out of pride, Allah will not look at him on the Day of Resurrection.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ عَطِيَّةَ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " مَنْ جَرَّ إِزَارَهُ مِنَ الْخُيَلاَءِ لَمْ يَنْظُرِ اللَّهُ إِلَيْهِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ " .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Dress, Hadith 3570

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3571

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَنْ جَرَّ ثَوْبَهُ مِنَ الْخُيَلاَءِ
chapter.englishTitle: One who lets his garment drag out of pride

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that a young man of Quriash passed by Abu Hurairah with his cloak dragging. He said:
           “O my nephew! I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying ‘Whoever let his garment drag out of pride, Allah will not look at him on the Day of Resurrection.’”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that a young man of Quriash passed by Abu Hurairah with his cloak dragging. He said:
hadiths.body: “O my nephew! I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying ‘Whoever let his garment drag out of pride, Allah will not look at him on the Day of Resurrection.’”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بِشْرٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ مَرَّ بِأَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ فَتًى مِنْ قُرَيْشٍ يَجُرُّ سَبَلَهُ فَقَالَ يَا ابْنَ أَخِي إِنِّي سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ  " مَنْ جَرَّ ثَوْبَهُ مِنَ الْخُيَلاَءِ لَمْ يَنْظُرِ اللَّهُ إِلَيْهِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ " .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Dress, Hadith 3571

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3572

chapter.englishTitle: Where is the place of the lower wrap?

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Hudhaifah said:
           “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ took hold of the lower part of my calf or his calf and said: ‘This is where the lower wrap should come to. If you insist, then lower, and if you insist, then lower, but the lower wrap has no right to (come to) the ankle.’”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Hudhaifah said:
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ took hold of the lower part of my calf or his calf and said: ‘This is where the lower wrap should come to. If you insist, then lower, and if you insist, then lower, but the lower wrap has no right to (come to) the ankle.’”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الأَحْوَصِ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ مُسْلِمِ بْنِ نُذَيْرٍ، عَنْ حُذَيْفَةَ، قَالَ أَخَذَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ بِأَسْفَلِ عَضَلَةِ سَاقِي أَوْ سَاقِهِ فَقَالَ  " هَذَا مَوْضِعُ الإِزَارِ فَإِنْ أَبَيْتَ . فَأَسْفَلَ فَإِنْ أَبَيْتَ فَأَسْفَلَ فَإِنْ أَبَيْتَ فَلاَ حَقَّ لِلإِزَارِ فِي الْكَعْبَيْنِ " .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Dress, Hadith 3572

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3573

chapter.englishTitle: Where is the place of the lower wrap?

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from ‘Ala bin ‘Abdur-Rahman that his father said:
           “I said to Abu Sa’eed: ‘Did you hear anything from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ concerning the lower wrap?’ He said: ‘Yes. I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: ‘The lower wrap of the believer should come to mid-calf, but there is no sin on him if it comes between that point and the ankle. But whatever is lower than the ankle is in the Fire.’ And he said three times: ‘Allah will not look at the one who lets his lower wrap drag out of vanity.’”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from ‘Ala bin ‘Abdur-Rahman that his father said:
hadiths.body: “I said to Abu Sa’eed: ‘Did you hear anything from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ concerning the lower wrap?’ He said: ‘Yes. I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: ‘The lower wrap of the believer should come to mid-calf, but there is no sin on him if it comes between that point and the ankle. But whatever is lower than the ankle is in the Fire.’ And he said three times: ‘Allah will not look at the one who lets his lower wrap drag out of vanity.’”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ الْعَلاَءِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ قُلْتُ لأَبِي سَعِيدٍ هَلْ سَمِعْتَ مِنْ، رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ شَيْئًا فِي الإِزَارِ قَالَ نَعَمْ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ " إِزْرَةُ الْمُؤْمِنِ إِلَى أَنْصَافِ سَاقَيْهِ لاَ جُنَاحَ عَلَيْهِ مَا بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَ الْكَعْبَيْنِ وَمَا أَسْفَلَ مِنَ الْكَعْبَيْنِ فِي النَّارِ " . يَقُولُ ثَلاَثًا " لاَ يَنْظُرُ اللَّهُ إِلَى مَنْ جَرَّ إِزَارَهُ بَطَرًا " .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Dress, Hadith 3573

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3574

chapter.englishTitle: Where is the place of the lower wrap?

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Mughirah bin Shu’bah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
           “O Sufyan bin Sahl, do not let your garment hang, for Allah does not like those who let their garments hang below the ankles.’”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Mughirah bin Shu’bah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “O Sufyan bin Sahl, do not let your garment hang, for Allah does not like those who let their garments hang below the ankles.’”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ، أَنْبَأَنَا شَرِيكٌ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ، عَنْ حُصَيْنِ بْنِ قَبِيصَةَ، عَنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ بْنِ شُعْبَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " يَا سُفْيَانَ بْنَ سَهْلٍ لاَ تُسْبِلْ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ لاَ يُحِبُّ الْمُسْبِلِينَ " .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Dress, Hadith 3574

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3575

chapter.englishTitle: Wearing a Qamees

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Umm Salamah said:
           There was no garment more beloved to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ than the shirt.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Umm Salamah said:
hadiths.body: There was no garment more beloved to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ than the shirt.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الدَّوْرَقِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو تُمَيْلَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمُؤْمِنِ بْنِ خَالِدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ بُرَيْدَةَ، عَنْ أُمِّهِ، عَنْ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ، قَالَتْ لَمْ يَكُنْ ثَوْبٌ أَحَبَّ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ مِنَ الْقَمِيصِ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Dress, Hadith 3575

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3576

chapter.englishTitle: How long should the Qamees be?

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Salim, from his father, that the Prophet ﷺ said:
            “Hanging down may apply to the waist wrap, shirt or turban. Whoever lets any of these drag out of pride, Allah will not look at him on the Day of Resurrection.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Salim, from his father, that the Prophet ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “Hanging down may apply to the waist wrap, shirt or turban. Whoever lets any of these drag out of pride, Allah will not look at him on the Day of Resurrection.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي رَوَّادٍ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ  " الإِسْبَالُ فِي الإِزَارِ وَالْقَمِيصِ وَالْعِمَامَةِ مَنْ جَرَّ شَيْئًا خُيَلاَءَ لَمْ يَنْظُرِ اللَّهُ إِلَيْهِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ " . قَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ مَا أَغْرَبَهُ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Dress, Hadith 3576

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3577

chapter.englishTitle: How should the sleeves of the garment be?

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Ibn ‘Abbas said:
           “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to wear a shirt that was short in the sleeves and length.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Ibn ‘Abbas said:
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to wear a shirt that was short in the sleeves and length.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ حَكِيمٍ الأَوْدِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو غَسَّانَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا حَسَنُ بْنُ صَالِحٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ وَكِيعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ صَالِحٍ، عَنْ مُسْلِمٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَلْبَسُ قَمِيصًا قَصِيرَ الْيَدَيْنِ وَالطُّولِ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Dress, Hadith 3577

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3578

chapter.englishTitle: Undoing buttons

hadiths.englishRaw:
Mu’awiyah bin Qurrah narrated that his father said:
           “I came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and gave him my pledge, and the buttons of his shirt were undone.”
hadiths.narrator: Mu’awiyah bin Qurrah narrated that his father said:
hadiths.body: “I came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and gave him my pledge, and the buttons of his shirt were undone.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ دُكَيْنٍ، عَنْ زُهَيْرٍ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ قُشَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنِي مُعَاوِيَةُ بْنُ قُرَّةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ أَتَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَبَايَعْتُهُ وَإِنَّ زِرَّ قَمِيصِهِ لَمُطْلَقٌ . قَالَ عُرْوَةُ فَمَا رَأَيْتُ مُعَاوِيَةَ وَلاَ ابْنَهُ فِي شِتَاءٍ وَلاَ صَيْفٍ إِلاَّ مُطْلَقَةً أَزْرَارُهُمَا .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Dress, Hadith 3578

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3579

chapter.englishTitle: Wearing trousers

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Suwaid bin Qais said:
           “The Prophet ﷺ came to us and haggled with us over the price of trousers.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Suwaid bin Qais said:
hadiths.body: “The Prophet ﷺ came to us and haggled with us over the price of trousers.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَعَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، وَعَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ سِمَاكِ بْنِ حَرْبٍ، عَنْ سُوَيْدِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ، قَالَ أَتَانَا النَّبِيُّ ﷺ فَسَاوَمَنَا سَرَاوِيلَ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Dress, Hadith 3579

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3580

chapter.englishTitle: How long should the end woman’s garment be?

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Umm Salamah said:
           “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ was asked about how long a woman’s hem should hang down. He said: ‘A hand span.’ I said: ‘But then (her legs and feet) will be uncovered.’ He said: ‘Then a forearm’s length, but no more than that.’”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Umm Salamah said:
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ was asked about how long a woman’s hem should hang down. He said: ‘A hand span.’ I said: ‘But then (her legs and feet) will be uncovered.’ He said: ‘Then a forearm’s length, but no more than that.’”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْمُعْتَمِرُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ يَسَارٍ، عَنْ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ، قَالَتْ سُئِلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ كَمْ تَجُرُّ الْمَرْأَةُ مِنْ ذَيْلِهَا قَالَ " شِبْرًا " . قُلْتُ إِذًا يَنْكَشِفَ عَنْهَا . قَالَ ذِرَاعٌ لاَ تَزِيدُ عَلَيْهِ " .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Dress, Hadith 3580

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3581

chapter.englishTitle: How long should the end woman’s garment be?

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Ibn ‘Umar:
           “The wives of the Prophet ﷺ were allowed to let their hems hang down, so they used to come to us and we would measure one forearms length for them with a reed.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Ibn ‘Umar:
hadiths.body: “The wives of the Prophet ﷺ were allowed to let their hems hang down, so they used to come to us and we would measure one forearms length for them with a reed.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ زَيْدٍ الْعَمِّيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي الصِّدِّيقِ النَّاجِيِّ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ أَزْوَاجَ النَّبِيِّ، ﷺ رُخِّصَ لَهُنَّ فِي الذَّيْلِ ذِرَاعًا فَكُنَّ يَأْتِيَنَّا فَنَذْرَعُ لَهُنَّ بِالْقَصَبِ ذِرَاعًا .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Dress, Hadith 3581

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3582

chapter.englishTitle: How long should the end woman’s garment be?

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Prophet ﷺ said to Fatimah, or to Umm Salamah:
           “Let your hem down one forearm’s length.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Prophet ﷺ said to Fatimah, or to Umm Salamah:
hadiths.body: “Let your hem down one forearm’s length.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي الْمُهَزِّمِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، . أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ قَالَ لِفَاطِمَةَ أَوْ لأُمِّ سَلَمَةَ  " ذَيْلُكِ ذِرَاعٌ " .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Dress, Hadith 3582

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3583

chapter.englishTitle: How long should the end woman’s garment be?

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from ‘Aishah that the Prophet ﷺ said, concerning how long a woman’s hem should hang down:
           “A hand span.” ‘Aishah said: “This may show her calves.” He said: “Then a forearm’s length.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from ‘Aishah that the Prophet ﷺ said, concerning how long a woman’s hem should hang down:
hadiths.body: “A hand span.” ‘Aishah said: “This may show her calves.” He said: “Then a forearm’s length.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَفَّانُ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَارِثِ، حَدَّثَنَا حَبِيبٌ الْمُعَلِّمُ، عَنْ أَبِي الْمُهَزِّمِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ قَالَ فِي ذُيُولِ النِّسَاءِ " شِبْرًا " . فَقَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ إِذًا تَخْرُجَ سُوقُهُنَّ . قَالَ " فَذِرَاعٌ " .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Dress, Hadith 3583

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3584

chapter.englishTitle: Black turban

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Ja’far bin ‘Amr bin Huraith that his father said:
            “I saw the Prophet ﷺ delivering a sermon on the pulpit, wearing a black turban.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Ja’far bin ‘Amr bin Huraith that his father said:
hadiths.body: “I saw the Prophet ﷺ delivering a sermon on the pulpit, wearing a black turban.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ مُسَاوِرٍ الْوَرَّاقِ، عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ حُرَيْثٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ رَأَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ يَخْطُبُ عَلَى الْمِنْبَرِ وَعَلَيْهِ عِمَامَةٌ سَوْدَاءُ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Dress, Hadith 3584

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3585

chapter.englishTitle: Black turban

hadiths.englishRaw: It was narrated from Jabir that the Prophet ﷺ entered Makkah wearing a black turban.
hadiths.body: It was narrated from Jabir that the Prophet ﷺ entered Makkah wearing a black turban.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ دَخَلَ مَكَّةَ وَعَلَيْهِ عِمَامَةٌ سَوْدَاءُ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Dress, Hadith 3585

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3586

chapter.englishTitle: Black turban

hadiths.englishRaw: It was narrated from Ibn ‘Umar that the Prophet ﷺ entered (Makkah), on the Day of the Conquest of Makkah, wearing a black turban.
hadiths.body: It was narrated from Ibn ‘Umar that the Prophet ﷺ entered (Makkah), on the Day of the Conquest of Makkah, wearing a black turban.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، أَنْبَأَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ عُبَيْدَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ دَخَلَ يَوْمَ فَتْحِ مَكَّةَ وَعَلَيْهِ عِمَامَةٌ سَوْدَاءُ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Dress, Hadith 3586

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3587

chapter.englishTitle: Letting the ends of the turban hang between the shoulders

hadiths.englishRaw:
Ja’far bin ‘Amr bin Huraith narrated that his father said:
           “It is as if I can see the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, wearing a black turban, with the ends hanging down his shoulders.”
hadiths.narrator: Ja’far bin ‘Amr bin Huraith narrated that his father said:
hadiths.body: “It is as if I can see the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, wearing a black turban, with the ends hanging down his shoulders.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ مُسَاوِرٍ، حَدَّثَنِي جَعْفَرُ بْنُ عَمْرِو بْنِ حُرَيْثٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ كَأَنِّي أَنْظُرُ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَعَلَيْهِ عِمَامَةٌ سَوْدَاءُ قَدْ أَرْخَى طَرَفَيْهَا بَيْنَ كَتِفَيْهِ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Dress, Hadith 3587

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3588

chapter.englishTitle: The disdain of wearing silk

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Anas bin Malik that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            “Whoever wears silk in this world will not wear it in the Hereafter.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Anas bin Malik that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “Whoever wears silk in this world will not wear it in the Hereafter.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ بْنِ صُهَيْبٍ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " مَنْ لَبِسَ الْحَرِيرَ فِي الدُّنْيَا لَمْ يَلْبَسْهُ فِي الآخِرَةِ " .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Dress, Hadith 3588

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3589

chapter.englishTitle: The disdain of wearing silk

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Bara’ bin ‘Azib said:
           “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade brocade, silk, and embroidered brocade.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Bara’ bin ‘Azib said:
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade brocade, silk, and embroidered brocade.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُسْهِرٍ، عَنِ الشَّيْبَانِيِّ، عَنْ أَشْعَثَ بْنِ أَبِي الشَّعْثَاءِ، عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ سُوَيْدٍ، عَنِ الْبَرَاءِ، قَالَ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَنِ الدِّيبَاجِ وَالْحَرِيرِ وَالإِسْتَبْرَقِ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Dress, Hadith 3589

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3590

chapter.englishTitle: The disdain of wearing silk

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Hudhaifah said:
           “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade wearing silk and gold. He said: ‘They are for them in this world and for us in the Hereafter.’”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Hudhaifah said:
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade wearing silk and gold. He said: ‘They are for them in this world and for us in the Hereafter.’”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنِ الْحَكَمِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى، عَنْ حُذَيْفَةَ، قَالَ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَنْ لُبْسِ الْحَرِيرِ وَالذَّهَبِ وَقَالَ  " هُوَ لَهُمْ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَلَنَا فِي الآخِرَةِ " .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Dress, Hadith 3590

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3591

chapter.englishTitle: The disdain of wearing silk

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from ‘Abdullah bin ‘Umar that ‘Umar bin Khattab saw a silken two piece suit (being offered for sale). He said:
           “O Messenger of Allah, why don’t you buy this two piece suit (to wear for meeting) the delegations, and on Fridays?” The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “This is only worn by one who has no share in the Hereafter.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from ‘Abdullah bin ‘Umar that ‘Umar bin Khattab saw a silken two piece suit (being offered for sale). He said:
hadiths.body: “O Messenger of Allah, why don’t you buy this two piece suit (to wear for meeting) the delegations, and on Fridays?” The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “This is only worn by one who has no share in the Hereafter.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحِيمِ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ رَأَى حُلَّةً سِيَرَاءَ مِنْ حَرِيرٍ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ لَوِ ابْتَعْتَ هَذِهِ الْحُلَّةَ لِلْوَفْدِ وَلِيَوْمِ الْجُمُعَةِ . فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " إِنَّمَا يَلْبَسُ هَذَا مَنْ لاَ خَلاَقَ لَهُ فِي الآخِرَةِ " .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Dress, Hadith 3591

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3592

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَنْ رُخِّصَ لَهُ فِي لُبْسِ الْحَرِيرِ
chapter.englishTitle: One who is granted a concession allowing him to wear silk

hadiths.englishRaw: It was narrated from Anas bin Malik that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ granted a concession to Zubair bin ‘Awwam and ‘Abdur-Rahman bin ‘Auf, allowing them to wear silk shirts, because of a rash they were suffering from.
hadiths.body: It was narrated from Anas bin Malik that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ granted a concession to Zubair bin ‘Awwam and ‘Abdur-Rahman bin ‘Auf, allowing them to wear silk shirts, because of a rash they were suffering from.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بِشْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي عَرُوبَةَ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، . أَنَّ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ، نَبَّأَهُمْ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ رَخَّصَ لِلزُّبَيْرِ بْنِ الْعَوَّامِ وَلِعَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَوْفٍ فِي قَمِيصَيْنِ مِنْ حَرِيرٍ مِنْ وَجَعٍ كَانَ بِهِمَا حِكَّةٍ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Dress, Hadith 3592

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3593

chapter.arabicTitle: باب الرُّخْصَةِ فِي الْعَلَمِ فِي الثَّوْبِ
chapter.englishTitle: Concession with regard the emblem on a garment

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from ‘Umar that he used to forbid silk and brocade, except for what was like this:
           Then he gestured with his finger, then a second, and a third, and a fourth (i.e., the width of four fingers), and he said: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to forbid it.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from ‘Umar that he used to forbid silk and brocade, except for what was like this:
hadiths.body: Then he gestured with his finger, then a second, and a third, and a fourth (i.e., the width of four fingers), and he said: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to forbid it.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصُ بْنُ غِيَاثٍ، عَنْ عَاصِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِي عُثْمَانَ، عَنْ عُمَرَ، أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَنْهَى عَنِ الْحَرِيرِ، وَالدِّيبَاجِ، إِلاَّ مَا كَانَ هَكَذَا ثُمَّ أَشَارَ بِإِصْبَعِهِ ثُمَّ الثَّانِيَةِ ثُمَّ الثَّالِثَةِ ثُمَّ الرَّابِعَةِ فَقَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَنْهَانَا عَنْهُ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Dress, Hadith 3593

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3594

chapter.arabicTitle: باب الرُّخْصَةِ فِي الْعَلَمِ فِي الثَّوْبِ
chapter.englishTitle: Concession with regard the emblem on a garment

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Abu ‘Umar, the freed slave of Asma’, said:
           “I saw Ibn ‘Umar buying a turban that had some markings, then he called for a pair of scissors and cut that off. I entered upon Asma’ and mentioned that to her, and she said: ‘May ‘Abdullah perish, O girl! Give me the garment of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ.’ A garment was brought that was hemmed with brocade on the sleeves, necklines and openings (at the front and back).”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Abu ‘Umar, the freed slave of Asma’, said:
hadiths.body: “I saw Ibn ‘Umar buying a turban that had some markings, then he called for a pair of scissors and cut that off. I entered upon Asma’ and mentioned that to her, and she said: ‘May ‘Abdullah perish, O girl! Give me the garment of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ.’ A garment was brought that was hemmed with brocade on the sleeves, necklines and openings (at the front and back).”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ بْنِ زِيَادٍ، عَنْ أَبِي عُمَرَ، مَوْلَى أَسْمَاءَ قَالَ رَأَيْتُ ابْنَ عُمَرَ اشْتَرَى عِمَامَةً لَهَا عَلَمٌ فَدَعَا بِالْجَلَمَيْنِ فَقَصَّهُ فَدَخَلْتُ عَلَى أَسْمَاءَ فَذَكَرْتُ ذَلِكَ لَهَا فَقَالَتْ بُؤْسًا لِعَبْدِ اللَّهِ يَا جَارِيَةُ هَاتِي جُبَّةَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ . فَجَاءَتْ بِجُبَّةٍ مَكْفُوفَةِ الْكُمَّيْنِ وَالْجَيْبِ وَالْفَرْجَيْنِ بِالدِّيبَاجِ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Dress, Hadith 3594

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3595

chapter.englishTitle: Wearing silk and gold for women

hadiths.englishRaw:
‘Ali bin Abu Talib said:
           “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ took hold of some silk in his left hand and some gold in his right, then he raised his hands and said: ‘These two are forbidden for the males of my nation, and permitted to the females.’”
hadiths.narrator: ‘Ali bin Abu Talib said:
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ took hold of some silk in his left hand and some gold in his right, then he raised his hands and said: ‘These two are forbidden for the males of my nation, and permitted to the females.’”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحِيمِ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ بْنِ أَبِي الصَّعْبَةِ، عَنْ أَبِي الأَفْلَحِ الْهَمْدَانِيِّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ زُرَيْرٍ الْغَافِقِيِّ، سَمِعْتُهُ يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ عَلِيَّ بْنَ أَبِي طَالِبٍ، يَقُولُ أَخَذَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ حَرِيرًا بِشِمَالِهِ وَذَهَبًا بِيَمِينِهِ ثُمَّ رَفَعَ بِهِمَا يَدَيْهِ فَقَالَ  " إِنَّ هَذَيْنِ حَرَامٌ عَلَى ذُكُورِ أُمَّتِي حِلٌّ لإِنَاثِهِمْ " .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Dress, Hadith 3595

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3596

chapter.englishTitle: Wearing silk and gold for women

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from ‘Ali that a two-piece suit hemmed with silk, either on the wrap or the weft,* was given to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and he sent them to me (‘Ali). I came to him and said:
           “O Messenger of Allah, what should I do with these? Shall I wear them?” He said: “No, rather make them into head-cloths and give them to the Fatimahs.”**
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from ‘Ali that a two-piece suit hemmed with silk, either on the wrap or the weft,* was given to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and he sent them to me (‘Ali). I came to him and said:
hadiths.body: “O Messenger of Allah, what should I do with these? Shall I wear them?” He said: “No, rather make them into head-cloths and give them to the Fatimahs.”**
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحِيمِ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي زِيَادٍ، عَنْ أَبِي فَاخِتَةَ، حَدَّثَنِي هُبَيْرَةُ بْنُ يَرِيمَ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ، أَنَّهُ أُهْدِيَ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ حُلَّةٌ مَكْفُوفَةٌ بِحَرِيرٍ إِمَّا سَدَاؤُهَا وَإِمَّا لُحْمَتُهَا فَأَرْسَلَ بِهَا إِلَىَّ فَأَتَيْتُهُ فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ مَا أَصْنَعُ بِهَا أَلْبَسُهَا قَالَ  " لاَ وَلَكِنِ اجْعَلْهَا خُمُرًا بَيْنَ الْفَوَاطِمِ " .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Dress, Hadith 3596

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3597

chapter.englishTitle: Wearing silk and gold for women

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that ‘Abdullah bin ‘Umar said:
           “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ came out to us, and in one of his hands was a garment of silk and in the other was some gold. He said: ‘These are forbidden to the males of my nation and permitted to the females.’”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that ‘Abdullah bin ‘Umar said:
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ came out to us, and in one of his hands was a garment of silk and in the other was some gold. He said: ‘These are forbidden to the males of my nation and permitted to the females.’”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحِيمِ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنِ الإِفْرِيقِيِّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ رَافِعٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو، قَالَ خَرَجَ عَلَيْنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَفِي إِحْدَى يَدَيْهِ ثَوْبٌ مِنْ حَرِيرٍ وَفِي الأُخْرَى ذَهَبٌ فَقَالَ  " إِنَّ هَذَيْنِ مُحَرَّمٌ عَلَى ذُكُورِ أُمَّتِي حِلٌّ لإِنَاثِهِمْ " .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Dress, Hadith 3597

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3598

chapter.englishTitle: Wearing silk and gold for women

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Anas said:
           “I saw Zainab the daughter of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ wearing a shirt of Siyara’ silk.*
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Anas said:
hadiths.body: “I saw Zainab the daughter of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ wearing a shirt of Siyara’ silk.*
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عِيسَى بْنُ يُونُسَ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ رَأَيْتُ عَلَى زَيْنَبَ بِنْتِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَمِيصَ حَرِيرٍ سِيَرَاءَ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Dress, Hadith 3598

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3599

chapter.englishTitle: Wearing red for men

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Bara’ said:
           “I never saw anyone more handsome then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, with his hair combed, wearing a red two-piece suit.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Bara’ said:
hadiths.body: “I never saw anyone more handsome then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, with his hair combed, wearing a red two-piece suit.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، عَنْ شَرِيكِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْقَاضِي، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنِ الْبَرَاءِ، قَالَ مَا رَأَيْتُ أَجْمَلَ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ مُتَرَجِّلاً فِي حُلَّةٍ حَمْرَاءَ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Dress, Hadith 3599

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3600

chapter.englishTitle: Wearing red for men

hadiths.englishRaw:
‘Abdullah bin Buraidah narrated that his father told him:
           I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ delivering a sermon, and Hasan and Husain came forward, wearing red shirts, stumbling and getting up again. The Prophet ﷺ stepped down, picked them up and put them in his lap. Then he said: “Allah and His Messenger have spoken the truth. ‘Your wealth and your children are only a trial.’ [64:15] I saw these two and I could not be patient. Then he resumed his sermon.”
hadiths.narrator: ‘Abdullah bin Buraidah narrated that his father told him:
hadiths.body: I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ delivering a sermon, and Hasan and Husain came forward, wearing red shirts, stumbling and getting up again. The Prophet ﷺ stepped down, picked them up and put them in his lap. Then he said: “Allah and His Messenger have spoken the truth. ‘Your wealth and your children are only a trial.’ [64:15] I saw these two and I could not be patient. Then he resumed his sermon.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَامِرٍ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَامِرِ بْنِ بَرَّادِ بْنِ يُوسُفَ بْنِ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ بْنِ أَبِي مُوسَى الأَشْعَرِيِّ، حَدَّثَنَا زَيْدُ بْنُ الْحُبَابِ، حَدَّثَنَا حُسَيْنُ بْنُ وَاقِدٍ، قَاضِي مَرْوَ حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ بُرَيْدَةَ، أَنَّ أَبَاهُ، حَدَّثَهُ قَالَ رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَخْطُبُ فَأَقْبَلَ حَسَنٌ وَحُسَيْنٌ عَلَيْهِمَا قَمِيصَانِ أَحْمَرَانِ يَعْثُرَانِ وَيَقُومَانِ فَنَزَلَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ فَأَخَذَهُمَا فَوَضَعَهُمَا فِي حِجْرِهِ فَقَالَ " صَدَقَ اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ {إِنَّمَا أَمْوَالُكُمْ وَأَوْلاَدُكُمْ فِتْنَةٌ} رَأَيْتُ هَذَيْنِ فَلَمْ أَصْبِرْ " . ثُمَّ أَخَذَ فِي خُطْبَتِهِ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Dress, Hadith 3600

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3601

chapter.englishTitle: Clothes dyed with safflower are undesirable for men

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Ibn ‘Umar said:
           “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade Al-Mufaddam.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Ibn ‘Umar said:
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade Al-Mufaddam.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُسْهِرٍ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي زِيَادٍ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ سُهَيْلٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَنِ الْمُفَدَّمِ . قَالَ يَزِيدُ قُلْتُ لِلْحَسَنِ مَا الْمُفَدَّمُ قَالَ الْمُشْبَعُ بِالْعُصْفُرِ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Dress, Hadith 3601

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3602

chapter.englishTitle: Clothes dyed with safflower are undesirable for men

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that ‘Abdullah bin Hunain said:
           “I heard ‘Ali say: ‘The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade me – and I do not say that he forbade you – from wearing clothes dyed with safflower.’”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that ‘Abdullah bin Hunain said:
hadiths.body: “I heard ‘Ali say: ‘The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade me – and I do not say that he forbade you – from wearing clothes dyed with safflower.’”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ أُسَامَةَ بْنِ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ حُنَيْنٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَلِيًّا، يَقُولُ نَهَانِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ - وَلاَ أَقُولُ نَهَاكُمْ - عَنْ لُبْسِ الْمُعَصْفَرِ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Dress, Hadith 3602

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3603

chapter.englishTitle: Clothes dyed with safflower are undesirable for men

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from ‘Amr bin Shu’aib, from his father, that his grandfather said:
           “We came with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was Thaniyyat Adhakhir. He turned to me, and I was wearing a thin cloak dyed with safflower, and said: ‘What is this?’ And I realized that he disliked it. I came to my family when they were heating their oven and threw it (in the oven). Then I came to him the following day and he said: ‘O ‘Abdullah, what happened to the thin cloak?’ I told him (what I had done) and he said: ‘Why did you not give it to some of your family to wear, for there is nothing wrong with it for women.’”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from ‘Amr bin Shu’aib, from his father, that his grandfather said:
hadiths.body: “We came with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was Thaniyyat Adhakhir. He turned to me, and I was wearing a thin cloak dyed with safflower, and said: ‘What is this?’ And I realized that he disliked it. I came to my family when they were heating their oven and threw it (in the oven). Then I came to him the following day and he said: ‘O ‘Abdullah, what happened to the thin cloak?’ I told him (what I had done) and he said: ‘Why did you not give it to some of your family to wear, for there is nothing wrong with it for women.’”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عِيسَى بْنُ يُونُسَ، عَنِ هِشَامِ بْنِ الْغَازِ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ شُعَيْبٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ، قَالَ أَقْبَلْنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ مِنْ ثَنِيَّةِ أَذَاخِرَ فَالْتَفَتَ إِلَىَّ وَعَلَىَّ رَيْطَةٌ مُضَرَّجَةٌ بِالْعُصْفُرِ فَقَالَ " مَا هَذِهِ " . فَعَرَفْتُ مَا كَرِهَ فَأَتَيْتُ أَهْلِي وَهُمْ يَسْجُرُونَ تَنُّورَهُمْ فَقَذَفْتُهَا فِيهِ ثُمَّ أَتَيْتُهُ مِنَ الْغَدِ فَقَالَ " يَا عَبْدَ اللَّهِ مَا فَعَلَتِ الرَّيْطَةُ " . فَأَخْبَرْتُهُ فَقَالَ " أَلاَ كَسَوْتَهَا بَعْضَ أَهْلِكَ فَإِنَّهُ لاَ بَأْسَ بِذَلِكَ لِلنِّسَاءِ " .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Dress, Hadith 3603

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3604

chapter.englishTitle: Yellow for men

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Qais bin Sa’d said:
           “The Prophet ﷺ came to us and we gave him some water with which to cool down. He bathed, then I brought him a yellow blanket, and I saw the traces of Wars (the yellow dye) on the folds of his stomach.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Qais bin Sa’d said:
hadiths.body: “The Prophet ﷺ came to us and we gave him some water with which to cool down. He bathed, then I brought him a yellow blanket, and I saw the traces of Wars (the yellow dye) on the folds of his stomach.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ شُرَحْبِيلَ، عَنْ قَيْسِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، قَالَ أَتَانَا النَّبِيُّ ﷺ فَوَضَعْنَا لَهُ مَاءً يَتَبَرَّدُ بِهِ فَاغْتَسَلَ ثُمَّ أَتَيْتُهُ بِمِلْحَفَةٍ صَفْرَاءَ فَرَأَيْتُ أَثَرَ الْوَرْسِ عَلَى عُكَنِهِ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Dress, Hadith 3604

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3605

chapter.arabicTitle: باب الْبَسْ مَا شِئْتَ مَا أَخْطَأَكَ سَرَفٌ أَوْ مَخِيلَةٌ
chapter.englishTitle: Wear whatever you want, as long as you avoid extravagance and vanity

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from ‘Amr bin Shu’aib, from his father, that his grandfather said:
           “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: ‘Eat and drink, give charity and wear clothes, as long as that does not involve any extravagance or vanity.’”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from ‘Amr bin Shu’aib, from his father, that his grandfather said:
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: ‘Eat and drink, give charity and wear clothes, as long as that does not involve any extravagance or vanity.’”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ، أَنْبَأَنَا هَمَّامٌ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ شُعَيْبٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " كُلُوا وَاشْرَبُوا وَتَصَدَّقُوا وَالْبَسُوا مَا لَمْ يُخَالِطْهُ إِسْرَافٌ أَوْ مَخِيلَةٌ " .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Dress, Hadith 3605

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3606

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَنْ لَبِسَ شُهْرَةً مِنَ الثِّيَابِ
chapter.englishTitle: One who wears a garment of fame

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Ibn ‘Umar said:
           “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: ‘Whoever wears a garment of pride and vanity, Allah will clothe him, on the Day of Resurrection, in a garment of humiliation.’”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Ibn ‘Umar said:
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: ‘Whoever wears a garment of pride and vanity, Allah will clothe him, on the Day of Resurrection, in a garment of humiliation.’”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبَادَةَ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ الْوَاسِطِيَّانِ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ، أَنْبَأَنَا شَرِيكٌ، عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ أَبِي زُرْعَةَ، عَنْ مُهَاجِرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " مَنْ لَبِسَ ثَوْبَ شُهْرَةٍ أَلْبَسَهُ اللَّهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ثَوْبَ مَذَلَّةٍ " .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Dress, Hadith 3606

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3607

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَنْ لَبِسَ شُهْرَةً مِنَ الثِّيَابِ
chapter.englishTitle: One who wears a garment of fame

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that ‘Abdullah bin ‘Umar said:
           “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: ‘Whoever wears a garment of pride and vanity in this world, Allah will clothe him in a garment of humiliation on the Day of Resurrection, then set it ablaze.’”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that ‘Abdullah bin ‘Umar said:
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: ‘Whoever wears a garment of pride and vanity in this world, Allah will clothe him in a garment of humiliation on the Day of Resurrection, then set it ablaze.’”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ أَبِي الشَّوَارِبِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ، عَنِ الْمُهَاجِرِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " مَنْ لَبِسَ ثَوْبَ شُهْرَةٍ فِي الدُّنْيَا أَلْبَسَهُ اللَّهُ ثَوْبَ مَذَلَّةٍ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ثُمَّ أَلْهَبَ فِيهِ نَارًا " .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Dress, Hadith 3607

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3608

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَنْ لَبِسَ شُهْرَةً مِنَ الثِّيَابِ
chapter.englishTitle: One who wears a garment of fame

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Dharr that the Prophet ﷺ said:
           “Whoever wears a garment of pride and vanity, Allah will turn away from him until he takes it off.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Dharr that the Prophet ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “Whoever wears a garment of pride and vanity, Allah will turn away from him until he takes it off.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا الْعَبَّاسُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ الْبَحْرَانِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعُ بْنُ مُحْرِزٍ النَّاجِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ جَهْمٍ، عَنْ زِرِّ بْنِ حُبَيْشٍ، عَنْ أَبِي ذَرٍّ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ  " مَنْ لَبِسَ ثَوْبَ شُهْرَةٍ أَعْرَضَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ حَتَّى يَضَعَهُ مَتَى وَضَعَهُ " .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Dress, Hadith 3608

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3609

chapter.arabicTitle: باب لُبْسِ جُلُودِ الْمَيْتَةِ إِذَا دُبِغَتْ
chapter.englishTitle: Wearing the skins of dead animals when they have been tanned

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Ibn ‘Abbas said:
           “I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: ‘Any skin that has been tanned has been purified.’”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Ibn ‘Abbas said:
hadiths.body: “I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: ‘Any skin that has been tanned has been purified.’”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ وَعْلَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ  " أَيُّمَا إِهَابٍ دُبِغَ فَقَدْ طَهُرَ " .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Dress, Hadith 3609

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3610

chapter.arabicTitle: باب لُبْسِ جُلُودِ الْمَيْتَةِ إِذَا دُبِغَتْ
chapter.englishTitle: Wearing the skins of dead animals when they have been tanned

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Maimunah that he (meaning the Prophet ﷺ) passed by a dead sheep belonging to the freed slave woman of Maimunah, that had been given to her in charity. He said:
           “Why don’t they take its skin and ten it, and make us of it?” They said: “O Messenger of Allah, it is dead meat.”* He said: “It is only unlawful to eat it.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Maimunah that he (meaning the Prophet ﷺ) passed by a dead sheep belonging to the freed slave woman of Maimunah, that had been given to her in charity. He said:
hadiths.body: “Why don’t they take its skin and ten it, and make us of it?” They said: “O Messenger of Allah, it is dead meat.”* He said: “It is only unlawful to eat it.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، عَنْ مَيْمُونَةَ، أَنَّ شَاةً، لِمَوْلاَةِ مَيْمُونَةَ مَرَّ بِهَا - يَعْنِي النَّبِيَّ ﷺ - قَدْ أُعْطِيَتْهَا مِنَ الصَّدَقَةِ مَيْتَةً فَقَالَ " هَلاَّ أَخَذُوا إِهَابَهَا فَدَبَغُوهُ فَانْتَفَعُوا بِهِ " . فَقَالُوا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّهَا مَيْتَةٌ . قَالَ " إِنَّمَا حَرُمَ أَكْلُهَا " .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Dress, Hadith 3610

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3611

chapter.arabicTitle: باب لُبْسِ جُلُودِ الْمَيْتَةِ إِذَا دُبِغَتْ
chapter.englishTitle: Wearing the skins of dead animals when they have been tanned

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Salman said:
           “One of the Mothers of the Believers had a sheep that died. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ passed by it and said: ‘It would not have harmed its owners if they had made use of its hide.’”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Salman said:
hadiths.body: “One of the Mothers of the Believers had a sheep that died. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ passed by it and said: ‘It would not have harmed its owners if they had made use of its hide.’”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحِيمِ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ لَيْثٍ، عَنْ شَهْرِ بْنِ حَوْشَبٍ، عَنْ سَلْمَانَ، قَالَ كَانَ لِبَعْضِ أُمَّهَاتِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ شَاةٌ فَمَاتَتْ فَمَرَّ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَلَيْهَا فَقَالَ  " مَا ضَرَّ أَهْلَ هَذِهِ لَوِ انْتَفَعُوا بِإِهَابِهَا " .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Dress, Hadith 3611

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3612

chapter.arabicTitle: باب لُبْسِ جُلُودِ الْمَيْتَةِ إِذَا دُبِغَتْ
chapter.englishTitle: Wearing the skins of dead animals when they have been tanned

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that ‘Aishah said:
           “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ commanded that use should be made of the skins of dead animals, if they were tanned.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that ‘Aishah said:
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ commanded that use should be made of the skins of dead animals, if they were tanned.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ، عَنْ مَالِكِ بْنِ أَنَسٍ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ قُسَيْطٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ أُمِّهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ أَمَرَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَنْ يُسْتَمْتَعَ بِجُلُودِ الْمَيْتَةِ إِذَا دُبِغَتْ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Dress, Hadith 3612

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3613

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَنْ كَانَ لاَ يَنْتَفِعُ مِنَ الْمَيْتَةِ بِإِهَابٍ وَلاَ عَصَبٍ
chapter.englishTitle: Those who say that untanned skins and sinew of dead animals should not be made use of

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that ‘Abdullah bin ‘Ukaym said:
           “There came to us a letter from the Prophet ﷺ (saying): ‘No not make use of the untanned skin and sinew of dead animals.’”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that ‘Abdullah bin ‘Ukaym said:
hadiths.body: “There came to us a letter from the Prophet ﷺ (saying): ‘No not make use of the untanned skin and sinew of dead animals.’”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُسْهِرٍ، عَنِ الشَّيْبَانِيِّ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا غُنْدَرٌ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنِ الْحَكَمِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُكَيْمٍ، قَالَ أَتَانَا كِتَابُ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ  " أَنْ لاَ تَنْتَفِعُوا مِنَ الْمَيْتَةِ بِإِهَابٍ وَلاَ عَصَبٍ " .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Dress, Hadith 3613

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3614

chapter.englishTitle: Description of sandals

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that ‘Abdullah bin ‘Abbas said:
           “The sandals of the Prophet ﷺ had two thongs doubled around their straps.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that ‘Abdullah bin ‘Abbas said:
hadiths.body: “The sandals of the Prophet ﷺ had two thongs doubled around their straps.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ خَالِدٍ الْحَذَّاءِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْعَبَّاسِ، قَالَ كَانَ لِنَعْلِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قِبَالاَنِ مَثْنِيٌّ شِرَاكُهُمَا .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Dress, Hadith 3614

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3615

chapter.englishTitle: Description of sandals

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Anas said:
           “The sandals of the Prophet ﷺ had two thongs.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Anas said:
hadiths.body: “The sandals of the Prophet ﷺ had two thongs.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ، عَنْ هَمَّامٍ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ كَانَ لِنَعْلِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قِبَالاَنِ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Dress, Hadith 3615

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3616

chapter.englishTitle: Putting on sandals and taking them off

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            “When anyone of you puts on his sandals, let him start with the right, and when he takes them off, let him start with the left.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “When anyone of you puts on his sandals, let him start with the right, and when he takes them off, let him start with the left.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " إِذَا انْتَعَلَ أَحَدُكُمْ فَلْيَبْدَأْ بِالْيُمْنَى وَإِذَا خَلَعَ فَلْيَبْدَأْ بِالْيُسْرَى " .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Dress, Hadith 3616

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3617

chapter.englishTitle: Walking in one sandal

hadiths.englishRaw: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said; “None of you should walk in one sandal or in one leather sock. Let him take them both off or walk in both of them.”
hadiths.body: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said; “None of you should walk in one sandal or in one leather sock. Let him take them both off or walk in both of them.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ إِدْرِيسَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَجْلاَنَ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " لاَ يَمْشِي أَحَدُكُمْ فِي نَعْلٍ وَاحِدٍ وَلاَ خُفٍّ وَاحِدٍ لِيَخْلَعْهُمَا جَمِيعًا أَوْ لِيَمْشِ فِيهِمَا جَمِيعًا " .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Dress, Hadith 3617

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3618

chapter.englishTitle: Putting on sandals while standing

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Abu Hurairah said:
           “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade putting on sandals whilst standing.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Abu Hurairah said:
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade putting on sandals whilst standing.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَنْ يَنْتَعِلَ الرَّجُلُ قَائِمًا .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Dress, Hadith 3618

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3619

chapter.englishTitle: Putting on sandals while standing

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Ibn ‘Umar said:
           “The Prophet ﷺ forbade putting on sandals whilst standing.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Ibn ‘Umar said:
hadiths.body: “The Prophet ﷺ forbade putting on sandals whilst standing.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ نَهَى النَّبِيُّ ﷺ أَنْ يَنْتَعِلَ الرَّجُلُ قَائِمًا .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Dress, Hadith 3619

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3620

chapter.englishTitle: Black leather socks

hadiths.englishRaw: It was narrated from Ibn Buraidah, from his father, that an-Najashi sent a pair of pure black Khuff as a gift to the Prophet ﷺ of, which he wore.
hadiths.body: It was narrated from Ibn Buraidah, from his father, that an-Najashi sent a pair of pure black Khuff as a gift to the Prophet ﷺ of, which he wore.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، حَدَّثَنَا دَلْهَمُ بْنُ صَالِحٍ الْكِنْدِيُّ، عَنْ حُجَيْرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْكِنْدِيِّ، عَنِ ابْنِ بُرَيْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ النَّجَاشِيَّ، أَهْدَى لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ خُفَّيْنِ سَاذَجَيْنِ أَسْوَدَيْنِ فَلَبِسَهُمَا .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Dress, Hadith 3620

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3621

chapter.englishTitle: Dyeing (hair) with henna

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Abu Hurairah attributed to the Prophet ﷺ:
            “The Jews and the Christians do not dye (their hair), so differ from them.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Abu Hurairah attributed to the Prophet ﷺ:
hadiths.body: “The Jews and the Christians do not dye (their hair), so differ from them.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، سَمِعَ أَبَا سَلَمَةَ، وَسُلَيْمَانَ بْنَ يَسَارٍ، يُخْبِرَانِ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، يَبْلُغُ بِهِ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ قَالَ  " إِنَّ الْيَهُودَ وَالنَّصَارَى لاَ يَصْبُغُونَ فَخَالِفُوهُمْ " .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Dress, Hadith 3621

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3622

chapter.englishTitle: Dyeing (hair) with henna

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Dharr that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
           “The best things with which you change gray hair are henna and Katam.”*
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Dharr that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “The best things with which you change gray hair are henna and Katam.”*
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ إِدْرِيسَ، عَنِ الأَجْلَحِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ بُرَيْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي الأَسْوَدِ الدِّيلِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي ذَرٍّ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " إِنَّ أَحْسَنَ مَا غَيَّرْتُمْ بِهِ الشَّيْبَ الْحِنَّاءُ وَالْكَتَمُ " .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Dress, Hadith 3622

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3623

chapter.englishTitle: Dyeing (hair) with henna

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that ‘Uthman bin Mawhab said:
           “I entered upon Umm Salamah and she brought out for me a hair of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, which was dyed with henna and Katam.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that ‘Uthman bin Mawhab said:
hadiths.body: “I entered upon Umm Salamah and she brought out for me a hair of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, which was dyed with henna and Katam.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سَلاَّمُ بْنُ أَبِي مُطِيعٍ، عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ مَوْهَبٍ، قَالَ دَخَلْتُ عَلَى أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ . قَالَ فَأَخْرَجَتْ إِلَىَّ شَعَرًا مِنْ شَعَرِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ مَخْضُوبًا بِالْحِنَّاءِ وَالْكَتَمِ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Dress, Hadith 3623

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3624

chapter.englishTitle: Dyeing (hair) black

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Jabir that he said:
           “Abu Quhaifah was brought to the Prophet ﷺ on the Day of the Conquest (of Makkah), and his head was all white. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: ‘Take him to some of his womenfolk and let them change this, but avoid black.’”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Jabir that he said:
hadiths.body: “Abu Quhaifah was brought to the Prophet ﷺ on the Day of the Conquest (of Makkah), and his head was all white. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: ‘Take him to some of his womenfolk and let them change this, but avoid black.’”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ، عَنْ لَيْثٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ جِيءَ بِأَبِي قُحَافَةَ يَوْمَ الْفَتْحِ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ ﷺ وَكَأَنَّ رَأْسَهُ ثَغَامَةٌ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " اذْهَبُوا بِهِ إِلَى بَعْضِ نِسَائِهِ فَلْتُغَيِّرْهُ وَجَنِّبُوهُ السَّوَادَ " .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Dress, Hadith 3624

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3625

chapter.englishTitle: Dyeing (hair) black

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Suhaib Al-Khair said:
           “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: ‘The best thing with which you can dye your hair is this black (dye). It makes your women desire you and creates fear in the hearts of your enemies.’”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Suhaib Al-Khair said:
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: ‘The best thing with which you can dye your hair is this black (dye). It makes your women desire you and creates fear in the hearts of your enemies.’”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ الصَّيْرَفِيُّ، مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ فِرَاسٍ حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ بْنِ زَكَرِيَّا الرَّاسِبِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا دَفَّاعُ بْنُ دَغْفَلٍ السَّدُوسِيُّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْحَمِيدِ بْنِ صَيْفِيٍّ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ، صُهَيْبِ الْخَيْرِ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " إِنَّ أَحْسَنَ مَا اخْتَضَبْتُمْ بِهِ لَهَذَا السَّوَادُ أَرْغَبُ لِنِسَائِكُمْ فِيكُمْ وَأَهْيَبُ لَكُمْ فِي صُدُورِ عَدُوِّكُمْ " .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Dress, Hadith 3625

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3626

chapter.englishTitle: Dyeing (hair) yellow

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Sa’eed bin Abu Sa’eed that ‘Ubaid bin Juraij asked Ibn ‘Umar:
           “I see that you dye your beard yellow with Wars.” Ibn ‘Umar said: “As for my dyeing of my beard yellow with Wars, I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ dyeing his beard yellow.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Sa’eed bin Abu Sa’eed that ‘Ubaid bin Juraij asked Ibn ‘Umar:
hadiths.body: “I see that you dye your beard yellow with Wars.” Ibn ‘Umar said: “As for my dyeing of my beard yellow with Wars, I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ dyeing his beard yellow.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، أَنَّ عُبَيْدَ بْنَ جُرَيْجٍ، سَأَلَ ابْنَ عُمَرَ قَالَ رَأَيْتُكَ تُصَفِّرُ لِحْيَتَكَ بِالْوَرْسِ فَقَالَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ أَمَّا تَصْفِيرِي لِحْيَتِي فَإِنِّي رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يُصَفِّرُ لِحْيَتَهُ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Dress, Hadith 3626

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3627

chapter.englishTitle: Dyeing (hair) yellow

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Ibn ‘Abbas said:
           “The Prophet ﷺ passed by a man who had dyed his hair with henna and said: ‘How handsome this is!’ Then he passed by another who had dyed his hair with henna and Katam, and said: ‘This one is more handsome than that one.’ Then he passed by another who had dyed his hair yellow and said: ‘This one is more handsome than all of them.’”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Ibn ‘Abbas said:
hadiths.body: “The Prophet ﷺ passed by a man who had dyed his hair with henna and said: ‘How handsome this is!’ Then he passed by another who had dyed his hair with henna and Katam, and said: ‘This one is more handsome than that one.’ Then he passed by another who had dyed his hair yellow and said: ‘This one is more handsome than all of them.’”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ طَلْحَةَ، عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ وَهْبٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ طَاوُسٍ، عَنْ طَاوُسٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ مَرَّ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ عَلَى رَجُلٍ قَدْ خَضَبَ بِالْحِنَّاءِ فَقَالَ " مَا أَحْسَنَ هَذَا " . ثُمَّ مَرَّ بِآخَرَ قَدْ خَضَبَ بِالْحِنَّاءِ وَالْكَتَمِ فَقَالَ " هَذَا أَحْسَنُ مِنْ هَذَا " . ثُمَّ مَرَّ بِآخَرَ قَدْ خَضَبَ بِالصُّفْرَةِ فَقَالَ " هَذَا أَحْسَنُ مِنْ هَذَا كُلِّهِ " . قَالَ وَكَانَ طَاوُسٌ يُصَفِّرُ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Dress, Hadith 3627

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3628

chapter.englishTitle: One who does not dye his hair

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Abu Juhaifah said:
           “I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and this part of his hair was white” – meaning the tuft of hair between the lower lip and the chin.
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Abu Juhaifah said:
hadiths.body: “I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and this part of his hair was white” – meaning the tuft of hair between the lower lip and the chin.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ، حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ أَبِي جُحَيْفَةَ، قَالَ رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ هَذِهِ مِنْهُ بَيْضَاءُ . يَعْنِي عَنْفَقَتَهُ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Dress, Hadith 3628

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3629

chapter.englishTitle: One who does not dye his hair

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Humaid said:
           “Anas bin Malik was asked: ‘Did the Messenger of Allah ﷺ dye his hair?’ He said: ‘He did not have any white hair apart from approximately seventeen or twenty hairs at the front of his beard.’”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Humaid said:
hadiths.body: “Anas bin Malik was asked: ‘Did the Messenger of Allah ﷺ dye his hair?’ He said: ‘He did not have any white hair apart from approximately seventeen or twenty hairs at the front of his beard.’”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ الْحَارِثِ، وَابْنُ أَبِي عَدِيٍّ، عَنْ حُمَيْدٍ، قَالَ سُئِلَ أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ أَخَضَبَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ إِنَّهُ لَمْ يَرَ مِنَ الشَّيْبِ إِلاَّ نَحْوَ سَبْعَةَ عَشَرَ أَوْ عِشْرِينَ شَعَرَةً فِي مُقَدَّمِ لِحْيَتِهِ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Dress, Hadith 3629

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3630

chapter.englishTitle: One who does not dye his hair

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Ibn ‘Umar said:
           “The white hair of the Prophet ﷺ numbered approximately twenty.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Ibn ‘Umar said:
hadiths.body: “The white hair of the Prophet ﷺ numbered approximately twenty.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْوَلِيدِ الْكِنْدِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ آدَمَ، عَنْ شَرِيكٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ كَانَ شَيْبُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ نَحْوَ عِشْرِينَ شَعَرَةً .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Dress, Hadith 3630

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3631

chapter.englishTitle: Wearing one’s hair down to the shoulders and wearing braids

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Mujahid said:
           “Umm Hani said: ‘When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ entered Makkah he had four braids.’”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Mujahid said:
hadiths.body: “Umm Hani said: ‘When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ entered Makkah he had four braids.’”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، قَالَ قَالَتْ أُمُّ هَانِئٍ دَخَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ مَكَّةَ وَلَهُ أَرْبَعُ غَدَائِرَ . تَعْنِي ضَفَائِرَ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Dress, Hadith 3631

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3632

chapter.englishTitle: Wearing one’s hair down to the shoulders and wearing braids

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Ibn ‘Abbas said:
           “The People of the Book used to let their hair hang down, and the idolaters used to part their hair. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ liked to be more like the People of the Book. So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ let his forelock hang down, then after that he parted it.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Ibn ‘Abbas said:
hadiths.body: “The People of the Book used to let their hair hang down, and the idolaters used to part their hair. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ liked to be more like the People of the Book. So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ let his forelock hang down, then after that he parted it.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ آدَمَ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ كَانَ أَهْلُ الْكِتَابِ يَسْدُلُونَ أَشْعَارَهُمْ وَكَانَ الْمُشْرِكُونَ يَفْرِقُونَ وَكَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ يُحِبُّ مُوَافَقَةَ أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ . قَالَ فَسَدَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ نَاصِيَتَهُ ثُمَّ فَرَقَ بَعْدُ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Dress, Hadith 3632

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3633

chapter.englishTitle: Wearing one’s hair down to the shoulders and wearing braids

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that ‘Aishah said:
           “I used to part the hair of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ behind his crown, and let his forelock hang down.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that ‘Aishah said:
hadiths.body: “I used to part the hair of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ behind his crown, and let his forelock hang down.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ عَبَّادٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ كُنْتُ أَفْرِقُ خَلْفَ يَافُوخِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ ثُمَّ أَسْدِلُ نَاصِيَتَهُ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Dress, Hadith 3633

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3634

chapter.englishTitle: Wearing one’s hair down to the shoulders and wearing braids

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Anas said:
           “The hair of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was wavy, and (hung down) between his ears and his shoulders.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Anas said:
hadiths.body: “The hair of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was wavy, and (hung down) between his ears and his shoulders.”
hadiths.arabic: يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ، أَنْبَأَنَا جَرِيرُ بْنُ حَازِمٍ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ كَانَ شَعَرُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ شَعَرًا رَجِلاً بَيْنَ أُذُنَيْهِ وَمَنْكِبَيْهِ.
references: Vol. 4, Book of Dress, Hadith 3634

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3635

chapter.englishTitle: Wearing one’s hair down to the shoulders and wearing braids

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that ‘Aishah said:
           “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ had hair that came between his earlobes and his shoulders.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that ‘Aishah said:
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ had hair that came between his earlobes and his shoulders.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي فُدَيْكٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ كَانَ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ شَعَرٌ دُونَ الْجُمَّةِ وَفَوْقَ الْوَفْرَةِ.
references: Vol. 4, Book of Dress, Hadith 3635

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3636

chapter.englishTitle: The disdain of having much hair

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Wa’il bin Hujr said:
           “The Prophet ﷺ saw me when I had long hair. He said: ‘Bad news, bad news!’ So I went away and cut it short. Then the Prophet ﷺ saw me and said: ‘I did not mean you, but this is better.’”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Wa’il bin Hujr said:
hadiths.body: “The Prophet ﷺ saw me when I had long hair. He said: ‘Bad news, bad news!’ So I went away and cut it short. Then the Prophet ﷺ saw me and said: ‘I did not mean you, but this is better.’”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاوِيَةُ بْنُ هِشَامٍ، وَسُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُقْبَةَ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ عَاصِمِ بْنِ كُلَيْبٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ وَائِلِ بْنِ حُجْرٍ، قَالَ رَآنِيَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ وَلِي شَعَرٌ طَوِيلٌ فَقَالَ " ذُبَابٌ ذُبَابٌ " . فَانْطَلَقْتُ فَأَخَذْتُهُ فَرَآنِيَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ فَقَالَ " إِنِّي لَمْ أَعْنِكَ وَهَذَا أَحْسَنُ " .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Dress, Hadith 3636

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3637

chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Qaza`

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Nafi’ that Ibn ‘Umar said:
           “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade Qaza’.” He (Nafi’) said: “What is Qaza’?” He said: “It means shaving part of a child’s head and leaving another part.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Nafi’ that Ibn ‘Umar said:
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade Qaza’.” He (Nafi’) said: “What is Qaza’?” He said: “It means shaving part of a child’s head and leaving another part.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَعَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهُ ﷺ عَنِ الْقَزَعِ . قَالَ وَمَا الْقَزَعُ قَالَ أَنْ يُحْلَقَ مِنْ رَأْسِ الصَّبِيِّ مَكَانٌ وَيُتْرَكَ مَكَانٌ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Dress, Hadith 3637

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3638

chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Qaza`

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Ibn ‘Umar said:
           “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade Qaza’.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Ibn ‘Umar said:
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade Qaza’.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا شَبَابَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَنِ الْقَزَعِ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Dress, Hadith 3638

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3639

chapter.englishTitle: Inscriptions on rings

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Ibn ‘Umar said:
           “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ wore a ring of silver, then he had engraved on it (the words) ‘Muhammad Rasul Allah’ (Muhammad the Messenger of Allah). And he said: ‘No one should have his ring engraved like this ring of mine.’”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Ibn ‘Umar said:
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ wore a ring of silver, then he had engraved on it (the words) ‘Muhammad Rasul Allah’ (Muhammad the Messenger of Allah). And he said: ‘No one should have his ring engraved like this ring of mine.’”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ بْنِ مُوسَى، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ اتَّخَذَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ خَاتَمًا مِنْ وَرِقٍ ثُمَّ نَقَشَ فِيهِ مُحَمَّدٌ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ فَقَالَ  " لاَ يَنْقُشْ أَحَدٌ عَلَى نَقْشِ خَاتَمِي هَذَا " .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Dress, Hadith 3639

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3640

chapter.englishTitle: Inscriptions on rings

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Anas bin Malik said:
           “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ had a ring made for him, and he said: ‘I have had a ring made for me and had it engraved, and no one should make a ring with similar engraving.’”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Anas bin Malik said:
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ had a ring made for him, and he said: ‘I have had a ring made for me and had it engraved, and no one should make a ring with similar engraving.’”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ بْنِ صُهَيْبٍ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ اصْطَنَعَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ خَاتَمًا فَقَالَ  " إِنَّا قَدِ اصْطَنَعْنَا خَاتَمًا وَنَقَشْنَا فِيهِ نَقْشًا فَلاَ يَنْقُشَنَّ عَلَيْهِ أَحَدٌ " .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Dress, Hadith 3640

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3641

chapter.englishTitle: Inscriptions on rings

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Anas bin Malik that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ wore a ring of silver, in which was an Ethiopian gemstone and the inscription:
           ‘Muhammad Rasul Allah’ (Muhammad the Messenger of Allah).”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Anas bin Malik that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ wore a ring of silver, in which was an Ethiopian gemstone and the inscription:
hadiths.body: ‘Muhammad Rasul Allah’ (Muhammad the Messenger of Allah).”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ اتَّخَذَ خَاتَمًا مِنْ فِضَّةٍ لَهُ فَصٌّ حَبَشِيٌّ وَنَقْشُهُ مُحَمَّدٌ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Dress, Hadith 3641

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3642

chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of gold rings

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that ‘Ali said:
           “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade wearing gold rings.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that ‘Ali said:
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade wearing gold rings.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ نَافِعِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، مَوْلَى عَلِيٍّ عَنْ عَلِيٍّ، قَالَ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَنِ التَّخَتُّمِ بِالذَّهَبِ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Dress, Hadith 3642

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3643

chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of gold rings

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Ibn ‘Umar said:
           “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade gold rings.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Ibn ‘Umar said:
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade gold rings.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُسْهِرٍ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي زِيَادٍ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ سُهَيْلٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَنْ خَاتَمِ الذَّهَبِ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Dress, Hadith 3643

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3644

chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of gold rings

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that ‘Aishah the Mother of the Believers said:
            “Najashi sent some jewelry as a gift to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. Among that was a gold ring with an Ethiopian gemstone. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ picked it up with a stick – as if he found it distasteful – or with one of his fingers, then he called for his daughter, Umamah bint Abul-‘As, and said: ‘Wear this, O my daughter.’”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that ‘Aishah the Mother of the Believers said:
hadiths.body: “Najashi sent some jewelry as a gift to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. Among that was a gold ring with an Ethiopian gemstone.
