The Messenger of Allah ﷺ picked it up with a stick – as if he found it distasteful – or with one of his fingers, then he called for his daughter, Umamah bint Abul-‘As, and said: ‘Wear this, O my daughter.’”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ عَبَّادِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ أُمِّ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ، قَالَتْ أَهْدَى النَّجَاشِيُّ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ حَلْقَةً فِيهَا خَاتَمُ ذَهَبٍ فِيهِ فَصٌّ حَبَشِيٌّ فَأَخَذَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ بِعُودٍ وَإِنَّهُ لَمُعْرِضٌ عَنْهُ أَوْ بِبَعْضِ أَصَابِعِهِ ثُمَّ دَعَا ابْنَةَ ابْنَتِهِ أُمَامَةَ بِنْتَ أَبِي الْعَاصِ فَقَالَ  " تَحَلَّىْ بِهَذَا يَا بُنَيَّةُ " .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Dress, Hadith 3644

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3645

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَنْ جَعَلَ فَصَّ خَاتَمِهِ مِمَّا يَلِي كَفَّهُ
chapter.englishTitle: One who wears a ring with the bezel towards his palm

hadiths.englishRaw: It was narrated from Ibn ‘Umar that the Prophet ﷺ used to wear (his ring) with the stone nearest his palm.
hadiths.body: It was narrated from Ibn ‘Umar that the Prophet ﷺ used to wear (his ring) with the stone nearest his palm.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ بْنِ مُوسَى، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ كَانَ يَجْعَلُ فَصَّ خَاتَمِهِ مِمَّا يَلِي كَفَّهُ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Dress, Hadith 3645

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3646

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَنْ جَعَلَ فَصَّ خَاتَمِهِ مِمَّا يَلِي كَفَّهُ
chapter.englishTitle: One who wears a ring with the bezel towards his palm

hadiths.englishRaw: It was narrated from Anas bin Malik that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ wore a silver ring with an Ethiopian gemstone, and he used to ear the stone in towards his palm.
hadiths.body: It was narrated from Anas bin Malik that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ wore a silver ring with an Ethiopian gemstone, and he used to ear the stone in towards his palm.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ أَبِي أُوَيْسٍ، حَدَّثَنِي سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ بِلاَلٍ، عَنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ الأَيْلِيِّ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ لَبِسَ خَاتَمَ فِضَّةٍ فِيهِ فَصٌّ حَبَشِيٌّ كَانَ يَجْعَلُ فَصَّهُ فِي بَطْنِ كَفِّهِ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Dress, Hadith 3646

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3647

chapter.englishTitle: Wearing rings on the right hand

hadiths.englishRaw: It was narrated from ‘Abdullah bin Ja’far that the Prophet ﷺ used to wear a ring on his right hand.
hadiths.body: It was narrated from ‘Abdullah bin Ja’far that the Prophet ﷺ used to wear a ring on his right hand.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ الْفَضْلِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَقِيلٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ كَانَ يَتَخَتَّمُ فِي يَمِينِهِ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Dress, Hadith 3647

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3648

chapter.englishTitle: Wearing rings on the thumb

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that ‘Ali said:
           “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade me to wear a ring on this and on this,” meaning the little finger and the thumb.
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that ‘Ali said:
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade me to wear a ring on this and on this,” meaning the little finger and the thumb.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ إِدْرِيسَ، عَنْ عَاصِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ، قَالَ نَهَانِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَنْ أَتَخَتَّمَ فِي هَذِهِ وَفِي هَذِهِ يَعْنِي الْخِنْصَرَ وَالإِبْهَامَ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Dress, Hadith 3648

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3649

chapter.englishTitle: Images in the house

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Talhah that the Prophet ﷺ said:
           “The angels do not enter a house in which there is a dog or an image.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Talhah that the Prophet ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “The angels do not enter a house in which there is a dog or an image.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، عَنْ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ  " لاَ تَدْخُلُ الْمَلاَئِكَةُ بَيْتًا فِيهِ كَلْبٌ وَلاَ صُورَةٌ " .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Dress, Hadith 3649

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3650

chapter.englishTitle: Images in the house

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from ‘Ali bin Abu Talib that the Prophet ﷺ said:
            “The angels do not enter a house in which there is a dog or an image.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from ‘Ali bin Abu Talib that the Prophet ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: “The angels do not enter a house in which there is a dog or an image.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا غُنْدَرٌ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مُدْرِكٍ، عَنْ أَبِي زُرْعَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُجَىٍّ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ  " إِنَّ الْمَلاَئِكَةَ لاَ تَدْخُلُ بَيْتًا فِيهِ كَلْبٌ وَلاَ صُورَةٌ " .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Dress, Hadith 3650

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3651

chapter.englishTitle: Images in the house

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that ‘Aishah said:
           “Jibril (as) promised the Messenger of Allah ﷺ that he would come to him at a certain hour, but he was late. The Prophet ﷺ went out and there was Jibril standing at the door. He said: ‘What kept you from entering?’ He said: ‘There is a dog in the house, and we do not enter a house in which there is a dog or an image.’”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that ‘Aishah said:
hadiths.body: “Jibril (as) promised the Messenger of Allah ﷺ that he would come to him at a certain hour, but he was late. The Prophet ﷺ went out and there was Jibril standing at the door. He said: ‘What kept you from entering?’ He said: ‘There is a dog in the house, and we do not enter a house in which there is a dog or an image.’”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُسْهِرٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ وَاعَدَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ جِبْرِيلُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ فِي سَاعَةٍ يَأْتِيهِ فِيهَا فَرَاثَ عَلَيْهِ فَخَرَجَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ فَإِذَا هُوَ بِجِبْرِيلَ قَائِمٌ عَلَى الْبَابِ فَقَالَ  " مَا مَنَعَكَ أَنْ تَدْخُلَ " . قَالَ إِنَّ فِي الْبَيْتِ كَلْبًا وَإِنَّا لاَ نَدْخُلُ بَيْتًا فِيهِ كَلْبٌ وَلاَ صُورَةٌ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Dress, Hadith 3651

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3652

chapter.englishTitle: Images in the house

hadiths.englishRaw: It was narrated from Abu Umamah that a woman came to the Prophet ﷺ and told him that her husband was away on some military campaign. She asked him for permission to make an image of a palm tree in her house, and he did not let her, or he forbade her.
hadiths.body: It was narrated from Abu Umamah that a woman came to the Prophet ﷺ and told him that her husband was away on some military campaign. She asked him for permission to make an image of a palm tree in her house, and he did not let her, or he forbade her.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا الْعَبَّاسُ بْنُ عُثْمَانَ الدِّمَشْقِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ، حَدَّثَنَا عُفَيْرُ بْنُ مَعْدَانَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي أُمَامَةَ، أَنَّ امْرَأَةً، أَتَتِ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ فَأَخْبَرَتْهُ أَنَّ زَوْجَهَا فِي بَعْضِ الْمَغَازِي فَاسْتَأْذَنَتْهُ أَنْ تُصَوِّرَ فِي بَيْتِهَا نَخْلَةً فَمَنَعَهَا أَوْ نَهَاهَا .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Dress, Hadith 3652

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3653

chapter.englishTitle: Images on items that are stepped on

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that ‘Aishah said:
           “I covered a small room closet of mine, meaning, from the inside, with a curtain on which there were images. When the Prophet ﷺ came, he tore it down, so I made two pillows from it, and I saw the Prophet ﷺ reclining on one of them.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that ‘Aishah said:
hadiths.body: “I covered a small room closet of mine, meaning, from the inside, with a curtain on which there were images. When the Prophet ﷺ came, he tore it down, so I made two pillows from it, and I saw the Prophet ﷺ reclining on one of them.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ أُسَامَةَ بْنِ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْقَاسِمِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ سَتَرْتُ سَهْوَةً لِي - تَعْنِي الدَّاخِلَ - بِسِتْرٍ فِيهِ تَصَاوِيرُ فَلَمَّا قَدِمَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ هَتَكَهُ فَجَعَلْتُ مِنْهُ مَنْبُوذَتَيْنِ فَرَأَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ مُتَّكِئًا عَلَى إِحْدَاهُمَا .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Dress, Hadith 3653

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3654

chapter.englishTitle: The saddle cushions that are red

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that ‘Ali said:
           “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade rings of gold and Al-Mitharah,”* meaning the red ones.
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that ‘Ali said:
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade rings of gold and Al-Mitharah,”* meaning the red ones.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الأَحْوَصِ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ هُبَيْرَةَ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ، قَالَ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَنْ خَاتَمِ الذَّهَبِ وَعَنِ الْمِيثَرَةِ يَعْنِي الْحَمْرَاءَ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Dress, Hadith 3654

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3655

chapter.englishTitle: Riding on leopard skins

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that ‘Amir Al-Hajri said:
           “I heard Abu Raihanah, the Companion of the Prophet ﷺ say: ‘The Prophet ﷺ used to forbid riding on leopard skins.’”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that ‘Amir Al-Hajri said:
hadiths.body: “I heard Abu Raihanah, the Companion of the Prophet ﷺ say: ‘The Prophet ﷺ used to forbid riding on leopard skins.’”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا زَيْدُ بْنُ الْحُبَابِ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، حَدَّثَنِي عَيَّاشُ بْنُ عَبَّاسٍ الْحِمْيَرِيُّ، عَنْ أَبِي حُصَيْنٍ الْحَجْرِيِّ الْهَيْثَمِ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ الْحَجْرِيِّ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا رَيْحَانَةَ، صَاحِبَ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ يَقُولُ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ يَنْهَى عَنْ رُكُوبِ النُّمُورِ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Dress, Hadith 3655

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3656

chapter.englishTitle: Riding on leopard skins

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Mu’awiyah said:
           “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to forbid riding on leopard skins.”
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Mu’awiyah said:
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to forbid riding on leopard skins.”
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ أَبِي الْمُعْتَمِرِ، عَنِ ابْنِ سِيرِينَ، عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ، قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَنْهَى عَنْ رُكُوبِ النُّمُورِ .
references: Vol. 4, Book of Dress, Hadith 3656

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3657

chapter.englishTitle: Honoring One's Parents

hadiths.englishRaw:
Ibn Salamah As-Sulami narrated that the Prophet ﷺ said:
           "I enjoin each one to honor his mother,I enjoin each one to honor his mother,I enjoin each one to honor his mother(three times), I enjoin each one to honor his guardian who is taking care of him, even if he is causing him some annoyance."
hadiths.narrator: Ibn Salamah As-Sulami narrated that the Prophet ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: "I enjoin each one to honor his mother,I enjoin each one to honor his mother,I enjoin each one to honor his mother(three times), I enjoin each one to honor his guardian who is taking care of him, even if he is causing him some annoyance."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ، عَنِ ابْنِ سَلاَمَةَ السُّلَمِيِّ، قَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ  " أُوصِي امْرَأً بِأُمِّهِ أُوصِي امْرَأً بِأُمِّهِ أُوصِي امْرَأً بِأُمِّهِ - ثَلاَثًا - أُوصِي امْرَأً بِأَبِيهِ أُوصِي امْرَءًا بِمَوْلاَهُ الَّذِي يَلِيهِ وَإِنْ كَانَ عَلَيْهِ مِنْهُ أَذًى يُؤْذِيهِ " .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3657

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3658

chapter.englishTitle: Honoring One's Parents

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah, may Allah be pleased with them, said that:
            Allah's Messenger said: "They said: 'O Messenger of Allah, whom should I treat kindly?' He said: 'Your mother.' He said: 'Then who?' He said :'Your mother." He said: 'Then who?' He said: 'Your father'. He said : 'Then who?' He said: 'The next closest and the next closest.'"
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah, may Allah be pleased with them, said that:
hadiths.body: Allah's Messenger said: "They said: 'O Messenger of Allah, whom should I treat kindly?' He said: 'Your mother.' He said: 'Then who?' He said :'Your mother." He said: 'Then who?' He said: 'Your father'. He said : 'Then who?' He said: 'The next closest and the next closest.'"
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ، مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مَيْمُونٍ الْمَكِّيُّ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ عُمَارَةَ بْنِ الْقَعْقَاعِ، عَنْ أَبِي زُرْعَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالُوا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ مَنْ أَبَرُّ قَالَ " أُمَّكَ " . قَالَ ثُمَّ مَنْ قَالَ " أُمَّكَ " . قَالَ ثُمَّ مَنْ قَالَ " أَبَاكَ " . قَالَ ثُمَّ مَنْ قَالَ " الأَدْنَى فَالأَدْنَى " .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3658

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3659

chapter.englishTitle: Honoring One's Parents

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah, may Allah be pleased with them, narrated that:
            Allah's Messenger said: "No child can compensate his father unless he finds a slave, and buys him and sets him free."
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah, may Allah be pleased with them, narrated that:
hadiths.body: Allah's Messenger said: "No child can compensate his father unless he finds a slave, and buys him and sets him free."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ سُهَيْلٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " لاَ يَجْزِي وَلَدٌ وَالِدَهُ إِلاَّ أَنْ يَجِدَهُ مَمْلُوكًا فَيَشْتَرِيَهُ فَيُعْتِقَهُ " .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3659

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3660

chapter.englishTitle: Honoring One's Parents

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah, may Allah be pleased with them, narrated that:
            Allah's Messenger said: "Qintar is twelve thousand 'Uqiyah, each 'Uqiyah of which is better than what is between heaven and earth." And the Messenger of Allahﷺ said: "A man will be raised in status in Paradise and will say: 'Where did this come from?' And it will be said:'From your son's praying for forgiveness for you.'"
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah, may Allah be pleased with them, narrated that:
hadiths.body: Allah's Messenger said: "Qintar is twelve thousand 'Uqiyah, each 'Uqiyah of which is better than what is between heaven and earth." And the Messenger of Allahﷺ said: "A man will be raised in status in Paradise and will say: 'Where did this come from?' And it will be said:'From your son's praying for forgiveness for you.'"
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الصَّمَدِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْوَارِثِ، عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ عَاصِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ " الْقِنْطَارُ اثْنَا عَشَرَ أَلْفَ أُوقِيَّةٍ كُلُّ أُوقِيَّةٍ خَيْرٌ مِمَّا بَيْنَ السَّمَاءِ وَالأَرْضِ " . وَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ " إِنَّ الرَّجُلَ لَتُرْفَعُ دَرَجَتُهُ فِي الْجَنَّةِ فَيَقُولُ أَنَّى هَذَا فَيُقَالُ بِاسْتِغْفَارِ وَلَدِكَ لَكَ " .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3660

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3661

chapter.englishTitle: Honoring One's Parents

hadiths.englishRaw:
Miqdam bin Ma'dikarib, may Allah be pleased with them, narrated that:
            Allah's Messenger said: "Allah enjoins you to treat your mother's kindly"-three times- "Allah enjoins you to treat your fathers kindly, Allah enjoins you to treat the closest and the next closest kindly."
hadiths.narrator: Miqdam bin Ma'dikarib, may Allah be pleased with them, narrated that:
hadiths.body: Allah's Messenger said: "Allah enjoins you to treat your mother's kindly"-three times- "Allah enjoins you to treat your fathers kindly, Allah enjoins you to treat the closest and the next closest kindly."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ عَيَّاشٍ، عَنْ بَحِيرِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ مَعْدَانَ، عَنِ الْمِقْدَامِ بْنِ مَعْدِيكَرِبَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ  " إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُوصِيكُمْ بِأُمَّهَاتِكُمْ - ثَلاَثًا - إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُوصِيكُمْ بِآبَائِكُمْ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُوصِيكُمْ بِالأَقْرَبِ فَالأَقْرَبِ " .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3661

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3662

chapter.englishTitle: Honoring One's Parents

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Umamah narrated that a man said that:
            "O Allah's Messengerﷺ, what are the rights of parents over their child?" He said:"They are your Paradise and your Hell."
hadiths.narrator: Abu Umamah narrated that a man said that:
hadiths.body: "O Allah's Messengerﷺ, what are the rights of parents over their child?" He said:"They are your Paradise and your Hell."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا صَدَقَةُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي الْعَاتِكَةِ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ يَزِيدَ، عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ، عَنْ أَبِي أُمَامَةَ، أَنَّ رَجُلاً، قَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ مَا حَقُّ الْوَالِدَيْنِ عَلَى وَلَدِهِمَا قَالَ  " هُمَا جَنَّتُكَ وَنَارُكَ " .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3662

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3663

chapter.englishTitle: Honoring One's Parents

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Darda' heard the Prophet ﷺ say that:
            "The father is the middle door of Paradise (i.e. the best way to Paradise), so it is up to you whether you take advantage of it or not."
hadiths.narrator: Abu Darda' heard the Prophet ﷺ say that:
hadiths.body: "The father is the middle door of Paradise (i.e. the best way to Paradise), so it is up to you whether you take advantage of it or not."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الصَّبَّاحِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ أَبِي الدَّرْدَاءِ، سَمِعَ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ يَقُولُ  " الْوَالِدُ أَوْسَطُ أَبْوَابِ الْجَنَّةِ فَأَضِعْ ذَلِكَ الْبَابَ أَوِ احْفَظْهُ " .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3663

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3664

chapter.arabicTitle: باب صِلْ مَنْ كَانَ أَبُوكَ يَصِلُ
chapter.englishTitle: Uphold ties with those whom your father used to uphold ties

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Abu Usaid, Malik bin Rabi'ah, said:
            "While we were with the Prophet ﷺ, a man from the Banu Salamah came to him and said: " O messenger of Allah, is there anyway of honoring my parents that I can still do for them after they die?' He said: "Yes offering the funeral prayer for them, praying for forgiveness for them, fulfilling their promises after their death, honoring their freinds and upholding the ties of kinship which you would not have were it nor for them.'"
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Abu Usaid, Malik bin Rabi'ah, said:
hadiths.body: "While we were with the Prophet ﷺ, a man from the Banu Salamah came to him and said: " O messenger of Allah, is there anyway of honoring my parents that I can still do for them after they die?' He said: "Yes offering the funeral prayer for them, praying for forgiveness for them, fulfilling their promises after their death, honoring their freinds and upholding the ties of kinship which you would not have were it nor for them.'"
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ إِدْرِيسَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ أَسِيدِ بْنِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ عُبَيْدٍ، مَوْلَى بَنِي سَاعِدَةَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي أُسَيْدٍ، مَالِكِ بْنِ رَبِيعَةَ قَالَ بَيْنَمَا نَحْنُ عِنْدَ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ إِذْ جَاءَهُ رَجُلٌ مِنْ بَنِي سُلَيْمٍ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَبَقِيَ مِنْ بِرِّ أَبَوَىَّ شَىْءٌ أَبَرُّهُمَا بِهِ مِنْ بَعْدِ مَوْتِهِمَا قَالَ  " نَعَمْ الصَّلاَةُ عَلَيْهِمَا وَالاِسْتِغْفَارُ لَهُمَا وَإِيفَاءٌ بِعُهُودِهِمَا مِنْ بَعْدِ مَوْتِهِمَا وَإِكْرَامُ صَدِيقِهِمَا وَصِلَةُ الرَّحِمِ الَّتِي لاَ تُوصَلُ إِلاَّ بِهِمَا " .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3664

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3665

chapter.arabicTitle: باب بِرِّ الْوَالِدِ وَالإِحْسَانِ إِلَى الْبَنَاتِ
chapter.englishTitle: Honoring one's father and being kind to daughters

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Aisha, said:
            "Some Bedouin people came to the Prophet ﷺ and said: 'Do you kiss your children?' He said: 'Yes'. He said: 'But we, by Allah, never kiss (our children)'. The Prophet ﷺ said: 'What can I do if Allah has taken away mercy from you?'"
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Aisha, said:
hadiths.body: "Some Bedouin people came to the Prophet ﷺ and said: 'Do you kiss your children?' He said: 'Yes'. He said: 'But we, by Allah, never kiss (our children)'. The Prophet ﷺ said: 'What can I do if Allah has taken away mercy from you?'"
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ قَدِمَ نَاسٌ مِنَ الأَعْرَابِ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ ﷺ فَقَالُوا أَتُقَبِّلُونَ صِبْيَانَكُمْ قَالُوا نَعَمْ . فَقَالُوا لَكِنَّا وَاللَّهِ مَا نُقَبِّلُ . فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ  " وَأَمْلِكُ أَنْ كَانَ اللَّهُ قَدْ نَزَعَ مِنْكُمُ الرَّحْمَةَ " .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3665

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3666

chapter.arabicTitle: باب بِرِّ الْوَالِدِ وَالإِحْسَانِ إِلَى الْبَنَاتِ
chapter.englishTitle: Honoring one's father and being kind to daughters

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Ya'la Al -Amir that he said:
            "Hasan and Hussain came running to the Prophet ﷺ and he embraced them and said: 'Children make a man a miser and a coward.'"
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Ya'la Al -Amir that he said:
hadiths.body: "Hasan and Hussain came running to the Prophet ﷺ and he embraced them and said: 'Children make a man a miser and a coward.'"
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَفَّانُ، حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ خُثَيْمٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي رَاشِدٍ، عَنْ يَعْلَى الْعَامِرِيِّ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ جَاءَ الْحَسَنُ وَالْحُسَيْنُ يَسْعَيَانِ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ ﷺ فَضَمَّهُمَا إِلَيْهِ وَقَالَ  " إِنَّ الْوَلَدَ مَبْخَلَةٌ مَجْبَنَةٌ " .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3666

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3667

chapter.arabicTitle: باب بِرِّ الْوَالِدِ وَالإِحْسَانِ إِلَى الْبَنَاتِ
chapter.englishTitle: Honoring one's father and being kind to daughters

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Suraqah bin Malik that the Prophet ﷺ said:
            "Shall I not tell you of the best charity? A daughter who comes back to you and has no other breadwinner apart from you."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Suraqah bin Malik that the Prophet ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: "Shall I not tell you of the best charity? A daughter who comes back to you and has no other breadwinner apart from you."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا زَيْدُ بْنُ الْحُبَابِ، عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ عُلَىٍّ، سَمِعْتُ أَبِي يَذْكُرُ، عَنْ سُرَاقَةَ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ قَالَ  " أَلاَ أَدُلُّكُمْ عَلَى أَفْضَلِ الصَّدَقَةِ ابْنَتُكَ مَرْدُودَةً إِلَيْكَ لَيْسَ لَهَا كَاسِبٌ غَيْرُكَ " .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3667

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3668

chapter.arabicTitle: باب بِرِّ الْوَالِدِ وَالإِحْسَانِ إِلَى الْبَنَاتِ
chapter.englishTitle: Honoring one's father and being kind to daughters

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Sa'sa'ah the paternal uncle of Ahnaf, said:
            "A woman entered upon Aisha with her two daughters, and she gave her three dates. (The woman) gave each of her daughters a date, then she split the last one between them. She (Aisha) said: 'Then the Prophet ﷺ came and I told him about that.' He said:' Why are you surprised? She will enter Paradise because of that.'"
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Sa'sa'ah the paternal uncle of Ahnaf, said:
hadiths.body: "A woman entered upon Aisha with her two daughters, and she gave her three dates. (The woman) gave each of her daughters a date, then she split the last one between them. She (Aisha) said: 'Then the Prophet ﷺ came and I told him about that.' He said:' Why are you surprised? She will enter Paradise because of that.'"
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بِشْرٍ، عَنْ مِسْعَرٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي سَعْدُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، عَنْ صَعْصَعَةَ، عَمِّ الأَحْنَفِ قَالَ دَخَلَتْ عَلَى عَائِشَةَ امْرَأَةٌ مَعَهَا ابْنَتَانِ لَهَا فَأَعْطَتْهَا ثَلاَثَ تَمَرَاتٍ فَأَعْطَتْ كُلَّ وَاحِدَةٍ مِنْهُمَا تَمْرَةً ثُمَّ صَدَعَتِ الْبَاقِيَةَ بَيْنَهُمَا . قَالَتْ فَأَتَى النَّبِيُّ ﷺ فَحَدَّثْتُهُ فَقَالَ  " مَا عَجَبُكِ لَقَدْ دَخَلَتْ بِهِ الْجَنَّةَ " .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3668

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3669

chapter.arabicTitle: باب بِرِّ الْوَالِدِ وَالإِحْسَانِ إِلَى الْبَنَاتِ
chapter.englishTitle: Honoring one's father and being kind to daughters

hadiths.englishRaw:
Uqbah bin Amir said, I heard the Messenger of Allahﷺ say:
            "Whoever has three daughters and is patient towards them, and feeds them, gives them to drink, and clothes them from his wealth; they will be a shield for him from the Fire on the Day of Resurrection.'"
hadiths.narrator: Uqbah bin Amir said, I heard the Messenger of Allahﷺ say:
hadiths.body: "Whoever has three daughters and is patient towards them, and feeds them, gives them to drink, and clothes them from his wealth; they will be a shield for him from the Fire on the Day of Resurrection.'"
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ الْحَسَنِ الْمَرْوَزِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ، عَنْ حَرْمَلَةَ بْنِ عِمْرَانَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عُشَّانَةَ الْمَعَافِرِيَّ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عُقْبَةَ بْنَ عَامِرٍ، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ  " مَنْ كَانَ لَهُ ثَلاَثُ بَنَاتٍ فَصَبَرَ عَلَيْهِنَّ وَأَطْعَمَهُنَّ وَسَقَاهُنَّ وَكَسَاهُنَّ مِنْ جِدَتِهِ - كُنَّ لَهُ حِجَابًا مِنَ النَّارِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ " .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3669

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3670

chapter.arabicTitle: باب بِرِّ الْوَالِدِ وَالإِحْسَانِ إِلَى الْبَنَاتِ
chapter.englishTitle: Honoring one's father and being kind to daughters

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Ibn Abbas that the Messenger of Allahﷺ said:
            "There is no man whose two daughters reach the age of puberty and he treats them kindly for the time they are together, but they will gain him admittance to Paradise."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Ibn Abbas that the Messenger of Allahﷺ said:
hadiths.body: "There is no man whose two daughters reach the age of puberty and he treats them kindly for the time they are together, but they will gain him admittance to Paradise."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ الْحَسَنِ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ، عَنْ فِطْرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعْدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " مَا مِنْ رَجُلٍ تُدْرِكُ لَهُ ابْنَتَانِ فَيُحْسِنُ إِلَيْهِمَا مَا صَحِبَتَاهُ أَوْ صَحِبَهُمَا إِلاَّ أَدْخَلَتَاهُ الْجَنَّةَ " .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3670

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3671

chapter.arabicTitle: باب بِرِّ الْوَالِدِ وَالإِحْسَانِ إِلَى الْبَنَاتِ
chapter.englishTitle: Honoring one's father and being kind to daughters

hadiths.englishRaw:
Anas bin Malik narrated that the Messenger of Allahﷺ said:
            "Be kind to your children, and perfect their manners."
hadiths.narrator: Anas bin Malik narrated that the Messenger of Allahﷺ said:
hadiths.body: "Be kind to your children, and perfect their manners."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا الْعَبَّاسُ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ الدِّمَشْقِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَيَّاشٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عُمَارَةَ، أَخْبَرَنِي الْحَارِثُ بْنُ النُّعْمَانِ، سَمِعْتُ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَنَّهُ قَالَ  " أَكْرِمُوا أَوْلاَدَكُمْ وَأَحْسِنُوا أَدَبَهُمْ " .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3671

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3672

chapter.englishTitle: The neighbour's rights

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Shuraih Al-Khuzai that the Prophet ﷺ said:
            "Whoever believes in the Last Day, let him treat his neighbour well. Whoever believes in Allah and Last Day, let him honor his guest. Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, let him say something good or else remain silent"
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Shuraih Al-Khuzai that the Prophet ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: "Whoever believes in the Last Day, let him treat his neighbour well. Whoever believes in Allah and Last Day, let him honor his guest. Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, let him say something good or else remain silent"
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ، سَمِعَ نَافِعَ بْنَ جُبَيْرٍ، يُخْبِرُ عَنْ أَبِي شُرَيْحٍ الْخُزَاعِيِّ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ قَالَ  " مَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ فَلْيُحْسِنْ إِلَى جَارِهِ وَمَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ فَلْيُكْرِمْ ضَيْفَهُ وَمَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ فَلْيَقُلْ خَيْرًا أَوْ لِيَسْكُتْ " .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3672

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3673

chapter.englishTitle: The neighbour's rights

hadiths.englishRaw:
Aisha narrated that the Messenger of Allahﷺ said:
            "Jibra'il kept enjoining good treatment of neighbours untol I thought that he would make neigbours heirs."
hadiths.narrator: Aisha narrated that the Messenger of Allahﷺ said:
hadiths.body: "Jibra'il kept enjoining good treatment of neighbours untol I thought that he would make neigbours heirs."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ، وَعَبْدَةُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رُمْحٍ، أَنْبَأَنَا اللَّيْثُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ حَزْمٍ، عَنْ عَمْرَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ  " مَا زَالَ جِبْرِيلُ يُوصِينِي بِالْجَارِ حَتَّى ظَنَنْتُ أَنَّهُ سَيُوَرِّثُهُ " .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3673

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3674

chapter.englishTitle: The neighbour's rights

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Hurayrah that the Messenger of Allahﷺ said:
            "Jibra'il kept enjoining good treatment of neighbours until I thought he would make neighbours heirs."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Hurayrah that the Messenger of Allahﷺ said:
hadiths.body: "Jibra'il kept enjoining good treatment of neighbours until I thought he would make neighbours heirs."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ بْنُ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " مَا زَالَ جِبْرَائِيلُ يُوصِينِي بِالْجَارِ حَتَّى ظَنَنْتُ أَنَّهُ سَيُوَرِّثُهُ " .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3674

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3675

chapter.englishTitle: The guest's rights

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Shuraih Al-Khuza'i that the Messenger of Allahﷺ said:
            "Whoever believes in the Last Day, let him honor his guest, and grant him reward for a day and a night. And it is not permissible for him to stay so long that he causes annoyance to his host. Hospitality is for three days, and whatever he spends on him after three days is charity."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Shuraih Al-Khuza'i that the Messenger of Allahﷺ said:
hadiths.body: "Whoever believes in the Last Day, let him honor his guest, and grant him reward for a day and a night. And it is not permissible for him to stay so long that he causes annoyance to his host. Hospitality is for three days, and whatever he spends on him after three days is charity."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَجْلاَنَ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي شُرَيْحٍ الْخُزَاعِيِّ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ  " مَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ فَلْيُكْرِمْ ضَيْفَهُ وَجَائِزَتُهُ يَوْمٌ وَلَيْلَةٌ وَلاَ يَحِلُّ لَهُ أَنْ يَثْوِيَ عِنْدَ صَاحِبِهِ حَتَّى يُحْرِجَهُ الضِّيَافَةُ ثَلاَثَةُ أَيَّامٍ وَمَا أَنْفَقَ عَلَيْهِ بَعْدَ ثَلاَثَةِ أَيَّامٍ فَهُوَ صَدَقَةٌ " .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3675

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3676

chapter.englishTitle: The guest's rights

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Uqbah bin Amir said:
            "We said to the Messenger of Allahﷺ: ' You send us and we stay with people who do not show us any hospitality. WHat do you think of that?' The MEssenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'If you stay with people and they give you what a guest deserves, then accept it. If they do not do that , then take from them what they should have offered, which a guest is entitled to.'"
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Uqbah bin Amir said:
hadiths.body: "We said to the Messenger of Allahﷺ: ' You send us and we stay with people who do not show us any hospitality. WHat do you think of that?' The MEssenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'If you stay with people and they give you what a guest deserves, then accept it. If they do not do that , then take from them what they should have offered, which a guest is entitled to.'"
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رُمْحٍ، أَنْبَأَنَا اللَّيْثُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الْخَيْرِ، عَنْ عُقْبَةَ بْنِ عَامِرٍ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ قُلْنَا لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ إِنَّكَ تَبْعَثُنَا فَنَنْزِلُ بِقَوْمٍ فَلاَ يَقْرُونَا فَمَا تَرَى فِي ذَلِكَ . قَالَ لَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " إِنْ نَزَلْتُمْ بِقَوْمٍ فَأَمَرُوا لَكُمْ بِمَا يَنْبَغِي لِلضَّيْفِ فَاقْبَلُوا وَإِنْ لَمْ يَفْعَلُوا فَخُذُوا مِنْهُمْ حَقَّ الضَّيْفِ الَّذِي يَنْبَغِي لَهُمْ " .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3676

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3677

chapter.englishTitle: The guest's rights

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Miqdam Abu Karimah said:
            "The Messenger of Allahﷺ said: ' Putting up a guest for one night is obligatory. If you find a guest at your door in the morning, then this (hospitality) is (like) a debt that you (the host) owe him. If he (the guest) wants, he may request it, and if he wants, he may leave it'"
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Miqdam Abu Karimah said:
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allahﷺ said: ' Putting up a guest for one night is obligatory. If you find a guest at your door in the morning, then this (hospitality) is (like) a debt that you (the host) owe him. If he (the guest) wants, he may request it, and if he wants, he may leave it'"
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، عَنِ الْمِقْدَامِ أَبِي كَرِيمَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " لَيْلَةُ الضَّيْفِ وَاجِبَةٌ فَإِنْ أَصْبَحَ بِفِنَائِهِ فَهُوَ دَيْنٌ عَلَيْهِ فَإِنْ شَاءَ اقْتَضَى وَإِنْ شَاءَ تَرَكَ " .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3677

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3678

chapter.englishTitle: The orphan's rights

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allahﷺ said:
            "O Allah, bear witness that I have issued a warning concerning (failure to fulfill) the rights of the two weak ones: Orphans and women.'"
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allahﷺ said:
hadiths.body: "O Allah, bear witness that I have issued a warning concerning (failure to fulfill) the rights of the two weak ones: Orphans and women.'"
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الْقَطَّانُ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَجْلاَنَ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أُحَرِّجُ حَقَّ الضَّعِيفَيْنِ الْيَتِيمِ وَالْمَرْأَةِ " .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3678

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3679

chapter.englishTitle: The orphan's rights

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allahﷺ said:
            "The best house among the Muslims is a house in which there is an orphan who is treated well. And the worst house among the Muslims is a house in which there is an orphan who is treated badly."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allahﷺ said:
hadiths.body: "The best house among the Muslims is a house in which there is an orphan who is treated well. And the worst house among the Muslims is a house in which there is an orphan who is treated badly."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ آدَمَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَبِي عَتَّابٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ  " خَيْرُ بَيْتٍ فِي الْمُسْلِمِينَ بَيْتٌ فِيهِ يَتِيمٌ يُحْسَنُ إِلَيْهِ وَشَرُّ بَيْتٍ فِي الْمُسْلِمِينَ بَيْتٌ فِيهِ يَتِيمٌ يُسَاءُ إِلَيْهِ " .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3679

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3680

chapter.englishTitle: The orphan's rights

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from `Abdullah bin `Abbas that the Messenger of Allahﷺ said:
            "Whoever raises three orphans, is like the one who spends his nights in prayer and fasts during the day, and goes out morning and evening drawing his sword in the cause of Allah. In Paradise, he and I will be brothers like these two sisters,'and he held up his forefinger and middle finger together."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from `Abdullah bin `Abbas that the Messenger of Allahﷺ said:
hadiths.body: "Whoever raises three orphans, is like the one who spends his nights in prayer and fasts during the day, and goes out morning and evening drawing his sword in the cause of Allah. In Paradise, he and I will be brothers like these two sisters,'and he held up his forefinger and middle finger together."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْكَلْبِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الأَنْصَارِيُّ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ أَبِي رَبَاحٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " مَنْ عَالَ ثَلاَثَةً مِنَ الأَيْتَامِ كَانَ كَمَنْ قَامَ لَيْلَهُ وَصَامَ نَهَارَهُ وَغَدَا وَرَاحَ شَاهِرًا سَيْفَهُ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ وَكُنْتُ أَنَا وَهُوَ فِي الْجَنَّةِ أَخَوَيْنِ كَهَاتَيْنِ أُخْتَانِ " . وَأَلْصَقَ إِصْبَعَيْهِ السَّبَّابَةَ وَالْوُسْطَى .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3680

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3681

chapter.englishTitle: Removing a harmful thing from the road

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Abu Barzah Al-Aslami said:
            "O Messenger of Allah! Tell me of an action by which I may benefit.' He said: 'Remove harmful things from the path of the Muslims.'"
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Abu Barzah Al-Aslami said:
hadiths.body: "O Messenger of Allah! Tell me of an action by which I may benefit.' He said: 'Remove harmful things from the path of the Muslims.'"
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَعَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ أَبَانَ بْنِ صَمْعَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي الْوَازِعِ الرَّاسِبِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي بَرْزَةَ الأَسْلَمِيِّ، قَالَ قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ دُلَّنِي عَلَى عَمَلٍ أَنْتَفِعُ بِهِ . قَالَ  " اعْزِلِ الأَذَى عَنْ طَرِيقِ الْمُسْلِمِينَ " .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3681

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3682

chapter.englishTitle: Removing a harmful thing from the road

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Hurayrah that the Prophet ﷺ said:
            "There was a branch of a tree that annoyed the people. A man removed it, so he was admitted to Paradise."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Hurayrah that the Prophet ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: "There was a branch of a tree that annoyed the people. A man removed it, so he was admitted to Paradise."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ  " كَانَ عَلَى الطَّرِيقِ غُصْنُ شَجَرَةٍ يُؤْذِي النَّاسَ فَأَمَاطَهَا رَجُلٌ فَأُدْخِلَ الْجَنَّةَ " .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3682

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3683

chapter.englishTitle: Removing a harmful thing from the road

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Dharr that the Prophet ﷺ said:
           
 "My nation was shown to me with their good deeds and bad deeds. Among their good deeds I saw a harmful thing being removed from the road. And among their bad deeds I saw sputum in the mosque that had not been removed."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Dharr that the Prophet ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: "My nation was shown to me with their good deeds and bad deeds. Among their good deeds I saw a harmful thing being removed from the road. And among their bad deeds I saw sputum in the mosque that had not been removed."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ، أَنْبَأَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ حَسَّانَ، عَنْ وَاصِلٍ، مَوْلَى أَبِي عُيَيْنَةَ عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ عُقَيْلٍ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ يَعْمَرَ، عَنْ أَبِي ذَرٍّ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ عُرِضَتْ عَلَىَّ أُمَّتِي بِأَعْمَالِهَا حَسَنِهَا وَسَيِّئِهَا فَرَأَيْتُ فِي مَحَاسِنِ أَعْمَالِهَا الأَذَى يُنَحَّى عَنِ الطَّرِيقِ وَرَأَيْتُ فِي سَيِّئِ أَعْمَالِهَا النُّخَاعَةَ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ لاَ تُدْفَنُ " .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3683

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3684

chapter.englishTitle: The Virtue of giving water in charity

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Sad bin Ubadah said:
            "I said: 'O Messenger of Allah, what charity is best?' He said: 'Giving water to drink.'"
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Sad bin Ubadah said:
hadiths.body: "I said: 'O Messenger of Allah, what charity is best?' He said: 'Giving water to drink.'"
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، صَاحِبِ الدَّسْتَوَائِيِّ عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ عُبَادَةَ، قَالَ قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَىُّ الصَّدَقَةِ أَفْضَلُ قَالَ  " سَقْىُ الْمَاءِ " .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3684

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3685

chapter.englishTitle: The Virtue of giving water in charity

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Anas bin Malik that the Messenger of Allahﷺ said:
            "On the Day of Resurrection, people will be lined up in rows, (one of the narrators) Ibn NUmair said: i.e., the people of Paradise, and a man from among the people of Hell will pass by a man (from the people of Paradise) and say: 'O so and so! Do you not remember the day when you asked for water and I gave you water to drink?" So he will intercede for him. And another man will come and say: " Do you not remember the day when I gave you water with which to purify yourself?" and he will intercede for him." (In his narration, one of the narrators) Ibn NUmair said: "And he will remember the day when you sent me to do such and such for you, and I went and did it for you?' and he will intercede for him." "
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Anas bin Malik that the Messenger of Allahﷺ said:
hadiths.body: "On the Day of Resurrection, people will be lined up in rows, (one of the narrators) Ibn NUmair said: i.e., the people of Paradise, and a man from among the people of Hell will pass by a man (from the people of Paradise) and say: 'O so and so! Do you not remember the day when you asked for water and I gave you water to drink?" So he will intercede for him. And another man will come and say: " Do you not remember the day when I gave you water with which to purify yourself?" and he will intercede for him." (In his narration, one of the narrators) Ibn NUmair said: "And he will remember the day when you sent me to do such and such for you, and I went and did it for you?' and he will intercede for him." "
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، وَعَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ الرَّقَاشِيِّ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ " يَصُفُّ النَّاسُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ صُفُوفًا - وَقَالَ ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ أَهْلُ الْجَنَّةِ - فَيَمُرُّ الرَّجُلُ مِنْ أَهْلِ النَّارِ عَلَى الرَّجُلِ فَيَقُولُ يَا فُلاَنُ أَمَا تَذْكُرُ يَوْمَ اسْتَسْقَيْتَ فَسَقَيْتُكَ شَرْبَةً قَالَ فَيَشْفَعُ لَهُ وَيَمُرُّ الرَّجُلُ فَيَقُولُ أَمَا تَذْكُرُ يَوْمَ نَاوَلْتُكَ طَهُورًا فَيَشْفَعُ لَهُ " . قَالَ ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ " وَيَقُولُ يَا فُلاَنُ أَمَا تَذْكُرُ يَوْمَ بَعَثْتَنِي فِي حَاجَةِ كَذَا وَكَذَا فَذَهَبْتُ لَكَ فَيَشْفَعُ لَهُ " .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3685

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3686

chapter.englishTitle: The Virtue of giving water in charity

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Suraqah bin Ju'shum said:
            "I asked the Messenger of Allahﷺ about a lost camel that comes to my cisterns that I have prepared for my own camels - will I be rewarded if I give it some water to drink? He said: Yes, in every living being there is reward.'"
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Suraqah bin Ju'shum said:
hadiths.body: "I asked the Messenger of Allahﷺ about a lost camel that comes to my cisterns that I have prepared for my own camels - will I be rewarded if I give it some water to drink? He said: Yes, in every living being there is reward.'"
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ جُعْشُمٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَمِّهِ، سُرَاقَةَ بْنِ جُعْشُمٍ قَالَ سَأَلْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَنْ ضَالَّةِ الإِبِلِ تَغْشَى حِيَاضِي قَدْ لُطْتُهَا لإِبِلِي فَهَلْ لِي مِنْ أَجْرٍ إِنْ سَقَيْتُهَا فَقَالَ  " نَعَمْ فِي كُلِّ ذَاتِ كَبِدٍ حَرَّى أَجْرٌ " .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3686

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3687

chapter.englishTitle: Gentleness

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Jarir bin Abdullah Al-Bajali that the Messenger of Allahﷺ said:
            "Whoever is deprived of gentleness, he is deprived of goodness."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Jarir bin Abdullah Al-Bajali that the Messenger of Allahﷺ said:
hadiths.body: "Whoever is deprived of gentleness, he is deprived of goodness."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ تَمِيمِ بْنِ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ هِلاَلٍ الْعَبْسِيِّ، عَنْ جَرِيرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْبَجَلِيِّ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " مَنْ يُحْرَمِ الرِّفْقَ يُحْرَمِ الْخَيْرَ " .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3687

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3688

chapter.englishTitle: Gentleness

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allahﷺ said:
            "Allah is Gentle and loves gentleness, and He grants reward for it that He does not grant for harshness."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allahﷺ said:
hadiths.body: "Allah is Gentle and loves gentleness, and He grants reward for it that He does not grant for harshness."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ حَفْصٍ الأُبُلِّيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ عَيَّاشٍ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ  " إِنَّ اللَّهَ رَفِيقٌ يُحِبُّ الرِّفْقَ وَيُعْطِي عَلَيْهِ مَا لاَ يُعْطِي عَلَى الْعُنْفِ " .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3688

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3689

chapter.englishTitle: Gentleness

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Aishah that the Prophet ﷺ said:
            "Allah is Gentle and loves gentleness in all things."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Aishah that the Prophet ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: "Allah is Gentle and loves gentleness in all things."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مُصْعَبٍ، عَنِ الأَوْزَاعِيِّ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، وَعَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَوْزَاعِيُّ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ  " إِنَّ اللَّهَ رَفِيقٌ يُحِبُّ الرِّفْقَ فِي الأَمْرِ كُلِّهِ " .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3689

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3690

chapter.englishTitle: Beneficence Towards Slaves

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Abu Dhar said:
            "The Messenger of Allah said: '(Slaves are) your brothers whom Allah has put under your control, so feed them with the same food that you eat, clothe them with the same clothes you wear, and do not burden them with so much that htey are overwhelmed; if you do burden them, then help them."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Abu Dhar said:
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah said: '(Slaves are) your brothers whom Allah has put under your control, so feed them with the same food that you eat, clothe them with the same clothes you wear, and do not burden them with so much that htey are overwhelmed; if you do burden them, then help them."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، عَنِ الْمَعْرُورِ بْنِ سُوَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي ذَرٍّ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " إِخْوَانُكُمْ جَعَلَهُمُ اللَّهُ تَحْتَ أَيْدِيكُمْ فَأَطْعِمُوهُمْ مِمَّا تَأْكُلُونَ وَأَلْبِسُوهُمْ مِمَّا تَلْبَسُونَ وَلاَ تُكَلِّفُوهُمْ مَا يَغْلِبُهُمْ فَإِنْ كَلَّفْتُمُوهُمْ فَأَعِينُوهُمْ " .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3690

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3691

chapter.englishTitle: Beneficence Towards Slaves

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Bakr Siddiq(RA) that the Messenger of Allahﷺ said:
            "No person who mistreats his slave will enter Paradise." They said: " O Messenger of Allah, did you not tell us that this nation will have more slaves and orphans than any other nation?" He said: " Yes, so be as kind to them as you are to your own children, and feed them with the same food that you eat." They said: "What will benefit us in this world?" He said: "A horse that is kept ready for fighting in the cause of Allah, and your slave to take care of you, and if he performs prayer, then he is your brother(in Islam)."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Bakr Siddiq(RA) that the Messenger of Allahﷺ said:
hadiths.body: "No person who mistreats his slave will enter Paradise." They said: " O Messenger of Allah, did you not tell us that this nation will have more slaves and orphans than any other nation?" He said: " Yes, so be as kind to them as you are to your own children, and feed them with the same food that you eat." They said: "What will benefit us in this world?" He said: "A horse that is kept ready for fighting in the cause of Allah, and your slave to take care of you, and if he performs prayer, then he is your brother(in Islam)."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَعَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ، عَنْ فَرْقَدٍ السَّبَخِيِّ، عَنْ مُرَّةَ الطَّيِّبِ، عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرٍ الصِّدِّيقِ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ " لاَ يَدْخُلُ الْجَنَّةَ سَيِّئُ الْمَلَكَةِ " . قَالُوا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَلَيْسَ أَخْبَرْتَنَا أَنَّ هَذِهِ الأُمَّةَ أَكْثَرُ الأُمَمِ مَمْلُوكِينَ وَيَتَامَى قَالَ " نَعَمْ فَأَكْرِمُوهُمْ كَكَرَامَةِ أَوْلاَدِكُمْ وَأَطْعِمُوهُمْ مِمَّا تَأْكُلُونَ " . قَالُوا فَمَا يَنْفَعُنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا قَالَ " فَرَسٌ تَرْتَبِطُهُ تُقَاتِلُ عَلَيْهِ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ مَمْلُوكُكَ يَكْفِيكَ فَإِذَا صَلَّى فَهُوَ أَخُوكَ " .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3691

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3692

chapter.englishTitle: Spreading (the Greeting of) Peace

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Hurairah(RA) that the Messenger of Allahﷺ said:
            "By the One in Whose Hand is my soul, you will not enter Paradise until you believe, and you will not believe until you love one another. Shall I not tell you of something which, if you do it, you will love one another? Spread (the greeting of) peace among yourselves.'"
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah(RA) that the Messenger of Allahﷺ said:
hadiths.body: "By the One in Whose Hand is my soul, you will not enter Paradise until you believe, and you will not believe until you love one another. Shall I not tell you of something which, if you do it, you will love one another? Spread (the greeting of) peace among yourselves.'"
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، وَابْنُ، نُمَيْرٍ عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهُ ﷺ  " وَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ لاَ تَدْخُلُوا الْجَنَّةَ حَتَّى تُؤْمِنُوا وَلاَ تُؤْمِنُوا حَتَّى تَحَابُّوا . أَوَلاَ أَدُلُّكُمْ عَلَى شَىْءٍ إِذَا فَعَلْتُمُوهُ تَحَابَبْتُمْ أَفْشُوا السَّلاَمَ بَيْنَكُمْ " .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3692

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3693

chapter.englishTitle: Spreading (the Greeting of) Peace

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Abu Umamah said:
            "Our Prophet ﷺ commanded us to spread (the greeting of) peace."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Abu Umamah said:
hadiths.body: "Our Prophet ﷺ commanded us to spread (the greeting of) peace."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ عَيَّاشٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ، عَنْ أَبِي أُمَامَةَ، قَالَ أَمَرَنَا نَبِيُّنَا ﷺ أَنْ نُفْشِيَ السَّلاَمَ .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3693

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3694

chapter.englishTitle: Spreading (the Greeting of) Peace

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abdullah bin 'Amr that the Messenger of Allahﷺ said:
            "Worship the Most Merciful and spread (the greeting of) peace.'"
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abdullah bin 'Amr that the Messenger of Allahﷺ said:
hadiths.body: "Worship the Most Merciful and spread (the greeting of) peace.'"
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ فُضَيْلٍ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ السَّائِبِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " اعْبُدُوا الرَّحْمَنَ وَأَفْشُوا السَّلاَمَ " .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3694

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3695

chapter.englishTitle: Returning (the greeting of) peace

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that:
            "a man entered the masjid, and the Messenger of Allahﷺ was sitting in a corner of the mosque. He prayed, then he came and greeted him with Salam(peace), and he said: 'Wa 'alaikassalm."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that:
hadiths.body: "a man entered the masjid, and the Messenger of Allahﷺ was sitting in a corner of the mosque. He prayed, then he came and greeted him with Salam(peace), and he said: 'Wa 'alaikassalm."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْمَقْبُرِيُّ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَجُلاً، دَخَلَ الْمَسْجِدَ وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ جَالِسٌ فِي نَاحِيَةِ الْمَسْجِدِ فَصَلَّى ثُمَّ جَاءَ فَسَلَّمَ فَقَالَ  " وَعَلَيْكَ السَّلاَمُ " .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3695

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3696

chapter.englishTitle: Returning (the greeting of) peace

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Salamah that 'Aishah told him that the Messenger of Allahﷺ said to her:
            "Jibrail send (greetings of) Salam to you." She said: "Wa 'alahisalam wa rahmatullah (and upon him be peace and mercy of Allah)."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Salamah that 'Aishah told him that the Messenger of Allahﷺ said to her:
hadiths.body: "Jibrail send (greetings of) Salam to you." She said: "Wa 'alahisalam wa rahmatullah (and upon him be peace and mercy of Allah)."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحِيمِ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ زَكَرِيَّا، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ، حَدَّثَتْهُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ لَهَا  " إِنَّ جِبْرَائِيلَ يَقْرَأُ عَلَيْكِ السَّلاَمَ " . قَالَتْ وَعَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3696

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3697

chapter.arabicTitle: باب رَدِّ السَّلاَمِ عَلَى أَهْلِ الذِّمَّةِ
chapter.englishTitle: Returning (the greeting of) peace to Ahludh-Dhimmah(Non Muslim living under the protectio

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Anas bin Malik said "the Messenger of Allahﷺ said":
            "When any of the People of the Book greets you with Salam (peace), then say, Wa 'alaikum(and also upon you)."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Anas bin Malik said "the Messenger of Allahﷺ said":
hadiths.body: "When any of the People of the Book greets you with Salam (peace), then say, Wa 'alaikum(and also upon you)."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَةُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بِشْرٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " إِذَا سَلَّمَ عَلَيْكُمْ أَحَدٌ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ فَقُولُوا وَعَلَيْكُمْ " .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3697

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3698

chapter.arabicTitle: باب رَدِّ السَّلاَمِ عَلَى أَهْلِ الذِّمَّةِ
chapter.englishTitle: Returning (the greeting of) peace to Ahludh-Dhimmah(Non Muslim living under the protectio

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Aishah that some of the Jews came to the Prophet ﷺ and said:
            "Assam o alaika (death be upon you), O Abul-Qasim!" He said: "Wa 'alayikum (and also upon you)."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Aishah that some of the Jews came to the Prophet ﷺ and said:
hadiths.body: "Assam o alaika (death be upon you), O Abul-Qasim!" He said: "Wa 'alayikum (and also upon you)."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ مُسْلِمٍ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّهُ أَتَى النَّبِيَّ ﷺ نَاسٌ مِنَ الْيَهُودِ فَقَالُوا السَّامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا أَبَا الْقَاسِمِ . فَقَالَ  " وَعَلَيْكُمْ " .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3698

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3699

chapter.arabicTitle: باب رَدِّ السَّلاَمِ عَلَى أَهْلِ الذِّمَّةِ
chapter.englishTitle: Returning (the greeting of) peace to Ahludh-Dhimmah(Non Muslim living under the protectio

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu 'Abdur-Rahman Al Juhani that the Messenger of Allahﷺ said:
            "I am riding to the Jews tomorrow. Do not initiate the greeting with them, and if they greet you, then say: Wa 'alaikum (and also upon you)".
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu 'Abdur-Rahman Al Juhani that the Messenger of Allahﷺ said:
hadiths.body: "I am riding to the Jews tomorrow. Do not initiate the greeting with them, and if they greet you, then say: Wa 'alaikum (and also upon you)".
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ، عَنْ مَرْثَدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْيَزَنِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْجُهَنِيِّ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " إِنِّي رَاكِبٌ غَدًا إِلَى الْيَهُودِ فَلاَ تَبْدَءُوهُمْ بِالسَّلاَمِ فَإِذَا سَلَّمُوا عَلَيْكُمْ فَقُولُوا وَعَلَيْكُمْ " .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3699

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3700

chapter.englishTitle: Greeting children and women

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Anas said:
            "The Messenger of Allahﷺ came to us, and we were young boys, and he greeted us with (the greeting of) peace".
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Anas said:
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allahﷺ came to us, and we were young boys, and he greeted us with (the greeting of) peace".
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو خَالِدٍ الأَحْمَرُ، عَنْ حُمَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ أَتَانَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَنَحْنُ صِبْيَانٌ فَسَلَّمَ عَلَيْنَا .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3700

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3701

chapter.englishTitle: Greeting children and women

hadiths.englishRaw:
Asma bint Yazid said:
            "The Messenger of Allahﷺ passed by us, among (a group of) women, and he greeted us with (the greeting of) peace."
hadiths.narrator: Asma bint Yazid said:
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allahﷺ passed by us, among (a group of) women, and he greeted us with (the greeting of) peace."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي حُسَيْنٍ، سَمِعَهُ مِنْ، شَهْرِ بْنِ حَوْشَبٍ يَقُولُ أَخْبَرَتْهُ أَسْمَاءُ بِنْتُ يَزِيدَ، قَالَتْ مَرَّ عَلَيْنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ فِي نِسْوَةٍ فَسَلَّمَ عَلَيْنَا .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3701

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3702

chapter.englishTitle: Shaking hands

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Anas bin Malik said:
            "O Messenger of Allah! Should we bow to one another?" He said: "No." We said: "Should we embrace one another?" He said: "No, but shake hands with one another."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Anas bin Malik said:
hadiths.body: "O Messenger of Allah! Should we bow to one another?" He said: "No." We said: "Should we embrace one another?" He said: "No, but shake hands with one another."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ جَرِيرِ بْنِ حَازِمٍ، عَنْ حَنْظَلَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ السَّدُوسِيِّ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ قُلْنَا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَيَنْحَنِي بَعْضُنَا لِبَعْضٍ قَالَ " لاَ " . قُلْنَا أَيُعَانِقُ بَعْضُنَا بَعْضًا قَالَ " لاَ وَلَكِنْ تَصَافَحُوا " .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3702

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3703

chapter.englishTitle: Shaking hands

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Bara bin Azib that the Messenger of Allahﷺ said:
            "There are no two Muslims who meet and shake hands, but they will be forgiven before they part."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Bara bin Azib that the Messenger of Allahﷺ said:
hadiths.body: "There are no two Muslims who meet and shake hands, but they will be forgiven before they part."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو خَالِدٍ الأَحْمَرُ، وَعَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، عَنِ الأَجْلَحِ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنِ الْبَرَاءِ بْنِ عَازِبٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " مَا مِنْ مُسْلِمَيْنِ يَلْتَقِيَانِ فَيَتَصَافَحَانِ إِلاَّ غُفِرَ لَهُمَا قَبْلَ أَنْ يَتَفَرَّقَا " .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3703

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3704

chapter.englishTitle: A man kissing another man's hand

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Ibn Umar said:
            "We kissed the hand of the Prophet ﷺ."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Ibn Umar said:
hadiths.body: "We kissed the hand of the Prophet ﷺ."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ فُضَيْلٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي زِيَادٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ قَبَّلْنَا يَدَ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3704

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3705

chapter.englishTitle: A man kissing another man's hand

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Safwan bin 'Assal that:
            "Some people among the Jews kissed the hands and feet of the Prophet ﷺ."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Safwan bin 'Assal that:
hadiths.body: "Some people among the Jews kissed the hands and feet of the Prophet ﷺ."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ إِدْرِيسَ، وَغُنْدَرٌ، وَأَبُو أُسَامَةَ عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مُرَّةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ سَلِمَةَ، عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ عَسَّالٍ، أَنَّ قَوْمًا، مِنَ الْيَهُودِ قَبَّلُوا يَدَ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ وَرِجْلَيْهِ .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3705

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3706

chapter.englishTitle: Seeking Permission to Enter

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Saeed Khudri that Abu Musa asked permission to enter upon 'Umar three times, and he did not give him permission, so he went away.'Umar sent word to him saying:
            "Why did you go back?" He said: "I asked permission to enter three times, as the Messenger of Allahﷺ enjoined upon us, then if we are given permission we should enter, otherwise we should go back." He said: "You should bring me proof of that, or else!" Then he came to a gathering of his people and asked them to swear by Allah concerning that, and they did so, so he let him go."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Saeed Khudri that Abu Musa asked permission to enter upon 'Umar three times, and he did not give him permission, so he went away.'Umar sent word to him saying:
hadiths.body: "Why did you go back?" He said: "I asked permission to enter three times, as the Messenger of Allahﷺ enjoined upon us, then if we are given permission we should enter, otherwise we should go back." He said: "You should bring me proof of that, or else!" Then he came to a gathering of his people and asked them to swear by Allah concerning that, and they did so, so he let him go."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ، أَنْبَأَنَا دَاوُدُ بْنُ أَبِي هِنْدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي نَضْرَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، أَنَّ أَبَا مُوسَى، اسْتَأْذَنَ عَلَى عُمَرَ ثَلاَثًا فَلَمْ يُؤْذَنْ لَهُ فَانْصَرَفَ فَأَرْسَلَ إِلَيْهِ عُمَرُ مَا رَدَّكَ قَالَ اسْتَأْذَنْتُ الاِسْتِئْذَانَ الَّذِي أَمَرَنَا بِهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ ثَلاَثًا فَإِنْ أُذِنَ لَنَا دَخَلْنَا وَإِنْ لَمْ يُؤْذَنْ لَنَا رَجَعْنَا . قَالَ فَقَالَ لَتَأْتِيَنِّي عَلَى هَذَا بِبَيِّنَةٍ أَوْ لأَفْعَلَنَّ . فَأَتَى مَجْلِسَ قَوْمِهِ فَنَاشَدَهُمْ فَشَهِدُوا لَهُ فَخَلَّى سَبِيلَهُ .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3706

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3707

chapter.englishTitle: Seeking Permission to Enter

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Abu Ayyub Ansari said:
            "We said: 'O Messenger of Allahﷺ, (we know) this (greeting of) Salam, but what does seeking permission to enter mean?' He said: 'It means a man saying SubhanAllah, and Allahu Akbar and Al Hamdulillah, and clearing his throat, announcing his arrival to the people in the house."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Abu Ayyub Ansari said:
hadiths.body: "We said: 'O Messenger of Allahﷺ, (we know) this (greeting of) Salam, but what does seeking permission to enter mean?' He said: 'It means a man saying SubhanAllah, and Allahu Akbar and Al Hamdulillah, and clearing his throat, announcing his arrival to the people in the house."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحِيمِ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ وَاصِلِ بْنِ السَّائِبِ، عَنْ أَبِي سَوْرَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ الأَنْصَارِيِّ، قَالَ قُلْنَا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ هَذَا السَّلاَمُ فَمَا الاِسْتِئْنَاسُ قَالَ  " يَتَكَلَّمُ الرَّجُلُ تَسْبِيحَةً وَتَكْبِيرَةً وَتَحْمِيدَةً وَيَتَنَحْنَحُ وَيُؤْذِنُ أَهْلَ الْبَيْتِ " .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3707

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3708

chapter.englishTitle: Seeking Permission to Enter

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Ali said:
            "I had two times of visiting the Messenger of Allahﷺ, at night and during the day. If I came to him when he was praying, he would clear his throat (to let me know he was praying)."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Ali said:
hadiths.body: "I had two times of visiting the Messenger of Allahﷺ, at night and during the day. If I came to him when he was praying, he would clear his throat (to let me know he was praying)."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ عَيَّاشٍ، عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ، عَنِ الْحَارِثِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُجَىٍّ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ، قَالَ كَانَ لِي مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ مُدْخَلاَنِ مُدْخَلٌ بِاللَّيْلِ وَمُدْخَلٌ بِالنَّهَارِ فَكُنْتُ إِذَا أَتَيْتُهُ وَهُوَ يُصَلِّي يَتَنَحْنَحُ لِي .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3708

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3709

chapter.englishTitle: Seeking Permission to Enter

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Jabir said:
            "I asked the Prophet ﷺ for permission to enter, and he said: 'Who is that?' I said: 'Me'. The Prophet ﷺ said " Me, me?!"
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Jabir said:
hadiths.body: "I asked the Prophet ﷺ for permission to enter, and he said: 'Who is that?' I said: 'Me'. The Prophet ﷺ said " Me, me?!"
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْمُنْكَدِرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ اسْتَأْذَنْتُ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ ﷺ فَقَالَ " مَنْ هَذَا " . فَقُلْتُ أَنَا فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ " أَنَا أَنَا " .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3709

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3710

chapter.arabicTitle: باب الرَّجُلِ يُقَالُ لَهُ كَيْفَ أَصْبَحْتَ
chapter.englishTitle: If a man is asked how are you this morning?

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Jabir said:
            "I said: 'How are you this morning, O Messenger of Allah?' He said: 'I am better than one who did not get up fasting, and who did not visit and sick.'"
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Jabir said:
hadiths.body: "I said: 'How are you this morning, O Messenger of Allah?' He said: 'I am better than one who did not get up fasting, and who did not visit and sick.'"
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عِيسَى بْنُ يُونُسَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ سَابِطٍ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ قُلْتُ كَيْفَ أَصْبَحْتَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ  " بِخَيْرٍ مِنْ رَجُلٍ لَمْ يُصْبِحْ صَائِمًا وَلَمْ يَعُدْ سَقِيمًا " .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3710

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3711

chapter.arabicTitle: باب الرَّجُلِ يُقَالُ لَهُ كَيْفَ أَصْبَحْتَ
chapter.englishTitle: If a man is asked how are you this morning?

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Abu Usaid Sa'idi said:
            "The Messenger of Allahﷺ said to Abbas ibn Abdul Muttalib, when he entered upon them: "Assalamu alaikum'. They said: 'Wa alaikas salamu wa ahmatullahi wa barakatuhu.' He said: 'How are you this morning?' They said: ' Well, praise is to Allah. And how are you this morning, may our fathers and mothers be ransomed for you, O Messenger of Allah?!' He said: 'I am well, praise is to Allah.'"
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Abu Usaid Sa'idi said:
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allahﷺ said to Abbas ibn Abdul Muttalib, when he entered upon them: "Assalamu alaikum'. They said: 'Wa alaikas salamu wa ahmatullahi wa barakatuhu.' He said: 'How are you this morning?' They said: ' Well, praise is to Allah. And how are you this morning, may our fathers and mothers be ransomed for you, O Messenger of Allah?!' He said: 'I am well, praise is to Allah.'"
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو إِسْحَاقَ الْهَرَوِيُّ، إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ حَاتِمٍ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ سَعْدِ بْنِ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ، حَدَّثَنِي جَدِّي أَبُو أُمِّي، مَالِكُ بْنُ حَمْزَةَ بْنِ أَبِي أُسَيْدٍ السَّاعِدِيُّ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ أَبِي أُسَيْدٍ السَّاعِدِيِّ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ لِلْعَبَّاسِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْمُطَّلِبِ وَدَخَلَ عَلَيْهِمْ فَقَالَ " السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكُمْ " . قَالُوا وَعَلَيْكَ السَّلاَمُ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ . قَالَ " كَيْفَ أَصْبَحْتُمْ " . قَالُوا بِخَيْرٍ نَحْمَدُ اللَّهَ فَكَيْفَ أَصْبَحْتَ بِأَبِينَا وَأُمِّنَا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ " أَصْبَحْتُ بِخَيْرٍ أَحْمَدُ اللَّهَ " .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3711

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3712

chapter.arabicTitle: باب إِذَا أَتَاكُمْ كَرِيمُ قَوْمٍ فَأَكْرِمُوهُ
chapter.englishTitle: If a man who is repspected comes to you, then honor him

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Ibn Umar that the Messenger of Allahﷺ said:
            "If there comes to you a man who is respected among his own people, then honor him."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Ibn Umar that the Messenger of Allahﷺ said:
hadiths.body: "If there comes to you a man who is respected among his own people, then honor him."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الصَّبَّاحِ، أَنْبَأَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَجْلاَنَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " إِذَا أَتَاكُمْ كَرِيمُ قَوْمٍ فَأَكْرِمُوهُ " .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3712

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3713

chapter.englishTitle: Replying to one who sneezes

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Anas bin Malik said:
            "Two men sneezed in he presence of the Prophet ﷺ and he replied (said: YarhamukAllah; may Allah have mercy on you') to one and not to the other. It was said: 'O Messenger of Allahﷺ, two men sneezed in your presence and you replied to one and not to the other?' He said: "'This one praised Allah(said Al-Hamdulillah fter sneezing) but that one did not.'"
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Anas bin Malik said:
hadiths.body: "Two men sneezed in he presence of the Prophet ﷺ and he replied (said: YarhamukAllah; may Allah have mercy on you') to one and not to the other. It was said: 'O Messenger of Allahﷺ, two men sneezed in your presence and you replied to one and not to the other?' He said: "'This one praised Allah(said Al-Hamdulillah fter sneezing) but that one did not.'"
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ التَّيْمِيِّ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ عَطَسَ رَجُلاَنِ عِنْدَ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ فَشَمَّتَ أَحَدَهُمَا - أَوْ سَمَّتَ - وَلَمْ يُشَمِّتِ الآخَرَ فَقِيلَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ عَطَسَ عِنْدَكَ رَجُلاَنِ فَشَمَّتَّ أَحَدَهُمَا وَلَمْ تُشَمِّتِ الآخَرَ فَقَالَ  " إِنَّ هَذَا حَمِدَ اللَّهَ وَإِنَّ هَذَا لَمْ يَحْمَدِ اللَّهَ " .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3713

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3714

chapter.englishTitle: Replying to one who sneezes

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Ilyas bin Salamah bin Akwa' that his father said:
            "The Messenger of Allahﷺ said: 'The one who sneezes may be responded to three times; if he sneezes more than that, he has a cold.'"
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Ilyas bin Salamah bin Akwa' that his father said:
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allahﷺ said: 'The one who sneezes may be responded to three times; if he sneezes more than that, he has a cold.'"
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ، عَنْ إِيَاسِ بْنِ سَلَمَةَ بْنِ الأَكْوَعِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " يُشَمَّتُ الْعَاطِسُ ثَلاَثًا فَمَا زَادَ فَهُوَ مَزْكُومٌ " .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3714

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3715

chapter.englishTitle: Replying to one who sneezes

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Ali that the Messenger of Allahﷺ said:
            "If anyone of you sneezes, let him say: Alhamdulillah (praise be to Allah). Those around him should respond by saying: Yarhamkullah (may Allah have mercy on you). And he should respond by saying: "Yahdikum Allah wa yuslaha balakum (may Allah Guide you and set right your state)."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Ali that the Messenger of Allahﷺ said:
hadiths.body: "If anyone of you sneezes, let him say: Alhamdulillah (praise be to Allah). Those around him should respond by saying: Yarhamkullah (may Allah have mercy on you). And he should respond by saying: "Yahdikum Allah wa yuslaha balakum (may Allah Guide you and set right your state)."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُسْهِرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى، عَنْ عِيسَى، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " إِذَا عَطَسَ أَحَدُكُمْ فَلْيَقُلِ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ . وَلْيَرُدَّ عَلَيْهِ مَنْ حَوْلَهُ يَرْحَمُكَ اللَّهُ . وَلْيَرُدَّ عَلَيْهِمْ يَهْدِيكُمُ اللَّهُ وَيُصْلِحُ بَالَكُمْ " .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3715

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3716

chapter.englishTitle: A man honoring his companion

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Anas bin Malik said:
            "Whenever the Prophet ﷺ met a man, he would speak to him, and would not tun away until he (the other man) was the one who turned away. And if he shook hands with him, he would not withdraw his hand until he (the other man) withdrew his hand. And he was never seen sitting with his knees ahead of the knees of the one who was sitting next to him."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Anas bin Malik said:
hadiths.body: "Whenever the Prophet ﷺ met a man, he would speak to him, and would not tun away until he (the other man) was the one who turned away. And if he shook hands with him, he would not withdraw his hand until he (the other man) withdrew his hand. And he was never seen sitting with his knees ahead of the knees of the one who was sitting next to him."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ أَبِي يَحْيَى الطَّوِيلِ، - رَجُلٌ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْكُوفَةِ - عَنْ زَيْدٍ الْعَمِّيِّ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ إِذَا لَقِيَ الرَّجُلَ فَكَلَّمَهُ لَمْ يَصْرِفْ وَجْهَهُ عَنْهُ حَتَّى يَكُونَ هُوَ الَّذِي يَنْصَرِفُ وَإِذَا صَافَحَهُ لَمْ يَنْزِعْ يَدَهُ مِنْ يَدِهِ حَتَّى يَكُونَ هُوَ الَّذِي يَنْزِعُهَا وَلَمْ يُرَ مُتَقَدِّمًا بِرُكْبَتَيْهِ جَلِيسًا لَهُ قَطُّ .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3716

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3717

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَنْ قَامَ مِنْ مَجْلِسٍ فَرَجَعَ فَهُوَ أَحَقُّ بِهِ
chapter.englishTitle: Whoever gets up from a spot then comes back, he has more right to it

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Prophet ﷺ said:
            "When one of you gets up from his spot, then comes back, he has more right to it."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Prophet ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: "When one of you gets up from his spot, then comes back, he has more right to it."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ سُهَيْلِ بْنِ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ  " إِذَا قَامَ أَحَدُكُمْ عَنْ مَجْلِسِهِ ثُمَّ رَجَعَ فَهُوَ أَحَقُّ بِهِ " .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3717

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3718

chapter.englishTitle: Excuses

hadiths.englishRaw: A hadith similar to the above has been narrated through a chain differing from the first at the 4th level of narrators.
hadiths.body: A hadith similar to the above has been narrated through a chain differing from the first at the 4th level of narrators.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ مِينَاءَ، عَنْ جَوْدَانَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " مَنِ اعْتَذَرَ إِلَى أَخِيهِ بِمَعْذِرَةٍ فَلَمْ يَقْبَلْهَا كَانَ عَلَيْهِ مِثْلُ خَطِيئَةِ صَاحِبِ مَكْسٍ " .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3718

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3719

chapter.englishTitle: Joking

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Umm Salamah said:
