            "Abu Bakr went out to trade in Busra, one year before the Prophet ﷺ died, and with him were Nu`aiman and Suwaibit the sons of Harmalah, who had been present at Badr. Nu`aiman was in charge of the provisions, and Suwaibit was a man who joked a lot. He said to Nu`aiman: 'Feed me'. He said: 'Not until Abu Bakr comes'. He said: 'Then I will have to annoy you'. Then they passed by some people, and Suwaibit said to them: 'Will you buy a slave from me?' They said: 'Yes'. He said 'He is a slave who talks a lot and he will tell you, "I am a free man". If you are going to let him go when he says that to you, do not bother buying him.' They said: 'We will buy him from you.' So they bought him from him in return for ten young she-camels, then they brought him and tied a turban or a rope around his neck. Nu`aiman said: 'This man is making fun of you. I am a free man, not a slave.' They said: 'He has already told us about you; and they took him off.' Then Abu Bakr came and he (Suwaibit) told him about that. So he followed those people and returned their camels to them, and took Nu`aiman back. When they came to the Prophet ﷺ they told him what had happened, and the Prophet ﷺ and his companions laughed about it for a year."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Umm Salamah said:
hadiths.body: "Abu Bakr went out to trade in Busra, one year before the Prophet ﷺ died, and with him were Nu`aiman and Suwaibit the sons of Harmalah, who had been present at Badr. Nu`aiman was in charge of the provisions, and Suwaibit was a man who joked a lot. He said to Nu`aiman: 'Feed me'. He said: 'Not until Abu Bakr comes'. He said: 'Then I will have to annoy you'. Then they passed by some people, and Suwaibit said to them: 'Will you buy a slave from me?' They said: 'Yes'. He said 'He is a slave who talks a lot and he will tell you, "I am a free man". If you are going to let him go when he says that to you, do not bother buying him.' They said: 'We will buy him from you.' So they bought him from him in return for ten young she-camels, then they brought him and tied a turban or a rope around his neck. Nu`aiman said: 'This man is making fun of you. I am a free man, not a slave.' They said: 'He has already told us about you; and they took him off.' Then Abu Bakr came and he (Suwaibit) told him about that. So he followed those people and returned their camels to them, and took Nu`aiman back. When they came to the Prophet ﷺ they told him what had happened, and the Prophet ﷺ and his companions laughed about it for a year."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ زَمْعَةَ بْنِ صَالِحٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ وَهْبِ بْنِ عَبْدِ بْنِ زَمْعَةَ، عَنْ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، حَدَّثَنَا زَمْعَةُ بْنُ صَالِحٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ وَهْبِ بْنِ زَمْعَةَ، عَنْ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ، قَالَتْ خَرَجَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ فِي تِجَارَةٍ إِلَى بُصْرَى قَبْلَ مَوْتِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ بِعَامٍ وَمَعَهُ نُعَيْمَانُ وَسُوَيْبِطُ بْنُ حَرْمَلَةَ وَكَانَا شَهِدَا بَدْرًا وَكَانَ نُعَيْمَانُ عَلَى الزَّادِ وَكَانَ سُوَيْبِطٌ رَجُلاً مَزَّاحًا فَقَالَ لِنُعَيْمَانَ أَطْعِمْنِي . قَالَ حَتَّى يَجِيءَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ . قَالَ فَلأُغِيظَنَّكَ . قَالَ فَمَرُّوا بِقَوْمٍ فَقَالَ لَهُمْ سُوَيْبِطٌ تَشْتَرُونَ مِنِّي عَبْدًا لِي قَالُوا نَعَمْ . قَالَ إِنَّهُ عَبْدٌ لَهُ كَلاَمٌ وَهُوَ قَائِلٌ لَكُمْ إِنِّي حُرٌّ . فَإِنْ كُنْتُمْ إِذَا قَالَ لَكُمْ هَذِهِ الْمَقَالَةَ تَرَكْتُمُوهُ فَلاَ تُفْسِدُوا عَلَىَّ عَبْدِي . قَالُوا لاَ بَلْ نَشْتَرِيهِ مِنْكَ . فَاشْتَرَوْهُ مِنْهُ بِعَشْرِ قَلاَئِصَ ثُمَّ أَتَوْهُ فَوَضَعُوا فِي عُنُقِهِ عِمَامَةً أَوْ حَبْلاً . فَقَالَ نُعَيْمَانُ إِنَّ هَذَا يَسْتَهْزِئُ بِكُمْ وَإِنِّي حُرٌّ لَسْتُ بِعَبْدٍ . فَقَالُوا قَدْ أَخْبَرَنَا خَبَرَكَ . فَانْطَلَقُوا بِهِ فَجَاءَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ فَأَخْبَرُوهُ بِذَلِكَ . قَالَ فَاتَّبَعَ الْقَوْمَ وَرَدَّ عَلَيْهِمُ الْقَلاَئِصَ وَأَخَذَ نُعَيْمَانَ . قَالَ فَلَمَّا قَدِمُوا عَلَى النَّبِيِّ ﷺ وَأَخْبَرُوهُ . قَالَ فَضَحِكَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ وَأَصْحَابُهُ مِنْهُ حَوْلاً .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3719

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3720

chapter.englishTitle: Joking

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Abu Taiyah said:
            "I heard Anas Bin Malik say: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to mix with us so much that he said to a little brother of mine: "O Abu `Umair, what happened to the Nughair (one of the narrators Waki` said that it means a bird that he used to play with)."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Abu Taiyah said:
hadiths.body: "I heard Anas Bin Malik say: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to mix with us so much that he said to a little brother of mine: "O Abu `Umair, what happened to the Nughair (one of the narrators Waki` said that it means a bird that he used to play with)."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي التَّيَّاحِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ، يَقُولُ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ يُخَالِطُنَا حَتَّى يَقُولَ لأَخٍ لِي صَغِيرٍ  " يَا أَبَا عُمَيْرٍ مَا فَعَلَ النُّغَيْرُ " . قَالَ وَكِيعٌ يَعْنِي طَيْرًا كَانَ يَلْعَبُ بِهِ .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3720

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3721

chapter.englishTitle: Plucking out white hairs

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from 'Amr bin Sh'uaib from his father, that his grandfather said:
            "The Messenger of Allahﷺ forbade plucking out white hairs and said: 'It is the light of the believer.'"
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from 'Amr bin Sh'uaib from his father, that his grandfather said:
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allahﷺ forbade plucking out white hairs and said: 'It is the light of the believer.'"
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَةُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ شُعَيْبٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ، قَالَ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَنْ نَتْفِ الشَّيْبِ وَقَالَ  " هُوَ نُورُ الْمُؤْمِنِ " .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3721

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3722

chapter.englishTitle: Sitting between the shade and the sun

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Ibn Buraidah, from his father, that the Prophet ﷺ :
            "forbade sitting between the shade and sun."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Ibn Buraidah, from his father, that the Prophet ﷺ :
hadiths.body: "forbade sitting between the shade and sun."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا زَيْدُ بْنُ الْحُبَابِ، عَنْ أَبِي الْمُنِيبِ، عَنِ ابْنِ بُرَيْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ نَهَى أَنْ يُقْعَدَ بَيْنَ الظِّلِّ وَالشَّمْسِ .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3722

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3723

chapter.arabicTitle: باب النَّهْىِ عَنِ الاِضْطِجَاعِ، عَلَى الْوَجْهِ
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of lying's on one's face

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Qais bin Tihfah Al-Ghifari that his father said:
            "The Messenger of Allahﷺ found me sleeping in the masjid on my stomach. He nudged me with his foot and said: 'Why are you sleeping like this? This is a kind of sleep that Allah dislikes,' or 'that Allah hates.'"
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Qais bin Tihfah Al-Ghifari that his father said:
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allahﷺ found me sleeping in the masjid on my stomach. He nudged me with his foot and said: 'Why are you sleeping like this? This is a kind of sleep that Allah dislikes,' or 'that Allah hates.'"
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الصَّبَّاحِ، حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ، عَنِ الأَوْزَاعِيِّ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، عَنْ قَيْسِ بْنِ طِخْفَةَ الْغِفَارِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ أَصَابَنِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ نَائِمًا فِي الْمَسْجِدِ عَلَى بَطْنِي فَرَكَضَنِي بِرِجْلِهِ وَقَالَ  " مَا لَكَ وَلِهَذَا النَّوْمِ هَذِهِ نَوْمَةٌ يَكْرَهُهَا اللَّهُ أَوْ يُبْغِضُهَا اللَّهُ " .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3723

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3724

chapter.arabicTitle: باب النَّهْىِ عَنِ الاِضْطِجَاعِ، عَلَى الْوَجْهِ
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of lying's on one's face

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Abu Dharr said:
            "The Prophet ﷺ passed by me and I was lying on my stomach. He nudged me with his foot and said: 'O Junaidib! This is how the people of Hell lie.'""
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Abu Dharr said:
hadiths.body: "The Prophet ﷺ passed by me and I was lying on my stomach. He nudged me with his foot and said: 'O Junaidib! This is how the people of Hell lie.'""
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ كَاسِبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ نُعَيْمِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْمُجْمِرِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ ابْنِ طِخْفَةَ الْغِفَارِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي ذَرٍّ، قَالَ مَرَّ بِيَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ وَأَنَا مُضْطَجِعٌ عَلَى بَطْنِي فَرَكَضَنِي بِرِجْلِهِ وَقَالَ  " يَا جُنَيْدِبُ إِنَّمَا هَذِهِ ضِجْعَةُ أَهْلِ النَّارِ " .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3724

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3725

chapter.arabicTitle: باب النَّهْىِ عَنِ الاِضْطِجَاعِ، عَلَى الْوَجْهِ
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of lying's on one's face

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Abu Umamah said:
            "The Prophet ﷺ passed by a man who was sleeping in the masjid, lying on his face. He struck him with his foot and said: 'Get up' or; 'Sit up, fo this is a hellish kind of sleep.'"
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Abu Umamah said:
hadiths.body: "The Prophet ﷺ passed by a man who was sleeping in the masjid, lying on his face. He struck him with his foot and said: 'Get up' or; 'Sit up, fo this is a hellish kind of sleep.'"
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ كَاسِبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سَلَمَةُ بْنُ رَجَاءٍ، عَنِ الْوَلِيدِ بْنِ جَمِيلٍ الدِّمَشْقِيِّ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ الْقَاسِمَ بْنَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ أَبِي أُمَامَةَ، قَالَ مَرَّ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ عَلَى رَجُلٍ نَائِمٍ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ مُنْبَطِحٍ عَلَى وَجْهِهِ فَضَرَبَهُ بِرِجْلِهِ وَقَالَ  " قُمْ وَاقْعُدْ فَإِنَّهَا نَوْمَةٌ جَهَنَّمِيَّةٌ " .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3725

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3726

chapter.englishTitle: Learning about the stars

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Ibn Abbas that the Messenger of Allahﷺ said:
            "Whoever learns about the stars, he learns a branch of magic; the more he learns (of the former) the more he learns (of the latter)."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Ibn Abbas that the Messenger of Allahﷺ said:
hadiths.body: "Whoever learns about the stars, he learns a branch of magic; the more he learns (of the former) the more he learns (of the latter)."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الأَخْنَسِ، عَنِ الْوَلِيدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ يُوسُفَ بْنِ مَاهَكَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " مَنِ اقْتَبَسَ عِلْمًا مِنَ النُّجُومِ اقْتَبَسَ شُعْبَةً مِنَ السِّحْرِ زَادَ مَا زَادَ " .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3726

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3727

chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of cursing the wind

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allahﷺ said:
            "Do not curse the wind, for it is from the mercy of Allah, bringing Rahmah (i.e., rain and breezes), or destruction. But ask Allah for its goodness, and seek refuge with Allah from its evil."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allahﷺ said:
hadiths.body: "Do not curse the wind, for it is from the mercy of Allah, bringing Rahmah (i.e., rain and breezes), or destruction. But ask Allah for its goodness, and seek refuge with Allah from its evil."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنِ الأَوْزَاعِيِّ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، حَدَّثَنَا ثَابِتٌ الزُّرَقِيُّ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " لاَ تَسُبُّوا الرِّيحَ فَإِنَّهَا مِنْ رَوْحِ اللَّهِ تَأْتِي بِالرَّحْمَةِ وَالْعَذَابِ وَلَكِنْ سَلُوا اللَّهَ مِنْ خَيْرِهَا وَتَعَوَّذُوا بِاللَّهِ مِنْ شَرِّهَا " .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3727

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3728

chapter.englishTitle: Names that are liked

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Ibn 'Umar that the Prophet ﷺ said:
            "The most beloved of names to Allah are 'Abdullah and 'Abdur-Rahman."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Ibn 'Umar that the Prophet ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: "The most beloved of names to Allah are 'Abdullah and 'Abdur-Rahman."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْعُمَرِيُّ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ  " أَحَبُّ الأَسْمَاءِ إِلَى اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ وَعَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ " .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3728

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3729

chapter.englishTitle: Names that are disliked

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from 'Umar ibn Al-Khattab that the Prophet ﷺ said:
            "If I live- if Allah wills - I will forbid the names Rabah(profit), Najih(saved), Aflah (Successful), Nafi (beneficial) and Yasar(prosperity)."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from 'Umar ibn Al-Khattab that the Prophet ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: "If I live- if Allah wills - I will forbid the names Rabah(profit), Najih(saved), Aflah (Successful), Nafi (beneficial) and Yasar(prosperity)."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا نَصْرُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أَحْمَدَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " لَئِنْ عِشْتُ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ لأَنْهَيَنَّ أَنْ يُسَمَّى رَبَاحٌ وَنَجِيحٌ وَأَفْلَحُ وَنَافِعٌ وَيَسَارٌ " .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3729

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3730

chapter.englishTitle: Names that are disliked

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Samurah said:
            "The Messenger of Allahﷺ forbade giving our slaves four names: Aflah (successful), Nafi' (beneficial), Rabah (profit) and Yasar(prosperity)."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Samurah said:
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allahﷺ forbade giving our slaves four names: Aflah (successful), Nafi' (beneficial), Rabah (profit) and Yasar(prosperity)."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْمُعْتَمِرُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنِ الرُّكَيْنِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ سَمُرَةَ، قَالَ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَنْ نُسَمِّيَ رَقِيقَنَا أَرْبَعَةَ أَسْمَاءٍ أَفْلَحُ وَنَافِعٌ وَرَبَاحٌ وَيَسَارٌ .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3730

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3731

chapter.englishTitle: Names that are disliked

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Masruq said:
            "I met 'Umar bin Khattab and he said: 'Who are you?' I said: 'Masruq bin Adja'.' 'Umar said: 'I heard the Messenger of Allahﷺ saying,"Ajda' is a devil."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Masruq said:
hadiths.body: "I met 'Umar bin Khattab and he said: 'Who are you?' I said: 'Masruq bin Adja'.' 'Umar said: 'I heard the Messenger of Allahﷺ saying,"Ajda' is a devil."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هَاشِمُ بْنُ الْقَاسِمِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَقِيلٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُجَالِدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، قَالَ لَقِيتُ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ فَقَالَ مَنْ أَنْتَ فَقُلْتُ مَسْرُوقُ بْنُ الأَجْدَعِ . فَقَالَ عُمَرُ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ  " الأَجْدَعُ شَيْطَانٌ " .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3731

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3732

chapter.englishTitle: Changing Names

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that:
            "Zainab used to be called "Barrah" (good), and it was said that she was praising herself. So the Messenger of Allahﷺ changed her name to Zainab."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that:
hadiths.body: "Zainab used to be called "Barrah" (good), and it was said that she was praising herself. So the Messenger of Allahﷺ changed her name to Zainab."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا غُنْدَرٌ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ أَبِي مَيْمُونَةَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا رَافِعٍ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ زَيْنَبَ، كَانَ اسْمُهَا بَرَّةَ فَقِيلَ لَهَا تُزَكِّي نَفْسَهَا فَسَمَّاهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ زَيْنَبَ .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3732

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3733

chapter.englishTitle: Changing Names

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Ibn Umar that:
            "a daughter of 'Umar was Asiyah(disobedient) then the Messenger of Allahﷺ named her 'Jamilah' (beautiful)."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Ibn Umar that:
hadiths.body: "a daughter of 'Umar was Asiyah(disobedient) then the Messenger of Allahﷺ named her 'Jamilah' (beautiful)."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ مُوسَى، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ ابْنَةً لِعُمَرَ، كَانَ يُقَالُ لَهَا عَاصِيَةُ فَسَمَّاهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ جَمِيلَةَ .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3733

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3734

chapter.englishTitle: Changing Names

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Abdullah bin Salam said:
            "I came to the Messenger of Allahﷺ, and my name was not Abdullah bin Salam. The Messenger of Allahﷺ named me Abdullah bin Salam."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Abdullah bin Salam said:
hadiths.body: "I came to the Messenger of Allahﷺ, and my name was not Abdullah bin Salam. The Messenger of Allahﷺ named me Abdullah bin Salam."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَعْلَى أَبُو الْمُحَيَّاةِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَى ابْنُ أَخِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ سَلاَمٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ سَلاَمٍ، قَالَ قَدِمْتُ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَلَيْسَ اسْمِي عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ سَلاَمٍ فَسَمَّانِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ سَلاَمٍ .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3734

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3735

chapter.arabicTitle: باب الْجَمْعِ بَيْنَ اسْمِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ وَكُنْيَتِهِ
chapter.englishTitle: Combining the name and the kunyah of the Prophet(SAW)

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Muhammad that they heard Abu Hurairah say:
            "Abul Qasimﷺ said: 'Call yourselves by my name but do not call yourselves by my Kunyah."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Muhammad that they heard Abu Hurairah say:
hadiths.body: "Abul Qasimﷺ said: 'Call yourselves by my name but do not call yourselves by my Kunyah."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، يَقُولُ قَالَ أَبُو الْقَاسِمِ ﷺ  " تَسَمَّوْا بِاسْمِي وَلاَ تَكَنَّوْا بِكُنْيَتِي " .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3735

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3736

chapter.arabicTitle: باب الْجَمْعِ بَيْنَ اسْمِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ وَكُنْيَتِهِ
chapter.englishTitle: Combining the name and the kunyah of the Prophet(SAW)

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Jabir that the Messenger of Allahﷺ said:
            "Call yourselves by my name but do not call yourselves by my Kunyah."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Jabir that the Messenger of Allahﷺ said:
hadiths.body: "Call yourselves by my name but do not call yourselves by my Kunyah."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " تَسَمَّوْا بِاسْمِي وَلاَ تَكَنَّوْا بِكُنْيَتِي " .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3736

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3737

chapter.arabicTitle: باب الْجَمْعِ بَيْنَ اسْمِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ وَكُنْيَتِهِ
chapter.englishTitle: Combining the name and the kunyah of the Prophet(SAW)

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Anas said:
            "The Messenger of Allahﷺ was in Baqi', and a man called out to another man: 'O Abul-Qasim!' The Messenger of Allahﷺ turned to him, and he said: 'I didn't mean you.' The Messenger of Allahﷺ said: 'Call yourselves by my name but do not call yourselves by my Kunyah.'"
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Anas said:
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allahﷺ was in Baqi', and a man called out to another man: 'O Abul-Qasim!' The Messenger of Allahﷺ turned to him, and he said: 'I didn't mean you.' The Messenger of Allahﷺ said: 'Call yourselves by my name but do not call yourselves by my Kunyah.'"
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ الثَّقَفِيُّ، عَنْ حُمَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ بِالْبَقِيعِ فَنَادَى رَجُلٌ رَجُلاً يَا أَبَا الْقَاسِمِ فَالْتَفَتَ إِلَيْهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَقَالَ إِنِّي لَمْ أَعْنِكَ . فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " تَسَمَّوْا بِاسْمِي وَلاَ تَكْتَنُوا بِكُنْيَتِي " .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3737

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3738

chapter.arabicTitle: باب الرَّجُلِ يُكَنَّى قَبْلَ أَنْ يُولَدَ لَهُ
chapter.englishTitle: A man being given a kunyah before he has a child

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Hamzah bin Suhaib that Umar said to Suhaib:
            "Why are you called Abu Yahya when you do not have a son?" He said: "The Messenger of Allahﷺ gave me the Kunya of Abu Yahya."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Hamzah bin Suhaib that Umar said to Suhaib:
hadiths.body: "Why are you called Abu Yahya when you do not have a son?" He said: "The Messenger of Allahﷺ gave me the Kunya of Abu Yahya."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَبِي بُكَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَقِيلٍ، عَنْ حَمْزَةَ بْنِ صُهَيْبٍ، أَنَّ عُمَرَ، قَالَ لِصُهَيْبٍ مَا لَكَ تَكْتَنِي بِأَبِي يَحْيَى وَلَيْسَ لَكَ وَلَدٌ . قَالَ كَنَّانِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ بِأَبِي يَحْيَى .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3738

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3739

chapter.arabicTitle: باب الرَّجُلِ يُكَنَّى قَبْلَ أَنْ يُولَدَ لَهُ
chapter.englishTitle: A man being given a kunyah before he has a child

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Aisha that she said to the Prophet ﷺ:
            "All of your wives have a Kunyah except me." He said: "You are Umm Abdullah".
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Aisha that she said to the Prophet ﷺ:
hadiths.body: "All of your wives have a Kunyah except me." He said: "You are Umm Abdullah".
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ مَوْلًى، لِلزُّبَيْرِ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، . أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ لِلنَّبِيِّ ﷺ كُلُّ أَزْوَاجِكَ كَنَّيْتَهُ غَيْرِي . قَالَ  " فَأَنْتِ أُمُّ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ " .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3739

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3740

chapter.arabicTitle: باب الرَّجُلِ يُكَنَّى قَبْلَ أَنْ يُولَدَ لَهُ
chapter.englishTitle: A man being given a kunyah before he has a child

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Anas said:
            "The Prophet ﷺ used to come to us and say to a brother of mine, who was small: 'O Abu Umair.'".
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Anas said:
hadiths.body: "The Prophet ﷺ used to come to us and say to a brother of mine, who was small: 'O Abu Umair.'".
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي التَّيَّاحِ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ يَأْتِينَا فَيَقُولُ لأَخٍ لِي وَكَانَ صَغِيرًا  " يَا أَبَا عُمَيْرٍ " .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3740

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3741

chapter.englishTitle: Nicknames

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Abu Jabirah bin Dahhak said:
            "(Allah's saying) "Nor insult one another by nicknames(Surah Al Hujarat 49:11)" was revealed concerning us, the Ansar. When the Prophet ﷺ came to us, a man among us would have two or three names, and the Prophet ﷺ might call him by one of those names, only to be told: "O Messenger of Allahﷺ, he does not like that name." Then:"Nor insult one another by nicknames." was revealed."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Abu Jabirah bin Dahhak said:
hadiths.body: "(Allah's saying) "Nor insult one another by nicknames(Surah Al Hujarat 49:11)" was revealed concerning us, the Ansar. When the Prophet ﷺ came to us, a man among us would have two or three names, and the Prophet ﷺ might call him by one of those names, only to be told: "O Messenger of Allahﷺ, he does not like that name." Then:"Nor insult one another by nicknames." was revealed."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ إِدْرِيسَ، عَنْ دَاوُدَ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي جَبِيرَةَ بْنِ الضَّحَّاكِ، قَالَ فِينَا نَزَلَتْ مَعْشَرَ الأَنْصَارِ {وَلاَ تَنَابَزُوا بِالأَلْقَابِ) قَدِمَ عَلَيْنَا النَّبِيُّ ﷺ وَالرَّجُلُ مِنَّا لَهُ الاِسْمَانِ وَالثَّلاَثَةُ فَكَانَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ رُبَّمَا دَعَاهُمْ بِبَعْضِ تِلْكَ الأَسْمَاءِ فَيُقَالُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّهُ يَغْضَبُ مِنْ هَذَا . فَنَزَلَتْ {وَلاَ تَنَابَزُوا بِالأَلْقَابِ} .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3741

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3742

chapter.englishTitle: Praise

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Miqdad bin 'Amr said:
            "The Messenger of Allahﷺ commanded us to throw dust in the faces of those who praise others."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Miqdad bin 'Amr said:
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allahﷺ commanded us to throw dust in the faces of those who praise others."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ حَبِيبِ بْنِ أَبِي ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ الْمِقْدَادِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو، قَالَ أَمَرَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَنْ نَحْثُوَ فِي وُجُوهِ الْمَدَّاحِينَ التُّرَابَ .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3742

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3743

chapter.englishTitle: Praise

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Muawiyah said:
            "I heard the Messenger of Allahﷺ say: 'Beware of praising one another, for it is slaughtering (one another).'"
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Muawiyah said:
hadiths.body: "I heard the Messenger of Allahﷺ say: 'Beware of praising one another, for it is slaughtering (one another).'"
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا غُنْدَرٌ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَوْفٍ، عَنْ مَعْبَدٍ الْجُهَنِيِّ، عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ  " إِيَّاكُمْ وَالتَّمَادُحَ فَإِنَّهُ الذَّبْحُ " .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3743

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3744

chapter.englishTitle: Praise

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abdur-Rahman bin Abu Bakrah that his father said:
            "A man praised another man in the presence of Messenger of Allahﷺ. The Messenger of Allahﷺ said: 'Woe to you,you have cut the neck of your companion,'several times. Then he said: 'If anyone of you praises his brother, let him say: "I think he is lie this, but I do not sanctify anyone before Allah."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abdur-Rahman bin Abu Bakrah that his father said:
hadiths.body: "A man praised another man in the presence of Messenger of Allahﷺ. The Messenger of Allahﷺ said: 'Woe to you,you have cut the neck of your companion,'several times. Then he said: 'If anyone of you praises his brother, let him say: "I think he is lie this, but I do not sanctify anyone before Allah."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شَبَابَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ خَالِدٍ الْحَذَّاءِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ مَدَحَ رَجُلٌ رَجُلاً عِنْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ " وَيْحَكَ قَطَعْتَ عُنُقَ صَاحِبِكَ " . مِرَارًا ثُمَّ قَالَ " إِنْ كَانَ أَحَدُكُمْ مَادِحًا أَخَاهُ فَلْيَقُلْ أَحْسِبُهُ وَلاَ أُزَكِّي عَلَى اللَّهِ أَحَدًا " .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3744

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3745

chapter.englishTitle: One who is consulted is entrusted

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allahﷺ said:
            "One who is consulted is entrusted."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allahﷺ said:
hadiths.body: "One who is consulted is entrusted."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَبِي بُكَيْرٍ، عَنْ شَيْبَانَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " الْمُسْتَشَارُ مُؤْتَمَنٌ " .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3745

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3746

chapter.englishTitle: One who is consulted is entrusted

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Mas'ud that the Messenger of Allahﷺ said:
            "One who is consulted is entrusted."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Mas'ud that the Messenger of Allahﷺ said:
hadiths.body: "One who is consulted is entrusted."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَسْوَدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ، عَنْ شَرِيكٍ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي عَمْرٍو الشَّيْبَانِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي مَسْعُودٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " الْمُسْتَشَارُ مُؤْتَمَنٌ " .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3746

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3747

chapter.englishTitle: One who is consulted is entrusted

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Jabir that that the Messenger of Allahﷺ said:
            "If one of you consults his brother, then let him advise him."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Jabir that that the Messenger of Allahﷺ said:
hadiths.body: "If one of you consults his brother, then let him advise him."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ زَكَرِيَّا بْنِ أَبِي زَائِدَةَ، وَعَلِيُّ بْنُ هَاشِمٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " إِذَا اسْتَشَارَ أَحَدُكُمْ أَخَاهُ فَلْيُشِرْ عَلَيْهِ " .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3747

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3748

chapter.englishTitle: Entering Bathhouses

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Abdullah bin Amr said:
            "The Messenger of Allahﷺ said: 'You will conquer the lands of the non-Arabs, where you will find houses called Hammamat (bathhouses). Men Should only enter them wearing a waist wrap, and do not let women enter them unless they are sick or bleeding following childbirth."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Abdullah bin Amr said:
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allahﷺ said: 'You will conquer the lands of the non-Arabs, where you will find houses called Hammamat (bathhouses). Men Should only enter them wearing a waist wrap, and do not let women enter them unless they are sick or bleeding following childbirth."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَةُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِي، يَعْلَى وَجَعْفَرُ بْنُ عَوْنٍ جَمِيعًا عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ زِيَادِ بْنِ أَنْعُمٍ الإِفْرِيقِيِّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ رَافِعٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " تُفْتَحُ لَكُمْ أَرْضُ الأَعَاجِمِ وَسَتَجِدُونَ فِيهَا بُيُوتًا يُقَالُ لَهَا الْحَمَّامَاتُ فَلاَ يَدْخُلْهَا الرِّجَالُ إِلاَّ بِإِزَارٍ وَامْنَعُوا النِّسَاءَ أَنْ يَدْخُلْنَهَا إِلاَّ مَرِيضَةً أَوْ نُفَسَاءَ " .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3748

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3749

chapter.englishTitle: Entering Bathhouses

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Aisha that the Prophet ﷺ:
            forbade men and women to enter bathhouses, then he allowed men to enter them wearing a waist wrap, but he did not make the same allowance for women.
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Aisha that the Prophet ﷺ:
hadiths.body: forbade men and women to enter bathhouses, then he allowed men to enter them wearing a waist wrap, but he did not make the same allowance for women.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَفَّانُ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، أَنْبَأَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ شَدَّادٍ، عَنْ أَبِي عُذْرَةَ، - قَالَ وَكَانَ قَدْ أَدْرَكَ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ - عَنْ عَائِشَةَ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ نَهَى الرِّجَالَ وَالنِّسَاءَ مِنَ الْحَمَّامَاتِ ثُمَّ رَخَّصَ لِلرِّجَالِ أَنْ يَدْخُلُوهَا فِي الْمَيَازِرِ وَلَمْ يُرَخِّصْ لِلنِّسَاءِ .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3749

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3750

chapter.englishTitle: Entering Bathhouses

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Malih AL-HUdhail that some women from the people of Hims asked permission to enter upon Aisha. She said:
            "Perhaps you are among those (women) who enter bathhouses? I heard the Messenger of Allahﷺ say: 'Any woman who takes off her clothes anywhere but in her husband's house, has torn the screen between her and Allah.'"
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Malih AL-HUdhail that some women from the people of Hims asked permission to enter upon Aisha. She said:
hadiths.body: "Perhaps you are among those (women) who enter bathhouses? I heard the Messenger of Allahﷺ say: 'Any woman who takes off her clothes anywhere but in her husband's house, has torn the screen between her and Allah.'"
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ أَبِي الْجَعْدِ، عَنْ أَبِي الْمَلِيحِ الْهُذَلِيِّ، أَنَّ نِسْوَةً، مِنْ أَهْلِ حِمْصَ اسْتَأْذَنَّ عَلَى عَائِشَةَ فَقَالَتْ لَعَلَّكُنَّ مِنَ اللَّوَاتِي يَدْخُلْنَ الْحَمَّامَاتِ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ  " أَيُّمَا امْرَأَةٍ وَضَعَتْ ثِيَابَهَا فِي غَيْرِ بَيْتِ زَوْجِهَا فَقَدْ هَتَكَتْ سِتْرَ مَا بَيْنَهَا وَبَيْنَ اللَّهِ " .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3750

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3751

chapter.englishTitle: Applying Hair removing chemical

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Umm Salamah that when the Prophet ﷺ would apply (it):
            he began with his private area, coating it with hair removing chemical. And his wife would do the remainder of his body.
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Umm Salamah that when the Prophet ﷺ would apply (it):
hadiths.body: he began with his private area, coating it with hair removing chemical. And his wife would do the remainder of his body.
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هَاشِمٍ الرُّمَّانِيِّ، عَنْ حَبِيبِ بْنِ أَبِي ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ كَانَ إِذَا اطَّلَى بَدَأَ بِعَوْرَتِهِ فَطَلاَهَا بِالنُّورَةِ وَسَائِرَ جَسَدِهِ أَهْلُهُ .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3751

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3752

chapter.englishTitle: Applying Hair removing chemical

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Umm Salamah that:
            "the Prophet ﷺ would coat (with hair removing chemical) and remove the pubic hairs with his hand."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Umm Salamah that:
hadiths.body: "the Prophet ﷺ would coat (with hair removing chemical) and remove the pubic hairs with his hand."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنِي إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ كَامِلٍ أَبِي الْعَلاَءِ، عَنْ حَبِيبِ بْنِ أَبِي ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ اطَّلَى وَوَلِيَ عَانَتَهُ بِيَدِهِ .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3752

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3753

chapter.englishTitle: Stories (for the purpose of exhortation)

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Amr bin Shuaib, from his father, from his grandfather, that the Messenger of Allahﷺ said:
            "No one tells the stories to the people (for the purpose of exhortation) except a ruler, one appointed by a ruler, or a show-off."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Amr bin Shuaib, from his father, from his grandfather, that the Messenger of Allahﷺ said:
hadiths.body: "No one tells the stories to the people (for the purpose of exhortation) except a ruler, one appointed by a ruler, or a show-off."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْهِقْلُ بْنُ زِيَادٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَوْزَاعِيُّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَامِرٍ الأَسْلَمِيِّ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ شُعَيْبٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ  " لاَ يَقُصُّ عَلَى النَّاسِ إِلاَّ أَمِيرٌ أَوْ مَأْمُورٌ أَوْ مُرَاءٍ " .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3753

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3754

chapter.englishTitle: Stories (for the purpose of exhortation)

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Ibn Umar said:
            "Stories (for the purpose of exhortation) were unknown at the time of the Messenger of Allahﷺ, the time of Abu Bakr and Umar."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Ibn Umar said:
hadiths.body: "Stories (for the purpose of exhortation) were unknown at the time of the Messenger of Allahﷺ, the time of Abu Bakr and Umar."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنِ الْعُمَرِيِّ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ لَمْ يَكُنِ الْقَصَصُ فِي زَمَنِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَلاَ زَمَنِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ وَلاَ زَمَنِ عُمَرَ .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3754

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3755

chapter.englishTitle: Poetry

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Ubbay bin Ka'b that the Messenger of Allahﷺ said:
            "In some poetry there is wisdom."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Ubbay bin Ka'b that the Messenger of Allahﷺ said:
hadiths.body: "In some poetry there is wisdom."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ، عَنْ يُونُسَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ، عَنْ مَرْوَانَ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الأَسْوَدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ يَغُوثَ، عَنْ أُبَىِّ بْنِ كَعْبٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ  " إِنَّ مِنَ الشِّعْرِ لَحِكْمَةً " .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3755

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3756

chapter.englishTitle: Poetry

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Ibn Abbas that the Prophet ﷺ said:
            "In some poetry there is wisdom."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Ibn Abbas that the Prophet ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: "In some poetry there is wisdom."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ زَائِدَةَ، عَنِ سِمَاكٍ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ كَانَ يَقُولُ  " إِنَّ مِنَ الشِّعْرِ حِكَمًا " .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3756

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3757

chapter.englishTitle: Poetry

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allahﷺ said:
            "The truest of wods spoken by the poet are the words of Labid: Everything except Allah is false.' And Abu Umayyah bin Abu Salt nearly accepted Islam."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allahﷺ said:
hadiths.body: "The truest of wods spoken by the poet are the words of Labid: Everything except Allah is false.' And Abu Umayyah bin Abu Salt nearly accepted Islam."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الصَّبَّاحِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ  " أَصْدَقُ كَلِمَةٍ قَالَهَا الشَّاعِرُ كَلِمَةُ لَبِيدٍ أَلاَ كُلُّ شَىْءٍ مَا خَلاَ اللَّهَ بَاطِلُ وَكَادَ أُمَيَّةُ بْنُ أَبِي الصَّلْتِ أَنْ يُسْلِمَ " .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3757

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3758

chapter.englishTitle: Poetry

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Amr bin Sharid that his father said:
            "I recited one hundered verses of the poetry of Umayyah bin Abu Salt to the Messenger of Allahﷺ, and after every line he said, "More". And he said: "He nearly accepted Islam."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Amr bin Sharid that his father said:
hadiths.body: "I recited one hundered verses of the poetry of Umayyah bin Abu Salt to the Messenger of Allahﷺ, and after every line he said, "More". And he said: "He nearly accepted Islam."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عِيسَى بْنُ يُونُسَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ يَعْلَى، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ الشَّرِيدِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ أَنْشَدْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ مِائَةَ قَافِيَةٍ مِنْ شِعْرِ أُمَيَّةَ بْنِ أَبِي الصَّلْتِ يَقُولُ بَيْنَ كُلِّ قَافِيَةٍ " هِيهِ " . وَقَالَ " كَادَ أَنْ يُسْلِمَ " .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3758

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3759

chapter.englishTitle: What kind of poetry is undesirable

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allahﷺ said:
            "If a man were to fill his stomach completely with pus until it destroyed him, that would be better for him than filling (his mind) with poetry."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allahﷺ said:
hadiths.body: "If a man were to fill his stomach completely with pus until it destroyed him, that would be better for him than filling (his mind) with poetry."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصٌ، وَأَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ وَوَكِيعٌ عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " لأَنْ يَمْتَلِئَ جَوْفُ الرَّجُلِ قَيْحًا حَتَّى يَرِيَهُ خَيْرٌ لَهُ مِنْ أَنْ يَمْتَلِئَ شِعْرًا " . إِلاَّ أَنَّ حَفْصًا لَمْ يَقُلْ يَرِيَهُ .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3759

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3760

chapter.englishTitle: What kind of poetry is undesirable

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Sad bin Abu Waqas that the Prophet ﷺ said:
            "If a man were to fill his stomach completely with pus until it destroyed him, that would be better for him than filling (his mind) with poetry."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Sad bin Abu Waqas that the Prophet ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: "If a man were to fill his stomach completely with pus until it destroyed him, that would be better for him than filling (his mind) with poetry."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنِي قَتَادَةُ، عَنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سَعْدِ بْنِ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ قَالَ  " لأَنْ يَمْتَلِئَ جَوْفُ أَحَدِكُمْ قَيْحًا حَتَّى يَرِيَهُ خَيْرٌ لَهُ مِنْ أَنْ يَمْتَلِئَ شِعْرًا " .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3760

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3761

chapter.englishTitle: What kind of poetry is undesirable

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Aisha that the Messenger of Allahﷺ said:
            "The worst of all people lying is a man who trades insults with another man, disparaging the entire tribe, and a man who denies his father and accuses his mother of adultery."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Aisha that the Messenger of Allahﷺ said:
hadiths.body: "The worst of all people lying is a man who trades insults with another man, disparaging the entire tribe, and a man who denies his father and accuses his mother of adultery."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، عَنْ شَيْبَانَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مُرَّةَ، عَنْ يُوسُفَ بْنِ مَاهَكَ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " إِنَّ أَعْظَمَ النَّاسِ فِرْيَةً لَرَجُلٌ هَاجَى رَجُلاً فَهَجَا الْقَبِيلَةَ بِأَسْرِهَا وَرَجُلٌ انْتَفَى مِنْ أَبِيهِ وَزَنَّى أُمَّهُ " .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3761

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3762

chapter.englishTitle: Playing Backgammon

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Abu Musa said:
            "The Messenger of Allahﷺ said: 'Whoever plays backgammon has disobeyed Allah and His Messenger.'"
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Abu Musa said:
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allahﷺ said: 'Whoever plays backgammon has disobeyed Allah and His Messenger.'"
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحِيمِ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، وَأَبُو أُسَامَةَ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي هِنْدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " مَنْ لَعِبَ بِالنَّرْدِ فَقَدْ عَصَى اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ " .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3762

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3763

chapter.englishTitle: Playing Backgammon

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Sulaiman bin Buraidah from his father that the Prophet ﷺ said:
            "Whoever plays backgammon, it is as if he dipped his hand in the flesh and blood of a pig."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Sulaiman bin Buraidah from his father that the Prophet ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: "Whoever plays backgammon, it is as if he dipped his hand in the flesh and blood of a pig."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، وَأَبُو أُسَامَةَ عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ بْنِ مَرْثَدٍ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ بُرَيْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ  " مَنْ لَعِبَ بِالنَّرْدَشِيرِ فَكَأَنَّمَا غَمَسَ يَدَهُ فِي لَحْمِ خِنْزِيرٍ وَدَمِهِ " .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3763

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3764

chapter.englishTitle: Playing with Pigeons

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from 'Aishah that the Prophet ﷺ looked at a man who was chasing a bird and said:
            "A devil chasing a devil."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from 'Aishah that the Prophet ﷺ looked at a man who was chasing a bird and said:
hadiths.body: "A devil chasing a devil."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَامِرِ بْنِ زُرَارَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ نَظَرَ إِلَى إِنْسَانٍ يَتْبَعُ طَائِرًا فَقَالَ  " شَيْطَانٌ يَتْبَعُ شَيْطَانًا " .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3764

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3765

chapter.englishTitle: Playing with Pigeons

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Prophet ﷺ saw a man chasing a pigeon and said:
            "A male devil following a female devil."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Prophet ﷺ saw a man chasing a pigeon and said:
hadiths.body: "A male devil following a female devil."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَسْوَدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ، عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ رَأَى رَجُلاً يَتْبَعُ حَمَامَةً فَقَالَ  " شَيْطَانٌ يَتْبَعُ شَيْطَانَةً " .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3765

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3766

chapter.englishTitle: Playing with Pigeons

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Uthman bin Affan that the Messenger of Allahﷺ saw a man following a pigeon and said:
            "A male devil chasing a female devil."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Uthman bin Affan that the Messenger of Allahﷺ saw a man following a pigeon and said:
hadiths.body: "A male devil chasing a female devil."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سُلَيْمٍ الطَّائِفِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ أَبِي الْحَسَنِ، عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ عَفَّانَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ رَأَى رَجُلاً وَرَاءَ حَمَامَةٍ فَقَالَ  " شَيْطَانٌ يَتْبَعُ شَيْطَانَةً " .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3766

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3767

chapter.englishTitle: Playing with Pigeons

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Anas bin Malik said:
            "The Messenger of Allahﷺ saw a man chasing a pigeon and said: 'A devil chasing a devil.'"
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Anas bin Malik said:
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allahﷺ saw a man chasing a pigeon and said: 'A devil chasing a devil.'"
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نَصْرٍ، مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ خَلَفٍ الْعَسْقَلاَنِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا رَوَّادُ بْنُ الْجَرَّاحِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو سَعْدٍ السَّاعِدِيُّ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ رَأَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ رَجُلاً يَتْبَعُ حَمَامًا فَقَالَ  " شَيْطَانٌ يَتْبَعُ شَيْطَانًا " .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3767

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3768

chapter.englishTitle: It is undesirable to be alone

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Ibn 'Umar that the Messenger of Allahﷺ said:
            "If anyone of you knew what is wrong with being alone, no one would travel at night by himself."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Ibn 'Umar that the Messenger of Allahﷺ said:
hadiths.body: "If anyone of you knew what is wrong with being alone, no one would travel at night by himself."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ عَاصِمِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " لَوْ يَعْلَمُ أَحَدُكُمْ مَا فِي الْوَحْدَةِ مَا سَارَ أَحَدٌ بِلَيْلٍ وَحْدَهُ " .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3768

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3769

chapter.englishTitle: Extinguishing the fire when going to sleep

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Salim, from his father, that the Prophet ﷺ said:
            "Do not leave fire in your houses when you go to sleep."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Salim, from his father, that the Prophet ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: "Do not leave fire in your houses when you go to sleep."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ قَالَ  " لاَ تَتْرُكُوا النَّارَ فِي بُيُوتِكُمْ حِينَ تَنَامُونَ " .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3769

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3770

chapter.englishTitle: Extinguishing the fire when going to sleep

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Abu Musa said:
            "A house burned down in Al-Madinah, with its occupants inside. The Prophet ﷺ was told of what had happened, and he said: 'This fire is an enemy to you. When you go to sleep, extinguish it.'"
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Abu Musa said:
hadiths.body: "A house burned down in Al-Madinah, with its occupants inside. The Prophet ﷺ was told of what had happened, and he said: 'This fire is an enemy to you. When you go to sleep, extinguish it.'"
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ بُرَيْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى، قَالَ احْتَرَقَ بَيْتٌ بِالْمَدِينَةِ عَلَى أَهْلِهِ فَحُدِّثَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ بِشَأْنِهِمْ فَقَالَ  " إِنَّمَا هَذِهِ النَّارُ عَدُوٌّ لَكُمْ فَإِذَا نِمْتُمْ فَأَطْفِئُوهَا عَنْكُمْ " .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3770

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3771

chapter.englishTitle: Extinguishing the fire when going to sleep

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Jabir said:
            "The Messenger of Allahﷺ commanded us (to do some things) and forbade us (to do some things), and he commanded us to extinguish our lamps."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Jabir said:
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allahﷺ commanded us (to do some things) and forbade us (to do some things), and he commanded us to extinguish our lamps."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ أَمَرَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَنَهَانَا فَأَمَرَنَا أَنْ نُطْفِئَ سِرَاجَنَا .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3771

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3772

chapter.arabicTitle: باب النَّهْىِ عَنِ النُّزُولِ، عَلَى الطَّرِيقِ
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of camping in the road

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Jabir that the Messenger of Allahﷺ said:
            "Do not camp on the middle of the road, or relieve yourselves there."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Jabir that the Messenger of Allahﷺ said:
hadiths.body: "Do not camp on the middle of the road, or relieve yourselves there."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ، أَنْبَأَنَا هِشَامٌ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " لاَ تَنْزِلُوا عَلَى جَوَادِّ الطَّرِيقِ وَلاَ تَقْضُوا عَلَيْهَا الْحَاجَاتِ " .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3772

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3773

chapter.englishTitle: Three people riding on one animal

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abdullah bin Ja'far said:
            "Whenever the Messenger of Allahﷺ came back from a journey, he would be met by us(children). (One day) he was met by me and Hasan or Husain. He made one of us ride in front of him and the other behind him, until we came to Al-Madinah."
hadiths.narrator: Abdullah bin Ja'far said:
hadiths.body: "Whenever the Messenger of Allahﷺ came back from a journey, he would be met by us(children). (One day) he was met by me and Hasan or Husain. He made one of us ride in front of him and the other behind him, until we came to Al-Madinah."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحِيمِ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ عَاصِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُوَرِّقٌ الْعِجْلِيُّ، حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ إِذَا قَدِمَ مِنْ سَفَرٍ تُلُقِّيَ بِنَا . قَالَ فَتُلُقِّيَ بِي وَبِالْحَسَنِ أَوْ بِالْحُسَيْنِ . قَالَ فَحَمَلَ أَحَدَنَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ وَالآخَرَ خَلْفَهُ حَتَّى قَدِمْنَا الْمَدِينَةَ " .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3773

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3774

chapter.englishTitle: Putting dust on writings

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Jabir that the Messenger of Allahﷺ said:
            "Put dust on your writings, because it is better, and dust is blessed (being humble in correspondence brings good results)."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Jabir that the Messenger of Allahﷺ said:
hadiths.body: "Put dust on your writings, because it is better, and dust is blessed (being humble in correspondence brings good results)."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ، أَنْبَأَنَا بَقِيَّةُ، أَنْبَأَنَا أَبُو أَحْمَدَ الدِّمَشْقِيُّ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ  " تَرِّبُوا صُحُفَكُمْ أَنْجَحُ لَهَا إِنَّ التُّرَابَ مُبَارَكٌ " .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3774

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3775

chapter.arabicTitle: باب لاَ يَتَنَاجَى اثْنَانِ دُونَ الثَّالِثِ
chapter.englishTitle: Two should not converse to the exclusion of a third

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abdullah that the Messenger of Allahﷺ said:
            "When you are three, two should not converse (privately) to the exclusion of their companion, because that makes him sad."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abdullah that the Messenger of Allahﷺ said:
hadiths.body: "When you are three, two should not converse (privately) to the exclusion of their companion, because that makes him sad."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، وَوَكِيعٌ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ شَقِيقٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " إِذَا كُنْتُمْ ثَلاَثَةً فَلاَ يَتَنَاجَى اثْنَانِ دُونَ صَاحِبِهِمَا فَإِنَّ ذَلِكَ يُحْزِنُهُ " .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3775

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3776

chapter.arabicTitle: باب لاَ يَتَنَاجَى اثْنَانِ دُونَ الثَّالِثِ
chapter.englishTitle: Two should not converse to the exclusion of a third

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Ibn 'Umar said:
            "The Messenger of Allahﷺ forbade two to converse (privately) to the exclusion of a third."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Ibn 'Umar said:
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allahﷺ forbade two to converse (privately) to the exclusion of a third."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَنْ يَتَنَاجَى اثْنَانِ دُونَ الثَّالِثِ .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3776

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3777

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَنْ كَانَ مَعَهُ سِهَامٌ فَلْيَأْخُذْ بِنِصَالِهَا
chapter.englishTitle: A person who has arrows should carry them by their heads

hadiths.englishRaw:
Jabir bin 'Abdullah said:
            "A man passed through the masjid with some arrows, and the Messenger of Allahﷺ said: 'Hold them by their heads!' He said: 'Yes(ok).'"
hadiths.narrator: Jabir bin 'Abdullah said:
hadiths.body: "A man passed through the masjid with some arrows, and the Messenger of Allahﷺ said: 'Hold them by their heads!' He said: 'Yes(ok).'"
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفَيْانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، قَالَ قُلْتُ لِعَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ سَمِعْتَ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، يَقُولُ مَرَّ رَجُلٌ بِسِهَامٍ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " أَمْسِكْ بِنِصَالِهَا " . قَالَ نَعَمْ .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3777

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3778

chapter.arabicTitle: باب مَنْ كَانَ مَعَهُ سِهَامٌ فَلْيَأْخُذْ بِنِصَالِهَا
chapter.englishTitle: A person who has arrows should carry them by their heads

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Musa that the Prophet ﷺ said:
            "When anyone of you passes through our masjid or our marketplace carrying arrows, let him hold them by their heads, lest he hurt any Muslims."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Musa that the Prophet ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: "When anyone of you passes through our masjid or our marketplace carrying arrows, let him hold them by their heads, lest he hurt any Muslims."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا مَحْمُودُ بْنُ غَيْلاَنَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ بُرَيْدٍ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ  " إِذَا مَرَّ أَحَدُكُمْ فِي مَسْجِدِنَا أَوْ فِي سُوقِنَا وَمَعَهُ نَبْلٌ فَلْيُمْسِكْ عَلَى نِصَالِهَا بِكَفِّهِ أَنْ تُصِيبَ أَحَدًا مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ بِشَىْءٍ أَوْ فَلْيَقْبِضْ عَلَى نِصَالِهَا " .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3778

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3779

chapter.englishTitle: The rewards associated with the Quran

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Aisha that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            "The one who is proficient with the Qur'an will be with the noble and righteous scribes (the angels), and the one who reads it and stumbles over it, finding it difficult, will have a double reward."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Aisha that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: "The one who is proficient with the Qur'an will be with the noble and righteous scribes (the angels), and the one who reads it and stumbles over it, finding it difficult, will have a double reward."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عِيسَى بْنُ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي عَرُوبَةَ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ زُرَارَةَ بْنِ أَوْفَى، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " الْمَاهِرُ بِالْقُرْآنِ مَعَ السَّفَرَةِ الْكِرَامِ الْبَرَرَةِ وَالَّذِي يَقْرَؤُهُ يَتَتَعْتَعُ فِيهِ وَهُوَ عَلَيْهِ شَاقٌّ لَهُ أَجْرَانِ اثْنَانِ " .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3779

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3780

chapter.englishTitle: The rewards associated with the Quran

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Sa`eed Al-Khudri that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            "It will be said to the companion of the Qur'an, when he enters Paradise: 'Recite and rise one degree for every Verse,' until he recites the last thing that he knows."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Sa`eed Al-Khudri that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: "It will be said to the companion of the Qur'an, when he enters Paradise: 'Recite and rise one degree for every Verse,' until he recites the last thing that he knows."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى، أَنْبَأَنَا شَيْبَانُ، عَنْ فِرَاسٍ، عَنْ عَطِيَّةَ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " يُقَالُ لِصَاحِبِ الْقُرْآنِ إِذَا دَخَلَ الْجَنَّةَ اقْرَأْ وَاصْعَدْ . فَيَقْرَأُ وَيَصْعَدُ بِكُلِّ آيَةٍ دَرَجَةً حَتَّى يَقْرَأَ آخِرَ شَىْءٍ مَعَهُ " .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3780

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3781

chapter.englishTitle: The rewards associated with the Quran

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Ibn Buraidah that his father told that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            "The Quran will come on the Day of Resurrection, like a pale man, and will say: 'I am the one that kept you awake at night and made you thirsty during the day."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Ibn Buraidah that his father told that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: "The Quran will come on the Day of Resurrection, like a pale man, and will say: 'I am the one that kept you awake at night and made you thirsty during the day."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ بَشِيرِ بْنِ مُهَاجِرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ بُرَيْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " يَجِيءُ الْقُرْآنُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ كَالرَّجُلِ الشَّاحِبِ فَيَقُولُ أَنَا الَّذِي أَسْهَرْتُ لَيْلَكَ وَأَظْمَأْتُ نَهَارَكَ " .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3781

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3782

chapter.englishTitle: The rewards associated with the Quran

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            "Wouldn't anyone of you like to find three great, fat pregnant she-camels when he returns to his family?" We said: "Yes." He said: "Three verses that one of you recites during the praer are better for him than three great, fat pregnant she-camels."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: "Wouldn't anyone of you like to find three great, fat pregnant she-camels when he returns to his family?" We said: "Yes." He said: "Three verses that one of you recites during the praer are better for him than three great, fat pregnant she-camels."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَعَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ " أَيُحِبُّ أَحَدُكُمْ إِذَا رَجَعَ إِلَى أَهْلِهِ أَنْ يَجِدَ فِيهِ ثَلاَثَ خَلِفَاتٍ عِظَامٍ سِمَانٍ " . قُلْنَا نَعَمْ . قَالَ " فَثَلاَثُ آيَاتٍ يَقْرَؤُهُنَّ أَحَدُكُمْ فِي صَلاَتِهِ خَيْرٌ لَهُ مِنْ ثَلاَثِ خَلِفَاتٍ سِمَانٍ عِظَامٍ " .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3782

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3783

chapter.englishTitle: The rewards associated with the Quran

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Ibn Umar that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
            "The likeness of the Quran is that of a hobbled camel. If its owner ties its rope, he will keep it, but if he loosens its rope it will go away."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Ibn Umar that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: "The likeness of the Quran is that of a hobbled camel. If its owner ties its rope, he will keep it, but if he loosens its rope it will go away."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ الأَزْهَرِ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَنْبَأَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " مَثَلُ الْقُرْآنِ مَثَلُ الإِبِلِ الْمُعَقَّلَةِ إِنْ تَعَاهَدَهَا صَاحِبُهَا بِعُقُلِهَا أَمْسَكَهَا عَلَيْهِ وَإِنْ أَطْلَقَ عُقُلَهَا ذَهَبَتْ " .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3783

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3784

chapter.englishTitle: The rewards associated with the Quran

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Abu Hurairah said, 'I heard the Messenger of Allahﷺ say':
            "Allah said: 'I have divided the prayer between Myself and My slave into two halves, and My slave shall have what he has asked for.'When the slave says: 'Al-hamdulillah i rabbil Alameen (All the praise is to Allah, the Lord of all that exists),' Allah says:'My slave has praised Me, and My slave shall have what he has asked for.' And when he says: 'Ar-Rahmanir-Rahim (The Mos Gracious, the Most Merciful),' Allah says: 'My slave has extolled Me, and My slave shall have what he has asked for.' And when he says: 'Maliki yawmiddin [The Only Owner (and he Ruling Judge] if the Day of Recompense],' Allahs says: 'My slave has Glorified Me. This is for Me, and this Verse is between me and My slave in two halves.' And when he says: ' Iyyaka na'budu wa iyyaka nastain [You (Alone) we worship, and You (Alone) we ask for help],' He says: 'This is between Me an My slave, and My slave shall have what he has asked for.' And the end of the Surah is for My slave.' And when he says: 'Ihdinas-siratal-mustaqeema, siratal-alldhina an'amta alayhim a lad-dallin [Guide us to the Straight Way, the way of those on whom You have bestowed Your Grace, not(the way) of those who earned Your Anger, nor of those who went astray],' He says: 'THis is for My slave, and My slave shall have what he has asked for."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Abu Hurairah said, 'I heard the Messenger of Allahﷺ say':
hadiths.body: "Allah said: 'I have divided the prayer between Myself and My slave into two halves, and My slave shall have what he has asked for.'When the slave says: 'Al-hamdulillah i rabbil Alameen (All the praise is to Allah, the Lord of all that exists),' Allah says:'My slave has praised Me, and My slave shall have what he has asked for.' And when he says: 'Ar-Rahmanir-Rahim (The Mos Gracious, the Most Merciful),' Allah says: 'My slave has extolled Me, and My slave shall have what he has asked for.' And when he says: 'Maliki yawmiddin [The Only Owner (and he Ruling Judge] if the Day of Recompense],' Allahs says: 'My slave has Glorified Me. This is for Me, and this Verse is between me and My slave in two halves.' And when he says: ' Iyyaka na'budu wa iyyaka nastain [You (Alone) we worship, and You (Alone) we ask for help],' He says: 'This is between Me an My slave, and My slave shall have what he has asked for.' And the end of the Surah is for My slave.' And when he says: 'Ihdinas-siratal-mustaqeema, siratal-alldhina an'amta alayhim a lad-dallin [Guide us to the Straight Way, the way of those on whom You have bestowed Your Grace, not(the way) of those who earned Your Anger, nor of those who went astray],' He says: 'THis is for My slave, and My slave shall have what he has asked for."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مَرْوَانَ، مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُثْمَانَ الْعُثْمَانِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنِ الْعَلاَءِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ " قَالَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ قَسَمْتُ الصَّلاَةَ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَ عَبْدِي شَطْرَيْنِ فَنِصْفُهَا لِي وَنِصْفُهَا لِعَبْدِي وَلِعَبْدِي مَا سَأَلَ " . قَالَ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ " اقْرَءُوا يَقُولُ الْعَبْدُ {الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ} فَيَقُولُ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ حَمِدَنِي عَبْدِي وَلِعَبْدِي مَا سَأَلَ . فَيَقُولُ {الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيمِ} فَيَقُولُ أَثْنَى عَلَىَّ عَبْدِي وَلِعَبْدِي مَا سَأَلَ . يَقُولُ {مَالِكِ يَوْمِ الدِّينِ } فَيَقُولُ اللَّهُ مَجَّدَنِي عَبْدِي فَهَذَا لِي وَهَذِهِ الآيَةُ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَ عَبْدِي نِصْفَيْنِ يَقُولُ الْعَبْدُ {إِيَّاكَ نَعْبُدُ وَإِيَّاكَ نَسْتَعِينُ} يَعْنِي فَهَذِهِ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَ عَبْدِي وَلِعَبْدِي مَا سَأَلَ وَآخِرُ السُّورَةِ لِعَبْدِي يَقُولُ الْعَبْدُ {اهْدِنَا الصِّرَاطَ الْمُسْتَقِيمَ * صِرَاطَ الَّذِينَ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ غَيْرِ الْمَغْضُوبِ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلاَ الضَّالِّينَ} فَهَذَا لِعَبْدِي وَلِعَبْدِي مَا سَأَلَ " .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3784

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3785

chapter.englishTitle: The rewards associated with the Quran

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Abu Sa'eed bin Mu'alla said:
            "The Messenger of Allahﷺ said to me: 'Shall I not teach you the greatest Surah in the Quran before I leave the masjid?' Then the Propehtﷺ went to leave, so I reminded him, and he said: Al-hamdulillahi Rabbil-Alameen (All the praise is to Allah, the Lord of all that exists). It is the Seven Oft-Recited Verses, and it is the Grand Quran that has been given to me.'"
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Abu Sa'eed bin Mu'alla said:
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allahﷺ said to me: 'Shall I not teach you the greatest Surah in the Quran before I leave the masjid?' Then the Propehtﷺ went to leave, so I reminded him, and he said: Al-hamdulillahi Rabbil-Alameen (All the praise is to Allah, the Lord of all that exists). It is the Seven Oft-Recited Verses, and it is the Grand Quran that has been given to me.'"
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا غُنْدَرٌ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ خُبَيْبِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ حَفْصِ بْنِ عَاصِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُعَلَّى، قَالَ قَالَ لِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ " أَلاَ أُعَلِّمُكَ أَعْظَمَ سُورَةٍ فِي الْقُرْآنِ قَبْلَ أَنْ أَخْرُجَ مِنَ الْمَسْجِدِ " . قَالَ فَذَهَبَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ لِيَخْرُجَ فَأَذْكَرْتُهُ فَقَالَ " { الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ} وَهِيَ السَّبْعُ الْمَثَانِي وَالْقُرْآنُ الْعَظِيمُ الَّذِي أُوتِيتُهُ " .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3785

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3786

chapter.englishTitle: The rewards associated with the Quran

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Prophet ﷺ said:
            "There is a surah in the Qur'an, with thirty verses, which will intercede for its companion (the one who recites it) until he is forgiven: Tabarakal-ladhi bi yadihil mulk (Blessed is He in Whose Hand is the Dominion)."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Prophet ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: "There is a surah in the Qur'an, with thirty verses, which will intercede for its companion (the one who recites it) until he is forgiven: Tabarakal-ladhi bi yadihil mulk (Blessed is He in Whose Hand is the Dominion)."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ عَبَّاسٍ الْجُشَمِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ " إِنَّ سُورَةً فِي الْقُرْآنِ ثَلاَثُونَ آيَةً شَفَعَتْ لِصَاحِبِهَا حَتَّى غُفِرَ لَهُ {تَبَارَكَ الَّذِي بِيَدِهِ الْمُلْكُ} " .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3786

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3787

chapter.englishTitle: The rewards associated with the Quran

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Abu Hurairah said that the Messenger of Allahﷺ said:
            "Qul Huwa Allahu ahad [Say: He is Allah, (the) One] is equivalent to one third of the Quran."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Abu Hurairah said that the Messenger of Allahﷺ said:
hadiths.body: "Qul Huwa Allahu ahad [Say: He is Allah, (the) One] is equivalent to one third of the Quran."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ بِلاَلٍ، حَدَّثَنِي سُهَيْلٌ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ " {قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ} تَعْدِلُ ثُلُثَ الْقُرْآنِ " .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3787

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3788

chapter.englishTitle: The rewards associated with the Quran

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Anas bin Malik said:
            "The Messenger of Allahﷺ said: Qul Huwa Allahu ahad [Say: He is Allah, (the) One] is equivalent to one third of the Quran."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Anas bin Malik said:
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allahﷺ said: Qul Huwa Allahu ahad [Say: He is Allah, (the) One] is equivalent to one third of the Quran."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ الْخَلاَّلُ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ، عَنْ جَرِيرِ بْنِ حَازِمٍ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ " {قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ} تَعْدِلُ ثُلُثَ الْقُرْآنِ " .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3788

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3789

chapter.englishTitle: The rewards associated with the Quran

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Abu Masud Al Ansari said:
            "The Messenger of Allahﷺ said: "Allahu ahad, Al-Wahidus-Samad [Allah (the) One, the One the Self-Sufficient Master] is equivalent to one third of the Quran."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Abu Masud Al Ansari said:
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allahﷺ said: "Allahu ahad, Al-Wahidus-Samad [Allah (the) One, the One the Self-Sufficient Master] is equivalent to one third of the Quran."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ أَبِي قَيْسٍ الأَوْدِيِّ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مَيْمُونٍ، عَنْ أَبِي مَسْعُودٍ الأَنْصَارِيِّ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ  " اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ الْوَاحِدُ الصَّمَدُ تَعْدِلُ ثُلُثَ الْقُرْآنِ " .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3789

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3790

chapter.englishTitle: The Virtues of Remembrance (Dhikr)

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Darda that the Prophet ﷺ said:
            "Shall I not tell you of the best of your deeds, the most pleasing to your Sovereign, those that raise you most in status, that are better than your gold and silver, or meeting you enemy (in battle) and you strike their necks and they strike your necks?" They said: " WHat is that, O Messenger of Allah?" He said: "Remembering Allah(Dhikr)."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Darda that the Prophet ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: "Shall I not tell you of the best of your deeds, the most pleasing to your Sovereign, those that raise you most in status, that are better than your gold and silver, or meeting you enemy (in battle) and you strike their necks and they strike your necks?" They said: " WHat is that, O Messenger of Allah?" He said: "Remembering Allah(Dhikr)."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ كَاسِبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْمُغِيرَةُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي هِنْدٍ، عَنْ زِيَادِ بْنِ أَبِي زِيَادٍ، مَوْلَى ابْنِ عَيَّاشٍ عَنْ أَبِي بَحْرِيَّةَ، عَنْ أَبِي الدَّرْدَاءِ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ قَالَ " أَلاَ أُنَبِّئُكُمْ بِخَيْرِ أَعْمَالِكُمْ وَأَرْضَاهَا عِنْدَ مَلِيكِكُمْ وَأَرْفَعِهَا فِي دَرَجَاتِكُمْ وَخَيْرٍ لَكُمْ مِنْ إِعْطَاءِ الذَّهَبِ وَالْوَرِقِ وَمِنْ أَنْ تَلْقَوْا عَدُوَّكُمْ فَتَضْرِبُوا أَعْنَاقَهُمْ وَيَضْرِبُوا أَعْنَاقَكُمْ " . قَالُوا وَمَا ذَاكَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ " ذِكْرُ اللَّهِ " . وَقَالَ مُعَاذُ بْنُ جَبَلٍ مَا عَمِلَ امْرُؤٌ بِعَمَلٍ أَنْجَى لَهُ مِنْ عَذَابِ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ مِنْ ذِكْرِ اللَّهِ .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3790

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3791

chapter.englishTitle: The Virtues of Remembrance (Dhikr)

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated that Abu Hurairah and Abu Sa'eed bore witness that the Prophet ﷺ said:
            "No people sit in a gathering remembering Allah, But the angels surround them, mercy covers them, tranquility descends upon them and Allah remembers them before those who are with Him."
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated that Abu Hurairah and Abu Sa'eed bore witness that the Prophet ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: "No people sit in a gathering remembering Allah, But the angels surround them, mercy covers them, tranquility descends upon them and Allah remembers them before those who are with Him."
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ آدَمَ، عَنْ عَمَّارِ بْنِ رُزَيْقٍ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنِ الأَغَرِّ أَبِي مُسْلِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، وَأَبِي، سَعِيدٍ يَشْهَدَانِ بِهِ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ  " مَا جَلَسَ قَوْمٌ مَجْلِسًا يَذْكُرُونَ اللَّهَ فِيهِ إِلاَّ حَفَّتْهُمُ الْمَلاَئِكَةُ وَتَغَشَّتْهُمُ الرَّحْمَةُ وَتَنَزَّلَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ السَّكِينَةُ وَذَكَرَهُمُ اللَّهُ فِيمَنْ عِنْدَهُ " .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3791

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3792

chapter.englishTitle: The Virtues of Remembrance (Dhikr)

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Prophet ﷺ said:
            "Allah says: 'I am with My slave when he remembers Me and his lips move saying My Name.'"
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Prophet ﷺ said:
hadiths.body: "Allah says: 'I am with My slave when he remembers Me and his lips move saying My Name.'"
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مُصْعَبٍ، عَنِ الأَوْزَاعِيِّ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ أُمِّ الدَّرْدَاءِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ  " إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ يَقُولُ أَنَا مَعَ عَبْدِي إِذَا هُوَ ذَكَرَنِي وَتَحَرَّكَتْ بِي شَفَتَاهُ " .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3792

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3793

chapter.englishTitle: The Virtues of Remembrance (Dhikr)

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abdullah bin Busr that a Bedouin said to the Messenger of Allahﷺ said:
            "The laws of Islam are burdensome for me. Tell me of something that I will be able to adhere to. He said: 'Always keep your tongue moist with the remembrance of Allah, the Mighty and Sublime.'"
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abdullah bin Busr that a Bedouin said to the Messenger of Allahﷺ said:
hadiths.body: "The laws of Islam are burdensome for me. Tell me of something that I will be able to adhere to. He said: 'Always keep your tongue moist with the remembrance of Allah, the Mighty and Sublime.'"
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا زَيْدُ بْنُ الْحُبَابِ، أَخْبَرَنِي مُعَاوِيَةُ بْنُ صَالِحٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ قَيْسٍ الْكِنْدِيُّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ بُسْرٍ، أَنَّ أَعْرَابِيًّا، قَالَ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ إِنَّ شَرَائِعَ الإِسْلاَمِ قَدْ كَثُرَتْ عَلَىَّ فَأَنْبِئْنِي مِنْهَا بِشَىْءٍ أَتَشَبَّثُ بِهِ . قَالَ  " لاَ يَزَالُ لِسَانُكَ رَطْبًا مِنْ ذِكْرِ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ " .
references: Vol. 5, Book of Etiquette, Hadith 3793

hadiths.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 3794

chapter.arabicTitle: باب فَضْلِ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ
chapter.englishTitle: The Virtue of (saying) None has the right to be Worshipped but Allah

hadiths.englishRaw:
It was narrated from Abu Hurairah and Abu Saeed bore witness that the Messenger of Allahﷺ said:
            "If a person says: 'La ilaha illallahu wa Allahu Akbar (None has the right to be worshipped but Allah and Allah is the Most Great),'Allah says: 'My slave has spoken the truth; there is none worthy of worship except I, and I am the Most Great.' If a person says: La ilaha Illallah wahdahu (There is none worthy of worship except Allah alone), Allah says: 'My slave has spoken the truth; there is none worthy of worship except I, alone.' If he says, La ilaha illallahu la sharikalahu (There is none worthy of worship except Allah with no partner or associate),' Allah says: 'My slave has spoken the truth; there is none worthy of worship except I, with no partner or associate.' If he says: 'La illah illallah, lahul mulku wa lahul hamdu (There is none worthy of worship except Allah, all dominion is His and all praise is to Him),' Allah says: 'My slave has spoken the truth; there is none of worthy of worship except I, all dominion Mine and all praise is due to Me.' If he says: ' La illaha illallah, la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah (There is none worthy of worship and there is no power and no strength except with Allah),' Allah says: 'My slave has spoken then truth; there is none worthy of worship except I, and tehre is no power and no strength except with Me.' One of the narrators Abu Ishaq said: "Then Agharr (another narrator) said something that I did not understand. I said to Abu Jafar: 'What did he say?' He said: 'Whoever is blessed with (the ability to say) them (these words) at the time of death, the Fire will not touch him.'"
hadiths.narrator: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah and Abu Saeed bore witness that the Messenger of Allahﷺ said:
